arabic: كل يوم بنصحى بدري عشان نخطط للفرح الكبير
english: Every day we wake up early to plan for the big wedding.
transliteration: Koll yōm bansaa badry ʿashān nokhaṭṭeṭ lel-faraḥ el-kabīr.

arabic: أمي بتقولي إن اختيار الفستان زي اختيار رئيس الجمهورية صعب
english: My mom tells me that choosing the dress is as difficult as choosing the President of the Republic.
transliteration: Ommi betʾūli en ekhtiyār el-fostān zayy ekhtiyār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya ṣaʿb.

arabic: أنا بجمع آراء كل صحابي قبل ما أعمل اي تصويت على الديكور
english: I gather opinions from all my friends before I make any vote on the decor.
transliteration: Ana bagmaʿ ārāʾ koll ṣoḥāby ʾabl ma aʿmel ayy taṣwīt ʿala el-dīkōr.

arabic: بابا بيقول إن الموضوع محتاج حكم كويس زي حكم القضاء
english: My dad says the matter needs good judgment like the judgment of the judiciary.
transliteration: Bābā biyʾūl en el-mawḍūʿ meḥtāg ḥokm kowayyes zayy ḥokm el-qaḍāʾ.

arabic: وكل يوم بنحاول نختار الأفضل عشان الفرح يكون أحسن حاجة
english: And every day we try to choose the best so the wedding will be the best thing.
transliteration: Wa koll yōm benḥāwel nekhtār el-ʾafḍal ʿashān el-faraḥ yekūn aḥsan ḥāga.

arabic: أحمد ومنى عيلة صغيرة.
english: Ahmed and Mona are a small family.
transliteration: Ahmad we Mona 3eila soghayara.

arabic: هما عايشين في بيت بسيط في القاهرة.
english: They live in a simple house in Cairo.
transliteration: Homa 3ayeshin fi beit baset fi El Qahera.

arabic: أحمد بيشتغل كتير كل يوم.
english: Ahmed works hard every day.
transliteration: Ahmad byeshtaghal keteer kol yom.

arabic: منى بتحب تطبخ أكل حلو لأولادها.
english: Mona loves to cook delicious food for their children.
transliteration: Mona bethebb tetbokh akl helw le awladha.

arabic: ابنهم كريم بيحب يلعب كورة.
english: Their son, Karim, likes to play football.
transliteration: Ebnehom Karim beyehebb yel3ab kora.

arabic: بنتهم نورا بتحب ترسم صور جميلة.
english: Their daughter, Nora, loves to draw beautiful pictures.
transliteration: Bentehom Nora bethebb tersom sowar gamila.

arabic: كل يوم جمعة، العيلة بتاكل كشري سوا.
english: Every Friday, the family eats koshary together.
transliteration: Kol yom Gom3a, el 3eila betakel koshary sawa.

arabic: أحمد دايمًا بيساعد كريم في واجبه.
english: Ahmed always helps Karim with his homework.
transliteration: Ahmad dayman beyesa3ed Karim fi wagbo.

arabic: منى بتشتري هدوم جديدة لعرايس نورا.
english: Mona buys new clothes for Nora's dolls.
transliteration: Mona beteshtari hedoom gedida le 3arayes Nora.

arabic: في يوم من الأيام، كريم وقع من عجلته.
english: One day, Karim fell from his bicycle.
transliteration: Fi yom men el ayam, Karim weqe3 men 3agalto.

arabic: منى كانت زعلانة قوي، بس أحمد فضل قوي.
english: Mona was very sad, but Ahmed stayed strong.
transliteration: Mona kanet za3lana awi, bas Ahmad fadl awi.

arabic: هما ودوا كريم للدكتور بسرعة.
english: They took Karim to the doctor quickly.
transliteration: Homa waddaw Karim lel doktor be sor3a.

arabic: الدكتور قال، "دي خربوش صغير، متقلقوش."
english: The doctor said, "It's a small scratch, don't worry."
transliteration: El doktor aal, "Di kharboosh soghayar, mat2alaqoosh."

arabic: العيلة كانت مبسوطة تاني بعد كده.
english: The family was happy again after that.
transliteration: El 3eila kanet mabsoota tani ba3d keda.

arabic: حبهم بيخلي بيتهم الصغير بيت دافي.
english: Their love makes their small house a warm home.
transliteration: Hobbehom byekhalli beithom el soghayar beit dafi.

arabic: ليلى كانت بنت صغيرة وجميلة أوي.
english: Layla was a very small and beautiful girl.
transliteration: Layla kanet bent soghayara we gamila awi.

arabic: صحت ليلى بدري النهاردة الصبح.
english: Layla woke up early this morning.
transliteration: Sehet Layla badri ennaharda el sobh.

arabic: شافت قطتها الحلوة نايمة جنبها على السرير.
english: She saw her cute cat sleeping next to her on the bed.
transliteration: Shafet ottetha el helwa nayma gambaha 3ala el serir.

arabic: قطتها اسمها "مشمش" ولونها أبيض زي الثلج.
english: Her cat's name is "Meshmesh" and its color is white like snow.
transliteration: Ottetha esmaha "Meshmesh" we lonha abyad zay el talg.

arabic: ليلى باست مشمش وقالت: صباح الخير يا حبيبتي.
english: Layla kissed Meshmesh and said: Good morning, my dear.
transliteration: Layla baset Meshmesh we alet: Sabah el kheir ya habibty.

arabic: بعدين قامت ليلى بسرعة وراحت أوضتها.
english: Then Layla got up quickly and went to her room.
transliteration: Ba3dein amet Layla be sor3a we rahet odetha.

arabic: لبست هدومها الجديدة لونها أزرق.
english: She put on her new blue clothes.
transliteration: Lebset hedoumaha el gedida lonha azra'.

arabic: نزلت ليلى المطبخ عشان تفطر مع باباها ومامتها.
english: Layla went down to the kitchen to have breakfast with her dad and mom.
transliteration: Nezlet Layla el matbakh 3ashan teftar ma3 babaha we mametha.

arabic: ماما كانت بتعمل أطباق فول كتير وطعمية سخنة.
english: Mom was making many foul dishes and hot ta'ameya.
transliteration: Mama kanet bet3amel atbaa2 foul ketir we ta3meya sokhna.

arabic: ليلى أكلت الفول والطعمية بتاعتها بحب.
english: Layla ate her foul and ta'ameya with love.
transliteration: Layla akalet el foul we el ta3meya beta3etha be hob.

arabic: بابا قال: إحنا لازم نروح السوق النهاردة يا حلوين.
english: Dad said: We must go to the market today, my dears.
transliteration: Baba aal: Ehna lazam narouh el soo2 ennaharda ya helwein.

arabic: ليلى فرحت أوي وقالت: ياللا بينا يا بابا!
english: Layla was very happy and said: Let's go, Dad!
transliteration: Layla farehet awi we alet: Yalla bina ya Baba!

arabic: ركبوا العربية بتاعتهم وراحوا السوق الكبير في القاهرة.
english: They got into their car and went to the big market in Cairo.
transliteration: Rakbou el 3arabeya beta3ethom we rahou el soo2 el kebir fi el Qahera.

arabic: في السوق، شافوا فواكه وخضروات بألوان كتير جميلة.
english: In the market, they saw many fruits and vegetables with beautiful colors.
transliteration: Fel soo2, shafou fawakeh we khodarwat be alwan ketir gamila.

arabic: ماما اشترت تفاح أحمر ومانجا صفرا طازة.
english: Mom bought fresh red apples and yellow mangoes.
transliteration: Mama eshtaret toffah ahmar we manga safra taza.

arabic: بابا اشترى خبز سخن ولبن للبيت.
english: Dad bought hot bread and milk for the house.
transliteration: Baba eshtara khobz sokhn we laban lel beit.

arabic: ليلى شافت ألعاب كتير بس بابا قال: مرة تانية يا حبيبتي.
english: Layla saw many toys but Dad said: Another time, my dear.
transliteration: Layla shafet al3ab ketir bas Baba aal: Marra tanya ya habibty.

arabic: الناس كانت كتير في السوق وكلهم بيضحكوا.
english: People were many in the market and all of them were laughing.
transliteration: El nas kanet ketir fel soo2 we kollhom beyed7akou.

arabic: بعدين رجعوا بيتهم الجميل مبسوطين جداً.
english: Then they returned to their beautiful house, very happy.
transliteration: Ba3dein reg'ou beithom el gamil mabsootein geddan.

arabic: مشمش كانت مستنياهم عند باب الشقة.
english: Meshmesh was waiting for them at the apartment door.
transliteration: Meshmesh kanet mestanyahom 3and bab el sha2qa.

arabic: ليلى ساعدت مامتها ترص الحاجات اللي اشتروها.
english: Layla helped her mom arrange the things they bought.
transliteration: Layla sa3adet mametha teros el hagat elly eshtarouha.

arabic: بالليل، كلوا عشا لذيذ عملته ماما في المطبخ.
english: At night, they ate a delicious dinner that Mom made in the kitchen.
transliteration: Bel leil, kalou 3asha laziz 3amalto Mama fel matbakh.

arabic: ليلى قالت: النهاردة كان يوم حلو أوي يا عيلتي.
english: Layla said: Today was a very nice day, my family.
transliteration: Layla alet: Ennaharda kan yom helw awi ya 3eilty.

arabic: بابا وماما باسوا ليلى وقالوا: تصبحي على خير يا حبيبتنا.
english: Dad and Mom kissed Layla and said: Good night, our dear.
transliteration: Baba we Mama basou Layla we aalou: Tesba7i 3ala kheir ya habibetna.

arabic: ليلى نامت وهي بتحلم بألعابها الجديدة اللي هتاخدها بكره.
english: Layla slept while she was dreaming of her new toys that she would get tomorrow.
transliteration: Layla namet we heya bete7lam be al3abha el gedida elly hatakhodha bokra.

arabic: كان فيه بيت صغير في حارة جميلة.
english: There was a small house in a beautiful alley.
transliteration: Kan fih beit soghayar fi 7ara gamila.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: في البيت ده، كان ساكن ولد اسمه كريم.
english: In this house, a boy named Karim lived.
transliteration: Fi el beit da, kan saken walad esmo Karim.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: كريم كان عنده أصحاب كتير.
english: Karim had many friends.
transliteration: Karim kan 3ando as7ab ketir.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: صحاب كريم كانوا بيحبوا يلعبوا كورة.
english: Karim's friends loved to play soccer.
transliteration: Sa7ab Karim kano by7ebbo yel3abo kora.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: كل يوم بعد المدرسة، كانوا بيتجمعوا.
english: Every day after school, they gathered.
transliteration: Kol yom ba3d el madrasa, kano beyetgammo3o.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: ملعبهم كان جنب الجامع القديم.
english: Their playground was next to the old mosque.
transliteration: Mal3abhom kan ganb el game3 el adim.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: في يوم، كورتهم وقعت في البير.
english: One day, their ball fell into the well.
transliteration: Fi yom, kortohom wa2a3et fi el bir.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: العيال كانوا زعلانين أوي.
english: The kids were very sad.
transliteration: El 3eyal kano za3lanin awi.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: “مش عارفين نعمل إيه؟” قال أحمد.
english: "We don't know what to do?" Ahmed said.
transliteration: “Mesh 3arfin na3mel eh?” al Ahmed.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: كريم فكر شوية.
english: Karim thought a little.
transliteration: Karim fakkar shwaya.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: راح عند عمه محمود، النجار.
english: He went to his uncle Mahmoud, the carpenter.
transliteration: Ra7 3and 3ammo Ma7moud, el naggar.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: “يا عم محمود، كورتنا وقعت.” قال كريم.
english: "Uncle Mahmoud, our ball fell." Karim said.
transliteration: “Ya 3am Ma7moud, kortena wa2a3et.” al Karim.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: العم محمود كان راجل طيب.
english: Uncle Mahmoud was a good man.
transliteration: El 3am Ma7moud kan ragel tayeb.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: “متقلقوش يا أولاد، هنجيبها.”
english: "Don't worry, kids, we will get it."
transliteration: “Mat2al2osh ya awlad, hangibha.”
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: العم محمود جاب حبل طويل.
english: Uncle Mahmoud brought a long rope.
transliteration: El 3am Ma7moud gab 7abl tawil.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: كمان، جاب سطل صغير.
english: Also, he brought a small bucket.
transliteration: Kaman, gab satl soghayar.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: كل أصحاب كريم ساعدوا.
english: All Karim's friends helped.
transliteration: Kol as7ab Karim sa3ado.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: الولاد شدوا الحبل مع بعض.
english: The boys pulled the rope together.
transliteration: El welad shaddo el 7abl ma3 ba3d.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: السطل نزل جوه البير.
english: The bucket went down inside the well.
transliteration: El satl nezl gowa el bir.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: شويه، الكورة طلعت تاني.
english: A little while, the ball came out again.
transliteration: Shwaya, el kora tal3et tani.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: العيال فرحوا جداً.
english: The kids rejoiced greatly.
transliteration: El 3eyal far7o geddan.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: شكروا العم محمود كتير أوي.
english: They thanked Uncle Mahmoud very much.
transliteration: Shakaro el 3am Ma7moud ketir awi.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: “إحنا عيلة واحدة يا ولاد.” قال العم محمود.
english: "We are one family, kids." Uncle Mahmoud said.
transliteration: “E7na 3eila wa7da ya welad.” al el 3am Ma7moud.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: كلهم حسوا بفرحة كبيرة.
english: They all felt great joy.
transliteration: Kolhom 7asso be far7a kebira.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: الصداقة والجيران الحلوين دول كنوزنا.
english: Friendship and these good neighbors are our treasures.
transliteration: El sadaqa wel giran el 7elwin dol kenozna.
storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

arabic: مصطفى: إزيك يا يوسف؟
english: Mostafa: How are you, Youssef?
transliteration: Mostafa: Izayy-ak ya Youssef?

arabic: يوسف: الحمد لله، أنا كويس. وإنت عامل إيه؟
english: Youssef: Praise be to God, I'm good. And how are you doing?
transliteration: Youssef: Elhamdulillah, ana kwayyes. We enta 3amel eh?

arabic: مصطفى: أنا كمان كويس. كنت فين امبارح؟
english: Mostafa: I'm good too. Where were you yesterday?
transliteration: Mostafa: Ana kaman kwayyes. Kont feen embareh?

arabic: يوسف: أنا كنت في البيت مع أهلي.
english: Youssef: I was at home with my family.
transliteration: Youssef: Ana kont fel beit ma3 ahly.

arabic: مصطفى: جميل! أنا زرت أصحابي كلهم.
english: Mostafa: Nice! I visited all my friends.
transliteration: Mostafa: Gameel! Ana zort as7aby kolluhom.

arabic: يوسف: أصحابك كويسين؟
english: Youssef: Are your friends good?
transliteration: Youssef: As7abak kwayyeseen?

arabic: مصطفى: أيوه، الحمد لله، هما كويسين جداً.
english: Mostafa: Yes, praise be to God, they are very good.
transliteration: Mostafa: Aywa, elhamdulillah, homa kwayyeseen geddan.

arabic: يوسف: كويس جداً. إحنا هنروح النادي النهاردة.
english: Youssef: Very good. We are going to the club today.
transliteration: Youssef: Kwayyes geddan. Ehna hanroo7 el nady ennaharda.

arabic: مصطفى: نادي إيه ده؟
english: Mostafa: Which club is this?
transliteration: Mostafa: Nady eh da?

arabic: يوسف: نادي الزمالك، صاحبي عنده ماتش كورة هناك.
english: Youssef: Zamalek club, my friend has a football match there.
transliteration: Youssef: Nady el Zamalek, sahby 3ando match kora henak.

arabic: مصطفى: يا سلام! أنا بحب الكورة المصرية.
english: Mostafa: Wow! I love Egyptian football.
transliteration: Mostafa: Ya salam! Ana baheb el kora el masreyya.

arabic: يوسف: طب تيجي معانا نشوف ماتش صاحبي؟
english: Youssef: So, do you want to come with us to watch my friend's match?
transliteration: Youssef: Tab tigi ma3ana neshoof match sahby?

arabic: مصطفى: أيوه، أكيد عايز أروح معاكم.
english: Mostafa: Yes, I definitely want to go with you (plural).
transliteration: Mostafa: Aywa, akeed 3ayez aroo7 ma3akom.

arabic: يوسف: تمام، هنقابل عند بيتي الساعة خمسة بالليل.
english: Youssef: Okay, we will meet at my house at five in the evening.
transliteration: Youssef: Tamam, hanqabel 3and beity el saa3a khamsa bel leil.

arabic: مصطفى: ماشي يا يوسف، أشوفك بكرة!
english: Mostafa: Okay, Youssef, see you tomorrow!
transliteration: Mostafa: Mashi ya Youssef, ashoofak bokra!

arabic: النهاردة، أنا سعيدة أوي.
english: Today, I am very happy.
transliteration: El Naharda, ana sa3ida awi.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

arabic: ماما كانت بتعمل أكل حلو.
english: Mom was making delicious food.
transliteration: Mama kanet betamel 2akl helw.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

arabic: إحنا بنحب أكل ماما كتير.
english: We love Mom's food a lot.
transliteration: E7na ben7ebb 2akl Mama ketir.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

arabic: ماما جابت ملوخية خضرا من السوق.
english: Mom brought green molokhia from the market.
transliteration: Mama gabt molokheya khadra men el sou2.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

arabic: أنا ساعدت ماما في غسيلها.
english: I helped Mom in washing it.
transliteration: Ana sa3adt Mama fi ghaseelha.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

arabic: إحنا عندنا بصل كتير وجرجير.
english: We have a lot of onions and arugula.
transliteration: E7na 3andena basal ketir we gargir.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

arabic: بابا اشترى لحمة من الجزار.
english: Dad bought meat from the butcher.
transliteration: Baba eshtara la7ma men el gazzar.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

arabic: ماما قطعت اللحمة مكعبات صغيرة.
english: Mom cut the meat into small cubes.
transliteration: Mama 2att3at el la7ma moka3abat soghayara.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

arabic: وبعدين، ماما طبخت الملوخية في حلتها.
english: Then, Mom cooked the molokhia in her pot.
transliteration: We ba3dein, Mama tabakhet el molokheya fi 7alletha.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

arabic: ريحة الأكل كانت جميلة جداً.
english: The smell of the food was very beautiful.
transliteration: Ree7et el 2akl kanet gamila geddan.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

arabic: العيلة كلها قعدت على السفرة.
english: The whole family sat at the dining table.
transliteration: El 3eila kollaha 2a3adet 3ala el sofra.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

arabic: إحنا أكلنا ملوخية ورز أبيض.
english: We ate molokhia and white rice.
transliteration: E7na 2akalna molokheya we rozz abyad.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

arabic: بابا عجبه الأكل أوي النهاردة.
english: Dad liked the food a lot today.
transliteration: Baba 3agabo el 2akl awi el Naharda.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

arabic: إحنا بنشرب شاي بعد الأكل.
english: We drink tea after eating.
transliteration: E7na benshrab shay ba3d el 2akl.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

arabic: كلنا مبسوطين إننا أكلنا سوا.
english: We are all happy that we ate together.
transliteration: Kollena mabsootin ennena 2akalna sawa.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

arabic: أنا وأختي روحنا بيت تيتا إمبارح.
english: My sister and I went to grandma's house yesterday.
transliteration: Ana w okhti ro7na beit teeta embare7.

arabic: هي دايماً بتعمل أكل حلو لينا كلنا، وأولادي بيحبوه أوي.
english: She always makes delicious food for all of us, and my children love it very much.
transliteration: Heya dayman beta3mel akl helw leena kollena, w awladi bey7ebboh awi.

arabic: إحنا أكلنا كتيير وساعتها بابا جه.
english: We ate a lot, and then my father came.
transliteration: E7na akalna keteer w sa3etha baba geh.

arabic: أنت بتسأل: هو بيعمل إيه؟
english: You ask: what is he doing?
transliteration: Enta betsa2al: howa beya3mel eh?

arabic: هو جاب لنا هدايا جميلة، وإحنا فرحنا أوي بيها.
english: He brought us beautiful gifts, and we were very happy with them.
transliteration: Howa gab lena hadaya gamila, w e7na fara7na awi beeha.

arabic: أحمد وأصحابه كل يوم بيلعبوا كورة في الشارع جنب بيوتهم.
english: Ahmed and his friends play football every day in the street next to their houses.
transliteration: Ahmed w as7abo kol yom beyel3abu kora fel shari3 gamb beyoot'hom.

arabic: امبارح، شافوا ست كبيرة شايلة شنط تقيلة كتير.
english: Yesterday, they saw an old lady carrying many heavy bags.
transliteration: Embareh, shafu sett kebira shayla shonat te'eela ketir.

arabic: على طول، ولاد الحتة بيروحوا يساعدوا الناس اللي محتاجة.
english: Immediately, the neighborhood boys go to help people who are in need.
transliteration: 3ala tool, welad el 7etta beyroo7u yesa3edu el nas elly me7taga.

arabic: أحمد وأصحابه شايلين الشنط، ويوصلوها لبيتها، ووشوشهم فرحانة جداً.
english: Ahmed and his friends carry the bags, deliver them to her house, and their faces are very happy.
transliteration: Ahmed w as7abo shailin el shonat, w yewassalooha lebeitha, w weshoshohom far7ana geddan.

arabic: ديما، كل الجيران بيحبوا أولادنا وبيقولوا إنهم أحسن أصحاب في الحي بتاعنا.
english: Always, all the neighbors love our children and say that they are the best friends in our neighborhood.
transliteration: Dayman, kol el giran bey7ebbu awladna w bey2oolo ennohom a7san as7ab fel 7ayy beta3na.

arabic: امبارح، اتنين من أصحابي، أحمد ومنى، وصلوا بيتي الصغير.
english: Yesterday, two of my friends, Ahmed and Mona, arrived at my small house.
transliteration: Embare7, etneen men as7abi, Ahmed w Mona, wasalo beity el soghayyar.

arabic: أنا بفتح الباب وهما بيدخلوا؛ الشقة بتاعتي صغيرة بس حلوة.
english: I open the door and they enter; my apartment is small but nice.
transliteration: Ana bafta7 el bab w homa byedkholo; el sha22a beta3ty soghayyara bas 7elwa.

arabic: بقول لهم: 'يا جماعة، تشربوا إيه؟ عندي ثلاث كوبايات شاي حلوين.'
english: I tell them: 'Guys, what do you want to drink? I have three nice cups of tea.'
transliteration: Ba2ul lehom: 'Ya gama3a, teshrabo eh? 3andy talat kobbayat shay 7elween.'

arabic: أحمد بيقول: 'أنا عايز شاي،' ومنى بتقول: 'أنا كمان بشرب شاي.' فبصب لهم الشاي في الكوبايات.
english: Ahmed says: 'I want tea,' and Mona says: 'I also drink tea.' So I pour them the tea into the cups.
transliteration: Ahmed byea2ul: 'Ana 3ayez shay,' w Mona bet2ul: 'Ana kaman bashrab shay.' Fa basobb lehom el shay fel kobbayat.

arabic: قعدنا نتكلم كتير عن أيامنا القديمة؛ كانت لحظات جميلة وسعيدة مع أصحابي.
english: We sat talking a lot about our old days; they were beautiful and happy moments with my friends.
transliteration: 2a3adna netkallem keteer 3an ayyamna el 2adima; kanet la7azat gameela w sa3eeda ma3 as7abi.

arabic: الجو كان جميل أوي الصبح في حتتنا.
english: The weather was very beautiful this morning in our neighborhood.
transliteration: El gaw kan gameel awi el sobh fi 7atetna.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: أحمد ونور كانوا بيلعبوا كورة في الشارع.
english: Ahmed and Nour were playing football in the street.
transliteration: Ahmed we Nour kano beyel3abo kora fi el share3.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: نور قالت: "بص يا أحمد، طنط خديجة قاعدة لوحدها".
english: Nour said: "Look, Ahmed, Tanta Khadiga is sitting alone."
transliteration: Nour alet: "Bos ya Ahmed, Tanta Khadiga aa3da lawa7daha."
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: أحمد قال: "ايوه، أنا شوفتها امبارح برضه".
english: Ahmed said: "Yes, I saw her yesterday too."
transliteration: Ahmed aal: "Aywa, ana shoftaha embare7 bardo."
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: هم فكروا يعملوا حاجة حلوة ليها.
english: They thought of doing something nice for her.
transliteration: Hom fakkaru ya3malo 7aga 7elwa leeha.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: نور اقترحت: "نجيب شاي وكيك؟".
english: Nour suggested: "Should we bring tea and cake?"
transliteration: Nour eqtara7et: "Nigeeb shay we cake?"
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: أحمد قال: "فكرة كويسة أوي!".
english: Ahmed said: "A very good idea!"
transliteration: Ahmed aal: "Fekra kwayesa awi!"
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: هم راحوا بيتهم بسرعة.
english: They went to their houses quickly.
transliteration: Hom ra7o bayet-hom be sor3a.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: أحمد جاب علبة الشاي من مطبخه.
english: Ahmed brought a tea box from his kitchen.
transliteration: Ahmed gab 3elbet el shay men matbakh-o.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: نور كان عندها كيكة صغيرة عملتها أمها.
english: Nour had a small cake her mother made.
transliteration: Nour kan 3andaha keeka soghayara 3ameletha ommaha.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: بعدين، راحوا عند عم محمود يسألوه.
english: Then, they went to Uncle Mahmoud to ask him.
transliteration: Ba3dein, ra7o 3and 3amm Mahmoud yes'aluh.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: عم محمود كان بيقرأ الجرنان بتاعه.
english: Uncle Mahmoud was reading his newspaper.
transliteration: 3amm Mahmoud kan bey2ara' el gornan beta3o.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: هو سمع فكرتهم وابتسم ليهم.
english: He heard their idea and smiled at them.
transliteration: Howa sama3 fekret-hom we ebtasam lee-hom.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: قال: "يلا يا ولاد، أنا هاجي معاكم".
english: He said: "Come on, kids, I will come with you."
transliteration: Aal: "Yalla ya welad, ana hagyi ma3akom."
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: هم فرحوا جدا بكلامه الحلو.
english: They were very happy with his kind words.
transliteration: Hom fare7o geddan be kalam-o el 7elw.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: عم محمود شال صينية صغيرة معاهم.
english: Uncle Mahmoud carried a small tray with them.
transliteration: 3amm Mahmoud shal senei'a soghayara ma3ahom.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: راحوا لبيت طنط خديجة المتواضع.
english: They went to Tanta Khadiga's modest house.
transliteration: Ra7o le bait Tanta Khadiga el metawade3.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: دقوا الباب بهدوء.
english: They knocked on the door quietly.
transliteration: Da22o el bab be hedoo2.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: طنط خديجة فتحت الباب وهي مبسوطة.
english: Tanta Khadiga opened the door and she was happy.
transliteration: Tanta Khadiga fata7et el bab we hya mabsoota.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: هي كانت بتحب الزيارات بتاعت ولاد الحتة.
english: She used to love the visits of the neighborhood kids.
transliteration: Heya kanet bet7ebb el zeyarat beta3et welad el 7etta.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: قعدوا كلهم يشربوا الشاي ويأكلوا الكيك.
english: They all sat down to drink tea and eat cake.
transliteration: Aa3ado kollahom yeshrabo el shay we ya2kolo el cake.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: طنط خديجة حكت لهم حكايات زمان.
english: Tanta Khadiga told them old stories.
transliteration: Tanta Khadiga 7aket lehom 7ekayat zaman.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: الأولاد استمتعوا بوجودها وكلامها.
english: The children enjoyed her presence and her words.
transliteration: El awlad estamta3o be wogoodaha we kalam-ha.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: اليوم ده كان يوم جميل في قلوبهم كلهم.
english: That day was a beautiful day in all their hearts.
transliteration: El yom da kan yom gameel fi 2oloobhom kollahom.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: عمل الخير بيفرح الناس وبيقرب القلوب.
english: Doing good makes people happy and brings hearts closer.
transliteration: 3amal el kheir beyefarra7 el nas we bey2arrab el 2oloob.
storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

arabic: كل يوم الصبح، أنا بصحى وبشرب قهوتي، عندي فنجانين قهوة على الترابيزة دلوقتي.
english: Every morning, I wake up and drink my coffee; I have two cups of coffee on the table right now.
transliteration: Kol youm el sobh, ana baṣḥa w bashrab ʾahweti, ʾandy fanageen ʾahwa ʾala el tarabeeza delwaʾty.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

arabic: إمبارح شغلّت مزيكا حلوة عشان أروّق دماغي، وكانت أغاني قديمة كتير عجبتني.
english: Yesterday I played beautiful music to clear my head, and they were many old songs that I liked.
transliteration: Embareh shaghghalt mazeeka ḥelwa ʾashan ʾarawwaʾ demaghi, we kanet ʾaghani ʾadeema keteir ʾagabetny.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

arabic: بكرة هنروح أنا وأختي السوق علشان نشتري فاكهة طازة، ممكن نجيب أربع برتقالات كبار.
english: Tomorrow, my sister and I will go to the market to buy fresh fruit; we might get four big oranges.
transliteration: Bokra hanrooḥ ana we ʾokhty el sooʾ ʾalashan neshtry fakha taza, momken nigeeb ʾarbaʾ bortoqalat kobar.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

arabic: هناك، الراجل بيبيع خضار طازة وبيقول: 'كام كيلو عايزة يا ست الكل؟' وأنا بقول له: 'عايزة كيلو بطاطس و اتنين كيلو طماطم من عندك'.
english: There, the man sells fresh vegetables and says: 'How many kilos do you want, madam?' And I tell him: 'I want one kilo of potatoes and two kilos of tomatoes from you.'
transliteration: Honak, el ragel byebaaʾ khoḍar taza w byeqool: 'Kam kilo ʾayza ya sitt el kol?' W ana baqoolloh: 'ʾAyza kilo batates w etnein kilo tamatem men ʾandak'.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

arabic: بعد ما نرجع البيت، هعمل سلطات فواكه متنوعة وهاشرب فنجان قهوة تاني مع صحباتي وهنتبسط أوي.
english: After we return home, I will make various fruit salads and will drink another cup of coffee with my female friends, and we will enjoy ourselves very much.
transliteration: Baʾd ma nergaʾ el beyt, haʾamel salatat fawakih metnawwaʾa w hashrah fangaan ʾahwa tany maʾa soḥabaty w hanetbaset ʾawy.
storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

arabic: كان عندنا فرحة كبيرة في بيتنا.
english: We had great joy in our house.
transliteration: Kan 3andena far7a kebira fi betna.
storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

arabic: أيام العيد كانت قربت أوي وماتش مصر كمان.
english: Eid days were very close, and Egypt's match was also coming soon.
transliteration: Ayam el Eid kanet 2arabet awi w match Masr kaman.
storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

arabic: أحمد الصغير كان بيحب الكورة بتاعتنا جداً.
english: Little Ahmed loved our football very much.
transliteration: Ahmad el soghayar kan by7ebb el kora beta3tna geddan.
storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

arabic: بابا قاله: "يلا يا أحمد، فريقنا هيلعب كويس في المغرب."
english: Dad told him: "Let's go, Ahmed, our team will play well in Morocco."
transliteration: Baba 2al lo: "Yalla ya Ahmad, fari2na hayla3ab kwayes fi el Maghreb."
storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

arabic: كلنا قعدنا قدام التلفزيون في الصالون بتاعنا.
english: All of us sat in front of the television in our living room.
transliteration: Kollena 2a3adna 2oddam el televiseon fi el saloon beta3na.
storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

arabic: اللعيبة بتوعنا لبسوا التيشرتات الحمرة بتاعتهم.
english: Our players wore their red shirts.
transliteration: El le3eeba betou3na lebso el tishertat el 7amra beta3thom.
storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

arabic: الماتش بدأ والناس كلها كانت فرحانة أوي.
english: The match started, and all the people were very happy.
transliteration: El match bada2 wel nas kollaha kanet far7ana awi.
storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

arabic: جول حلو دخل مرمى الخصم! كلنا صرخنا جامد من الفرحة.
english: A beautiful goal went into the opponent's net! All of us screamed loudly from joy.
transliteration: Gool 7elw dakhal marma el khasem! Kollena sarakhna gamed men el far7a.
storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

arabic: أحمد وبابا كانوا مبسوطين أوي بالنتيجة دي للماتش.
english: Ahmed and Dad were very happy with this match result.
transliteration: Ahmad we Baba kano mabsooteen awi bel neteega di lel match.
storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

arabic: إن شاء الله كاس أفريقيا ده يكون بتاعنا يا مصريين!
english: God willing, this African Cup will be ours, Egyptians!
transliteration: In sha Allah kas Afrika da yekoun beta3na ya Masreyyeen!
storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

arabic: أحمد راح السوق الكبير في القاهرة امبارح.
english: Ahmed went to the big market in Cairo yesterday.
transliteration: Ahmed rah el sooq el kebir fel Qahera embareh.

arabic: السوق كان جميل أوي وفيه ناس كتير.
english: The market was very beautiful and had many people.
transliteration: El sooq kan gamil awi w fih nas ktir.

arabic: هو شاف أصحابه علي ومنى جنب محل الفاكهة.
english: He saw his friends Ali and Mona next to the fruit shop.
transliteration: Howa shaf ashabo Ali w Mona gamb mahl el faka.

arabic: الشمس كانت حارة، لكن المانجا كانت ساقعة وحلوة.
english: The sun was hot, but the mangoes were cold and sweet.
transliteration: El shams kanet har, lakin el manga kanet saa w helwa.

arabic: أحمد قال أنا عايز اتنين كيلو تفاح أحمر لو سمحت.
english: Ahmed said, I want two kilos of red apples, please.
transliteration: Ahmed al ana ayez etnin kilo toffah ahmar law samaht.

arabic: الفاكهاني إداله الفاكهة في شنطة كبيرة.
english: The fruit seller gave him the fruit in a big bag.
transliteration: El fakaheni edalo el faka fi shanta kebira.

arabic: بعدين، أحمد اشترى عيش طازة لأمه وإخواته.
english: Then, Ahmed bought fresh bread for his mother and sisters.
transliteration: Badeen, Ahmed eshtara eish taza le ommo w ekhwato.

arabic: إخواته البنات بيحبوا العيش المصري أوي.
english: His sisters love Egyptian bread very much.
transliteration: Ekhwato el banat beyhebu el eish el masri awi.

arabic: هو رجع بيته فرحان في المساء.
english: He returned to his house happy in the evening.
transliteration: Howa rege beto farhan fel masa.

arabic: أهله أكلوا الأكل مع بعض في الأوضة الصغيرة.
english: His family ate the food together in the small room.
transliteration: Ahlo akalu el akl mabaad fel oda el soghayara.

arabic: عيلتي كانت ساكنة في بيت صغير في القاهرة.
english: My family lived in a small house in Cairo.
transliteration: Eilaty kanet sakna fee beit soghayar fee el Qahera.

arabic: بابايا بيشتغل في شركة كبيرة، وماما بتعمل لنا أكل حلو.
english: My father works in a big company, and mom makes delicious food for us.
transliteration: Babaya biyeshtaghal fee sherka kebira, we mama betamel lena akl helw.

arabic: عندي أخوات ولاد وبنات، وإحنا بنحب أهلينا قوي.
english: I have brothers and girls, and we love our parents very much.
transliteration: Andy akhwat welad we banat, we ehna benoheb ahlena awy.

arabic: امبارح قعدنا مع بعض واتكلمنا عن أحلامنا الجديدة.
english: Yesterday we sat together and talked about our new dreams.
transliteration: Embareh aadna maa baad we etkallamna aan ahlamna el gedida.

arabic: العيلة هي كل حاجة في حياتي، وأنا فرحان معاهم.
english: Family is everything in my life, and I am happy with them.
transliteration: El eila heya kol haga fee hayaty, we ana farhan maahom.

arabic: الشهر اللي فات، أحمد وصحابه اتفرجوا على ماتشات كاس أمم أفريقيا مع بعض في القهوة.
english: Last month, Ahmed and his friends watched the African Cup of Nations matches together at the café.
transliteration: El shahr elly fat, Ahmed wa sahabo etfarago ala matshat kas omam afriqya ma'a ba'd fel ahwa.

arabic: هما كانوا لابسين تيشيرتات حمراء بتاعة المنتخب المصري.
english: They were wearing red shirts belonging to the Egyptian national team.
transliteration: Homa kano labsin t-shirtat hamra beta'et el montakhab el masry.

arabic: كل واحد في الحتة كان حاسس بفرحة كبيرة عشان الفريق كان بيلعب كويس.
english: Every person in the area was feeling a great joy because the team was playing well.
transliteration: Kol wahed fel hetta kan hases be farha kebira ashan el fariq kan beyelab kways.

arabic: أحمد قال لصاحبه علي: الجو هنا جميل أوي النهاردة.
english: Ahmed said to his friend Ali: The atmosphere here is very beautiful today.
transliteration: Ahmed al le sahbo Ali: El gaw hena gamil awi ennaharda.

arabic: علي رد عليه: صح، إحنا دايماً بنحب بلدنا وفريقنا.
english: Ali replied to him: Right, we always love our country and our team.
transliteration: Ali rad aleh: Sah, ehna dayman benheb baladna wa fariqna.

arabic: فجأة، اللاعب المصري جاب جون، وكل الناس صرخوا من الفرحة.
english: Suddenly, the Egyptian player scored a goal, and all the people screamed from joy.
transliteration: Fagaa, el la'eb el masry gab gon, wa kol el nas sarakho mel farha.

arabic: العيال الصغيرين نطوا في الشارع والجيران فتحوا شبابيكهم.
english: The small children jumped in the street and the neighbors opened their windows.
transliteration: El eyal el soghayarin nato fel share' wel geran fataho shababikhom.

arabic: قلوبنا كانت بتدق بسرعة في آخر دقايق من الماتش.
english: Our hearts were beating fast in the last minutes of the match.
transliteration: Oloobna kanet betde' be sor'a fi akher da'ayeq mel matsh.

arabic: شربنا شاي سخن وأكلنا شوية حلويات مع جيراننا.
english: We drank hot tea and ate some sweets with our neighbors.
transliteration: Sherebna shay sokhn wa akalna shwayet halawiyat ma'a geranna.

arabic: الشعور ده باللمة بيخلينا فرحانين أوي كل مرة.
english: This feeling of gathering makes us very happy every time.
transliteration: El sho'our da bel lamma beykhallina farhanin awi kol marra.

arabic: لما الماتش خلص، المشجعين مشيوا في الشوارع ومعاهم أعلام.
english: When the match finished, the fans walked in the streets and with them were flags.
transliteration: Lamma el matsh khalas, el moshage'in meshyo fel shaware' wa ma'ahom a'lam.

arabic: الصحوبية بتبقى أقوى لما بنشارك اللحظات دي مع بعض.
english: Friendship becomes stronger when we share these moments together.
transliteration: El sohobeya beteb'a aqwa lamma bensharek el lahazat di ma'a ba'd.

arabic: أنا وصحابي عايزين نشوف المنتخب في الماتش النهائي.
english: My friends and I want to see the national team in the final match.
transliteration: Ana wa sahabi ayzin neshouf el montakhab fel matsh el neha'i.

arabic: يا رب الكاس يفضل في مصر السنة دي.
english: Oh Lord, may the cup stay in Egypt this year.
transliteration: Ya rab el kas yefdal fi masr el sana di.

arabic: كاس أمم أفريقيا مش بس كورة، لكن حفلة كبيرة لينا.
english: The African Cup of Nations is not just football, but a big party for us.
transliteration: Kas omam afriqya mesh bas kora, laken hafla kebira lena.

arabic: أنا وصلت نيويورك مع أخواتي الاتنين الأسبوع اللي فات عشان نزور ابن عمنا.
english: I arrived in New York with my two brothers last week to visit our cousin.
transliteration: Ana wasalt New York ma'a akhwati el etneen el osbou'a elly fat ashan nezoor ebn ammena.

arabic: كنا عايزين نشوف التلج لأول مرة في حياتنا عشان مش بنشوفه خالص في القاهرة.
english: We wanted to see the snow for the first time in our lives because we never see it at all in Cairo.
transliteration: Konna ayzin neshouf el talg le awel marra fi hayatna ashan mesh benshoufo khales fi el kahera.

arabic: فجأة السما بدأت تمطر حاجات بيضا زي قطع القطن الصغيرة.
english: Suddenly, the sky started raining white things like small pieces of cotton.
transliteration: Fag'a el sama bada'et temattar hagat beida zay eta'a el otn el soghayara.

arabic: أخويا الكبير أحمد زعق من الفرحة وكلم أمنا فيديو عشان يوريها الجمال ده.
english: My big brother Ahmed shouted with joy and called our mother on video to show her this beauty.
transliteration: Akhoya el kebir Ahmed za'a men el farha we kalem omena video ashan yoriha el gamal da.

arabic: هي كانت بتضحك وبتقول لنا: "ربنا يخليكم ليا يا ولادي وتفضلوا دايما مع بعض."
english: She was laughing and telling us: "May God keep you for me, my children, and may you always stay together."
transliteration: Heya kanet betedhak we betolena: 'Rabbena yekhalikom leya ya weladi we tefdalo dayman ma'a ba'ad.'

arabic: ابن عمنا جاب لنا تلات بالطي تقيلة عشان البرد كان قوي جداً في الشوارع.
english: Our cousin brought us three heavy coats because the cold was very strong in the streets.
transliteration: Ebn ammena gab lena talat balaty te'ila ashan el bard kan awi geddan fi el shawarea.

arabic: نزلنا نلعب كلنا وعملنا خمس كور تلج كبيرة ورميناهم على بعض.
english: We all went down to play and made five big snowballs and threw them at each other.
transliteration: Nezelna nel'ab kollona we amalna khamas kowar talg kebira we rameenahom ala ba'ad.

arabic: أنا حسيت إن قلبي بيتنطط من السعادة في وسط الجو الجديد ده.
english: I felt that my heart was jumping from happiness in the middle of this new atmosphere.
transliteration: Ana hasset en alby beyetnattat men el saada fi wast el gaw el gedid da.

arabic: اللحظات دي أحلى من أي حاجة تانية في الدنيا عشان عيلتي معايا.
english: These moments are sweeter than anything else in the world because my family is with me.
transliteration: El lahazat di ahla men ay haga tanya fi el donia ashan ailty ma'aya.

arabic: عمرنا ما هننسى أول مرة نشوف فيها التلج في شوارع نيويورك.
english: We will never forget the first time we see snow in the streets of New York.
transliteration: Omrena ma hanensa awel marra neshouf fiha el talg fi shawarea New York.

arabic: أحمد كان خباز في منطقة صغيرة في القاهرة.
english: Ahmed was a baker in a small area in Cairo.
transliteration: Ahmad kan khabbaz fi mantika soghayara fi el-kahera.

arabic: في يوم، كان عنده تلاتة طلبات كبيرة لمطاعم مختلفة.
english: One day, he had three big orders for different restaurants.
transliteration: Fi yom, kan ando talaata talabat kebira le-mataem mokhtalifa.

arabic: بص على العجلة بتاعته وشاف إنها مكسورة لحتتين.
english: He looked at his bike and saw that it was broken into two pieces.
transliteration: Bass ala el-agala betaato wa shaf ennaha maksoora le-heteteyn.

arabic: أحمد فكر: إزاي هوصل الشنط التقيلة دي للزباين؟
english: Ahmed thought: How will I deliver these heavy bags to the customers?
transliteration: Ahmad fakkar: ezzay ha-wasal el-shonat el-tekila di lel-zebayen?

arabic: هو قرر يسأل جيرانه عشان يساعدوه بعربية صغيرة.
english: He decided to ask his neighbors to help him with a small cart.
transliteration: Howa qarar yesal gerano ashan yesaadouh be-arabiya soghayara.

arabic: هو لقى خمس عربيات جنب السوق واختار الأقوى.
english: He found five carts near the market and chose the strongest one.
transliteration: Howa la-aa khamas arabiyat ganb el-souq wa ekhtar el-aqwa.

arabic: هو حط عشر شنط عيش جوه العربية بحرص.
english: He put ten bags of bread inside the cart carefully.
transliteration: Howa hat ashar shonat eish gowa el-arabiya be-hers.

arabic: أحمد مشي للمطعم الأول واداهم أربع شنط.
english: Ahmed walked to the first restaurant and gave them four bags.
transliteration: Ahmad meshi lel-matam el-awwal wa edahom arbaa shonat.

arabic: بعدين خلص الست شنط التانية في ساعتين بس.
english: Then he finished the other six bags in two hours only.
transliteration: Baaden khallas el-set shonat el-tanya fi saateyn bas.

arabic: أحمد كان مبسوط أوي عشان قراره السريع أنقذ شغله النهاردة.
english: Ahmed was very happy because his quick decision saved his work today.
transliteration: Ahmad kan mabsoot awi ashan qararo el-saree ankaz shoghlo el-naharda.

arabic: أحمد كان شاب صغير وكان عايز يبقى فنان مشهور.
english: Ahmed was a young man and he wanted to become a famous artist.
transliteration: Ahmed kan shabb soghayyar we kan ayiz yib-a fannan mash-hoor.

arabic: هو انضم لمدرسة كبيرة عشان يتعلم الرسم في المدينة.
english: He joined a big school to learn drawing in the city.
transliteration: Huwa indamm le madrasa kibeera ashan yit-allim el rasm fel madina.

arabic: في الدرس الأول، قابل صحابه الجداد والمدرب بتاعه.
english: In the first lesson, he met his new friends and his instructor.
transliteration: Fel dars el awwal, abel sohabo el godad we el modarreb bita-o.

arabic: هو كان حاسس بشوية قلق عشان مكنش عنده خبرة.
english: He was feeling a bit of anxiety because he didn't have experience.
transliteration: Huwa kan hassis bi shewayyet alaq ashan ma-kansh ando khibra.

arabic: المدرب قاله: متقلقش، الغلط خطوة طبيعية عشان تتعلم.
english: The instructor said to him: Don't worry, the mistake is a natural step to learn.
transliteration: El modarreb al-loh: Ma ti-la-sh, el ghalat khatwa tabieyya ashan tit-allim.

arabic: أحمد اتمرن كتير كل يوم عشان يحسن إيده.
english: Ahmed practiced a lot every day to improve his hand.
transliteration: Ahmed itmarrin keteer kol yom ashan yihassin eedo.

arabic: هو رسم عماير وناس من المنطقة بتاعته.
english: He drew apartment buildings and people from his neighborhood.
transliteration: Huwa rasam amayer we nas min el manteqa bita-to.

arabic: على مدار الوقت، رسمه اتحسن وبقى مبسوط أوي.
english: Over time, his drawing improved and he became very happy.
transliteration: Ala madar el wa-t, rasmo ethassan we ba-a mabsoot awi.

arabic: هو خد قرار يشتغل فنان محترف في المستقبل.
english: He took a decision to work as a professional artist in the future.
transliteration: Huwa khad qarar yishtaghal fannan mohtarif fel mostaqbal.

arabic: الخبرة دي غيرت حياته وادته حكمة كبيرة.
english: This experience changed his life and gave him great wisdom.
transliteration: El khibra dee ghayyaret hayato we edet-loh hekma kibeera.

arabic: النهاردة أول يوم في العيد الكبير في مصر.
english: Today is the first day of the big holiday in Egypt.
transliteration: En-naharda awwil yom fi el-eid el-kebir fi masr.
storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

arabic: أنا و عيلتي فرحانين أوي النهاردة.
english: My family and I are very happy today.
transliteration: Ana wa ailti farhanin awi en-naharda.
storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

arabic: بابا بيقعد في الأوضة و بيشوف الأخبار في التليفزيون.
english: Dad sits in the room and watches the news on the television.
transliteration: Baba biyuud fi el-oda wa biyishoof el-akhbar fi el-television.
storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

arabic: الأخبار بتقول إن فيه حرب في إيران دلوقتي.
english: The news says that there is a war in Iran now.
transliteration: El-akhbar bitool in fih harb fi Iran dilwati.
storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

arabic: أمريكا و إسرائيل في الحرب ضد إيران.
english: America and Israel are in the war against Iran.
transliteration: Amrika wa Israil fi el-harb did Iran.
storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

arabic: الرؤساء عايزين سلطة و سيطرة في المنطقة.
english: The presidents want power and control in the region.
transliteration: El-ruasa ayzin sulta wa saytara fi el-mantiqa.
storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

arabic: المشكلة دي ليها تاريخ طويل من سنين كتيرة.
english: This problem has a long history from many years ago.
transliteration: El-moshkila di liha tarikh tawil min sinin ketira.
storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

arabic: ماما بتجيب أكل كويس أوي لغدانا.
english: Mom brings very good food for our lunch.
transliteration: Mama bitgeeb akl kwayis awi lighadana.
storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

arabic: هي بتقول إن الحرب وحشة أوي للأطفال.
english: She says that war is very bad for children.
transliteration: Hiya bitool in el-harb wehsha awi lil-atfal.
storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

arabic: إحنا بناكل الأكل لكن بنفكر في الناس هناك.
english: We eat the food but we think about the people there.
transliteration: Ehna binakul el-akl lakin binfakkir fi en-nas honak.
storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

arabic: أختي بتسأل عن أهداف البلاد دي.
english: My sister asks about the goals of these countries.
transliteration: Okhti bitisal an ahdaf el-bilad di.
storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

arabic: بابا بيشرح إن الوضع صعب أوي و قديم.
english: Dad explains that the situation is very difficult and old.
transliteration: Baba biyishrah in el-wad saab awi wa adeem.
storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

arabic: أنا عايز سلام للعالم كله في العيد ده.
english: I want peace for the whole world during this holiday.
transliteration: Ana ayiz salam lil-alam kullo fi el-eid da.
storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

arabic: إحنا بنصلي للعائلات في إيران و كل مكان.
english: We pray for the families in Iran and every place.
transliteration: Ehna binsalli lil-ailat fi Iran wa kull makan.
storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

arabic: إحنا بنتمنى الحرب تخلص بدري أوي.
english: We hope the war ends very soon.
transliteration: Ehna binitmanna el-harb tikhlas badri awi.
storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

arabic: السلام عليكم يا صحبي عامل ايه النهارده
english: Hello my friend, how are you doing today?
transliteration: as-salamu alaykum ya sahbi amel eh ennaharda

arabic: الحمد لله انا كويس وبشرب شاي الصبح
english: Thank God I am good and drinking tea in the morning.
transliteration: elhamdullelah ana kwayes wa bashrab shay el sobh

arabic: اخويا بيشتغل في بيت كبير مع العيلة
english: My brother works in a big house with the family.
transliteration: akhoya biyeshtaghal fi beit kabeer ma el eila

arabic: هو كان مع اخواتي في البيت امبارح
english: He was with my siblings in the house yesterday.
transliteration: hwa kan ma akhwati fi el beit embareh

arabic: احنا عندنا احلام كتير وعايزين نعمل حاجة
english: We have many dreams and want to do something.
transliteration: ehna andena ahlam keteer wa ayzeen neamel haga

arabic: السلام عليكم يا احمد عامل ايه النهارده
english: Peace be upon you Ahmed how are you doing today
transliteration: Assalamu alaykum ya Ahmed amel eh ennaharda

arabic: انا بشرب شاي الصبح في البيت
english: I drink tea in the morning in the house
transliteration: Ana bashrab shay el sobh fel beit

arabic: اخويا بيشتغل في القاهرة من امبارح
english: My brother works in Cairo since yesterday
transliteration: Akhoya biyeshtaghal fel Qahera men embareh

arabic: انا عندي عيلة كبيرة وعندي اخوات كتير
english: I have a big family and I have many siblings
transliteration: Ana andi eila kebira we andi akhwat kteer

arabic: كل حاجة كويسة والحمد لله
english: Everything is good and thank God
transliteration: Kol haga kwayesa welhamdullelah

arabic: السلام عليكم يا احمد عامل ايه النهارده
english: Peace be upon you Ahmed how are you doing today
transliteration: Assalamu alaykum ya Ahmed amel eh ennaharda

arabic: انا كويس الحمد لله وبشرب شاي الصبح في البيت
english: I am good thank God and I drink tea in the morning at home
transliteration: Ana kwayes elhamdullelah wa bashrab shay el sobh fel beit

arabic: اخويا بيشتغل كتير من امبارح وعاوز ينام
english: My brother has been working a lot since yesterday and wants to sleep
transliteration: Akhoya biyeshtaghal kteer men embareh wa awiz yenam

arabic: العيلة كلها عندها احلام كبيرة للمستقبل
english: The whole family has big dreams for the future
transliteration: El eila kullaha andaha ahlam kbeera lel mostaqbal

arabic: كل واحد فينا بيعمل حاجة مهمة كل يوم
english: Every one of us does something important every day
transliteration: Kull wahed feena biyemel haga mohemma kull yom

arabic: السلام عليكم انا بشرب شاي الصبح في البيت
english: Hello, I drink tea in the morning at home.
transliteration: As-salamu alaykum ana bashrab shay el sobh fel beit

arabic: العيلة كلهم كويسين واخواتي كانوا هنا امبارح
english: The family are all well and my siblings were here yesterday.
transliteration: El eila kollohom kwayessin we akhwaty kano hena embareh

arabic: اخويا الكبير بيشتغل في شركة في مصر الجديدة
english: My older brother works in a company in Heliopolis.
transliteration: Akhoya elkebir biyeshtaghal fi sherka fi Masr el-Gedida

arabic: الحمد لله كويس وانت عامل ايه النهارده في الشغل
english: Thank God I am good and you how are you doing today at work?
transliteration: Elhamdullelah kwayes wenta amel eh ennaharda fel shoghl

arabic: في حاجة تانية انا عندي احلام كبيرة للمستقبل
english: One more thing, I have big dreams for the future.
transliteration: Fi haga tanya ana andy ahlam kebira lil mustaqbal

arabic: السلام عليكم يا صاحبي عامل ايه النهارده
english: Peace be upon you my friend, how are you doing today?
transliteration: As salamu alaykum ya sahbi amel eh ennaharda
storyTitle: A New Day with the Family

arabic: الحمد لله انا كويس وبشرب شاي الصبح في البيت
english: Thank God I am good and I drink tea in the morning at home.
transliteration: Elhamdullelah ana kwayes wa bashrab shay el sobh fel beit
storyTitle: A New Day with the Family

arabic: امبارح انا كنت مع عيلتي واخواتي في حاجة مهمة
english: Yesterday I was with my family and siblings for something important.
transliteration: Embareh ana kont ma eilty wa akhwati fe haga mohimma
storyTitle: A New Day with the Family

arabic: اخويا بيشتغل كتير علشان عنده احلام كبيرة
english: My brother works a lot because he has big dreams.
transliteration: Akhoya biyeshtaghal keteer ashan andoh ahlam kabeera
storyTitle: A New Day with the Family

arabic: وانت عامل ايه النهاردة في الشغل بتاعك
english: And you, how are you doing today in your work?
transliteration: Wenta amel eh ennaharda fel shoghl betaak
storyTitle: A New Day with the Family

arabic: السلام عليكم يا محمد عامل ايه النهارده
english: Peace be upon you Mohamed, how are you doing today?
transliteration: As-salamu alaykum ya Mohamed amel eh ennaharda

arabic: الحمد لله انا كويس وبشرب شاي الصبح في البيت
english: Thank God I am good and I am drinking morning tea at home.
transliteration: Elhamdullelah ana kwayes wa bashrab shay el sobh fel beit

arabic: امبارح كلمت اخواتي علشان نخطط لرحلة العيلة يوم السبت
english: Yesterday I talked to my siblings to plan for the family trip on Saturday.
transliteration: Embareh kallimt akhwati ashan nekhattat le rehlet el eila yom el sabt

arabic: اخويا بيشتغل كتير بس هو عايز يعمل حاجة جديدة في الاجازة
english: My brother works a lot but he wants to do something new on the vacation.
transliteration: Akhoya biyeshtaghal kteer bas howa ayiz yiamil haga gedeeda fel agaza

arabic: الرحلة دي من احلام العيلة من زمان ونفسنا ننبسط
english: This trip is one of the family's dreams for a long time and we hope to have fun.
transliteration: El rehla di men ahlam el eila men zaman wa nefsina nenbest

arabic: انا خرجت من البيت الصبح بس تهت في الشوارع الكبيرة
english: I left the house in the morning but I got lost in the big streets.
transliteration: Ana kharagt men el beit el sobh bas toht fe el shawarea el kebira

arabic: كنت خايفة قوي عشان مش شايفة اي حاجة عارفاها
english: I was very afraid because I didn't see anything I knew.
transliteration: Kont khayfa awi ashan mesh shayfa ay haga arfaha

arabic: شفت راجل بيشتغل في محل وقلت له السلام عليكم
english: I saw a man who works in a shop and I said to him peace be upon you.
transliteration: Shoft ragel biyeshtaghal fe mahal we olteloh as salamu alaykum

arabic: سألته عامل ايه النهارده وطلبت منه يوصف لي طريق بيت عيلتي
english: I asked him how are you today and asked him to describe the way to my family's house.
transliteration: Saaltoh amel eh ennaharda we talabt mennoh yowsef li tareeq beit eilti

arabic: هو كان شخص كويس اوي وساعدني والحمد لله وصلت بالسلامة
english: He was a very good person and helped me and thank God I arrived safely.
transliteration: Howa kan shakhs kwayes awi we saadni wel hamdullelah wasalt bel salama

arabic: انا بشرب شاي الصبح في البيت والولد الصغير دخل عليا
english: I drink tea in the morning at home and the little boy entered to me
transliteration: Ana bashrab shay el sobh fel beit wel walad el soghayar dakhal alaya
storyTitle: The Boy and the Many Questions

arabic: هو قال السلام عليكم وبعدين بدأ يسأل عن كل حاجة حواليه
english: He said Peace be upon you and then started asking about everything around him
transliteration: Howa al as-salamu alaykum we baden bada yis-al an kol haga hawalih
storyTitle: The Boy and the Many Questions

arabic: هو سأل ليه الشاي سخن وليه بابا بيشتغل كتير كل يوم
english: He asked why the tea is hot and why dad works a lot every day
transliteration: Howa sa-al leh el shay sokhn we leh baba biyeshtaghal kteer kol yom
storyTitle: The Boy and the Many Questions

arabic: هو افتكر اللي حصل امبارح وسأل عن اخواته واحلامه الكبيرة
english: He remembered what happened yesterday and asked about his siblings and his big dreams
transliteration: Howa eftakar elli hasal embareh we sa-al an akhwato we ahlamo el kabira
storyTitle: The Boy and the Many Questions

arabic: انا قلت له الحمد لله انا كويس وعيلتنا سعيدة جدا
english: I told him Thank God I am good and our family is very happy
transliteration: Ana oltelo elhamdullelah ana kwayes we eiletna saeeda geddan
storyTitle: The Boy and the Many Questions

arabic: انا كنت بشرب شاي الصبح في البيت لما ابن اختي جه
english: I was drinking tea in the morning at home when my nephew arrived
transliteration: Ana kont bashrab shay el sobh fil beit lamma ibn okhti geh

arabic: هو قال السلام عليكم يا خالو عامل ايه النهارده
english: He said peace be upon you uncle how are you doing today
transliteration: Howa al as salamu alaykum ya khalo amel eh ennaharda

arabic: انا قلت الحمد لله كويس وبدأت أسأله عن العيلة والاخوات
english: I said thank God I am good and started asking him about the family and siblings
transliteration: Ana olt elhamdullelah kwayes we badaat asalo an el eila wel akhwat

arabic: هو سألني ازاي الموتور بيشتغل وعن كل حاجة بيشوفها
english: He asked me how the motor works and about every thing he sees
transliteration: Howa saalni ezay el motor biyeshtaghal we an kol haga biyishofha

arabic: هو فضل يسأل عن حاجات من امبارح لحد أحلامه
english: He kept asking about things from yesterday until his dreams
transliteration: Howa fedel yisal an hagat min embareh lehad ahlamo

arabic: يا احمد يلا نسافر اخر الاسبوع عشان هنكون مشغولين باقي السنه
english: Ahmed let's travel this weekend because we will be busy the rest of the year
transliteration: ya Ahmed yalla nesafer akher el esboo ashan hanekoon mashghoolin baqi el sana

arabic: احنا قابلنا بعض في المحطه عشان نشوف مواعيد قطره كتير
english: We met each other at the station to see many train schedules
transliteration: ehna abelna bad fi el mahatta ashan nishoof mawaid otora keteer

arabic: انت لازم تجيب اكل صحي معاك في الطريق
english: You must bring healthy food with you on the way
transliteration: enta lazem tigueeb akl sehhi maak fi el tareeq

arabic: هل القطر سريع زي الطلقه ولا بطيء
english: Is the train fast like a bullet or slow
transliteration: hal el atr sarea zay el tala wala batee

arabic: مفيش دروس خصوصيه يوم السبت عشان كده نقدر نروح
english: There are no private lessons on Saturday so we can go
transliteration: mafish doroos khosooseyya yom el sabt ashan keda nedar nerooh

arabic: بص الكرسي مكسور في الحتة دي
english: Look, the chair is broken in this part
transliteration: boss el korsi maksour fi el hitta di

arabic: انا نصحتك ما تنطش عليه
english: I advised you not to jump on it
transliteration: ana nasahtak ma tontish aleh

arabic: من فضلك اديني العدة عشان اصلحه دلوقتي
english: Please give me the tools to fix it now
transliteration: men fadlak iddini el edda ashan asalaho delwati

arabic: كمل شغلك و ما توقفش
english: Continue your work and don't stop
transliteration: kammil shoglak wa ma twaaffish

arabic: النهارده صاحبي كلمني في التليفون
english: Today my friend called me on the phone.
transliteration: elnaharda sahby kalemny fe eltelifon

arabic: انا كنت مبسوط اوي عشان بحبه
english: I was very happy because I love him.
transliteration: ana kont mabsout awy ashan bahebo

arabic: هو حكالي حكايه حلوه اوي
english: He told me a very nice story.
transliteration: howa hakaly hekaya helwa awy

arabic: بس بعد كده هو كان زعلان
english: But after that he was sad.
transliteration: bas baad keda howa kan zaalan

arabic: انا قلتله انا دايما معاك
english: I told him I am always with you.
transliteration: ana oltelo ana dayman maak

arabic: انا رحت اشتري هدوم جديده امبارح
english: I went to buy new clothes yesterday.
transliteration: Ana roht eshtery hedoom gedeeda embareh.

arabic: صاحبي مشي معايا عشان نختار مع بعض
english: My friend walked with me so we could choose together.
transliteration: Sahby meshy maaya ashan nekhtar ma baad.

arabic: هو نصحني اشتري حته قميص حلو
english: He advised me to buy a nice piece of shirt.
transliteration: Howa nasahny eshtery hettet qamees helw.

arabic: انا قلت هكمل الشرا بالليل
english: I said I will continue buying at night.
transliteration: Ana olt hakammel el shera bel leel.

arabic: بس انا لقيت اني نسيت فلوسي في البيت
english: But I found out that I forgot my money at home.
transliteration: Bas ana laqeet eny neseet floosy fe el beet.

arabic: فرح اختي بكرة واحنا مبسوطين اوي
english: My sister's wedding is tomorrow and we are very happy.
transliteration: farah okhty bokra we ehna mabsoteen awy

arabic: اشترينا فستان ابيض جميل اوي للعروسة
english: We bought a very beautiful white dress for the bride.
transliteration: eshtareyna fostan abyad gameel awy lel arosa

arabic: امي بتطبخ اكل كتير عشان المعازيم
english: My mother is cooking a lot of food for the guests.
transliteration: ommy betotbokh akl keteer ashan el maazeem

arabic: اخويا هيجيب فرقة كبيرة عشان الفرح
english: My brother will bring a big band for the wedding.
transliteration: akhouya haygeeb ferqa kebeera ashan el farah

arabic: احنا هنرقص ونغني طول الليل
english: We will dance and sing all night.
transliteration: ehna hanorqos we noghanny tool el leyl

arabic: السلام عليكم الحمد لله انا كويس وانت عامل ايه النهارده
english: Hello thank God I am good and you how are you doing today
transliteration: As-salamu alaykum elhamdullelah ana kwayes wenta amel eh ennaharda

arabic: انا بشرب شاي الصبح دلوقتي ومبسوط عشان بكلمك
english: I am drinking tea in the morning now and happy because I am talking to you
transliteration: Ana bashrab shay el sobh delwaqti wa mabsout ashan bakallemak

arabic: بالمناسبة شوفت اخواتك امبارح قدام بيتي
english: By the way I saw your siblings yesterday in front of my house
transliteration: Belmonasba shoft akhwatak embareh oddam beiti

arabic: عرفت ان ابوك بيشتغل كتير بس العيلة كلها كويسة
english: I knew that your father works a lot but the whole family is good
transliteration: Araft en abouk biyeshtaghal ketir bas el eila kolaha kwayesa

arabic: لو محتاج اي حاجة كلمني بالليل
english: If you need anything call me at night
transliteration: Law mehtag ay haga kallemni bel leil

arabic: النهاردة انا بطبخ اكل جديد في المطبخ
english: Today I am cooking new food in the kitchen.
transliteration: elneharda ana batbokh akl gediid fi elmatbakh

arabic: امي بتساعدني كتير
english: My mother is helping me a lot.
transliteration: omi betsaadni ketiir

arabic: اخويا جعان ومستني
english: My brother is hungry and waiting.
transliteration: akhouya gaaan we mestani

arabic: ريحة الاكل حلوة اوي
english: The smell of the food is very nice.
transliteration: rihet elaakl helwa awi

arabic: بناكل مع بعض والعيلة مبسوطة
english: We eat together and the family is happy.
transliteration: benaakol maa baad we eleila mabsouta

arabic: انا رحت ازور خالتي في القاهرة النهاردة
english: I went to visit my aunt in Cairo today.
transliteration: ana roht azour khalty fi el qahera el naharda

arabic: هي فتحت الباب وقالت اهلا بيك
english: She opened the door and said welcome.
transliteration: heya fatahet el bab we alet ahlan beek

arabic: انا قلت لها عامله ايه يا خالتي
english: I said to her how are you aunt.
transliteration: ana olt laha aamla eih ya khalty

arabic: هي قالت انا كويسة الحمد لله
english: She said I am fine thank God.
transliteration: heya alet ana kwayesa el hamdo lelah

arabic: احنا شربنا شاي بلبن مع بعض
english: We drank tea with milk together.
transliteration: ehna sherebna shay be laban maa baad

arabic: في مشكلة كبيرة في البيت النهاردة
english: There is a big problem at home today.
transliteration: Fi moshkela kebeera fel beet el naharda.

arabic: التلاجة مش شغالة و المية في كل حتة
english: The fridge is not working and the water is everywhere.
transliteration: El tallaga mesh shaghala wa el mayya fi kol hetta.

arabic: انا هتصل بالمدير بكرة عشان اخد اجازة
english: I will contact the manager tomorrow to take a day off.
transliteration: Ana hatessel bel modeer bokra ashan akhod agaza.

arabic: اخويا بيرد على اصحابه ومش بيساعدني
english: My brother replies to his friends and is not helping me.
transliteration: Akhouya biyrodd ala ashabo wa mesh beyseaadni.

arabic: انا هنضف المطبخ وهكمل المذاكرة بالليل
english: I will clean the kitchen and will continue studying at night.
transliteration: Ana hanaddaf el matbakh wa hakammil el mozakra bel leel.

arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع وريحة القهوة السخنة كانت حلوة
english: I was walking in the street and the smell of the hot coffee was beautiful.
transliteration: Kont mashi fi el sharea wa rihet el ahwa el sokhna kanet helwa.

arabic: فجاة شفت صاحبي القديم محمود قدام المخبز
english: Suddenly I saw my old friend Mahmoud in front of the bakery.
transliteration: Fagaa shoft sahby el adeem Mahmoud oddam el makhbaz.

arabic: كنت مبسوط اوي بس قلت انا اسف على التاخير
english: I was very happy but I said I am sorry for the delay.
transliteration: Kont mabsout awy bas olt ana asef ala el takheer.

arabic: غلطتي اني نسيت الميعاد مع اخويا
english: It is my mistake that I forgot the appointment with my brother.
transliteration: Ghaltety eny neseet el meaad maa akhouya.

arabic: هو قال مفيش مشكلة وامشي طوالي لحد ما تشوف البنك
english: He said no problem and go straight until you see the bank.
transliteration: Howa aal mafeesh moshkela wa emshy tawaly lahad ma tshouf el bank.

arabic: امبارح رحت السوق عشان اشتري حاجة للبيت
english: Yesterday I went to the market to buy a thing for the house.
transliteration: embareh roht el sooq ashan ashtari haga lel beit

arabic: شفت عمي اللي بيشتغل هناك
english: I saw my uncle who works there.
transliteration: shoft ammi elli biyeshtaghal henak

arabic: قلت له سلام عليكم يا عمي
english: I said to him peace be upon you uncle.
transliteration: olt loho salam aleykom ya ammi

arabic: قال اهلا بيك ازي العيلة
english: He said welcome how is the family.
transliteration: aal ahlan beek ezay el eila

arabic: قعدنا مع بعض وشربنا شاي
english: We sat together and drank tea.
transliteration: aadna ma baad we sherebna shay

arabic: السلام عليكم يا علي، عامل ايه النهارده؟
english: Peace be upon you Ali, how are you doing today?
transliteration: As salamu alaykum ya Ali, amel eh ennaharda?

arabic: وعليكم السلام، الحمد لله كويس، وانت؟
english: And upon you be peace, thank God I am good, and you?
transliteration: Wa alaykum as salam, elhamdullelah kwayes, wenta?

arabic: انا كويس، انت فاضي بكرة عشان نشرب شاي الصبح؟
english: I am good, are you free tomorrow so we drink tea in the morning?
transliteration: Ana kwayes, enta fadi bokra ashan neshrab shay el sobh?

arabic: لأ، انا مشغول بكرة عشان هاعمل رياضة.
english: No, I am busy tomorrow because I will do sports.
transliteration: La, ana mashghool bokra ashan haamel reyada.

arabic: فكرة كويسة، انا خرجت مع اصحابي امبارح وتعبان.
english: Good idea, I went out with my friends yesterday and I am tired.
transliteration: Fekra kwayesa, ana kharagt ma a ashabi embareh wa taaban.

arabic: انت عندك حق، الدنيا مش ماشية كويس لما مش بننام.
english: You are right, the world is not going well when we do not sleep.
transliteration: Enta andak hak, el donia mesh mashya kewayyes lamma mesh benenam.

arabic: بالظبط، انا هانضف بيتي والاوضة النهارده بدل الخروج.
english: Exactly, I will clean my house and the room today instead of going out.
transliteration: Belzabt, ana hanaddaf beity wa el oda ennaharda badal el khoroog.

arabic: حلو اوي، وانا هشوف فيلم جديد في وقت فراغي.
english: Very nice, and I will watch a new movie in my free time.
transliteration: Helw awi, wa ana hashoof film gedid fi wakt faraghi.

arabic: ممتاز، ممكن ازورك الاسبوع الجاي مع اعز صاحب ليا؟
english: Excellent, can I visit you next week with my best friend?
transliteration: Momtaz, momken azoorak el esbou el gay ma a a azz saheb leya?

arabic: اهلا وسهلا في اي وقت، انا جاهز وبيتي مفتوح ليك.
english: Welcome anytime, I am ready and my house is open for you.
transliteration: Ahlan wa sahlan fi ay wakt, ana gahez wa beity maftooh leek.

arabic: رحت انا وجدي عشان نتفرج على الماتش في الاستاد
english: My grandfather and I went to watch the match at the stadium.
transliteration: roht ana wa gedi ashan netfarag ala el matsh fi el estad

arabic: هو كان لابس قميص كحلي غامق وانا كنت لابس تيشيرت ملون
english: He was wearing a dark navy blue shirt and I was wearing a colored tshirt.
transliteration: howa kan labes amees kohli ghamek wa ana kont labes teshert melawen

arabic: جدي استغرب من التيشيرت الفاقع بتاعي وقال ده بيوجع العين
english: My grandfather was surprised by my bright tshirt and said it hurts the eye.
transliteration: gedi estaghrab men el teshert el faakea betaaee wa aal da beyewgaa el ayn

arabic: قلت له ان الشباب دلوقتي بتحب تلبس الوان كتير في الرياضة
english: I told him that the youth nowadays love to wear many colors in sports.
transliteration: olt loh en el shabab delwaaty betheb telbes alwaan keteer fi el reyada

arabic: هو ضحك وقال ايامه كانت كل هدوم الكورة ابيض او اسود
english: He laughed and said in his days all football clothes were white or black.
transliteration: howa dehek wa aal ayamo kanet kol hedoom el kora abyad aw eswed

arabic: احمد وعمر بيلعبوا ماتش كورة النهاردة
english: Ahmed and Omar are playing a football match today.
transliteration: ahmed wa omar beyelaabou match kora elnaharda

arabic: عمر بيقول باصي الكورة ليا بسرعة
english: Omar says pass the ball to me quickly.
transliteration: omar beyool bassy el kora leya besoraa

arabic: احمد بيلعب الكورة حلو اوي
english: Ahmed plays the ball very well.
transliteration: ahmed beyelaab el kora helw awy

arabic: احمد بيجيب جول جميل في الاخر
english: Ahmed scores a beautiful goal in the end.
transliteration: ahmed beygeeb goal gameel fe el akher

arabic: هم مبسوطين جدا بعد الماتش
english: They are very happy after the match.
transliteration: homa mabsooteen gedan baad el match

arabic: النور في الصالة مش شغال
english: The light in the living room is not working.
transliteration: el noor fi el sala mish shaghghal

arabic: ابويا عايز يصلح النور دلوقتي
english: My father wants to fix the light now.
transliteration: abouya ayiz yesallah el noor delwaqti

arabic: اخويا بيجيب اللمبة الجديدة من الاوضة
english: My brother brings the new lamp from the room.
transliteration: akhouya beygeeb el lamba el gedeeda min el oda

arabic: امي بتساعد ابويا بابتسامة
english: My mother helps my father with a smile.
transliteration: ommi betsaaed abouya be ebtesama

arabic: دلوقتي الصالة حلوة اوي
english: Now the living room is very beautiful.
transliteration: delwaqti el sala helwa awi

arabic: انا رحت بيت جدتي النهارده
english: I went to my grandmother's house today.
transliteration: ana roht beit gedety el naharda

arabic: انا جبت معايا علبة جاتوه
english: I brought a box of cake with me.
transliteration: ana gebt maaya elbet gatoh

arabic: هي عملت شاي بالنعناع
english: She made tea with mint.
transliteration: heya amalet shay bel nanaa

arabic: احنا اكلنا الغدا سوا والاكل كان حلو
english: We ate lunch together and the food was good.
transliteration: ehna akalna el ghada sawa wa el akl kan helw

arabic: انا بست ايدها قبل ما امشي
english: I kissed her hand before I left.
transliteration: ana bost edha abl ma amshy

arabic: احمد راح المحل عشان يشتري هدوم
english: Ahmed went to the shop to buy clothes.
transliteration: ahmed raah el mahal ashan yeshtery hedoom

arabic: احمد قال للبياع انا عايز قميص جديد
english: Ahmed said to the seller I want a new shirt.
transliteration: ahmed aal lel bayaa ana ayez amees gedeed

arabic: البياع جاب قميص ازرق حلو
english: The seller brought a nice blue shirt.
transliteration: el bayaa gaab amees azra helw

arabic: احمد قال بكام القميص ده
english: Ahmed said how much is this shirt.
transliteration: ahmed aal bekam el amees da

arabic: البياع قال القميص ده رخيص اوي
english: The seller said this shirt is very cheap.
transliteration: el bayaa aal el amees da rekhees awy

arabic: امبارح انا رحت مع عيلتي عشان نشتري هدوم
english: Yesterday I went with my family to buy clothes.
transliteration: embareh ana roht ma eilety ashan neshtry hodoom

arabic: انا شفت حاجة حلوة اوي في المحل
english: I saw a very nice thing in the shop.
transliteration: ana shoft haga helwa awy fi el mahal

arabic: جدي بيشتغل في مصنع وبيحب الهدوم الكلاسيك
english: My grandfather works in a factory and likes classic clothes.
transliteration: geddy biyeshtaghal fi masna we biheb el hodoom el classik

arabic: هو قال الهدوم الجديدة دي وحشة باقي السنه
english: He said these new clothes are bad for the rest of the year.
transliteration: howa aal el hodoom el gedida di wahsha baqi el sana

arabic: احنا رجعنا البيت وشربنا شاي
english: We went back to the house and drank tea.
transliteration: ehna ragaana el beit we sharabna shay

arabic: امبارح انا وعيلتي قعدنا في البيت
english: Yesterday my family and I sat in the house.
transliteration: embareh ana we eilaty aadna fe el beit

arabic: شربنا شاي سخن واكلنا حاجة حلوة
english: We drank hot tea and ate a sweet thing.
transliteration: sherebna shay sokhn we akalna haga helwa

arabic: اخويا بيشتغل كتير عشان كده عايز مكان هادي
english: My brother works a lot so he wants a quiet place.
transliteration: akhouya biyeshtaghal keteer ashan keda ayiz makan hady

arabic: احنا هنروح الريف عشان نشوف بط جميل
english: We will go to the countryside to see beautiful ducks.
transliteration: ehna hanrouh el reef ashan neshouf batt gameel

arabic: الرحلة دي زي احلام جميلة لينا
english: This trip is like beautiful dreams for us.
transliteration: el rehla de zay ahlam gamila lina

arabic: ابني بيسال كتير اوي
english: My son asks very much.
transliteration: ibni biyesal kitir awi

arabic: بيقول بابا ليه الشمس حر
english: He says dad why is the sun hot.
transliteration: biyoul baba leh el shams har

arabic: وبعدين يسال امتى ناكل بيتزا
english: And then he asks when we eat pizza.
transliteration: we baaden yesal emta nakol bitza

arabic: انا مش عارف كل حاجة
english: I do not know everything.
transliteration: ana mesh aref kol haga

arabic: دلوقتي انا عايز انام بس
english: Now I just want to sleep.
transliteration: delwaqti ana ayez anam bas

arabic: انا بصحى بدري كل يوم
english: I wake up early every day.
transliteration: ana basha badry kol yom

arabic: انا بشرب شاي بلبن بسرعة
english: I drink tea with milk quickly.
transliteration: ana bashrab shay belaban besoraa

arabic: بعدين باكل فطار صغير
english: Then I eat a small breakfast.
transliteration: baadeen bakol fetar soghayar

arabic: انا بلبس هدومي عشان الشغل
english: I wear my clothes for work.
transliteration: ana balbes hodomy ashan el shoghl

arabic: انا بروح الشغل بالعربية
english: I go to work by car.
transliteration: ana barouh el shoghl bel arabeya

arabic: النهارده نزلنا انا وامي سوق الخضار عشان نجهز غدا العيلة
english: Today my mother and I went down to the vegetable market to prepare the family lunch.
transliteration: El-naharda nezelna ana wa ommi soo' el-khodar ashan negahez ghada el-eila.

arabic: البياع رحب بينا وقال لامي اهلا بيكي يا حاجة ازيك
english: The seller welcomed us and said to my mother welcome to you Hajja how are you.
transliteration: El-bayya' rahhab beena wa aal le ommi ahlan beeki ya hagga izzayyik.

arabic: امي ابتسمت وردت عليه انا كويسة الحمد لله ونقت طماطم وخيار
english: My mother smiled and replied to him I am good praise be to God and picked tomatoes and cucumbers.
transliteration: Ommi ebtasamet wa raddet aleyh ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah wa naqqet tomatem wa khiyar.

arabic: بعد ما وزن الخضار ودفعنا الحساب امي قالت له مع السلامة
english: After he weighed the vegetables and we paid the bill my mother said to him goodbye.
transliteration: Ba'd ma wazan el-khodar wa dafa'na el-hesab ommi aalet loh ma'a salama.

arabic: البياع اداني تفاحة ببلاش وقال لنا الله يسلمك
english: The seller gave me an apple for free and said to us may God keep you safe.
transliteration: El-bayya' eddani toffaha bebalash wa aal lina Allah yisallimik.

arabic: النهارده عيلتي بتاكل مع بعض في البيت
english: Today my family is eating together in the house.
transliteration: elnaharda eilety betakol maa baad fel beit

arabic: امي طبخت اكل كتير حلو
english: My mother cooked a lot of delicious food.
transliteration: omy tabakhet akl keteer helw

arabic: ابويا بيتكلم وبيضحك مع اخويا
english: My father is talking and laughing with my brother.
transliteration: abouya beyetkallem we beyedhak maa akhouya

arabic: اختي الصغيره قاعده جنبي
english: My little sister is sitting next to me.
transliteration: okhty elsoghayara aada ganby

arabic: انا بحب عيلتي واليوم الدافي ده
english: I love my family and this warm day.
transliteration: ana baheb eilety wel yom eldafy da

arabic: انا بصحى بدري كل يوم
english: I wake up early every day.
transliteration: ana bashy badry kol yom

arabic: مراتي بتعمل شاي وفطار لينا
english: My wife makes tea and breakfast for us.
transliteration: meraty betemel shay we fetar lina

arabic: الولاد بياكلوا العيش والجبنة بسرعة
english: The kids eat the bread and cheese quickly.
transliteration: el welad beyaklo el eish wel gebna besorea

arabic: انا بشرب الشاي بتاعي وبلعب مع بنتي
english: I drink my tea and play with my daughter.
transliteration: ana bashrab el shay betaei we balab ma benty

arabic: احنا بننزل من البيت وبنروح الشغل مبسوطين
english: We leave the house and go to work happy.
transliteration: ehna benenzel men el bet we benroh el shoghl mabsotin

arabic: كلمت صاحبي احمد في التليفون النهارده
english: I called my friend Ahmed on the phone today
transliteration: kalemt sahby ahmed fe el telefon elnaharda
storyTitle: A phone call with my friend

arabic: قال لي الو عامل ايه يا صاحبي
english: He said to me hello how are you doing my friend
transliteration: aal ly alo aamel eh ya sahby
storyTitle: A phone call with my friend

arabic: قلت له الحمد لله انا وعيلتي كويسين

transliteration: el reeha wahsha we kol haga mabloola
