english: I am calling the plumber to fix the pipe now.
transliteration: ana bakallem el sabbak ashan yesallah el masoora delwaqti

arabic: احمد راح المحل عشان يرجع القميص
english: Ahmed went to the shop to return the shirt.
transliteration: Ahmed raah el mahal ashan yeraggaa el amees

arabic: هو قال للراجل القميص ده كبير اوي
english: He said to the man this shirt is very big.
transliteration: Howa aal lel ragel el amees da kebeer awi

arabic: الراجل بص على القميص و ضحك
english: The man looked at the shirt and laughed.
transliteration: El ragel bas ala el amees wa dehek

arabic: هو قال القميص ده مش من هنا
english: He said this shirt is not from here.
transliteration: Howa aal el amees da mesh men hena

arabic: احمد خد القميص و راح المحل التاني
english: Ahmed took the shirt and went to the other shop.
transliteration: Ahmed khad el amees wa raah el mahal el tani

arabic: رحت المحل عشان اشتري هدوم جديدة
english: I went to the store to buy new clothes.
transliteration: ruht el mahal ashan ishtiri huduum gidiida

arabic: شفت قميص احمر حلو اوي
english: I saw a very beautiful red shirt.
transliteration: shuft amiis ahmar hilw awi

arabic: بس القميص كان غالي اوي
english: But the shirt was very expensive.
transliteration: bas el amiis kaan ghaali awi

arabic: زعلت وطلعت من المحل
english: I got sad and left the store.
transliteration: zaelt w talaet min el mahal

arabic: بعدين لقيت قميص رخيص وبقيت فرحان
english: Then I found a cheap shirt and I became happy.
transliteration: baadeen laayt amiis rakhiis w baayt farhaan

arabic: امبارح جاري كان زعلان في بيته
english: Yesterday my neighbor was sad in his house.
transliteration: embareh gari kan zaalan fi beito.

arabic: انا رحت عنده وشربنا شاي سوا
english: I went to him and we drank tea together.
transliteration: ana roht ando we sharebna shay sawa.

arabic: هو قالي انه بيشتغل كتير عشان عيلته
english: He told me that he works a lot for his family.
transliteration: howa ali enno biyeshtaghal keteer ashan eilto.

arabic: انا قلت دي حاجة كويسة وهو ابتسم
english: I said this is a good thing and he smiled.
transliteration: ana olt di haga kwayesa we howa ebtasam.

arabic: دلوقتي هو مبسوط وعنده احلام حلوة
english: Now he is happy and has beautiful dreams.
transliteration: delwaati howa mabsout we ando ahlam helwa.

arabic: امبارح رحت ازور اختي
english: Yesterday I went to visit my sister.
transliteration: embareh roht azour okhty

arabic: هي طبخت غدا حلو اوي
english: She cooked a very nice lunch.
transliteration: heya tabakhet ghada helw awy

arabic: انا قلت لها الاكل جميل
english: I said to her the food is beautiful.
transliteration: ana olt laha el akl gamil

arabic: هي قالت خد فنجان شاي
english: She said take a cup of tea.
transliteration: heya alet khod fengan shay

arabic: بعدين ولادها رجعوا من المدرسة
english: Then her kids returned from the school.
transliteration: baaden weladha rejou men el madrasa

arabic: انا بروح الشغل الصبح
english: I go to work in the morning.
transliteration: ana barouh el shoghl el sobh

arabic: المكتب كبير وفيه ريحة قهوة حلوة
english: The office is big and has a nice smell of coffee.
transliteration: el maktab kebeer wa feeh reeha ahwa helwa

arabic: انا بشرب شاي سخن على المكتب
english: I drink hot tea at the desk.
transliteration: ana bashrab shay sokhn aala el maktab

arabic: انا بسمع صوت عالي من الشارع
english: I hear a loud sound from the street.
transliteration: ana basmaa soot aaly men el sharea

arabic: الشغل كتير بس انا مبسوط
english: The work is a lot but I am happy.
transliteration: el shoghl keteer bas ana mabsoot

arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع وفجاة شفت حد ما شفتهوش من زمان اوي
english: I was walking in the street and suddenly saw someone I had not seen for a very long time.
transliteration: kont mashi fel sharea we fagaa shoft had ma shoftoosh men zaman awi

arabic: ما عرفتش مين ده في الاول علشان شكله اتغير قبل ما يقرب مني
english: I did not know who this was at first because his appearance changed before he got closer to me.
transliteration: ma araftesh meen da fel awal alashan shaklo etghayar abl ma yearab meny

arabic: بس اول ما ضحك اتاكدت فعلا ان ده صاحبي القديم
english: But as soon as he laughed I was really sure that this was my old friend.
transliteration: bas awal ma dehek etakedt fealan en da sahby el adeem

arabic: فرحت اوي وقلت الحمد لله اننا اتقابلنا تاني
english: I was very happy and said praise to God that we met again.
transliteration: feraht awi we olt el hamd lelah enena etabelna tany

arabic: حتى بعد السنين دي كلها احساسنا بقي كاننا ما بعدناش
english: Even after all these years our feeling remained as if we had not parted.
transliteration: hatta baad el seneen de kolaha ehsasna baea kaenena ma baadnash

arabic: كل يوم جمعة العيلة كلها بتتجمع قدام التليفزيون عشان تتفرج على ماتش المنتخب
english: Every Friday, the whole family gathers in front of the TV to watch the national team's match.
transliteration: kol yom gom3a el 3eila kolaha btetgama3 oddam el telvezyon 3ashan tetfarag 3ala matsh el montakhab
storyTitle: The National Team Match with the Family

arabic: امي عملتلنا فشار وشاي مسكر وقعدت جنب ابويا اللي كان متوتر اوي
english: My mom made us popcorn and sweet tea and sat next to my dad who was very nervous.
transliteration: ommy 3amaletlena feshar wa shay mesakkar wa 2a3adet ganb abouya elly kan metwattar awy
storyTitle: The National Team Match with the Family

arabic: في الشوط التاني اللعب بقى صعب بس اللعيبة كانوا بيجروا بسرعة
english: In the second half, the game got difficult but the players were running quickly.
transliteration: fe el showt el tany el le3b ba2a sa3b bas el le3eeba kano beyegrou besor3a
storyTitle: The National Team Match with the Family

arabic: فجاة المهاجم جاب جون يجنن وكلنا نطينا من الفرحة
english: Suddenly the striker scored an amazing goal and we all jumped from joy.
transliteration: fagaa el mohagem gab goon yegannen wa kollena natteyna men el farha
storyTitle: The National Team Match with the Family

arabic: ابويا حضن اخويا جامد والجو الدافي ملى الصالة
english: My dad hugged my brother tightly and the warm atmosphere filled the living room.
transliteration: abouya hadan akhouya gamed wel gaw el dafy mala el sala
storyTitle: The National Team Match with the Family

arabic: احمد قابل سارة في النادي وقال لها صباح الخير يا سارة ازيك
english: Ahmed met Sarah at the club and told her good morning Sarah how are you.
transliteration: Ahmed qabel Sara fi el nady wa aal laha sabaḥ el kheer ya Sara izzayyik.

arabic: سارة ردت عليه وقالت اهلا بيك انا كويسة الحمد لله
english: Sarah replied to him and said welcome to you I am good praise be to God.
transliteration: Sara raddet aaleeh wa aalet ahlan beek ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah.

arabic: هم قعدوا مع بعض علشان يتفرجوا على ماتش الكورة ويشجعوا الفريق
english: They sat with each other to watch the football match and cheer the team.
transliteration: Homa aadoo ma'a baad aalashan yetfarragoo aala match el kora wa yeshaggaoo el fareeq.

arabic: بعد ما الفريق كسب الماتش هم كانوا مبسوطين جدا
english: After the team won the match they were very happy.
transliteration: Baad ma el fareeq keseb el match homa kanoo mabsooteen geddan.

arabic: سارة كان لازم تمشي بدري وقالت لاحمد مع السلامة
english: Sarah had to leave early and said to Ahmed goodbye.
transliteration: Sara kan lazem temshy badry wa aalet le Ahmed ma'a salama.

arabic: علي كان ولد صغير بس هو ماكانش بيعرف يطبخ.
english: Ali was a young boy, but he did not know how to cook.
transliteration: Ali kan walad soghayar bas huwa makansh biyaaraf yitbukh.

arabic: كل يوم مامته طبخت أكل حلو عشان إخواته.
english: Every day, his mother cooked delicious food for his brothers.
transliteration: Kul yom mamto tabakhet akl helw ashan ekhwato.

arabic: هو كان عايز يساعدها ويتعلم معاها.
english: He wanted to help her and learn with her.
transliteration: Huwa kan ayez yesaaedha wa yetallem maaha.

arabic: إمبارح علي بدأ أول درس ليه في المطبخ.
english: Yesterday, Ali started his first lesson in the kitchen.
transliteration: Imbareh Ali bada awel dars lih fi el matbakh.

arabic: هو قطع الطماطم والبصل.
english: He cut the tomatoes and the onions.
transliteration: Huwa qataa el tamatem wa el basal.

arabic: النهارده هو بيطبخ غدا كبير عشان أصحابه.
english: Today, he cooks a big lunch for his friends.
transliteration: El naharda huwa biyitbukh ghada kebir ashan ashabo.

arabic: أصحابه بياكلوا الأكل وبيحبوه.
english: His friends eat the food and love it.
transliteration: Ashabo biyaklu el akl wa biyehubuh.

arabic: هما بيقولوا كلام حلو عن أطباقه الجديدة.
english: They say sweet words about his new dishes.
transliteration: Huma biqulu kalam helw an atbaqo el gedida.

arabic: دلوقتي علي بيعرف إن الغلطات بتعلم الناس.
english: Now, Ali knows that mistakes teach people.
transliteration: Dilwaqti Ali biyaaraf in el ghalatat bitalem el nas.

arabic: هو حاسس إنه مبسوط قوي عشان هو بيتعلم كتير.
english: He feels very happy because he is learning a lot.
transliteration: Huwa hases inu mabsut awi ashan huwa biyitalem ketir.

arabic: انا بروح السوق كل يوم الصبح
english: I go to the market every morning.
transliteration: ana barouh el souk kol yom el sobh

arabic: السوق قريب اوي من بيتي
english: The market is very close to my house.
transliteration: el souk arib awi men beity

arabic: انا بشتري عيش وطماطم
english: I buy bread and tomatoes.
transliteration: ana bashtari eish wa tomatom

arabic: الخضار طازة ورخيص
english: The vegetables are fresh and cheap.
transliteration: el khodar taza wa rkhis

arabic: برجع البيت عشان افطر
english: I return home to eat breakfast.
transliteration: barga el beit ashan aftar

arabic: امبارح عيلتي جت بيتي عشان ناكل
english: Yesterday my family came to my house to eat.
transliteration: embareh eiltey gat beity ashan nakol

arabic: طبخنا بط بس كان كبير اوي
english: We cooked duck but it was very big.
transliteration: tabakhna batt bas kan kebeer awy

arabic: اخويا بيشتغل كتير وكل البط كله
english: My brother works a lot and ate all the duck.
transliteration: akhouya biyeshtaghal keteer wa kal el batt kollo

arabic: هو مسابش اي حاجة لينا
english: He did not leave anything for us.
transliteration: howa masabsh ay haga leena

arabic: في الاخر شربنا شاي ونمنا
english: In the end we drank tea and slept.
transliteration: fe el akher sherebna shay wa nemna

arabic: مسافر كان بيمشي في الشارع وتاه
english: A traveler was walking in the street and got lost.
transliteration: mesafer kan beyemshy fe el sharea we tah.

arabic: هو كلم اصحابه بس هم رجعوا الفندق بدري
english: He called his friends but they returned to the hotel early.
transliteration: howa kalem ashabo bas homa regeo el fondoq badry.

arabic: هو سأل ست عن الطريق لمطعم قريب
english: He asked a woman about the way to a nearby restaurant.
transliteration: howa saal set an el tareeq le mataam areeb.

arabic: هو بص كويس وعرف انها اخت صاحبه
english: He looked well and knew that she is his friend's sister.
transliteration: howa bas kwayes we araf enaha okht sahbo.

arabic: هي عملت فنجان شاي وطبخت لحمة في حلتها
english: She made a cup of tea and cooked meat in her pot.
transliteration: heya aamalet fengan shay we tabakhet lahma fe haletha.

arabic: عمر صحي متاخر وكان بيجري في البيت عشان يدور على تليفونه
english: Omar woke up late and was running in the house to look for his phone
transliteration: Omar sehi metakhar wa kan beyegri fi el beit ashan edawar ala telephono

arabic: جده كان قاعد هادي بيشرب شاي وقال صباح الخير
english: His grandfather was sitting calmly drinking tea and said good morning
transliteration: Gedo kan aed hadi beyeshrab shay wa aal sabah el kheer

arabic: عمر رد بسرعة صباح النور السلام عليكم
english: Omar replied quickly morning of light peace be upon you
transliteration: Omar rad besoraa sabah an noor as salamu alaykum

arabic: الجد ضحك وقال وعليكم السلام بس فين فطارك
english: The grandfather laughed and said and upon you be peace but where is your breakfast
transliteration: El ged dehek wa aal wa alaykum as salam bas feen fetarak

arabic: الشاب قال مفيش وقت للاكل ونزل الشارع
english: The young man said there is no time for food and went down to the street
transliteration: El shab aal mafeesh waet lel akl wa nezel el sharea

arabic: احمد متاخر على الشغل وزعلان قوي
english: Ahmed is late for work and very upset.
transliteration: Ahmed metaakhkhar ala el shoghl wa zaalan awi

arabic: هو بيشوف سارة وبيقول السلام عليكم صباح الخير
english: He sees Sarah and says hello good morning.
transliteration: Howa bishoof Sara wa biyoul as salamu alaykum sabah el kheer

arabic: احمد بيسال صباح الخير يا سارة ازيك
english: Ahmed asks good morning Sarah how are you.
transliteration: Ahmed biyesal sabah el kheer ya Sara izzayyik

arabic: سارة بترد انا كويسة الحمد لله بس مشغولة
english: Sarah replies I am good praise be to God but busy.
transliteration: Sara betrodd ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah bas mashghoula

arabic: احمد بيجري بسرعة عشان هو متاخر وتعبان
english: Ahmed runs quickly because he is late and tired.
transliteration: Ahmed biyegri besoraa ashan howa metaakhkhar wa taaban

arabic: احمد جه وقال السلام عليكم صباح الخير ازيك يا سارة
english: Ahmed came and said hello good morning how are you Sarah
transliteration: Ahmed ga wa aal as salamu alaykum sabaah el kheer izzayyik ya Sara

arabic: سارة ابتسمت وقالت انا كويسة الحمد لله وانا جعانة اوي
english: Sarah smiled and said I am good alhamdulillah and I am very hungry
transliteration: Sara ibtasamet wa aalet ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah wa ana gaana awy

arabic: العيلة قعدت مع بعض والاكل كان حلو اوي
english: The family sat together and the food was very delicious
transliteration: El eila aadet maa baad wa el akl kaan helw awy

arabic: الام كانت فرحانة عشان كله بياكل وبيتكلم
english: The mother was happy because everyone is eating and talking
transliteration: El om kaanet farhana ashaan kollo beyakol wa beyetkallem

arabic: احمد اكل كتير وقال انا كويس وشبعان دلوقتي
english: Ahmed ate a lot and said I am good and full now
transliteration: Ahmed akal keteer wa aal ana kwayyes wa shabaan delwaaty

arabic: "يا عم محمود، أنا عايز ساندوتش فول بسرعة!"
english: "Uncle Mahmoud, I want a ful sandwich quickly!"
transliteration: "Ya am Mahmoud, ana ayiz sandwitsh ful bisuraa!"

arabic: عمر عنده تلاتين سنة وبيشتغل ميكانيكي في الدقي، وهو دايما جعان.
english: Omar is thirty years old and works as a mechanic in Dokki, and he is always hungry.
transliteration: Omar ando talateen sana wa biyishtaghal meekaneekee fee El Dokki, wa howa dayman gaaan.

arabic: هو دور في جيوبه، بس ملقاش فلوس كتير.
english: He searched in his pockets, but he did not find much money.
transliteration: Howa dawwar fee giyoobo, bas malaqash fuloos kiteer.

arabic: عمر كان معاه خمسة جنيه بس النهاردة.
english: Omar had only five pounds with him today.
transliteration: Omar kaan maah khamsa gineh bas elnaharda.

arabic: ساندوتش الفول العادي في الشارع ده بعشرة جنيه.
english: The regular ful sandwich in this street is for ten pounds.
transliteration: Sandwitsh el ful el aadee fee el shaaria da bi ashara gineh.

arabic: عمر زعلان جدا وبيقول: "معلش يا عم، أنا هروح".
english: Omar is very sad and says: "Sorry uncle, I will go".
transliteration: Omar zaalaan gidan wa biyekool: "maalesh ya am, ana harooh".

arabic: بس عم محمود راجل طيب وبيحب جيرانه.
english: But Uncle Mahmoud is a kind man and loves his neighbors.
transliteration: Bas am Mahmoud raagel tayyib wa biyeheb geerano.

arabic: هو إدى عمر الساندوتش وقاله: "خد يا ابني، ولا يهمك".
english: He gave Omar the sandwich and told him: "Take it my son, do not worry".
transliteration: Howa idda Omar el sandwitsh wa aalo: "khod ya ibnee, wala yehemmak".

arabic: عمر بياكل الفول السخن وبيشرب شاي.
english: Omar eats the hot ful and drinks tea.
transliteration: Omar biyaakol el ful el sokhn wa biyeshrab shay.

arabic: هو مبسوط عشان الفطار طعمه حلو خالص.
english: He is happy because the breakfast tastes very good.
transliteration: Howa mabsoot ashaan el fitaar taamo helw khaales.

arabic: انا بروح السوق كل يوم
english: I go to the market every day.
transliteration: ana barooh el sook kol yom

arabic: السوق زحمة اوي النهاردة
english: The market is very crowded today.
transliteration: el sook zahma awy el naharda

arabic: انا عايز اشتري طماطم وعيش
english: I want to buy tomatoes and bread.
transliteration: ana ayez eshtery tomatem wa eish

arabic: الطماطم رخيصة بس العيش غالي
english: The tomatoes are cheap but the bread is expensive.
transliteration: el tomatem rkheesa bas el eish ghaly

arabic: انا برجع البيت مبسوط
english: I go back home happy.
transliteration: ana barga el beit mabsout

arabic: انا بصحى بدري كل يوم
english: I wake up early every day.
transliteration: ana bashaa badry kol yom

arabic: بشرب قهوة بلبن الصبح
english: I drink coffee with milk in the morning.
transliteration: bashrab ahwa belaban el sobh

arabic: باكل عيش وجبنة
english: I eat bread and cheese.
transliteration: bakol eish wa gebna

arabic: بلبس هدومي بسرعة جدا
english: I wear my clothes very fast.
transliteration: balbes hodoumy besoraa gedan

arabic: بروح الشغل بالاتوبيس
english: I go to work by bus.
transliteration: barouh el shoghl bel otobees

arabic: السلام عليكم يا احمد ازيك انا كويس الحمد لله
english: Hello Ahmed how are you I am good alhamdulillah
transliteration: As salamu alaykum ya Ahmed izzayyak ana kwayyes alhamdulillah

arabic: انا عايز اروح اسكندرية يوم الجمعة
english: I want to go to Alexandria on Friday
transliteration: Ana ayiz aruh Iskandariyya yom el gomaa

arabic: اهلا بيك معايا في الرحلة
english: Welcome to you with me on the trip
transliteration: Ahlan beek maaya fi el rehla

arabic: احنا هنسافر الصبح بدري
english: We will travel early in the morning
transliteration: Ehna hansafir el sobh badri

arabic: مع السلامة دلوقتي
english: Goodbye for now
transliteration: Maa salama dilwaqti

arabic: انا قاعد على القهوة البلدي
english: I am sitting at the local cafe.
transliteration: ana aed ala el ahwa el baladi

arabic: طلبت شاي بالنعناع من القهوجي
english: I ordered tea with mint from the waiter.
transliteration: talabt shai bel naanaa men el ahwagi

arabic: الشاي جه في كوباية ازاز
english: The tea came in a glass cup.
transliteration: el shai gah fi kobaya ezaz

arabic: الناس حوالي بيلعبوا طاولة
english: The people around me are playing backgammon.
transliteration: el nas hawalaya beyelabo tawla

arabic: انا مستني صاحبي عشان نشرب الشاي سوا
english: I am waiting for my friend so we can drink the tea together.
transliteration: ana mestani sahby ashan neshrab el shai sawa

arabic: انا رحت بيت عمتي النهارده
english: I went to my aunt's house today.
transliteration: ana roht beit ammeti elnaharda

arabic: انا شميت ريحة شاي بالنعناع
english: I smelled the scent of mint tea.
transliteration: ana shammeit rihet shay belnanaa

arabic: انا اكلت بسبوسة سخنة جدا
english: I ate very hot basbousa.
transliteration: ana akalt basboosa sokhna geddan

arabic: الكرسي في الصالة مريح قوي
english: The chair in the living room is very comfortable.
transliteration: elkorsi fi elsala morih awi

english: When I am happy, I talk to my friends, but I remembered that it's my cat's birthday
transliteration: Lama bakoon mabsoot bakallem ashabi bas eftakart en da eid milad ottati

arabic: النهاردة كل العيلة متجمعة في بيتي عشان ناكل
english: Today all the family is gathered at my house to eat.
transliteration: Elnaharda koll el3eila metgammea fe beiti 3ashan nakol

arabic: ريحة الأكل الحلو مالية المكان وماما طبخت محاشي كتير
english: The smell of the delicious food fills the place, and mom cooked a lot of mahshi.
transliteration: Reehet elakl elhelw malya el makan w mama tabakhet ma7ashi kteer

arabic: أنا جعان اوي ولما بشوف عيلتي مبسوطة كده أنا بكون مبسوط جدا
english: I am very hungry, and when I see my family happy like this, I get very happy.
transliteration: Ana gaaan awi w lama bashoof 3eilti mabsoota keda ana bakoon mabsoot giddan

arabic: كلنا بناكل وبنضحك وبنتكلم عن حاجات كتير بصوت عالي
english: We are all eating, laughing, and talking about many things loudly.
transliteration: Kollena banakol w bandahak w banetkallem 3an hagag kteer besoot 3ali

arabic: بعد الأكل لما مفيش قهوة في البيت أنا هشتري قهوة من اوبر ايتس عشان نكمل السهرة
english: After eating, when there's no coffee at home, I will buy coffee from Uber Eats so we can continue the evening.
transliteration: Ba3d elakl lama mafish ahwa fil beit ana hashtry ahwa men Uber Eats 3ashan nekammel elsahra

arabic: منى شايلة شنطتها الكبيرة وبتبص في كتب سوق العتبة، والسعر ده غالي خالص عليها.
english: Mona, carrying her big bag, was looking at the books in Ataba market, and this price was too expensive for her.
transliteration: Mona shayla shantetha el-kebira we betbos fi kotob Souq El Ataba, wel se'r da ghali khales 3aleha.
storyTitle: Mona and the Ataba Market Book

arabic: هي عايزة كتاب "ألف ليلة وليلة" اللي كان بـ ٨٠ جنيه، بس معاها ٥٠ جنيه بس.
english: She wanted "One Thousand and One Nights" book, which was 80 EGP, but she only had 50 EGP.
transliteration: Heya 3ayza ketab "Alf Leila we Leila" elly kan be-80 geneh, bas ma'aha 50 geneh bas.
storyTitle: Mona and the Ataba Market Book

arabic: البياع اللي اسمه عم حسن، راجل كبير كده، لاحظ إنها زعلانة شوية.
english: The vendor, whose name was Uncle Hassan, an older man, noticed that she was a bit sad.
transliteration: El-bayya3 elly esmo 3amm Hassan, ragel kebir kida, lahezh enaha za3lana shwaya.
storyTitle: Mona and the Ataba Market Book

arabic: عم حسن قالها: "يا بنتي، معلش، طب خدي الكتاب ده بـ ٥٠ جنيه عشانك."
english: Uncle Hassan told her: "My daughter, never mind, okay take this book for 50 EGP for you."
transliteration: 3amm Hassan al-laha: "Ya benty, ma'lesh, tab khodi el-ketab da be-50 geneh 3ashanak."
storyTitle: Mona and the Ataba Market Book

arabic: منى فرحت خالص وشكرت عم حسن كتير وراحت البيت مبسوطة.
english: Mona was very happy and thanked Uncle Hassan a lot and went home pleased.
transliteration: Mona farehet khales we shakaret 3amm Hassan ketir we rahet el-beit mabsoota.
storyTitle: Mona and the Ataba Market Book

arabic: الدنيا بتمطر بره وانا قاعد في بيتي دلوقتي
english: It's raining outside and I'm sitting in my house now
transliteration: El donya betmatar barra w ana aaed fi beiti delwaqty

arabic: أنا جعان اوي دلوقتي وهاعمل أكل حلو
english: I am very hungry now and I will make nice food
transliteration: Ana gaaan awi delwaqty w haamel akl helw

arabic: بس مفيش قهوة في البيت وده مش كويس خالص
english: But there is no coffee at home and this is not good at all
transliteration: Bas mafish ahwa fil beit w da mesh kwayes khales

arabic: هفتح تليفوني وهشتري قهوة من اوبر ايتس حالا
english: I will open my phone and I will buy coffee from Uber Eats right now
transliteration: Haftah telefooni w hashtry ahwa men Uber Eats hala

arabic: لما بيكون عندي اكل وقهوة انا مبسوط اوي في اليوم ده
english: When I have food and coffee, I am very happy on that day
transliteration: Lama bikoon aandy akl w ahwa ana mabsoot awi fil yoom da

arabic: الو ازيك يا منى عاملة ايه
english: Hello, how are you Mona?
transliteration: Alo ezayek ya Mona amla eh?

arabic: انا لسه نايمه من ساعتين عشان كنت تعبانه اوي من الشغل
english: I just fell asleep two hours ago because I was very tired from work.
transliteration: Ana lessa nayma men saatein ashan kont taabana awi men el shoghl.

arabic: اه عشان كدة انتي شوفتي هدير انهارده الصبح
english: Oh, that's why. Did you see Hadeer this morning?
transliteration: Ah ashan keda inti shofti Hadeer ennaharda essobh?

arabic: لأ انا لسه سايباها في المول من ساعه
english: No, I just left her at the mall an hour ago.
transliteration: La ana lessa saybaha fi el mol men saaha.

arabic: طيب انا رايحه اشتري حاجات من السوق عايزة حاجه
english: Okay, I'm going to buy some things from the market, do you want anything?
transliteration: Tayeb ana rayha ashtiri hagat min es souq, ayza haga?

arabic: النهاردة بابا وماما عاملين عزومة كبيرة في البيت دي عائلتي كلها
english: Today Baba and Mama are hosting a big feast at home this is my whole family
transliteration: Elnaharda Baba we Mama 3amleen 3azouma kebeera fel beit di 3aylti kolaha

arabic: قاعدين على السفرة بنتي مريم بتصور الأكل بالتليفون
english: Sitting at the dining table my daughter Maryam is photographing the food with her phone
transliteration: Qa3deen 3ala el sofra benti Maryam betsawwar el akl bel telephon

arabic: أخويا الكبير بيقول لها سيبك من التليفون وكلي
english: My older brother tells her 'leave the phone and eat'
transliteration: Akhoya el kebeer bey2oul laha sibek men el telephon we koli

arabic: بس ولدي الصغير كان بيضحك وعايز ياخد صورة هو كمان
english: But my young son was laughing and wanted to take a picture too
transliteration: Bas waladi el soghayyar kan beyed7ak we 3ayez ya5od soura howa kaman

arabic: جدتي كانت بتحكي حواديت زمان وأحنا كلنا بنسمع
english: My grandmother was telling old stories and we were all listening
transliteration: Gedtety kanet beta7ki 7awadeet zaman we e7na kolena benesma3

arabic: سلمت مها على عمها وقالت السلام عليكم
english: Maha greeted her uncle and said, "Hello".
transliteration: Sallamit Maha 3ala 3ammaha wi 'alit as-salamu alaykum.

arabic: رد العم وقال ازيك يا مها اتفضلي اقعدي
english: The uncle replied and said, "How are you, Maha? Please, sit down."
transliteration: Radd el-3amm wi 'al izzayyik ya Maha itfaḍḍali 'u3di.

arabic: العيلة كلها قاعدة بتاكل غدا سوا
english: The whole family is sitting eating lunch together.
transliteration: El-3eila kullaha 'a3da bta'kol ghada sawa.

arabic: كلهم بيحبوا ياكلوا بايديهم ويشاركوا الاكل
english: Everyone loves to eat with their hands and share the food.
transliteration: Kulluhum biyiḥibbu yaklu bi'ideihom wi yisharku el-akl.

arabic: بعد الاكل قالت مها مع السلامة ورد العم الله يسلمك
english: After the meal, Maha said, "Goodbye," and the uncle replied, "May God keep you safe."
transliteration: Ba3d el-akl 'alit Maha ma3a salama wi radd el-3amm Allah yisallimak.

arabic: كان فيه ولد صغير اسمه أحمد بيسأل أسئلة كتير كل يوم
english: There was a small boy named Ahmed who asked many questions every day
transliteration: Kan feeh walad soghayar esmo Ahmad byes'al as'ila kiteer kol yawm

arabic: هو دايماً يقول ليه السما زرقا وإيه ده يا ماما
english: He always says 'why is the sky blue?' and 'what is that, Mom?'
transliteration: Howa dayman ye'oul leih el sama zar'a w eih dah ya mama

arabic: ماما كانت بتقول مش عارفة يا حبيبي
english: Mom used to say 'I don't know, my dear'
transliteration: Mama kanet bet'oul mish 'arfa ya habibi

arabic: هي كانت تعبانة من الأسئلة دي
english: She was tired from these questions
transliteration: Heya kanet ta'bana men el as'ila di

arabic: أحمد بص لماما وقال عايز أعرف كل حاجة عشان أبقى أستاذ
english: Ahmed looked at Mom and said 'I want to know everything so I can be a teacher'
transliteration: Ahmad boss le mama w 'al 'ayez a'raf kol haga 'ashan ab'a ostaz

arabic: انا عايزة نعمل فرح كبير
english: I want us to make a big wedding.
transliteration: Ana 3ayza ne3mel farah kbeer.

arabic: طيب يا حبيبتي فين المكان الجديد ده
english: Okay my dear. Where is this new place?
transliteration: Tayeb ya habibty feen el makan el gedid da.

arabic: ايوه نكتب اسم ناس كتير
english: Yes, let's write many people's names.
transliteration: Aywa nekteb esm nas keteer.

arabic: يلا نروح المكان النهارده
english: Let's go to the place today.
transliteration: Yalla nroo7 el makan el naharda.

arabic: ده شغل كتير قوي
english: This is a lot of work!
transliteration: Da shoghl keteer awi!

arabic: انا رحت السوق
english: I went to the market.
transliteration: Ana roht el sooq.

arabic: السوق كان زحمة اوي
english: The market was very crowded.
transliteration: El sooq kaan zahma awi.

arabic: شفت خضار وفاكهة كتير وكنت مبسوط
english: I saw a lot of vegetables and fruits and I was happy.
transliteration: Shoft khodaar w fak-ha keteer w kont mabsoot.

arabic: عايز اشتري طماطم بس لقيتها غالية شوية
english: I want to buy tomatoes but I found them a bit expensive.
transliteration: Aayez ashtari tamaatem bas laqet'ha ghalia shwaya.

arabic: دفعت فلوس وقولت شكرا للبياع
english: I paid money and said thank you to the seller.
transliteration: Dafa't felous w olt shokran lel baya'.

arabic: احنا دلوقتي بنجهز للفرح
english: We are now preparing for the wedding.
transliteration: Ehna delwa'ty bengehhez lel-farah.

arabic: البيت كله لون ابيض وجميل اوي
english: The whole house is white and very beautiful.
transliteration: El-beit kullo lon abyad w gameel awi.

arabic: في اكل حلو كتير وموسيقى صوتها عالي
english: There is a lot of nice food and loud music.
transliteration: Fi akl helw keteer w mosiqa sot-ha 'aly.

arabic: صحابي هنا بيساعدوا كل يوم
english: My friends are here helping every day.
transliteration: Sahaby hena bysa'dou koll yom.

arabic: الفرح هيكون بالليل الاسبوع الجاي
english: The wedding will be at night next week.
transliteration: El-farah haykoun bel-leil el-osbou' el-gay.

arabic: انا بتفرج على ماتش كورة مع صاحبي
english: I am watching a football game with my friend.
transliteration: Ana batfarrag 3ala matsh koora ma3 ṣāḥibī

arabic: احنا مبسوطين عشان فرقتنا بتلعب حلو
english: We are happy because our team is playing well.
transliteration: Iḥna mabsooteen 3ashān fir2itna bital3ab ḥilw

arabic: صاحبي قال يا لهوي جون
english: My friend said "Wow, a goal!"
transliteration: Ṣāḥibī ʾāl ya laḥwī gōn

arabic: انا قلت ايوه جون جميل
english: I said "Yes, a beautiful goal!"
transliteration: Ana ʾult aywa gōn gameel

arabic: خالي كان بيتفرج على الماتش معانا
english: My uncle was watching the match with us.
transliteration: Khālī kān biyitfarrag 3ala elmatsh ma3ana

arabic: احنا عائلة كبيرة
english: We are a big family.
transliteration: Ehna 'a'ila kebeera.

arabic: النهاردة بنخطط لفرح حلو
english: Today we are planning for a sweet wedding.
transliteration: Elnaharda benkhattat le farah helw.

arabic: ماما وبابا مبسوطين جدا
english: Mom and Dad are very happy.
transliteration: Mama w Baba mabsooteen giddan.

arabic: كلنا عايزين اكل كتير
english: We all want a lot of food.
transliteration: Kollena 'ayzeen akl keteer.

arabic: الفرح هيكون جميل هنا
english: The wedding will be beautiful here.
transliteration: Elfarah haykoon gameel hena.

arabic: اليوم في المدرسة كان فيه مدرس جديد
english: Today at school there was a new teacher.
transliteration: El-yoom fel madrasa kan feeh modarres gedid

arabic: المدرس بيستخدم طريقة سهلة على التليفون
english: The teacher uses an easy method on the phone.
transliteration: El-modarres beyestakhdem tareeqa sahla 'ala el-telefoan

arabic: الطلاب الصغيرين بيحبوا الطريقة دي
english: The young students like this method.
transliteration: El-tollab el-soghayyareen beyhebbou el-tareeqa di

arabic: المدرس القديم كان بيستخدم الكتاب بس
english: The old teacher used only the book.
transliteration: El-modarres el-adeem kan beyestakhdem el-ketab bas

arabic: ده جيل جديد ودي طريقة شغل مختلفة
english: This is a new generation and this is a different way of working.
transliteration: Da geel gedid we di taree'et shoghl mokhtalefa

arabic: مفيش قهوة في بيتي النهاردة انا جيت هنا عشان اشتري قهوة
english: There is no coffee in my house today, I came here to buy coffee.
transliteration: Mafish ahwa fi beiti enharda ana geet hena ashan ashtary ahwa

arabic: ريحة البن الحلوة في كل مكان و بسمع مزيكا هادية
english: The sweet smell of coffee beans is everywhere and I hear calm music.
transliteration: Reehet el bon el helwa fi kol makan w basma' mazika hadya

arabic: انا قاعد على ترابيزة صغيرة وببص في تليفوني وانا مستني طلبي
english: I am sitting at a small table and looking at my phone while waiting for my order.
transliteration: Ana aa'ed ala tarabeeza soghayara w baboss fi telefooni wana mestanny talaby

arabic: لما بشوف القهوة جاية انا بكون مبسوط اوي
english: When I see the coffee coming, I get very happy.
transliteration: Lama bashoof el ahwa gaya ana bakoon mabsoot awy

arabic: الكوباية سخنة و لون القهوة غامق جميل
english: The cup is hot and the coffee color is beautifully dark.
transliteration: El kobaya sokhna w loon el ahwa ghameq gameel

arabic: اهلا يا علي ازيك
english: Hello Ali, how are you?
transliteration: Ahlan ya Ali, Ezzayak?

arabic: انا كويس يا سلمى ازيك انت
english: I am good Salma, how are you?
transliteration: Ana kwayyes ya Salma, Ezzayek enti?

arabic: احنا بنخطط لفرح اختي سارة
english: We are planning my sister Sarah's wedding.
transliteration: E7na benkhaTTet le farah okhti Sarah.

arabic: كل بنات العيلة بيساعدوا
english: All the girls in the family are helping.
transliteration: Kol banat el-3eila beyza3doo.

arabic: ماما بتعمل اكل حلو قوي لينا كلنا
english: Mom is making very delicious food for all of us.
transliteration: Mama beta3mel akl Helw awi leena kolena.

arabic: انا اتصلت بصاحبي احمد الصبح بدري
english: I called my friend Ahmed early in the morning.
transliteration: ana ettasalt be-sahby Ahmed el-sobh badry

arabic: قلت له صباح الخير ازيك عامل ايه
english: I said to him, "Good morning, how are you, what are you doing?"
transliteration: olteloh sabah el kheir azayyak amel eh

arabic: هو رد قال الحمد لله كويس بس كنت مشغول شوية
english: He replied, "Praise be to God, good, but I was a little busy."
transliteration: howwa radd al el-hamdulillah kwayyes bas kont mashghool shwayya

arabic: انا ضحكت وقلت له يلا معلش نتكلم بعدين
english: I laughed and told him, "Okay, never mind, let's talk later."
transliteration: ana dehekt w olteloh yalla maalesh netkallem ba'dein

arabic: هو قالي ماشي شكرا واقفلنا السكة
english: He told me, "Okay, thank you," and we hung up.
transliteration: howwa ally mashy shokran w affelna el-sekka

arabic: الواد صحي الصبح وبيسأل ماما احنا هناكل إيه دلوقتي
english: The boy woke up in the morning and is asking mom, "What are we going to eat now?"
transliteration: Elwaad sehi elsobh webyes'al mama ehna hanaakol eih delwa'ty.

arabic: بعدين سأل إمتى بابا هيروح الشغل وليه مش هيلعب معانا
english: Then he asked, "When will dad go to work and why won't he play with us?"
transliteration: Ba'deen sa'al emta baba hayrouh elshoghl weleih mesh hayla'ab ma'aana.

arabic: مامته قالت له لسه شوية عشان بيلبس هدومه عشان يروح الشغل
english: His mom told him, "Still a little bit because he is getting dressed to go to work."
transliteration: Mametoh aletloh lissa shawya 'ashaan byelbas hodoumoh 'ashaan yerouh elshoghl.

arabic: سأل تاني إمتى هو كمان هيروح المدرسة وإمتى هيخلص لعب
english: He asked again, "When will he also go to school and when will he finish playing?"
transliteration: Sa'al taany emta howwa kamaan hayrouh elmadrasa weemta hayekhallas la'b.

arabic: بالليل بعد الأكل سأل احنا خلاص هننام دلوقتي ولا لسه فيه كلام
english: At night, after the food, he asked, "Are we already going to sleep now or is there still talk?"
transliteration: Billeil ba'd elakl sa'al ehna khalaas hannam delwa'ty wala lissa feeh kalaam.

arabic: فيه ولد صغير اسمه كريم
english: There is a small boy named Karim.
transliteration: Feeh walad soghayar esmo Karim.

arabic: هو بيسأل ايه ده كتير اوي
english: He asks "What is this?" a lot.
transliteration: Howa biyes'al eih da keteer awi.

arabic: صوته صغير بس بيوصل لكل مكان
english: His voice is small but reaches everywhere.
transliteration: Souto soghayar bas byo'sal lekoll makan.

arabic: هو دايما عايز يعرف ليه كل حاجة
english: He always wants to know "Why" everything.
transliteration: Howa dayman ayiz ye'raf leih koll haga.

arabic: اسئلته دي زي اغنية حلوة كل يوم
english: His questions are like a sweet song every day.
transliteration: As'elto di zayy ogneyya helwa koll yom.

arabic: أحمد بيفكر في الإجازة بتاعة الأسبوع
english: Ahmed is thinking about the weekend holiday.
transliteration: Aḥmad biyfakkir fī el-egāza betāʕet el-osbūʕ.

arabic: هو عايز يسافر مكان جميل
english: He wants to travel to a beautiful place.
transliteration: Howa ʕayez yesāfer makān gamīl.

arabic: أحمد فرحان اوي عشان هيروح اجازة
english: Ahmed is very happy because he will go on a holiday.
transliteration: Aḥmad farḥān ʔawī ʕashān hayrūḥ egāza.

arabic: ممكن يروح اسكندرية يشوف البحر هناك
english: Maybe he will go to Alexandria to see the sea there.
transliteration: Momken yerūḥ Eskandareyya yeshūf el-baḥr henāk.

arabic: هو مستني يوم الاجازة بكره بفارغ الصبر
english: He is waiting for the holiday day tomorrow impatiently.
transliteration: Howa mestannī yōm el-egāza bukra be-fāregh es-ṣabr.

arabic: الو يا سلمى عاملة ايه
english: Hello Salma, how are you?
transliteration: Alo ya Salma amla eh?
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: اهلا يا منى انا لسه نايمه عشان تعبانه من الشغل
english: Hello Mona, I am still sleeping because I am tired from work.
transliteration: Ahlan ya Mona, ana lessa nayma ashan taabana min el shoghl.
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: معلش يا حبيبتي طب قوليلي انتي شوفتي هدير
english: Sorry my dear, tell me, did you see Hadeer?
transliteration: Maalesh ya habibty, tab qoleeli inti shofti Hadeer?
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: اه انا لسه سايباها في المول من ساعه كانت بتشتري حاجات
english: Yes, I just left her at the mall an hour ago, she was buying things.
transliteration: Ah ana lessa saybaha fi el mol men saaha kanet beteshtary hagat.
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: تمام عشان انا رايحه اشتري حاجات من السوق وكنت عايزاها تيجي معايا
english: Okay, because I'm going to buy things from the market and I wanted her to come with me.
transliteration: Tamam ashan ana rayha ashtiri hagat min es souq we kont ayzaha tegi ma'aya.
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: وصلت العيلة كلها والجو كان حلو انا لسه سايقه العربيه عشان اجي البيت
english: The whole family arrived, and the atmosphere was lovely; I just drove the car to come home.
transliteration: Weselt el eila kolaha we el gaww kan helw ana lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan agi el bet

arabic: السفرة مليانة اكل مصري شهي زي الملوخية والرز والمحشي وكلنا قعدنا حواليها
english: The dining table was full of delicious Egyptian food like molokhia, rice, and mahshi, and we all sat around it.
transliteration: El sofra malyana akl masri shahi zay el molokheya we el rozz we el mahshi we kollena qa'adna hawalayha

arabic: قالت ماما انتي شوفتي هدير هي لسه موصلتش ليه يا حبيبتي
english: Mom asked, "Did you see Hadeer? Why hasn't she arrived yet, my dear?"
transliteration: Qalet Mama inti shofti Hadeer heyya lessa mawasaletsh leih ya habibti

arabic: وبعد الاكل الكبير انا لسه جايبه تفاح انهارده الصبح ممكن ناكله دلوقتي
english: And after the big meal, I just got apples this morning; we can eat them now.
transliteration: We ba'd el akl el kebir ana lessa gayba toffah ennaharda essobh momken nakolo delwa'ti

arabic: الكل استمتع باللمة الحلوة وقررنا مش هنبقى سايبين بعض قريب
english: Everyone enjoyed the lovely gathering, and we decided we wouldn't be leaving each other soon.
transliteration: El kol estamta' bel lamma el helwa we qarrarna mesh hanebqa saybeen ba'd qareeb

arabic: سارة راحت تزور طنط منى وطنت منى فتحت الباب وقالت أهلاً بيكي يا سارة
english: Sara went to visit Aunt Mona and Aunt Mona opened the door and said "Welcome Sara."
transliteration: Sara rahet tezour Tant Mona we Tant Mona fatahet el-bab we qalet ahlan beeki ya Sara

arabic: سارة قالت صباح الخير يا طنط إزيكِ طنط منى قالت أنا كويسة الحمد لله
english: Sara said "Good morning Aunt, how are you?" Aunt Mona said "I'm good, alhamdulillah."
transliteration: Sara qalet sabah el-kheer ya Tant izzayyik? Tant Mona qalet ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah.

arabic: قعدوا يتكلموا وشربوا شاي سوا
english: They sat and talked and drank tea together.
transliteration: Qa'adu yetkallimu we sherbu shay sawa.

arabic: بعد شوية سارة قالت مع السلامة يا طنط
english: After a while, Sara said "Goodbye Aunt."
transliteration: Ba'd shwaya Sara qalet ma'a salama ya Tant.

arabic: طنط منى ردت الله يسلمك
english: Aunt Mona replied "May God keep you safe."
transliteration: Tant Mona raddet Allah yisallimik.

arabic: يلا نروح السوق مع امي
english: Let's go to the market with my mom.
transliteration: Yalla nerooh el soo' ma'a ommy.
storyTitle: A Day at the Market with My Mom

arabic: السوق كبير وفيه خضار وفاكهة كتير
english: The market is big and has many vegetables and fruits.
transliteration: El soo' kibeer we feeh khodaar we fakha kiteer.
storyTitle: A Day at the Market with My Mom

arabic: انا وامي بنحب نشتري طماطم حمرا
english: My mom and I love to buy red tomatoes.
transliteration: Ana w ommy benhebb neshtary tamatem hamra.
storyTitle: A Day at the Market with My Mom

arabic: ماما سألت البياع بكام الطماطم دي
english: Mom asked the seller how much these tomatoes are.
transliteration: Mama saalet el bayya' bekam el tamatem di.
storyTitle: A Day at the Market with My Mom

arabic: روحنا البيت مبسوطين بعد السوق
english: We went home happy after the market.
transliteration: Rohna el bayt mabsooteen ba'd el soo'.
storyTitle: A Day at the Market with My Mom

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد صاحبتي هنا
english: Today is my friend Hana's birthday.
transliteration: Elnaharda eid milad sahbeti Hana.

arabic: أنا بقول لها شكرا على العزومة
english: I tell her "thank you for the invitation".
transliteration: Ana ba'ool laha shukran ala el'azouma.

arabic: هنا بتقول لي عفوا يا حبيبتي أنا من القاهرة
english: Hana tells me "You're welcome, my dear, I am from Cairo".
transliteration: Hana bet'ool li "Afwan ya habibti, ana min Elqahira."

arabic: صاحبتنا منى بتسالني انت منين
english: Our friend Mona asks me "Where are you from?"
transliteration: Sahbetna Mona betsa'alni "Enti menein?"

arabic: أنا بقول لها أنا من اسكندرية وبنقول باي للكل
english: I tell her "I am from Alexandria" and we say "bye" to everyone.
transliteration: Ana ba'ool laha "Ana min Eskandareya" w ben'ool "Bye" lel kol.

arabic: صباح الخير يا احمد ازيك
english: Good morning, Ahmed, how are you?
transliteration: Sabah el kheir ya Ahmad, ezzayyak?

arabic: صباح النور يا سارة الحمد لله بخير انتي عاملة ايه
english: Good morning, Sara, praise be to God, I'm fine. How are you?
transliteration: Sabah el noor ya Sara, alhamdulillah bekheir, enti aamla eih?

arabic: انا عاملة قهوة دلوقتي تحبي تشربي قهوة
english: I'm making coffee now, would you like to drink coffee?
transliteration: Ana aamla ahwa delwa'ti, tehebbī tishrabī ahwa?

arabic: اه شكرا يا سارة انا بحب القهوة كتير
english: Yes, thank you, Sara, I like coffee a lot.
transliteration: Ah shokran ya Sara, ana bahebb el ahwa keteer.

arabic: طب كويس بس مين انتي انا مش عارفة مين انتي
english: Okay, that's good, but who are you? I don't know who you are.
transliteration: Tab kwayyes, bass meen enti? Ana mish 'arfa meen enti?

arabic: مساء الخير يا ام احمد عاملة ايه
english: Good evening, Umm Ahmed, how are you?
transliteration: Masaa el kheir ya Om Ahmed, aamla eih?

arabic: اهلا بيكي يا حبيبتي انا كويسة والولاد عاملين ايه
english: Welcome, my dear, I'm good, and how are the children?
transliteration: Ahlan beeki ya habibty, ana kwayesa wel awlad aamleen eih?

arabic: الحمد لله هما زي الفل والبنت الكبيرة في بيتنا دلوقتي
english: Thank God, they are very good, and the older daughter is in our house now.
transliteration: Alhamdulillah, homa zay el foll wel bent el kabeera fe beitna delwa'ty.

arabic: طيب تشربي شاي ولا قهوة عندنا
english: Okay, would you like to drink tea or coffee with us?
transliteration: Tayeb, teshraaby shay wala ahwa andena?

arabic: شكرا يا حبيبتي معلش بعدين انا ماشية سلام
english: Thank you, my dear, never mind, later, I'm going, bye.
transliteration: Shokran ya habibty, ma'lesh ba'dein, ana mashya, salaam.

arabic: امي طلبت مني نشتري فاكهة وخضار من السوق الكبير
english: My mother asked me to buy fruit and vegetables from the big market.
transliteration: Ommy talabit minni neshtary fakha we khodaar men el soo' el kibeer.

arabic: مشيت كتير وحسيت اني تهت
english: I walked a lot and felt that I got lost.
transliteration: Meshit keteer we haseet enny tehet.

arabic: خفت شوية عشان مش عارف طريق البيت
english: I felt a little scared because I didn't know the way to the house.
transliteration: Khoft shwaya ashan mish aref taree' el bayt.

arabic: شفت ست كبيرة وقررت اسألها
english: I saw an old woman and decided to ask her.
transliteration: Shoft sett kibeera we qarrart as'alha.

arabic: سألتها لو سمحتي ازاي ارجع للشارع الرئيسي قريب من بيتي
english: I asked her: "Excuse me, how can I get back to the main street near my house?"
transliteration: Sa'altaha: "Law samahti, ezay arga' lel share' el ra'eesy orayyeb men bayti?"

arabic: كل الاهل بيتجمعوا في البيت على العشا
english: All the family gathers at home for dinner.
transliteration: Kol el ahl byetgama'u fel beet 'ala el 'asha

arabic: هما كلهم بيقعدوا حوالين السفرة
english: They all sit around the dining table.
transliteration: Homma kollahom byo'do hawaleen el sofra

arabic: فيه اكل واطباق وكوبايات
english: There is food, plates, and cups.
transliteration: Fee akl w atbaaq w kobbayaat

arabic: كل واحد بياكل وبيشرب شاي
english: Everyone eats and drinks tea.
transliteration: Kol wahed byakol w byeshrab shay

arabic: القعدة دي جميلة جدا
english: This gathering is very beautiful.
transliteration: El qa'da di gameela geddan

arabic: انا عايزة هدوم جديدة
english: I want new clothes.
transliteration: Ana ayza hedoom gedeeda.

arabic: كل يوم بلبس نفس الهدوم
english: Every day I wear the same clothes.
transliteration: Kol yom balbes nafs el hedoom.

arabic: دلوقتي هاروح المحل عشان اشتري تيشرت وبنطلون
english: Now I will go to the shop to buy a T-shirt and pants.
transliteration: Delwa'ty harooh el mahall ashan ashtary tishert we bantaloon.

arabic: انا عايزة هدوم لشغلي ولبيتي
english: I want clothes for my work and for my home.
transliteration: Ana ayza hedoom li shoghly we li beety.

arabic: معايا فلوس كتير عشان اشتري
english: I have a lot of money to buy.
transliteration: Ma'aya felous keteer ashan ashtary.

arabic: الجو مطر النهاردة
english: The weather is rainy today.
transliteration: El gawa matar naharda.

arabic: انا في البيت جوه
english: I am at home, inside.
transliteration: Ana fel beit gowwa.

arabic: الشباك مفتوح شوية
english: The window is open a little.
transliteration: Esh shubbak maftouh shwayya.

arabic: انا باسمع صوت صغير مياو
english: I hear a small "meow" sound.
transliteration: Ana basma3 soot soghayyar "meow".

arabic: قطة صغيرة هنا هي عايزة اكل
english: A small cat is here, she wants food!
transliteration: Otta soghayyara hena heya ayza akel!

arabic: نهلة راحت السوق عشان تشتري هدوم جديدة
english: Nahla went to the market to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Nahla rahet el souq ashan teshtari hedoom gedeeda.

arabic: هي شافت فستان حلو اوي في محل صغير
english: She saw a very nice dress in a small shop.
transliteration: Heyya shafet fostan helw awi fi mahal soghayyar.

arabic: البياع قال اتفضلي قيسي الفستان يا مدام
english: The seller said: "Please try on the dress, madam."
transliteration: El bayya' 'al: "Etfaddaly 'eisi el fostan ya madam."

arabic: نهلة قالت انا مصرية ممكن ناخد خصم بسيط
english: Nahla said: "I am Egyptian, can we take a small discount?"
transliteration: Nahla 'alet: "Ana masreya, momken nakhod khasm baseet?"

arabic: البياع ابتسم وقال طبعا يا نهلة واخدت الفستان بسعر كويس
english: The seller smiled and said: "Of course, Nahla" and she took the dress for a good price.
transliteration: El bayya' ebtasam w 'al: "Tab'an ya Nahla" w akhadet el fostan be se'r kwayyes.

arabic: مريم رفعت السماعة وقالت مساء الخير يا سلمى
english: Maryam picked up the phone and said, "Good evening, Salma!"
transliteration: Maryam rafa'et es-sama'a w qalet masa' el-kheer ya Salma

arabic: سلمى ردت عليها وقالت مساء النور إزيكِ عاملة إيه
english: Salma replied to her and said, "Evening of light! How are you, what's up?"
transliteration: Salma raddet aleiha w qalet masa' an-noor izzayyik amla eh

arabic: مريم قالت أنا كويسة الحمد لله انتِ عاملة إيه
english: Maryam said, "I'm good, praise be to God. How are you?"
transliteration: Maryam qalet ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah inti amla eh

arabic: سلمى قالت أنا كمان كويسة الحمد لله كنت عايزة أسألك على حاجة
english: Salma said, "I'm also good, praise be to God. I wanted to ask you about something."
transliteration: Salma qalet ana kaman kwayyesa alhamdulillah konti ayza as'alak ala haga

arabic: مريم ردت عليها وقالت اتفضلي أنا سامعاكي
english: Maryam replied to her and said, "Go ahead, I'm listening to you."
transliteration: Maryam raddet aleiha w qalet etfaddali ana sam'aki

arabic: بعد ما زرت اهلي في بيوتهم قررت اعمل اكلة جديدة شفتها هناك
english: After I visited my family in their houses, I decided to make a new dish I saw there.
transliteration: Ba'd ma zort ahly fi beyoot'hom qarrart a'mel akla gedida shoftaha henāk.
storyTitle: A Dish I Cooked for the First Time

arabic: المطبخ كان عامل زي ساحة حرب والمكونات في كل حتة
english: The kitchen looked like a battlefield and the ingredients were everywhere.
transliteration: El matbakh kan 'amel zayy sahet harb wel mokawwenat fi koll hatta.
storyTitle: A Dish I Cooked for the First Time

arabic: لما الاكل استوى شكله كان غريب اكيد مش زي اللي شفته
english: When the food was cooked, its appearance was strange, definitely not like what I saw.
transliteration: Lamma el akl estawa shakloh kan ghareeb akeed mesh zayy elly shoftoh.
storyTitle: A Dish I Cooked for the First Time

arabic: عيلتي بصوا للاكل باستغراب وسألوا ايه ده
english: My family looked at the food with surprise and asked, "What is this?"
transliteration: Eilaty bassou lel akl bestighrab we sa'alou eih da.
storyTitle: A Dish I Cooked for the First Time

arabic: هما اكيد مش هياكلوا ده بس انا فخورة بمحاولتي
english: They definitely won't eat this, but I'm proud of my attempt.
transliteration: Homa akeed mesh hayaklou dah bas ana fakhoura bemohawelty.
storyTitle: A Dish I Cooked for the First Time

arabic: انا في كافيه كبير دلوقتي
english: I am at a big café now.
transliteration: Ana fi kafeih kibeer delwa'ti.

arabic: انا مستني صاحبي بس هو مش جاي
english: I am waiting for my friend, but he is not coming.
transliteration: Ana mestanni sahbi bas howa mish gay.

arabic: انا شربت قهوة كتير
english: I drank a lot of coffee.
transliteration: Ana sharibt ahwa keteer.

arabic: هو فين انا زعلان شويه
english: Where is he? I am a little sad.
transliteration: Howa fein? Ana za'lan shwaya.

arabic: يمكن فيه مشكلة
english: Maybe there is a problem?
transliteration: Yomken feeh moshkela?

arabic: وصلت سارة عند تيتا وقالت السلام عليكم يا تيتا ازيك
english: Sara arrived at Grandma's and said, "Hello Grandma, how are you?"
transliteration: Waṣalit Sara ʿand Tīta wa qālit As-salāmu ʿalaykum ya Tīta izzayyik?

arabic: تيتا ردت اهلا بيكي يا سارة انا كويسة الحمد لله
english: Grandma replied, "Welcome to you, Sara, I'm good, alhamdulillah."
transliteration: Tīta raddit ahlan beeki ya Sara ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah.

arabic: كل العيلة قعدت تاكل اكل تيتا الحلو
english: The whole family sat down to eat Grandma's delicious food.
transliteration: Kull el-ʿēla qaʿadit tākul akl Tīta el-ḥelw.

arabic: احمد كان بيضحك بصوت عالي وكان فرحان
english: Ahmed was laughing loudly and was happy.
transliteration: Aḥmad kān beyiḍḥak beṣōt ʿālī wa kān farḥān.

arabic: وكلهم قالوا مع السلامة قبل ما يمشوا وهما مبسوطين
english: And they all said "Goodbye" before they left, feeling happy.
transliteration: Wa kulluhum qālū maʿa salāma qabl mā yimshū wa huma mabsuṭīn.

arabic: صباح الخير انا صحيت بدري
english: Good morning, I woke up early.
transliteration: Sabah el kheir ana sa7et badri.

arabic: مفيش وقت كتير قبل الشغل
english: There isn't much time before work.
transliteration: Mafeesh waqt keteer 'abl el shoghl.

arabic: انا باكل فطار شواية
english: I am eating a little breakfast.
transliteration: Ana baakul fetar shwaya.

arabic: وبعدين بشرب شاي بسرعة
english: And then I drink tea quickly.
transliteration: Waba3dein bashrab shay be sor3a.

arabic: يللا انا رايح الشغل دلوقتي
english: Let's go, I'm going to work now.
transliteration: Yalla ana raayeh el shoghl delwa'ty.

arabic: خرجت من بيتي عشان اشتري اكل لاني كنت جعان
english: I left my house to buy food because I was hungry.
transliteration: Kharagt men beiti ashan ashtary akl le'anny kont ga'aan.

arabic: بس مشيت كتير ومفيش قهوة في الشارع ده اللي انا فيه
english: But I walked a lot and there's no coffee on this street I'm on.
transliteration: Bass mesheet keteer wamafish ahwa fi esh-share' da elli ana feeh.

arabic: حسيت اني تهت خالص ومبقتش عارف اروح فين
english: I felt completely lost and didn't know where to go.
transliteration: Hassait enny teht khales wamaba'eetsh aref arouh fein.

arabic: شفت راجل كبير فقلتله لو سمحت ممكن تقوللي بيتي فين من هنا
english: I saw an old man and told him "Excuse me, could you tell me where my house is from here?"
transliteration: Shoft ragel kebeer faqultelo law samaht, mumkin te'oulli beiti fein men hena?

arabic: هو وراني الطريق وكنت مبسوط اوي انه ساعدني
english: He showed me the way and I was very happy that he helped me.
transliteration: Howwa warrani et-taree' we kont mabsoot awi enno sa'edni.

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلادي انا مبسوط اوي
english: Today is my birthday, I am very happy.
transliteration: Elnaharda eid miladi ana mabsoot awi

arabic: لما بكون مبسوط بكلم اصحابي وهنحتفل في بيتي
english: When I am happy, I talk to my friends, and we will celebrate at my house.
transliteration: Lama bakoon mabsoot bakallem ashabi w hanhetfel fi beiti

arabic: جدتي عايزة تعمل اكل كتير عشان عارفة اني جعان
english: My grandmother wants to cook a lot of food because she knows I am hungry.
transliteration: Gaddeti ayza taamel akl kiteer ashan arfa enni gaaan

arabic: اصحابي هيلعبوا العاب على تليفوناتهم بس جدتي عايزة تحكي قصص زمان
english: My friends will play games on their phones, but my grandmother wants to tell old stories.
transliteration: Ashabi hayel'abou al'ab ala telefoonat-hom bas gaddeti ayza tahki qesas zaman

arabic: يمكن اشتري قهوة بعدين بس جدتي كل اللي عايزاه ان العيلة كلها تكون موجودة
english: Maybe I will buy coffee later, but my grandmother just wants the whole family to be present.
transliteration: Yemken ashtry ahwa ba'dein bas gaddeti kol elly ayzah en el-eila kolha takoon mawgouda

arabic: كريم ولد صغير بيحب يسأل اسئلة كتير
english: Karim is a small boy who loves to ask many questions.
transliteration: Karim walad soghayyar bey7eb yes'al as'ela keteer.

arabic: كل يوم بيسأل ماما ليه السما زرقا
english: Every day he asks Mama why the sky is blue.
transliteration: Koll yoom beyes'al Mama leh el sama zar'a.

arabic: ماما بتضحك وبتقول اه يا حبيبي
english: Mama laughs and says "Ah, my darling."
transliteration: Mama beted7ak we bet'ool aah ya 7abibi.

arabic: وبعدين بيروح يسأل بابا عنده كام نجمة في السما
english: And then he goes to ask Papa how many stars there are in the sky.
transliteration: Waba3dein beyroo7 yes'al Baba 3ando kam negma fi el sama.

arabic: العيلة كلها بتحب اسئلة كريم وبتجاوب عليه بحب
english: The whole family loves Karim's questions and answers him with love.
transliteration: El 3eila kollaha bet7eb as'elat Karim we betgawwb 3aleih be7obb.

arabic: صباح الخير يا ام محمد جارتي قالتلي يلا نروح السوق
english: Good morning Umm Mohammad, my neighbor told me, 'Let's go to the market.'
transliteration: Sabah el kheir ya Omm Mohammad garty qaletly yalla nrooh el soo'

arabic: احنا بنحب نشتري خضار وفاكهة من هناك
english: We love to buy vegetables and fruit from there.
transliteration: Ehna benhebb neshtary khodaar w fakha men henak

arabic: السوق ده كبير اوي واسعاره كويسة
english: This market is very big and its prices are good.
transliteration: El soo' da kibeer awi w as'aro kwayesa

arabic: سألتها الطماطم بكام النهاردة
english: I asked her, 'How much are the tomatoes today?'
transliteration: Sa'altaha el tamatem bekam el naharda

arabic: امي دايماً بتوصيني على الطماطم للبيت
english: My mother always advises me on tomatoes for the house.
transliteration: Ommy dayman betwaseeny 'ala el tamatem lel bayt

arabic: الجو عامل ايه النهاردة الجو مطر وبرد دلوقتي
english: How's the weather today? The weather is rainy and cold now.
transliteration: El gaw aamel eh el naharda? El gaw matar w bard delwa'ty.

arabic: احنا قاعدين في البيت والجو دافي
english: We are sitting at home and the atmosphere is warm.
transliteration: E7na 2a3deen fy el beit wel gaw dafy.

arabic: ماما سالت انتوا خرجتوا بدري قبل المطر
english: Mom asked, "Did you (plural) go out early before the rain?"
transliteration: Mama sa2alet "Entu xaragtu badry 2abl el matar?"

arabic: بكره احنا هنعمل حاجات كتير في البيت
english: Tomorrow we will do many things at home.
transliteration: Bokra e7na hane3mel 7agat keteer fy el beit.

arabic: كلنا مبسوطين اننا مع بعض دلوقتي
english: We are all happy that we are together now.
transliteration: Kollena mabsooteen ennena ma3 ba3d delwa'ty.

arabic: النهاردة كل العيلة متجمعة في بيت جدي
english: Today all the family is gathered at my grandfather's house.
transliteration: Elnaharda kol el-3eila metgamme3a fi beit geddy

arabic: ماما عملت اكل حلو اوي و بابا مبسوط
english: Mom made very good food and Dad is happy.
transliteration: Mama 3amalet akl helw awi w baba mabsoot

arabic: اخويا الصغير بيلعب مع بنت عمتي الكبيرة
english: My little brother is playing with my big cousin (aunt's daughter).
transliteration: Akhoya el-soghayar beyl3ab ma3a bint 3amety el-kibeera

arabic: كلنا بناكل و بنشرب شاي مع بعض
english: We are all eating and drinking tea together.
transliteration: Kollena benakel w beneshrab shay ma3a ba3d

arabic: احنا بنحب اللمة دي كتير و الجو كويس اوي
english: We love this gathering a lot and the atmosphere is very good.
transliteration: E7na benhebb el-lamma di keteer w el-gaww kwayes awi

arabic: أمي وأنا رحنا المول عشان نشتري هدوم جديدة
english: My mom and I went to the mall to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Ommy w ana rohna el mol ashan neshtiry hodoom gedida

arabic: هي كانت عايزه فساتين واسعه وأنا كنت بدور على بنطلونات جينز
english: She wanted wide dresses, and I was looking for jeans.
transliteration: Heya kanet ayza fasateen was3a w ana kont badawwar 3ala bantalonat jeans

arabic: ماما قالتلي احنا لسه سايبين المحل اللي فيه فساتين حلوة
english: Mom told me, "We just left the shop that had nice dresses."
transliteration: Mama qaletly ehna lessa saybeen el mahal elly fee fasateen helwa

arabic: أنا مش عايزه الفساتين دي أنا عايزه حاجه على الموضة
english: I don't want these dresses; I want something fashionable.
transliteration: Ana mesh ayza el fasateen di ana ayza haga 3ala el moda

arabic: هي في الآخر سابتني أختار اللي عجبني ودخلنا محل تاني
english: In the end, she let me choose what I liked, and we entered another store.
transliteration: Heya fel akher sabetny akhtar elly 3agabny we dakhalna mahal tany

arabic: ماما واختي هدير قاعدين بيخططوا لفرح اختي الكبيرة
english: Mom and my sister Hadeer are sitting planning my older sister's wedding.
transliteration: Mama we okhti Hadeer aa'deen beykhattetu lefarah okhti el kebeera.

arabic: انا لسه سايقه العربيه عشان اجي البيت عشان أساعدهم
english: I just drove the car to come home to help them.
transliteration: Ana lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan agi el bet ashan asa'edhom.

arabic: ماما قالتلي انتي شوفتي هدير فين الفستان الجديد
english: Mom told me "Did you see Hadeer, where is the new dress?"
transliteration: Mama a'altetli inti shofti Hadeer fein el fustan el gedid.

arabic: قالتلها انا لسه سايباها في المول من ساعه بتجرب حاجات كتير
english: I told her "I just left her at the mall an hour ago trying many things."
transliteration: A'oltelha ana lessa saybaha fi el mol men saaha betgarab hagat keteer.

arabic: وبعدين انا رايحه اشتري حاجات من السوق عشان العشا بتاع الليله
english: And then I am going to buy things from the market for tonight's dinner.
transliteration: Waba'adein ana rayha ashtiri hagat min es souq ashan el asha beta' el leila.

arabic: انا كنت ماشي في الشارع
english: I was walking in the street.
transliteration: Ana kont mashi fi esh-shari'.

arabic: فجأة شفت صاحبي القديم احمد
english: Suddenly, I saw my old friend Ahmed.
transliteration: Fag'a shoft saḥbi el-adeem Ahmed.

arabic: قلت له إزيك يا احمد أنتَ متغير خالص
english: I told him, "How are you, Ahmed? You've changed completely!"
transliteration: Oult loh izzayak ya Ahmed, enta motaghayyer khales!

arabic: هو ضحك وقال انا كويس أنتَ كمان كبرت
english: He laughed and said, "I'm good, you've also gotten older!"
transliteration: Howa deḥek w 'al, "Ana kwayyes, enta kaman kebert!"

arabic: قلنا لازم نتقابل قريب ان شاء الله
english: We said, "We must meet again soon, God willing."
transliteration: Oulna lazem net'abel 'orayeb, in sha Allah.

arabic: النهاردة بليل العيلة اتكلمت عن الويك اند
english: Today evening, the family talked about the weekend.
transliteration: Elnaharda belleil el-3eila etkallemet 3an el-week end.

arabic: احنا عايزين نروح البحر بكرة الصبح
english: We want to go to the sea tomorrow morning.
transliteration: E7na 3ayzeen nrou7 el-ba7r bokra el-sob7.

arabic: الولاد مبسوطين قوي بالرحلة
english: The children are very happy with the trip.
transliteration: El-wilaad mabsoo6een qawi bel-re7la.

arabic: مراتي هتجهز الاكل والشرب
english: My wife will prepare the food and drinks.
transliteration: Merati hatgahezz el-akl w el-shorb.

arabic: الكل جاهز للمتعة والوقت الحلو
english: Everyone is ready for fun and a nice time!
transliteration: El-koll gahez lel-mot3a w el-waqt el-7elw.

arabic: مساء الخير يا عيلة النهاردة هنجرب اكلة جديدة
english: Good evening family, today we will try a new dish.
transliteration: Masa' el-kheer ya 'eila el-naharda hanagarab akla gedeeda.

arabic: ماما وبابا كانوا بيساعدوني وانا بطبخها اول مرة
english: Mom and Dad were helping me while I cooked it for the first time.
transliteration: Mama w baba kanoo beysaa'dooni w ana batbokhha awwal marra.

arabic: الريحة كانت حلوة اوي في البيت كله
english: The smell was very nice in the whole house.
transliteration: El-reeha kanet helwa awi fel beet kollo.

arabic: لما قعدنا ناكل الكل عجبته الاكلة الجديدة
english: When we sat to eat, everyone liked the new dish.
transliteration: Lamma qa'adna nakol el-kol 'agabto el-akla el-gedeeda.

arabic: كان يوم جميل ولقمة هنية مع العيلة
english: It was a beautiful day and a blessed meal with the family.
transliteration: Kan yoom gameel w loqma haniyya ma' el-'eila.

arabic: انا عايزة هدوم جديدة النهاردة
english: I want new clothes today.
transliteration: Ana 'ayza hedoom gedeeda elnaharda.

arabic: بشوف فستان احمر جميل
english: I see a beautiful red dress.
transliteration: Bashouf fustaan ahmar gameel.

arabic: الفستان ده قطن ناعم اوي
english: This dress is very soft cotton.
transliteration: El fustaan da qotn na'em awi.

arabic: ده مقاسي بالظبط ومش غالي
english: This is exactly my size and not expensive.
transliteration: Da ma'asy belzabt w mesh ghali.

arabic: انا بشتريه عشان جميل اوي
english: I buy it because it is very beautiful.
transliteration: Ana bashtareeh 'ashan gameel awi.

arabic: كان فيه طفل اسمه كريم بيسأل اسئلة كتير كل يوم الصبح
english: There was a child named Karim who asked many questions every morning
transliteration: Kan fi tefl esmo Karim biyes'al as'ela kiteer kol yom el sobh

arabic: ماما هو احنا هنفطر ايه وهنعمل ايه بعدين
english: Mom what will we have for breakfast and what will we do afterwards
transliteration: Mama howa ehna hanfatar eh we hanaamel eh baadein

arabic: لما بيكون جعان بيسأل ماما هو احنا هنعمل اكل امتى
english: When he is hungry he asks Mom when we will cook
transliteration: Lama bikoon gaaan biyes'al Mama howa ehna hanaamel akl emta

arabic: الصبح لما مفيش قهوة في بيتي ماما بتشتري قهوة من اوبر ايتس
english: In the morning when there is no coffee in my house Mom buys coffee from Uber Eats
transliteration: El sobh lama mafish ahwa fi beiti Mama beteshtry ahwa men Uber Eats

arabic: كريم بيحب الروتين ده ودايماً بيكون مبسوط لما بيكلم مامته عن يومهم
english: Karim likes this routine and is always happy when he talks to his mom about their day
transliteration: Karim bihebb el routin dah we dayman bikoon mabsoot lama biykalem mamtoh aan yomhom

arabic: الصبح صحيت بدري كان مفيش قهوة في بيتي
english: In the morning, I woke up early, there was no coffee in my house.
transliteration: El sobh saheet badry kan mafish ahwa fi beiti

arabic: علشان كده طلبت قهوة من اوبر ايتس وجاتلي بسرعة
english: Because of that, I ordered coffee from Uber Eats and it came quickly.
transliteration: Alashan keda talabt ahwa men Uber Eats we gatly besor'a

arabic: في الشغل سلمت على زمايلي وكلهم كانوا مبسوطين زيي
english: At work, I greeted my colleagues and all of them were happy like me.
transliteration: Fil shoghl sallamt ala zmayli we kollohom kanoo mabsooteen zayyi

arabic: بعد كام ساعة كنت جعان اوي فنزلت اشتري سندوتشات طعمية وفول
english: After a few hours, I was very hungry, so I went down to buy ta'ameya and fool sandwiches.
transliteration: Ba'd kam sa'a kont gaa'an awy fa nezelt eshtari sandwiches ta'ameya we fool

arabic: لما روحت بيتي بالليل كلمت اصحابي عشان انا بكون مبسوط لما بتكلم معاهم
english: When I went home at night, I called my friends because I get happy when I talk with them.
transliteration: Lamma rowwaht beiti bel leil kallamt ashabi ashan ana bakoon mabsoot lamma batkallem ma'ahom

arabic: مساء الخير يا ماما رايحين فين النهاردة
english: Good evening mom, where are we going today?
transliteration: Masa' el-kheer ya mama, rayhin fein el naharda?

arabic: مساء النور يا حبيبتي احنا رايحين نشتري هدوم جديدة
english: Evening of light my dear, we are going to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Masa' an-noor ya habibty, ehna rayhin neshtari hedoum gedida.

arabic: بابا واخي كانوا مبسوطين اوي بالهدوم الجديدة
english: Dad and my brother were very happy with the new clothes.
transliteration: Baba w akhi kano mabsooteen awi bel hadoum el gedida.

arabic: انا لبست فستان جميل وبابا جابلنا اكل كتير
english: I wore a beautiful dress and Dad brought us a lot of food.
transliteration: Ana lebist fustan gameel w baba gablana akl keteer.

arabic: النهاردة كان يوم جميل مع العيلة كلها
english: Today was a beautiful day with the whole family.
transliteration: El naharda kan yom gameel ma'a el 'ayla kolaha.

arabic: الموبايل رن بصوت عالي جنبي وانا قاعدة على الكنبة
english: The mobile phone rang loudly next to me while I was sitting on the couch.
transliteration: El mobayl rann besot 'ali ganbi wana 'aa'da 'ala el kanaba

arabic: رديت بسرعة وسألت صاحبتي مها انتي شوفتي هدير
english: I answered quickly and asked my friend Maha, 'Did you see Hadeer?'
transliteration: Raddet be sor'a we sa'alt sahabty Maha enti shofti Hadeer

arabic: قالتلي بهدوء انا لسه سايباها في المول من ساعة وصوتها كان مرهق
english: She told me calmly, 'I just left her at the mall an hour ago,' and her voice was tired.
transliteration: Qaletli be hedoo' ana lessa saybaha fi el mol men saa'a we sot-ha kan morheq

arabic: انا كمان كنت لسه سايقة العربية عشان اجي البيت ومحتاجة انام شوية
english: I also just drove the car to come home and need to sleep a little.
transliteration: Ana kaman kont lessa say'a el arabeya ashan agi el bet we mahtaga anam shwaya

arabic: اتفقنا نرغي بكرة بعد ما نكون ارتاحنا شوية وقفلنا الخط
english: We agreed to chat tomorrow after we've rested a bit, and we hung up.
transliteration: Ettaf'na narghy bokra ba'd ma nekon ertahna shwaya we 'afalna el khat

arabic: امبارح انا روحت ازور خالتي
english: Yesterday I went to visit my aunt.
transliteration: Imbareh ana roht azour khalti.

arabic: هي قالتلي اهلا يا حبيبي كل
english: She told me, "Welcome, my dear, eat!"
transliteration: Heya qaletli "Ahlan ya habibi, kol!"

arabic: كان فيه اكل كتير قوي مش شوية
english: There was a lot of food, not a little.
transliteration: Kan feh akl keteer awi mish shwayya.

arabic: انا اكلت وشربت كتير بجد
english: I ate and drank a lot, seriously.
transliteration: Ana akalt we sheribt keteer be-gad.

arabic: دلوقتي انا شبعان لكن هي لسه بتقول كل شوية كمان
english: Now I am full, but she is still saying, "Eat a little more!"
transliteration: Delwa'ti ana shab'an lakin heya lessa betqoul "Kol shwayya kamaan!"

arabic: ده عيد ميلاد سارة
english: This is Sara's birthday.
transliteration: Dah eid milad Sara.

arabic: كل سنة وانت طيبة يا سارة
english: Happy birthday, Sara.
transliteration: Kol sana wenti tayeba ya Sara.

arabic: سارة مبسوطة اوي بالتورتاية
english: Sara is very happy with the cake.
transliteration: Sara mabsoota awi bel tortaya.

arabic: هي عايزة حتة كبيرة
english: She wants a big piece.
transliteration: Heya ayza hetta kebeera.

arabic: الكل بيقولها سنة حلوة
english: Everyone is telling her "have a sweet year".
transliteration: El kol biy'oolha sana helwa.

arabic: منى قالت لجارتها نادية صباح الخير
english: Mona said to her neighbor Nadia, "Good morning."
transliteration: Mona 'alet le garaheha Nadia sabah el kheer

arabic: نادية قالت لها صباح النور عاملة إيه يا منى
english: Nadia said to her, "Good morning, how are you, Mona?"
transliteration: Nadia 'alet laha sabah el noor, 'amla eh ya Mona?

arabic: منى ردت انا كويسة بس مفيش سكر عندي في البيت
english: Mona replied, "I'm fine, but there's no sugar at my house."
transliteration: Mona raddet ana kwayyesa bas mafeesh sukkar 'andy fel beit

arabic: نادية ضحكت وقالت إنت دايماً بتنسي السكر يا جارة
english: Nadia laughed and said, "You always forget the sugar, neighbor!"
transliteration: Nadia dehekt we 'alet enti dayman betensy el sukkar ya gaara!

arabic: منى قالت شكرا يا نادية هروح المحل دلوقتي اجيب
english: Mona said, "Thank you, Nadia, I'll go to the shop now to get some."
transliteration: Mona 'alet shokran ya Nadia, harooh el mahal delwa'ty ageeb.

arabic: أنا رحت السوق النهاردة الصبح بدري
english: I went to the market early this morning.
transliteration: Ana roht el soo' el naharda el sobh badry

arabic: كان فيه ناس كتير والخضار والفاكهة مالية المكان
english: There were many people, and vegetables and fruit filled the place.
transliteration: Kaan fee naas keteer wal khodaar wal fak-ha malya el makan

arabic: ريحة النعناع والبرتقال كانت حلوة أوي
english: The smell of mint and oranges was very nice.
transliteration: Reehet el na'na' wal burtu'aan kaanet helwa awi

arabic: أنا عايزة أشتري شوية فراخ وعيش بلدي
english: I want to buy some chicken and local bread.
transliteration: Ana aayza ashtari shawayet faraakh w aish balady

arabic: دفعت الفلوس للتاجر ومشيت مع السلامة
english: I paid the money to the vendor and left, goodbye.
transliteration: Dafa't el felous lel taager w mesheet ma'a el salama

arabic: أنا بخطط لفرح أختي الكبير
english: I am planning my big sister's wedding.
transliteration: Ana bakhaṭṭaṭ le faraḥ okhti el kebir

arabic: خالتي بتساعدني أختار الفستان
english: My maternal aunt is helping me choose the dress.
transliteration: Khalti betsa3edni akhtar el fostan

arabic: صديقتي منى كمان بتساعد في الديكور
english: My friend Mona is also helping with the decorations.
transliteration: Sadīqtī Mona kaman betsa3ed fe el decor

arabic: عمي محمد هيجيب الدي جي
english: My paternal uncle Mohamed will bring the DJ.
transliteration: 3ammi Mohamed haygeb el DJ

arabic: كلنا مبسوطين جداً بالفرح الجاي
english: We are all very happy for the upcoming wedding.
transliteration: Kollena mabsoṭīn giddan bel faraḥ el gay

arabic: اهلا بيك يا احمد قالت الخالة مديحة
english: Welcome, Ahmed, said Aunt Madiha.
transliteration: Ahlan beek ya Ahmed, qalet el khala Madiha.

arabic: احمد قال انا كويس الحمد لله يا خالة وازيك انتي
english: Ahmed said, "I'm good, alhamdulillah, Aunt, and how are you?"
transliteration: Ahmed qal: "Ana kwayyes alhamdulillah ya khala, we izzayyek enti?"

arabic: كل العيلة قعدت حوالين السفرة عشان الغدا
english: The whole family sat around the dining table for lunch.
transliteration: Koll el 'eila qa'adet hawalain es-sofra 'ashan el ghada.

arabic: الكل كان بيضحك ويتكلم على مواضيع كتير
english: Everyone was laughing and talking about many topics.
transliteration: El kol kan beyedhak we yetkallem 'ala mawadee' keteer.

arabic: بعد الغدا احمد قال مع السلامة والخالة ردت الله يسلمك
english: After lunch, Ahmed said goodbye, and the aunt replied, "May God keep you safe."
transliteration: Ba'd el ghada Ahmed qal ma'a salama, wel khala raddet: "Allah yisallimak."

arabic: إمبارح رحت الماتش بتاع الكورة مع بابا
english: Yesterday, I went to the football match with Dad.
transliteration: Embareh roht el-match beta3 el-koora ma3 Baba.
storyTitle: The Day of the Football Match

arabic: الاستاد كان مليان ناس وصوت الجمهور كان عالي اوي
english: The stadium was full of people and the crowd's sound was very loud.
transliteration: El-estad kan malyan nas we sot el-gomhour kan 3ali awi.
storyTitle: The Day of the Football Match

arabic: اللعيبة كانوا بيجروا بسرعة والكرة كانت بتطير في الهوا
english: The players were running fast and the ball was flying in the air.
transliteration: El-la3eeba kanu beyegroo be-sor3a wel-koora kanet betteer fel hawa.
storyTitle: The Day of the Football Match

arabic: أبويا قالي إن ماما والعيلة كانوا بيتفرجوا على الماتش في البيت
english: My father told me that Mom and the family were watching the match at home.
transliteration: Abouya qali en Mama wel-3eila kanu beytfargo 3al-match fel beit.
storyTitle: The Day of the Football Match

arabic: كان ماتش حلو اوي وكُلنا كنا مبسوطين
english: It was a very good match, and all of us were happy.
transliteration: Kan match helw awi we kollena kunna mabsooteen.
storyTitle: The Day of the Football Match

arabic: وصلت بيت تيتا دلوقتي ومبسوطة اني شفت كل العيلة
english: I arrived at Grandma's house now and I'm happy I saw all the family.
transliteration: Waṣalt bēt tēta dilwa'ti w mabsūṭa innī shuflit kull el-ʿēla.

arabic: كل الناس قاعدين حوالين السفرة وبيتكلموا كتير
english: Everyone is sitting around the dining table and talking a lot.
transliteration: Kull en-nās ʾaʿdīn ḥawālīn es-sufra w byitkallimu kitīr.

arabic: الرز والمحاشي شكلهم كويس جدا وعايزين ناكل بسرعة
english: The rice and stuffed vegetables look very good and we want to eat quickly.
transliteration: Er-rozz wel-maḥāshī shaklihum kwayyis giddan w ʿayzīn nākol bi-surʿa.

arabic: بعد ما كلنا كتير كنت حاسة اني شبعانة جدا وكلنا كنا بنضحك
english: After we ate a lot, I felt full and we were all laughing.
transliteration: Baʿd ma kalna kitīr kont ḥassa innī shabʿāna giddan w kulluna kunna binḍaḥak.

arabic: يوم العيلة ده بيبقى جميل قوي وانا دايما بحب التجمعات دي
english: This family day is always very beautiful and I always love these gatherings.
transliteration: Yōm el-ʿēla da bibʾa gamīl ʾawi w ana dāyman baḥibb et-tagammuʿāt dī.

arabic: الجد الكبير والولد الصغير بيتفرجوا على ماتش كورة
english: The old grandfather and the young boy are watching a football match.
transliteration: El ged el kibeer wel walad el sagheer beitfaraggu 'ala match kora

arabic: الجد بيقول اللعيبة القديمة كانت كويسة اوي
english: The grandfather says the old players were very good.
transliteration: El ged bey'ool el la'eeba el adeema kanet kwayyesa awy

arabic: الولد الصغير عايز يشوف اللعيبة الجديدة بس
english: The young boy wants to see only the new players.
transliteration: El walad el sagheer ayaz yeshoof el la'eeba el gedida bas

arabic: الجد فاكر ان الكورة زمان كانت احسن
english: The grandfather thinks that football in the past was better.
transliteration: El ged faker en el kora zaman kanet ahsan

arabic: الولد الصغير بيحب الماتش ده دلوقتي
english: The young boy loves this match now.
transliteration: El walad el sagheer bihebb el match da delwa'ti

arabic: النهاردة مطرة كتير بعد الضهر
english: Today there is a lot of rain in the afternoon.
transliteration: El naharda matara kiteer ba'd el dohr.

arabic: الجو بره بارد قوي
english: The weather outside is very cold.
transliteration: El gaw barra barid awi.

arabic: انا في البيت دلوقتي
english: I am at home right now.
transliteration: Ana fil beyt dilwa'ti.

arabic: انا باشرب شاي سخن ومبسوط
english: I am drinking hot tea and happy.
transliteration: Ana bashrab shai sokhn w mabsoot.

arabic: دا يوم جميل اوي
english: This is a very beautiful day.
transliteration: Da youm gamil awi.

arabic: ماما لسه سايقه العربيه عشان تيجي البيت عندنا وكل العيله اتجمعت على الغدا
english: Mom just drove the car to come to our house, and the whole family gathered for lunch.
transliteration: Mama lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan teegi el bet 3andena we kol el 3eila etgammet 3ala el ghada

arabic: خالتي لسه جايبه تفاح انهارده الصبح و كمان عملت محشي ورق عنب تحفه
english: My aunt just got apples this morning and also made amazing stuffed grape leaves.
transliteration: Khalti lessa gayba toffah ennaharda essobh we kaman 3amalet mahshi waraq 3enab tohfa

arabic: عمو سامي دخل وقال انتي شوفتي هدير انا لسه سايباها في المول من ساعه
english: Uncle Sami came in and said: Did you see Hadeer? I just left her at the mall an hour ago.
transliteration: 3ammo Sami dakhal we qal enti shofti Hadeer ana lessa saybaha fi el mol men sa3a

arabic: كلنا قعدنا حوالين الترابيزة الكبيرة عشان ناكل سوا والكل بيسال على حال التاني
english: We all sat around the big table to eat together, and everyone was asking about each other's well-being.
transliteration: Kollena qa3adna hawalein el tarabeeza el kebeera ashan nakol sawa wel koll beyessal 3ala hal el tani

arabic: بعد الأكل قعدنا نتكلم ونشرب شاي ونسينا هموم الشغل
english: After eating, we sat talking and drinking tea, forgetting work worries.
transliteration: Ba3d el akl qa3adna netkallem we neshrab shay we neseena homoom el shoghl

arabic: انا لسه سايقه العربيه عشان اروح الاستاد النهارده واشوف الماتش
english: I just drove the car to go to the stadium today and watch the match.
transliteration: ana lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan arouh el estad ennaharda we ashouf el match.

arabic: انا لسه شايفه اللعيبه بتسخن قبل الماتش والجمهور كان حماسي اوي
english: I just saw the players warming up before the match and the crowd was very excited.
transliteration: ana lessa shayfa el le3iba betsakhan qabl el match we el gomhour kan hamasi awi.

arabic: بعد نص ساعة لعيب سجل هدف جامد الجمهور كله صرخ من الفرحة
english: After half an hour, a player scored a great goal, and the whole crowd screamed with joy.
transliteration: ba3d noss saa3a la3ib saggel hadaf gamid el gomhour kollo sarakh men el farha.

arabic: كنت مبسوطة اوي لغاية ما سألت صاحبتي انتي شوفتي هدير اللي قاعدة جنبنا
english: I was so happy until I asked my friend: 'Did you see Hadeer who was sitting next to us?'
transliteration: kont mabsouta awi leghayet ma sa'alt sahabty: 'inti shofti Hadeer elli qa3da gambena?'

arabic: صاحبتي ردت وقالتلي انا لسه سايباها في المول من ساعه وكانت رايحه البيت
english: My friend replied and told me: 'I just left her at the mall an hour ago, and she was going home.'
transliteration: sahabty raddet we qaletli: 'ana lessa saybaha fi el mol men saa3a we kanet rayha el bet.'

arabic: النهاردة قررت أعمل أكلة جديدة في البيت
english: Today I decided to make a new dish at home.
transliteration: El naharda qarrart a'mel akla gideeda fi el beit.

arabic: حاولت أتابع الوصفة كويس بس مش عارف إيه اللي حصل
english: I tried to follow the recipe well but I don't know what happened.
transliteration: Hawwalt atabe' el wasfa kwayyes bas mesh aref eih elli hasal.

arabic: الطبق كان شكله غريب جدا مش زي الصورة خالص
english: The dish looked very strange, not like the picture at all.
transliteration: El tabaq kan shaklo ghareeb geddan mesh zayy el soora khales.

arabic: يا إلهي هل ده أكل ولا إيه أنا لسة مش فاهم
english: Oh my god, is this food or what? I still don't understand.
transliteration: Ya elahy hal da akl wala eih ana lessa mesh fahem.

arabic: يمكن بكرة أعمل أكل تاني يكون أحسن من ده
english: Maybe tomorrow I'll make other food that's better than this.
transliteration: Yomken bokra a'mel akl tani yekoon ahsan men da.

arabic: النهاردة كان فيه ماتش كورة بين صحابي
english: Today there was a football match between my friends.
transliteration: El-nahārda kān fīh matsh kora bēn soḥābi.

arabic: احمد كان ناوي يلعب حارس مرمى
english: Ahmed intended to play goalkeeper.
transliteration: Aḥmad kān nāwi yelʿab ḥāres marma.

arabic: بس غلطته انه نسي الكورة في البيت
english: But his mistake was that he forgot the ball at home.
transliteration: Bas ghalaṭto enno nisy el-kora fel-bēt.

arabic: كلنا قلنا له دي مش خطة كويسة
english: All of us told him, 'This is not a good plan'.
transliteration: Kollena oulna lo dī mish khuṭṭa kwayyesa.

arabic: هو قال انا اسف على التاخير بتاع الكورة
english: He said, 'I'm sorry for the ball's delay'.
transliteration: Howa ʾāl ana āsef ʿala et-taʾkhīr betāʿ el-kora.

arabic: الجو حر اوي النهاردة
english: The weather is very hot today.
