transliteration: El gaw 7arr awy el naharda.

arabic: انا عايز ارجع القميص ده للمحل
english: I want to return this shirt to the shop.
transliteration: Ana 3ayez arga3 el amees da lel ma7al.

arabic: هو مش مناسب خالص وانا هاعمل رياضة بكرة الصبح
english: It's not suitable at all and I will do sports tomorrow morning.
transliteration: Howa mesh monaseb khales w ana ha3mel riyada bokra el sobh.

arabic: رحت المحل لكن لقيت الباب مقفول
english: I went to the shop but found the door closed.
transliteration: Ro7t el ma7al laken la2eet el bab ma'fool.

arabic: ياه انا نسيت ان النهاردة اجازة رسمية
english: Oh I forgot that today is an official holiday!
transliteration: Yaah ana neseet en el naharda agaza rasmiyya!

arabic: انا ماشي في الشارع الصبح فجأة شفت صاحبي
english: I was walking in the street in the morning, suddenly I saw my friend.
transliteration: Ana mashy fel-share' es-sobh, faga'a shoft saHby.

arabic: قلت له سلام عليكم يا حبيبي انت عامل ايه
english: I said to him: "Peace be upon you, my dear, how are you?"
transliteration: Oltelo: salam 'aleykom ya Habibi, enta 'amel eh?

arabic: هو رد علي وعليكم السلام يا صاحبي انا كويس الحمد لله
english: He replied to me: "And upon you be peace, my friend, I am fine, praise be to God."
transliteration: Howa radd 'alaya: wa 'aleykom es-salaam ya saHby, ana kwayyes el-hamdulillah.

arabic: سألته اخبارك ايه يا صاحبي فين ايام زمان
english: I asked him: "How are you, my friend? Where are the old days?"
transliteration: Sa'alto: akhbarak eh ya saHby? Feen ayyam zaman?

arabic: هو قال ربنا يخليك يا صاحبي لازم نقعد سوا قريب
english: He said: "May God keep you, my friend, we must meet again soon."
transliteration: Howa 'al: rabana yikhalleek ya saHby, lazim no'od sawa 'orayeb.

arabic: عادة ستي وانا بنروح السوق كل يوم جمعة
english: Usually my grandma and I go to the market every Friday
transliteration: Adatan settī w ana benrouh el sou' kol yom gom'a

arabic: ستي بتحب تشتري خضار طازة وحاجات قديمة
english: My grandma likes to buy fresh vegetables and old things
transliteration: Settī betehebb teshtary khodar tazza w hagāt adīma

arabic: انا بقى بشوف الالعاب وبحب اشتري شوكولاتة ولعبة وقعت مني
english: But I look at the toys and like to buy chocolate, and a toy fell from me
transliteration: Ana ba'a bashouf el al'āb w bahebb eshtary shokolata w le'ba wi'i'it menni

arabic: ستي شجعتني وقالتلي متخافش يا حبيبي انا هشتريلك واحدة تانية
english: My grandma encouraged me and told me "Don't be afraid, my dear, I will buy you another one"
transliteration: Settī shagg'etni w qāletli matkhafsh ya habibi ana hashtirīlak waḥda tanya

arabic: هي بتشوف السوق غيري لكننا دايماً بنبقى مبسوطين مع بعض
english: She sees the market differently than me, but we are always happy together
transliteration: Heya betshouf el sou' ghayri lakenna dāyman benabqa mabsooteen ma' ba'd

arabic: يوم الجمعة والسبت جايين عايزين نروح مكان جديد
english: Friday and Saturday are coming, we want to go to a new place.
transliteration: Yoom el-gom'a wel-sabt gayyeen ayzeen narouh makan gdeed

arabic: عادة بنصحى متأخر في البيت ونشرب شاي
english: Usually we wake up late at home and drink tea.
transliteration: A'ada bensaha meta'akher fel-beit we neshrab shay

arabic: لكن المرة دي مش هننام كتير عشان نروح بدري
english: But this time we won't sleep much so we can go early.
transliteration: Laken el-marra di mesh hanenam kteer ashan narouh badry

arabic: هنشتري حاجات بسيطة للغدا والعشا وناخد العربية
english: We will buy simple things for lunch and dinner and take the car.
transliteration: Hanestari hagat baseeta lel-ghada wel-asha we nakhed el-arabeya

arabic: هناك ممكن نقعد في مكان جميل ونتفرج على النيل
english: There we might sit in a beautiful place and watch the Nile.
transliteration: Henak momken na'od fi makan gameel we netfarrag 'ala el-Neel

arabic: الصبح جار فتح باب بيته وريحة اكل سخن طلعت
english: In the morning, a neighbor opened his house door, and the smell of hot food came out.
transliteration: El sobh gaar fataḥ baab beito w reeḥet akl sokhn tele3et.

arabic: جارته قالتله يا صباح الخير ازيك عامل ايه
english: His neighbor (f) said to him, "Good morning! How are you?"
transliteration: Gaarto qaletlo ya sabah el kheir izzayak 3amel eih?

arabic: هو رد الحمد لله كويس جدا وريحة اكلك جميل اوي
english: He replied, "Praise be to God, very good! And the smell of your food is very nice."
transliteration: Howa radd el ḥamdulillah kwayyes geddan w reeḥet aklak gameel awi.

arabic: هي قالت تشرب شاي دلوقتي لو فاضي شوية
english: She said, "Do you want to drink tea now if you are free for a bit?"
transliteration: Heya qalet teshrob shay delwa'ti law fadi shwaya?

arabic: هو قال حاضر شكرا انا جاي مع السلامة
english: He said, "Okay, thank you! I'm coming. Goodbye."
transliteration: Howa qal ḥader shukran ana gay ma3 el salama.

arabic: النهاردة انا رحت السوق
english: Today I went to the market.
transliteration: El naharda ana roht es-sou'

arabic: كان فيه خضار وفاكهة كتير
english: There were many vegetables and fruits.
transliteration: Kan feh khodar we fawakih keteer

arabic: شفت طماطم حمرا وخيار اخضر
english: I saw red tomatoes and green cucumbers.
transliteration: Shoft tamatem hamra we khiyar akhdar

arabic: ريحة البرتقال كانت حلوة اوي
english: The smell of the oranges was very nice.
transliteration: Reehet el bortoqal kanet Helwa awi

arabic: بعد كده انا اشتريت موز اصفر
english: After that, I bought yellow bananas.
transliteration: Ba3d keda ana eshtarayt mooz asfar

arabic: انا تهت ومش عارفة اروح فين
english: I am lost and don't know where to go.
transliteration: Ana teht w mesh 'arfa arouh fein?

arabic: معلش يا استاذ ممكن تساعدني
english: Excuse me, sir, can you help me?
transliteration: Ma'lesh ya ostaz momken tsa'edni?

arabic: انا عايزة اروح جامعة القاهرة
english: I want to go to Cairo University.
transliteration: Ana 'ayza arouh gam'et el Qahira.

arabic: اهي هناك على طول يمين
english: It's right there, straight ahead, then right.
transliteration: Ahi henak 'ala tool yemin.

arabic: شكرا جدا يا استاذ
english: Thank you very much, sir.
transliteration: Shokran geddan ya ostaz.

arabic: انا وصاحبي بنتكلم عن اجازة الاسبوع
english: My friend and I are talking about the weekend holiday.
transliteration: Ana we sahby bannetkalem 3an agazet el osboo3.

arabic: فين هنروح الاجازة دي
english: Where will we go this holiday?
transliteration: Feen honrooh el agaza di?

arabic: انا بحب السفر يالا نشوف مكان كويس
english: I love to travel, let's go see a good place.
transliteration: Ana bahebb es safar yalla neshoof makan kwayyes.

arabic: طيب هنشوف فندق كويس او بيت
english: Okay, we will look for a good hotel or a house.
transliteration: Tayyeb hanshoof fonde' kwayyes aw byt.

arabic: بس بابا قال الاجازة دي في البيت
english: But my dad said, this holiday is at home!
transliteration: Bas baba al el agaza di fel beet!

arabic: فيه مشكلة في البيت النهاردة
english: There is a problem at home today.
transliteration: Fih mushkela fel beit ennaharda.

arabic: التلفزيون قديم ومش شغال
english: The TV is old and not working.
transliteration: El televisyoun qadeem we mish shaghghal.

arabic: تيتا بتقول هات حد يصلحه
english: Grandma says "Get someone to fix it".
transliteration: Teita betqoul hat hadd yesallahoh.

arabic: انا باقول لا نشتري واحد جديد ده احسن
english: I say "No, let's buy a new one, this is better".
transliteration: Ana baqoul la neshtiri wahed gedeed da ahsan.

arabic: ده كلام كتير وبياخد وقت
english: This is a long discussion and takes time.
transliteration: Da kalam keteer we byakhod waqt.

arabic: النهارده ماما وبابا بيتكلموا عن الفرح
english: Today Mom and Dad are talking about the wedding.
transliteration: El-naharda mama we baba beyetkallemu 'an el-farah.

arabic: احنا بنعمل فرح كبير
english: We are making a big wedding.
transliteration: Ehna bena'mel farah kabeer.

arabic: احنا بنختار مكان حلو للناس الكتير
english: We are choosing a nice place for many people.
transliteration: Ehna benekhtar makan helw lel-nas el-keteer.

arabic: ماما عايزة أكل كويس جدا
english: Mom wants very good food.
transliteration: Mama 'ayza akl kwayyes geddan.

arabic: عندنا فرح سعيد للكل
english: We have a happy wedding for everyone.
transliteration: 'Andena farah sa'eed lel-kol.

arabic: انا ماشي في الشارع ده ومش عارف فين انا
english: I am walking on this street and I don't know where I am.
transliteration: Ana mashi fi el-share' da w mesh 'aref fen ana.

arabic: شفت راجل كبير قولتلو يا عمو لو سمحت
english: I saw an old man, I said to him, "Uncle, please."
transliteration: Shoft ragel kebir, oltelo ya 'ammo law samaht.

arabic: انا عايز اروح المحطة هي فين
english: I want to go to the station, where is it?
transliteration: Ana 'ayez arawwah el-mahatta, heya fen?

arabic: هو قالي امشي طوالي وبعدين خش يمين
english: He told me to walk straight and then turn right.
transliteration: Howwa 'ali emshi tawali w ba'dein khosh yemin.

arabic: قولتله شكرا وهو رد العفو
english: I said "thank you" to him, and he replied "you're welcome."
transliteration: Oltelo shokran, w howwa radd el-'afw.

arabic: انا بروح السوق كل يوم الصبح
english: I go to the market every morning.
transliteration: Ana barouh el souq kol youm el sobh.

arabic: انا عايزة اشتري خضار وفاكهة اليوم
english: I want to buy vegetables and fruit today.
transliteration: Ana ayza ashtri khodar we fakha el yoom.

arabic: عندك طماطم جديدة في المحل
english: Do you have fresh tomatoes in the shop?
transliteration: Andak tamatem gedida fel mahal?

arabic: ده بكام
english: How much is this?
transliteration: Dah be kam?

arabic: انا بشتري الطماطم وبرجع البيت
english: I buy the tomatoes and go back home.
transliteration: Ana bashtri el tamatem we baraga' el beit.

arabic: انا كنت رايحه السوق عشان اشتري حاجات بس انا تهت
english: I was going to the market to buy things, but I got lost.
transliteration: ana kont rayha el souq ashan ashtiri hagat bas ana tehet

arabic: الشمس كانت حامية اوي والشارع كان زحمة بصوت العربيات العالي
english: The sun was very hot and the street was crowded with the loud sound of cars.
transliteration: el shams kanet hamya awi we el shara' kan zahma be sot el arabeyat el ali

arabic: انا لسه سايقه العربيه من البيت وكنت فاكرة الطريق بس دلوقتي مش شايفة اي علامة اعرفها
english: I just drove the car from home and I thought I knew the way, but now I don't see any familiar signs.
transliteration: ana lessa sayqa el arabeya men el bet we kont fakra el tareeq bas delwaqty mesh shayfa ay alama a'rafha

arabic: شفت راجل كبير واقف جنب محل خضار وقررت اسأله عن الطريق
english: I saw an old man standing next to a vegetable shop and decided to ask him for directions.
transliteration: shoft ragel kebir wa'ef gamb mahal khodar we qarart as'alo 'an el tareeq

arabic: قلتله لو سمحت انا تهت ممكن تقولي فين السوق لو سمحت
english: I told him, 'Excuse me, I'm lost. Could you please tell me where the market is, please?'
transliteration: oltelo law samaht ana tehet momken ta'oli fein el souq law samaht

arabic: صباح الخير يا ماما ازيك
english: Good morning mom, how are you?
transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer ya mama, izzayyek?

arabic: ماما بتجهز للشغل وبتلبس هدومها
english: Mom is preparing for work and getting dressed.
transliteration: Mama bitgahhez lesh-shoġl w bitlabes hudoomha.

arabic: البنت بتسأل هو انتي رايحة الشغل دلوقتي
english: The girl asks: Are you going to work now?
transliteration: El-bent betsa'al: Howa enti rayḥa esh-shoġl dilwa'ti?

arabic: ماما بترد ايوه يا حبيبتي رايحة الشغل
english: Mom replies: Yes, my dear, I'm going to work.
transliteration: Mama betrodd: Aywa ya habibti, rayḥa esh-shoġl.

arabic: البنت بتقول وانا كمان رايحة الشغل عشان العب
english: The girl says: And I'm also going to work to play!
transliteration: El-bent bet'ool: W ana kamaan rayḥa esh-shoġl 3ashan al3ab!

arabic: امي بتقول يلا نروح سوق كبير عشان نشتري حاجات للرحلة
english: My mother says let's go to a big market to buy things for the trip.
transliteration: Ommy bet'ool yalla nrooh soo' kibeer 'ashan neshtary hagaat lel rehla

arabic: احنا بنحب ناكل فاكهة وخضار كتير هناك في بيت الرحلة
english: We love to eat a lot of fruit and vegetables there at the trip house.
transliteration: Ehna benhebb nakol fakha we khodaar kiteer henaak fi bayt el rehla

arabic: لازم نسأل بكام كيلو المانجا والخيار قبل ما ناخدهم
english: We need to ask how much a kilo of mango and cucumber is before we take them.
transliteration: Laazem nes'al bekam kilo el manga wel khiyaar abl ma nakhodhom

arabic: بعد السوق هنرجع البيت ونحضر شنطنا الصغيرة بسرعة
english: After the market, we will return home and prepare our small bags quickly.
transliteration: Ba'd el soo' hanerga' el bayt we nehadar shonatna el soghayyara besor'a

arabic: الرحلة دي هتكون حلوة قوي والجو جميل
english: This trip will be very nice and the weather is beautiful.
transliteration: El rehla di hatkoon helwa 'awi wel gaw gameel

arabic: راجل كبير قاعد في القهوة
english: An old man is sitting in the café.
transliteration: Rajil kebeer qa3id fil-ahwa.

arabic: بنت و ولد صغيرين قاعدين معاهم تليفونات
english: A young girl and boy are sitting with their phones.
transliteration: Bint w walad soghayyareen qa3deen ma3ahom teleefonaat.

arabic: الراجل الكبير بيشرب شاي و بيسمع راديو
english: The old man drinks tea and listens to the radio.
transliteration: El-rajil el-kebeer biyshrab shay w biysima3 radio.

arabic: هو بيفكر هما دايماً بيبصوا في التليفون مش بيتكلموا
english: He thinks: they always look at the phone, they don't talk.
transliteration: Howwa biyfakkir: homma dayman bibusso fil-teleefoon mish biyitkallimu.

arabic: كل واحد بيعمل حاجة مختلفة لكن كلهم في نفس القهوة
english: Everyone does something different, but they are all in the same café.
transliteration: Koll wahed biy3amal haga mokhtalefa lakin kolluhom fi nafs el-ahwa.

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد منى
english: Today is Mona's birthday
transliteration: El Naharda eid meelad Mona

arabic: كلنا في البيت عندها
english: We are all at her house
transliteration: Kollena fel beit 3andaha

arabic: فيه تورتة كبيرة وحلوة
english: There is a big and beautiful cake
transliteration: Feeh torteh kebeera we helwa

arabic: منى عايزة تفتح الهدية دي
english: Mona wants to open this gift
transliteration: Mona ayza tefta7 el hedeyya di

arabic: بس الهدية فاضية
english: But the gift is empty
transliteration: Bas el hedeyya fadya

arabic: في مشكلة في البيت
english: There is a problem in the house.
transliteration: fi moshkela fel beit

arabic: مفيش مية دلوقتي
english: There is no water now.
transliteration: mafeesh maya delwa'ty

arabic: كريم زعلان هو عايز مية
english: Karim is sad, he wants water.
transliteration: Karim za'laan howa ayiz maya

arabic: المية فين ايه الحل
english: Where is the water? What is the solution?
transliteration: el maya fein eh el hall

arabic: هو لازم يلاقي حل
english: He needs to find a solution.
transliteration: howa laazem yela'y hall

arabic: احنا بنخطط لفرح كبير النهاردة
english: We are planning for a big wedding today.
transliteration: Eḥna benkhaṭṭaṭ lefarḥ kabīr innahārda.

arabic: انا عايزة فستان ابيض حلو وورد احمر
english: I want a beautiful white dress and red flowers.
transliteration: Ana ʕayza fustān abyaḍ ḥelw wa ward aḥmar.

arabic: فيه مزيكا كتير واكل حلو كتير
english: There will be a lot of music and a lot of sweet food.
transliteration: Fīh mazīka katīr w akel ḥelw katīr.

arabic: احنا هنقضي وقت حلو مع العيلة والاصحاب
english: We will spend good time with family and friends.
transliteration: Eḥna hanqaḍḍī waʾt ḥelw maʕ el-ʕēla wel-aṣḥāb.

arabic: ده يوم حلو اوي ان شاء الله
english: This is a very beautiful day, God willing.
transliteration: Da yōm ḥelw ʾawī in shāʾ Allāh.

arabic: النهاردة روحت أزور خالتي في بيتها
english: Today I went to visit my aunt at her house.
transliteration: El naharda rooht azor khalty fi beitaha.

arabic: لما وصلت أنا كنت مبسوط جداً
english: When I arrived, I was very happy.
transliteration: Lama weselt ana kont mabsoot geddan.

arabic: خالتي قالت لي يلا يا حبيبي مفيش قهوة في البيت بس أنا هعملك أحلى شاي
english: My aunt told me 'Come on, my dear, there's no coffee at home but I will make you the best tea'.
transliteration: Khalty a'aletly yalla ya habibi mafish ahwa fil beit bas ana haamelak ahla shay.

arabic: بعد شوية لما بكون مبسوط بكلم أصحابي بس النهاردة قعدت أتكلم معاها
english: After a while, when I'm happy I talk to my friends, but today I sat and talked with her.
transliteration: Ba'd shwaya lama bakoon mabsoot bakallem ashabi bas el naharda a'adt atkallem ma'aha.

arabic: قضينا وقت جميل وقبل ما أمشي قالت لي متجيش جعان المرة الجاية
english: We had a great time and before I left, she told me 'Don't come hungry next time!'
transliteration: Addeina wa't gameel w abl ma amshy a'aletly matgeesh gaa'an el marra el gaya.

arabic: سلام عليكم انا قاعد هنا في القهوة
english: Hello. I am sitting here at the café.
transliteration: Salam alaykum. Ana aa'ed hena fel ahwa.

arabic: يا معلم عايز واحد شاي من فضلك
english: Excuse me, I want one tea please.
transliteration: Ya m3allem, ayyez wahed shay men fadlak.

arabic: القهوجي قال حاضر
english: The café worker said, "At your service."
transliteration: El ahwagy aal hader.

arabic: الناس هنا بتشرب قهوة وسكر كتير
english: The people here drink coffee with a lot of sugar.
transliteration: El nas hena beteshrab ahwa w sukkar keteer.

arabic: انا مستني صاحبي دلوقتي
english: I am waiting for my friend now.
transliteration: Ana mestanny sahby delwa'ty.

arabic: لعبنا كورة النهاردة
english: We played football today.
transliteration: La'abna kora elnaharda.

arabic: فريقنا كان كبير اوي
english: Our team was very big.
transliteration: Faree'na kan kabeer awi.

arabic: صاحبي قال فين الكورة دلوقتي
english: My friend said "Where is the ball now?"
transliteration: Saahbi 'al "feen el kora dilwa'ti?"

arabic: الكورة كانت قريبة من شجرة صغيرة
english: The ball was close to a small tree.
transliteration: El kora kanet 'arayyeba min shagara soghayyara.

arabic: انا قولت يلا بينا نلعب تاني
english: I said "Let's play again!"
transliteration: Ana 'olt "yalla beena nel'ab tani!"

arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع فجأة شفت وش مالوف
english: I was walking in the street when suddenly I saw a familiar face.
transliteration: Kont mashi fel shari' faga'a shoft wesh ma'loof.

arabic: قولتله انت منين انا حاسس اني اعرفك
english: I told him 'Where are you from? I feel like I know you.'
transliteration: Olttelo enta menain ana hases enni a'rafak.

arabic: رد وقالي انا رامي زميلك بتاع الجامعة انا دلوقتي بقيت أمريكاني
english: He replied and told me 'I'm Rami, your university colleague. I'm American now.'
transliteration: Radd w qali ana Rami zameelak beta' el gam'a ana delwa'ty ba'eet Amreekani.

arabic: كان شكل حياته مختلف خالص عن ايامنا زمان هو بيكلم اولاده عن ألعاب جديدة
english: His life looked completely different from our days back then; he was talking to his children about new games.
transliteration: Kan shakl hayato mokhtalef khales 'an ayyamna zaman howwa beykallem awlado 'an al'ab gedeeda.

arabic: حسينا قد ايه الزمن غيرنا وقد ايه الدنيا اتطورت حوالينا
english: We felt how much time had changed us and how much the world had developed around us.
transliteration: Hasseina ad eih el zaman ghayyarnaa w ad eih el donya ettatwarat hawaleina.

arabic: العيلة كلها اتجمعت على الغدا وفيه ضحك كتير
english: The whole family gathered for lunch and there was a lot of laughter.
transliteration: El eila kolaha etgammet ala el ghada we feh dehk kiteer

arabic: ماما بصت حواليها وقالت انتي شوفتي هدير
english: Mom looked around and said "Did you see Hadeer?"
transliteration: Mama basset hawalayha we alet "Inti shofti Hadeer?"

arabic: خالتو ردت وقالت اه انا لسه سايباها في المول من ساعه وكانت رايحه تشتري حاجات
english: Aunt replied and said "Oh, I just left her at the mall an hour ago, and she was going to buy things."
transliteration: Khalto raddet we alet "Ah ana lessa saybaha fi el mol men saaha we kanet rayha teshtiri hagat."

arabic: بابا كان تعبان وقال انا لسه سايق العربيه عشان اجي البيت من الشغل
english: Dad was tired and said, "I just drove the car to come home from work."
transliteration: Baba kan taaban we al "Ana lessa sayeq el arabeya ashan agi el bet men el shoghl."

arabic: الكل ضحك وبدأ ياكل وكان الجو كله حب وسعادة
english: Everyone laughed and started eating, and the atmosphere was full of love and happiness.
transliteration: El kol dehek we bada yakol we kan el gaw koloh hob we sa'ada

arabic: صباح الخير اليوم انا بجهز نفسي عشان ازور خالتي
english: Good morning, today I prepare myself to visit my aunt.
transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer el-yoom ana baġahhez nafsi 3ashan azōr khalteti.

arabic: بلبس هدومي وبعمل قهوة
english: I get dressed and make coffee.
transliteration: Balbes hudoomi waba'mel 'ahwa.

arabic: وصلت بيت خالتي وقلت السلام عليكم
english: I arrived at my aunt's house and said Hello.
transliteration: Waṣalt bēt khalteti wa olt as-salamu alaykum.

arabic: خالتي قالت لي اهلا ازيك يا حبيبي
english: My aunt said to me, "Welcome, how are you, my dear?"
transliteration: Khalteti 'aletli ahlan izzayyak ya ḥabibi.

arabic: بس هي مش خالتي ده عامل النظافة بتاع العمارة
english: But it wasn't my aunt, it was the building's cleaner.
transliteration: Bas heyya mish khalteti da 3āmil an-naẓāfa beta3 el-3emāra.

arabic: امي كانت زعلانة قوي عشان مفيش خضار وفاكهة في البيت
english: My mother was very sad because there were no vegetables and fruit at home.
transliteration: Ommy kanet za'lana 'awi 'ashan mafish khodaar w fakha fel bayt
storyTitle: The Home Problem and the Market

arabic: احنا بنحب ناكل الحاجات دي كل يوم وهي فاضية
english: We love to eat these things every day and it was empty.
transliteration: E7na benhebb nakol el-hagat di kolle yom w heya fadya
storyTitle: The Home Problem and the Market

arabic: هي قالت بصوت عالي مش معقول نشتري ايه النهاردة
english: She said loudly "Unbelievable, what will we buy today?"
transliteration: Heya 'alet be-sot 'aly "mish ma'oul neshtary eh el-naharda?"
storyTitle: The Home Problem and the Market

arabic: بابا كان متضايق هو كمان من المشكلة دي
english: Father was also upset about this problem.
transliteration: Baba kan metdayyeq howwa kaman men el-moshkela di
storyTitle: The Home Problem and the Market

arabic: يلا بينا نروح السوق الكبير دلوقتي عشان نشتري كل حاجة
english: Let's go to the big market now to buy everything.
transliteration: Yalla bina rooh el-soo' el-kibeer delwa'ti 'ashan neshtary kolle haga
storyTitle: The Home Problem and the Market

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلادي والدنيا بتشتي من الصبح بدري
english: Today is my birthday and it's been raining since early morning.
transliteration: El naharda eid meelady wel donya beteshatti men el sob7 badry

arabic: بعدين الجو بقى مشمس وجميل
english: Then the weather became sunny and beautiful.
transliteration: Ba'deen el gaw ba'a moshmes w gameel

arabic: اصحابي جم البيت واكلنا تورته كبيرة
english: My friends came home and we ate a big cake.
transliteration: Ashaaby gom el beit wakalna torta kebeera

arabic: كنت مبسوط اوي بالهدايا والضحك
english: I was very happy with the gifts and laughter.
transliteration: Kont mabsoot awy bel hadaya wel da7k

arabic: اليوم كان حلو اوي والسما كانت مغيمة بس متشتتش
english: The day was very nice and the sky was cloudy but it didn't rain.
transliteration: El yom kan helw awy wel sama kanet megayyema bas meteshattatsh

arabic: صباح الخير يا احمد صباح النور يا بابا
english: Good morning, Ahmed. Morning of light, Dad.
transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer ya Ahmed. Sabaḥ an-noor ya Baba.

arabic: عايزين نسافر في الويك اند
english: We want to travel this weekend.
transliteration: Ayzeen nesafer fel week-end.

arabic: انا عايز نروح مكان هادي وقريب
english: I want to go to a quiet and nearby place.
transliteration: Ana ayz nrooḥ makan hady w areeb.

arabic: لا انا عايز مكان فيه لعب ومزيكا
english: No, I want a place with games and music.
transliteration: La ana ayz makan feeh la'b w mazeeka.

arabic: طيب نشوف حاجة تناسبنا كلنا
english: Okay, let's find something that suits all of us.
transliteration: Tayeb neshoof haga tenasebna kollena.

arabic: بابا وماما في البيت ودي عائلتي الصغيرة معاهم يوسف شقي ومحب للاستكشاف
english: Dad and Mom are at home, and this is my small family, with them is Youssef, naughty and loves exploration.
transliteration: Baba we Mama fel beit we di 3aylti el-sagheera ma3ahom Youssef sha2y we muheb lel-istikshaf.

arabic: من بدري وصوت اسئلة يوسف عالي زي صفير القطر
english: Since early, the sound of Youssef's questions was loud like a train whistle.
transliteration: Men badri we sot as2elet Youssef 3ali zay safeer el-2atr.

arabic: ليه السما زرقا يا ماما وليه القطة بتنام على الكنبة
english: Why is the sky blue, Mom, and why does the cat sleep on the sofa?
transliteration: Leh el-sama zar2a ya Mama we leh el-2otta betnam 3ala el-kanaba?

arabic: بابا مسح على شعره وابتسم بس الأسئلة ما وقفتش
english: Dad stroked his hair and smiled, but the questions didn't stop.
transliteration: Baba masah 3ala sha3ro we ibtasam bas el-as2ela ma wa2afetsh.

arabic: كل حاجة حواليه كانت بتفتح باب لسؤال جديد في دماغ الولد الشاطر ده
english: Everything around him was opening a door to a new question in the mind of this clever boy.
transliteration: Kol haga hawalieh kanet betfatah bab le so2al gedeed fe demagh el-walad el-shater dah.

arabic: انا عايزة اطبخ طبق جديد
english: I want to cook a new dish.
transliteration: Ana aayza atbakh tabaq gidiid.

arabic: انا كنت في المطبخ دلوقتي
english: I was in the kitchen now.
transliteration: Ana kunt fi el matbakh dilwa'ti.

arabic: انا حطيت ملح كتير في الاكل
english: I put a lot of salt in the food.
transliteration: Ana hatteit malh kitiir fi el akl.

arabic: الاكل ده مش حلو ده وحش
english: This food is not good, it's bad.
transliteration: El akl da mish helw da wahish.

arabic: يمكن بكرة هطبخ فراخ
english: Maybe tomorrow I will cook chicken.
transliteration: Yemkin bukra hatbakh farakh.

arabic: انا شفت جارتي الصبح
english: I saw my neighbor in the morning.
transliteration: Ana shoft garti el sobh.

arabic: قولتلها صباح الخير عاملة ايه
english: I told her, "Good morning! How are you?"
transliteration: Olteelaha sabah el kheer amela eh?

arabic: قالتلي انا كويسة الحمد لله
english: She told me, "I am good, thank God."
transliteration: Aletli ana kwayesa el hamdulillah.

arabic: سألتها عايزة شاي
english: I asked her, "Do you want tea?"
transliteration: Sa'alteha ayza shay?

arabic: قالتلي لا شكرا مع السلامة
english: She told me, "No thank you, goodbye."
transliteration: Aletli la shokran ma'a el salama.

arabic: انا والولد صاحبي بنلعب كورة انهارده
english: My friend and I are playing football today.
transliteration: Ana wel walad sa7by benla'ab koora ennaharda.

arabic: الملعب كبير والجو جميل
english: The field is big and the weather is beautiful.
transliteration: El mal'ab kabeer wel gaw gameel.

arabic: هو بيجري بسرعة بس انا وقعت فجأة
english: He is running fast but I fell suddenly.
transliteration: Howa beyegry be sor'a bas ana wa'a't fag'a.

arabic: اه معلش الكورة طارت بعيد اوي
english: Oh, never mind, the ball flew very far.
transliteration: Ah ma'alesh el koora tarat ba'eed awi.

arabic: الولد ضحك كتير وانا كمان ضحكت معاه
english: The boy laughed a lot and I also laughed with him.
transliteration: El walad dehek kiteer wana kaman dehekt ma'aah.

arabic: احنا بنجهز لفرح اختي
english: We are preparing for my sister's wedding.
transliteration: Ihna bangehhez lefarh okhti

arabic: رحنا نشتري فستان الفرح امبارح
english: We went to buy the wedding dress yesterday.
transliteration: Rohna nishtiri fustan elfarah imbareh

arabic: ماما عايزة حفلة كبيرة وفيها مزيكا كتير
english: Mom wants a big party with a lot of music.
transliteration: Mama ayza hafla kebira w fiha mazika kiteer

arabic: بابا هيعزم كل العيلة والصحاب
english: Dad will invite all the family and friends.
transliteration: Baba hayezim koll el-eila w el-sohab

arabic: ده يوم جميل ومهم لكل الناس
english: This is a beautiful and important day for everyone.
transliteration: Dah yom gameel w mohem lekoll el-nas

arabic: أنا بكلم صاحبتي على التليفون
english: I am calling my friend on the phone.
transliteration: Ana bakallem sahbeti 'ala el-telefoon.

arabic: أنا بقول ألو إزيك
english: I say "Hello! How are you?"
transliteration: Ana ba'ool "Allo! Ezzayek?"

arabic: هي بتقول أنا كويسة أنت ليه مش بتبعتي رسالة
english: She says "I'm good. Why aren't you sending a message?"
transliteration: Heyya bet'ool "Ana kwayyesa. Enti leih mesh beteb'ati resala?"

arabic: أنا بقول أنا عايزة أتكلم النهاردة يا صاحبتي
english: I say "I want to talk today, my friend!"
transliteration: Ana ba'ool "Ana 'ayza atkallem el-naharda ya sahbeti!"

arabic: هي بتقول ماشي يالا مع السلامة
english: She says "Okay, goodbye!"
transliteration: Heyya bet'ool "Mashi yalla ma'a el-salama!"

arabic: مفيش قهوة في بيتي الصبح النهاردة
english: There is no coffee in my house this morning today.
transliteration: Mafish ahwa fi beiti elsobh ennaharda

arabic: نزلت بسرعة علشان أشتري قهوة من أي كافيه
english: I went down quickly to buy coffee from any cafe.
transliteration: Nezelt besor'a alashan ashtary ahwa men ay cafeh

arabic: فجأة قابلت صاحبي القديم أحمد في الشارع
english: Suddenly, I met my old friend Ahmed in the street.
transliteration: Fag'ah abelt sahby el adeem Ahmed fil share'a

arabic: أنا كنت مبسوط أوي لما شوفته بعد سنين
english: I was very happy when I saw him after years.
transliteration: Ana kont mabsoot awi lama shoftoh ba'd sneen

arabic: خدت تليفونه عشان نتكلم أكتر الأيام الجاية
english: I took his phone so we can talk more in the coming days.
transliteration: Khaddt telefoono ashan netkallem aktar el ayam el gayya

arabic: رنا طفلة بتحب تسأل كتير اوي تيتا
english: Rana is a child who loves to ask Teta many questions.
transliteration: Rana tefla bethebb tesal keteer awi Teta

arabic: كل يوم الصبح بتسأل هنفطر ايه و اخويا هيصحى امتى
english: Every morning she asks what we will eat for breakfast and when my brother will wake up.
transliteration: Koll yom el sobh betesal hanefțar eh w akhoya hayeṣḥa emta

arabic: و بتسأل اختي مريم هتروح المدرسة ازاي النهاردة
english: And she asks my sister Maryam how she will go to school today.
transliteration: W betesal okhti Maryam hatrouḥ el madrasa ezay el naharda

arabic: هي دايما بتسأل عن كل حاجة صغيرة وكبيرة حوالينا
english: She always asks about everything small and big around us.
transliteration: Heya dayman betesal an kol haga soghayara w kebeera hawalena

arabic: وتيتا بترد عليها بصبر وحب كل يوم
english: And Teta answers her with patience and love every day.
transliteration: W Teta beterodd alaiha be sabr w hob koll yom

arabic: بره الجو مطر كتير
english: Outside, the weather is a lot of rain.
transliteration: barra el gaww matar kiteer

arabic: انا جوه البيت
english: I am inside the house.
transliteration: ana gawwa el beit

arabic: انا باسمع صوت المطر
english: I hear the sound of the rain.
transliteration: ana ba'esma3 sout el matar

arabic: انا باشوف المطر من الشباك
english: I see the rain from the window.
transliteration: ana bashouf el matar men el shibbak

arabic: جوه البيت دافي
english: Inside the house, it's warm.
transliteration: gawwa el beit dafy

arabic: انا ماشي في الشارع وشفت واحد
english: I am walking in the street and I saw someone.
transliteration: Ana mashi fi el shari' w shoft wahed.

arabic: قلت ايه ده انت عمر
english: I said, "What is this? Are you Omar?"
transliteration: Oult "Eh da? Inta Omar?"

arabic: هو قال ايوه ازيك يا صديقي
english: He said, "Yes! How are you, my friend?"
transliteration: Howa 'al "Aywa! Izzayak ya sadi'i?"

arabic: قلت انا كويس قوي ومبسوط انك هنا
english: I said, "I'm very good and happy that you are here."
transliteration: Oult "Ana kwayyes awi w mabsoot innak hena."

arabic: هو قال الحمد لله مع السلامة يا صاحبي
english: He said, "Praise be to God. Goodbye, my friend."
transliteration: Howa 'al "Alhamdulillah. Ma'a el salama ya sahbi."

arabic: انا لسه سايقه العربيه عشان اروح الشغل الصبح بدري
english: I just drove the car to go to work early this morning
transliteration: ana lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan arouh el shoghl essobh badri
storyTitle: A Day at Work and Home

arabic: في الشغل قابلت زمايلي و سالت عن هدير بس محدش شافها
english: At work, I met my colleagues and asked about Hadeer, but no one saw her
transliteration: fi el shoghl qabelt zamayli we sa'alt 'an hadeer bas mahadesh shafha
storyTitle: A Day at Work and Home

arabic: بعد يوم طويل انا لسه جايبه تفاح انهارده الصبح وانا مروحه البيت
english: After a long day, I had just bought apples this morning on my way home
transliteration: ba'd yom tawil ana lessa gayba toffah ennaharda essobh wana marawaha el bet
storyTitle: A Day at Work and Home

arabic: لما وصلت البيت لقيت فيه نور في الصاله و سمعت صوت ضحك عالي
english: When I arrived home, I found a light in the hall and heard loud laughter
transliteration: lamma wasalt el bet laqet fih nour fi essala we sema't sot dehk 'ali
storyTitle: A Day at Work and Home

arabic: بس انا لسه سايباها في المول من ساعه كنت فاكراها هتفضل هناك
english: But I just left her at the mall an hour ago, I thought she would stay there
transliteration: bas ana lessa saybaha fi el mol men saaha kont fakraha hatfadal henaka
storyTitle: A Day at Work and Home

arabic: امي قالت يلا بينا ننزل السوق الكبير نشتري هدوم جديدة
english: My mother said, "Let's go down to the big market to buy new clothes."
transliteration: Ommy 'alet yalla bena nenzel el soo' el kibeer neshtary hedoom gedeeda.

arabic: شفنا محل هدوم حلوة قوي جوه السوق
english: We saw a shop with very nice clothes inside the market.
transliteration: Shofna mahal hedoom helwa 'awe gowwa el soo'.

arabic: مسكت تيشرت ازرق جميل وسألت البياع ده بكام
english: I held a beautiful blue t-shirt and asked the seller, "How much is this?"
transliteration: Masakt t-shirt azra' gameel we sa'alt el bayya': dah bekam?

arabic: بعد ما اشترينا التيشرت امي قالت لسه محتاجين فاكهة وخضار للبيت
english: After we bought the t-shirt, my mother said, "We still need fruit and vegetables for the house."
transliteration: Ba'd ma eshtarayna el t-shirt, ommy 'alet: lessa mehtageen fakha w khodaar lel bayt.

arabic: وصلنا قسم الفاكهة والخضار وفجأة امي قالت نسيت اقولك الهدوم دي كانت للقطة بتاعتنا
english: We reached the fruit and vegetable section, and suddenly my mother said, "I forgot to tell you, these clothes were for our cat!"
transliteration: Wasalna 'esm el fakha wel khodaar, we faga'a ommy 'alet: "Neseet a'ollak, el hedoom di kanet lel 'otta beta'tna!"

arabic: الجو جميل النهاردة انا حاسس بالانتعاش وانا ماشي في الشارع
english: The weather is beautiful today I feel refreshed while walking in the street
transliteration: El gaw gameel el naharda ana 7ases bel entea'ash w ana mashi fel shari3

arabic: فجأة شفت راجل لابس تيشرت ازرق وبيبصلي
english: Suddenly I saw a man wearing a blue t-shirt looking at me
transliteration: Fa ga'a shoft ragel labes t-shirt azra' w beybosli

arabic: وشه كان مألوف وضحكته كانت زي ما هي
english: His face was familiar and his laugh was still the same
transliteration: Wish-sho kan ma'loof w da7ket-toh kanet zay ma heya

arabic: ده كان صاحبي القديم احمد اللي مشفتهوش من سنين
english: This was my old friend Ahmed whom I haven't seen for years
transliteration: Da kan sa7bi el qadeem Ahmed elli ma shoftehosh men sneen

arabic: سلمت عليه بحرارة وكنت مبسوط جدا اني شفته
english: I greeted him warmly and was very happy to see him
transliteration: Sallamt a'aleih be 7arara w kont mabsoot geddan enni shof-toh

arabic: اليوم رحت السوق اشتري خضار وفاكهة وفجأة شفت صاحبي القديم احمد
english: Today I went to the market to buy vegetables and fruit, and suddenly I saw my old friend Ahmed.
transliteration: El-naharda roht es-souq ashtari khodaar w fakha wi fag'a shoft sahbi el-qadeem Ahmed.

arabic: سلمت عليه وقلت له السلام عليكم يا احمد ازيك انا كويس الحمد لله فرد علي وقاللي اهلا بيك مش معقول
english: I greeted him and said, "Hello Ahmed, how are you? I'm good, alhamdulillah." He replied, "Welcome, unbelievable!"
transliteration: Sallimt aleih w qoltelo As-salamu alaykum ya Ahmed izzayyak ana kwayyes alhamdulillah fa radd aleiya w qalli Ahlan beek mish ma'oul.

arabic: قالي انا عندي ولاد دلوقتي وبيكلموا انجليزي بس على طول ومابيعرفوش يجيبوا خضار
english: He told me, "I have kids now, and they only speak English all the time, and they don't know how to buy vegetables."
transliteration: Qalli ana andi wilaad delwa'ti w biyitkallimu Engleezi bass ala tool w ma bya'rafoosh yigibu khodaar.

arabic: استغربت اوي من كلامه احنا زمان كنا بنحب السوق والناس
english: I was very surprised by his words; in our time, we used to love the market and the people.
transliteration: Istaghrabt awi min kalaamo e7na zamaan kon-na ben7eb es-souq wen-naas.

arabic: سلمت عليه تاني وقلت له مع السلامة يا احمد وان شاء الله نتقابل تاني قريب
english: I greeted him again and said, "Goodbye, Ahmed, and God willing, we'll meet again soon."
transliteration: Sallimt aleih tani w qoltelo Ma'a salama ya Ahmed w inshallah nitqabil tani qareeb.

arabic: المطر كتير بره دلوقتي
english: The rain is a lot outside now.
transliteration: El matar kitiir barra dilwa'ty.

arabic: احنا جوه البيت
english: We are inside the house.
transliteration: Ehna gowwa el beit.

arabic: ده كويس قوي
english: This is very good.
transliteration: Dah kwayyis awi.

arabic: عايز شاي يا احمد
english: Do you want tea, Ahmed?
transliteration: Ayez shay ya Ahmed?

arabic: ايوه عايز
english: Yes, I want.
transliteration: Aywa ayez.

arabic: منى شايفة قماش كتير في العتبة بس البياع قال سعر غالي خالص.
english: Mona sees a lot of fabric in El-Ataba, but the vendor quoted a very expensive price.
transliteration: Mona shayfa oumash keteir fi el-Ataba bas el-bayya3 aal se3r ghaly khales.

arabic: هي كانت معاها خمسين جنيه بس، يعني مش كفاية لكل القماش ده.
english: She only had fifty pounds with her, meaning it wasn't enough for all this fabric.
transliteration: Heyya kanet ma3aha khamsin gineih bas, ya3ny mish kefaya le koll el-oumash dah.

arabic: قالت للبياع: "معلش يا عمو، ممكن ألاقي أرخص شوية؟"
english: She said to the vendor: "Excuse me, uncle, can I find it a little cheaper?"
transliteration: Aalet lel-bayya3: "Ma3lesh ya 3ammu, mumkin alaa2i arkhas shwayya?"

arabic: البياع رد بابتسامة: "يا بنتي، أهو ده أحسن سعر عندي."
english: The vendor replied with a smile: "My daughter, this is the best price I have."
transliteration: El-bayya3 radd be-ebtesama: "Ya benty, aho dah ahsan se3r 3andy."

arabic: منى بصت على الأقمشة اللي جنبها وقررت تدور على محل تاني عشان تلاقي ألوانها المفضلة بسعر أحسن.
english: Mona looked at the fabrics next to her and decided to search for another shop to find her favorite colors at a better price.
transliteration: Mona basset 3ala el-oumesha elli ganbaha we qararet tedawwar 3ala mahal tany 3ashan telaa2i alwanaha el-mofaddala be-se3r ahsan.

arabic: ماما قالتلي يلا بينا نروح السوق نجيب خضار وفاكهة
english: Mom told me, "Let's go to the market to get vegetables and fruit."
transliteration: Mama 2aletli yalla bina naroo7 es-sou2 nigeeb 5odaar we fakha

arabic: لما وصلنا السوق كان زحمة قوي وشفنا ناس كتير
english: When we arrived at the market, it was very crowded and we saw many people.
transliteration: Lamma wesalna es-sou2 kaan za7ma 2awy we shofna naas keteer

arabic: بياع قال لماما اتفضلي يا ست الكل الفراولة دي بلدي ومسكرة
english: A seller told Mom, "Please, dear lady, these strawberries are local and sweet."
transliteration: Bayya3 2aal le Mama etfaDDali ya sett el-koll el-faraawla di balady we mesakkara

arabic: ماما ردت عليه وقالت هآخد نص كيلو عشان عائلتي بتحبها
english: Mom replied to him and said, "I'll take half a kilo because my family loves them."
transliteration: Mama raddet 3aleih we 2alet haa5od noSS kilo 3ashaan 3aylti beta7ebaha

arabic: بعد ما اشترينا كل حاجة رجعنا البيت ومبسوطين ان بابا هيتبسط بالاكل
english: After we bought everything, we returned home happy that Dad would enjoy the food.
transliteration: Ba3d ma eshtereina koll 7aga rege3na el-beit we mabsooteen en Baba hayetbasat bel-akl

arabic: صحيت متأخر زي كل يوم والوقت كان بيجري بسرعة عشان الشغل
english: I woke up late like every day and time was running fast because of work.
transliteration: Sa7eet meta'akhar zay kol yom wel wa't kan beyegri be sor3a 3ashan el shoghl

arabic: ماما ندهت عليا من المطبخ وقالت يالا يا حبيبي الفطار جاهز
english: Mom called me from the kitchen and said 'Come on dear, breakfast is ready.'
transliteration: Mama nadahet 3alaya men el matbakh we 'alet yalla ya 7abibi el fetar gahez

arabic: دخلت لقيت بابا قاعد بيشرب شاي وبيقول صباح الخير مستعجل ليه كده
english: I went in and found Dad sitting drinking tea, saying 'Good morning, why are you in such a hurry?'
transliteration: Dakhelt la'eet Baba 2a3ed beyeshrab shay we bey'ool sabah el kheer masta3gel leih keda

arabic: رديت عليه وقولتله الشغل مستني ومفيش وقت للراحة يا بابا
english: I replied to him and told him 'Work is waiting, and there's no time for rest, Dad.'
transliteration: Raddet 3aleih we 'oltelo el shoghl mestani we mafish wa't lel ra7a ya Baba

arabic: دي عائلتي اللي بتديني الطاقة ابدأ بيها يومي المزدحم ده
english: This is my family that gives me the energy to start my busy day.
transliteration: Di 3aylti elli betdeni el ta'a abda' beha yomi el mozdaham dah

arabic: صباح الخير انا رايح السوق النهاردة
english: Good morning, I am going to the market today.
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ana rayeh el souq el naharda.

arabic: السوق كبير ومليان فواكه وخضروات جميلة
english: The market is big and full of beautiful fruits and vegetables.
transliteration: El souq kabeer w malyan fawakeh w khadrawat gameela.

arabic: انا سعيد جداً اني هنا في السوق
english: I am very happy that I am here in the market.
transliteration: Ana sa'eed giddan inni hena fil souq.

arabic: بائع واحد بيضحك وبيقول ممكن مساعدة
english: One seller is smiling and saying "Can I help?"
transliteration: Baa'e' wahed biyedhak w bi'oul momken mosa'ada.

arabic: قلت له شكراً انا مبسوط اوي
english: I told him "Thank you, I am very pleased."
transliteration: Oult lo shokran ana mabsoot awi.

arabic: صباح الخير يا عم سيد ازيك انا كويسة الحمد لله
english: Good morning Uncle Sayed, how are you? I'm good, alhamdulillah.
transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer ya 'amm Sayed, izzayyik? Ana kwayyesa, alhamdulillah.

arabic: انا جاية ارجع القميص ده معلش
english: I came to return this shirt, sorry.
transliteration: Ana gayya aragga el-amees da, ma'alish.

arabic: اهلا بيكي يا منى مفيش مشكلة خالص
english: Welcome, Mona, no problem at all.
transliteration: Ahlan beeki ya Mona, mafish mushkila khalis.

arabic: اتفضلي يا بنتي الفلوس بتاعتك اهي
english: Here you go, my daughter, here is your money.
transliteration: Etfaḍḍali ya binti, el-felus beta'tik ahi.

arabic: شكرا جزيلا مع السلامة يا عم سيد
english: Thank you very much, goodbye Uncle Sayed.
transliteration: Shukran gaziilan, ma'a salama ya 'amm Sayed.

arabic: كريم ولد صغير صوته عالي بيسأل أسئلة كتير أوي
english: Karim is a small boy with a loud voice who asks very many questions.
transliteration: Karim walad sagheer soto aali biyes'al as'ela keteer awi

arabic: ماما كانت بتعمل شاي ريحته حلوة فكريم سأل من فضلكي ليه الشاي سخن اوي
english: Mama was making sweet-smelling tea, so Karim asked, "Please, why is the tea very hot?"
transliteration: Mama kanet bet'amel shay rehto helwa fakareem sa'al min fadliki leeh el shay sokhn awi

arabic: شاف وردة حمرا و سأل ماما هي الوردة دي كويسة
english: He saw a red flower and asked Mama, "Is this flower good?"
transliteration: Shaf warda hamra w sa'al Mama heya el warda di kwayyesa

arabic: ماما كانت تعبانة لكن بتجاوب دايماً الحمد لله
english: Mama was tired but always answered, "Praise be to God."
transliteration: Mama kanet ta'bana laken betgawb dayman Alhamdullah

arabic: وكل مرة بتخلص اجابة بيقول شكرا وبيسأل سؤال جديد
english: And every time an answer finishes, he says "Thank you" and asks a new question.
transliteration: W kol marra betkhallas igaba biyo'ul shukran w biyes'al so'al gideed

arabic: انا رحت السوق النهاردة
english: I went to the market today.
transliteration: Ana roht el sou' el naharda

arabic: كنت عايز اشتري خضار وفاكهة
english: I wanted to buy vegetables and fruit.
transliteration: Kont aayez ashtary khodaar w fak-ha

arabic: كان فيه طماطم كبيرة وموز حلو اوي
english: There were big tomatoes and very good bananas.
transliteration: Kan feih tamaatem kebeera w mooz helw awi

arabic: سالت على الفلوس قالولي مش غالي
english: I asked about the money, they told me "not expensive."
transliteration: Sa'alt ala el felous, 'alouly mesh ghaly

arabic: انا اشتريت تفاح صغير واحد بس و روحت بضحك
english: I bought only one small apple and went home laughing.
transliteration: Ana eshtareet toffah soghayyar wahed bas w roht beda7k

arabic: انا روحت بيت جدتي امبارح
english: I went to my grandmother's house yesterday.
transliteration: Ana roht beit giddeti imbareh.

arabic: هي عملت لي شاي وقعدنا نتكلم شوية
english: She made me tea and we sat and talked a little.
transliteration: Heya 'amaletli shay w qa'adna netkallem shwaya.

arabic: هي كانت بتتفرج على التليفزيون وانا كنت ماسك الموبايل بتاعي
english: She was watching TV and I was holding my mobile.
transliteration: Heya kanet betetfarrag 'ala el-television w ana kont masek el-mobile beta'i.

arabic: جدتي قالت لي انت بتعمل ايه في الموبايل ده دلوقتي
english: My grandmother said to me, "What are you doing on this mobile now?"
transliteration: Giddeti 'aletli "enta bet'amel eih fi el-mobile da delwa'ti?"

arabic: انا شرحت لها بس هي مش فهمت قوي وقالت زمان كان فيه حاجات تانية
english: I explained to her but she didn't understand very much and said, "In the past there were other things."
transliteration: Ana sharahtelha bas heya mish fehemt qawi w 'alet "zamaan kan fiih hagat tanya."

arabic: انا عايزة اعمل فرح حلو النهاردة
english: I want to make a beautiful wedding today.
transliteration: Ana ayza a'mel farah helw el-naharda.

arabic: لازم اشوف مطعم كبير ومفيش مشكلة في الفلوس
english: I must see a big restaurant, and there is no problem with money.
transliteration: Laazim ashouf maT'am kabeer wamafeesh moshkela fel felous.

arabic: بس فين شقة جديدة للعرسان
english: But where is a new apartment for the newlyweds?
transliteration: Bas feen sha'a gedeeda lel-ersaan?

arabic: امبارح شفت شقة صغيرة بس مش حلوة كتير
english: Yesterday I saw a small apartment but it wasn't very beautiful.
transliteration: Embaareh shoft sha'a soghayyara bas mish helwa keteer.

arabic: بكرة هشوف شقة تانية يمكن تكون احسن
english: Tomorrow I will see another apartment, maybe it will be better.
transliteration: Bokra hashof sha'a tanya yemken tekoun ahsan.

arabic: انا صحيت الصبح
english: I woke up in the morning.
transliteration: Ana seheyt el sobh

arabic: رحت المطبخ علشان اعمل فطار
english: I went to the kitchen to make breakfast.
transliteration: Roht el matbakh ala shan a'mel fetar

arabic: مفيش عيش في التلاجة
english: There is no bread in the fridge.
transliteration: Mafish aish fel talaga

arabic: انا عايزة اكل جبنة وعيش
english: I want to eat cheese and bread.
transliteration: Ana ayza akel gebna w aish

arabic: فين العيش دي مشكلة
english: Where is the bread? This is a problem.
transliteration: Feen el aish? Di moshkela

arabic: صباح الخير يا ماما أنا صحيت بدري النهاردة عشان عيد ميلادي
english: Good morning, Mama, I woke up early today because it's my birthday.
transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer ya Mama, ana ṣaḥeet badry el-naharda 'ashan 'eid miladi.

arabic: عملت فطار خفيف وجهزت نفسي عشان أصحابي جايين
english: I made a light breakfast and got myself ready because my friends are coming.
transliteration: 'Amelt fetar khafeef we gahhazt nafsi 'ashan aṣḥabi gayyeen.

arabic: أول واحدة وصلت كانت مريم وسارة قالتلها أهلاً بيكي يا مريم
english: The first one to arrive was Maryam, and Sara told her: "Welcome, Maryam!"
transliteration: Awwal waḥda waṣalet kanet Maryam, we Sara 'aletlaha: "Ahlan beeki ya Maryam!"

arabic: مريم سألت إزيك يا سارة فردت سارة أنا كويسة الحمد لله
english: Maryam asked: "How are you, Sara?" Sara replied: "I'm good, alhamdulillah."
transliteration: Maryam sa'alet: "Izzayyik ya Sara?" fa-raddet Sara: "Ana kwayyesa, alhamdulillah."

arabic: بعدين قعدوا يتكلموا ويشربوا عصير ويستنوا باقي الأصحاب
english: Then they sat talking, drinking juice, and waiting for the rest of the friends.
transliteration: Ba'deen qa'adu yetkallemu we yeshrabu 'aseer we yestannu ba'i el-aṣḥab.

arabic: انا اسف ممكن ارجع التيشيرت ده
english: I'm sorry, can I return this t-shirt?
transliteration: ana assef momken aragga3 el-tishirt da

arabic: اهلا يا فندم فيه مشكلة آه بصراحة مقاسه صغير قوي عليا
english: Welcome sir, is there a problem? Yes, honestly its size is too small for me.
transliteration: ahlan ya fandem fih moshkela ah basaaraHa ma'aso soghayyar awi 3alaya

arabic: طيب الفاتورة معاك
english: Okay, do you have the receipt?
transliteration: Tayyeb el-fatura ma3ak

arabic: اه معايا عايز اغيره بواحد اكبر
english: Yes I have it, I want to exchange it for a bigger one.
transliteration: ah ma3aya 3ayez aghayyaroh bewahed akbar

arabic: تمام مفيش اي مشكلة تعال شوف المقاس اللي يناسبك
english: Okay, no problem at all, come see the size that suits you.
transliteration: tamam mafish ay moshkela ta3ala shoof el-ma'as elli yenasebak

arabic: ابن اختي احمد دايماً بيسأل اسئلة كتير اوي
english: My nephew Ahmed always asks so many questions.
transliteration: Ibn okhti Ahmad dayman biyis'al as'ela keteer awi.

arabic: النهاردة كان بيساعدني وانا بقطع خضار وفاكهة وسألني ليه الجزر برتقالي
english: Today he was helping me while I was cutting vegetables and fruit, and he asked me why carrots are orange.
transliteration: El-naharda kan biyisa'idni wana ba'ata' khodaar w fakha w sa'alni leh el-gazar bortu'ali.

arabic: جاوبته ولقيته سألني عن طبق السلطة القديم اللي على الترابيزة
english: I answered him, and then I found him asking me about the old salad bowl on the table.
transliteration: Gawaabto w la'eeto sa'alni 'an taba' el-salata el-qadeem elli 'ala el-tarabeeza.

arabic: مش معقول كمية الكلام اللي بيقولها في خمس دقايق بس
english: It's unbelievable the amount of talking he does in just five minutes.
transliteration: Mish ma'oul kammiyya el-kalam elli biy'oolha fi khams da'ayeq bas.

arabic: انا بحبه اوي بس محتاج اشرب كوباية شاي عشان اركز معاه
english: I love him very much, but I need to drink a cup of tea to focus with him.
transliteration: Ana bahebbo awi bas mehtag ashrab kobayyet shay 'ashan arakkez ma'aah.

arabic: أنا رحت السوق امبارح
english: I went to the market yesterday.
transliteration: Ana roht el souq embareh.

arabic: شفت تفاح كتير ولونه احمر
english: I saw many apples and their color was red.
transliteration: Shoft tuffah kiteer w lonoh ahmar.

arabic: سألت الراجل من فضلك التفاح بكام
english: I asked the man, "Please, how much are the apples?"
transliteration: Sa'alt el ragel min fadlak, el tuffah be kam?

arabic: قال لي الراجل آه التفاح ده غالي حبتين
english: The man told me, "Ah, these apples are a little expensive!"
transliteration: Aal li el ragel: "Ah el tuffah da ghali habbetein!"

arabic: ضحكت وقلت له شكرا باي واشتريت موز
english: I laughed and told him "Thank you, bye," and bought bananas.
transliteration: Dehekt w oltiloh shukran bye, w eshtareet mawz.

arabic: قاعدة في الكافيه مستنية هدير بقالي كتير
english: I'm sitting in the café waiting for Hadeer for a long time.
transliteration: Qa'da fel cafe mestanniya Hadeer ba'ali keteer.

arabic: يا ترى هي فين انا لسه سايباها في المول من ساعه
english: I wonder where she is, I just left her at the mall an hour ago.
transliteration: Ya tara hiyya fein? Ana lessa saybaha fel mol men sa'a.

arabic: يمكن نسيت معادنا او لسه تعبانه من الشغل
english: Maybe she forgot our appointment or is still tired from work.
transliteration: Yemken nesyet ma'adna aw lessa ta'bana men el shoghl.

arabic: انا لسه قاعدة هنا مستنية شوفتي ازاي الوقت بيجري بسرعة
english: I am still sitting here waiting, did you see how fast time flies?
transliteration: Ana lessa qa'da hena mestanniya, shofti ezay el wa't beyegri be sor'a?

arabic: انا هكلمها دلوقتي واقولها خلاص مفيش وقت انا ماشية
english: I will call her now and tell her 'enough, there's no time, I'm leaving'.
transliteration: Ana hakallemha delwa'ty w a'ollaha khalas mafish wa't ana mashya.

arabic: انا قاعد في القهوة مستني صاحبي
english: I am sitting in the cafe waiting for my friend.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed fel 'ahwa mestanni sahby.
storyTitle: Waiting for My Friend at the Café

arabic: بصيت على المنيو ولقيت عصير فاكهة
english: I looked at the menu and found fruit juice.
transliteration: Basseet 'ala el menu we la'eet 'aseer fakha.
storyTitle: Waiting for My Friend at the Café

arabic: سألت الجرسون بكام العصير ده
english: I asked the waiter, "How much is this juice?"
transliteration: Sa'alt el garson bekam el 'aseer da.
storyTitle: Waiting for My Friend at the Café

arabic: شويه وصاحبي وصل وقالي يلا بينا
english: A little while later, my friend arrived and told me, "Let's go."
transliteration: Shwaya we sahby wasal we qali yalla beina.
storyTitle: Waiting for My Friend at the Café

arabic: قلتله امي عايزة خضار من السوق الكبير عشان البيت
english: I told him, "My mother wants vegetables from the big market for the house."
transliteration: Oltelo ommy 'ayza khodaar men el soo' el kibeer 'ashan el bayt.
storyTitle: Waiting for My Friend at the Café

arabic: كنت باخطط لخطوبة اختي مع صاحبتي المقربة
english: I was planning my sister's engagement with my close friend
transliteration: Kunt bakhaṭṭeṭ li-khoṭūbet okhtī ma3 ṣāḥibtī el-muqarriba

arabic: ريحة الورد كانت مالية القاعة كلها ومنورة بالزينة
english: The smell of roses filled the entire hall, illuminated by decorations
transliteration: Rīḥet el-ward kānet mālyah el-qā3a kullaha w-minawwara bil-zīna

arabic: خالي كان بيراجع نظام الصوت وبيتاكد ان كل حاجة تمام
english: My maternal uncle was checking the sound system and making sure everything was alright
transliteration: Khālī kān biyurāgi3 nizām el-ṣōt w-biyita'akked inn kull ḥāga tamām

arabic: جدتي كانت بتدوق الكيكة بفرحة وباين عليها مبسوطة اوي
english: My grandmother was tasting the cake with joy, and she looked very happy
transliteration: Gaddatī kānet bitdū' el-kīka bi-farḥa w-bāyin 3alēha mabsūṭa awī

arabic: كلنا كنا متحمسين جدا لليوم الكبير ده
english: We were all very excited for this big day
transliteration: Kullina kunna mutaḥammisīn giddan lil-yōm el-kabīr da

arabic: فيه طفل صغير اسمه كريم
english: There is a small child, his name is Karim.
transliteration: Feh tefl soghayar esmo Karim.

arabic: كريم بيسال باباه اسئلة كتير كل يوم
english: Karim asks his dad many questions every day.
transliteration: Karim beysa'al babah as'ela keteer kol yawm.

arabic: هو بيسال يا بابا ليه التليفون ده قديم
english: He asks 'Dad, why is this phone old?'
transliteration: Howa beysa'al ya baba leh el telefun da adeem?

arabic: باباه بيقول يا كريم احنا كنا بنلعب بحاجات بسيطة مش تليفونات
english: His dad says 'Karim, we used to play with simple things, not phones.'
transliteration: Babah be'ool ya Karim ehna konna benla'ab be-hagāt baseeta mesh telefunat.

arabic: كريم مش فاهم هو عايز يعرف كل حاجة دلوقتي
english: Karim doesn't understand, he wants to know everything now.
transliteration: Karim mesh fahem howa ayiz ya'raf kol haga delwa'ty.

arabic: سلمى افتكرت إنها نسيت تجيب لبن لقهوة مامتها الصبح.
english: Salma remembered that she forgot to bring milk for her mother's morning coffee.
transliteration: Salma eftakaret ennaha nesyet tegeeb laban le'ahwet mamettha elsobh.

arabic: والدها كان بيقرا الجورنال في الصالة عادي، وبيشرب شاي.
english: Her father was reading the newspaper in the living room, as usual, and drinking tea.
transliteration: Walidha kan biy'ra elgornal fi essala aadi, wibiyishrab shay.

arabic: أختها الصغيرة، نور، كانت بتلعب بعرائسها جنبها ومبسوطة.
english: Her younger sister, Nour, was playing with her dolls next to her and happy.
transliteration: Okhtaha essagheera, Nour, kanat bital'ab bi'ara'isha gambaha wamabsouta.

arabic: فجأة، أخوها الكبير، كريم، قال: "معلش يا سلمى، أنا هجيب اللبن دلوقتي".
english: Suddenly, her older brother, Karim, said: "Never mind, Salma, I will bring the milk now."
transliteration: Faj'a, akhouha elkabeer, Karim, 'al: "Ma'lesh ya Salma, ana hageeb ellaban dilwa'ti."

arabic: الأم حضرت الفطير المشلتت وطلبت قهوة زيادة لينا كلنا.
english: The mother prepared the feteer meshaltet and asked for extra coffee for all of us.
transliteration: El'omm haddaret elfeteer elmeshaltet watlabet 'ahwa ziyada leena kollena.

arabic: انا في البيت فيه مشكلة
english: I am in the house, there is a problem.
transliteration: Ana fil-bayt fiih mushkela.

arabic: القطة جعانة هي عايزة لبن
english: The cat is hungry, she wants milk.
transliteration: El-otta ga'ana heya ayza laban.

arabic: فين اللبن هو مش في التلاجة
english: Where is the milk? It is not in the fridge.
transliteration: Feen el-laban? Howa mesh fit-tallaga.

arabic: انا بادور في المطبخ مفيش لبن
english: I am looking in the kitchen. There is no milk.
transliteration: Ana badawwar fil-matbakh. Mafeesh laban.

arabic: القطة بتشرب مايه
english: The cat is drinking water!
transliteration: El-otta betishrab mayya!

arabic: اليوم رحت ازور خالتي سلوى في بيتها
english: Today I went to visit my maternal aunt Salwa at her house.
transliteration: El-yoom roḥt azōr khālti Salwā fī bēt-hā.

arabic: لما دخلت شمت ريحة كحك سخن وقهوة مظبوطة مالية المكان
english: When I entered, I smelled the scent of hot kahk and perfectly brewed coffee filling the place.
transliteration: Lamma dakhalet shammet rīḥet kaḥk sokhn w qahwa maẓboota malya el-makān.

arabic: خالتي استقبلتني بابتسامة دافية وحضن كبير
english: My aunt welcomed me with a warm smile and a big hug.
transliteration: Khālti est'ablētnī b'ebtisāma dāfya w ḥuḍn kabīr.

arabic: قعدنا نتكلم كتير وهي كانت بتحكيلي عن جارتها صاحبة البيت اللي جنبهم
english: We sat and talked a lot, and she was telling me about her neighbor, the female friend of the house next to them.
transliteration: Qa'adnā netkallem kitīr w hiya kānet beteḥkīlī 3an gāret-hā ṣāḥibet el-bēt elly ganbuhom.

arabic: قبل ما امشي قلتلها مع السلامة يا خالتي اشوفك قريب
english: Before I left, I told her 'goodbye, my aunt, see you soon'.
transliteration: Abl mā amshī oltel-hā ma'a s-salāma ya khālti ashoofek qarīb.

arabic: انا عايز اشتري لبس جديد
english: I want to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Ana ayiz eshtiri labs gedid.

arabic: رحت محل كبير في السوق
english: I went to a big store in the market.
transliteration: Roht mahall kebir fi is-souq.

arabic: جربت قمصان كتير بس المقاس مش كويس
english: I tried many shirts but the size wasn't good.
transliteration: Garrabt omsan ketir bas il-ma'as mish kwayyes.

arabic: بعدين لقيت تي شيرت الوانه جميلة اوي
english: Then I found a t-shirt with very beautiful colors.
transliteration: Ba'dein le'eit tee-shirt alwanu gameela awi.

arabic: انا مبسوط اوي اني اشتريته بفلوس قليلة
english: I am very happy that I bought it for little money.
transliteration: Ana mabsout awi inni eshtaraitoh befelous aleela.

arabic: انا قاعد في القهوة هنا
english: I am sitting in the cafe here.
transliteration: Ana 2a3ed fel 2ahwa hena.

arabic: انا عايز واحد قهوة من فضلك
english: I want one coffee please.
transliteration: Ana 3ayez wahed 2ahwa min fadlak.

arabic: معلش فين القهوة بتاعتي
english: Excuse me, where is my coffee?
transliteration: Ma3lesh feen el 2ahwa beta3ty?

arabic: انا مستني بقالي عشر دقايق
english: I have been waiting for ten minutes.
transliteration: Ana mestanny ba2aly 3ashar da2aye2.

arabic: شكرا القهوة بتاعتي وصلت
english: Thank you, my coffee arrived.
transliteration: Shokran el 2ahwa beta3ty weslet.

arabic: الصبح انا صحيت في البيت
english: In the morning, I woke up at home.
transliteration: El sobh ana seheet fel beit.

arabic: في المطبخ كانت فيه مشكلة
english: In the kitchen, there was a problem.
transliteration: Fel matbakh kanet feeh moshkela.

arabic: التلاجة بتاعتي مكسورة
english: My fridge is broken.
transliteration: El tallaga beta'ty maksoora.

arabic: انا عايز اصلحها لازم
english: I want to fix it, it's necessary.
transliteration: Ana ayiz aslahha lazem.

arabic: هكلم الراجل بكرة عشان يصلحها
english: I will call the man tomorrow for him to fix it.
transliteration: Hakallem el ragel bokra ashan yeslahha.

arabic: يا صباح الخير يا ام احمد ازيك
english: Good morning, Umm Ahmed, how are you?
transliteration: Ya sabah el kher ya Umm Ahmed, ezayek?

arabic: صباح النور يا جارتي انا مش كويسة النهاردة
english: Good morning, my neighbor, I'm not good today.
transliteration: Sabah el noor ya garti, ana mesh kwayesa el naharda.

arabic: ليه انتي زعلانة في اي مشكلة
english: Why are you sad? Is there any problem?
transliteration: Leh enti za'lana? Fi ay mushkela?

arabic: ايوه انا محتاجة مساعدة صغيرة في البيت
english: Yes, I need a little help at home.
transliteration: Aywa, ana mahtaga mosa'ada soghayara fel beit.

arabic: متقلقيش انا هنا ومبسوطة اني اساعدك
english: Don't worry, I'm here and happy to help you.
transliteration: Ma teqlaqeesh, ana hena w mabsuta enni asa'edek.

arabic: يا ماما التلاجة مش شغالة الاكل هيبوظ
english: Mom, the fridge isn't working, the food will spoil!
transliteration: Ya mama et-tallaga mesh shaghghala el-akl hayboz

arabic: يا نهار ابيض لازم نشوف حل بسرعة مين هيصلحها
english: Oh no! We need to find a solution quickly, who will fix it?
transliteration: Ya nahar abyad! Lazem neshuf ḥall besorʿa, mīn hayṣallaḥha?

arabic: اكيد بابا هو مرشحنا الوحيد للمشاكل دي في البيت
english: Of course Dad, he's our only candidate for these problems at home.
transliteration: Akīd baba, howa morashshaḥna el-waḥīd lel-mashākel dī fel-bēt.

arabic: طب خلاص هشوفها دلوقتي مفيش وقت للتصويت
english: Alright, I'll check it now, there's no time for voting.
transliteration: Ṭab khalaṣ, hashufha delwaʾtī, mafīsh waʾt lel-taṣwīt.

arabic: يارب يعرف يصلحها هو الحكم في بيتنا
english: I hope he knows how to fix it, he is the governance in our house.
transliteration: Ya rab yaʿraf yeṣallaḥha, howa el-ḥokm fī bētna.

arabic: انا رحت بيت عمي النهاردة
english: I went to my uncle's house today.
transliteration: Ana roht beit ammy el naharda.

arabic: عمي قال لي عامل ايه
english: My uncle said to me, "How are you?"
transliteration: Ammy aal li amel eih?

arabic: انا قلت الحمد لله انا بخير
english: I said, "Praise be to God, I am fine."
transliteration: Ana olt el hamdulillah ana bikheir.

arabic: هو اداني شاي واكل
english: He gave me tea and food.
transliteration: Howa eddani shay w akl.

arabic: انا قلت شكرا ومع السلامة
english: I said "thank you" and "goodbye".
transliteration: Ana olt shukran w ma'a el salama.

arabic: سلمى واحمد كانوا بيتكلموا عن فرحهم الكبير
english: Salma and Ahmed were talking about their big wedding.
transliteration: Salma w Ahmed kanu biyitkallemu an faraḥhum el kibiir

arabic: راحوا يشوفوا قاعة واسعة فيها ورد كتير والوان مبهجة
english: They went to see a spacious hall with many flowers and cheerful colors.
transliteration: Raḥu yeshufu qa'a was'a fiha ward kitiir w alwan mubhega

arabic: احمد كان عايز الناس تاكل اكل حلو وتشرب عصاير فريش
english: Ahmed wanted people to eat good food and drink fresh juices.
transliteration: Ahmed kan ayiz ennas takol akl helw w teshrab asayir fresh

arabic: كل صحابهم واهلهم هييجوا ويقعدوا مبسوطين طول الليل
english: All their friends and family will come and sit happily all night.
transliteration: Koll sohabhum w ahluhum hayigu w ya'oodu mabsuutin tuul el liil

arabic: محتاجين يعملوا حاجات كتير عشان الفرح يبقى جميل اوي
english: They need to do many things for the wedding to be very beautiful.
transliteration: Mohtagiin ya'amelu hagatt kitiir ashan el faraḥ yeb'a gamil awi

arabic: انا كنت ماشي في الشارع
english: I was walking in the street.
transliteration: Ana kunt māshi fel-shāreʿ.

arabic: شفت صاحبي القديم احمد
english: I saw my old friend Ahmed.
transliteration: Shoft ṣaḥbi el-ʾadīm Ahmed.

arabic: سالته ايه خططك للويك اند
english: I asked him, "What are your plans for the weekend?"
transliteration: Saʾaltoh ʾēh khuṭaṭak lel-wīk end?

arabic: قال لي انا ناوي اسافر بكرة
english: He told me, "I intend to travel tomorrow."
transliteration: ʾĀl lī ana nāwi asāfer bokra.

arabic: بعدين ضحك وقال انا اطفائي
english: Then he laughed and said, "I am a firefighter!"
transliteration: Baʿdīn ḍeḥek w ʾāl "Ana iʈfāʔi!"

arabic: انا قاعد في قهوة
english: I am sitting in a café.
transliteration: Ana a'ed fi ahwa.

arabic: بستنى الجرسون يجي
english: I am waiting for the waiter to come.
transliteration: Bastanna el-garson yigi.

arabic: لسه مفيش حد
english: Still, there isn't anyone.
transliteration: Lessa mafeesh hadd.

arabic: عايز كوباية شاي لو سمحت
english: I want a cup of tea, please.
transliteration: Ayez kubayet shay law samaht.

arabic: يارب يجي دلوقتي بسرعة
english: O Lord, I hope he comes now quickly.
transliteration: Ya rab yigi delwa'ty bosor'a.

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد اختي الصغيرة وبابا وماما في البيت بيجهزوا كل حاجة
english: Today is my little sister's birthday, and Dad and Mom are at home preparing everything.
transliteration: Elnaharda 3eid milad okhti elsaghira we Baba we Mama fel beit biyeghazzu koll haga.

arabic: كل العيلة الكبيرة جت عشان نحتفل سوا في جو جميل
english: The whole extended family came to celebrate together in a beautiful atmosphere.
transliteration: Koll el-3eila el-kebira gat 3ashan na7tafel sawa fi gaw gamil.

arabic: جبنا تورتة كبيرة عليها شمع وغنينا لها أغنية عيد الميلاد بفرحة
english: We brought a big cake with candles on it and sang her the birthday song joyfully.
transliteration: Gebna torta kebira 3aleeha shama3 we ghaneena laha oghneyet 3eid el-milad befarha.

arabic: بعد كده فتحت الهدايا اللي بابا وماما والعيلة كلها جابوها لها وهي مبسوطة اوي
english: After that, she opened the gifts that Dad and Mom and the whole family brought her, and she was very happy.
transliteration: Ba3d keda fatahet elhadaya elli Baba we Mama wel-3eila kollaha gabouha laha we heya mabsoota awi.

arabic: الاحتفال كان جميل ودي عائلتي اللي بحبها اكتر حاجة في الدنيا
english: The celebration was beautiful, and this is my family whom I love most in the world.
transliteration: El-e7tefal kan gamil we di 3aylti elli bahebba aktar haga fel donya.

arabic: بصحى بدري كل يوم و بعمل قهوة
english: I wake up early every day and make coffee.
transliteration: Basḥa badri koll yōm wi ba'mel 'ahwa.

arabic: بعدين بلبس هدومي و بجهز نفسي للشغل
english: Then I get dressed and prepare myself for work.
transliteration: Ba'dein balbes hudoomi wi bagahhez nafsi lesh-shoġl.

arabic: صباح الخير عامل النظافة النهاردة بعدين شفت صاحبي القديم
english: Good morning cleaner today then I saw my old friend.
transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer 'āmil an-naẓāfa en-naharda ba'dein shoft ṣaḥbi el-'adeem.

arabic: قلتله السلام عليكم ازيك استغرب
english: I said to him 'Hello, how are you?' He was surprised.
transliteration: Oltelu as-salāmu 'alaykum izzayyak estaghrab.

arabic: بعد ما اتكلمنا شوية قلت مع السلامة قالي الله يسلمك
english: After we talked a bit, I said 'Goodbye' and he replied 'May God keep you safe.'
transliteration: Ba'd ma etkallimna shwayya olt ma'a salama qali Allah yisallimak.

arabic: الصبح كان زحمة جدا واحمد بيحاول يجهز بسرعة للشغل
english: The morning was very busy and Ahmed was trying to get ready quickly for work.
transliteration: El-ṣubḥ kān zaḥma giddan w Aḥmed biyaḥāwil yigaḥḥiz bi-sur'a lil-shuġl.

arabic: زوجته سارة قالت له صباح الخير يا احمد ازيك
english: His wife, Sarah, said to him: "Good morning Ahmed, how are you?"
transliteration: Zōgitoh Sara qālitloh: "Sabaḥ el-kheer ya Aḥmed, izzayyak?"

arabic: احمد رد وقال انا كويس الحمد لله بس مستعجل شوية
english: Ahmed replied and said: "I'm good, alhamdulillah, but I'm a bit rushed."
transliteration: Aḥmed radd w qāl: "Ana kwayyes el-ḥamdulillah bas musta'gil shwayya."

arabic: سارة قالت له مع السلامة يا حبيبي خلي بالك من نفسك
english: Sarah said to him: "Goodbye my dear, take care of yourself."
transliteration: Sara qālitloh: "Ma'a salama ya ḥabibi, khalli bālak min nafsak."

arabic: احمد قال لها الله يسلمك وهنزل انا دلوقتي
english: Ahmed said to her: "May God keep you safe, I'm heading down now."
transliteration: Aḥmed qāl lahā: "Allah yisallimik, w hanza wil ana dilwa'ti."

arabic: النور في اوضة المعيشة مش شغال
english: The light in the living room is not working.
transliteration: El noor fi awdet el ma3isha mesh shoghal.

arabic: يا علي ايه ده مش كويس
english: Oh Ali, what is this? This is not good.
transliteration: Ya Ali eh da mesh kwayes.

arabic: ايوه مفيش نور هنا
english: Yes, there is no light here.
transliteration: Aywa mafeesh noor hena.

arabic: ايه هنعمل ايه دلوقتي
english: What will we do now?
transliteration: Eh hane3mel eh delwaqty?

arabic: يلا نكلم مهندس
english: Let's call an engineer.
transliteration: Yalla nekallem mohandes.

arabic: رحت المحل امبارح عشان ارجع تي شيرت
english: I went to the shop yesterday to return a t-shirt.
transliteration: Roht elma7al embareh ashan aragga3 tee shirt.

arabic: التي شيرت كان صغير عليا اوي
english: The t-shirt was too small for me.
transliteration: Elt-shirt kan soghayar 3alaya awi.

arabic: صاحب المحل قال آسف يا فندم
english: The shop owner said: Sorry, sir.
transliteration: Sa7eb elma7al 'al: Asif ya fanadem.

arabic: ادالي الفلوس بتاعتي وده كان كويس
english: He gave me my money back, and that was good.
transliteration: Eddali elfelous beta3ty, we dah kan kwayyes.

arabic: كنت مبسوط اوي وقلت شكرا
english: I was very happy and said thank you.
transliteration: Kont mabsout awi we 'olt shokran.

arabic: انا اروح السوق كل يوم
english: I go to the market every day.
transliteration: Ana arouh es-souq koll yom.

arabic: عايز اشتري فاكهة وخضار
english: I want to buy fruit and vegetables.
transliteration: Ayez ashtaree fakha w khodar.

arabic: فيه طماطم حمرا وموز اصفر كتير
english: There are many red tomatoes and yellow bananas.
transliteration: Feeh tamatem hamra w mawz asfar keteer.

arabic: الطماطم حلوة ورخيصة بس الموز غالي شوية
english: The tomatoes are good and cheap, but the bananas are a bit expensive.
transliteration: Et-tamatem helwa w rakheesa bas el-mawz ghaly shwaya.

arabic: فجأة شفت قطة صغيرة حلوة واشتريتها
english: Suddenly I saw a cute small cat and bought it!
transliteration: Fag'a shoft otta soghayara helwa w ashtareetha!

arabic: النهاردة انا رايح السوق المحلي
english: Today I am going to the local market.
transliteration: El Naharda ana rayeh el sou' el maHallī
storyTitle: A Visit to the Local Market

arabic: مش فاضي بكرة بس النهاردة عندي وقت
english: I am not free tomorrow, but today I have time.
transliteration: Mish fadi bokra bas el naharda 'andy wa't
storyTitle: A Visit to the Local Market

arabic: اشتريت خضار وفاكهة من الساعة تسعة الصبح
english: I bought vegetables and fruits from 9 AM.
transliteration: Eshtareet khoDaar we fakha men el sa'a tes'a el sobH
storyTitle: A Visit to the Local Market

arabic: شفت قطة كبيرة بتجري ورا كلب صغير
english: I saw a big cat running after a small dog.
transliteration: Shoft 'oTTa kebeera betegry wara kalb soghayyar
storyTitle: A Visit to the Local Market

arabic: طلع إن القطة كان عندها ميعاد مع صاحب الكلب
english: It turned out that the cat had an appointment with the dog's owner!
transliteration: Tala' en el 'oTTa kan 'andaha me'aad ma' SaHeb el kalb
storyTitle: A Visit to the Local Market

arabic: الدنيا بتمطر بره وماما بتعمل شاي سخن
english: It's raining outside and Mom is making hot tea.
transliteration: El-donya betmaṭṭar barra w Mama bet'amel shay sokhn.

arabic: احنا قاعدين كلنا في الصالة بنسمع اغاني قديمة
english: We are all sitting in the living room listening to old songs.
transliteration: Eḥna 'a'deen kollena fiṣ-ṣala benisma' aghany 'adeema.

arabic: بابا بيحكي نكتة حلوة وكلنا بنضحك بصوت عالي
english: Dad is telling a nice joke and we are all laughing out loud.
transliteration: Baba beyḥaky nokta ḥelwa w kollena benedḥak beṣoot 'aly.

arabic: اختي جابت وفاكهة علشان ناكلها مع الشاي
english: My sister brought fruit for us to eat with the tea.
transliteration: Okhty gabit w fakha 'alashan nakolha ma'a sh-shay.

arabic: الجو ده دافي وجميل مش معقول
english: This warm and beautiful atmosphere is unbelievable.
transliteration: El-gaww da dafy w gameel mish ma'oul.

arabic: كل يوم الصبح بجهز نفسي وبعمل قهوة
english: Every morning I prepare myself and make coffee.
transliteration: Kull yoom es-sobh baġahhez nafsi waba'mel 'ahwa.

arabic: بعدين بلبس هدومي وبنزل اروح الشغل
english: Then I get dressed and go down to work.
transliteration: Ba'deen balbes hudoomi wabanzel arooḥ esh-shoġl.

arabic: في الشارع قابلت صاحبي القديم احمد فقلت له صباح الخير ازيك
english: In the street I met my old friend Ahmed so I said to him Good morning how are you.
transliteration: Fi esh-shaare' 'abelt ṣaḥbi el-adeem Aḥmad fa'olt loh Sabaḥ el-kheer izzayyak.

arabic: احمد رد السلام عليكم وقال انا كويس الحمد لله
english: Ahmed replied hello and said I'm fine thank God.
transliteration: Aḥmad radd as-salamu alaykum wa'al ana kwayyes el-ḥamdulillah.

arabic: بعدين قلت له مع السلامة يا احمد ورحت الشغل
english: Then I said to him goodbye Ahmed and I went to work.
transliteration: Ba'deen 'olt loh Ma'a salama ya Aḥmad waruḥt esh-shoġl.

arabic: امبارح اشتريت حتة قميص من المحل ده
english: Yesterday I bought a shirt from this shop.
transliteration: Embāreḥ eshtarēt ḥittet amīṣ men el maḥall da.

arabic: النهاردة انا عايز ارجعه لو سمحت
english: Today I want to return it, if you please.
transliteration: El nahārda ana 3āyez aragge3oh law samaḥt.

arabic: البائع رد وقالي مفيش مشكلة
english: The seller replied and told me "no problem."
transliteration: El bā'e3 radd wa 'ālī mafeesh moshkela.

arabic: انا كنت فرحان انه سمح بالارجاع
english: I was happy that he allowed the return.
transliteration: Ana kont farḥān ennoh samaḥ bel ergaa'.

arabic: بعد كده هكمل مشاويري
english: After that, I will continue my errands.
transliteration: Ba3d keda hakammil mashāwīri.

arabic: صحت منى متأخر لانها كانت لسه نايمه وتعبانه من الشغل
english: Mona woke up late because she was still sleeping and tired from work.
transliteration: Sehet Mona meta'akher le'annaha kanet lessa nayma we taabana min el shoghl.

arabic: قامت بسرعه وهي حاسه بالضيق والتوتر من الوقت الضايع
english: She got up quickly, feeling stressed and anxious about the lost time.
transliteration: Aamet besor'a we heya hassa bel deeq wel tawattor min el wa't el daye'.

arabic: كانت بتدور على مفاتيح عربيتها ومش لاقياهم خالص في مكانهم
english: She was looking for her car keys and couldn't find them at all in their place.
transliteration: Kanet betdawwar ala mafateeh arabeyet'ha we mesh la'yayahom khales fi makanhom.

arabic: صرخت انتي شوفتي يا هدير انا كنت سايباهم هنا من شويه صغيرين
english: She shouted, "Hadeer, did you see them? I had just left them here a little while ago."
transliteration: Sarrakhet inti shofti ya Hadeer ana kont saybaho hom hena men shwaya soghayyareen.

arabic: بعد ما لقتهم بالعافيه مسكت تفاحه بسرعه ونزلت تجري عشان متتأخرش اكتر على الشغل
english: After she finally found them, she quickly grabbed an apple and ran down so she wouldn't be even more late for work.
transliteration: Ba'd ma la'et'hom bel 'afya meseket toffaha besor'a we nizelet tegry ashan mateta'khargesh aktar ala el shoghl.

arabic: عيد ميلاد سارة كان النهاردة و البيت كله زحمة صحاب
english: Sara's birthday was today and the whole house was crowded with friends.
transliteration: eid milad Sara kan ennaharda we el bet kollo zahmet sohab

arabic: مريم وصلت متأخر وقالت انا لسه سايقه العربيه عشان اجي البيت
english: Mariam arrived late and said, "I just drove the car to come home."
transliteration: Maryam wasalet meta'akher we 'alet ana lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan agi el bet

arabic: باباها شاف الكيكة وضحك وقال مين ساب الشمع مولع
english: Her dad saw the cake and laughed, saying, "Who left the candles burning?"
transliteration: babaha shaf el keika we dehek we 'al min saab el shama3 mola3

arabic: انتي شوفتي هدير كانت نايمه على الكنبة عشان كانت تعبانه من الشغل
english: Did you see Hadeer? She was sleeping on the couch because she was tired from work.
transliteration: inti shofti Hadeer kanet nayma 3ala el kanaba 3ashan kanet taabana min el shoghl

arabic: بس كلهم كانوا مبسوطين اوي وقعدوا يغنوا ويضحكوا كتير
english: But they were all very happy and kept singing and laughing a lot.
transliteration: bas kollohom kanu mabsooteen awi we 'a3adu yighannu we yidhakku kiteer

arabic: انا في قهوة دلوقتي
english: I am at a cafe now.
transliteration: Ana fi 'ahwa delwa'ty.

arabic: انا عايز قهوة
english: I want coffee.
transliteration: Ana 'aayez 'ahwa.

arabic: انا مستني صاحبي هنا
english: I am waiting for my friend here.
transliteration: Ana mestanni sahbi hena.

arabic: صاحبي مش موجود
english: My friend is not here (present).
transliteration: Sahbi mish mawgoud.

arabic: يا الهي دي مش قهوتي
english: Oh my god, this is not my cafe!
transliteration: Ya ilahi di mish 'ahweti!

arabic: كل يوم الصباح انا بصحى بدري
english: Every day in the morning, I wake up early.
transliteration: Kol yom el sabah ana bas7a badri.

arabic: بعدين بروح المدرسة مع صحابي
english: Then I go to school with my friends.
transliteration: Ba3dein baro7 el madrasa ma3 so7abi.

arabic: في المدرسة بناخد درس جديد
english: At school, we take a new lesson.
transliteration: Fel madrasa benakhod dars gedid.

arabic: انا باكل غدا صغير وبشرب شاي
english: I eat a small lunch and drink tea.
transliteration: Ana bakol ghada soghayyar w bashrab shay.

arabic: بخلص المدرسة وبروح البيت سعيد
english: I finish school and go home happy.
transliteration: Bakhalas el madrasa w baro7 el beit sa3eed.

arabic: العيلة كلها هنا في البيت
english: The whole family is here at home.
transliteration: El 3eila kollaha hena fel beit.

arabic: ماما عاملة اكل كتير وحلو
english: Mom made a lot of nice food.
transliteration: Mama 3amla akl kiteer we helw.

arabic: الكل بيقول اهلا ازيكوا يا اهل
english: Everyone says "hello, how are you, family".
transliteration: El kol bi'ool "ahlan izzayku ya ahl".

arabic: كلنا بناكل من طبق واحد كبير
english: We all eat from one big plate.
transliteration: Kollena benakol men taba2 wahed kibeer.

arabic: بعد الاكل بنشرب شاي مع بعض
english: After the food, we drink tea together.
transliteration: Ba3d el akl, benshrab shay ma3 ba3d.

arabic: أنا مش لاقي الطريق هنا
english: I can't find the way here.
transliteration: Ana mish la'i el taree' hena.

arabic: شفت راجل كبير، قولت عفواً يا عمو
english: I saw an old man, I said "Excuse me, uncle".
transliteration: Shoft ragel kibeer, olt "Afwan ya ammu".

arabic: من فضلك، أنا تايه فين المحطة
english: Please, I'm lost. Where is the station?
transliteration: Min fadlak, ana tayeh. Fein el mahatta?

arabic: الراجل ضحك وقال آه المحطة دي ورا ضهرك
english: The man laughed and said: "Ah, the station is right behind your back!"
transliteration: El ragel dehek w 'al: "Ah, el mahatta di wara dahrak!"

arabic: قولتله شكراً وباي
english: I told him thank you and bye!
transliteration: Oltelo shukran w bye!

arabic: أنا رايحة السوق النهارده عشان أشتري هدوم جديدة
english: I am going to the market today to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Ana rayha is-sou' innaharda 'ashan ashtiri hidum gedida.

arabic: أنتِ منين يا مدام
english: Where are you from, madam?
transliteration: Enti menein ya madam?

arabic: أنا من هنا من القاهرة
english: I am from here, from Cairo.
transliteration: Ana min hena min il-Qahira.

arabic: من فضلكِ ممكن أشوف الفستان ده
english: Please, can I see this dress?
transliteration: Min fadlik, mumkin ashoof il-fustan da?

arabic: آه عجبني جداً شكراً
english: Yes, I like it very much. Thank you.
transliteration: Ah 'agabni geddan shukran.

arabic: كنت ماشية في الشارع وكنت تايهة جداً
english: I was walking in the street and I was very lost.
transliteration: Kont mashya fel share' w kont tayha geddan.

arabic: بصيت حواليا مكنتش عارفة أروح فين وبقيت قلقانة
english: I looked around me, didn't know where to go, and became worried.
transliteration: Basseit hawalaya makontesh 'arfa arouh fein w ba'eet 'ala'ana.

arabic: شفت راجل طيب وقلت له من فضلك يا عمو ممكن تساعدني
english: I saw a kind man and told him, "Please, uncle, can you help me?"
transliteration: Shoft ragel tayeb w oltelo min fadlak ya 'ammu mumkin tesa'edni?

arabic: هو سألني آه يا بنتي أنتِ منين
english: He asked me, "Yes, my daughter? Where are you from?"
