transliteration: Howa sa'alni ah ya benty enti menein?

arabic: قلت له أنا من جنب المحطة شكراً ليك يا عمو
english: I told him, "I am from next to the station. Thank you, uncle."
transliteration: Oltelo ana min gamb el mahatta. Shukran leek ya 'ammu.

arabic: صباح الخير انا تايه ومش عارف انا فين
english: Good morning, I am lost and I don't know where I am.
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ana tayeh w mish aref ana feen

arabic: ممكن لو سمحت تساعدني الاقي السوق
english: Can you please help me find the market?
transliteration: Momken law samaht tsaa'edny ala'y el souq

arabic: الراجل قالي روح يمين وبعدين على طول
english: The man told me 'go right and then straight ahead'.
transliteration: El ragel 'aly rooh yemeen w ba'deen ala tool

arabic: انا رحت شمال ولسه تايه
english: I went left and I am still lost.
transliteration: Ana rooht shemal w lessa tayeh

arabic: شكرا الراجل ده حاول يساعدني بس انا مش بفهم
english: Thank you, this man tried to help me, but I don't understand (directions).
transliteration: Shokran el ragel da hawel ysa'edny bas ana mish bafeham

arabic: انا قاعد في قهوة هنا
english: I am sitting in a café here.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed fi ahwa hena

arabic: فيه بنت صغيرة ماسكة تليفون جديد
english: There is a young girl holding a new phone.
transliteration: Feeh bint soghayara mas'ka telefoon gideed

arabic: و فيه راجل كبير ماسك كتاب قديم
english: And there is an old man holding an old book.
transliteration: Wi feeh ragel kibeer mas'ek ketaab adeem

arabic: هو بيشرب شاي و مش مستني حد
english: He is drinking tea and not waiting for anyone.
transliteration: Howa biyishrab shay w mish mestanni hadd

arabic: الكل قاعد و كل واحد في عالمه
english: Everyone is sitting, and each one is in their world.
transliteration: El kol qa'ed w kol wahed fi 'almo

arabic: العيلة كلها كانت متجمعة علشان تاكل اكلة حلوة اوي
english: The whole family was gathered to eat a very delicious meal.
transliteration: El 3ela kolaha kanet metgamme3a 3alashan takol akla 7elwa awi

arabic: الحمد لله الاكل كان كتير ومختلف وكل الناس مبسوطة
english: Praise be to God, the food was a lot and varied, and everyone was happy.
transliteration: El 7amd lellah el akl kan keteer w mokhtalef w kol el nas mabsoota

arabic: قبل ما ناكل خالتي وصلت متأخرة شوية بس جابت معاها حاجة غريبة
english: Before we ate, my aunt arrived a little late, but she brought something strange with her.
transliteration: 2abl ma nakol khalti weslet met2akhra shwaya bas gabt ma3aha 7aga ghareeba

arabic: كلنا سألنا مين جاب الطبق الغريب ده اللي فعلا شكله مش مألوف خالص
english: We all asked who brought this strange dish that really looked completely unfamiliar.
transliteration: Kollena sa2alna meen gab el taba2 el ghareeb da elli fe3lan shaklo mesh ma2loof khales

arabic: في الآخر بقي اكتشفنا انها عملت طبق كشري تاني بس بالفاكهة مش بالرز
english: In the end, we discovered that she made another koshary dish, but with fruit instead of rice.
transliteration: Fel akher ba2a ektashafna enaha 3amalet taba2 koshary tany bas bel fakha mesh bel rozz

arabic: صحيت بدري اوي قبل ما الشمس تطلع علشان ماما كانت بتجهز الفطار
english: I woke up very early before the sun rose because mom was preparing breakfast.
transliteration: sa7et badri awy 2abl ma el shams tetla3 3alashan mama kanet betgahez el fetar
storyTitle: A Warm Day at Our Home

arabic: في الشغل قابلت صاحبتي وقالتلي إن الشغل فعلا بقى ممتع النهارده
english: At work, I met my friend and she told me that work really became enjoyable today.
transliteration: fel shoghl 2abelt sa7ebty w 2aletly en el shoghl fe3lan ba2a momte3 el naharda
storyTitle: A Warm Day at Our Home

arabic: سألت نفسي مين بيحب اليوم ده زيي حتى لو كان فيه تعب شوية
english: I asked myself, who loves this day like me, even if it had a little tiredness?
transliteration: sa2alt nafsi meen bi7eb el yom da zayyi 7atta law kan feih ta3ab shwaya
storyTitle: A Warm Day at Our Home

arabic: الحمد لله رجعت البيت لقيت أولادي مستنييني ومبسوطين اوي
english: Praise be to God, I returned home and found my children waiting for me and very happy.
transliteration: el 7amd lellah rega3t el beit la2et awlady mestanyini w mabsooteen awy
storyTitle: A Warm Day at Our Home

arabic: يا رب نقضي وقت حلو تاني مع بعض كده كل يوم
english: Oh God, I hope we spend sweet time together again like this every day.
transliteration: ya rab na2ady wa2t 7elw tany ma3 ba3d keda koll yom
storyTitle: A Warm Day at Our Home

arabic: بصحى بدري في شقتي كل يوم
english: I wake up early in my apartment every day.
transliteration: Basha badri fi sha'ti koll yom.

arabic: بعمل قهوة سخنة بسرعة
english: I make hot coffee quickly.
transliteration: Ba'mel ahwa sokhna besor3a.

arabic: ريحة القهوة حلوة و الشارع زحمة
english: The smell of the coffee is nice and the street is crowded.
transliteration: Reehet el ahwa helwa w el shari3 zahma.

arabic: باكل فاكهة بسرعة قبل الشغل
english: I eat fruit quickly before work.
transliteration: Bakol fak-ha besor3a abl el shoghl.

arabic: معنديش وقت كتير دلوقتي
english: I don't have much time now.
transliteration: Ma'andeesh wa't keteer delwa'ti.

arabic: يلا انا وامي رايحين نشتري هدوم جديدة
english: Let's go, my mother and I are going to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Yalla ana w ommy rayheen neshtary hedoum gedeeda.

arabic: امي بتحب الهدوم التقليدية وانا بنحب الموضة اوي
english: My mother loves traditional clothes and I really love fashion.
transliteration: Ommy bethebb el hedoum el taqledeya w ana benhebb el moda awy.

arabic: شوفت فستان جميل بكام سألت امي
english: I saw a beautiful dress, "how much?" I asked my mother.
transliteration: Shouft fostan gameel bekam sa'alt ommy.

arabic: امي قالت ده غالي اوي ومش عملي
english: My mother said "this is very expensive and not practical."
transliteration: Ommy qalet dah ghali awy w mesh amaly.

arabic: في الاخر اتفقنا نشتري تي شيرت واحد بس لكل واحد
english: In the end, we agreed to buy just one t-shirt for each of us.
transliteration: Fil akher ettafa'na neshtary t-shirt wahed bas le kol wahed.

arabic: الاسرة بتقعد في البيت مع بعض.
english: The family sits at home together.
transliteration: El-usra betqaa'd fi el-beit ma' ba'd.

arabic: الاكل جميل اوي.
english: The food is very delicious.
transliteration: El-akl gamil awi.

arabic: اخويا كبير و اختي صغيرة.
english: My brother is big and my sister is small.
transliteration: Akhoya kibiir w okhti saghiira.

arabic: كلنا بنحب نضحك و نتكلم.
english: We all love to laugh and talk.
transliteration: Kullena benhebb nedhak w netkallem.

arabic: ده يوم جميل.
english: This is a beautiful day.
transliteration: Da yoom gamil.

arabic: بعد الضهر الجو فيه مطر كتير
english: In the afternoon, the weather has a lot of rain.
transliteration: Ba'd el dohr el gaww feeh matar keteer

arabic: انا قاعد جوه البيت دلوقتي
english: I am sitting inside the house now.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed gowwa el beit delwa'ty

arabic: شايف المطر بره الشباك
english: I see the rain outside the window.
transliteration: Shayef el matar barra el shobak

arabic: انا عايز اشرب شاي سخن
english: I want to drink hot tea.
transliteration: Ana ayeez ashrab shay sokhn

arabic: ده يوم حلو في البيت
english: This is a nice day at home.
transliteration: Da yom helw fi el beit

arabic: صباح الخير انا رايح السوق النهاردة
english: Good morning, I'm going to the market today.
transliteration: sabah el kheer ana rayeh es-sou' en-naharda

arabic: السوق فيه خضار وفاكهة كتير وحلو
english: The market has many nice vegetables and fruits.
transliteration: es-sou' feeh khodar we fakiha kteer we helw

arabic: انا عايز اشتري طماطم وكمان تفاح
english: I want to buy tomatoes and also apples.
transliteration: ana ayiz eshtary tamatem we kaman toffah

arabic: سالت البياع الطماطم بكام
english: I asked the vendor how much the tomatoes were.
transliteration: sa'alt el bayya' et-tamatem be-kam

arabic: دفعت الفلوس وكان يوم كويس
english: I paid the money, and it was a good day.
transliteration: dafa't el felous we kan yom kwayyes

arabic: النهاردة الأهل كلهم في البيت
english: Today all the family are at home.
transliteration: Ennaharda el ahl kulluhum fi el beit.

arabic: فيه أكل كتير وحلو على السفرة
english: There is a lot of good food on the dining table.
transliteration: Feeh akl keteer we helw ala el sofreh.

arabic: طفل صغير بيشوف سمكة جديدة في طبق
english: A small child sees a new fish in a dish.
transliteration: Tefl saghir beyshoof samaka gideeda fi tabaq.

arabic: الطفل الصغير بيقول أنا عايز أكل السمكة دي
english: The small child says, "I want to eat this fish."
transliteration: El tefl es saghir bey'ool ana ayiz akol es samaka di.

arabic: بس السمكة دي مش للأكل دي سمكة زينة
english: But this fish is not for eating, this is an ornamental fish!
transliteration: Bas es samaka di mesh lel akl, di samaka zeena!

arabic: النهاردة فيه ماتش كورة بين الاهلي والزمالك
english: Today there is a football match between Al Ahly and Al Zamalek.
transliteration: El naharda feh matsh kora bein Al Ahly w Al Zamalek.

arabic: صاحبي قال لي انت هتتفرج على الماتش يا احمد
english: My friend said to me: "Are you going to watch the match, Ahmed?"
transliteration: Sahby qaal li enta hatetfarag 3ala el matsh ya Ahmed?

arabic: انا قلت له اه طبعاً انا هتفرج هو فين الماتش
english: I told him: "Yes, of course I'll watch, where is the match?"
transliteration: Ana oltelo ah tab3an ana hatetfarag howa fen el matsh?

arabic: هو قال الماتش في البيت عندي يلا بينا
english: He said: "The match is at my house, let's go."
transliteration: Howa qaal el matsh fel beit 3andy yalla bina.

arabic: انا قلت له كويس اوي انا جاي دلوقتي
english: I told him: "Very good, I'm coming now."
transliteration: Ana oltelo kwayyes awy ana gay delwaqti.

arabic: بره فيه مطر كتير بس جوه البيت احنا قاعدين
english: Outside there is a lot of rain, but inside the house we are sitting.
transliteration: Barra feih matar kitiir bas gawwa el beit ehna qa3deen.

arabic: الجو دفى وجميل مع عيلتي
english: The atmosphere is warm and beautiful with my family.
transliteration: El gaww dafa w gameel ma3 3eilti.

arabic: بابا بيشرب شاي وماما بتعمل كيك
english: Dad is drinking tea and Mom is making cake.
transliteration: Baba biyishrab shay w mama bita3mel cake.

arabic: كلنا بنتكلم ونضحك بصوت عالي
english: All of us are talking and laughing loudly.
transliteration: Kullina bentkallem w nishhak bi soot 3ali.

arabic: انا سعيد قوي اني في بيتنا دافي
english: I am very happy that I am in our warm home.
transliteration: Ana sa3eed qawi inni fi beitna dafi.

arabic: البنت عايزة فرح كبير
english: The girl wants a big wedding.
transliteration: El bent ayza farah kibeer

arabic: مامتها عايزة فرح صغير
english: Her mother wants a small wedding.
transliteration: Mamatha ayza farah soghayyar

arabic: البنت عايزة اغاني جديدة
english: The girl wants new songs.
transliteration: El bent ayza aghani gedeeda

arabic: بس مامتها عايزة اغاني زمان
english: But her mother wants old songs.
transliteration: Bass mamatha ayza aghani zaman

arabic: هي عايزة اصحابها كلهم يكونوا هنا
english: She wants all her friends to be here.
transliteration: Heya ayza ashabha kolluhum yekoonu hena

arabic: انا عايزة اطبخ اكل جديد النهاردة
english: I want to cook a new dish today.
transliteration: Ana ayza atbokh akl gedid el naharda.
storyTitle: A New Dish and the Old Way

arabic: انا سألت ماما ازاي اطبخ الاكل ده
english: I asked Mom: "How do I cook this dish?"
transliteration: Ana sa'alt mama: ezzay atbokh el akl dah?
storyTitle: A New Dish and the Old Way

arabic: هي قالت اطبخيه بالطريقة القديمة كويس
english: She said: "Cook it the old way, it's good!"
transliteration: Heya 'alet: etbokhieh bel taree'a el adeema, kwayyes!
storyTitle: A New Dish and the Old Way

arabic: لكن انا عايزة اجرب طريقة جديدة
english: But I want to try a new way.
transliteration: Laken ana ayza agarreb taree'a gedida.
storyTitle: A New Dish and the Old Way

arabic: ماما ضحكت وقالت تمام يلا نطبخ سوا
english: Mom laughed and said: "Okay, let's cook together!"
transliteration: Mama deheket w 'alet: tamam, yalla netbokh sawa!
storyTitle: A New Dish and the Old Way

arabic: في يوم كنت ماشي في الشارع
english: One day, I was walking in the street.
transliteration: Fi yoom kont mashi fi el shari'.

arabic: بعدين شفت صديق قديم
english: Then, I saw an old friend.
transliteration: Ba'dein shoft sadeeq adeem.

arabic: سمعت صوته وضحكته كانت حلوة
english: I heard his voice and his laugh was sweet.
transliteration: Seme't soto w daHketo kanet Helwa.

arabic: قلت اهلا ازيك
english: I said, 'Hello! How are you?'
transliteration: Olt ahlan izzayyak.

arabic: يا سلام زمان كتير ما شفتك
english: Wow, it's been a long time since I saw you!
transliteration: Ya salam zaman kiteer ma shoftak.

arabic: الدنيا بتمطر بره دلوقتي
english: It's raining outside now.
transliteration: El donya betmaṭṭar barra delwa'ti.

arabic: البيت دافي وماما وبابا قاعدين
english: The house is warm, and Mom and Dad are sitting.
transliteration: El beit dafi w Mama w Baba 'a'deen.

arabic: أنا فاضي دلوقتي ممكن نعمل حاجة سوا
english: I am free now, maybe we can do something together.
transliteration: Ana fadi delwa'ti momken na'mel haga sawa.

arabic: إيه رأيك نعمل شاي الساعة اربعة
english: What do you think about making tea at 4 o'clock?
transliteration: Eih ra'yak na'mel shay el sa'a arba'a?

arabic: بابا قال فكرة حلوة أوي ونضحك كلنا
english: Dad said 'very good idea' and we all laughed.
transliteration: Baba 'al fekra Helwa 'awi w neDhak kollena.

arabic: يلا يا امي نروح نشتري هدوم جديدة
english: Let's go, my mother, to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Yalla ya ommy nrooh neshtary hedoom gedeeda.
storyTitle: A Shopping Trip with My Mother

arabic: روحنا سوق كبير اوي فيه محلات كتير
english: We went to a very big market with many shops.
transliteration: Rohna soo' kibeer awi feeh mahallat keteer.
storyTitle: A Shopping Trip with My Mother

arabic: امي كانت بتختار حاجات كلاسيك وانا كنت عايزة هدوم شبابي
english: My mother was choosing classic things and I wanted youthful clothes.
transliteration: Ommy kanet betekhtar hagaat classic w ana kont ayza hedoom shababy.
storyTitle: A Shopping Trip with My Mother

arabic: شفت فستان حلو قوي وسألت البائع بكام ده
english: I saw a very beautiful dress and asked the seller, "How much is this?"
transliteration: Shoft fostan helw qawi w sa'alt el baaye' bekam da.
storyTitle: A Shopping Trip with My Mother

arabic: في الاخر بنحب نشتري اللي يعجبنا وروحنا البيت مبسوطين
english: In the end, we love to buy what we like and we went home happy.
transliteration: Fil akher benhebb neshtary elli ye'gebna w rohna el bayt mabsooteen.
storyTitle: A Shopping Trip with My Mother

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد منى وهي مبسوطة اوي
english: Today is Mona's birthday and she is very happy.
transliteration: El-naharda eid milad Mona we hiyya mabsoota awi.

arabic: صحابها جم البيت وقالوا اهلاً بيكي يا منى
english: Her friends came home and said "Welcome, Mona."
transliteration: Sohabha gomu el-beit we aalou ahlan beeki ya Mona.

arabic: منى فرحانة جدا بوجودهم
english: Mona is very happy with their presence.
transliteration: Mona farhana geddan bi-wugoodhom.

arabic: اكلوا تورته وغنوا سوا
english: They ate cake and sang together.
transliteration: Aklou torta we ghannou sawa.

arabic: بعد شوية قالوا مع السلامة وهي كانت مبسوطة
english: After a while, they said goodbye and she was happy.
transliteration: Ba'd shwaya aalou ma'a salama we hiyya kanet mabsoota.

arabic: انا كل يوم باكل فطار بدري بس النهاردة اتفاجئت ان التلاجة مش شغالة
english: Every day I eat breakfast early, but today I was surprised that the fridge wasn't working.
transliteration: Ana koll yom baakul fetar bedri bas enharda etfaga't en el talaga mish shaghala

arabic: زعلت اوي وقلت يا جماعة ايه ده تاني
english: I got very upset and said 'Oh guys, what is this again?'
transliteration: Za'elt awi w olt ya gama'a eh da tany

arabic: فعلا كنت مستغرب مين نسى يوصل الفيشة قبل ما ننام
english: Indeed, I was wondering who forgot to plug in the cord before we slept.
transliteration: Fe3lan kont mestaghreb meen nesy yewassal el feesha abl ma nenam

arabic: كل الاكل اللي كان فيها بقى دافي ومبقاش ينفع
english: All the food that was in it became warm and was no longer good.
transliteration: Kol el akel elly kan feha ba2a dafi we mab2ash yenfa'

arabic: لازم نشوف مين يصلحها دلوقتي ان عايزنا ناكل اكل كويس
english: We must find someone to fix it now if we want to eat good food.
transliteration: Lazim neshuf meen yessala7ha delwa'ty en 3ayezna nakol akel kwayyes

arabic: النهارده يوم ماتش كورة كبير
english: Today is a big football match day.
transliteration: El naharda yom matsh kora kbeer

arabic: احنا دلوقتي بنشوف الماتش مع اصحابي في البيت
english: We are now watching the match with my friends at home.
transliteration: Ehna delwa'ty benshoof el matsh ma'a ashabby fel beit

arabic: ماما بتعمل شاي حلو و اكل خفيف
english: Mom is making good tea and light food.
transliteration: Mama beta'mel shay helw w akl khafeef

arabic: الجمهور بيقول يا رب و يلا اهلي
english: The crowd says "Oh Lord" and "Come on Ahly".
transliteration: El gomhour byo'ol ya rab w yalla Ahly

arabic: احنا كلنا بنحب الكورة في مصر اوي
english: We all love football very much in Egypt.
transliteration: Ehna kollena benhebb el kora fe Masr awi

arabic: النهاردة كان يوم مطر وشتا كتير في بيتي
english: Today was a day of lots of rain and winter at my house.
transliteration: Elnaharda kan yom matar w sheta keteer fi beiti

arabic: في الاول حسيت اني كسلان ومش مبسوط
english: At first, I felt lazy and not happy.
transliteration: Fil awel haseit enni kaslan w mesh mabsoot

arabic: بس لما افتكرت مفيش قهوة في البيت قلت انا هشتري قهوة من اوبر ايتس
english: But when I remembered there was no coffee at home, I said I would buy coffee from Uber Eats.
transliteration: Bas lama eftakart mafish ahwa fil beit olt ana hashtary ahwa men Uber Eats

arabic: بعد ما طلبت القهوة أنا حسيت إني مبسوط وقررت أعمل أكل
english: After I ordered the coffee, I felt happy and decided to cook.
transliteration: Ba'd ma talabt el'ahwa ana haseit enni mabsoot w qarrart a'amel akl

arabic: لما بكون مبسوط بكلم أصحابي وبحكي لهم عن يومي
english: When I am happy, I talk to my friends and tell them about my day.
transliteration: Lama bakoon mabsoot bakallem ashabi w bahki lahom 'an yoomi

arabic: انا مسكت التليفون
english: I held the phone.
transliteration: Ana masakt el-telefoon.

arabic: كلمت صاحبي
english: I called my friend.
transliteration: Kallamt sahby.

arabic: قلت له ازيك عامل ايه
english: I said to him 'How are you doing?'
transliteration: Oltelo ezzayak amel eh?

arabic: هو رد انا كويس الحمد لله
english: He replied, 'I am good, thank God.'
transliteration: Howwa radd ana kwayyes el-hamdu lellah.

arabic: صحيح مين معايا انت مش صاحبي
english: Actually, who is with me? You are not my friend!
transliteration: Saheeh meen ma'aya? Enta mesh sahby!

arabic: احمد طفل صغير بيسال كتير
english: Ahmed is a small child who asks a lot.
transliteration: Ahmed ṭefl ṣoghayar byes'al ketīr.

arabic: على العشا شاف سمك و رز و خضار
english: At dinner, he saw fish, rice, and vegetables.
transliteration: ʕala l-ʕasha shāf samak w rozz w khoḍaar.

arabic: قال لمامته ايه ده
english: He asked his mom, "What is this?"
transliteration: ʾāl le-māmtu eeh da?

arabic: و ده حلو ولا مش حلو
english: And is this good or not good?
transliteration: w da ḥelw walla mush ḥelw?

arabic: مامته ضحكت وقالت انت بتسال كتير اوي يا احمد
english: His mom laughed and said, "You ask too much, Ahmed."
transliteration: māmtu ḍeḥket w ʾālet enta betes'al ketīr ʾawi ya Ahmed.

arabic: الام شافت المطبخ مش نضيف قوي
english: Mom saw the kitchen wasn't very clean.
transliteration: El-omm shafet el-matbakh mesh nideef qawi.

arabic: قالت يا اولادي مين هيساعدني
english: She said, "Oh my children, who will help me?"
transliteration: Qalet ya awladi meen hayesa'edni?

arabic: كريم قال انا عايز اساعدك يا ماما
english: Karim said, "I want to help you, Mom."
transliteration: Karim qal ana ayiz asa'edik ya mama.

arabic: اخته الصغيرة ليلى قالت انا كمان عايزة اساعد
english: His little sister Layla said, "I also want to help."
transliteration: Okhto el-soghayyara Layla qalet ana kaman ayza asa'ed.

arabic: دلوقتي كل البيت نضيف والاسرة مبسوطة مع بعض
english: Now the whole house is clean and the family is happy together.
transliteration: Delwa'ty koll el-beit nideef wel-osra mabsoota ma' ba'd.

arabic: صباح الخير انا بجهز نفسي للشغل
english: Good morning, I prepare myself for work.
transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer ana baġahhez nafsi lesh-shoġl

arabic: بعدين بعمل قهوة و بلبس هدومي
english: Then I make coffee and get dressed.
transliteration: Ba'deen ba'mel 'ahwa w balbes hudoomi

arabic: في الشغل بقول السلام عليكم لعامل النظافة
english: At work, I say hello to the cleaner.
transliteration: Fesh-shoġl ba'ool as-salamu alaykum le-3āmil naẓāfa

arabic: بسأله ازيك هو بيرد بخير
english: I ask him "How are you?", he replies "Good."
transliteration: Bas'alo izzayyak howwa biyrodd bi-kheer

arabic: بعد الشغل بقول مع السلامة للكل
english: After work, I say goodbye to everyone.
transliteration: Ba'd esh-shoġl ba'ool ma'a salama lel-koll

arabic: امي قالت لي يلا نروح السوق عشان نشتري فاكهة وخضار
english: My mother told me, 'Let's go to the market to buy fruit and vegetables.'
transliteration: Ommy aletly yalla nrooh el soo' ashan neshtary fakha we khodaar

arabic: المكان كان زحمة قوي والسوق كبير وضعت
english: The place was very crowded and the market was big, and I got lost.
transliteration: El makan kan zahma awy wel soo' kibeer we do't

arabic: شفت راجل كبير محترم وقولتله بعد اذنك يا عمو
english: I saw a respectable older man and said to him, 'Excuse me, uncle.'
transliteration: Shoft ragel kibeer mohtaram we oltello ba'd eznek ya 'ammo

arabic: ممكن تقول لي ازاي اروح لبيتي من هنا
english: Can you tell me how to get to my house from here?
transliteration: Momken te'oolly ezzay arooh le-beity men hena

arabic: ابتسم الراجل وقالي متقلقش هتوصل بالسلامة امشي طوالي
english: The man smiled and told me, 'Don't worry, you'll arrive safely, walk straight.'
transliteration: Ebtasam el ragel we aly mata'la'sh hatowsal bel salama emshy tawaly

arabic: انا عايز اسافر في الويك اند
english: I want to travel on the weekend.
transliteration: Ana aayez asafer fel week end

arabic: دي فكرة جميلة انا مبسوط
english: This is a beautiful idea. I am happy.
transliteration: Di fekra gameela ana mabsut

arabic: احنا ممكن نروح اسكندرية
english: We can go to Alexandria.
transliteration: Ehna momken naruh Eskandareya

arabic: ده هيكون يوم حلو اوي
english: This will be a very nice day.
transliteration: Dah haykoon yom helw awy

arabic: يلا بينا نحضر الشنط دلوقتي
english: Let's prepare the bags now.
transliteration: Yalla bena nahaddar el shonnat delwa'ty

arabic: اليوم فيه مطر كتير
english: Today there is a lot of rain.
transliteration: El yoom fee matar keteer.

arabic: انا في البيت دلوقتي
english: I am at home now.
transliteration: Ana fel beit delwa'ty.

arabic: المطر على الشباك عامل صوت كبير
english: The rain on the window is making a big sound.
transliteration: El matar 'ala el shobbaak 'amel soot kabeer.

arabic: انا عايز اشرب شاي سخن
english: I want to drink hot tea.
transliteration: Ana aayez ashrab shay sokhn.

arabic: مفيش شمس اليوم بس فيه ضحك كتير
english: There is no sun today, but there is a lot of laughter!
transliteration: Mafeesh shams el yoom bas fee dehk keteer!

arabic: انا لسه سايقه العربيه عشان اجي البيت والمطره بدأت تنزل بغزاره
english: I just drove the car to come home and the rain started falling heavily.
transliteration: ana lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan agi el bet wel matara badat tenzel be ghazara

arabic: صوت المطره على الشباك كان مريح وهوا ساقع دخل من البلكونه المفتوحه
english: The sound of the rain on the window was relaxing, and cold air came in from the open balcony.
transliteration: sot el matara ala el shobak kan moryeh we hawa saqea dakhal men el balkona el maftouha

arabic: انا كنت لسه نايمه من ساعتين عشان كنت تعبانه اوي من الشغل وحسيت ان اليوم طويل
english: I had just slept two hours ago because I was very tired from work, and I felt that the day was long.
transliteration: ana kont lessa nayma men saatein ashan kont taabana awi men el shoghl we hasset en el yom tawil

arabic: فقلت اعمل شاي سخن واقعد اتفرج على فيلم جديد على نيتفليكس
english: So I decided to make hot tea and sit and watch a new movie on Netflix.
transliteration: fa olt aamel shay sokhn w aod atfarag ala film gedid ala netflix

arabic: الجو ده بيخليني احس بالدفى وانا قاعده في البيت ومش عايزه اخرج خالص
english: This weather makes me feel warm while I'm at home and don't want to go out at all.
transliteration: el gaw da beykhallini ahess bel dafa wana aada fi el bet w mesh ayza akhrog khales

arabic: احنا بنخطط لآخر الاسبوع
english: We are planning for the weekend.
transliteration: Ehna benkhattat li akher el esbou3.

arabic: فين هنروح مع العيلة
english: Where will we go with the family?
transliteration: Fen hanrooh ma3 el 3eila?

arabic: ماما قالت يلا نروح مكان حلو
english: Mom said: Let's go to a nice place.
transliteration: Mama aalet: Yalla nrooh makan helw.

arabic: احنا عايزين الجو يبقى جميل
english: We want the atmosphere to be beautiful.
transliteration: Ehna 3ayzeen el gaww yeb'a gameel.

arabic: هيكون وقت حلو اوي لينا
english: It will be a very nice time for us.
transliteration: Haykoon waqt helw awi leena.

arabic: اليوم انا رايحة اشتري هدوم جديدة
english: Today I'm going to buy new clothes.
transliteration: El-yoom ana rayḥa eshtery hedoom gedeeda.

arabic: دخلت المحل والست قالت لي اهلا بيكي
english: I entered the shop and the lady said to me, "Welcome".
transliteration: Dakhalet el-maḥall wel-sett qalet-li ahlan beeki.

arabic: انا دورت على فستان حلو ولقيته
english: I looked for a nice dress and found it.
transliteration: Ana dawwart 'ala fostan ḥelw we-leqetoh.

arabic: دفعت الفلوس وانا مبسوطة جداً
english: I paid the money and I was very happy.
transliteration: Defa't el-felous w-ana mabsooṭa giddan.

arabic: قلت لها مع السلامة ومشيت
english: I said "Goodbye" to her and left.
transliteration: Qolt laha ma'a salama w-mesheet.

arabic: امي طلبت مني ارجع خضار للمحل
english: My mother asked me to return vegetables to the shop.
transliteration: Ommy talabit menni aragga' khodaar lel mahal

arabic: الخضار ماكانش طازة عشان كدة قالتلي اغيره
english: The vegetables were not fresh, so she told me to change them.
transliteration: El khodaar makanesh taaza ashan keda alatli aghayyaro

arabic: انا رحت المحل الكبير اللي جنب بيتنا
english: I went to the big shop next to our house.
transliteration: Ana roht el mahal el kibeer elli gamb baytna

arabic: صاحب المحل كان طيب جدا وقالي مفيش مشكلة واداني غيره
english: The shop owner was very kind and told me "no problem", and gave me new ones.
transliteration: Saheb el mahal kan tayeb geddan we ali mafish moshkela we eddani gheero

arabic: احنا بنحب نشتري خضارنا دايما من المحل ده
english: We always like to buy our vegetables from this shop.
transliteration: Ehna benhebb neshtary khodaarna dayman men el mahal dah

arabic: كان فيه ولد صغير اسمه كريم عينه لونها اخضر
english: There was a small boy named Karim, his eyes are green.
transliteration: Kan fe walad soghayyar esmo Karim 'eino loonha akhdar

arabic: هو بيسال كل يوم ايه ده وفين ده
english: He asks every day "What is this?" and "Where is this?".
transliteration: Howa byes'al kol yom eih da w feen da

arabic: صوته بيبقى عالي لما يشوف فاكهة حمرا او اكل حلو
english: His voice gets loud when he sees red fruit or sweet food.
transliteration: Soto byeb'a 'aali lamma yeshoof fakha hamra aw akl helw

arabic: ماما بتقوله مش كل حاجة ليها اجابة دلوقتي يا حبيبي
english: Mom tells him "Not everything has an answer right now, my dear".
transliteration: Mama bet'oloh mesh kol haga leeha egaba delwa'ty ya habibi

arabic: اسئلة كريم الصغير مالهاش نهاية
english: Little Karim's questions have no end.
transliteration: As'elet Karim el soghayyar malhash nehaya

arabic: يا ماما سألت جنى كتير اوي طول الطريق للبيت
english: Oh Mama, Jana asked so many questions all the way home.
transliteration: Ya mama sa'alet Jana keteer awi tool el tareeq lel beit

arabic: ماما كانت لسه سايقه العربيه عشان تيجي البيت وكانت تعبانه
english: Mama had just driven the car to come home and was tired.
transliteration: Mama kanet lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan teegy el beit w kanet ta'bana

arabic: هي لسه سألت احنا لسه سايبين البيت ليه يا ماما وانتي شوفتي صاحبتي هدير فين
english: She still asked, 'Why did we just leave the house, Mama?' and 'Where did you see my friend Hadeer?'
transliteration: Heya lessa sa'alet 'ehna lessa saybeen el beit leh ya mama?' w 'enty shofty sahbeti Hadeer fein?'

arabic: ماما حست انها عايزة تنام عشان كانت تعبانه اوي من الشغل طول اليوم
english: Mama felt like she wanted to sleep because she was very tired from work all day.
transliteration: Mama hasset ennaha ayza tnam ashan kanet ta'bana awi men el shoghl tool el youm

arabic: لكنها ابتسمت بحب وردت على كل اسئلة بنتها الصغيرة بفرحه
english: But she smiled lovingly and answered all her little daughter's questions with joy.
transliteration: Lakenaha ebtasamet be hob w raddet ala kol as'elet bentaha es sagheera be farha

arabic: صباح الخير يا سارة ازيك
english: Good morning Sarah how are you
transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer ya Sara izzayyik

arabic: انا كويسة الحمد لله
english: I am good alhamdulillah
transliteration: Ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah

arabic: يلا بينا نخطط لرحلة الويك اند
english: Let's plan the weekend trip
transliteration: Yalla bena nakhattat le-rehlet el-weekend

arabic: انا هجهز شنطتي الصبح بدري
english: I will prepare my bag early in the morning
transliteration: Ana hagahhez shantaty es-sobḥ badry

arabic: وانت هتجيب الاكل والشرب من السوق
english: And you will get the food and drinks from the market
transliteration: W-enta hategib el-akl w-esh-shorb men es-sou'

arabic: سارة قابلت أحمد الصبح وقالت له صباح الخير يا أحمد إزيك أنا كويسة الحمد لله
english: Sara met Ahmed in the morning and told him: Good morning Ahmed, how are you? I'm good, praise be to God.
transliteration: Sara qablet Ahmed el-sobh we qalet lo sabah el-kheer ya Ahmed izzayyak ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah.

arabic: أحمد رد عليها أهلاً بيكي أنا كويس الحمد لله وهتعملي إيه النهاردة
english: Ahmed replied to her: Welcome to you, I'm good, praise be to God. What will you do today?
transliteration: Ahmed radd alaiha ahlan beeki ana kwayyes alhamdulillah we hatamali eh el-naharda.

arabic: سارة قالت أنا هروق الشقة وأجهز الغدا بدري عشان عندي مشوار مهم
english: Sara said: I will tidy the apartment and prepare lunch early because I have an important errand.
transliteration: Sara qalet ana ha-rawwaq el-shaqqa w aghahhez el-ghada badri ashan andi meshwar mohem.

arabic: أحمد قال اهلاً وسهلا أنا كمان لازم أنزل السوق أجيب طلبات البيت بسرعة
english: Ahmed said: Welcome! I also need to go down to the market to get groceries quickly.
transliteration: Ahmed qaal ahlan wa sahlan ana kaman lazem anazzel el-soo' ageeb talabat el-beit be sor'a.

arabic: وبعدين قالوا لبعض مع السلامة الله يسلمك
english: And then they said to each other: Goodbye, may God keep you safe.
transliteration: W ba'dein aaloo le ba'd ma'a salama allah yisallimak.

arabic: النهاردة انا جعان وعايز اعمل اكل جديد في بيتي
english: Today I am hungry and I want to make new food in my house.
transliteration: Elnaharda ana gaaan we ayiz a'amel akl gedid fi beiti.

arabic: فتحت تليفوني عشان اشوف وصفة كشري سهل
english: I opened my phone to see an easy Koshary recipe.
transliteration: Fataht telefooni ashan ashoof wasfet koshary sahl.

arabic: لما كنت بعمل الاكل كنت مبسوط قوي عشان اول مرة اعمله
english: When I was cooking the food, I was very happy because it was my first time making it.
transliteration: Lama kont ba'amel elakl kont mabsoot awy ashan awel marra a'amelo.

arabic: ريحة الاكل كانت مالية البيت كله وجيراني شموا الريحة الجميلة
english: The smell of the food filled the whole house and my neighbors smelled the beautiful scent.
transliteration: Rihet elakl kanet malya elbeit kollo we geerani shammo elreeha elgameela.

arabic: لما خلصت انا كنت مبسوط جدا والطعم كان تحفة
english: When I finished, I was very happy and the taste was amazing.
transliteration: Lama khallasht ana kont mabsoot giddan welta'm kan tohfa.

arabic: مفيش قهوة في بيتي الصبح النهاردة وده عامل لي صداع
english: There's no coffee in my house this morning and that's giving me a headache
transliteration: Mafish ahwa fi beiti el sobh el naharda we dah aamel li sodaa
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: أنا جعان ومش عايز أطلب أكل فأنا قررت أنزل السوق اللي جنب البيت
english: I'm hungry and don't want to order food, so I decided to go down to the market next to the house
transliteration: Ana gaaan we mesh ayz atlob akl fa ana qarart anzel el sooq elli gamb el beit
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: لما بكون في السوق بكون مبسوط اوي عشان بشوف ناس كتير وبشتري حاجات حلوة
english: When I'm at the market, I'm very happy because I see many people and buy nice things
transliteration: Lama bakoon fil sooq bakoon mabsoot awi ashan bashoof nas kteer we bashtry hagaty helwa
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: شفت ست بتبيع خضار كتير وقالتلي يا بنتي انتي هتطبخي كل ده لوحدك وضحكت
english: I saw a woman selling many vegetables and she told me "My daughter, will you cook all this by yourself?" and laughed
transliteration: Shoft sett betebia khodar kteer we qaletli Ya benti enti hatetbokhi kol dah lewahdek we dehekt
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: أنا مبسوطة عشان اشتريت قهوة وخضار كتير وهعمل أحلى أكل في بيتي
english: I am happy because I bought coffee and lots of vegetables and I will make the best food in my house
transliteration: Ana mabsoota ashan eshtareet ahwa we khodar kteer we haamel ahla akl fi beiti
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: الجو حر اوي النهاردة والمروحة بتاعتنا مكسورة
english: The weather is very hot today and our fan is broken.
transliteration: El gaww harr awi el naharda wel marwaha beta'tna maksoora.

arabic: عايز اكلم الكهربائي ييجي يصلحها بس هو مش فاضي دلوقتي
english: I want to call the electrician to come fix it, but he's not free now.
transliteration: Ayz akallim el kahraba'i yigi yisallahha bass howa mish fadi dilwa'ti.

arabic: فكرت يمكن الاقي حل بنفسي بالليل
english: I thought maybe I could find a solution myself at night.
transliteration: Fakkart yumkin ala'i hall binafsi balleel.

arabic: قمت جبت حتة بصل وحاولت اركبها في المروحة يمكن تشتغل
english: I went and got a piece of onion and tried to install it in the fan, maybe it would work.
transliteration: Omt gibt hettet basal we hawilt arkab-ha fil marwaha yumkin tishtaghal.

arabic: طبعا مروحة البصل ما اشتغلتش خالص والدنيا بقت حر اكتر
english: Of course, the onion fan didn't work at all, and it got even hotter!
transliteration: Tab'an marwahet el basal ma ishtaghaltish khales wel donya ba'et harr aktar!

arabic: ماما قالت يلا بينا نشتري هدوم جديدة
english: Mama said "Let's go buy new clothes!"
transliteration: Mama 'alet yalla beena nishtiri hedoom gedeeda
storyTitle: A Fun Shopping Day with Family

arabic: روحنا محل كبير اوي وماما شافت فستان جميل
english: We went to a very big store and Mama saw a beautiful dress.
transliteration: Roohna maḥall kibeer awi w Mama shafit fostan gameel
storyTitle: A Fun Shopping Day with Family

arabic: قابلنا سارة بنت خالتي هناك وسألتها ازيك يا سارة
english: We met my cousin Sara there, and I asked her "How are you, Sara?"
transliteration: 'Abilna Sara bint khalti henak w sa'altaha "Izzayyik ya Sara?"
storyTitle: A Fun Shopping Day with Family

arabic: سارة ردت انا كويسة الحمد لله اهلا بيكي
english: Sara replied: "I'm good, alhamdulillah! Welcome to you!"
transliteration: Sara raddit: "Ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah! Ahlan beeki!"
storyTitle: A Fun Shopping Day with Family

arabic: اشترينا هدوم حلوة اوي وقلنا مع السلامة ورجعنا البيت مبسوطين
english: We bought very nice clothes and said "Goodbye" and returned home happy.
transliteration: Ishtarina hedoom ḥelwa awi w 'olna "Ma'a salama" w rega'na el-beet mabsooteen
storyTitle: A Fun Shopping Day with Family

arabic: صباح الخير يا احمد ازيك
english: Good morning Ahmed, how are you?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheer ya Ahmed, izzayyak?

arabic: انا كويس الحمد لله اهلا بيكي يا سارة
english: I'm good, alhamdulillah. Welcome to you, Sara.
transliteration: Ana kwayyes, el-hamdu lillah. Ahlan beeki ya Sara.

arabic: رايح فين يا احمد
english: Where are you going, Ahmed?
transliteration: Rayeh fein ya Ahmed?

arabic: رايح اجيب طلبات للبيت
english: I'm going to get groceries for the house.
transliteration: Rayeh ageeb talabat lel-beet.

arabic: طيب مع السلامة الله يسلمك
english: Okay, goodbye. May God keep you safe.
transliteration: Tayyeb, ma'a salama. Allah yisallimak.

arabic: امي قالت يلا نروح سوق كبير عشان نشتري فاكهة
english: My mother said, 'Let's go to a big market to buy fruit'.
transliteration: Ommy alet yalla nrooh soo' kibeer 'ashan neshtary fakha.

arabic: بس انا مشيت لوحدي و فجأة لقيت نفسي تاهت
english: But I walked alone and suddenly found myself lost.
transliteration: Bas ana mesheet lewahdy w faga'a la'eet nafsi tahet.

arabic: قلبي كان بيدق بسرعة و كنت خايفة ارجع البيت ازاي
english: My heart was beating fast and I was afraid how I would return home.
transliteration: Alby kan bydo' be-sor'a w kont khayfa arga' el bayt ezayy.

arabic: شفت راجل طيب و سألته لو سمحت ممكن تقول لي فين السوق
english: I saw a kind man and asked him, 'Excuse me, could you tell me where the market is?'
transliteration: Shoft ragel tayeb w sa'alto law samaht momken ta'oolly fein el soo'.

arabic: هو وراني الطريق و عرفت ارجع اشتري الفاكهة اللي بنحبها
english: He showed me the way and I was able to go back to buy the fruit we love.
transliteration: Howwa warrany el taree' w 'areft arga' eshtary el fakha elli benhebbaha.

arabic: انا لسه سايقه العربية عشان اجي عند خالتي سارة انهارده
english: I just drove the car to come to my Aunt Sarah's today.
transliteration: ana lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan agi aand khalti Sara ennaharda

arabic: كنت جايبه معايا تفاح و مانجة من السوق ليها
english: I had brought apples and mangoes from the market for her.
transliteration: kont gayba ma'aya toffah w manga men es souq leha

arabic: لما دخلت قلتلها ازيك يا خالتي انتي شوفتي هدير بنت خالتي
english: When I entered I said to her "How are you Auntie did you see Hadeer my cousin?"
transliteration: lamma dakhalet oltelha izzayek ya khalti inti shofti Hadeer bent khalti

arabic: ردت وقالتلي لسه سايباها نايمة في اوضتها عشان كانت تعبانة
english: She replied and told me "I just left her sleeping in her room because she was tired."
transliteration: raddet we qaletli lessa saybaha nayma fi odet'ha ashan kanet taabana

arabic: قعدت اتكلمت معاها شوية قبل ما امشي و اسيبها ترتاح
english: I sat and talked with her for a bit before I left and let her rest.
transliteration: qa'adt etkallemt ma'aha showaya qabl ma amshi w asibha tertah

arabic: صباح الخير انا صحيت
english: Good morning, I woke up.
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ana saheet.

arabic: عايز اشرب قهوة سريع قبل الشغل
english: I want to drink coffee quickly before work.
transliteration: Ayiz ashrab ahwa saree' qabl el shoghl.

arabic: يلا انا رايح الشغل دلوقتي
english: Come on, I'm going to work now.
transliteration: Yalla ana rayeh el shoghl dilwa'ti.

arabic: فيه شغل كتير اليوم ده
english: There is a lot of work today.
transliteration: Feeh shoghl keteer el yom dah.

arabic: معلش مفيش شغل النهاردة
english: Oops, there is no work today!
transliteration: Ma'lesh, mafeesh shoghl el naharda!

arabic: انا تايه في الشارع ده
english: I am lost on this street.
transliteration: Ana tayeh fe el-shaare' da.
storyTitle: I Got Lost and Asked for Directions

arabic: فين محطة المترو من فضلك
english: Where is the metro station, please?
transliteration: Feen ma7attet el-metro men fadlak?
storyTitle: I Got Lost and Asked for Directions

arabic: سألت راجل كبير لو سمحت
english: I asked an old man: "Excuse me!"
transliteration: Sa'alt ragel kebeer: "Law sama7t!"
storyTitle: I Got Lost and Asked for Directions

arabic: هو قال لي امشي طوالي وبعدين يمين
english: He told me to walk straight and then right.
transliteration: Howwa 'al li emshi tawali w ba'deen yemeen.
storyTitle: I Got Lost and Asked for Directions

arabic: شكرا جدا انا فهمت الطريق
english: Thank you very much, I understood the way.
transliteration: Shokran geddan ana fehemt el-taree'.
storyTitle: I Got Lost and Asked for Directions

arabic: صحيت متأخر النهاردة
english: I woke up late today.
transliteration: Saheet met'akhkhar ennaharda.

arabic: انا عايز اروح الشغل بسرعة
english: I want to go to work quickly.
transliteration: Ana ayiz arooh esh-shoghl besor'a.

arabic: فين القهوة بتاعتي
english: Where is my coffee?
transliteration: Feen el ahwa bita'ti?

arabic: مش لاقيها هنا
english: I don't find it here.
transliteration: Mesh la'eeha hena.

arabic: يلا بينا نروح الشغل من غير قهوة
english: Let's go to work without coffee!
transliteration: Yalla bina nrooh esh-shoghl men gheir ahwa!

arabic: الو ازيك يا صاحبتي
english: Hello, how are you, my friend?
transliteration: Allo ezzayek ya sahbeti

arabic: انا كويسة الحمد لله ماما وبابا بخير
english: I am good, thank God. Mom and Dad are well.
transliteration: Ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah mama w baba bekhair

arabic: عايزة تيجي البيت بكرة يا حبيبتي
english: Do you want to come to the house tomorrow, my dear?
transliteration: Aayza teegi el beit bokra ya habibti

arabic: اه دلوقتي انا مش فاضية بس ممكن اجي بعدين
english: Yes, now I am not free, but I can come later.
transliteration: Ah delwa'ti ana mesh fadya bas momken agi ba'dein

arabic: اوكيه اشوفك قريب مع السلامة
english: Okay, I'll see you soon. Goodbye.
transliteration: Okay ashoofek orayeb ma'a el salama

arabic: انا رحت بيت تيتا امبارح
english: I went to Tita's house yesterday.
transliteration: Ana roht beit Tita embareh.

arabic: تيتا كبيرة في السن وانا صغير
english: Tita is old in age and I am young.
transliteration: Tita kebira fel sinn wana saghir.

arabic: هي كانت عايزة تشرب شاي وانا كنت عايز العب بالتليفون
english: She wanted to drink tea and I wanted to play with the phone.
transliteration: Heya kanet ayza teshrob shay wana kont ayz al'ab bel telephon.

arabic: تيتا بتتكلم عن زمان وانا بتكلم عن دلوقتي
english: Tita talks about the past and I talk about now.
transliteration: Tita betetkallem 'an zaman wana betkallem 'an delwa'ti.

arabic: الزيارة كانت حلوة بس فيه فرق كبير
english: The visit was nice but there is a big difference.
transliteration: El ziyara kanet helwa bas fi'h far' kibeer.

arabic: اوضتي النهارده مبهدلة خالص
english: My room is very messy today.
transliteration: ʔoɖti in-nahárda mitbahdila ẖáliṣ

arabic: انا قررت اني لازم ابدأ انظمها
english: I decided that I must begin to organize it.
transliteration: ána ʔarrárt ínni lázim ábdaʔ únazzimha

arabic: ماما امرتني اخلص قبل العشا
english: Mom ordered me to finish before dinner.
transliteration: máma ʔamáritni áẖlaṣ ʔabl il-ʕaša

arabic: حاجة غريبة حصلت مع لعبتي القديمة
english: A strange thing happened with my old toys.
transliteration: ḥága ɣaríba ḥáṣalit maʕ luʕabti il-ʔadíma

arabic: لازم الاقي حل كويس عشان انظم كل حاجة بسرعة
english: I must find a good solution to organize everything quickly.
transliteration: lázim aláʔi ḥall kúwayyis ʕašán únazzam kull ḥága bi-súrʕa

arabic: صباح الخير يا استاذة ايمان فيه ايه مالك شكلك مش تمام كدة النهاردة
english: Good morning, Mrs. Iman, what's wrong? You don't look okay today.
transliteration: Sabah el kheir ya ostaza Iman, fee eh malek shaklek mesh tamam kida el naharda?

arabic: صباح النور يا مدام سارة معلش عندي مشوار مهم ومحدش فاضي يوصلني
english: Good morning, Mrs. Sara, sorry, I have an important errand and no one is free to drive me.
transliteration: Sabah el noor ya madam Sara, ma'lesh 'andy meshwar mohem we mahaddesh fady yewassalny.

arabic: بجد طب ما تقولي كنت ممكن اجي معاكي دلوقتي
english: Really? Why didn't you say! I could have come with you now.
transliteration: Begad? Tab ma te'ouly! Kont mumkin agy ma'aki delwa'ti.

arabic: يا بختي بيكي والله متشكرة جدا يا جارتي
english: How lucky I am to have you, really! Thank you very much, my neighbor.
transliteration: Ya bakhty beeki wallahy! Motashakkerah geddan ya garaty.

arabic: مفيش اي شكر يلا بينا نخلص المشوار بسرعة
english: No need for thanks, let's go finish the errand quickly.
transliteration: Mafeesh ay shokr, yalla bina nekhalas el meshwar be sor'a.

arabic: انا ماشي في شارع كبير دلوقتي
english: I am walking in a big street now.
transliteration: Ana mashi fi share' kebir dilwa'ti.

arabic: انا مش عارف فين بيت صاحبي
english: I don't know where my friend's house is.
transliteration: Ana mish 'aref feen beit sahby.

arabic: انا شفت راجل كبير وقلت صباح الخير يا عمو
english: I saw an old man and said: Good morning, uncle.
transliteration: Ana shoft ragel kebir w olt: sabah el kher ya 'ammu.

arabic: من فضلك انا عايز اروح بيت صاحبي
english: Please, I want to go to my friend's house.
transliteration: Min fadlak, ana 'ayez arooh beit sahby.

arabic: هو قال امشي على طول وبعدين يمين انا قلت شكرا جزيلا
english: He said: Walk straight ahead then right. I said: Thank you very much.
transliteration: Howa 'al: emshi 'ala tool w ba'dein yemin. Ana olt: shokran gazilan.

arabic: أنا كنت ماشي في الشارع ولقيت نفسي تايه خالص
english: I was walking in the street and found myself completely lost.
transliteration: Ana kont mashi fel share' w la'eit nafsi tayeh khales.

arabic: بصيت حواليا وقولت يا ترى فين البيت
english: I looked around and said, 'I wonder where the house is?'
transliteration: Basseit hawaleiyya w olt ya tara fein el beit?

arabic: شفت راجل كبير وقولت له صباح الخير يا عمو ازيك
english: I saw an old man and said to him, 'Good morning uncle, how are you?'
transliteration: Shoft ragel kabeer w olt lo sabah el kheer ya 'ammu izzayyak.

arabic: رد علي وقالي أنا كويس الحمد لله عايز إيه يا حبيبي
english: He replied to me and said, 'I'm good, alhamdulillah, what do you want my dear?'
transliteration: Radd 'alayya w 'aly ana kwayyes alhamdulillah 'ayez eh ya habibi.

arabic: شكرته وسألته عن الطريق وبعدها مع السلامة الله يسلمك
english: I thanked him and asked him about the way, and then goodbye, may God keep you safe.
transliteration: Shakarto w sa'alto 'an el tareeq w ba'daha ma'a salama allah yisallimak.

arabic: الصبح بدري قررت اروح السوق اللي كان زحمة قوي كالعادة
english: Early in the morning, I decided to go to the market, which was very crowded as usual.
transliteration: El-sobh badri, qarrart arouh el-souq elly kan zahma qawi kal-3ada.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Egyptian Market

arabic: كنت عايزة اشتري طماطم وفاكهة فريش عشان نعمل سلطة حلوة
english: I wanted to buy fresh tomatoes and fruit to make a nice salad.
transliteration: Kunt ayza ashtary tamatem we fakha fresh 3ashan ne3mel salata helwa.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Egyptian Market

arabic: البياع قالي الكيلو غالي حبتين قلتله يا عم خف شوية على الفلوس
english: The seller told me the kilo was a bit expensive, I told him, "Hey uncle, go easy on the money a bit."
transliteration: El-bayya3 qaly el-kilo ghaly habbetayn, qultelo ya 3amm khaff shwaya 3ala el-felous.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Egyptian Market

arabic: هو ضحك وقالي الفاكهة دي لازم تكون غالية عشان طعمها جنان
english: He laughed and told me this fruit must be expensive because its taste is amazing.
transliteration: Howa dehek we qaly el-fakha di lazem takun ghaliya 3ashan ta3maha genan.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Egyptian Market

arabic: في الآخر اشتريت نص كيلو بس وضحكت وقلت مفيش فلوس كتير يا بياع
english: In the end, I only bought half a kilo and laughed, saying, "There isn't much money, seller!"
transliteration: Fel akher eshtarayt noss kilo bass we dehekt we qult mafeesh felous keteer ya bayya3.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Egyptian Market

arabic: العيلة كلها في البيت النهاردة لغدا كبير
english: The whole family is at home today for a big lunch.
transliteration: El-`ayla kolleha fel-bet el-naharda le-ghada kbeer.

arabic: ماما عملت فراخ ورز سخن
english: Mom made hot chicken and rice.
transliteration: Mama `amalet fraakh we rozz sokhn.

arabic: ريحة الاكل حلوة اوي
english: The smell of the food is very good.
transliteration: Reehet el-akl helwa awi.

arabic: الكل بياكل كتير وبيشرب عصير وميّة باردة
english: Everyone eats a lot and drinks juice and cold water.
transliteration: El-kol beyakel keteer we beyeshrab `aseer we mayya barda.

arabic: اللمة دي حلوة اوي
english: This gathering is very nice.
transliteration: El-lamma di helwa awi.

arabic: انا في قهوة دلوقتي
english: I am at a cafe now.
transliteration: Ana fi ahwa delwa'ty

arabic: انا مستني صاحبي احمد
english: I am waiting for my friend Ahmed.
transliteration: Ana mestanni sahbi Ahmed

arabic: صباح الخير يا معلم
english: Good morning, boss (waiter).
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya ma'allem

arabic: انا عايز واحد قهوة سادة
english: I want one plain coffee.
transliteration: Ana ayiz wahed ahwa saada

arabic: فين احمد يا رب يجي بسرعة
english: Where is Ahmed? I hope he comes quickly.
transliteration: Feen Ahmed ya rab yigi besor'a

arabic: انا النهاردة عايز اعمل اكل جديد
english: Today, I want to make new food.
transliteration: Ana elnaharda 'ayez a'mel akl gedid.

arabic: حطيت حاجات صغيرة في طبق كبير
english: I put small things in a big plate.
transliteration: Hatayyet hagaat saghira fi taba' kebir.

arabic: الاكل شكله حلو وريحته حلوة
english: The food looks nice and smells nice.
transliteration: El akl shaklo helw w rehto helwa.

arabic: جبت الاكل عشان هو ياكل
english: I brought the food so he eats.
transliteration: Gebt el akl 'ashan howa yakol.

arabic: بس هو قطة صغيرة
english: But he is a small cat.
transliteration: Bas howa otta saghira.

arabic: النهاردة الصبح صحيت مفيش قهوة في بيتي
english: This morning I woke up, there was no coffee in my house.
transliteration: Elnaharda elsobh saheet mafish ahwa fi beiti

arabic: أنا هطلب قهوة من اوبر ايتس من تليفوني
english: I will order coffee from Uber Eats from my phone.
transliteration: Ana hatlob ahwa men Uber Eats men telefooni

arabic: لما كنت بدور على تليفوني فتحت دولاب المطبخ
english: As I was looking for my phone, I opened the kitchen cabinet.
transliteration: Lama kont badawar ala telefooni fataht dolab elmatbakh

arabic: فجأة شفت كيس قهوة كبير جديد جوه
english: Suddenly, I saw a big new coffee bag inside.
transliteration: Fag'a shoft kees ahwa kabeer gedeed gowa

arabic: دلوقتي أنا مبسوط ومفيش داعي اشتري قهوة
english: Now I am happy and there's no need to buy coffee.
transliteration: Delwa'ty ana mabsoot wamfish da'y ashtry ahwa

arabic: جدة عملت اكل
english: Grandma made food.
transliteration: Gedda ʿamalet akl.

arabic: الاكل كان رز و سمك
english: The food was rice and fish.
transliteration: El akl kan rozz w samak.

arabic: البنت الصغيرة قالت ايه ده سمك ده مش حلو
english: The little girl said, "What is this? Fish? This is not good!"
transliteration: El bent el soghayyara ʾalet eeh da samak da mush ḥelw.

arabic: الجدة قالت لا سمك حلو و صحي
english: Grandma said, "No, fish is good and healthy!"
transliteration: El gedda ʾalet laʾ samak ḥelw w seḥḥi.

arabic: البنت عايزة فاكهة بس الجدة عايزة خضار
english: The girl wants fruit but Grandma wants vegetables.
transliteration: El bent ʿayza fakiha bas el gedda ʿayza khoḍaar.

arabic: كان المطر بدأ ينزل جامد بره
english: The rain started falling heavily outside.
transliteration: kān il-maṭar bádaʔ yínzil gámid bárra.

arabic: انا كنت قاعد في البيت بتفرج على التلفزيون
english: I was sitting at home watching TV.
transliteration: ana kunt ʔáʕid fil-bēt batfarraǧ ʕala t-tilifizyōn.

arabic: فجأة سمعت صوت حاجة بتضرب على الشباك
english: Suddenly I heard a sound of something hitting the window.
transliteration: fágʔa simíʕt ṣōt ḥága bitɖárab ʕala sh-shibbāk.

arabic: قومت اشوف ايه اللي حصل بالظبط
english: I got up to see exactly what happened.
transliteration: ʔumt ashūf ēh illi ḥaṣal biẓ-ẓabṭ.

arabic: لقيت قطة صغيرة مبلولة واعترفتلي انها جعانة
english: I found a small wet cat, and it admitted to me that it was hungry.
transliteration: laʔēt ʔuṭṭa ṣuɣayyaṛa maballūla w-i3tárafit-li innaha gaʕána.

arabic: يا ماما هو احنا ليه هنا سال علي وهو مش بيبطل اسئلة
english: "Oh mama, why are we here?" Ali asked, not stopping his questions.
transliteration: Ya mama howa ehna leih hena sa'al Ali we howa mesh bebotol as'ela
storyTitle: The Boy Who Asks a Lot

arabic: يا حبيبي انا لسه سايقه العربيه عشان اجي البيت واحنا في البيت دلوقتي ردت الام بتعب
english: "My darling, I just drove the car to come home and we are at home now," the mother replied tiredly.
transliteration: Ya habibi ana lessa say'a el arabeya ashan agi el bet we ehna fel bet delwa'ty raddet el omm be ta'ab
storyTitle: The Boy Who Asks a Lot

arabic: طيب وبابا فين وانت شوفتي هدير كمل علي اسئلته بسرعة
english: "Okay, and where is dad? And did you see Hadeer?" Ali continued his questions quickly.
transliteration: Tayeb we baba fein wenti shofti Hadeer kamel Ali as'elto be sor'a
storyTitle: The Boy Who Asks a Lot

arabic: الام اتنهدت وقالت يا علي انا لسه نايمه من ساعتين عشان كنت تعبانه اوي من الشغل
english: The mother sighed and said, "Oh Ali, I just fell asleep two hours ago because I was very tired from work."
transliteration: El omm etnahhadet we 'alet ya Ali ana lessa nayma men saatein ashan kont taabana awi men el shoghl
storyTitle: The Boy Who Asks a Lot

arabic: بس مين ساب الباب مفتوح كده سال علي وهو بيبص حواليه في السوبر ماركت
english: "But who left the door open like that?" Ali asked, looking around him in the supermarket.
transliteration: Bass min saab el bab maftooh keda sa'al Ali we howa beyeboss hawalaih fel supermarket
storyTitle: The Boy Who Asks a Lot

arabic: انا كلمت صاحبي احمد النهاردة
english: I called my friend Ahmed today.
transliteration: Ana kallimt sahby Ahmed elnaharda.

arabic: امي كانت جنبي بتسلم عليه بحب
english: My mother was next to me, saying hello to him with love.
transliteration: Ommy kanet gamby betsalem alieh be hobb.

arabic: اتكلمنا عن البيت وايه اللي ناقصنا
english: We talked about the house and what we needed.
transliteration: Etkallimna an el bayt w eih elli na2esna.

arabic: قررنا ننزل السوق الكبير نشتري فاكهة وخضار
english: We decided to go to the big market to buy fruit and vegetables.
transliteration: Qarrarna nenzel el soo' el kibeer neshtary fakha w khodaar.

arabic: احنا بنحب الاكل الطازج لبيتنا
english: We love fresh food for our home.
transliteration: E7na benhebb el akl el tazej le baytna.

arabic: النهارده انا عايز هدوم جديد
english: Today I want new clothes.
transliteration: Ennaharda ana ayiz hedoum gdid.

arabic: رحت المحل الكبير اللي في الشارع
english: I went to the big shop in the street.
transliteration: Roht el mahal el kebir elli fi esh shari'.

arabic: شفت فستان لونه احمر و كان حلو اوي
english: I saw a dress its color was red and it was very nice.
transliteration: Shoft fostaan lonoh ahmar we kan helw awi.

arabic: بس المقاس بتاعه كان صغير و كان غالي شوية
english: But its size was small and it was a bit expensive.
transliteration: Bas el ma'as bita'oh kan soghayar we kan ghali showaya.

arabic: انا دلوقتي مبسوط بفستان جديد لون ازرق
english: I am now happy with a new blue dress.
transliteration: Ana delwa'ti mabsout befostaan gdid lon azraq.

arabic: احنا اسرة كبيرة
english: We are a big family.
transliteration: Ehna osra kabeera.

arabic: يوم الجمعة بناكل غدا مع بعض في البيت
english: On Friday, we eat lunch together at home.
transliteration: Yom el Gom'a benakol ghada ma' ba'd fi el beit.

arabic: الاكل لذيذ اوي وكثير
english: The food is very delicious and a lot.
transliteration: El akl lazeez awi w keteer.

arabic: اخويا الصغير بيضحك كتير وعمتي بتتكلم كتير
english: My small brother laughs a lot and my aunt talks a lot.
transliteration: Akhouya el sagheer beyedhak keteer w 'amty betetkallem keteer.

arabic: كلنا مبسوطين اوي النهاردة
english: All of us are very happy today.
transliteration: Kollena mabsooteen awi elnaharda.

arabic: احنا بنفكر في فرح كبير
english: We are thinking about a big wedding.
transliteration: E7na benfakkir fi fara7 kabiir.

arabic: هو سعيد قوي بيحب الفرح
english: He is very happy, he loves the wedding.
transliteration: Howwa sa'eed awi be-y7ibb el-fara7.

arabic: هي بتتصور يوم جميل وناس كتير
english: She imagines a beautiful day and many people.
transliteration: Hiyya bet-tṣawwar yoom gamil wi nas ketiir.

arabic: انا بقول يالا نختار مكان حلو
english: I say, let's choose a nice place.
transliteration: Ana ba'ool yalla nekhtar makan 7elw.

arabic: احنا هنكون سعدا في الفرح ده
english: We will be happy at this wedding.
transliteration: E7na hankoon so'ada fi el-fara7 da.

arabic: عندنا فرح قريب
english: We have a wedding soon.
transliteration: A'andena farah 'areeb.

arabic: كل يوم فيه شغل كتير
english: Every day there is a lot of work.
transliteration: Kull yoom feeh shoghl keteer.

arabic: احنا عايزين شقة جديدة
english: We want a new apartment.
transliteration: Ehna aayzeen sha'a gedeeda.

arabic: صاحبتي بتساعدني
english: My friend helps me.
transliteration: Saahibti betsa'edni.

arabic: بكره هنروح السوق عشان الأكل
english: Tomorrow we will go to the market for food.
transliteration: Bokra hanrooh es-soo' 'ashan el-akl.

arabic: الصبح بدري في بيتي مفيش قهوة وريحة المطبخ هادية
english: Early in the morning in my house there is no coffee and the kitchen smell is quiet
transliteration: El sobh badri fi beiti mafish ahwa w rehet el matbakh hadya

arabic: لما مش بيكون في قهوة في بيتي بشتري قهوة سخنة من أوبر إيتس
english: When there isn't coffee in my house, I buy hot coffee from Uber Eats
transliteration: Lama mesh bikoon fi ahwa fi beiti bashtry ahwa sokhna men Uber Eats

arabic: في الشغل بشوف أصحابي وبسمع صوت الضحك وأنا بكون مبسوط
english: At work I see my friends and hear the sound of laughter and I am happy
transliteration: Fi el shoghl bashoof ashabi w basma' sot el dahk w ana bakoon mabsoot

arabic: لما الوقت بيعدي وأنا جعان تليفوني بيرن عشان الغدا
english: When time passes and I am hungry, my phone rings for lunch
transliteration: Lama el waqt bya'di w ana gaaan, telefooni byerenn 'ashan el ghada

arabic: بعد الشغل لما برجع بيتي أنا بعمل أكل ريحته حلوة ومبسوط
english: After work, when I return home, I make food that smells good and I am happy
transliteration: Ba'd el shoghl, lama barg'a beiti, ana ba'amel akl rehto helwa w mabsoot

arabic: انا اشتريت قميص امبارح
english: I bought a shirt yesterday.
transliteration: Ana ishtarayt 'amees imbareh.

arabic: بس هو كبير قوي انا لازم ارجعه
english: But it's too big, I need to return it.
transliteration: Bas howa kebeer awi ana lazim argah'oh.

arabic: المحل بيفتح الساعة تلاتة
english: The shop opens at three o'clock.
transliteration: El maHall biyiftaH el sa'a talata.

arabic: دلوقتي الساعة اتنين ونص انا رايح المحل
english: Now it's 2:30, I am going to the shop.
transliteration: Delwa'ty el sa'a itneen w nos ana rayiH el maHall.

arabic: انا هرجع القميص
english: I will return the shirt.
transliteration: Ana hargah' el 'amees.

arabic: منى شافت جارها كريم وزعلت اوي
english: Mona saw her neighbor Karim and was very upset.
transliteration: Mona shafet garha Karim waza'let awi.

arabic: هي بدأت تتكلم بصوت عالي ايه اللي حصل امبارح بالليل كان ازعاج رهيب
english: She started talking loudly: "What happened last night was terrible noise!"
transliteration: Hiyya bada't tetkallem besot 'ali: "Eh elli hasal embarah bel-leil kan ez'ag rahib!"

arabic: كريم اتفاجئ وحاول ينكر اي حاجة غلط
english: Karim was surprised and tried to deny anything wrong.
transliteration: Karim etfage' we hawel yenker ay haga ghalat.

arabic: لكن منى قالت مش ممكن تنكر صوت المزيكا بتاعك ده كان عالي جدا
english: But Mona said: "You can't deny your music's sound, it was very loud!"
transliteration: Laken Mona qalet: "Mesh momken tenker sot el-mozika beta'ak, da kan 'ali geddan!"

arabic: كريم اتنهد واعترف في الاخر معلش انا اسف يا منى مش هتتكرر تاني
english: Karim sighed and finally admitted: "I'm sorry, Mona, it won't happen again."
transliteration: Karim etnahhad we'taraf fil-akher: "Ma'alesh ana assef ya Mona, mesh hatetkarrar tani."

arabic: الدنيا كانت بتمطر جامد انهارده بعد الضهر
english: It was raining heavily this afternoon.
transliteration: El donya kanet betmater gamed ennaharda ba'd el dohr.

arabic: انا لسه سايقه العربيه عشان اجي البيت والمطر نزل فجأة
english: I had just driven the car to come home and the rain started suddenly.
transliteration: Ana lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan agi el bet wel matar nezel faga'a.

arabic: دخلت البيت جريت على السرير لاني كنت تعبانه اوي من الشغل
english: I entered the house, ran to the bed because I was very tired from work.
transliteration: Dakhalet el bet gereit ala el sereer le'ani kont taabana awi men el shoghl.

arabic: انا لسه نايمه من ساعتين وصحيت على صوت رعد قوي
english: I had just fallen asleep two hours ago and woke up to a loud thunder sound.
transliteration: Ana lessa nayma men saatein we saheet ala sot ra'd qawi.

arabic: فجأة افتكرت وسألت انتي شوفتي هدير فين احنا سايبينها بره
english: Suddenly I remembered and asked 'Did you see Hadeer? Did we leave her outside?'
transliteration: Faga'a eftakart we sa'alt enti shofti Hadeer fein ehna saybenha barra.

arabic: انا كنت ماشي في شارع كبير النهاردة
english: I was walking on a big street today
transliteration: Ana kont mashi fi share3 kabeer el naharda

arabic: فجأة شفت صاحب قديم احمد
english: Suddenly I saw an old friend, Ahmed
transliteration: Faga'a shoft saheb adeem Ahmad

arabic: صوته كان واضح وسمعته بيضحك
english: His voice was clear and I heard him laughing
transliteration: Soto kan wadeh w same3to beyedhak

arabic: انا قلت اهلا ازيك يا احمد هو كان مبسوط قوي
english: I said "Hello, how are you Ahmed?" He was very happy
transliteration: Ana olt Ahlan ezayyak ya Ahmad howa kan mabsoot awi

arabic: ده كان يوم حلو قوي الحمدلله
english: This was a very good day, praise be to God
transliteration: Da kan yom helw awi alHamdulillah

arabic: انا جعان اوي النهارده انا هعمل اكل جديد
english: I am very hungry today, I will cook a new dish.
transliteration: Ana gaa'aan awy el naharda ana haa'mel akl gedeed.

arabic: الموضوع كان صعب شوية عشان دي اول مرة اعمل الطبق ده في بيتي
english: It was a bit difficult because this is the first time I cook this dish in my house.
transliteration: El mawdoo' kan sa'b shwaya 'ashan di awel marra a'mel el taba' da fi beiti.

arabic: فجأة لقيت مفيش ملح كفاية بس انا كملت الطبخ
english: Suddenly, I found there wasn't enough salt, but I continued cooking.
transliteration: Fag'a la'eet mafish malh kefaya bas ana kammelt el tabkh.

arabic: لما خلصت الاكل ذوقته ولقيته حلو اوي انا كنت مبسوط
english: When I finished the food, I tasted it and found it very delicious, I was happy.
transliteration: Lamma khalasht el akl zawwa'to w la'eeto helw awy ana kont mabsoot.

arabic: لما بكون مبسوط بكلم اصحابي عشان احكيلهم عن الطبق الجديد
english: When I am happy, I talk to my friends to tell them about the new dish.
transliteration: Lamma bakoon mabsoot bakallem ashabi 'ashan ahkilhom 'an el taba' el gedeed.

arabic: العصر تليفوني رن وكان صاحبي أحمد اللي بيتصل
english: In the afternoon, my phone rang and it was my friend Ahmed who was calling.
transliteration: El-ʻasr telefony rann w kan sahby Ahmad elly beyetessel.

arabic: رديت عليه وقولتله ازيك يا أحمد واحشني جدا عامل إيه
english: I answered him and said, "How are you, Ahmed? I miss you so much! How are you doing?"
transliteration: Raddayt ʻaleih w olto-llo izzayyak ya Ahmad waheshni giddan ʻamel eih.

arabic: قالي انا كنت عايز أسألك لو فاضي بكرة عشان عندي ليك مفاجأة حلوة
english: He told me, "I wanted to ask you if you're free tomorrow because I have a nice surprise for you."
transliteration: Qal-li ana kont ʻayez as'alak law fady bokra ʻashan ʻandy leek mofaga'a helwa.

arabic: قلتله أكيد فاضي بس يا ترى إيه المفاجأة دي بجد أنا متفاجئ
english: I told him, "Certainly I'm free, but I wonder what this surprise is? I'm really surprised!"
transliteration: Olto-llo akeed fady bas ya tara eih el-mofaga'a di bigad ana metfage'e.

arabic: ضحك وقالي أنا مش أحمد أنا أخوه الصغير سيف وتليفونه كان معايا
english: He laughed and told me, "I'm not Ahmed, I'm his younger brother Seif, and his phone was with me."
transliteration: Dehek w qal-li ana mish Ahmad ana akhu-h el-soghayyar Seif w telephonoh kan maʻaya.

arabic: صباح الخير يا سارة ازيك
english: Good morning Sarah, how are you?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheer ya Sara, izzayyik?

arabic: انا كويسة الحمد لله وانت ازيك يا احمد
english: I'm good, alhamdulillah. And how are you Ahmed?
transliteration: Ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah. Wenta izzayyak ya Ahmed?

arabic: انا كويس والله كنت بشتري حاجات للبيت
english: I'm good, by God. I was buying things for the house.
transliteration: Ana kwayyes wallahi. Kont bashtary hagāt lel-beit.

arabic: اه اهلا بيك في اي وقت
english: Oh, welcome to you anytime.
transliteration: Ah, ahlan beek fi ayy wa't.

arabic: تمام اشوفك بكره مع السلامة الله يسلمك
english: Okay, see you tomorrow. Goodbye. May God keep you safe.
transliteration: Tamam, ashoufak bokra. Ma'a salama. Allah yisallimik.

arabic: اشتريت حاجة امبارح بس لما روحت البيت لقيتها مش مناسبة
english: I bought something yesterday, but when I went home, I found it wasn't suitable.
transliteration: Ishtarēt ḥāga imbāreḥ bas lammā ruḥt el-bēt laqētaha mish munāsiba.
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: قررت النهاردة أروح المحل عشان أرجعها وأخد فلوسي تاني
english: Today I decided to go to the shop to return it and get my money back.
transliteration: Qarrart el-nahārda arūḥ el-maḥall ʿashān araggaʿha wa ākhod flūsi tāni.
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: أول ما دخلت صاحب المحل رحب بيا وقال لي أهلًا وسهلًا إيه اللي عايز تعمله
english: As soon as I entered, the shop owner welcomed me and said, "Ahlan wa Sahlan, what do you want to do?"
transliteration: Awwal mā dakhelt, ṣāḥeb el-maḥall raḥḥab biya wa qāl li 'ahlan wa sahlan 'ēh illi ʿāyiz taʿmelu.
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: قلت له بصراحة إني عايز أرجع الحاجة دي فسألني عن الفاتورة
english: I told him frankly that I want to return this item, so he asked me for the receipt.
transliteration: Qult lu biṣarāḥa innī ʿāyiz araggaʿ el-ḥāga di, fa sa'alni ʿan el-fātūra.
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: ابتسم وأخد الفاتورة مني وقال لي تمام مفيش مشكلة واداني الفلوس بسرعة
english: He smiled and took the receipt from me, and told me, "Tamam, no problem," and quickly gave me the money.
transliteration: Ibtasam wa akhad el-fātūra minni, wa qāl li tamām mafīsh mushkila wa adāni el-flūs bi-sorʿa.
storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

arabic: منى كانت ماشية في شارع المعز، وفجأة شافت كتاب قديم خالص على فرشة صغيرة.
english: Mona was walking in El Moez Street, and suddenly she saw a very old book on a small stand.
transliteration: Mona kanet mashya fi share' el Mo'ez, we fag'a shafet ketab adim khales 'ala farsha soghayara.
storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

arabic: هي كانت محتاجة كتاب تاريخ نادر لمشروعها؛ أهو ده هو؟
english: She needed a rare history book for her project; could this be it?
transliteration: Heya kanet mehtaga ketab tareekh nader le mashroo'ha; aho dah howa?
storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

arabic: الكتاب كان أزرق غامق، بالظبط زي ما أستاذها وصف، بس سعرُه كان مكتوب عشرين جنيه بس.
english: The book was dark blue, exactly as her professor described, but its price was written only twenty pounds.
transliteration: El ketab kan azraq ghame' bilzabt zay ma ostazha wassaf, bas se'ro kan maktoob 'eshreen geneh bas.
storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

arabic: منى كان معاها خمسين جنيه بس في شنطتها؛ يعني ده سعر كويس، بس هي كانت قلقانة.
english: Mona only had fifty pounds in her bag; meaning, this was a good price, but she was worried.
transliteration: Mona kan ma'aha khamseen geneh bas fi shantetha; ya'ni dah se'r kwayyes, bas heya kanet 'alqana.
storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

arabic: "معلش يا عمو، الكتاب ده بكام؟" هي سألت البياع.
english: "Excuse me, uncle, how much is this book?" she asked the vendor.
transliteration: "Ma'lesh ya 'amo, el ketab dah be kam?" heya sa'alet el bayya'.
storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

arabic: الراجل الكبير، عم حسن، ابتسم وقال: "أيوه يا بنتي، هو بعشرين جنيه بس، ده كتاب زمان."
english: The old man, Uncle Hassan, smiled and said: "Yes, my daughter, it's twenty pounds only, this is an old-time book."
transliteration: El ragel el kabeer, 'amm Hassan, ibtasam we qaal: "Aywa ya benty, howa be 'eshreen geneh bas, dah ketab zaman."
storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

arabic: منى بصّت على أول صفحة كويس وشافت اسم أستاذها مكتوب جوه!
english: Mona looked at the first page carefully and saw her professor's name written inside!
transliteration: Mona basset 'ala awwal safha kwayyes we shafet esm ostazha maktoob gowwa!
storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

arabic: "إيه ده!" هي قالت، "ده كتاب أستاذي! أكيد هو وقع منه."
english: "What's this!" she exclaimed, "This is my professor's book! He must have dropped it."
transliteration: "Eh dah!" heya qalet, "Dah ketab ostazy! Akeed howa waqa' menno."
storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

arabic: هي قررت تشتريه فورًا وترجّعُه ليه في الجامعة بكرة.
english: She decided to buy it immediately and return it to him at the university tomorrow.
transliteration: Heya qarraret teshtareeh fawran we teragga'o leeh fel gam'a bokra.
storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

arabic: منى حست إنها مبسوطة؛ هي لقيت الكتاب وهتقدر تساعد أستاذها.
english: Mona felt happy; she found the book and would be able to help her professor.
transliteration: Mona hasset ennaha mabsoota; heya la'et el ketab we hateqdar tesa'ed ostazha.
storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

arabic: العيلة كلها كانت قاعدة بتخطط لرحلة الويك إند
english: The whole family was sitting planning the weekend trip
transliteration: El-eila kolloha kanet aa'da betkhattat le-rehlet el-weekend

arabic: بابا وماما كانوا عايزين يروحوا بيتي القديم في البلد بس أنا وإخواتي كنا عايزين مكان جديد
english: Dad and Mom wanted to go to my old house in the village, but my siblings and I wanted a new place
transliteration: Baba w mama kanu ayzeen yeruhu beiti el-adeem fil balad bas ana w ekhwati konna ayzeen makan gedeed

arabic: أختي الصغيرة فتحت تليفونها بسرعة وورينا صور لأماكن شبابية حلوة
english: My little sister quickly opened her phone and showed us pictures of cool, youthful places
transliteration: Okhti el-sagheera fatahet telefoonha be-sor'a w warrena sowar le-amaken shababeya helwa

arabic: بابا قال لما بكون مبسوط بحب أقعد في هدوء بعيد عن الدوشة دي كلها
english: Dad said: 'When I am happy, I like to sit in quiet away from all this noise'
transliteration: Baba aal: 'Lama bakoon mabsoot bahebb a'ood fi hodoo' ba'eed 'an el-dawsha di kolloha'

arabic: ماما قالت طيب هنعمل إيه في الفطار مفيش قهوة في البيت أنا هشتري قهوة من أوبر إيتس للرحلة
english: Mom said: 'Okay, what will we do for breakfast? There's no coffee at home, I will buy coffee from Uber Eats for the trip'
transliteration: Mama aalet: 'Tayyeb hana'mel eh fil fetar? Mafish ahwa fil beit, ana hashtry ahwa men Uber Eats lel rehla'

arabic: عندنا مشكلة كبيرة في البيت النهاردة الانترنت مش شغال خالص
english: We have a big problem at home today, the internet is not working at all.
transliteration: 3andina moškela kebīra fel-bēt en-nahārda el-internet meš šaġġāl ḫāleṣ.

arabic: حاولت اطفي الراوتر واشغله تلاتاشر مرة بس مفيش فايدة
english: I tried turning off the router and turning it on thirteen times, but it was no use.
transliteration: ḥāwelt aṭaffi er-router w ašaġġalo talattāšar marra bas mafīš fāyda.

arabic: ابني الصغير قالي يا بابا فيه خير قولتله لأ مفيش اي خير
english: My little son asked me, 'Dad, is everything good?' I told him, 'No, nothing is good.'
transliteration: ebnī eṣ-ṣoġayyar ʾalī ya baba fīh ḫeir? ʾoltelo la' mafīš ay ḫeir.

arabic: كان عنده واجبات كتير على النت وخلص خمستاشر منهم بس فاضله خمسة كمان
english: He had a lot of homework online and finished fifteen of them, but he still has five more.
transliteration: kān 3ando wāgebāt ketīr 3ala en-net w ḫallaṣ xamastāšar menhom bas fāḍeloh ḫamsa kamān.

arabic: يمكن لو قعدت استنى عشرين دقيقة تاني يحصل معجزة ونقول امين
english: Maybe if I wait twenty more minutes a miracle will happen and we'll say amen.
transliteration: yemken law ʾa3adt astanna 3išrīn deʾīʾa tānī yeḥṣal mo3geza w neʾūl amīn.

arabic: ريحة اكل حلوة قوي طلعت من شقة اميرة
english: A very nice food smell came out of Amira's apartment.
transliteration: rīḥet akl ḥelwa qawiṭ ṭalaʿet men shaʾʾet Amīra.
storyTitle: A Nice Smell from the Neighbors' Apartment

arabic: جارتها منى عدت وقالت ايه الريحة الحلوة دي يا اميرة
english: Her neighbor Mona passed by and said: What is this nice smell, Amira?
transliteration: gāṛetha Muna ʿaddet w qālet: eeh el-rīḥa el-ḥelwa dī ya Amīra?
storyTitle: A Nice Smell from the Neighbors' Apartment

arabic: اميرة ردت وقالت ده سمك ورز مع خضار
english: Amira replied and said: This is fish and rice with vegetables.
transliteration: Amīra raddet w qālet: dah samak w rozz maʿ khoḍaar.
storyTitle: A Nice Smell from the Neighbors' Apartment

arabic: منى قالت الله ده اكيد حلو قوي شكله يفتح النفس
english: Mona said: Oh, this must be very good, it looks appetizing.
transliteration: Muna qālet: Allah! dah akīd ḥelw qawiṭ shaklo yefteḥ el-nafs.
storyTitle: A Nice Smell from the Neighbors' Apartment

arabic: اميرة ابتسمت وقالت طب تعالي كلي معايا حتة
english: Amira smiled and said: Okay, come eat a piece with me.
transliteration: Amīra ebtasmet w qālet: ṭab taʿālī kulī maʿāya ḥetta.
storyTitle: A Nice Smell from the Neighbors' Apartment

arabic: انا ماشي في الشارع
english: I am walking in the street.
transliteration: Ana mashy fi el share'

arabic: فجأة شميت ريحة قهوة حلوة
english: Suddenly, I smelled a delicious coffee scent.
transliteration: Foga'a shammeit reehet ahwa helwa

arabic: بصيت وشوفت صاحب قديم اسمه كريم
english: I looked and saw an old friend named Karim.
transliteration: Basseit w shuft saheb adeem ismu Karim

arabic: قولت صباح الخير يا كريم ازيك
english: I said, "Good morning, Karim! How are you?"
transliteration: Oult Sabah el kheer ya Karim izzayak

arabic: ابتسم وقالي انا كويس شكرا
english: He smiled and told me, "I'm good, thank you."
transliteration: Ebtasam w 'aly "Ana kwayyes, shokran"

arabic: انا في القهوة عايز ترابيزة
english: I am at the café, I want a table.
transliteration: Ana fee el ahwa ayiz tarabeeza.

arabic: فيه ترابيزة فاضية هناك وفي كرسي
english: There is an empty table there, and a chair.
transliteration: Fee tarabeeza fadya henak w fee korsi.

arabic: انا باستنى الجارسون ييجي
english: I am waiting for the waiter to come.
transliteration: Ana ba'astanna el garson yeegy.

arabic: هو بييجي وانا بقول ممكن قهوة من فضلك
english: He comes and I say "Can I have coffee please?"
transliteration: Howa biyeegy w ana ba'ool momken ahwa min fadlak.

arabic: هو بيقول تمام وانا بقول شكرا
english: He says "Okay" and I say "Thank you."
transliteration: Howa bi'ool tamam w ana ba'ool shokran.

arabic: صباح الخير يا منى عاملة ايه
english: Good morning, Mona, how are you?
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya Mona, aamla eh?

arabic: انا كويسة يا فاطمة شكرا ايه ده معاكي
english: I'm good, Fatma, thank you. What is this with you?
transliteration: Ana kwayyesa ya Fatma, shokran. Eh da ma'aaki?

arabic: دي زرعة صغيرة اوي
english: This is a very small plant.
transliteration: Di zar'a soghayyara awi.

arabic: منى ضحكت وقالت فين بيتها الصغير ده
english: Mona laughed and said: "Where is its small house?"
transliteration: Mona deheket w 'alet: "Feen beetha el soghayyar da?"

arabic: فاطمة قالت بيتها هنا في شقتي انا
english: Fatma said: "Its house is here in my apartment."
transliteration: Fatma 'alet: "Beetha hena fi sha'eti ana."

arabic: بعد ما روحت البيت حصلت مشكلة في الجاكت اللي اشتريته
english: After I went home, a problem happened with the jacket I bought.
transliteration: baʕd ma rowwaħt il-beet, ɧáȿalit muʃkila fil-gakkit illi-ʃtaraytu.

arabic: بدأت اجهز نفسي عشان ارجع الجاكت المحل تاني
english: I started preparing myself to return the jacket to the shop again.
transliteration: bádaʔt agahhez nafsi ʕaʃaan argáʕ il-gakkit il-maħall taani.

arabic: الراجل في المحل بص على الجاكت واِعْترف إن فيه عيب واضح
english: The man in the shop looked at the jacket and admitted that there was a clear defect.
transliteration: ir-raagil fil-maħall baṣṣ ʕala l-gakkit wi-3táraf inn fee ʕeeb waaɖeħ.

arabic: مكنش فيه أي مشاكل والموضوع كله نهى بسرعة
english: There weren't any problems and the whole matter finished quickly.
transliteration: makanʃ fee ayy maʃakil wal-mawɖooʕ kullu náha b-surʕa.

arabic: حسيت اني مبسوط عشان التجربة دي كانت سهلة جداً
english: I felt happy because this experience was very easy.
transliteration: ħassayt inni mabsuuṭ ʕaʃaan it-tagraba di kanit sahla giddan.

arabic: احمد بدأ يومه وهو متحمس يشتري هدوم جديدة للصيف
english: Ahmed started his day excited to buy new clothes for summer.
transliteration: ʼAḥmad bádaʔ yómuh wa húwwa mutaḥammes yeštiri hdúm gedída leṣ-ṣayf.

arabic: لما جرب تي شيرت لونه ازرق فاتح حس بسعادة كبيرة
english: When he tried a light blue t-shirt, he felt great happiness.
transliteration: Lamma garrab tī-šērt lóndu ʼazraʔ fátiḥ ḥass be-saʻáda kebíra.

arabic: لكن لما شاف سعر بنطلون عجبه سعادته بدأت تقل شوية
english: But when he saw the price of pants he liked, his happiness started to decrease a bit.
transliteration: Lakin lamma šāf seʻr banṭalón ʻagabu, saʻádtu bádaʔit teʼell šwáyya.

arabic: حصل موقف محرج لما حاول يلبس جاكت كان صغير عليه
english: An embarrassing situation happened when he tried to wear a jacket that was too small for him.
transliteration: Ḥaṣal mawqeif muḥreg lamma ḥáwal yelbes gāket kān ṣoghayyar ʻaléih.

arabic: اخيرا نهى التسوق بتاعه واشترى التي شيرت فقط وهو راضي
english: Finally, he finished his shopping and bought only the t-shirt, feeling satisfied.
transliteration: ʼAkhíran náha t-tasawwoq betáʻu w-eštara t-tī-šērt faqaṭ wa húwwa ráḍi.

arabic: الدنيا بتمطر جامد برا والجو ساقعة خالص في يوم شتا جميل
english: It's raining heavily outside and the weather is very cold on a beautiful winter day.
transliteration: El-donya betmaṭṭar gamid barra wel-gaw saq'a khales fi yom sheta gameel.

arabic: الباب خبط وكانت سارة صاحبتي فقلتلها أهلاً بيكي يا سارة إزيكِ
english: The door knocked and it was my friend Sara, so I told her, "Welcome Sara, how are you?"
transliteration: El-bab khabbat w kanet Sara saḥebti fa-qultelha "Ahlan beeki ya Sara, izzayyik?"

arabic: سارة دخلت وهي بتنفض هدومها وقالت أنا كويسة يا أحمد الحمد لله بس المطر كان مفاجأة
english: Sara entered, shaking off her clothes, and said, "I'm good Ahmed, alhamdulillah, but the rain was a surprise."
transliteration: Sara dakhalet w heya betnaffad hedoumeha w qalet "Ana kwayyesa ya Ahmed, alhamdulillah, bas el-maṭar kan mofag'a."

arabic: قعدنا نشرب شاي سخن ونتكلم عن الجو وبعد ساعة قالت سارة أنا لازم أمشي دلوقتي مع السلامة
english: We sat drinking hot tea and talking about the weather, and after an hour Sara said, "I have to leave now, goodbye."
transliteration: Qa'adna neshrab shai sokhn w netkallem 'an el-gaw w ba'd sa'a qalet Sara "Ana lazim amshi delwa'ti, ma'a salama."

arabic: قلتلها ربنا معاكي يا سارة الله يسلمك وهي خارجة من الباب وهي لسه مبتسمة
english: I told her, "God be with you, Sara, may God keep you safe" as she was leaving the door, still smiling.
transliteration: Qultelha "Rabbena ma'aki ya Sara, Allah yisallimak" w heya kharga men el-bab w heya lessa mobtasma.

arabic: ليلى ومامتها بيخططوا لفرح ليلى
english: Layla and her mother are planning Layla's wedding.
transliteration: Layla w mamatha bekhataTto le farah Layla.

arabic: ليلى عايزة فرح بسيط وجديد
english: Layla wants a simple and modern wedding.
transliteration: Layla aayza farah baseet we gedeed.

arabic: هي عايزة تشتري فستان ازرق مش فستان ابيض
english: She wants to buy a blue dress, not a white dress.
transliteration: Heya aayza teshtry fostan azraq mesh fostan abyad.

arabic: مامتها بتقول لا الفستان الابيض التقليدي حلو بس غالي
english: Her mother says, "No, the traditional white dress is beautiful but expensive."
transliteration: Mamatha beta'ool la el-fostan el-abyad el-taqleedi helw bas ghali.

arabic: ليلى شايفة الفستان الازرق البسيط رخيص وحلو
