english: Layla thinks the simple blue dress is cheap and beautiful.
transliteration: Layla shayfa el-fostan el-azraq el-baseet rakhees we helw.

arabic: النهاردة كان مطر كبير على بيتنا
english: Today there was heavy rain over our home.
transliteration: El-naharda kaan matar kibeer ala baytna.

arabic: امي قالت مش هينفع نروح السوق دلوقتي
english: My mother said "We can't go to the market now."
transliteration: Ommy alet "mesh hayenfa' nrooh es-soo' delwa'ty."

arabic: احنا بنحب ناكل فاكهة وخضار طازة من السوق
english: We love to eat fresh fruit and vegetables from the market.
transliteration: Ehna benhebb nakol fakha wa khodaar taza men es-soo'.

arabic: بس النهاردة هنعمل شاي ونتفرج على التلفزيون
english: But today we will make tea and watch TV.
transliteration: Bas el-naharda hana'mel shay wa netfarag ala et-telefeezyoon.

arabic: وبعدين امي قالت المرة الجاية يلا نشتري اكل كتير
english: Then my mother said "Next time, let's buy a lot of food."
transliteration: Waba'deen ommy alet "El-marra el-gaya yalla neshtary akl kteer."

arabic: عندي اجازة يومين عايزة اروح اسوان
english: I have a two-day holiday, I want to go to Aswan.
transliteration: Andy agaza yomein ayza arouh Aswan.

arabic: هناك نشوف السوق الكبير و ناكل اكل حلو
english: There we will see the big market and eat delicious food.
transliteration: Henak neshouf el souq el kabeer w nakol akl helw.

arabic: نروح سوا انا و اصحابي و نفطر في مطعم
english: My friends and I will go together and have breakfast at a restaurant.
transliteration: Narouh sawa ana w ashabi w neftar fi mat'am.

arabic: نتكلم مع ناس من اهلها و نشرب شاي
english: We will talk with its local people and drink tea.
transliteration: Netkallem ma'a nas men ahlaha w neshrab shay.

arabic: الاجازة دي هتبقى جميلة اوي
english: This holiday will be very beautiful.
transliteration: El agaza di hatib'a gameela awi.

arabic: انا روحت بيت خالتي امبارح
english: I went to my aunt's house yesterday.
transliteration: Ana roht beit khalti embareh.

arabic: هي قالتلي اهلا وسهلا يا بنتي
english: She told me, "Welcome, my daughter."
transliteration: Heya 'aletli ahlan wa sahlan ya benty.

arabic: خالتي جابتلي شاي وحاجة حلوة
english: My aunt brought me tea and something sweet.
transliteration: Khalti gabetli shay w haga helwa.

arabic: انا شكرتها وقلتلها شكرا يا خالتي
english: I thanked her and told her, "Thank you, auntie."
transliteration: Ana shakartaha w oltelha shokran ya khalti.

arabic: كانت زيارة حلوة اوي وبعدين مشيت ومع السلامة
english: It was a very nice visit and then I left, goodbye.
transliteration: Kanet ziyara helwa awi w ba'dein mesheet w ma'a salama.

arabic: النهاردة الصبح انا رحت بيت عمي
english: Today morning, I went to my uncle's house.
transliteration: El naharda el sobh ana roht beit 'ammy.

arabic: اول ما دخلت قلت صباح الخير ازيك يا عمو
english: As soon as I entered, I said, "Good morning, how are you, uncle?"
transliteration: Awwel ma dakhalet olt "Sabah el kheer, izzayyak ya 'ammo."

arabic: قعدنا نفطر سوا واكلنا عيش وجبنة وشربت لبن
english: We sat to have breakfast together, we ate bread and cheese, and I drank milk.
transliteration: Qa'adna neftar sawa w akalna 'eish w gebna w sherbet laban.

arabic: بعد الفطار قعدت اتكلمت معاه وشوفنا التلفزيون شوية
english: After breakfast, I sat and talked with him and we watched TV for a bit.
transliteration: Ba'd el fitaar qa'adt etkallemt ma'aah w shofna el televizyon shwayya.

arabic: قبل ما امشي قلت شكرا يا عمو باي
english: Before I left, I said, "Thank you, uncle, bye."
transliteration: Qabl ma amshi olt "Shukran ya 'ammo, bye."

arabic: انا قاعده في القهوه مستنيه صاحبتي هدير
english: I'm sitting at the café waiting for my friend Hadeer.
transliteration: ana qa'ada fi el ahwa mestaneya sahbeti Hadeer

arabic: انا لسه سايباها في المول من ساعه وكانت جايه على طول
english: I just left her at the mall an hour ago and she was supposed to come right away.
transliteration: ana lessa saybaha fi el mol men saaha w kanet gaya ala tool

arabic: طلبت قهوه و قاعده ببص على الناس اللي ماشيه في الشارع
english: I ordered coffee and am sitting watching the people walking in the street.
transliteration: talabt ahwa w qa'ada babos ala el nas elly mashya fi el share'a

arabic: فين هدير انا مستنيه كتير
english: Where is Hadeer? I've been waiting a lot.
transliteration: fen Hadeer ana mestaneya keteer

arabic: انا لسه شايفه فيلم حلو امبارح نفسي احكيلها عليه
english: I just watched a nice movie yesterday, I want to tell her about it.
transliteration: ana lessa shayfa film helw embareh nafsi ahkelha aleih

arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع
english: I was walking in the street
transliteration: Kont mashi fel share'

arabic: فجأة شفت صاحب قديم
english: Suddenly I saw an old friend
transliteration: Fag'a shoft saheb adeem

arabic: صوته كان معروف وابتسامته حلوة
english: His voice was familiar and his smile was nice
transliteration: Soto kan ma'rouf w ebtesameto helwa

arabic: انا كنت مبسوط قوي اني شفته دلوقتي
english: I was very happy that I saw him now
transliteration: Ana kont mabsoot awi enni shofto delwa'ty

arabic: سلمت عليه وقلنا اهلا وقعدنا نشرب قهوة
english: I greeted him and we said hello and sat to drink coffee
transliteration: Sallamt aleih w olna ahlan w adna neshrab ahwa

arabic: التليفون رن انا رديت
english: The phone rang I answered
transliteration: El-telefoon rann ana radeet

arabic: الو ازيك يا صاحبي عامل ايه
english: Hello my friend how are you
transliteration: Alo ezzayak ya sahby amel eh

arabic: انا كويس انت فين دلوقتي
english: I'm good where are you now
transliteration: Ana kwayyes enta fein delwa'ty

arabic: انا مش صاحبك انا حد تاني
english: I'm not your friend I'm someone else
transliteration: Ana mesh sahbak ana hadd tani

arabic: يا لهوي انا اسف جدا معلش
english: Oh my goodness I am very sorry my apologies
transliteration: Ya lahwi ana assef geddan ma'lesh

arabic: انا عايزة اعمل اكل جديد النهاردة
english: I want to make new food today.
transliteration: Ana ayza a'mel akl gedeed el naharda.

arabic: دخلت المطبخ عشان اطبخ طبق حلو
english: I entered the kitchen to cook a nice dish.
transliteration: Dakhalet el matbakh ashan atbokh tabaq helw.

arabic: دي اول مرة ليا اعمل الوصفة دي
english: This is my first time making this recipe.
transliteration: Di awel marra leya a'mel el wasfa di.

arabic: حطيت خضار و لحمة و زيت
english: I put vegetables, meat, and oil.
transliteration: Hattayt khodar w lahma w zet.

arabic: الاكل طلع لذيذ جدا
english: The food turned out very delicious.
transliteration: El akl tele' lazeez geddan.

arabic: صباح الخير يا سارة ازيك انا كويسة الحمد لله
english: Good morning Sarah, how are you? I'm good, alhamdulillah.
transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer ya Sara, izzayyik? Ana kwayyesa, alhamdulillah.

arabic: في الشغل سارة بتستخدم اللابتوب بتاعها كتير
english: At work, Sarah uses her laptop a lot.
transliteration: Fi el-shoġl Sara bitistakhdim el-laptop bita‘ha keteer.

arabic: مدام فاتن بتحب تكتب كل حاجة في كراسة كبيرة
english: Madam Faten likes to write everything in a big notebook.
transliteration: Madam Faten bithạbb tiktib koll ḥaga fi korrasa kebeera.

arabic: سارة قالت لمدام فاتن ازيك يا مدام فاتن فمدام فاتن قالت اهلاً بيكي يا سارة
english: Sarah said to Madam Faten, "How are you, Madam Faten?" and Madam Faten said, "Welcome to you, Sarah."
transliteration: Sara qalet li Madam Faten "Izzayyik ya Madam Faten?" fa-Madam Faten qalet "Ahlan beeki ya Sara."

arabic: بعد الشغل سارة قالت مع السلامة ومدام فاتن ردت الله يسلمك
english: After work, Sarah said "Goodbye" and Madam Faten responded "May God keep you safe."
transliteration: Ba‘d el-shoġl Sara qalet "Ma‘a salama" wi Madam Faten raddit "Allah yisallimik."

arabic: صحيت متأخر والوقت جري مني بسرعة
english: I woke up late and time ran away from me quickly.
transliteration: Saḥeet met'akhkhar wel wa't gara menni be-sor'a.

arabic: نزلت المطبخ بسرعة عشان الاقي حاجة اكلها قبل الشغل
english: I went down to the kitchen quickly to find something to eat before work.
transliteration: Nazalt el maṭbakh be-sor'a 'ashan ala'i ḥaga aklha abl el shoghl.

arabic: شفت رز وخضار من امبارح وفكرت ايه ده ده مش حلو للفطار خالص
english: I saw rice and vegetables from yesterday, and I thought: "What is this? This is not good for breakfast at all."
transliteration: Shoft rozz we khoḍaar men embareḥ we fakart "Eeh da? Da mush ḥelw lel feṭaar khaleṣ".

arabic: لقيت تفاح وكمان فاكهة تانية دي حلوة اوي للصبح
english: I found apples and also other fruit, this is very good for the morning.
transliteration: Laqeet toffaḥ w kamaan fakiha tanya di ḥelwa awi lel ṣobḥ.

arabic: اكلت بسرعة ولبست ونزلت الشغل جري
english: I ate quickly, got dressed, and ran down to work.
transliteration: Akalt be-sor'a w lebist w nazalt el shoghl gari.

arabic: النهارده جدو وبنته راحوا المحل
english: Today, Grandpa and his granddaughter went to the shop.
transliteration: El naharda geddo w bento raho el mahal.

arabic: جدو كان عايز يرجع القميص ده
english: Grandpa wanted to return this shirt.
transliteration: Geddo kan ayz yeragga' el amees da.

arabic: الراجل الصغير في المحل قال لا مفيش ترجيع
english: The young man in the shop said, "No returns."
transliteration: El ragel el soghayar fel mahal 'al la mafish targie'.

arabic: جدو قال إيه في يومي كان ممكن ترجع كل حاجة
english: Grandpa said, "What? In my day, you could return anything!"
transliteration: Geddo 'al eh fe yomi kan mumken teragga' koll haga.

arabic: بنته ابتسمت وقالت خلاص يا جدو ممكن نشتري حاجة تانية
english: His granddaughter smiled and said, "It's okay, Grandpa, we can buy something else."
transliteration: Bento ebtasemet w 'alet khalas ya geddo mumken neshtri haga tanya.

arabic: أنا مبسوط قوي النهارده عشان كده قررت أكلم صاحبتي
english: I am very happy today, so I decided to call my friend.
transliteration: Ana mabsoot qawi innaharda ashan keda qarart akallem sahbeti.

arabic: مسكت تليفوني واتصلت بيها عشان أحكيلها كل الأخبار
english: I grabbed my phone and called her to tell her all the news.
transliteration: Masakt telefooni wattesalt beeha ashan ahkeelaha koll el akhbar.

arabic: لما ردت كنت مبسوطة إنها فاضية وقعدنا نتكلم كتير
english: When she answered, I was happy she was free and we sat and talked a lot.
transliteration: Lama raddet kont mabsoota ennaha fadya wa'adna netkallem keteer.

arabic: بعد المكالمة بصيت حواليا ولقيت مفيش قهوة في البيت
english: After the call, I looked around and found there was no coffee at home.
transliteration: Ba'd el mokalama basset hawalayya wala'et mafish ahwa fil beit.

arabic: دلوقتي أنا هشتري قهوة حلوة من بره بيتي عشان أشربها
english: Now I will buy a nice coffee from outside my house to drink it.
transliteration: Delwa'ti ana hashtry ahwa helwa men barra beiti ashan ashrabaha.

arabic: صحيت متأخرة الصبح وقمت مستعجلة عشان اجهز للشغل
english: I woke up late in the morning and got up rushing to get ready for work.
transliteration: Saheet meta'akhkhira es-sobḥ we omet mesta'gila 'ashan agahhez le sh-shoghl
storyTitle: A Fast Morning and a Sweet Mistake

arabic: لبست بسرعة وشربت شاي بلبن وانا ماشية
english: I got dressed quickly and drank tea with milk while I was walking.
transliteration: Libist besor'a we sheribt shay belaban wana mashya
storyTitle: A Fast Morning and a Sweet Mistake

arabic: نزلت السلم بسرعة وقابلت جارتي ام سارة قلتلها صباح الخير يا سارة ازيكِ
english: I went down the stairs quickly and met my neighbor Umm Sara, I told her "Good morning, Sara, how are you?"
transliteration: Nezilt es-sellam besor'a we qabilt garti Omm Sara oltelha Sabah el-kheer ya Sara izzayyik
storyTitle: A Fast Morning and a Sweet Mistake

arabic: ردت عليا وقالتلي انا كويسة الحمد لله يا حبيبتي
english: She replied to me and said, "I'm good, praise be to God, my dear."
transliteration: Raddet 'alayya we qaletli ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah ya habibti
storyTitle: A Fast Morning and a Sweet Mistake

arabic: بس فجأة افتكرت ان النهارده الجمعة وانه اجازة رسمية
english: But suddenly I remembered that today is Friday and it's an official holiday.
transliteration: Bass faga'a eftakart en ennaharda el-gom'a we enno agaza rasmiyya
storyTitle: A Fast Morning and a Sweet Mistake

arabic: العيلة كلها قعدت تتكلم عن اجازة اخر الاسبوع
english: The whole family sat down to talk about the weekend holiday.
transliteration: el-3ēla kolleha ʔa3adet tetkallem 3an ʔagāzet āxir el-ʔusbū3

arabic: ماما بدأت تنظم معانا كل حاجة للسفرية
english: Mom started organizing everything with us for the trip.
transliteration: māma bádaʔet tinaẓẓam ma3āna kolle ḥāga lel-safarēya

arabic: بابا سأل يا ترى ايه اللي هيحصل هناك
english: Dad asked, "I wonder what will happen there?"
transliteration: bāba saʔal yā tarā ēlli hayáḥṣal henāk

arabic: اخويا الصغير جرى بسرعة يجيب شنطته عشان يجهز
english: My little brother quickly ran to get his bag to get ready.
transliteration: axūya el-ṣoġayyar gára bi-sor3a yigīb šanṭeto 3ašān yigahhez

arabic: كلنا كنا مبسوطين اوي وفرحانين بالرحلة الجاية
english: We were all very happy and excited about the upcoming trip.
transliteration: kollena konna mabsūṭīn ʔawi we farḥanīn bel-reḥla el-gáyya

arabic: انا عايز اخطط رحلة قصيرة للويك اند ده
english: I want to plan a short trip for this weekend.
transliteration: Ana `ayez akhaTTat rehla `aSeera lel-week end dah.

arabic: بس الجو مش مستقر خالص في الربيع ده
english: But the weather is not stable at all this spring.
transliteration: Bas el-gaww mish mustaqirr khaleS fi er-rabee` dah.

arabic: يا دوب يومين كويسين وخلاص الجو الحلو بيبقى قصير قوي
english: Barely two good days and then the nice weather is very short.
transliteration: Ya doob yomein kuwayyesiin we khalaS el-gaww el-helw beyeb'a `aSeer `awwi.

arabic: انا فكرت في اكلة حلوة ومشروبات ساقعة بس فين بقى
english: I thought about a nice meal and cold drinks, but where?
transliteration: Ana fikkart fi `akla helwa we mashroubaat sa'`a bas fein ba'a.

arabic: يمكن ننام احسن والرحلة كلها تبقى في الاحلام
english: Maybe we should just sleep and the whole trip will be in dreams.
transliteration: Yemken nenaam aHsan wel-rehla kollaha teb'a fi el-aHlaam.

arabic: يلا يا امي نروح السوق الكبير
english: Let's go, my mother, let's go to the big market.
transliteration: Yalla ya ommy nrouh el soo' el kibeer.

arabic: لما دخلنا السوق شمينا ريحة الخضار والفاكهة الطازة الجميلة
english: When we entered the market, we smelled the beautiful fresh vegetables and fruit.
transliteration: Lamma dakhalna el soo' shammeina reehet el khodaar w el fakha el taza el gameela.

arabic: شفت طماطم حمرا وفراولة حلوة جدا وعاوزين نشتري منهم
english: I saw very red tomatoes and sweet strawberries, and we want to buy some of them.
transliteration: Shoft tamatem hamra w farawla helwa geddan, w aawzeen neshtary menhom.

arabic: امي سالت البياع الفراولة بكام الكيلو
english: My mother asked the seller how much the strawberries are per kilo.
transliteration: Ommy sa'alet el bayya' el farawla bekam el kilo.

arabic: بنحب نشتري حاجات طازة للبيت كل اسبوع
english: We love to buy fresh things for the house every week.
transliteration: Benhebb neshtary hagat taza lel bayt kol esboo3.

arabic: الجو برا مطر دلوقتي
english: The weather outside is rainy now.
transliteration: El gaw barra matar dilwa'ti

arabic: انا قاعد جوه البيت ومبسوط
english: I am sitting inside the house and happy.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed gowwa el beit w mabsoot

arabic: الجو دافي وجميل هنا
english: The weather is warm and beautiful here.
transliteration: El gaw dafi w gameel hena

arabic: انا عايز اشرب شاي دلوقتي
english: I want to drink tea now.
transliteration: Ana ayaz ashrab shay dilwa'ti

arabic: انا بتفرج على تليفزيون
english: I am watching television.
transliteration: Ana batfarag ala televezyon

arabic: صديقي احمد قال يلا بينا نعمل حاجة حلوة الاسبوع ده
english: My friend Ahmed said: 'Let's do something nice this week!'
transliteration: Sadi'i Ahmad 'al 'yalla bina na'mel haga helwa el-osboo3 da!'

arabic: أنا قلت فكرة كويسة عايزين نروح فين
english: I said: 'Good idea! Where do we want to go?'
transliteration: Ana 'olt 'fekrra kwayyesa! 3ayzeen nroo7 feen?'

arabic: هو رد مش عارف بصراحة ايه رأيك في اسكندرية
english: He replied: 'I don't know honestly, what do you think about Alexandria?'
transliteration: Howwa radd 'mesh 3aref bisara7a, eih ra'yak fi Eskandareyya?'

arabic: أنا قلت اه ممكن نروح هناك بكرة طبعا الجو كويس
english: I said: 'Ah, maybe we can go there tomorrow, of course the weather is good.'
transliteration: Ana 'olt 'Ah, mumkin nroo7 henak bokra, tab3an el-gaww kwayyes.'

arabic: احمد قال تمام جدا يلا نروح اسكندرية
english: Ahmed said: 'Great! Let's go to Alexandria!'
transliteration: Ahmad 'al 'Tamam geddan! Yalla nroo7 Eskandareyya!'

arabic: جدو وحسن كانوا بيتفرجوا على ماتش كورة في التليفزيون
english: Gedo and Hassan were watching a football match on TV.
transliteration: Gedo w Hassan kanoo beyetfarragoo 'ala match koora fel televezyoon

arabic: جدو قال الكورة القديمة كانت حلوة اللعب فيها بالراحة
english: Gedo said old football was good, playing slowly.
transliteration: Gedo 'al el koora el adeema kanet ḥelwa el le'b feeha bel raaḥa

arabic: حسن رد قال ايه ده اللعب البطيء ده مش حلو خالص يا جدو
english: Hassan replied, "What is this? This slow play is not good at all, Gedo."
transliteration: Hassan radd 'al eeh da el le'b el baṭee' da mush ḥelw khaaliṣ ya Gedo

arabic: حسن بيحب اللعب السريع والمهارات الجديدة اللي بتفرح
english: Hassan likes fast play and new exciting skills.
transliteration: Hassan beyeḥebb el le'b el saree' wel mahaaraat el gedeeda elle betfarraḥ

arabic: بس هما الاتنين كانوا مبسوطين وهما بيتفرجوا على الماتش مع بعض
english: But both of them were happy watching the match together.
transliteration: Bass homa el etneen kanoo mabsooṭeen w homa beyetfarragoo 'ala el match ma' ba'ḍ

arabic: امبارح اشتريت قميص بس لونه ما كانش عاجبني خالص
english: Yesterday I bought a shirt but I didn't like its color at all.
transliteration: Imbareh eshtareit ameess bas loonuh ma kanesh agabni khales
storyTitle: Returning a Shirt to the Shop

arabic: النهاردة قررت ارجع المحل عشان ارجعه
english: Today I decided to go back to the shop to return it.
transliteration: Elnaharda qarrart argaa elmahall ashan araggau
storyTitle: Returning a Shirt to the Shop

arabic: كان الشارع زحمة وسمعت مزيكا عالية طالعة من المحل
english: The street was busy and I heard loud music coming from the shop.
transliteration: Kan elsharee zahma w semeet mazeeka aalaya tal'a men elmahall
storyTitle: Returning a Shirt to the Shop

arabic: جوه المحل كانت ريحة الهدوم الجديدة قوية وكان منور اوي ومكنتش مبسوط بالقميص
english: Inside the shop, the smell of new clothes was strong and it was very bright, and I wasn't happy with the shirt.
transliteration: Gowwa elmahall kanet reehet elhedoom elgedeeda qawiyya w kan menawwar awi w makonteesh mabsoot bel ameess
storyTitle: Returning a Shirt to the Shop

arabic: لما رجعته انا كنت مبسوط ورجعت بيتي بسرعة
english: When I returned it, I was happy and went back to my house quickly.
transliteration: Lama ragga'toh ana kont mabsoot w rega't beiti besor'a
storyTitle: Returning a Shirt to the Shop

arabic: النهارده انا عايزة اطبخ طبق جديد
english: Today, I want to cook a new dish.
transliteration: Ennaharda ana ayza atbokh taba2 gideed

arabic: في الاول كان صعب شوية
english: At first, it was a little difficult.
transliteration: Fil awwal kan sa3b shwayya

arabic: بس انا عملت الاكل كويس
english: But I made the food well.
transliteration: Bas ana 3amalt el akl kwayyes

arabic: الطعم جميل جدا دلوقتي
english: The taste is very good now.
transliteration: Et-ta3m gameel giddan delwa2ti

arabic: كل البيت مبسوط بالاكل ده
english: Everyone in the house is happy with this food.
transliteration: Kol el beit mabsoot bil akl da

arabic: بفكر في رحلة للويك اند هتبقى عظيمة
english: I'm thinking about a trip for the weekend, it will be great!
transliteration: Bafakkar fi rehla lel week-end hatib2a 3azeema

arabic: ممكن نروح الفيوم مكان مشهور
english: Maybe we can go to Fayoum, it's a famous place.
transliteration: Momken nrooh el Fayoum makan mashhoor

arabic: اعتقد البحيرة هناك هتعجبك اوي
english: I think you will really like the lake there.
transliteration: A3taqed el bo7eira henāk hat3agebek awi

arabic: ناخد الكاميرا بتاعتنا نصور بيها
english: We can take our camera to take pictures with it.
transliteration: Nakhoḍ el camera beta3tna nṣawwar beeha

arabic: ايوه الرحلة دي اكيد هتبقى ممتعة لينا
english: Yes, this trip will definitely be fun for us.
transliteration: Aywa el rehla di akeed hatib2a momte3a leena

arabic: امي طلبت مني ارجع الفاكهة اللي اشتريناها
english: My mother asked me to return the fruit we bought.
transliteration: Ommy talabit minni aragga' el fakha elli eshtareenaha.

arabic: كانت البرتقال طري وريحته مش حلوة خالص
english: The oranges were soft and smelled really bad.
transliteration: Kanit el burtu'aal tari w rehto mesh helwa khales.

arabic: يلا بينا نروح المحل اللي جنب البيت
english: Let's go to the shop next to the house.
transliteration: Yalla bena nrooh el mahal elli gamb el bayt.

arabic: لما وصلت المحل الراجل شاف الفاكهة الصفرا واتاسف
english: When I arrived at the shop, the man saw the yellow fruit and apologized.
transliteration: Lamma wussalt el mahal, el ragel shaf el fakha el safra w et'assaf.

arabic: ورجعت البيت بفاكهة طازة وشكلها جميل
english: And I returned home with fresh and beautiful fruit.
transliteration: W rega't el bayt bi fakha taza w shaklaha gameel.

arabic: سارة وكريم بيخططوا لفرحهم
english: Sara and Karim are planning their wedding.
transliteration: Sara w Karim biyikhattatu lifarahhum

arabic: سارة عايزة حفلة صغيرة وجديدة
english: Sara wants a small and new party.
transliteration: Sara ayza hafla saghira w gedida

arabic: بس ماما عايزة فرح كبير وناس كتير
english: But Mom wants a big wedding with many people.
transliteration: Bas Mama ayza farah kebir w nas ketir

arabic: بابا بيقول هنا بيتنا القديم مكان كويس
english: Dad says, "Here, our old house is a good place."
transliteration: Baba bi'ul hena beitna el adiim makaan kwayyes

arabic: عندهم افكار مختلفة لليوم ده
english: They have different ideas for this day.
transliteration: Andohom afkar mokhtalefa lel yom da

arabic: انا عايز اجازة السبت والحد
english: I want a holiday on Saturday and Sunday.
transliteration: Ana ayez agaza el sabt wel had.

arabic: هنروح مع الاصحاب
english: We will go with friends.
transliteration: Hanrouh ma'a el ashaab.

arabic: عايزين نشوف النيل ونقعد في قهوة بلدي
english: We want to see the Nile and sit in a local coffee shop.
transliteration: Ayezin neshof el Nile w ne'od fi ahwa baladi.

arabic: هناكل اكل كويس وهنشرب شاي
english: We will eat good food and drink tea.
transliteration: Hanakol akl kwayyes w hanshrab shay.

arabic: لازم نجيب فلوس ونزور اهل
english: We must bring money and visit family.
transliteration: Lazim negib felous w nezawar ahl.

arabic: كل صباح انا بروح السوق
english: Every morning, I go to the market.
transliteration: Kol sabah ana barooh el soo'

arabic: باشتري خضار وفاكهة
english: I buy vegetables and fruit.
transliteration: Bashtari khodaar w fakha

arabic: وكمان باشتري عيش طازة
english: And I also buy fresh bread.
transliteration: W kaman bashtari eish taza

arabic: البياع بيقول صباح الخير
english: The seller says "Good morning".
transliteration: El bayya' bey'ool sabah el kheer

arabic: بدفع فلوس وبقول شكرا
english: I pay money and say "Thank you".
transliteration: Badfa' felous w ba'ool shokran

arabic: أمي وانا روحنا نشتري هدوم جديدة
english: My mom and I went to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Ommi w ana rooHna nishtiri hedoom gedeeda

arabic: هي كانت بتفكر في الشتا وهدوم تقيلة
english: She was thinking about winter and heavy clothes.
transliteration: Heyya kanit bitfakkar fi esh-shita w hedoom te'eela

arabic: أنا بقى كنت عايزة فستان قصير ومختلف
english: As for me, I wanted a short and different dress.
transliteration: Ana ba'a konti 'ayza fostan 'aseer w mukhtalif

arabic: هي قالت الجو مش مستقر في الربيع ده محتاج تدفئة
english: She said the weather is not stable in the spring; this needs warmth.
transliteration: Heyya 'alit el-gaww mish mustaqirr fi er-rabee' dah mehtag tadfe'a

arabic: بعد كلام كتير هي فهمت إن ذوقي غير ذوقها
english: After a lot of talking, she understood that my taste is different from hers.
transliteration: Ba'd kalam kiteer heyya fahmit inn zo'i gheir zo'ha

arabic: اليوم عيد ميلاد سارة الصغيرة
english: Today is little Sara's birthday.
transliteration: El-naharda 'eid milad Sara el-sagheera.

arabic: اصحابها بيقولوا اهلا بيكي يا سارة ومبسوطين بالالعاب الجديدة
english: Her friends say "Welcome to you, Sara" and are happy with the new games.
transliteration: Ashaabha bi'oolo ahlan beeki ya Sara w mabsooteen bel-al'aab el-gedeeda.

arabic: الجدة قاعدة وبتقول زمان العيد ميلاد كان بسيط
english: Grandma is sitting and saying, "Back then, birthdays were simple."
transliteration: El-gedda 'a'da w bet'ool zaman el-'eid milad kan baseet.

arabic: سارة بتحب الاغاني والموسيقى العالية قوي
english: Sara loves very loud songs and music.
transliteration: Sara bethebb el-aghani wel-musiqa el-3alya 'awi.

arabic: الام بتقول اهلا وسهلا للكل وكله كويس الحمد لله
english: The mother says "Welcome" to everyone and "Everything is good, praise be to God."
transliteration: El-omm bet'ool ahlan wa sahlan lel-kol w kullo kwayyes alhamdulillah.

arabic: احمد بيحب الفطار اوي
english: Ahmed loves breakfast very much.
transliteration: Ahmed bihebb el fitaar awi.

arabic: وهو بياكل بيسال ماما هو احنا بنعمل ايه في الغدا يا ماما
english: While he is eating, he asks Mama, "What are we making for lunch, Mama?"
transliteration: Wa howwa bya'kol byis'al Mama, howwa ehna bine'mel eh fel ghada ya Mama?

arabic: ماما قالت هنعمل اكل حلو بس احمد قال انا عايز عيش
english: Mama said we will make good food, but Ahmed said, "I want bread."
transliteration: Mama 'alet hane'mel akl helw bas Ahmed 'al ana 'aayez eish.

arabic: وبعدين قال انا عايز مايه كمان يا ماما
english: Then he said, "I want water too, Mama."
transliteration: Waba'dein 'al ana 'aayez maya kamaan ya Mama.

arabic: ماما بتضحك وبتقوله يا حبيبي كل اسئلتك حلوة
english: Mama laughs and tells him, "My darling, all your questions are lovely."
transliteration: Mama bitidhak wabet'uloh ya habibi koll as'eltak helwa.

arabic: أنا عايزة أطبخ أكلة جديدة أول مرة
english: I want to cook a new dish for the first time.
transliteration: Ana ʿayza aṭbukh akla gedīda awwil marra.

arabic: أمي قالت الأكل ده صعب
english: My mother said: This food is difficult.
transliteration: Ummi qālit: El-akl da ṣaʿb.

arabic: لكن جدتي كانت بتطبخ أكل قديم بس
english: But my grandmother only used to cook old food.
transliteration: Lākin gidditi kānit bituṭbukh akil qadīm bas.

arabic: أنا بحب أطبخ حاجات جديدة ومختلفة
english: I like to cook new and different things.
transliteration: Ana baḥibb aṭbukh ḥagāt gedīda wimukhtalifa.

arabic: الأكلة الجديدة دي طلعت حلوة قوي
english: This new dish turned out very good!
transliteration: El-akla el-gedīda dī ṭiliʿit ḥelwa qawi!

arabic: امبارح اشتريت طاقية من محل جديد
english: Yesterday I bought a hat from a new shop.
transliteration: Embaaare7 eshtarayt ta'eyya men ma7al gedeed.

arabic: بس الطاقية دي كانت صغيرة جدا على راسي
english: But this hat was very small for my head!
transliteration: Bas el-ta'eyya dee kanet sagheera giddan 3ala rasi!

arabic: النهاردة انا عايز ارجعها تاني للمحل
english: Today I want to return it to the shop again.
transliteration: Ennahaarda ana 3ayez aragga3ha tani lel-ma7al.

arabic: البائع شافني وقالي هو انت جاي النهاردة
english: The seller saw me and told me: "Are you coming today?"
transliteration: El-baa'e3 shafny w 2aly "howa enta gay el-nahaarda?"

arabic: ضحكت واداني فلوسي مفيش اي مشكلة
english: I laughed and he gave me my money, no problem at all.
transliteration: De7ekt w eddany felousy, mafeesh ay moshkela.

arabic: تليفوني رن الو
english: My phone rang, hello.
transliteration: Telefony rann allo

arabic: صباح الخير يا سارة ازيك
english: Good morning, Sara. How are you?
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya Sara izzayek

arabic: انا كمان تمام شكرا ليكي
english: I'm good too, thank you.
transliteration: Ana kaman tamam shokran leeki

arabic: يلا بينا نتكلم دلوقتي
english: Let's talk now.
transliteration: Yalla bena netkallem delwa'ty

arabic: مع السلامة يا صاحبتي
english: Goodbye, my friend.
transliteration: Ma'a el salama ya sahbety

arabic: العيلة كلها قاعدة على السفرة
english: The whole family is sitting at the dining table.
transliteration: El 'eila kolloha 'a'da 'ala el sofrah.

arabic: الاكل كتير وجميل اوي
english: The food is a lot and very nice.
transliteration: El akl kiteer w gameel awi.

arabic: الجدة مبسوطة والكل بياكل
english: The grandmother is happy and everyone is eating.
transliteration: El gedda mabsoota w el kol bya'kol.

arabic: الطفل الصغير عايز ياكل تاني
english: The small child wants to eat more.
transliteration: El tefl el soghayyar 'ayez ya'kol tani.

arabic: كل واحد مبسوط باللمة هنا
english: Everyone is happy with the gathering here.
transliteration: Kol wahed mabsoot bel lamma hena.

arabic: النهاردة كان فيه عيد ميلاد
english: Today there was a birthday.
transliteration: El naharda kan feih eid milad

arabic: الجدة كانت بتضحك وبتحكي قصص قديمة
english: Grandma was laughing and telling old stories.
transliteration: El gedda kanet betedhak w betheki qesas adeema

arabic: الاولاد الصغيرين كانوا بيلعبوا بالموبايلات بتاعتهم
english: The small children were playing with their mobile phones.
transliteration: El awlad el soghayyareen kanoo beyel'aboo bel mobaylat beta'tohom

arabic: كله كان فرحان بالكيكة الكبيرة
english: Everyone was happy with the big cake.
transliteration: Koloh kan farhan bel keeka el kebeera

arabic: كل جيل بيحب يفرح بطريقة مختلفة
english: Each generation likes to celebrate in a different way.
transliteration: Kol geel beyheb yefrah betare'a mokhtalefa

arabic: العيلة كلها بتتفرج على ماتش كورة في البيت
english: The whole family is watching a football match at home.
transliteration: El 3eila kolaha bitetfarag 3ala match kora fel beit.

arabic: بابا وأخويا بيحبوا الكورة وبيشجعوا فريقهم
english: Dad and my brother love football and support their team.
transliteration: Baba w akhoya biHebbu el kora w biishagga3u faree'ohom.

arabic: الجو حلو وكلنا مبسوطين مع بعض
english: The atmosphere is nice, and we are all happy together.
transliteration: El gaw helw w kollena mabsooteen ma3 ba3d.

arabic: ماما عملت أكل لذيذ وقعدنا كلنا على الكراسي
english: Mom made delicious food, and we all sat on the chairs.
transliteration: Mama 3amalet akl laziz w qa3adna kollena 3ala el karasi.

arabic: أنا بحب قعدة العيلة دي في البيت
english: I love this family gathering at home.
transliteration: Ana baHeb qa3det el 3eila di fel beit.

arabic: انا كل يوم بروح السوق
english: Every day I go to the market.
transliteration: ana kolle yom barooh el souq

arabic: عايزة اشتري خضار وفاكهة
english: I want to buy vegetables and fruit.
transliteration: ayza ashtari khodaar w fak-ha

arabic: الطماطم والبطاطس هنا كتير
english: The tomatoes and potatoes are many here.
transliteration: et-tamaatem wel bataates hena keteer

arabic: بس الموز غالي شوية
english: But the bananas are a little expensive.
transliteration: bas el moz ghali shwayya

arabic: يلا بينا نرجع البيت
english: Let's go back home.
transliteration: yalla beena nerga' el beit

arabic: صحيت متاخر النهارده يا الله
english: I woke up late today, oh my God!
transliteration: Saheet meta'akhar ennaharda ya Allah!

arabic: جريت بسرعة عشان اجهز للشغل
english: I ran quickly to get ready for work.
transliteration: Gereet be sor'a 'ashan agahhez lel shoghl.

arabic: شفت سارة وقلت لها صباح الخير يا سارة ازيك
english: I saw Sarah and told her: "Good morning Sarah, how are you?"
transliteration: Shoft Sara w oltelha: "Sabah el kheer ya Sara, izzayyik?"

arabic: شربت الشاي بتاعي بسرعة جدا ونسيت الفطار
english: I drank my tea very quickly and forgot breakfast!
transliteration: Sheribt esh-shay betaa'y be sor'a geddan w neseet el fetar!

arabic: قلت مع السلامة يا سارة مع السلامة للشغل
english: I said, "Goodbye Sarah, goodbye to work!"
transliteration: Olt: "Ma'a salama ya Sara, ma'a salama lel shoghl!"

arabic: امبارح كان عيد ميلاد جدي وعملنا حفلة كبيرة في البيت
english: Yesterday was my grandfather's birthday and we had a big party at home.
transliteration: Imbareh kan Eid milad geddi w amalna hafla kebeera fi el beit.

arabic: كبار السن كانوا فرحانين اوي وبيتكلموا على ايام زمان كتير
english: The elderly people were very happy and talked a lot about old times.
transliteration: Kobar el sann kanu farhanin awi w biyetkallemu ala ayyam zaman keteer.

arabic: لكن الشباب كانوا عايزين اغاني جديدة ويرقصوا
english: But the youth wanted new songs and to dance.
transliteration: Laken el shabab kanu ayzin aghani gedida w yor'osu.

arabic: كل الناس كلت اكل حلو وفرحت بالهدايا الكتير
english: Everyone ate good food and was happy with the many gifts.
transliteration: Koll el nas kalet akl helw w farehet bel hadaya el keteer.

arabic: الاحتفال كان مختلف لكل جيل لكن كله كان فرحان مع بعض
english: The celebration was different for each generation, but everyone was happy together.
transliteration: El ehtefal kan mokhtalef le koll geel laken kollu kan farhan ma'a ba'd.

arabic: بابا قال يلا نخطط لرحلة الويك اند
english: My father said: Let's plan the weekend trip.
transliteration: Baba 'al: Yalla nakhathat li-rehlet el-week-end.

arabic: امي قالت لازم نشتري فاكهة وخضار كتير
english: My mother said: We must buy a lot of fruit and vegetables.
transliteration: Ommy 'alet: Lazem neshtary fakha we khodaar kiteer.

arabic: هنروح سوق كبير نجيب كل حاجة
english: We will go to a big market to get everything.
transliteration: Hanrooh soo' kibeer negeeb koll haga.

arabic: بابا بيسأل كل ده بكام يا امي
english: My father asks: How much is all of this, my mother?
transliteration: Baba beyis'al: Koll da bekam ya Ommy?

arabic: احنا بنحب الرحلات ونرجع للبيت مبسوطين
english: We love trips and return home happy.
transliteration: Ehna benhebb el-rehlaat we nerga' lel-bayt mabsooteen.

arabic: صباح الخير يا علي يلا بينا نروح السوق
english: Good morning Ali, let's go to the market.
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya Ali, yalla bina nrooh el soo'.

arabic: هناك خضار وفاكهة كتير وحلوة
english: There are many good vegetables and fruits there.
transliteration: Henak khodaar we fak-ha keteer we helwa.

arabic: البياع قال صباح الخير يا ست عايزة ايه
english: The vendor said, "Good morning madam, what do you want?"
transliteration: El bayya' aal "Sabah el kheer ya sitt, aayza ee?"

arabic: قلت له عايزة طماطم لو سمحت بكام الجنيه
english: I told him, "I want tomatoes please, how much is the pound?"
transliteration: Oltelo "Aayza tamaatem law samaht, be kam el geneh?"

arabic: هو قال الجنيه بخمسة يا ست قلت تمام شكرا
english: He said, "The pound is for five, madam." I said, "Okay, thank you."
transliteration: Howa aal "El geneh be khamsa ya sitt." Olt "Tamaam shokran!"

arabic: كان فيه ولد صغير اسمه كريم
english: There was a small boy named Karim.
transliteration: Kan fih walad soghayar esmo Karim.

arabic: هو بيحب يسأل أسئلة كتير
english: He loves to ask many questions.
transliteration: Howwa bihebb yes'al as'ela kiteer.

arabic: في يوم عيلته كانت بتاكل الغدا في البيت
english: One day, his family was eating lunch at home.
transliteration: Fi yom eilto kanet beta'kol el ghada fi el beit.

arabic: كريم سأل ماما ايه الاكل دا وليه الرز هنا
english: Karim asked Mom, "What is this food? And why is the rice here?"
transliteration: Karim sa'al Mama eih el akl da w leih el rozz hena?

arabic: مامته ابتسمت وقالت ممكن نجرب ناكله
english: His mother smiled and said, "Maybe we can try to eat it."
transliteration: Mamto ebtasemet w 'alet momken negarrab naklo.

arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع و فجأة شفت صاحبي القديم احمد
english: I was walking in the street and suddenly I saw my old friend Ahmed.
transliteration: Kunt maashi fi esh-shaare' w faga'a shoft saaHbi el-adeem Ahmad.

arabic: سلمنا على بعض و هو قالي ازيك يا صاحبي عامل ايه ما شفتكش من زمان
english: We greeted each other and he said to me "How are you, my friend? How are you doing? I haven't seen you in ages."
transliteration: Sallimna 'ala ba'D w howa 'aali izzayyak ya saaHbi 'aamil eeH ma shoftaksh min zamaan.

arabic: انا قلتله انا تمام الحمد لله تيجي نقعد نشرب اي مشروب و نتكلم شوية
english: I told him, "I'm fine, thank God. Shall we sit and have a drink and talk a little?"
transliteration: Ana 'ultelu ana tamaam el-Hamdu lillaah teegy no'od neshrab ayy mashroub w netkallim shwayya.

arabic: هو قال فكرة كويسة اوي انا كنت لسه بفكر في اكله حلوة الجو الكويس في الربيع قصير
english: He said, "That's a very good idea! I was just thinking about a nice meal. The good weather in spring is short."
transliteration: Howa 'aal fekra kwayyisa awi ana kunt lessa bafakkar fi akla Helwa el-gaww el-kawayyes fi er-rabii3 'aseer.

arabic: ضحكنا و رحنا قعدنا في كافيه قريب و طلبنا مشروباتنا و قعدنا نحكي
english: We laughed and went and sat in a nearby cafe, ordered our drinks, and started chatting.
transliteration: DiHikna w roHna 'a'adna fi cafe 'orayeb w Talabna mashroubaatna w 'a'adna naHki.

arabic: مريم، طالبة الجامعة العنيدة اللي عندها خمسة وعشرين سنة، كانت بتدور بقالها ساعة في وكالة البلح على كتاب "أصول الهندسة المعمارية القديمة" ومش لاقياه خالص بالسعر اللي معاها.
english: Maryam, the stubborn 25-year-old university student, had been searching for an hour in Wekalet el-Balah for the book "Principles of Ancient Architecture" and couldn't find it at all for the price she had.
transliteration: Maryam, talibet el-gameaa el-aneeda elli 3andaha khamsa we 3eshreen sana, kanet betdawwar ba'alha sa3a fi Wekalet el-Balah 3ala ketab "Osol el-Handasa el-Me3mareya el-Adeema" we mesh la'yah khales bel-se3r elli ma3aha.

arabic: بعد ما سألت كام بياع، لقيت واحد شايب كده عنده محل كتب صغير، قعد يشرحلها إن الكتاب ده نادر وغالي أوي وبيتباع بمية وخمسين جنيه أقل حاجة.
english: After asking a few vendors, she found an old man who owned a small bookshop, who started explaining to her that this book was very rare and expensive and sold for at least 150 pounds.
transliteration: Ba3d ma sa'alet kam bayya3, la'et wahed shayeb keda 3andu ma7all kotob soghayyar, qa3ad yeshra7laha en el-ketab da nader we ghali awi we beyetba3 be miyyet we khamseen geneh a'all haga.

arabic: هي معاها تمانين جنيه بس، وقالتله: "يا عمو، طب يعني معلش، مفيش أي حاجة أقل من كده؟ ده أنا طالبة غلبانة ومش هعرف أخلّص المشروع بتاعي من غيره."
english: She only had eighty pounds, and she told him: "Uncle, well, I mean, sorry, isn't there anything less than that? I'm a poor student and I won't be able to finish my project without it."
transliteration: Heya ma3aha tamaneen geneh bas, we qaletlo: "Ya 3ammo, tab ya3ni ma3lesh, mafish ay haga a'all men keda? Da ana taliba ghalabana we mesh ha3raf akhalles el-mashrou3 beta3i men gheero."

arabic: الراجل، بعد تفكير طويل و"أهو يا بنتي" كده، قالها: "بصي يا بنتي، آخر كلام عندي مية وعشرين، لو عايزاه، مش هتعرفي تلاقيه بالسعر ده تاني خالص."
english: The man, after a long thought and a "here you go, my daughter" kind of gesture, told her: "Look, my daughter, my final offer is 120, if you want it, you won't be able to find it for this price again at all."
transliteration: El-ragel, ba3d tafkeer taweel we "aho ya benti" keda, qalelha: "Bossi ya benti, akher kalam 3andi miyyet we 3eshreen, law 3ayzah, mesh hat3rafi tela'eeh bel-se3r da tani khales."

arabic: مريم، بعد ما حسّت إن ده أملها الأخير، قررت ترجع البيت تدور على شغلانة تانية بسرعة عشان تجمع باقي الفلوس وترجعله بكرة الصبح.
english: Maryam, after feeling that this was her last hope, decided to go back home to quickly look for another job to gather the rest of the money and return to him tomorrow morning.
transliteration: Maryam, ba3d ma hasset en da amalha el-akheer, qarrarat terga3 el-beit tedawwar 3ala shoghlana tanya besor3a 3ashan tagamma3 ba'i el-felous we terga3lo bokra el-sobh.

arabic: كل يوم الاسرة بتاكل سوا في البيت
english: Every day, the family eats together at home.
transliteration: Kolle yom, el osra betakul sawa fel beit.

arabic: الاب و الام قاعدين على السفرة
english: The father and mother are sitting at the dining table.
transliteration: El ab w el omm qa'dein 'ala el sofra.

arabic: هم بياكلوا رز و لحمة و سلطة
english: They are eating rice, meat, and salad.
transliteration: Hom byaklo rozz w lahma w salata.

arabic: الاكل حلو اوي و الكل مبسوط
english: The food is very nice, and everyone is happy.
transliteration: El akl helw awi w el kol mabsoot.

arabic: بعد الاكل بيشربوا شاي سوا
english: After the food, they drink tea together.
transliteration: Ba'd el akl, byeshrabo shay sawa.

arabic: انا روحت السوق المحلي النهارده
english: I went to the local market today.
transliteration: Ana roht el sou' el ma7ally ennaharda
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: صباح الخير يا عمو عايزة فاكهة حلوة من فضلك
english: Good morning, uncle, I want sweet fruit please.
transliteration: Saba7 el kheir ya 3amo 3ayza fakha helwa min fadlak
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: البياع قال تفضلي الطبق ده بكام
english: The seller said, "Here you go, how much is this plate?"
transliteration: El bayya3 'al tafaddaly el taba' da bekam
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: انا دفعت فلوس عشرة جنيه بس
english: I paid money, ten pounds only.
transliteration: Ana dafa't felous 3ashara geneh bass
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: شكرا مع السلامة
english: Thank you, goodbye!
transliteration: Shokran ma3 el salama
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: العيلة كلها هنا مبسوطة عشان الأكل
english: The whole family is here, happy for the food.
transliteration: El 3eila kolaha hena mabsoota 3ashan el akl.

arabic: ماما بتعمل اكل حلو وكل واحد جعان
english: Mom makes good food and everyone is hungry.
transliteration: Mama bit3amal akl helw w kol wahed ga'aan.

arabic: بابا بيسأل مين عايز مية
english: Dad asks, "Who wants water?"
transliteration: Baba biyis'al "Meen 3ayiz mayya?"

arabic: سارة اختي بتضحك اوي وهي بتاكل
english: My sister Sara laughs a lot while she eats.
transliteration: Sara okhti bitidhak awi w hiyya bitakul.

arabic: كلنا بنحب قعدة العيلة دي كتير
english: We all love this family gathering a lot.
transliteration: Kolena banhebb qa3det el 3eila di keteer.

arabic: احنا عايزين اجازة الاسبوع ده
english: We want a trip this weekend.
transliteration: E7na ayzin agaza el esboo3 da.

arabic: بابا وماما عايزين مكان هادي
english: Dad and Mom want a quiet place.
transliteration: Baba w mama ayzin makan hady.

arabic: بس انا واصحابي عايزين نروح مكان زحمة ومطعم
english: But I and my friends want to go to a crowded place and a restaurant.
transliteration: Bas ana w as7aby ayzin naroo7 makan za7ma w mat3am.

arabic: جدو وتيتا بيحبوا البيت الهادي قوي
english: Grandpa and Grandma really love the quiet house.
transliteration: Gido w teta be7ebu el beet el hady awi.

arabic: ممكن نروح كلنا بالعربية مكان جميل للكل
english: Maybe we all go by car to a beautiful place for everyone.
transliteration: Momken naroo7 kollena bel 3arabeya makan gameel lel koll.

arabic: العم جه البيت وقال السلام عليكم
english: The uncle came to the house and said 'Hello'.
transliteration: El-amm geh el-beit w qal as-salamu alaykum.

arabic: كلنا قولنا وعليكم السلام وقعدنا ناكل
english: We all said 'And upon you be peace' and sat down to eat.
transliteration: Kollena olna wa alaykum as-salam w a'adna nakol.

arabic: الاكل كان حلو والجو كان دافي وجميل
english: The food was good and the atmosphere was warm and beautiful.
transliteration: El-akl kan helw wal-gaw kan dafi w gameel.

arabic: الاسرة كلها بتتكلم وتضحك مع بعض
english: The whole family talks and laughs with each other.
transliteration: El-osra kolleha betetkallem w tedhak ma' ba'd.

arabic: دي احلى لمة عيلة في مساء الخير
english: This is the best family gathering on a good evening.
transliteration: Di ahla lamma 'eila fi masa' el-kheer.

arabic: النهاردة الصبح جالي تليفون من صاحبي
english: This morning I got a phone call from my friend.
transliteration: Elnaharda elsobh galy telephon men sahby.

arabic: قلتله صباح الخير عامل ايه
english: I told him "Good morning, how are you?"
transliteration: Olto-lou sabah el kheer amel eh.

arabic: هو قال انا كويس الحمد لله
english: He said "I am good, thank God"
transliteration: Howa 'al ana kwayes elhamdolellah.

arabic: بس صوته كان مختلف انا مش فاهم
english: But his voice was different, I don't understand.
transliteration: Bas soto kan mokhtalef ana mesh fahem.

arabic: بعدين اكتشفت ان الرقم ده مش رقم صاحبي
english: Then I discovered that this number is not my friend's number.
transliteration: Ba'dein ektashaft en el raqam da mesh raqam sahby.

arabic: انا صحيت متاخر اوي
english: I woke up very late.
transliteration: Ana saheet metakha'er awi.

arabic: الساعة سبعة وال شغل بادئ
english: It's seven o'clock and work is starting.
transliteration: El saa'a sab'a wa el shoghl bade'.

arabic: انا تعبان اوي بس لازم اروح
english: I am very tired, but I must go.
transliteration: Ana ta'baan awi bas lazim arouh.

arabic: في كتير حاجة في اليوم ده
english: There are many things in this day.
transliteration: Fe keteer haga fe el youm da.

arabic: اتمنى يوم احسن
english: I wish for a better day.
transliteration: Atmanna youm ahsan.

arabic: انا سمعت صوت التليفون رن بصوت عالي
english: I heard the telephone ring loudly.
transliteration: Ana sama't sot el telefoon rann be sot 'ali

arabic: كانت صاحبتي مها بتكلمني وقالتلي ازيك
english: It was my friend Maha calling me and she said "How are you?"
transliteration: Kanat sahbeti Maha betkallemni w 'aletli izzayek

arabic: انا قلت الحمد لله كويسة وصوتها كان واضح جدا
english: I said "Praise be to God, I'm fine" and her voice was very clear.
transliteration: Ana olt el hamdulillah kwayyesa w sotaha kan wade'h geddan

arabic: احنا اتكلمنا شوية في الاوضة عندي
english: We talked a little in my room.
transliteration: Ehna etkallemna shwayya fel oda 'andy

arabic: كنت سعيدة اوي اني سمعت صوتها الحلو
english: I was very happy that I heard her sweet voice.
transliteration: Kunt sa'eeda awi enni sama't sotaha el helw

arabic: احنه عندنا فرح كبير قريب
english: We have a big wedding soon.
transliteration: Eḥna 'andena faraḥ kebir 'orayeb.

arabic: ايه اللي لازم نعمله دلوقتي يا حبيبي
english: What must we do now, my darling?
transliteration: Eih illi lazem na'melo delwa'ti ya habibi?

arabic: ممكن نشوف مكان الفرح بكره
english: We can look at the wedding venue tomorrow.
transliteration: Momken neshuf makan el-faraḥ bokra.

arabic: فين المكان ده كويس
english: Which place is good?
transliteration: Fein el-makan dah kwayes?

arabic: فيه مكان جديد جنب البيت ممكن نشوفه
english: There is a new place next to the house, we can see it.
transliteration: Fih makan gedid gamb el-beit momken neshofo.

arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع وفجأة شفت وش مألوف مش ممكن
english: I was walking in the street and suddenly I saw a familiar face, impossible!
transliteration: Kunt mashi fi el-share' wafag'a shoft wish ma'louf, mish mumkin!

arabic: طلع صاحبي القديم احمد اللي ما شفتوش بقالي كتير
english: It turned out to be my old friend Ahmed whom I hadn't seen for a long time.
transliteration: Teli' saahbi el-qadeem Ahmed elli ma shoftoosh ba'ali kiteer.

arabic: سلمت عليه بحرارة وقلتله ازيك يا احمد عامل ايه وحشتني اوي
english: I greeted him warmly and told him "How are you, Ahmed, how are you? I missed you so much."
transliteration: Sallamt 'aleih biharara w-kultelo "Izzayak ya Ahmed, aamel eh? Waheshtani awi!"

arabic: رد احمد وقالي الحمد لله بخير انت اللي عامل ايه يا صاحبي
english: Ahmed replied and told me, "Praise be to God, I'm fine. How are you, my friend?"
transliteration: Radd Ahmed w-qali "Elhamdullah bikheir, enta elli aamel eh ya saahbi?"

arabic: ضحكنا شوية ووعدنا نتقابل قريب وبعدين سلمت عليه وقلتله سلملي على عائلتك وفي رعاية الله
english: We laughed a bit and promised to meet soon, then I greeted him and told him "Say hello to your family and in God's care."
transliteration: Dehekkna shwaya w-wa'adna net'abel qareeb, waba'dein sallamt 'aleih w-kultelo "Sallimli 'ala 'a'elatak w fi re'ayet Allah."

arabic: انهارده عيد ميلاد منى
english: Today is Mona's birthday.
transliteration: Ennaharda eid milad Mona.

arabic: هي فرحانة اوي عشان صحابها هنا
english: She is very happy because her friends are here.
transliteration: Heya farhana awwi ashan sohabha hena.

arabic: هما بياكلوا اكل كتير وكيكة جميلة
english: They are eating a lot of food and beautiful cake.
transliteration: Homa biyaklo akl kiteer w keeka gameela.

arabic: منى عندها هدايا كتير دلوقتي
english: Mona has many gifts now.
transliteration: Mona 'andaha hadaya kiteer delwa'ty.

arabic: هي بتقول شكرا لكل صحابها وهي فرحانة اوي
english: She says thank you to all her friends and she is very happy.
transliteration: Heya bit'ool shukran le kull sohabha w heya farhana awwi.

arabic: النهاردة انا هطبخ اكل جديد
english: Today I will cook new food.
transliteration: El naharda ana hattabakh akel gdid.

arabic: يا صاحبي يالا نعمل الاكل ده مع بعض
english: My friend, let's make this food together.
transliteration: Ya sahby yalla na3mel el akel da ma3a ba3d.

arabic: انت حط شوية ميه هنا لو سمحت
english: You put a little water here please.
transliteration: Enta hott shwayet mayya hena law samaht.

arabic: مممم الاكل ده مش طيب خالص
english: Mmmm, this food is not tasty at all.
transliteration: Mmmm el akel da mesh tayeb khales.

arabic: آه خلصنا طبخ بس انا مش هعمله تاني
english: Ah, we finished cooking, but I won't make it again.
transliteration: Ah khalasna tabakh bas ana mesh ha3melo tani.

arabic: يلا يا امي نروح السوق الكبير نشتري فاكهة وخضار
english: Let's go, my mother, to the big market to buy fruit and vegetables.
transliteration: Yalla ya ommy nerouh el soo' el kibeer neshtary fakha w khodaar.

arabic: كان السوق زحمة اوي وريحة التوابل والفاكهة مالية المكان
english: The market was very crowded and the smell of spices and fruit filled the place.
transliteration: Kan el soo' zahma awi w rehet el tawaabel wel fakha malya el makan.

arabic: فجأة بصيت حواليّ وما لقيتش امي جنبي وحسيت إني تهت
english: Suddenly I looked around and didn't find my mother next to me and I felt that I was lost.
transliteration: Faga'a baset hawalyya w ma la'etsh ommy gamby w hasset enny tehet.

arabic: سألت راجل كبير لو سمحت ازاي ارجع للبيت من هنا
english: I asked a big man: 'Excuse me, how do I get back home from here?'
transliteration: Sa'alt raagel kibeer: 'Law samaht, ezay arga' lel bayt men hena?'

arabic: الراجل الطيب ورّاني الطريق وكنت فرحان إني وصلت بيتنا بسلام
english: The kind man showed me the way, and I was happy that I reached our home safely.
transliteration: El raagel el tayyeb warrany el taree' w kont farhan enny weselt baytna be salaam.

arabic: النهاردة انا عايز اعمل رحلة في الاجازة
english: Today I want to make a trip for the holiday.
transliteration: Elnaharda ana ayiz a'mel rehla fel egaza.

arabic: انا و صحابي ممكن نروح اسكندرية
english: My friends and I might go to Alexandria.
transliteration: Ana w sahabi mumkin nrooh eskandareya.

arabic: هناك عايزين ناكل سمك و نشرب شاي
english: There we want to eat fish and drink tea.
transliteration: Henak ayzeen nakol samak w neshrab shay.

arabic: بس مفيش فلوس كتير
english: But there isn't much money.
transliteration: Bas mafeesh foloos keteer.

arabic: خلاص هنقعد في البيت ونشرب شاي
english: Okay, we will stay at home and drink tea.
transliteration: Khalas han'od fel beet w neshrab shay.

arabic: انا عايزة اخطط لرحلة قصيرة في الويك اند ده
english: I want to plan a short trip this weekend.
transliteration: Ana 3ayza akhaTTat le-reHla 'aSeera fi el-weekend da.

arabic: بس المشكلة ان الجو مش مستقر في الربيع ده خالص
english: But the problem is that the weather is not stable at all this spring.
transliteration: Bas el-moshkela en el-gaww mish mustaqirr fi er-rabee3 da khaleS.

arabic: شكلي هقضي الوقت في البيت اقرا كتاب جديد
english: It looks like I'll spend time at home reading a new book.
transliteration: Shakli ha'aDi el-wa't fi el-beet aqra ketaab gedeed.

arabic: وهفكر في اكله حلوة ومشروبات كتير
english: And I will think about a nice meal and many drinks.
transliteration: Wa hafakkar fi akla Helwa w mashroubaat keteer.

arabic: اه فهمت خلاص الويك اند هيبقى جوه البيت
english: Ah, I got it, the weekend will be inside the house.
transliteration: Ah fahimt khalaS el-weekend hayeb'a gawwa el-beet.

arabic: صحيت بدري النهاردة وقتي قصير قوي قبل الشغل
english: I woke up early today, my time is very short before work.
transliteration: Saḥeet badri ennaharda waqti qaṣeer awi qabl esh-shoghl.

arabic: لازم اخطط كل حاجة عشان مفيش وقت يضيع
english: I have to plan everything so no time is wasted.
transliteration: Lazem akhaṭṭaṭ koll ḥaga ʿashan mafeesh waqt yeḍayyaʿ.

arabic: عملت اكلة خفيفة وشربت مشروب سخن بسرعة
english: I made a light meal and drank a hot drink quickly.
transliteration: ʿAmalt akla khafeefa we sheribt mashroub sokhn be-sorʿa.

arabic: فكرت في الاجتماعات المهمة والجو مش مستقر في الربيع
english: I thought about the important meetings and the weather is not stable in the spring.
transliteration: Fakkart fi el-egtemaʿat el-mohemma wel-gaww mesh mostaqirr fi er-rabeeʿ.

arabic: كده فهمت يومي ماشي ازاي ودلوقتي اقدر انزل الشغل
english: This way I understood how my day is going and now I can go down to work.
transliteration: Kedah fahimt yoomi mashi ezayy we delwaʾti aqdar anzil esh-shoghl.

arabic: صباح الخير يا تيتا نورا دخلت المطبخ وهي بتقول السلام عليكم
english: "Good morning, Grandma." Noura entered the kitchen saying "peace be upon you."
transliteration: Sabah el-kheer ya Teta. Noura dakhalit el-matbakh we hiyya bat'ool as-salam alaykum.

arabic: تيتا ردت وعليكم السلام يا حبيبتي بس دلوقتي صباح مش مساء الخير
english: Grandma replied, "And peace be upon you, my dear, but now it's morning, not good evening."
transliteration: Teta raddet wa alaykum as-salam ya habibti bas dilwa'ti sabah mish masaa' el-kheer.

arabic: نورا ما اهتمتش وبسرعة سألت ليه لازم ناكل خضار وكل فين وفين الشمس بتروح
english: Noura didn't care and quickly asked, "Why must we eat vegetables and where does the sun go sometimes?"
transliteration: Noura ma ihtammitsh we bosor'a sa'alet leeh lazim nakol khodar we koll feen we feen el-shams betrooh?

arabic: تيتا ابتسمت بتعب وقالت لما كنا صغيرين ماكناش بنسأل كل الأسئلة دي
english: Grandma smiled tiredly and said, "When we were young, we didn't ask all these questions."
transliteration: Teta ibtasamet be-ta'ab we 'alet lamma kunna soghayyareen ma-konnash benis'al koll el-as'ela di.

arabic: نورا بصتلها وقالت بس ليه يا تيتا إحنا بنسأل عشان نفهم كل حاجة
english: Noura looked at her and said, "But why, Grandma? We ask to understand everything!"
transliteration: Noura bassetil-ha we 'alet bas leeh ya Teta ehna benis'al 'ashan nefham koll haga?

arabic: انا جعان النهاردة وعايز اعمل اكل جديد في بيتي
english: I am hungry today and want to cook a new dish in my house.
transliteration: Ana gaaan ennarda w ayiz aamel akl gedid fi beiti
storyTitle: A New Dish and a Surprise

arabic: جبت كل المكونات وبدات اطبخ الوصفة اللي لقيتها على تليفوني
english: I got all the ingredients and started cooking the recipe I found on my phone.
transliteration: Gebt kol el mokawwenat w bad'at atbokh el wasfa elli la'etha ala telefooni
storyTitle: A New Dish and a Surprise

arabic: لما خلصت الطبخة كنت مبسوط جدا وشكلها كان حلو اوي
english: When I finished the dish, I was very happy and it looked really good.
transliteration: Lama khallasst ettabkha kont mabsoot geddan w shaklaha kan helw awi
storyTitle: A New Dish and a Surprise

arabic: دوقته عشان اتاكد من الطعم بس اكتشفت اني نسيت احط الملح خالص
english: I tasted it to check the flavor, but I discovered that I completely forgot to add salt.
transliteration: Do'to ashan at'akked men el ta'm bas ektashaft enni neseet ahott el malh khales
storyTitle: A New Dish and a Surprise

arabic: دلوقتي انا جعان تاني ومش هقدر اكل الطبق ده يبقى لازم اطلب اكل
english: Now I am hungry again and I can't eat this dish, so I have to order food.
transliteration: Delwa'ti ana gaaan tani w mesh ha'dar akol el taba' da yeb'a lazim atlob akl
storyTitle: A New Dish and a Surprise

arabic: ريحة البن مالية الجو في اهوة ابو شقرة.
english: The smell of coffee filled the air at Ahwa Abou Shakra.
transliteration: Rihet el-bon malya el-gaw fi Ahwa Abou Shakra.

arabic: منى طالبة عشرين سنة مجبورة تذاكر الدرس ده.
english: Mona, a twenty-year-old student, is forced to study this lesson.
transliteration: Mona talba ishrin sana, magboura tzakir el-dars dah.

arabic: مسكت المنيو وقالت للويتر: "مفيش قهوة سادة؟"
english: She held the menu and said to the waiter: "Isn't there plain coffee?"
transliteration: Meseket el-menyu w'alet lel-waiter: "Mafeesh ahwa sada?"

arabic: رد: "لا، فيه قهوة مظبوط بخمسة جنيه، عادي."
english: He replied: "No, there is medium coffee for five pounds, normal."
transliteration: Radd: "La, fih ahwa mazbout bekhamsa geneh, aadi."

arabic: منى بتجيب كتابها وبتشرب قهوتها، لازم تخلص.
english: Mona gets her book and drinks her coffee, she must finish.
transliteration: Mona betgeeb ketabha w'beteshrab ahwetha, lazem tekhlas.

arabic: ريحة الشاي بالنعناع والخشب القديم مالت الجو في قهوة الفيشاوي بالخان الخليلي؛ كريم، طالب جامعي عنده 22 سنة وشوية خجول، كان قاعد بكتاب الدرس بتاعه.
english: The smell of mint tea and old wood filled the air at Ahwet El-Fishawy in Khan el-Khalili; Kareem, a 22-year-old shy university student, sat there with his study book for the lesson.
transliteration: Rihet esh-shay bel-na'na' wel-khashab el-qadeem malet el-gaww fi ahwet el-Fishawy bel-Khan el-Khalili; Kareem, taleb gam'i 'ando 22 sana w shwayet khagul, kan qa'ed be-ketab el-dars beta'o.

arabic: هو كان بيفكر يطلب إيه، عايز قهوة مظبوط، بس مكسوف شوية من الزحمة، لا، مفيش قهوة في البيت وأمه مجبورة تضل بالبيت، عشان كده هو لازم يشتري قهوة هنا.
english: He was thinking about what to order, wanting a medium-sweet coffee, but a bit shy because of the crowd; no, there was no coffee at home and his mother was forced to stay home, so he had to buy coffee here.
transliteration: Howwa kan beyfakkar yetlob eih, 'ayez ahwa mazboot, bas maksouf shwaya men ez-zahma, la, mafish ahwa fel-beit w ommo magbura tedall bel-beit, 'ashan keda howwa lazim yeshtari ahwa hena.

arabic: فكر في أبوه اللي كان بيعلمه "لازم تكون واضح يا ابني"، وبص على الوادل اللي باين عليه بيروح الشغل كل يوم ده، وقرر إنه لازم يطلب حالا عشان لازم ندرس للامتحان.
english: He thought of his father, who always taught him, "You must be clear, my son," and looked at the waiter who clearly goes to work every day, then decided he must order now because they must study for the exam.
transliteration: Fakkar fi abooh elly kan beya'allimoh "lazim takoon wadeh ya ebny," w bass 'ala el-wadil elly bayen 'aleih beyrouh esh-shoghl koll yom dah, w qarar enno lazim yetlob halan 'ashan lazim nedres lel-emtehan.

arabic: نادى الوادل، اللي قاله: "لو سمحت يا أستاذ، أنا بجيب الأكل لنفسي دايماً عشان أركز في دراستي، فممكن قهوة مظبوط بخمسة عشر جنيه؟"
english: He called the waiter, who he told: "Excuse me, استاذ, I always get food for myself to focus on my studies, so could I have a medium-sweet coffee for fifteen pounds?"
transliteration: Nada el-wadil, elly qaloh: "Law samaht ya ostaz, ana bagib el-akl le-nafsi dayman 'ashan arakkiz fi deraseti, fa momkin ahwa mazboot be-khamsata 'ashar geneh?"

arabic: الوادل جاب القهوة بسرعة، وكريم حس إنه مبسوط عشان طلب صح، وبدأ يفتح كتابه عشان يكمل الدرس.
english: The waiter brought the coffee quickly, and Kareem felt happy because he ordered correctly, and started to open his book to continue the lesson.
transliteration: El-wadil gab el-ahwa be-sor'a, w Kareem hass enno mabsoot 'ashan talab sahh, w bada' yeftah ketabo 'ashan yekammel el-dars.

arabic: منى، الطالبة اللي عندها 22 سنة ودايماً بتنسى حاجات، افتكرت فجأة إنها مجبورة تسافر بكير للقاهرة ونسيت أهم كتاب للدرس في بيت أبوها.
english: Mona, the 22-year-old student who always forgets things, suddenly remembered that she was forced to travel early to Cairo and forgot the most important book for the lesson at her father's house.
transliteration: Mona, el-taliba elly 'andaha 22 sana we-daayman betensa hagaat, eftekaret faga'a ennaha magboora tesaafer bakkeer lel-Qahira we-nesyet aham ketaab lel-dars fe beet aboo-ha.

arabic: هي كانت خلاص في محطة رمسيس، الساعة سبعة الصبح، والقطر بتاعها فاضل له نص ساعة، وهي كانت عايزة الكتاب ده خالص.
english: She was already at Ramses Station, seven in the morning, and her train had half an hour left, and she really wanted that book.
transliteration: Heyya kanet khalaas fe mahattet Ramsis, el-saa'a sab'a el-sobh, wel-qatr beta'ha fadhel loh noss saa'a, we-heyya kanet 'ayza el-ketaab dah khales.

arabic: قالت لنفسها: "لا، مفيش وقت ضايع، أنا لازم أروح هلا وأجيب الكتاب قبل ما القطر يمشي، حتى لو هركب تاكسي بـ 50 جنيه".
english: She said to herself: "No, there's no time to waste, I must go now and get the book before the train leaves, even if I take a taxi for 50 pounds."
transliteration: Qalet le-nafseha: "La, mafish wa't daye', ana laazem arooh halla we-ageeb el-ketaab qabl ma el-qatr yemshee, hatta law harkab taksy b-50 geneh."

arabic: بالظبط، هي جريت بسرعة ولقيت تاكسي أصفر قديم، وقالت للسواق "عايزة أروح بيت والدي في شبرا بسرعة، لو سمحت!".
english: Exactly, she ran quickly and found an old yellow taxi, and told the driver, "I want to go to my father's house in Shubra quickly, please!"
transliteration: Bel-zabt, heyya gereet be-sor'a we-la'et taksy asfar qadeem, we-qalet lel-sawwa' "'Ayza arooh beet walady fe Shubra be-sor'a, law samaht!"

arabic: بعد ما وصلت بيت أبوها وجابت الكتاب، رجعت المحطة ومبسوطة، كانت خلاص مستعدة للدرس الجديد ولما هتوصل الإسكندرية هتبدأ تذاكر.
english: After she arrived at her father's house and got the book, she returned to the station happy; she was now ready for the new lesson, and when she arrives in Alexandria, she will start studying.
transliteration: Ba'd ma wasalet beet aboo-ha we-gabet el-ketaab, rege'et el-mahatta we-mabsoota, kanet khalaas mosta'edda lel-dars el-gedeed we-lamma hatowsal el-Eskendereyya hatabda' tezaaker.

arabic: رحت بيت جدتي الكبير
english: I went to my big grandmother's house.
transliteration: roht beit geddety el-kabeer

arabic: فتحت الباب و سمعت صوتها الحلو
english: I opened the door and heard her sweet voice.
transliteration: fataht el-bab we sema't sot-ha el-helw

arabic: كان فيه ريحة اكل حلوة في البيت
english: There was a nice smell of food in the house.
transliteration: kan fee reehet akl helwa fel-beit

arabic: قعدنا ناكل و نشرب شاي
english: We sat, ate, and drank tea.
transliteration: 'a'adna nakol we neshrab shay

arabic: كنت مبسوط اوي معاها
english: I was very happy with her.
transliteration: kont mabsoot awi ma'aha

arabic: صباح الخير يا عمو احمد، ازي حضرتك؟
english: Good morning, Uncle Ahmed, how are you?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya Ammu Ahmed, izzay hadretak?

arabic: صباح النور يا منى، اهلا بيكي! عاملة ايه يا بنتي؟
english: Good morning, Mona, welcome! How are you, my daughter?
transliteration: Sabah el-nour ya Mona, ahlan beeki! Aamla eh ya benti?

arabic: الحمد لله يا عمو احمد، انا كويسة خالص... ايه ده، ايه الاخبار؟
english: Thank God, Uncle Ahmed, I'm very good... What's new, what's the news?
transliteration: El-hamdu lellah ya Ammu Ahmed, ana kwayyisa khales... Eh da, eh el-akhbar?

arabic: طب تشربي شاي؟ الدراسة عاملة ايه معاكي يا حبيبتي؟
english: So, will you drink tea? How are your studies doing, my dear?
transliteration: Tab teshrabi shay? El-derasa aamla eh ma'aaki ya habibti?

arabic: ايوه، ماشي، الدراسة كويسة، معلش، كنت عايزة اسألك عن شغل.
english: Yes, okay, studies are good, excuse me, I wanted to ask you about work.
transliteration: Aywa, mashi, el-derasa kwayyisa, ma'alesh, kunt ayza as'alak an shoghl.

arabic: مها اكتشفت إن موبايلها فاصل وهي متأخرة خالص على سارة.
english: Maha realized that her phone was dead and she was very late for Sara.
transliteration: Maha aktashafet en mobayelha fasel we heya met'akhara khales 3ala Sara.

arabic: جريت بسرعة، قالت "صباح الفل" لعم محمود البواب، وسألته "إزيك يا عم محمود؟"
english: She ran quickly, said "good morning" to Uncle Mahmoud the doorman, and asked him "how are you, Uncle Mahmoud?"
transliteration: Geret be sor3a, 'alet "sabah el foll" le 3amm Mahmoud el bawab, we sa'alto "ezzayak ya 3amm Mahmoud?"

arabic: صاحب القهوة، عم خالد، شافها داخلة مستعجلة وسلم عليها: "أهلاً يا مها، عاملة إيه النهاردة؟"
english: The coffeehouse owner, Uncle Khaled, saw her rushing in and greeted her: "Welcome, Maha, how are you today?"
transliteration: Sa7eb el ahwa, 3amm Khaleed, shafha dakhla mesta3gala we sallim 3aleiha: "Ahlan ya Maha, 3amla eih el naharda?"

arabic: مها ردت: "الحمد لله يا عم خالد، سارة موجودة؟" وهي بتبص حواليها.
english: Maha replied: "Thank God, Uncle Khaled, is Sara here?" while looking around her.
transliteration: Maha raddet: "Alhamdulillah ya 3amm Khaleed, Sara mawgoda?" we heya betboss hawaliha.

arabic: بعدين شافت سارة، وشاورتلها وقالت "إزيك يا سارة! عاملة إيه يا حبيبتي؟"
english: Then she saw Sara, waved to her, and said "Hello, Sara! How are you, my dear?"
transliteration: Ba3dein shafet Sara, we shawertelha we 'alet "Ezzayek ya Sara! 3amla eih ya habibty?"

arabic: علي، طالب جامعي عنده 22 سنة، واقف قدام مكتبة في خان الخليلي، مجتهد بس أحيانًا بينسى مواعيده. شاف عم حامد، البواب بتاع المحل اللي جنبه، وقال له: "صباح الخير يا عمو! إزيك عامل إيه؟"
english: Aly, a 22-year-old university student, stood in front of a bookstore in Khan el-Khalili, diligent but sometimes forgetting his appointments. He saw Uncle Hamed, the doorman of the shop next to it, and said to him: "Good morning, Uncle! How are you doing?"
transliteration: Aly, taleb gamiey andu 22 sana, waqef oddam maktaba fi Khan el-Khalili, mugtahed bas ahianan biensa mawaidu. Shaf am Hamed, el-bawwab beta el-mahal elli ganbu, w qallu: "Sabah el-kheir ya ammo! Izzayak amel eh?"
storyTitle: A Book's Journey in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: عم حامد رد بابتسامة: "صباح النور يا علي! كويس الحمد لله، إيه اللي مصحيك بدري كده؟ أنت لازم تروح الدرس بتاعك؟" علي قال: "أيوه، أنا مجبور ألاقي كتاب للدرس دلوقتي، ومش لاقيه هنا. المكتبة قافلة."
english: Uncle Hamed replied with a smile: "Good morning, Aly! I'm fine, thank God. What got you up so early like this? Do you have to go to your lesson?" Aly said: "Yes, I am forced to find a book for the lesson now, and I can't find it here. The bookstore is closed."
transliteration: Am Hamed radd be-ebtisama: "Sabah el-noor ya Aly! Kwayyes el-hamdu lellah, eh elli masahhik badri keda? Enta lazim teruh el-dars betaak?" Aly qal: "Aywa, ana magboor ala'i ketab lel-dars delwa'ty, w mesh la'ieh hena. El-maktaba qafla."
storyTitle: A Book's Journey in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: عم حامد شاور على قهوة قريبة وقال: "يا ابني، متقلقش. أهو، روح قهوة الحاج فؤاد اللي هناك، يمكن تلاقي أَب صاحبك، عمو محمود، هو دايماً هناك الصبح بدري، ودايماً بيجيب كتاب معاه."
english: Uncle Hamed pointed to a nearby coffeehouse and said: "Son, don't worry. There, go to Hajj Fouad's coffeehouse over there, maybe you'll find your friend's father, Uncle Mahmoud; he's always there early in the morning, and he always brings a book with him."
transliteration: Am Hamed shawar ala ahwa qariba w qal: "Ya ebny, matqalqish. Aho, ruh ahwet el-Hag Fouad elli henaka, yumkin tala'i ab sahibak, ammo Mahmoud, howa dayman henaka el-sobh badri, w dayman biygeeb ketab ma'ah."
storyTitle: A Book's Journey in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: علي راح على القهوة، وفعلاً لقى عمو محمود قاعد بيشرب شاي وبيتصفح كتاب. سلم عليه بحماس: "أهلاً يا عمو محمود! إزيك يا جميل؟" عمو محمود قال: "أهلاً بيك يا علي! أنا كويس الحمد لله، لما بكون مبسوط كده بقعد هنا."
english: Aly went to the coffeehouse, and indeed found Uncle Mahmoud sitting, drinking tea and browsing a book. He greeted him enthusiastically: "Hello, Uncle Mahmoud! How are you, beautiful?" Uncle Mahmoud said: "Welcome, Aly! I'm fine, thank God. When I'm happy like this, I sit here."
transliteration: Aly rah ala el-ahwa, w fa'lan laqa ammo Mahmoud qa'ed biyeshrab shay w biyetsaflah ketab. Sallim aleih behamas: "Ahlan ya ammo Mahmoud! Izzayak ya gameel?" Ammo Mahmoud qal: "Ahlan beek ya Aly! Ana kwayyes el-hamdu lellah, lamma bakoon mabsoot keda baq'ud hena."
storyTitle: A Book's Journey in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: علي شرح له مشكلته، وعمو محمود رد: "بالظبط! أنا معايا كتاب الدرس اللي أنت عايزه ده، خده. أنا بروح الشغل كل يوم بعد القهوة. أنت لازم تدرس للامتحان كويس جداً." علي رد: "ألف شكر يا عمو! مع السلامة دلوقتي، أنا لازم أروح أذاكر بيه فوراً!"
english: Aly explained his problem to him, and Uncle Mahmoud replied: "Exactly! I have the lesson book you want, take it. I go to work every day after the coffeehouse. You must study very well for the exam." Aly responded: "A thousand thanks, Uncle! Goodbye for now, I must go study with it immediately!"
transliteration: Aly sharah lu mushkeltu, w ammo Mahmoud radd: "Bel-zabt! Ana ma'aya ketab el-dars elli enta ayezuh da, khoduh. Ana baruh el-shoghl kull yom ba'd el-ahwa. Enta lazim tedrus lel-emtihan kwayyes geddan." Aly radd: "Alf shokr ya ammo! Ma'a el-salama delwa'ty, ana lazim aruh azaker beih fawran!"
storyTitle: A Book's Journey in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: أنا عادل، بدرس كتاب.
english: I am Adel, I study a book.
transliteration: Ana Adel, badros kitab.

arabic: أنا أَبُو إبراهيم، ببيع هنا.
english: I am Abu Ibrahim, I sell here.
transliteration: Ana Abu Ibrahim, babee' hena.

arabic: الدرس ده لازم أقراه.
english: This lesson I must read.
transliteration: El-dars da lazem aqrah.

arabic: لا، هي مجبورة تضل.
english: No, she is forced to stay.
transliteration: La, heya magboora tedall.

arabic: أنا بجيب الأكل.
english: I get the food.
transliteration: Ana bagib el-akl.

arabic: ريحة الكتب القديمة ملَت الفصل.
english: The smell of old books filled the classroom.
transliteration: Reehet el kotob el qadima malet el fasl.

arabic: ليلى كانت بتدرس كتاب الدرس بجد.
english: Laila was studying the lesson book diligently.
transliteration: Laila kanet betedres ketab el dars begad.

arabic: هي مجبورة تفهم الدرس ده كويس.
english: She has to understand this lesson well.
transliteration: Heya magboura tefham el dars dah kowayes.

arabic: طب، هي قررت تكلم أبوها يساعدها.
english: So, she decided to talk to her father to help her.
transliteration: Tab, heya qararet tekallem abouha yesa3edha.

arabic: هو قال: لازم ندرس للامتحان كويس.
english: He said: We must study for the exam well.
transliteration: Howa qal: Lazem nedres lel emtehan kowayes.

arabic: صباح الخير يا عم سيد! إيه ده، مش كنت خرجت خلاص؟
english: Good morning, Uncle Sayed! What's this, didn't you retire already?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya 3amm Sayed! Eh da, mesh kont kharagt khalas?

arabic: عم سيد رد: "أهلاً يا نادية! عاملة إيه؟ فكرت في الشغل تاني."
english: Uncle Sayed replied: "Welcome, Nadia! How are you? I thought about work again."
transliteration: 3amm Sayed radd: "Ahlan ya Nadia! 3amla eh? Fakkart fi el-shoghl tani."

arabic: أنا كويسة. الجو الكويس في الربيع قصير خالص.
english: I'm good. The good weather in spring is really short.
transliteration: Ana kwayyesa. El-gaww el-kwayyes fi el-rabee3 2aseer khales.

arabic: فهمت. إيه رايك في الكتب؟ عايزة كتاب جديد اقراه.
english: I got it. What's your opinion on the books? I want a new book to read.
transliteration: Fehemt. Eh ra'yak fi el-kotob? 3ayza ketab gedid aqraah.

arabic: يلا بينا! خططت نقعد على قهوة، وناكل كشري.
english: Let's go! I planned for us to sit at a coffee shop, and eat koshari.
transliteration: Yalla bina! Khattatt noq3od 3ala ahwa, w nakol koshary.

arabic: سيف طفل شاطر بس بيسأل كتير قوي كل يوم
english: Seif is a clever child but he asks a lot of questions every day.
transliteration: Seif tifl shater bas biyes'al keteer awi kol yom

arabic: باباه صحي الصبح قاله صباح الخير يا سيف ازيك يا حبيبي
english: His dad woke up in the morning and said to him "Good morning Seif, how are you my darling?"
transliteration: Babah sehi el-sobh 'alo sabah el-kheer ya Seif izzayyak ya habibi

arabic: سيف رد انا كويس الحمد لله بس يا بابا ليه الشمس لونها اصفر
english: Seif replied "I'm good, alhamdulillah, but dad, why is the sun yellow?"
transliteration: Seif radd ana kwayyes alhamdulillah bas ya baba leh el-shams lonha asfar

arabic: وبعدين سأل ليه القطة بتنام على الكنبة وليه القهوة مرة
english: And then he asked why the cat sleeps on the couch and why coffee is bitter.
transliteration: Wa ba'dein sa'al leh el-'otta bitnam 'ala el-kanaba wa leh el-'ahwa morra

arabic: باباه ابتسم وقاله ما خلاص يا حبيبي مع السلامة عشان الشغل
english: His dad smiled and told him "That's enough, my darling, goodbye for work."
transliteration: Babah ibtasam we 'alo ma khalas ya habibi ma'a salama 'ashan el-shoghl

arabic: الدنيا بتمطر جامد برا البيت والجو شبه الشتا
english: It's raining heavily outside the house and the weather is like winter.
transliteration: El donia betmaTTar gamed barra el beit wel gaww shabah el sheta

arabic: انا قاعد جوه وبشرب مشروب سخن وبفكر في كتاب جديد اقراه
english: I'm sitting inside, drinking a hot beverage and thinking about a new book to read.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed gowwa w bashrab mashroub sokhn w bafakkar fi ketaab gedeed aqraah

arabic: دي فرصة حلوة اعمل اكلة لذيذة واقضي وقت هادي في البيت
english: This is a nice chance to make a delicious meal and spend quiet time at home.
transliteration: Di forsa helwa a'mel akla laziza w aqDi waqt hadi fi el beit

arabic: فجأة سمعت صوت غريب جاي من البلكونة صوت مش طبيعي
english: Suddenly I heard a strange sound coming from the balcony, an unnatural sound.
transliteration: Fag'a sema't soot ghareeb gayy men el balkona soot mish tabi'i

arabic: طلعت ابص لقيت قطة صغيرة ماسكة مضلة ملونة ومستخبية من المطرة
english: I went out to look and found a small cat holding a colorful umbrella, hiding from the rain.
transliteration: Tala't aboss laqeet oTTa soghayyara mas'ka maDalla melawwana w mostakhabya men el maTara

arabic: الاسرة عايزة تعمل رحلة حلوة في الويك اند
english: The family wants to make a nice trip on the weekend.
transliteration: El osra ayza taamel rehla helwa fel week end.

arabic: الجدة عايزة مكان هادي جدا بعيد عن الناس
english: Grandma wants a very quiet place far from people.
transliteration: El gedda ayza makan hady geddan ba'eed 'an el nas.

arabic: الشباب عايزين اتنين او تلاته اماكن جديدة فيها بحر او العاب
english: The youth want two or three new places with a beach or games.
transliteration: El shabab ayzeen etneen aw talata amaken gedida feeha bahr aw al'ab.

arabic: هما قعدوا يتكلموا عشان يخططوا لمده اربعه ساعات
english: They sat talking to plan for four hours.
transliteration: Homa 'a'ado yetkallemo 'ashan yekhatato lemoddet arba'a sa'at.

arabic: في الاخر قرروا يعملوا واحد يوم هنا و يوم تاني هناك عشان كل واحد مبسوط
english: In the end, they decided to do one day here and another day there so everyone is happy.
transliteration: Fel akher qarraro ya'melo wahed yoom hena w yoom tany henak 'ashan kol wahed mabsoot.

arabic: انا صحيت بدري النهاردة عشان عندي شغل كتير
english: I woke up early today because I have a lot of work.
transliteration: Ana seheet badry ennaharda ashan andy shoghl keteer.

arabic: امي قالتلي يا احمد محتاجين فاكهة وخضار للبيت مفيش حاجة
english: My mother told me, "Ahmed, we need fruit and vegetables for the house, there's nothing."
transliteration: Ommy a'aletly "Ya Ahmed, mehtageen fakha w khodaar lelbayt, mafeesh haga."

arabic: رديت عليها بس يا امي انا مستعجل جدا ومش هلحق اروح السوق الكبير
english: I replied to her, "But mother, I'm very rushed and won't have time to go to the big market."
transliteration: Raddayt alayha "Bas ya ommy, ana mesta'gel geddan w mesh halha' arooh es-soo' el kibeer."

arabic: قالتلي يلا فيه واحد فاتح قريب نسأل بكام التفاح ونشتري
english: She told me, "Let's go, there's one open nearby, we'll ask how much the apples are and buy."
transliteration: A'aletly "Yalla, feeh wahed fateh 'orayyeb, nes'al bekam et-toffah w neshtary."

arabic: تمام يا امي يلا بينا بس لازم ارجع البيت بسرعه عشان الشغل
english: "Okay, mother, let's go, but I need to return home quickly for work."
transliteration: Tamam ya ommy, yalla beena, bas lazim arga' el bayt besor'a ashan esh-shoghl.

arabic: الو ازيك يا حبيبي
english: Hello, how are you, my dear?
transliteration: Alo ezayyik ya habibi?

arabic: كله تمام عندك في البيت
english: Is everything good at your house?
transliteration: Kollo tamam 'andak fel beyt?

arabic: ماما وبابا عاملين ايه
english: How are Mom and Dad doing?
transliteration: Mama w baba 'amleen eh?

arabic: انا عايز أكلمك تاني بكرة
english: I want to talk to you again tomorrow.
transliteration: Ana 'ayez akallimak tani bokra.

arabic: مع السلامة يا عمري
english: Goodbye, my love.
transliteration: Ma'a salama ya 'omri.

arabic: القطه تعبانة شوية
english: The cat is a little sick.
transliteration: El otta ta3bana shwaya

arabic: هي مش عايزة تشرب اللبن
english: She doesn't want to drink the milk.
transliteration: Heya mesh 3ayza teshrab el laban

arabic: الولد زعلان اوي عشان القطه
english: The boy is very sad because of the cat.
transliteration: El walad za3lan awy 3ashan el otta

arabic: هو نادى على ابوه بسرعة
english: He called his father quickly.
transliteration: Howa nada 3ala abuh besor3a

arabic: بابا القطه تعبانة مش بتنام كويس
english: Dad, the cat is sick, she doesn't sleep well.
transliteration: Baba el otta ta3bana mesh betnam kwayyes

arabic: النهارده شفت واحد صاحبي القديم جنب المدرسه
english: Today I saw one of my old friends next to the school.
transliteration: Elnaharda shoft wahed sahby el'adeem gamb elmadrasa.

arabic: كان معاه ابنه الصغير عنده خمس سنين
english: He had his small son with him, five years old.
transliteration: Kan ma'ah ebno elsoghayar 'ando khamas saneen.

arabic: سلمنا بحراره وقعدنا نشرب شاي سوا
english: We greeted warmly and sat to drink tea together.
transliteration: Sallamna beha'rara we qa'adna neshrab shay sawa.

arabic: ابنه كان لابس تيشرت احمر ولعب مع قطه حلوه
english: His son was wearing a red t-shirt and played with a pretty cat.
transliteration: Ebno kan labes teeshert ahmar we le'eb ma'a otta helwa.

arabic: كان يوم حلو اوي بعد سنين طويله
english: It was a very nice day after many long years.
transliteration: Kan yom helw awi ba'd saneen taweela.

arabic: صباح الخير يا سارة إزيكِ أنا كويسة الحمد لله
english: Good morning Sarah, how are you? I'm good, alhamdulillah.
transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer ya Sara, izzayyik? Ana kwayyesa, alhamdulillah.

arabic: فكرت نعمل رحلة حلوة إسكندرية الويك إند الجاي
english: I thought we could do a nice trip to Alexandria next weekend.
transliteration: Fakkart na'mel re7la 7elwa Eskendereya el-week end el-gay.

arabic: هناك نشوف البحر الأزرق ونشم هوا نضيف
english: There we will see the blue sea and smell clean air.
transliteration: Henak nishoof el-ba7r el-azraq we neshemm hawa nideef.

arabic: ونجيب سمك طازة وناكل جنب المينا
english: And we'll get fresh fish and eat next to the harbor.
transliteration: We nigeeb samak taze we nakol ganb el-meena.

arabic: يا سلام هيكون ويك إند تحفة ومبسوطين أوي
english: Oh wow, it will be an amazing weekend and we'll be very happy.
transliteration: Ya salam haykoon week end to7fa we mabsooteen awi.

arabic: انا صحيت النهارده وقررت ازور عمتي
english: I woke up today and decided to visit my aunt.
transliteration: Ana saheet elnaharda w qarrart azor amaty

arabic: مفيش قهوة في بيتي الصبح
english: There is no coffee at my house in the morning.
transliteration: Mafish ahwa fi beity elsobh

arabic: علشان كده اشتريت قهوة من اوبر ايتس
english: That's why I bought coffee from Uber Eats.
transliteration: Alashan keda eshtareet ahwa men Uber Eats

arabic: انا مبسوط جدا اني شفت عمتي
english: I am very happy that I saw my aunt.
transliteration: Ana mabsoot geddan inni shoft amaty

arabic: لما بكون مبسوط بكلم اصحابي بعد الزيارة
english: When I am happy, I talk to my friends after the visit.
transliteration: Lama bakoon mabsoot bakallem ashabi ba'd elziyara

arabic: يا عمو، واحد قهوة مظبوط لو سمحت.
english: Uncle, one mazboot coffee please.
transliteration: Ya 3ammu, waḥid 'ahwa maẓbuṭ law samaḥt.

arabic: هاني كان قاعد بيفكر في شغل جديد.
english: Hany was sitting, thinking about a new job.
transliteration: Hany kan qa3id biyfakkar fi shughl gidid.

arabic: عايز يقدم على وظيفة في شركة الإعلانات الكبيرة.
english: He wants to apply for a job at the big ad company.
