transliteration: 3ayiz yiqaddim 3ala waẓifa fi shariket el-i3lanat el-kabira.

arabic: بس اللاب توب بتاعه قديم والإعلانات بتظهر كتير.
english: But his laptop is old and ads appear a lot.
transliteration: Bas el-laptop bita3u qadim wel-i3lanat bitizhar kitir.

arabic: الشركة دي عملت حملة إعلانات حلوة أوي.
english: This company made a very good ad campaign.
transliteration: El-sharika di 3amalet ḥamlit i3lanat ḥilwa 'awi.

arabic: دفع خمسة جنيه للقهوة، وهو بيحوش جزء من مصروفه.
english: He paid five pounds for the coffee, and he saves a part of his allowance.
transliteration: Dafa3 khamsa ginēh lil-'ahwa, wahuwa biyḥawwish guz' min maṣrufuh.

arabic: كان بيفكر في عروض المنتجات اللي شافها.
english: He was thinking about product offers he saw.
transliteration: Kan biyfakkar fi 3uruḍ el-muntagat elli shafha.

arabic: فجأة، فكرة حلوة خليته يبتسم، وقرر يكمل.
english: Suddenly, a good idea made him smile, and he decided to continue.
transliteration: Fag'a, fikra ḥilwa khallētuh yibtisim, wa qarrar yikammil.

arabic: الفكرة كانت عن جزء في حملة الإعلانات بتاعت الشركة.
english: The idea was about a part in the company's ad campaign.
transliteration: El-fikra kanat 3an guz' fi ḥamlit el-i3lanat bita3t el-sharika.

arabic: هيفضل يشتغل عليها الليلة دي ويقدم بكره.
english: He will continue working on it tonight and apply tomorrow.
transliteration: Hayifḍal yishtaghal 3alēha el-lēla di w-yiqaddim bukra.

arabic: معلش يا عمو، فين مكتبة الامل؟
english: Excuse me uncle, where is Al-Amal bookshop?
transliteration: Ma'lesh ya 'ammu, fein maktabet el-Amal?
storyTitle: Mona Searches for a Book in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: لا يا بنتي، مش هنا بالظبط. ابني هو عارف.
english: No, my daughter, not exactly here. My son knows.
transliteration: La ya binti, mish hina bilzabt. Ibni howa 'arif.
storyTitle: Mona Searches for a Book in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: أنا لازم أروح هلا عشان الدرس.
english: I must go now for the lesson.
transliteration: Ana lazim arouh halla 'ashan el-dars.
storyTitle: Mona Searches for a Book in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: بصي يا بنتي، هتعدي قهوة الفيشاوي وبعدين يمين.
english: Look, my daughter, you'll pass El-Fishawy coffeehouse and then right.
transliteration: Bossi ya binti, hat'addi ahwet el-Fishawi w ba'dein yameen.
storyTitle: Mona Searches for a Book in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: أيوه، هناك كتاب جميل أنا بشتري.
english: Yes, there is a beautiful book I am buying.
transliteration: Aywa, hinak kitab gameel ana bashtari.
storyTitle: Mona Searches for a Book in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: معلش يا عم، الكركديه ده غالي خالص!
english: Excuse me, uncle, this karkade is very expensive!
transliteration: Ma'lesh ya 'amm, el-karkadeh da ghali khales!

arabic: البائع قال: لا يا بنتي، ده بـ ٨٠ جنيه.
english: The seller said: No, my daughter, this is 80 pounds.
transliteration: El-bayye' 'al: La ya benti, da b-tamanin geneh.

arabic: مُنى قالت: لازم أجيب لجدتي.
english: Mona said: I must get for my grandmother.
transliteration: Mona 'alet: Lazem ageeb l-geddati.

arabic: هي مجبورة تضل بالبيت؛ مش ٦٠ جنيه؟
english: She has to stay at home; isn't it 60 pounds?
transliteration: Heyya magboura tedall bel-beit; mesh sitteen geneh?

arabic: مُنى دفعت وهي مبسوطة، كسبت الدرس!
english: Mona paid and she was happy, she won the lesson!
transliteration: Mona dafa'et we heyya mabsoota, kessibet el-dars!

arabic: إيه ده، كتاب الدرس بتاعي هنا!
english: What is this, my lesson book is here!
transliteration: Eh da, kitab el dars beta'y hena!
storyTitle: A Shopping Day in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: منى سألت البياع: بكام ده يا عمو؟
english: Mona asked the seller: How much is this, uncle?
transliteration: Mona sa'alt el bayya': be kam da ya 'ammu?
storyTitle: A Shopping Day in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: قال بـ١٠٠ جنيه! لا، كتير خالص.
english: He said 100 pounds! No, too much at all.
transliteration: Aal be miya geneh! La, keteir khales.
storyTitle: A Shopping Day in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: منى قالت: يا أب، عايزاه بـ٧٠.
english: Mona said: Oh father, I want it for 70.
transliteration: Mona aalat: Ya ab, 'ayzah be sab'een.
storyTitle: A Shopping Day in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: منى دفعت ٧٠ جنيه وهي مبسوطة خالص.
english: Mona paid 70 pounds and she was very happy.
transliteration: Mona dafa'at sab'een geneh w heya mabsouta khales.
storyTitle: A Shopping Day in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: انا هنا في القهوة
english: I am here at the cafe.
transliteration: Ana hena fel ahwa.

arabic: انا عايز واحد قهوة
english: I want one coffee.
transliteration: Ana 3ayez wa7ed ahwa.

arabic: انا مستني صاحبتي
english: I am waiting for my friend (f).
transliteration: Ana mestanni sa7ebty.

arabic: هي فين
english: Where is she?
transliteration: Heya feen?

arabic: يا رب تيجي بسرعة
english: I hope she comes quickly.
transliteration: Ya rab teegi be sor3a.

arabic: اليوم فيه عزومة كبيرة في بيتنا
english: Today there is a big gathering at our house.
transliteration: El-yom feih 'azouma kibiira fi beitna.

arabic: كل الاهل بيقعدوا حوالين السفرة
english: All the family are sitting around the dining table.
transliteration: Koll el-ahl biyo'do hawalein el-sofra.

arabic: بنت صغيرة و ولد كبير بياكلوا فراخ
english: A small girl and a big boy are eating chicken.
transliteration: Bint saghiira w walad kabiir byaklo faraakh.

arabic: هم بيتكلموا و بيضحكوا بصوت عالي
english: They are talking and laughing loudly.
transliteration: Hom bitkallemo w bidhako be-sot 'aali.

arabic: الكل سعيد جدا و بيشربوا شاي بعد الاكل
english: Everyone is very happy and drinking tea after the food.
transliteration: El-kol sa'iid giddan w bishrabu shay ba'd el-akl.

arabic: انا كنت عايز اروح السوق
english: I wanted to go to the market.
transliteration: Ana kont ayiz arouh el-sou'.

arabic: بس انا تايه ومش عارف فين السوق
english: But I am lost and don't know where the market is.
transliteration: Bas ana tayeh w mesh 'aref feen el-sou'.

arabic: شفت راجل كبير في الشارع
english: I saw an old man on the street.
transliteration: Shuft ragel kebir fi el-share'.

arabic: سالته لو سمحت فين السوق من هنا
english: I asked him, "Excuse me, where is the market from here?"
transliteration: Sa'alto "Law sama7t, feen el-sou' men hena?"

arabic: قال لي امشي طوالي وبعدين خش يمين
english: He told me, "Walk straight and then turn right."
transliteration: Aal li "Emshi tawali w ba'deen khosh yemeen."

arabic: صباح الخير احمد بيصحي كل يوم الصبح بدري
english: Good morning! Ahmed wakes up early every morning.
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir! Ahmed biyesha kol yom el-sobh badri.

arabic: هو عايز يشرب مياه دلوقتي
english: He wants to drink water now.
transliteration: Howa ayiz yeshrab mayya delwa'ty.

arabic: لكن ما فيش مياه في الشقة خالص
english: But there is no water in the apartment at all.
transliteration: Laken mafeesh mayya fi el-sha'a khales.

arabic: دي مشكلة كبيرة ليه كل يوم
english: This is a big problem for him every day.
transliteration: Di moshkela kebira leih kol yom.

arabic: هو لازم يحل المشكلة دي النهاردة
english: He must solve this problem today.
transliteration: Howa lazem yehell el-moshkela di ennaharda.

arabic: صباح الخير يا عم حسن والاستاذ اللي معاه، عاملين إيه حضرتكوا؟
english: Good morning, Uncle Hassan and the gentleman with him, how are you all doing?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya 3am Hassan wel-ostaz elli ma'aah, 3amleen eih 7adretko?

arabic: أهلاً يا منى! بخير خالص، خير إن شاء الله جرى إيه؟
english: Welcome, Mona! Very well, God willing, what happened?
transliteration: Ahlan ya Mona! Bekheir khales, kheir en shaa Allah gara eih?

arabic: معلش، شقتنا بتتدهن. بقترح أخلي كتبي بتاعنا هنا.
english: Excuse me, our apartment is being painted. I suggest keeping our books here.
transliteration: Ma'lesh, sha'etena betetdehen. Ba'tare7 akhalli kotobi beta'na hena.

arabic: طبعاً يا بنتي، خليهم. الشاي بتاعنا مشهور، يبقى عظيم وبنقترحه.
english: Of course, my daughter, keep them. Our tea is famous, it will be great, and we recommend it.
transliteration: Tab'an ya benti, khalleehom. Esh-shay beta'na mashhoor, yeb'a 3azeem waben'tare7o.

arabic: شكراً يا عم حسن، مع السلامة عليكوا! هتعجبك المذاكرة بيها.
english: Thank you, Uncle Hassan, goodbye to you all! You'll like studying with it.
transliteration: Shokran ya 3am Hassan, ma'a el-salama 3aleeko! Hat'agebak el-mozakara beeha.

arabic: احمد بيصحى بدري كل يوم
english: Ahmed wakes up early every day.
transliteration: Ahmad bisahha badri kull yom.

arabic: بيفطر وبعدين بيروح المدرسة
english: He has breakfast and then goes to school.
transliteration: Biyiftar w ba'dein biyrouh il-madrasa.

arabic: في المدرسة بياخد دروس وبيشوف اصحابه
english: At school, he takes lessons and sees his friends.
transliteration: Fil-madrasa biyakhud duruus w biyishuf ashabu.

arabic: بعد المدرسة بيرجع البيت وبيتغدى
english: After school, he returns home and has lunch.
transliteration: Ba'd il-madrasa biyirga' il-beit w biyitghadda.

arabic: هو تعبان شوية وبيحب ينام
english: He is a little tired and likes to sleep.
transliteration: Huwwa ta'baan shwayya w biyihibb yinaam.

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد صاحبي
english: Today is my friend's birthday.
transliteration: El-nahārda ʿīd mīlād ṣāḥbī.

arabic: جبنا كيكة كبيرة وهدايا كتير
english: We brought a big cake and many gifts.
transliteration: Gibnā kēka kabīra wē hadāya kitīr.

arabic: صاحبي كان مبسوط اوي لما شاف الهدايا
english: My friend was very happy when he saw the gifts.
transliteration: Ṣāḥbī kān mabsūṭ ʾawī lamma shāf el-hadāya.

arabic: ابتسم ابتسامة حلوة وضحك بصوت عالي
english: He smiled a sweet smile and laughed out loud.
transliteration: Ibtisim ibtisāma ḥilwa we ḍiḥik bi-ṣōt ʿālī.

arabic: كان يوم سعيد جدا للكل
english: It was a very happy day for everyone.
transliteration: Kān yōm saʿīd giddan lil-kull.

arabic: ريحة الكشري ملت وسط البلد. منى دخلت، "السلام عليكم، صباح الخير يا عمو!"
english: The smell of koshari filled Downtown Cairo. Mona entered, "Hello, good morning uncle!"
transliteration: Rihet el koshary malet wasat el balad. Mona dakhalet, "Es salamu alaykum, sabah el kheir ya ammu!"

arabic: عمو كريم ابتسم، "أهلاً بيكي يا بنتي، إزيكِ؟"
english: Uncle Karim smiled, "Welcome dear, how are you?"
transliteration: Ammu Karim ebtasam, "Ahlan beeki ya benti, ezzayeki?"

arabic: منى جاوبت، "كويسة، الحمد لله. عايزة طبق كشري كبير."
english: Mona replied, "I'm good, praise be to God. I want a large koshari dish."
transliteration: Mona gawabet, "Kwayyesa, alhamdulillah. Ayza tabaq koshary kebir."

arabic: أبو كريم قال، "أهلاً وسهلاً يا حبيبتي، الطبق بـ30 جنيه بس."
english: Abu Karim said, "Welcome dear, the dish is only 30 pounds."
transliteration: Abu Karim qal, "Ahlan wa sahlan ya habibti, el tabaq be 30 geneh bas."

arabic: منى أخذت الطبق، "مع السلامة يا عمو، الله يسلمك!"
english: Mona took the dish, "Goodbye uncle, may God keep you safe!"
transliteration: Mona akhadet el tabaq, "Ma'a el salama ya ammu, Allah yesallemak!"

arabic: يا جماعة بابا بيقول ايه راي حضرتكوا نطلع رحلة حلوة اخر الاسبوع ده
english: Everyone, Dad is saying what do you all think about us going on a nice trip this weekend?
transliteration: Ya gama3a baba bey2ool eh ra2y 7adaratkoo netla3 re7la 7elwa akher el esboo3 dah?

arabic: ممكن نروح اسكندرية جوها بيبقى جميل جدا ومشهور بالهوا النضيف
english: We could go to Alexandria, its weather is very beautiful and famous for the clean air.
transliteration: Momken nrou7 Eskendereyya, gawwha yeb2a gameel geddan w mashhoor bel hawa el nadeef.

arabic: خليهم يلعبوا على البحر براحتهم و يبقى يوم عظيم لينا كلنا
english: Let them play on the beach freely, and it will be a great day for all of us.
transliteration: Khaleehom yel3abo 3al ba7r bara7ethom w yeb2a yom 3azeem leena kollena.

arabic: فكرة عظيمة يا بابا وانا متحمسة بيها جدا
english: Great idea, Dad, and I'm very excited about it!
transliteration: Fekra 3azeema ya baba w ana mota7ammessa beeha geddan!

arabic: يبقى كده اتفقنا نجهز الشنط وناخد معانا المخلل بتاعنا
english: So it's agreed, we'll prepare the bags and take our snacks and our pickles with us.
transliteration: Yeb2a kedah ettafa2na, negahez el shonat w nakhod ma3ana el mekhalil beta3na.

arabic: العيلة كلها خططت تتفرج على ماتش كورة مهم
english: The whole family planned to watch an important football match.
transliteration: El-3eila kolleha khaTTat tetfarag 3ala match koora mohem.

arabic: ماما عملت اكلة لذيذة وبابا جاب مشروبات كتير لينا
english: Mom made a delicious meal and Dad brought many drinks for us.
transliteration: Mama 3amalet akla laziza w baba gab mashroubaat keteer leena.

arabic: الماتش كان حماسي جدا والكل بيشجع بصوت عالي في الصالة
english: The match was very exciting and everyone was cheering loudly in the living room.
transliteration: El-match kan hamasi giddan wel-kol bishagga3 be-sowt 3ali fi el-sala.

arabic: فكرت ان الجو الكويس في الربيع قصير لكن لمتنا دي كانت احلى حاجة
english: I thought that the good weather in spring is short, but this gathering of ours was the best thing.
transliteration: Fakart en el-gaww el-kawayyes fi er-rabii3 'aseer laken lammetna di kanet ahla haga.

arabic: بابا بصلي وابتسم وقال فهمت يا بنتي انك بتحبي الايام دي
english: Dad looked at me and smiled and said, "I understood, my daughter, that you love these days."
transliteration: Baba basseli webtasam w 2al "Fahimt ya benti ennaky bet7ebbi el-ayyam di."

arabic: ماما راحت مع بنتها المحل
english: Mama went with her daughter to the shop.
transliteration: Mama rahet ma'a bentaha el mahall

arabic: كان فيه حاجة كبيرة مش كويسة
english: There was a big thing that wasn't good.
transliteration: Kan feeh haga kebeera mesh kowayyesa

arabic: الراجل قالهم لا مفيش مشكلة
english: The man told them, "No, no problem."
transliteration: El ragel alhom la mafish moshkela

arabic: ادّاهم حاجة تانية لونها ابيض
english: He gave them another thing, its color was white.
transliteration: Eddahom haga tanya lawnaha abyad

arabic: النهاردة كل حاجة كويسة
english: Today everything is good.
transliteration: Ennarda kol haga kowayyesa

arabic: النهاردة أنا مبسوط اوي عشان رايح المدرسة
english: Today I am very happy because I am going to school.
transliteration: El naharda ana mabsut awi 'ashan rayeh el madrasa.

arabic: شفت صاحبي زعلان شوية في الفصل
english: I saw my friend a little sad in the classroom.
transliteration: Shoft sahby za'laan shwayya fi el fasl.

arabic: هو قال انه تعبان امبارح
english: He said he was tired yesterday.
transliteration: Howwa 'aal enno ta'baan embaareh.

arabic: قلتله متقلقش بكرة هتبقى كويس
english: I told him 'don't worry, tomorrow you will be well'.
transliteration: Oltello mate'la'sh bokra hatib'a kwayyes.

arabic: دلوقتي انا راجع البيت ومبسوط
english: Now I am going home and happy.
transliteration: Delwa'ti ana rage' el beit w mabsut.

arabic: النهاردة يوم ميلاد سارة
english: Today is Sara's birthday.
transliteration: Innahaarda yoom milaad Sara.

arabic: هي مبسوطة كتير
english: She is very happy.
transliteration: Heyya mabsoota keteer.

arabic: صحابها جابوا لها هدايا حلوة
english: Her friends brought her nice gifts.
transliteration: Sohabha gaboo laha hadaya helwa.

arabic: سارة بتضحك لما تشوف الهدايا
english: Sara laughs when she sees the gifts.
transliteration: Sara bitidhak lamma tishoof ilhadaya.

arabic: كان يوم حلو اوي
english: It was a very nice day.
transliteration: Kan yoom helw awi.

arabic: منى صحيت على برد غريب.
english: Mona woke up to a strange cold.
transliteration: Mona sehet ala bard ghareeb.

arabic: بصت من الشباك، إيه ده؟
english: She looked out the window, what is this?
transliteration: Bosset men el shebbak, eh da?

arabic: الدنيا بيضا خالص!
english: The world is totally white!
transliteration: El donya beyda khales!

arabic: أخوها طارق عنده سخونة.
english: Her brother Tarek has a fever.
transliteration: Akhoha Tarek ando sokhoona.

arabic: طب وإحنا عندنا طيارة أسوان النهاردة.
english: But we have a flight to Aswan today.
transliteration: Tab we ehna andena tayyara Aswan el naharda.

arabic: هي دي عاصفة تلجية؟
english: Is this a snow storm?
transliteration: Heya di asefa talgeyya?

arabic: نزلت تشوف البواب عم سعيد موجود.
english: She went down to see if the doorman Uncle Saeed was present.
transliteration: Nezelet teshof el bawab amm Saeed mawgood.

arabic: "يا عم سعيد، الجو ادفى جوه ولا بره؟"
english: "Uncle Saeed, is the weather warmer inside or outside?"
transliteration: "Ya amm Saeed, el gaw adfa gowa wala barra?"

arabic: هو قال: "ايوه، بره احر كتير، الشمس طلعت!"
english: He said: "Yes, it's much hotter outside, the sun came out!"
transliteration: Howa aal: "Aywa, barra ahar keteer, el shams teleat!"

arabic: منى اطمنت، يعني هيسافروا.
english: Mona was reassured, meaning they will travel.
transliteration: Mona et'amanet, yaani hayesafro.

arabic: عمر، تايه بـ خان الخليلي، سأل بائع مخلل: صباح الفل يا عم، إيه جرى؟
english: Omar, lost in Khan el-Khalili, asked a pickle seller: 'Good morning, uncle, what happened?'
transliteration: Omar, tayih bi Khan el-Khalili, sa'al ba'e3 makhallal: 'Sabah el-fol ya 3amm, eih gara?'

arabic: البائع رد بابتسامة: أهلاً بيك يا ابني، يبقى حضرتكوا بتسألوا عن إيه؟
english: The seller replied with a smile: 'Welcome, my son, so what are you asking about?'
transliteration: El-ba'e3 radd bi-ibtisama: 'Ahlan bik ya ibni, yib'a 7aḍratku bitis'alu 3an eih?'

arabic: عمر قال: مساء الفل يا عم، بقترح عليكوا تساعدوني ألاقي فانوس.
english: Omar said: 'Good evening, uncle, I suggest you help me find a lamp.'
transliteration: Omar 'al: 'Masa' el-fol ya 3amm, ba'tarraḥ 3alayku tisa3duni ala'i fanoos.'

arabic: البائع نصح: محل 'نور الزمان' بتاعنا مشهور بيها؛ هتعجِبك خالص.
english: The seller advised: 'Our 'Noor El Zaman' shop is famous for them; you will definitely like it.'
transliteration: El-ba'e3 nasa7: 'Ma7al 'Noor ez-Zaman' bita3na mashhoor biha; hatagibak khalis.'

arabic: عمر فرح وقال: عظيم يا عم، متشكرين خالص، مع السلامة!
english: Omar was happy and said: 'Great, uncle, thanks a lot, goodbye!'
transliteration: Omar faraḥ wi 'al: '3azeem ya 3amm, mitshakkerin khalis, ma3 es-salama!'

arabic: انا ماشي في الشارع الصبح
english: I am walking in the street in the morning.
transliteration: Ana mashi fi el shari' el sobh

arabic: شفت واحد صاحبي قديم
english: I saw an old friend.
transliteration: Shoft wahed sahby adim

arabic: قلت له صباح الخير ازيك
english: I said to him, "Good morning, how are you?"
transliteration: Oltelo sabah el kheir ezzayak

arabic: قال لي انا كويس شكرا وانت
english: He said to me, "I'm good, thank you, and you?"
transliteration: Aal li ana kwayyes shokran wa enta

arabic: قلت له انا كويس بس انت مش صاحبي القديم
english: I said to him, "I'm good, but you are not my old friend."
transliteration: Oltelo ana kwayyes bas enta mesh sahby el adim

arabic: ريحة البهارات ملت الجو.
english: The smell of spices filled the air.
transliteration: Riihet el-bahaaraat mallit el-gaw.

arabic: منى مشيت في خان الخليلي.
english: Mona walked in Khan el-Khalili.
transliteration: Mona mishyet fi Khan el-Khalili.

arabic: هي عايزة هدية لمامتها.
english: She wanted a gift for her mother.
transliteration: Hiyya 3ayza hadiyya li-mamatha.

arabic: عيد ميلاد مامتها النهاردة.
english: Her mother's birthday was today.
transliteration: 3iid miilaad mamatha ennaharda.

arabic: منى شافت فوانيس حلوة كتير.
english: Mona saw many beautiful lamps.
transliteration: Mona shafit fawaniis helwa kitiir.

arabic: الفوانيس كانت غالية، يعني.
english: The lamps were expensive, you know.
transliteration: El-fawaniis kanit ghaliya, ya3ni.

arabic: معاها خمسين جنيه بس.
english: She had only fifty pounds.
transliteration: Ma3aha khamsiin geneh bas.

arabic: معلش، دورت على واحد صغير.
english: Never mind, she looked for a small one.
transliteration: Ma3lesh, dawwart 3ala wahed soghayyar.

arabic: لقت فانوس صغير و جميل.
english: She found a nice, small lamp.
transliteration: La'it fannous soghayyar we gamil.

arabic: منى كانت مبسوطة خالص.
english: Mona was very happy.
transliteration: Mona kanit mabsoota khales.

arabic: منى، طالبة الجامعة، اكتشفت إن محفظتها مش معاها.
english: Mona, the university student, discovered that her wallet wasn't with her.
transliteration: Mona, talebt el-gam'a, aktashafet en mahfazet-ha mesh ma'aha.
storyTitle: Mona's Lost Wallet at the Metro

arabic: كانت واقفة في محطة جمال عبد الناصر، وقت العصر.
english: She was standing at Gamal Abdel Nasser station, in the afternoon.
transliteration: Kanet wa'fa fi mahaTTet Gamal Abdel Nasser, wa't el-'aSr.
storyTitle: Mona's Lost Wallet at the Metro

arabic: هي عايزة تروح البيت في شبرا دلوقتي خالص.
english: She wants to go home to Shubra right now, badly.
transliteration: Heya 'ayza trouH el-beit fi Shubra delwa'ty khales.
storyTitle: Mona's Lost Wallet at the Metro

arabic: “طب، أنا مش معايا ولا جنيه أهو!” فكرت بحزن.
english: "Well, I don't have a single pound now!" she thought sadly.
transliteration: "Tab, ana mesh ma'aya wala geneh aho!" fakkarat be-hozn.
storyTitle: Mona's Lost Wallet at the Metro

arabic: هي شايفة الناس بتشتري تذاكر المترو عادي.
english: She sees people buying metro tickets normally.
transliteration: Heya shayfa el-nas beteshtary tazaker el-metro 'ady.
storyTitle: Mona's Lost Wallet at the Metro

arabic: بواب العمارة بتاعتهم، عم حسين، ممكن يساعدها؟
english: Their building's doorman, Uncle Hussein, could he help her?
transliteration: Bawwab el-'emara beta'et-hom, 'amm Hussein, momken yesa'ed-ha?
storyTitle: Mona's Lost Wallet at the Metro

arabic: قررت تتصل بصاحبتها سارة اللي ساكنة قريب.
english: She decided to call her friend Sara who lives nearby.
transliteration: Qarrart tettaSel be-saHebet-ha Sara elli sakna 'orayyeb.
storyTitle: Mona's Lost Wallet at the Metro

arabic: “أيوه يا منى! أنا جاية حالاً دلوقتي!” ردت سارة بسرعة.
english: "Yes, Mona! I'm coming right away now!" Sara replied quickly.
transliteration: "Aywa ya Mona! Ana gayya halan delwa'ty!" raddet Sara be-sor'a.
storyTitle: Mona's Lost Wallet at the Metro

arabic: سارة وصلت بعد ربع ساعة ومعاها خمسين جنيه.
english: Sara arrived after fifteen minutes, with fifty pounds.
transliteration: Sara waSalt ba'd rob' sa'a w ma'aha khamseen geneh.
storyTitle: Mona's Lost Wallet at the Metro

arabic: منى دفعت تذكرتها وخمسة جنيه لسارة، وشكرتها.
english: Mona paid for her ticket and five pounds to Sara, and thanked her.
transliteration: Mona dafa'at tazkaret-ha w khamset geneh le-Sara, w shakaratha.
storyTitle: Mona's Lost Wallet at the Metro

arabic: احمد صحي بدري الصبح قال صباح الخير لمامته
english: Ahmed woke up early in the morning. He said good morning to his mom.
transliteration: Aḥmed seḥi badri es-sobḥ. ʾal ṣabaḥ el-kheer le-mametoh.

arabic: هو رايح يلعب كورة مع صحابه في النادي
english: He is going to play football with his friends at the club.
transliteration: Howwa rayyeḥ yelʿab koora maʿ ṣoḥabo fe en-nadi.

arabic: في النادي قال السلام عليكم لاصحابه
english: At the club, he said hello to his friends.
transliteration: Fe en-nadi ʾal as-salamu alaykum le-ʾaṣḥabo.

arabic: اصحابه قالوا وعليكم السلام ولعبوا كورة
english: His friends said 'and upon you be peace' and played football.
transliteration: ʾAṣḥabo ʾalu wa alaykum as-salam we leʿebu koora.

arabic: اليوم كان حلو جدا
english: The day was very nice.
transliteration: El-yom kan ḥelw geddan.

arabic: اهلا بيك يا جدي كريم جاي يسلم عليك
english: Welcome to you, Grandpa! Karim is coming to greet you.
transliteration: Ahlan beek ya geddi, Karim gayy yisallim 3aleek.

arabic: الجد قاله ازيك يا كريم انا كويس الحمد لله
english: The grandfather said to him, "How are you, Karim? I'm good, alhamdulillah."
transliteration: El-gadd qāllo: "Izzayyak ya Karim? Ana kwayyes, el-ḥamdulillah."

arabic: بس كريم بدا يسال كتير ايه ده وليه ده وكان زمان عامل ازاي
english: But Karim started asking a lot: "What is this? And why is this? And how was it in the past?"
transliteration: Bass Karim bada yis'al kiteer: "Eih da? W leih da? W kan zaman 3amel izzay?"

arabic: الجد استغرب من اسئلته الحاجات دي كانت عادي بالنسبة له
english: The grandfather was surprised by his questions; these things were normal for him.
transliteration: El-gadd istaghrab min as'ilto, el-ḥagāt di kanet 3ādi bel-nesba lo.

arabic: لما كريم مشي قال له مع السلامة يا جدي والجد رد عليه الله يسلمك
english: When Karim left, he said to him, "Goodbye, Grandpa!" And the grandfather replied to him, "May God keep you safe."
transliteration: Lamma Karim meshi āllo: "Ma'a salama ya geddi!" Wel-gadd radd 3aleih: "Allah yisallimak."

arabic: صباح الخير انا رايح السوق النهارده
english: Good morning. I'm going to the market today.
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir. Ana rayeh el-sou' ennaharda.

arabic: وصلت السوق وكان زحمة شوية شفت عمو احمد بتاع الخضار
english: I arrived at the market and it was a bit crowded. I saw Uncle Ahmed, the vegetable seller.
transliteration: Wasalt el-sou' w kan zahma shwayya. Shoft 'ammu Ahmad bita' el-khodar.

arabic: قلت له صباح الخير يا عمو احمد ازيك من فضلك طماطم
english: I told him, "Good morning, Uncle Ahmed, how are you? Please, tomatoes."
transliteration: Oltelo sabah el-kheir ya 'ammu Ahmad, ezzayak? Min fadlak tamatem.

arabic: هو قال كويس الحمد لله وانتَ عامل ايه انا رديت انا كويس تمام
english: He said: "Good, thank God, and how are you doing?" I replied: "I'm good, fine."
transliteration: Howwa 'al: kwayyes el-hamdu lellah, w enta 'amel eh? Ana radeit: ana kwayyes tamam.

arabic: اخدت الطماطم وقلت له شكرا يا عمو احمد
english: I took the tomatoes and told him, "Thank you, Uncle Ahmed."
transliteration: Akhadht el-tamatem w oltelo shokran ya 'ammu Ahmad.

arabic: ريحة البهارات كانت قوية جداً.
english: The smell of spices was very strong.
transliteration: rihet el-boharat kanet qawiya geddan.

arabic: هاني مشي في شارع المعز.
english: Hany walked on El-Moez Street.
transliteration: Hany meshi fi share' el-Moez.

arabic: هو طالب، عنده اتنين وعشرين سنة.
english: He is a student, 22 years old.
transliteration: howa taleb, 'ando etnein we 'eshreen sana.

arabic: هاني حاسس بالجوع دلوقتي.
english: Hany feels hungry now.
transliteration: Hany hases bel-gou' delwa'ty.

arabic: عايز ياكل كشري سخن.
english: He wants to eat hot koshary.
transliteration: 'ayez yakol koshary sokhn.

arabic: معاه عشرين جنيه بس.
english: He has only twenty pounds.
transliteration: ma'ah 'eshreen geneh bass.

arabic: الكشري غالي ولا إيه؟ سأل نفسه.
english: Is the koshary expensive or what? He asked himself.
transliteration: el-koshary ghali wala eh? sa'al nafso.

arabic: بائع ابتسم له برضه.
english: A vendor smiled at him too.
transliteration: ba'e' ebtasam lo barḍo.

arabic: قال له: "كشري بعشرة جنيه يا هاني!"
english: He told him: "Koshary for ten pounds, Hany!"
transliteration: 'al lo: "koshary be-'ashara geneh ya Hany!"

arabic: هاني فرح جداً واشترى.
english: Hany was very happy and bought it.
transliteration: Hany fareh geddan we eshtara.

arabic: سلام يا كريم ازيك
english: Hello Karim, how are you?
transliteration: Salam ya Karim ezzayak?

arabic: انا كويس الحمد لله انت كويس
english: I'm good, thank God. Are you good?
transliteration: Ana kwayyes alhamdulillah. Enta kwayyes?

arabic: ايوه انا كويس ايه اخبار اليوم
english: Yes, I am good. What's new today?
transliteration: Aioh ana kwayyes. Eh akhbar el yom?

arabic: مفيش حاجة جديدة انا في البيت
english: Nothing new. I am at home.
transliteration: Mafish haga gadida. Ana fi el beit.

arabic: تمام يلا نشوف بكرة مع السلامة
english: Okay, let's see tomorrow. Goodbye.
transliteration: Tamam yalla nshuf bukra. Ma'a salama.

arabic: انا بجهز لفرحي الاسبوع الجاي
english: I am preparing for my wedding next week.
transliteration: Ana bagahhez le farahi el esbou3 el gay

arabic: كل يوم بشرب قهوة وبشوف قايمة المدعوين
english: Every day I drink coffee and look at the guest list.
transliteration: Kol yawm bashrab ahwa w bashoof qaymet el mad3oween

arabic: امي بتساعدني اختار الفستان
english: My mother helps me choose the dress.
transliteration: Ommi betsa3edni akhtar el fostan

arabic: انا وصاحبتي بنروح السوق نشتري حاجات
english: My friend and I go to the market to buy things.
transliteration: Ana w sahbeti benrouh el souq neshtiri hagāt

arabic: الفرح هيكون جميل ان شاء الله
english: The wedding will be beautiful God willing.
transliteration: El farah hayekoun gameel in sha' Allah

arabic: منى وصلت، قلقانة. صباح الخير يا دكتور! قالت.
english: Mona arrived, anxious. "Good morning, Doctor!" she said.
transliteration: Mona wasalet, qalqana. "Sabah el-kheir ya doctor!" qalet.

arabic: دكتور كريم ابتسم. أهلاً يا منى! إزيك؟
english: Dr. Karim smiled. "Hello, Mona! How are you?"
transliteration: Doctor Karim ebtasam. "Ahlan ya Mona! Ezzayek?"

arabic: منى حست براحة. الحمد لله! ردت.
english: Mona felt relief. "Praise be to God!" she replied.
transliteration: Mona hasset be-raha. "El-hamdullah!" raddet.

arabic: تمام، مع السلامة يا منى. قال دكتور كريم.
english: "Okay, goodbye, Mona." Dr. Karim said.
transliteration: "Tamam, ma'a el-salama ya Mona." Qal Doctor Karim.

arabic: منى مشيت مبسوطة. مع السلامة يا دكتور! شورت.
english: Mona left happy. "Goodbye, Doctor!" she waved.
transliteration: Mona meshiet mabsoota. "Ma'a el-salama ya doctor!" shawaret.

arabic: منى اتخضت، تليفونها مش لاقياه.
english: Mona was startled, her phone she couldn't find.
transliteration: Mona etkaddet, telephonha mesh laqyah.

arabic: شافت عم حسن في محله بالخان.
english: She saw Uncle Hassan in his shop in Khan.
transliteration: Shafet 3amm Hassan fi mahalloh bel Khan.

arabic: قالتله بتردد: "مساء الخير يا عم، إزيك؟"
english: She told him hesitantly: "Good evening, Uncle, how are you?"
transliteration: Qaletlo betaraddod: "Masa' el kheer ya 3amm, ezayyik?"

arabic: عم حسن رد بابتسامة: "أهلاً يا بنتي، الحمد لله."
english: Uncle Hassan replied with a smile: "Welcome, my daughter, praise be to God."
transliteration: 3amm Hassan radd be'ebtesamah: "Ahlan ya benti, el Hamdulillah."

arabic: منى بدأت تحكي، "تليفوني ضاع."
english: Mona started to tell, "My phone is lost."
transliteration: Mona bada'et tahki, "Telephoni da3."

arabic: انا في البيت النهاردة
english: I am at home today.
transliteration: Ana fi el beit ennaharda.

arabic: في مشكلة صغيرة في المطبخ
english: There is a small problem in the kitchen.
transliteration: Fi moshkela saghira fi el matbakh.

arabic: القطة عايزة تاكل كل الاكل
english: The cat wants to eat all the food.
transliteration: El qotta ayza takol koll el akl.

arabic: ايه الحل دلوقتي
english: What is the solution now?
transliteration: Eih el hal delwa'ty?

arabic: لازم الاقي مكان جديد للاكل
english: I must find a new place for the food.
transliteration: Lazem ala'i makan gadeed lel akl.

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد امي
english: Today is my mother's birthday.
transliteration: El naharda eid milad ommy.

arabic: العيلة كلها متجمعة في البيت
english: The whole family is gathered at home.
transliteration: El 3eila kollaha metgamme3a fel beit.

arabic: فيه تورتة كبيرة وحلويات كتير
english: There is a big cake and many sweets.
transliteration: Fih torta kebira w 7alawiyat keteir.

arabic: كلنا فرحانين وبنغني اغاني حلوة
english: We are all happy and singing nice songs.
transliteration: Kollena far7aneen w benghanney aghany 7elwa.

arabic: بنحب امي اوي وكل سنة وهي طيبة
english: We love my mother very much and Happy Birthday to her.
transliteration: Ben7eb ommy awy w kol sana w hiya tayyeba.

arabic: رحنا القهوة نتفرج على الماتش
english: We went to the cafe to watch the match.
transliteration: rohna el ahwa netfarag ala el matsh

arabic: القهوة كانت مليانة ناس
english: The cafe was full of people.
transliteration: el ahwa kanet malyana nas

arabic: كل الناس كانت فرحانة وبتشجع فريقها
english: Everyone was happy and cheering for their team.
transliteration: koll el nas kanet farhana w betshagga' fare'aha

arabic: شربوا شاي وقهوة
english: They drank tea and coffee.
transliteration: sherbo shay w ahwa

arabic: كانت ليلة حلوة
english: It was a beautiful night.
transliteration: kanet leila helwa

arabic: عمر طفل بيسأل كتير
english: Omar is a child who asks a lot of questions.
transliteration: Omar tefl biyes'al keteer

arabic: هو بيسأل مامته ايه ده
english: He asks his mom, 'What is this?'
transliteration: Howa biyes'al mamto eh da

arabic: مامته بترد عليه وبتقول ده كتاب
english: His mom replies to him and says, 'This is a book.'
transliteration: Mamto betrodd alayh we bet'ool da ketaab

arabic: عمر بيسأل تاني ليه الكتاب كبير كده
english: Omar asks again, 'Why is the book so big?'
transliteration: Omar biyes'al tani leh el ketaab kibeer keda

arabic: مامته بتضحك وبتقول عشان فيه معلومات كتير يا حبيبي
english: His mom laughs and says, 'Because it has a lot of information, my dear.'
transliteration: Mamto betedhak we bet'ool ashan feh ma'lomat keteer ya habibi

arabic: التليفون رن بصوت عالي وانا رديت سمعت صوت صاحبي المبهج
english: The phone rang loudly, and I answered, hearing my friend's cheerful voice.
transliteration: El-telefoon rann be-sout 3ali w ana raddeit sema3t sout sa7by el-mobheg

arabic: كان بيحكيلي عن محل ساندويتشات جديد انا متاكد انها هتعجبك المحل ده مشهور
english: He was telling me about a new sandwich place, I'm sure you will like it; that place is famous.
transliteration: Kan bey7kili 3an ma7all sandwetshat gedeed ana met2akked enaha hat3agebek el-ma7all da mashhoor

arabic: كنت حاسس اني شامم ريحة اللحمة المشوية والعيش الطازة من التليفون
english: I felt like I could almost smell the grilled meat and fresh bread through the phone.
transliteration: Kont 7asses enni shammem ree7et el-la7ma el-mashweya wel-3eish el-taza men el-telefoon

arabic: قالي انه هيجيب المخلل بتاعنا معاه وانا قولتله عظيم
english: He told me he would bring our special pickles with him, and I told him, "Great!"
transliteration: 2ali enno haygeeb el-mekhalil beta3na ma3ah w ana 2oltelo 3azeem

arabic: فكرة اننا ناكلها سوا بعدين خلتني ابتسم اليوم ده هيبقى حلو
english: The thought of us eating it together later made me smile; this day is going to be good.
transliteration: Fekret ennana nakolha sawa ba3dein khallitni abtesem el-youm da hayeb2a 7elw

arabic: ليلى كانت تعبانة جدا وهي بتخطط للفرح الكبير
english: Layla was very tired while planning the big wedding.
transliteration: Layla kanat ta'bana geddan w hiyya betkhaTTat lel faraH el kebir.

arabic: قالت لصاحبتها منى انا بفكر في كل حاجة الاكل والمشروبات
english: She told her friend Mona, "I'm thinking about everything, the food and the drinks."
transliteration: Aallet le SaHibtaha Mona ana bafakkar fi kol Haga el akl w el mashroubat.

arabic: منى ردت عليها وقالت الجو الكويس في الربيع قصير و الجو مش مستقر في الربيع
english: Mona replied to her and said, "The good weather in spring is short, and the weather is not stable in the spring."
transliteration: Mona raddet 'aleha w Aallet el gaww el kawayyes fi er-rabii3 'aseer w el gaww mish mustaqirr fi er-rabee'.

arabic: ليلى كانت قلقانة جدا بعد ما سمعت كلام منى
english: Layla was very worried after she heard Mona's words.
transliteration: Layla kanat 'al'ana geddan ba'd ma sem'et kalam Mona.

arabic: قالت ليلى اه فهمت بس انا لسه خايفة من اي مشكلة
english: Layla said, "Ah, I got it, but I'm still scared of any problem."
transliteration: Aallet Layla ah fahimt bas ana lessa khayfa men ayy moshkela.

arabic: عمو حسني، موظف متقاعد، وجد كوب شاي أخضر أمامه.
english: Uncle Hosni, a retired employee, found a cup of green tea in front of him.
transliteration: 'Ammu Hosni, muwazzaf mutaqa'id, wagad kobb shay akhdar amamah.

arabic: يا سلام! أنا طلبت قهوة مظبوط، مش كده؟
english: Wow! I ordered medium coffee, didn't I?
transliteration: Ya salam! Ana talabt 'ahwa mazbut, mish kida?

arabic: لولا النادل، كنت شربت كوب شاي حد تاني.
english: If it hadn't been for the waiter, I would have drunk someone else's cup of tea.
transliteration: Lawla el-nadel, kont sherebt kobb shay hadd tani.

arabic: على قد ما أحاول أركز، على قد ما بتلخبط خالص.
english: As much as I try to focus, as much as I get completely confused.
transliteration: 'Ala 'add ma ahewal arakkez, 'ala 'add ma batlakhbat khales.

arabic: بقى، دي قهوتي المظبوطة بخمسة جنيه، الحمد لله!
english: So, this is my medium coffee for five pounds, thank God!
transliteration: Ba'a, di 'ahweti el-mazbuta bi-khamsah geneh, el-hamdullah!

arabic: ريحة البن فاحت. ماما عملت قهوة لمُنى.
english: The coffee smell wafted. Mom made coffee for Mona.
transliteration: Ree7et el-bunn fa7et. Mama 3amelet ahwa le Mona.

arabic: مُنى كانت بتذاكر طول الليل. أخوها بيتفرج على تلفزيون.
english: Mona was studying all night. Her brother was watching TV.
transliteration: Mona kanet betzakir tool el-leil. Akhooha beyetfarag 3ala televizion.

arabic: بابا قال: "لولا دعمي، كنت فشلتي."
english: Dad said: "Without my support, you would have failed."
transliteration: Baba qal: "Loola da3my, konti fashalti."

arabic: جدتها جابتلها فطير. قالت: "مهما كان صعب، كملي."
english: Her grandmother brought her feteer. She said: "No matter how hard, continue."
transliteration: Giddetha gabit-laha feteer. Qalet: "Mahma kan sa3b, kammeli."

arabic: مُنى ركزت. مامتها ابتسمت. يا سلام!
english: Mona focused. Her mother smiled. Wow!
transliteration: Mona rakkazet. Mamatha ibtasamet. Ya salam!

arabic: انا صحيت متاخر النهاردة
english: I woke up late today.
transliteration: Ana saheet meta'akher ennaharda.

arabic: عندي يا دوب عشر دقايق عشان اجهز
english: I have barely ten minutes to get ready.
transliteration: Andi ya doob ashar da'aye' ashan agehaz.

arabic: الفطار مش جاهز و الغسالة كانت بايظة طول الليل
english: Breakfast isn't ready and the washing machine was broken all night.
transliteration: El fetar mesh gahez wel ghassala kanet bayza tool el leil.

arabic: لو كنت صحيت بدري لكان الوضع احسن بكتير
english: If I had woken up early, the situation would have been much better.
transliteration: Law kont saheet badri lakan el wad' ahsan bekteer.

arabic: لازم اصلح الغسالة دي بالكتير قبل الليل
english: I must fix this washing machine at most before night.
transliteration: Lazem asallah el ghassala di bel kateer abl el leil.

arabic: الجو كان مطر كتير النهاردة
english: The weather was very rainy today.
transliteration: El gaww kan matar kiteer ennaharda.

arabic: انا قاعد جوه البيت جنب الشباك
english: I am sitting inside the house next to the window.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed gowwa el beit gamb el shebbak.

arabic: بشرب شاي و بسمع صوت المطر
english: I am drinking tea and listening to the sound of the rain.
transliteration: Bashrab shay w basma' sot el matar.

arabic: فجأة شفت حاجة صغيرة ابيض بتتحرك بره
english: Suddenly I saw something small and white moving outside.
transliteration: Fag'a shoft haga soghayyara abyad bititharrak barra.

arabic: كانت قطة صغيرة بتلعب في المطر
english: It was a small cat playing in the rain.
transliteration: Kanet otta soghayyara bitil'ab fil matar.

arabic: الاسرة اتجمعت للغدا
english: The family gathered for lunch.
transliteration: El-usra etgamme'et lel-ghada.

arabic: ماما عملت اكل حلو
english: Mama made nice food.
transliteration: Mama 'amalet akl helw.

arabic: كل واحد اكل وكان مبسوط
english: Everyone ate and was happy.
transliteration: Koll wahed akal we kan mabsout.

arabic: بعدين بابا قال فين القطة
english: Then Baba said "Where is the cat?"
transliteration: Ba'dein Baba 'al feen el-qotta?

arabic: القطة كانت تحت الترابيزة بتاكل سمك
english: The cat was under the table eating fish!
transliteration: El-qotta kanet taht el-tarabeeza betakol samak.

arabic: صباح الخير انا رايح السوق
english: Good morning I am going to the market.
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ana rayeh el souq.

arabic: شفت خضار وفاكهة كتير هناك
english: I saw a lot of vegetables and fruit there.
transliteration: Shoft khodaar we fakha keteer henak.

arabic: قلت للبياع اهلا يا عمو عايز طماطم
english: I said to the seller 'Hello uncle I want tomatoes'.
transliteration: Olt lel bayaa' ahlan ya ammu ayiz tamatem.

arabic: البياع رد صباح النور اتفضل يا حبيبي
english: The seller replied 'Good morning please my dear'.
transliteration: El bayaa' radd sabah el noor etfaddal ya habibi.

arabic: اشتريت الطماطم ورجعت البيت مبسوط
english: I bought the tomatoes and returned home happy.
transliteration: Eshtareet el tamatem we rega't el beit mabsoot.

arabic: كل العيلة اتجمعت على اكل حلو
english: The whole family gathered for a nice meal.
transliteration: Koll el 3eila etgamme3t 3ala akl helw.

arabic: جدو وتيتا كانوا بيتكلموا عن زمان وحكايات كتير
english: Grandpa and Grandma were talking about old times and many stories.
transliteration: Geddo w Teta kanoo biyetkallimoo 3an zamaan w hekayat kteer.

arabic: ولادهم واحفادهم كانوا ماسكين الموبايلات بتاعتهم دلوقتي
english: Their children and grandchildren were holding their phones now.
transliteration: Wladhom w ahfadhom kanoo maskeen el mobaylat beta3ethom delwa'ty.

arabic: ماما وبابا حاولوا يخلوا الكل يتكلم مع بعض
english: Mom and Dad tried to make everyone talk with each other.
transliteration: Mama w Baba haweloo ykhalloo el koll yetkallim ma3 ba3d.

arabic: الاكل كان حلو وكل واحد كان مبسوط بس طريقة الكلام مختلفة
english: The food was nice and everyone was happy, but the way of talking was different.
transliteration: El akl kan helw w koll wahed kan mabsoot bas taree'et el kalam mokhtalefa.

arabic: مساء الخير يا امي كنا بنروح نزور خالتي
english: Good evening mom, we were going to visit my aunt.
transliteration: Masa' el-kheer ya ommi konna benrooh nezour khalti.

arabic: الرحلة كانت قصيرة يا دوب نص ساعة بالعربية
english: The trip was short, barely half an hour by car.
transliteration: El rehla kanet 'asira ya doob noss sa'a bel 'arabeya.

arabic: لما وصلنا خالتي قالت وعليكم السلام بفرحة
english: When we arrived, my aunt said "And peace be upon you" with joy.
transliteration: Lamma wasalna khalti 'alet wa alaykum as-salam befarha.

arabic: قعدنا نتكلم كتير وشربنا شاي مع بعض
english: We sat and talked a lot and drank tea together.
transliteration: 'Adna netkallem keteer we sheribna shay ma' ba'd.

arabic: كان يوم جميل وكلنا كنا مبسوطين اوي
english: It was a beautiful day and we were all very happy.
transliteration: Kan yom gameel we kollena konna mabsooteen awi.

arabic: النهارده كنت ماشي في الشارع
english: Today I was walking in the street.
transliteration: El naharda kont mashi fe el share'a
storyTitle: An Old Encounter in the Street

arabic: شفت صاحبي القديم علي
english: I saw my old friend, Ali.
transliteration: Shoft saahbi el adeem Ali
storyTitle: An Old Encounter in the Street

arabic: قولت له اهلا عامل ايه
english: I said to him, "Hello, how are you?"
transliteration: Olt loh ahlan aamel ee
storyTitle: An Old Encounter in the Street

arabic: قال لي الحمد لله وده ابني الصغير
english: He said to me, "Praise be to God, and this is my young son."
transliteration: Qal li el hamdulillah we dah ebni el sagheer
storyTitle: An Old Encounter in the Street

arabic: فرحت اني شفتك يا صاحبي
english: I was happy that I saw you, my friend.
transliteration: Feraht enni shoftak ya saahbi
storyTitle: An Old Encounter in the Street

arabic: انا زرت بيت عمي امس
english: I visited my uncle's house yesterday.
transliteration: Ana zort beit ammi ams

arabic: عمي كان مبسوط كتير لما شافني
english: My uncle was very happy when he saw me.
transliteration: Ammi kan mabsoot keteer lamma shafni

arabic: انا شفت اولاده هم صغيرين
english: I saw his children, they are small.
transliteration: Ana shoft awlado hom soghayyareen

arabic: احنا ضحكنا كتير و اكلنا حاجات حلوة
english: We laughed a lot and ate sweet things.
transliteration: Ehna dehekna keteer w akalna hagaat helwa

arabic: كان يوم حلو قوي
english: It was a very nice day.
transliteration: Kan yom helw awi

arabic: انا رحت السوق عشان اشتري هدوم جديده
english: I went to the market to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Ana roht el souq 'ashan ashtari hedoom gedeeda.

arabic: شفت قميص كبير اوي
english: I saw a very big shirt.
transliteration: Shoft 'amees kebeer awi.

arabic: لبست القميص بس كان ضيق خالص
english: I put on the shirt but it was very tight.
transliteration: Labast el 'amees bas kan dayye' khales.

arabic: صاحبي ضحك كتير اوي
english: My friend laughed a lot.
transliteration: Sahbi dehek keteer awi.

arabic: فا اشتريت قميص تاني اصغر شويه
english: So I bought another shirt, a bit smaller.
transliteration: Fa-shtareet 'amees tani asghar shwaya.

arabic: انا رحت المحل عشان ارجع حاجة
english: I went to the shop to return something.
transliteration: Ana roht el mahall ashan arga' haga.

arabic: انا عايز ارجع الجزمة دي
english: I want to return these shoes.
transliteration: Ana ayiz arga' el gazma di.

arabic: البياع سأل ليه عايز ترجعها
english: The seller asked, "Why do you want to return it?"
transliteration: El bayya' sa'al leeh ayiz targa'ha?

arabic: انا قلت هي كبيرة شوية عليا
english: I said, "It's a bit big for me."
transliteration: Ana olt heya kibeera showaya alayya.

arabic: البياع قال مفيش مشكلة ممكن نغيرها
english: The seller said, "No problem, we can change it."
transliteration: El bayya' qal mafeesh moshkela mumkin neghayyarha.

arabic: اللمبة في اوضة المعيشة مش شغالة
english: The light bulb in the living room is not working.
transliteration: El-lamba fi odet el-ma'eesha mish shaghala.
storyTitle: The Light Bulb Problem at Home

arabic: ماما عايزة تصلحها عشان الجو ضلمة
english: Mom wants to fix it because it's dark.
transliteration: Mama ayza tesallaha ashan el-gaw dalma.
storyTitle: The Light Bulb Problem at Home

arabic: احنا بنحب نقعد في الاوضة دي كل يوم
english: We like to sit in this room every day.
transliteration: Ehna benhebb no'od fi el-oda di koll yom.
storyTitle: The Light Bulb Problem at Home

arabic: بابا مشغول في الشغل دلوقتي
english: Dad is busy at work now.
transliteration: Baba mashghoul fi el-shoghl delwa'ti.
storyTitle: The Light Bulb Problem at Home

arabic: ممكن نسأل الجار يساعدنا بكرة الصبح
english: Maybe we can ask the neighbor to help us tomorrow morning.
transliteration: Momken nes'al el-gar yesa'edna bokra el-sobh.
storyTitle: The Light Bulb Problem at Home

arabic: صباح الخير يا عمو، إزيكَ؟ سألت منى بخجل في خان الخليلي.
english: Good morning, uncle, how are you? Mona asked shyly in Khan el-Khalili.
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya 'ammo, ezayyak? Sa'alet Mona bekhajal fi Khan el-Khalili.

arabic: كويس، الحمد لله يا بنتي، أهلاً وسهلاً بيكي.
english: Good, praise be to God, my daughter, welcome to you.
transliteration: Kowayyes, el-hamdu lellah ya binty, ahlan wa sahlan beeky.

arabic: أنا كويسة، شكراً. قالت منى، وسألته عن محل الهدايا.
english: I'm good, thank you. Mona said, and asked him about the gift shop.
transliteration: Ana kowayyesa, shokran. Qalet Mona, wa sa'altoh 'an mahal el-hadaya.

arabic: مع السلامة يا عمو. قالت منى بعد ما عرفت الطريق.
english: Goodbye, uncle. Mona said after she knew the way.
transliteration: Ma'a el-salama ya 'ammo. Qalet Mona ba'd ma 'arefet el-tareeq.

arabic: الله يسلمك يا بنتي. رد البائع، ومشت منى تدور على المحل.
english: May God keep you safe, my daughter. The vendor replied, and Mona walked looking for the shop.
transliteration: Allah yesallemek ya binty. Radd el-ba'e', we meshet Mona tedawwar 'ala el-mahal.

arabic: منى فاكرة انها لازم تسلم على البواب.
english: Mona remembers she must greet the doorman.
transliteration: Mona fakra innaha lazim tisallim ala el-bawwab.

arabic: صباح الخير يا عمو أحمد، ازيك؟
english: Good morning, Uncle Ahmed, how are you?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya ammo Ahmed, izzayak?

arabic: أهلاً بيكي يا منى، أنا كويس، الحمد لله.
english: Welcome, Mona, I'm good, praise be to God.
transliteration: Ahlan beeki ya Mona, ana kowayyes, el-hamdu lellah.

arabic: أنا كويسة، الحمد لله. ممكن الطرد بتاعي؟
english: I'm good, praise be to God. Can I have my package?
transliteration: Ana kowayyisa, el-hamdu lellah. Mumkin el-tard beta'i?

arabic: شكراً ليك، مع السلامة يا عمو أحمد. الله يسلمك.
english: Thank you, goodbye, Uncle Ahmed. May God keep you safe.
transliteration: Shukran leek, ma'a el-salama ya ammo Ahmed. Allah yisallimak.

arabic: كان فيه طفل صغير اسمه كريم بيسأل كتير قوي عن كل حاجة
english: There was a small child named Karim who asked a lot about everything.
transliteration: Kan feeh tefl soghayyar esmo Kareem biyes'al keteer awi 3an kol haga.

arabic: ريحة المطبخ كانت حلوة وهو بيشوف مامته بتعمل اكل
english: The kitchen smell was nice as he watched his mom making food.
transliteration: Ree7et elmatbakh kanet 7elwa we howa biyshoof mameto bit3amel akl.

arabic: ماما الاكل ده هيبقى حلو سأل كريم بصوت عالي وهي بتضحك
english: "Mom, will this food be nice?" Karim asked loudly, and she laughed.
transliteration: "Mama, elakl dah hayeb2a 7elw?" sa'al Kareem besot 3ali we heya betde7ak.

arabic: قالتله ايوه يا حبيبي وهتعجبك اوي يا بطل بس خليهم يستووا الاول
english: She told him, "Yes, my darling, and you will really like it, champ, but let them cook first."
transliteration: 'aletlo "Ayiwa ya 7abibi we hat3agebak awi ya batal bas khaleehom yestawu elawel."

arabic: كريم كان بيبص على الاكل اللي بيغلي بحماس كبير وعايز ياكل معاه دلوقتي
english: Karim was looking at the boiling food with great excitement and wanted to eat with it now.
transliteration: Kareem kan biyeboss 3ala elakl elle biyaghli be7amas keteer we 3ayez yakol ma3ah delwa'ti.

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد صاحبي
english: Today is my friend's birthday
transliteration: Elnaharda eid milad sahby

arabic: رحنا بيته الكبير
english: We went to his big house
transliteration: Rohna beito el kabeer

arabic: البيت كان فيه بلالين حمرا وزرقا
english: The house had red and blue balloons
transliteration: El beit kan feeh balaleen hamra w zarqa

arabic: اكلنا تورتة لذيذة وشربنا عصير
english: We ate delicious cake and drank juice
transliteration: Akalna torta ladheetha w sheribna aseer

arabic: كلنا كنا فرحانين اوي
english: We were all very happy
transliteration: Kollena kunna farhaneen awi

arabic: النهارده انا روحت المدرسة بدري
english: Today I went to school early.
transliteration: El naharda ana rowwaht el madrasa badri

arabic: الدرس الاول كان صعب شويه
english: The first lesson was a little difficult.
transliteration: El dars el awwal kan sa'b shawaya

arabic: بس بعدين شفت صاحبي و انا مبسوط
english: But then I saw my friend and I was happy.
transliteration: Bas ba'dein shoaft saahbi w ana mabsoot

arabic: خلصت الشغل و روحت البيت
english: I finished work and went home.
transliteration: Khalast el shoghl w rowwaht el beit

arabic: انا تعبان دلوقتي بس اليوم كان كويس
english: I am tired now but the day was good.
transliteration: Ana ta'baan delwa'ti bas el yom kan kwayyes

arabic: انا رحت ماتش كورة
english: I went to a football match.
transliteration: Ana roht match koora

arabic: كان فيه ناس كتير في الشارع
english: There were many people in the street.
transliteration: Kan fee nas kteer fel share'

arabic: احنا قعدنا في قهوة نشرب شاي ونشوف الماتش
english: We sat in a cafe to drink tea and watch the match.
transliteration: Ehna a'adna fe ahwa neshrab shay wenshoof el match

arabic: كل الناس كانت فرحانة بفريقنا
english: Everyone was happy with our team.
transliteration: Koll el nas kanet farhana be faree'na

arabic: اليوم كان جميل اوي
english: Today was very beautiful.
transliteration: El yom kan gameel awi

arabic: انا عايز اشتري هدوم جديدة
english: I want to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Ana ayiz ashtiree hedoom gideeda.

arabic: انا رحت السوق امبارح
english: I went to the market yesterday.
transliteration: Ana roht es-souq embaareh.

arabic: انا شفت قميص حلو هناك
english: I saw a beautiful shirt there.
transliteration: Ana shoft amees helw henāk.

arabic: السعر كان كويس
english: The price was good.
transliteration: Es-se'r kān kwayyes.

arabic: انا اشتريت القميص وبنطلون
english: I bought the shirt and pants.
transliteration: Ana ashtareet el-amees we bantaloon.

arabic: ازيك يا ام احمد
english: How are you, Umm Ahmed?
transliteration: Izzayek ya Umm Ahmed?

arabic: الحمد لله انتي عامله ايه وازاي ولادك
english: Thank God, how are you and how are your children?
transliteration: Elhamdulillah, enti amla eh we izzay weladek?

arabic: انا بخير ومريم كويسة بتلعب في الشارع
english: I'm fine, and Mariam is good, playing in the street.
transliteration: Ana bekhair we Mariam kwayesa betlaab fel sharea.

arabic: تعالي اشربي معانا شاي بالليل
english: Come drink tea with us tonight.
transliteration: Ta'ali ishrabi ma'ana shay belleil.

arabic: اكيد هاجي تسلمي يا حبيبتي
english: Of course I'll come, thank you my dear.
transliteration: Akid hagi teslami ya habibti.

arabic: صباح الخير يا سارة ازيك انا كويسة الحمد لله شفتك النهاردة
english: Good morning Sara, how are you? I'm good, alhamdulillah. I saw you today.
transliteration: Sabah el-kheer ya Sara izzayyik? Ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah. Shoftik el-naharda.

arabic: اهلا بيكي يا منى عاملة ايه رايحة الشغل دلوقتي
english: Welcome to you, Mona. How are you doing? Are you going to work now?
transliteration: Ahlan beeki ya Mona, amla eh? Rayha el-shoghl delwa'ty?

arabic: ايوه رايحة شغلي بعد ما جبت الفطار من السوق
english: Yes, I'm going to my work after I got breakfast from the market.
transliteration: Aywa rayha shoghly ba'd ma gebt el-fettar men el-souq.

arabic: ربنا معاكي انا كمان رايحة اشتري حاجات للبيت
english: May God be with you. I'm also going to buy things for the house.
transliteration: Rabbina ma'aki. Ana kaman rayha ashtiry hagāt lel-beit.

arabic: تمام مع السلامة الله يسلمك
english: Okay, goodbye. May God keep you safe.
transliteration: Tamam. Ma'a salama. Allah yisallimak.

arabic: صحيت بدري النهاردة وكنت مستعجل اوي
english: I woke up early today and was very much in a hurry
transliteration: Seheet badri ennaharda w kont mista'gil awi

arabic: شربت قهوة بسرعة عشان الحق البس
english: I drank coffee quickly to catch up on getting dressed
transliteration: Sherebt ahwa bosor'a 'ashan alhaq albes

arabic: مفيش وقت للاكل وكنت جعان جدا
english: There was no time for food and I was very hungry
transliteration: Mafeesh wa't lel akl w kont ga'aan geddan

arabic: نزلت البيت بسرعة عشان اشوف المواصلات
english: I left the house quickly to find transportation
transliteration: Nazalt el beet bosor'a 'ashan ashoof el mowasalat

arabic: يارب اوصل الشغل بدري النهاردة
english: I hope I arrive at work early today
transliteration: Ya rab awsall el shoghl badri ennaharda

arabic: صحيت متأخر النهاردة الصبح
english: I woke up late this morning.
transliteration: Saheet meta'akher el naharda el sobh

arabic: قلت السلام عليكم صباح الخير لنفسي وبدأت اجري
english: I said 'Hello good morning!' to myself and started running.
transliteration: Olt As-salamu alaykum sabaḥ el-kheer le nafsi w bada't agri

arabic: يا دوب لحقت الأتوبيس قبل ما يمشي
english: I barely caught the bus before it left.
transliteration: Ya doob lahaqt el atobees abl ma yemshi

arabic: الرحلة هتاخد بالكتير ساعة بسبب المرور
english: The trip will take at most an hour because of the traffic.
transliteration: El rehla hatakhod bel kateer sa'a besabab el moroor

arabic: وصلت الشغل وانا تعبان بس مبسوط
english: I arrived at work tired but happy.
transliteration: Wasalt el shoghl w ana ta'ban bas mabsoot

arabic: منى، طالبة، شافت فاتورة فطير كبير قوي بتمانين جنيه على ترابيزة فاضية.
english: Mona, a student, saw a very big feteer bill for eighty pounds on an empty table.
transliteration: Mona, talba, shafet fatura feteer kebir awy be-tamanin geneh 'ala tarabeza fadya.
storyTitle: Mother's Birthday and Feteer at the Café

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد امي اللي من اسكندرية، وهي بتحب الفطير.
english: Today is my mother's birthday, who is from Alexandria, and she loves feteer.
transliteration: Elnaharda 'eid milad ommy elli men Eskendereyya, we heyya bethebb el-feteer.
storyTitle: Mother's Birthday and Feteer at the Café

arabic: النادل الطيب قال لمُنى: 'عندنا فطير حلو، بكام تحبي؟'
english: The kind waiter told Mona: 'We have good feteer, how much would you like?'
transliteration: El-nadel el-tayyeb 'al le-Mona: ' 'Andena feteer helw, be-kam tehebb?'
storyTitle: Mother's Birthday and Feteer at the Café

arabic: منى ابتسمت: 'آه، نشتري واحد كبير لبيتنا، عشان امي تبقى مبسوطة.'
english: Mona smiled: 'Ah, we will buy a big one for our home, so my mother will be happy.'
transliteration: Mona ebtasemet: 'Ah, neshtary wahed kebir le-beitna, 'ashan ommy teb'a mabsoota.'
storyTitle: Mother's Birthday and Feteer at the Café

arabic: 'شكراً ليك، يلا عشان نجهز خضار وفاكهة كمان!'
english: 'Thank you, let's go prepare vegetables and fruit too!'
transliteration: 'Shokran lik, yalla 'ashan negahez khodar we faka kaman!'
storyTitle: Mother's Birthday and Feteer at the Café

arabic: مافيش فاكهة ولا خضار في البيت خالص
english: There is no fruit or vegetables at home at all.
transliteration: Mafish fakha wala khodaar fel bayt khales

arabic: امي قالت لازم ننزل السوق الكبير نشتري كل حاجة
english: My mother said we must go down to the big market to buy everything.
transliteration: Ommy alet lazam nenzel el soo' el kibeer neshtary kol haga

arabic: انا قلتلها يا امي ممكن نطلب من الابلكيشن احسن واسرع
english: I told her, "Mom, we can order from the app, it's better and faster."
transliteration: Ana oltelha ya ommy momken notlob men el application ahsan w asra'

arabic: هي قالت لا احنا بنحب نشوف الحاجة بكام ونتأكد انها طازة
english: She said, "No, we love to see how much things are and make sure they are fresh."
transliteration: Heya alet la' ehna benhebb neshof el haga bekam w net'akked enaha tazza

arabic: فقلت ماشي يلا بينا نروح السوق انا كمان عايزة فاكهة
english: So I said, "Okay, let's go to the market, I also want fruit."
transliteration: Fa olt mashi yalla bena nrooh el soo' ana kaman ayza fakha

arabic: النهاردة انا رحت بيت جدو وتيتة
english: Today I went to grandfather and grandmother's house.
transliteration: El naharda ana roht beit geddo we teeta.

arabic: جدو بيصحى بدري كل يوم
english: Grandfather wakes up early every day.
transliteration: Geddo byesaha badri kol youm.

arabic: تيتة بتعمل فطار حلو
english: Grandmother makes nice breakfast.
transliteration: Teeta bete'mel fetar helw.

arabic: انا بشرب شاي معاهم
english: I drink tea with them.
transliteration: Ana bashrab shay ma'ahom.

arabic: كلنا بنقعد ونتكلم كتير
english: All of us sit and talk a lot.
transliteration: Kolena beno'od we netkallem kteer.

arabic: النهاردة قررت اعمل اكلة جديدة لعائلتي كلها
english: Today I decided to cook a new dish for my whole family.
transliteration: Elnaharda qarart a3mel akla gedida le-3aylti kollaha.
storyTitle: A New Dish for the Family

arabic: ماما ساعدتني في التحضير وقالتلي دي طريقة جدتي القديمة
english: Mom helped me with the preparation and told me this is my grandmother's old recipe.
transliteration: Mama sa3etni fel tahdeer we qa'aletli di taree'et geddti el'adeema.
storyTitle: A New Dish for the Family

arabic: كان لازم ادوق الملح وبابا قالي تسلم ايدك يا بنتي
english: I had to taste the salt, and Dad told me 'your hands are blessed, my daughter'.
transliteration: Kan lazim adawwa' el-malh we Baba qa'ali teslam eidk ya benti.
storyTitle: A New Dish for the Family

arabic: وبعد ما خلصت بابا وماما في البيت وقعدنا كلنا ناكل سوا
english: And after I finished, Dad and Mom were at home, and we all sat down to eat together.
transliteration: We ba3d ma khallas-t Baba we Mama fel beit we qa3adna kollena nakol sawa.
storyTitle: A New Dish for the Family

arabic: كل العائلة انبسطت بالاكل وطلبت مني اعملها تاني قريب
english: The whole family enjoyed the food and asked me to make it again soon.
transliteration: Koll el-3ayla enbasatet bel-akl we talabet menni a3melha tani qareeb.
storyTitle: A New Dish for the Family

arabic: انا قعدت في الكافيه
english: I sat in the café.
transliteration: Ana a'adt fil kafeeh.

arabic: الترابيزة فاضية ومحدش جه
english: The table was empty and no one came.
transliteration: El tarabeeza fadya w mahaddish geh.

arabic: انا استنيت شوية عشان اطلب
english: I waited a bit to order.
transliteration: Ana estannet shwaya 'ashan atlob.

arabic: الجرسون جه وسال عايز ايه
english: The waiter came and asked "What do you want?".
transliteration: El garsoon geh w sa'al 'ayez eh.

arabic: قلت له عايز واحد قهوة سادة من فضلك
english: I told him "I want one plain coffee please".
transliteration: Oltelo 'ayez wahed ahwa saada min fadlak.

arabic: الدنيا بتمطر برا
english: It's raining outside.
transliteration: El donya betmatar barra

arabic: انا قاعد في البيت جنب الشباك
english: I am sitting at home next to the window.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed fel beit gamb el shebbak

arabic: ماما قالت يلا نشرب شاي سخن
english: Mom said 'Let's drink hot tea!'
transliteration: Mama qalet 'Yalla neshrab shay sokhn!'

arabic: الجو برد النهاردة
english: The weather is cold today.
transliteration: El gaww bard el naharda

arabic: انا بحب اقرا كتاب وانا قاعد
english: I like to read a book while I am sitting.
transliteration: Ana bahebb aqra ketab wana qa'ed

arabic: بكرة الجمعة انا عايز اروح اسكندرية
english: Tomorrow is Friday, I want to go to Alexandria.
transliteration: Bokra el-gom'a ana 'ayez arooh Eskandareyya.

arabic: هناك هزور عيلتي واشرب قهوة معاهم
english: There I will visit my family and drink coffee with them.
transliteration: Henak hazor 'eilty w ashrab ahwa ma'ahom.

arabic: احنا دايما بناكل اكل بيتي حلو قوي
english: We always eat very nice homemade food.
transliteration: Ehna dayman benakol akl beity helw qawi.

arabic: بعد الغدا بنشرب شاي ونتكلم كتير
english: After lunch we drink tea and talk a lot.
transliteration: Ba'd el-ghada benshrab shay w netkallem keteer.

arabic: يوم السبت هنروح السوق نشتري حاجات
english: On Saturday we will go to the market to buy things.
transliteration: Yom el-sabt hanrooh el-soo' neshtry hagaat.

arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع الصبح بدري
english: I was walking in the street early morning.
transliteration: Kunt maashi fi el shari' el sobh badri

arabic: فجأة شفت راجل قدامي وبصيت كويس
english: Suddenly I saw a man in front of me and looked closely.
transliteration: Faga'a shoft ragel oddami w bassayt kwayyes

arabic: لقيته صاحبي القديم اللي وحشني كتير
english: I found him to be my old friend whom I missed a lot.
transliteration: Le'eto sahbi el adim elli waheshni keteir

arabic: فرحت جدا وسمعت ضحكته الحلوة تاني
english: I was very happy and heard his sweet laugh again.
transliteration: Faraht geddan w seme't dahketoh el helwa tani

arabic: قعدنا نتكلم عن ايام زمان وشربنا قهوة
english: We sat and talked about old times and drank coffee.
transliteration: A'adna netkallem an ayyam zaman w sherbna ahwa

arabic: صباح الخير يا جارة
english: Good morning, neighbor!
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya gaara

arabic: صباح النور ازيك
english: Good morning! How are you?
transliteration: Sabah el noor izzayek

arabic: الحمد لله انا بخير ايه ده اللي معاكي
english: Praise be to God, I am fine. What is this with you?
transliteration: Alhamdulillah ana bekhair eh da elli ma'aki

arabic: ده كلب صغير بتاعي
english: This is my small dog.
transliteration: Da kalb soghayyar beta'i

arabic: كلب بس انا شفت قطة امبارح
english: A dog? But I saw a cat yesterday!
transliteration: Kalb bas ana shoft otta embareh

arabic: كل يوم الصبح باروح القهوة
english: Every day in the morning, I go to the café.
transliteration: Koll yom el sobh ba-rooh el 'ahwa.
storyTitle: At the Café in the Morning

arabic: باقعد مستني صاحبي هنا
english: I sit waiting for my friend here.
transliteration: Ba-'a'ed mestanni sahbi hena.
storyTitle: At the Café in the Morning

arabic: انا عايز قهوة سادة
english: I want a plain coffee.
transliteration: Ana 'ayez 'ahwa sada.
storyTitle: At the Café in the Morning

arabic: صاحبي لسه ما جاش دلوقتي
english: My friend hasn't come yet now.
transliteration: Sahbi lessa ma gash delwa'ti.
storyTitle: At the Café in the Morning

arabic: بشرب قهوتي وبستنى شوية كمان
english: I drink my coffee and wait a little bit more.
transliteration: Bashrab 'ahweti w ba-stanna shwaya kaman.
storyTitle: At the Café in the Morning

arabic: اهلا يا ساره يلا نخطط لرحلة في الويك اند ده
english: Hello Sarah, let's plan a trip this weekend.
transliteration: Ahlan ya Sarah, yalla nakhattet le rehla fel weekend da.

arabic: ايوه فكره حلوه قوي ممكن نروح مكان كبير جنب البحر
english: Yes, that's a great idea, we could go to a big place by the sea.
transliteration: Aywa fekra helwa awi, mumkin narouh makan kabiir ganb el bahr.

arabic: هنحتاج اكل كتير ومايه علشان اليوم هيكون طويل
english: We will need a lot of food and water because the day will be long.
transliteration: Hanhetaag akl ketiir w mayya 3alashan el yom haykoun tawiil.

arabic: انا متحمس اشوف السما الصافيه والنجوم بالليل
english: I'm excited to see the clear sky and the stars at night.
transliteration: Ana met7ammes ashouf el sama el safya wel nogoom belleil.

arabic: يلا نجهز شنطنا ونستمتع بالرحلة دي
english: Let's pack our bags and enjoy this trip.
transliteration: Yalla negahhez shonatina we nistamte3 bel rehla di.

arabic: صباح الخير يا احمد
english: Good morning, Ahmed.
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya Ahmed

arabic: صباح النور يا منى ازيك
english: Good morning, Mona. How are you?
transliteration: Sabah el noor ya Mona izzayek

arabic: انا كويسة الحمد لله هتروح الشغل النهاردة
english: I'm good, thank God. Are you going to work today?
transliteration: Ana kwayyisa el hamdulillah hatrouh el shoghl el naharda

arabic: ايوه بس هشرب قهوة واكل فطار الاول
english: Yes, but I will drink coffee and eat breakfast first.
transliteration: Aywa bas hashrob ahwa w akol fatar el awwal

arabic: تمام يوم سعيد
english: Okay, have a nice day.
transliteration: Tamam yom sa'eed

arabic: صباح الخير يا منى
english: Good morning, Mona.
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya Mona

arabic: صباح النور يا احمد ازيك عامل ايه
english: Good morning, Ahmed. How are you doing?
transliteration: Sabah el noor ya Ahmed ezzayak amel eh

arabic: الحمد لله تمام انتي رايحة فين دلوقتي
english: Praise be to God, I'm good. Where are you going now?
transliteration: Alhamdulillah tamam enty rayha fein delwa'ty

arabic: انا رايحة السوق اجيب اكل
english: I'm going to the market to get food.
transliteration: Ana rayha el souq ageeb akl

arabic: تمام انا رايح الشغل مع السلامة يا منى
english: Okay, I'm going to work. Goodbye, Mona.
transliteration: Tamam ana rayeh el shoghl ma'a el salama ya Mona

arabic: اليوم الصبح انا خططت اروح السوق المحلي
english: This morning, I planned to go to the local market.
transliteration: El-naharda es-sobh ana khaTTat arouh el-sou' el-mahalli.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: الجو الكويس في الربيع قصير عشان كده عايز استمتع بيه
english: The good weather in spring is short, that's why I want to enjoy it.
transliteration: El-gaww el-kawayyes fi er-rabii3 'aseer 'ashan keda 'ayez astamte' beih.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: انا محتاج اشتري خضار وفاكهة عشان اعمل اكله حلوة
english: I need to buy vegetables and fruits to make a nice meal.
transliteration: Ana mehtaag eshteri khoDaar we fakiha 'ashan a'mel akla Helwa.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: كمان فكرت في مشروب بارد اشربه وانا راجع
english: I also thought about a cold drink to have on my way back.
transliteration: Kamaan faKKart fi mashroub baared ashrabo wana raage'.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: السوق كان زحمة شوية بس فهمت كل حاجة انا عايزها
english: The market was a bit crowded, but I got everything I wanted.
transliteration: El-sou' kaan zaHma showaya bas fahimt kol Haga ana 'ayezha.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: يلا بينا نروح السوق الكبير مع امي
english: Let's go to the big market with my mother.
transliteration: Yalla bena nrooh el soo' el kibeer ma' ommy.

arabic: بنحب نشتري خضار وفاكهة طازة لبيتنا
english: We love to buy fresh vegetables and fruit for our home.
transliteration: Benhebb neshtary khodaar w fakha taza lebaytna.

arabic: السوق دايما زحمة وفيه ناس كتير بتضحك
english: The market is always crowded and there are many people laughing.
transliteration: El soo' dayman zahma w feeh nas keteer betdehak.

arabic: امي بتسأل البياع بكام التفاح الاحمر ده
english: My mother asks the seller, "How much is this red apple?"
transliteration: Ommy bets'al el bayya' bekam el toffah el ahmar da.

arabic: بعدين بنرجع البيت مبسوطين بكل اللي اشتريناه
english: Afterwards, we return home happy with everything we bought.
transliteration: Ba'deen benrega' el bayt mabsooteen bekol elly eshtarainah.

arabic: احنا بنجهز لفرح اختي الكبير
english: We are preparing for my big sister's wedding.
transliteration: Ehna bangehhez le farah okhty el kabeer.

arabic: احنا بنختار اكل حلو و مزيكا جميلة
english: We are choosing nice food and beautiful music.
transliteration: Ehna benkhtaar akl helw w mazika gameela.

arabic: ريحة الاكل هتكون حلوة و الورد لونه احمر
english: The smell of the food will be nice and the roses will be red.
transliteration: Reehet el akl hatkoon helwa w el ward loonoh ahmar.

arabic: ناس كتير جاية من كل مكان عشان الفرح
english: Many people are coming from everywhere for the wedding.
transliteration: Nas keteer gayya men kol makaan 'ashan el farah.

arabic: الفرح هيكون يوم كبير و جميل
english: The wedding will be a big and beautiful day.
transliteration: El farah haykoon yoom kabeer w gameel.

arabic: امبارح انا زرت خالتي
english: Yesterday, I visited my aunt.
transliteration: Imbaarih ana zort khalti.

arabic: هي كانت فرحانة قوي لما شافتني
english: She was very happy when she saw me.
transliteration: Hiyya kanit farhana qawi lamma shaafitni.

arabic: انا كمان حسيت اني مبسوط
english: I also felt happy.
transliteration: Ana kamaan haseet inni mabsoot.

arabic: اتكلمنا كتير وضحكنا
english: We talked a lot and laughed.
transliteration: Itkallimna kiteer we dehikna.

arabic: كانت زيارة حلوة وجميلة
english: It was a sweet and beautiful visit.
transliteration: Kanit ziyaara hilwa we gameela.

arabic: انا طبخت اكل جديد النهارده
english: I cooked a new dish today.
transliteration: Ana tabakht akl gadeed ennaharda.

arabic: اسرتي كانت معايا في المطبخ
english: My family was with me in the kitchen.
transliteration: Usrati kanet ma'aya fel matbakh.

arabic: كلنا كنا سعيدين واحنا بنحضر الاكل
english: We were all happy while preparing the food.
transliteration: Kollena konna sa'eedeen w ehna benhadar el akl.

arabic: الاكل كان شكله حلو وريحته كانت جميلة
english: The food looked good and smelled beautiful.
transliteration: El akl kan shaklo helw w rehto kanet gameela.

arabic: لما دوقناه لقيناه لذيذ جدا
english: When we tasted it, we found it very delicious.
transliteration: Lamma do'naah laqeenaah ladheedh geddan.

arabic: انا بصحى بدري اليوم
english: I wake up early today.
transliteration: Ana bas'ha badry el yoom.

arabic: انا بشرب قهوة في المطبخ
english: I drink coffee in the kitchen.
transliteration: Ana bashrab ahwa fy el matbakh.

arabic: انا بروح الشغل بالعربية
english: I go to work by car.
transliteration: Ana barooh el shoghl bel arabeya.

arabic: معنديش وقت كتير
english: I don't have much time.
transliteration: Ma'andeesh wa't keteer.

arabic: ده يوم زحمة
english: This is a busy day.
transliteration: Dah yoom zahma.

arabic: انا رحت ازور عمتي صباح الخير قالت لي صباح النور
english: I went to visit my aunt. "Good morning," I said, and she replied, "Good morning."
transliteration: Ana roht azour ammaty Sabah el kheer qaletly Sabah el noor

arabic: احنا فطرنا سوا واكلنا عيش وفول
english: We had breakfast together and ate bread and fava beans.
transliteration: Ehna fatarna sawa w akalna eish w fool

arabic: بليل اتفرجنا على التلفزيون وقلت مساء الخير
english: In the evening, we watched TV and I said, "Good evening."
transliteration: Belleil etfarragna ala el televisyoun w olt Masa' el kheer

arabic: هي ردت مساء النور واكلنا عشا بسيط
english: She replied, "Good evening," and we ate a simple dinner.
transliteration: Hiyya raddet Masa' el noor w akalna asha baseet

arabic: قبل ما انام قلت لها تصبح على خير
english: Before I slept, I said to her, "Good night."
transliteration: Qabl ma anam oltelha tesba7 ala kheer

arabic: ماما وبابا اشتروا هدية حلوة لبنت عمي في ديسمبر
english: Mom and Dad bought a nice gift for my cousin in December.
transliteration: Mama w baba eshtaraw hedeya helwa le bent ammi fi december

arabic: لكن الهدية كانت كبيرة شوية عليها
english: But the gift was a bit big for her.
transliteration: Laken el hedeya kanet kebira shwaya aleiha

arabic: النهاردة واحد يناير واحنا رايحين المحل نرجعها
english: Today is January 1st and we are going to the shop to return it.
transliteration: Ennaharda wahed yanayer we ehna rayheen el mahal neragga'ha

arabic: صاحب المحل كان طيب قوي وقال مفيش مشكلة
english: The shop owner was very kind and said no problem.
transliteration: Sahebel mahal kan tayeb qawi w qal mafeesh moshkela

arabic: اخدنا هدية تانية اصغر وبابا شكر الراجل
english: We took another smaller gift and Dad thanked the man.
transliteration: Akhadna hedeya tanya asghar w baba shakar el ragel

arabic: كان فيه طفل اسمه كريم دايما بيسال امي اسئلة كتير وهو في البيت
english: There was a child named Karim who always asked my mother many questions while he was at home.
transliteration: Kan fe tifl esmo Kareem dayman byesal ommy as'ela kiteer w howa fel bayt.

arabic: في يوم قال يلا يا امي نروح السوق الكبير عشان نشتري فاكهة وخضار
english: One day he said, "Let's go, my mother, to the big market to buy fruit and vegetables."
transliteration: Fe yom 'al yalla ya ommy nrooh el soo' el kibeer 'ashan neshtary fakha w khodaar.

arabic: كريم سال امه الفاكهة دي بكام وليه بنحب الجزر
english: Karim asked his mother, "How much is this fruit, and why do we love carrots?"
transliteration: Kareem sa'al ommo el fakha di bekam w leih benhebb el gazar.

arabic: امي كانت بترد بصبر على كل سؤال وبيضحكوا مع بعض كتير
english: My mother answered patiently every question, and they laughed a lot together.
transliteration: Ommy kanet betrodd be-sabr 'ala kol so'al w beyedhakkoo ma' ba'd kiteer.

arabic: وفي الاخر امي سالته سؤال واحد انت مين انا مش فاكراك
english: And in the end, my mother asked him one question, "Who are you? I don't remember you."
transliteration: W fel akher ommy sa'alto so'al wahed enta meen ana mesh fakrak.

arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع شفت صاحبي القديم
english: I was walking in the street, I saw my old friend.
transliteration: kunt maashi fi esh-shaare' shuft saahbi el-adeem

arabic: كان شايل شنطه كبيره
english: He was carrying a big bag.
transliteration: kaan shayel shanta kebeera

arabic: قولتله يا عم في شنطتك ايه كتاب وقلم
english: I told him 'Dude, what's in your bag, a book and a pen?'
transliteration: oltelo ya 'amm fi shantetak eh kitaab we qalam

arabic: ضحك وقالي ايوه عشان اذاكر
english: He laughed and told me 'Yes, for studying.'
transliteration: dehek we ali aywa 'ashaan azaker

arabic: احنا ضحكنا كتير كان يوم مضحك
english: We laughed a lot, it was a funny day.
transliteration: ehna dehekna keteer kaan yom modhek

arabic: انا بزور خالتي كل يوم جمعة
english: I visit my aunt every Friday
transliteration: Ana bazoor khalti koll yom gom'a

arabic: هي بتعمل اكل حلو قوي
english: She makes very delicious food
transliteration: Heya beta'mel akl helw qawi

arabic: احنا بناكل سوا وبنشرب شاي
english: We eat together and drink tea
transliteration: Ehna benakel sawa we benshrab shay

arabic: بعد الاكل بتكلم معاها كتير
english: After eating I talk with her a lot
transliteration: Ba'd el akl batkallem ma'aha keteer

arabic: يوم الجمعة ده يوم حلو قوي
english: This Friday is a very nice day
transliteration: Yom el gom'a dah yom helw qawi

arabic: مساء الخير كنا بنروح النادي عشان نشوف ماتش كورة
english: Good evening We were going to the club to watch a football match
transliteration: Masa' el-kheer Konna benrooh el-nadi 'ashan neshof match kora

arabic: الجو كان حلو والناس كانت فرحانة
english: The weather was nice and people were happy
transliteration: El-gaww kan helw wel-nas kanet farhana

arabic: يا دوب لحقت بداية الماتش بعد زحمة الطريق
english: I barely caught the start of the match after the traffic jam
transliteration: Ya doob lahaqt bedayet el-match ba'd zahmet el-tari'

arabic: الفريق بتاعنا جاب جولين في اول عشر دقايق
english: Our team scored two goals in the first ten minutes
transliteration: El-faree' beta'na gab goleen fi awwal 'ashar da'aye'

arabic: بس بعد كده عرفنا اننا في الماتش الغلط
english: But then we realized we were at the wrong match
transliteration: Bas ba'd keda 'arefna ennena fil-match el-ghalat

arabic: يلا يا امي نشتري فاكهة وخضار من السوق الكبير
english: Let's go, my mother, to buy fruit and vegetables from the big market.
transliteration: Yalla ya ommy neshtary fakha we khodaar men el soo' el kibeer.

arabic: مش لاقي الطريق للسوق وانا تايه دلوقتي
english: I can't find the way to the market and I am lost now.
transliteration: Mesh la'y el taree' lel soo' we ana tayeh delwa'ty.

arabic: سالت راجل عفيف لو سمحت فين السوق الكبير
english: I asked a kind man: Excuse me, where is the big market?
transliteration: Sa'alt raagil 'afeef: lw samaht feen el soo' el kibeer?

arabic: هو وراني الطريق وقالي انه قريب من البيت
english: He showed me the way and told me it's close to the house.
transliteration: Huwa warrany el taree' we 'aly eno 'areeb men el bayt.

arabic: فرحت جدا عشان بنحب الفاكهة الفريش
english: I was very happy because we love fresh fruit.
transliteration: Faraht geddan 'ashan benhebb el fakha el fresh.

arabic: امبارح رحت عند تيتا
english: Yesterday I went to Grandma's.
transliteration: Imbaarih roht aand tiita.

arabic: تيتا بتحب تقعد في البيت القديم
english: Grandma loves to sit in the old house.
transliteration: Tiita bithebb teq'od fil-beet el-qadiim.

arabic: انا بحب العب العاب على الموبايل
english: I love to play games on my mobile.
transliteration: Ana bahebb al'ab al'aab 'ala el-mobaayil.

arabic: تيتا بتحكي قصص زمان
english: Grandma tells stories from the past.
transliteration: Tiita bitḥki qisas zamaan.

arabic: في فرق كبير بينا بس بنحب بعض
english: There is a big difference between us but we love each other.
transliteration: Fi far' kibiir beynina bas benḥebb ba'ḍ.

arabic: انهارده انا رحت بيت خالتي
english: Today I went to my aunt's house.
transliteration: Ennaharda ana roht beit khalti.

arabic: هي قالت اهلا ازيك يا حبيبتي
english: She said Welcome, how are you my dear?
transliteration: Heya 'alet ahlan izzayek ya habibti.

arabic: احنا شربنا شاي سوا
english: We drank tea together.
transliteration: Ehna sherebna shay sawa.

arabic: بعدين اكلنا كحك حلو كتير
english: Then we ate a lot of sweet kahk.
transliteration: Ba'dein aklna kahk helw keteer.

arabic: انا كنت مبسوطة اوي هناك
english: I was very happy there.
transliteration: Ana kont mabsoota awe henāk.

arabic: انا قاعد في قهوة
english: I am sitting in a cafe.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed fi ahwa

arabic: انا مستني صاحبي
english: I am waiting for my friend.
transliteration: Ana mestanny sahby

arabic: انا عايز قهوة من فضلك
english: I want coffee please.
transliteration: Ana ayiz ahwa min fadlak

arabic: هو مش هنا دلوقتي
english: He is not here now.
transliteration: Howa mesh hena delwa'ty

arabic: اهلا يا صاحبي انت الوتر
english: Hello my friend, you are the waiter!
transliteration: Ahlan ya sahby enta el weyter

arabic: صباح الخير يا عمو، معلش، ممكن أسأل عن حاجة؟
english: Good morning, uncle. Excuse me, can I ask about something?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya ammo, ma'alesh, mumkin as'al 'an haga?

arabic: أهلاً يا بنتي، إزيك؟ أيوه طبعاً، اتفضلي.
english: Welcome, my daughter, how are you? Yes, of course, please.
transliteration: Ahlan ya benti, izzayek? Aywa tab'an, etfaddali.

arabic: أنا بدور على محل هدايا كويس خالص لجدتي.
english: I am looking for a very good gift shop for my grandmother.
transliteration: Ana badawwar 'ala mahal hadaya kowayyes khales le-gaddeti.

arabic: طب، روحي هناك، هتلاقي محل حلو قوي، سلام.
english: Okay, go there, you'll find a very nice shop, goodbye.
transliteration: Tab, roohi henāk, hatla'i mahal helw 'awei, salam.

arabic: شكراً جداً يا عمو، مع السلامة!
english: Thank you very much, uncle, goodbye!
transliteration: Shokran geddan ya ammo, ma'a el-salama!

arabic: الاسبوع الجاي اجازة نهاية الاسبوع
english: Next week is the weekend holiday
transliteration: El esboo3 el gay agazet nehayeet el esboo3

arabic: الشباب عايزين يروحوا مكان جديد بعربية
english: The young people want to go to a new place by car
transliteration: El shabab 3ayzin yrou7u makan gedeed be3arabeya

arabic: لكن بابا وماما عايزين يقعدوا في البيت ويرتاحوا
english: But dad and mom want to stay home and relax
transliteration: Laken baba w mama 3ayzin ya3'odu fel beit w yerta7u

arabic: هما مش عايزين رحلة طويلة
english: They don't want a long trip
transliteration: Homa mesh 3ayzin rehla tawila

arabic: كل واحد ليه فكرة مختلفة
english: Everyone has a different idea
