transliteration: Kol wa7ed leih fekra mokhtalefa

arabic: كان يوم عيد ميلاد رامي يوم كبير ليه
english: It was Ramy's birthday, a big day for him.
transliteration: kaan yom eid milaad Ramy yom kabiir lih

arabic: عيلته جهزت اكل كتير وتورته كبيره في البيت
english: His family prepared a lot of food and a big cake at their house.
transliteration: aeilto gahhazit akl kitiir w torte kabiira fil bayt

arabic: لما شاف المفاجاه رامي كان مبسوط اوي
english: When he saw the surprise, Ramy was very happy.
transliteration: lamma shaaf el mofaga'a Ramy kaan mabsuut awi

arabic: صاحبه قال اهلا يا رامي وهو رد ايوه شكرا انك جيت
english: His friend said "Hello Ramy" and he replied "Yes, thank you for coming".
transliteration: saahbo aal ahlan ya Ramy w howwa radd aywa shukran innak geet

arabic: كل الناس استمتعوا باليوم والاكل الحلو
english: Everyone enjoyed the day and the delicious food.
transliteration: koll en naas estamta'u bel yom wel akl el helw

arabic: شفت الجارة صباح الخير
english: I saw the neighbor, 'Good morning'.
transliteration: Shoft el gara sabah el kheir

arabic: سألتها عاملة ايه
english: I asked her, 'How are you?'
transliteration: Sa'alteha amila eh

arabic: قالت الحمد لله تمام
english: She said, 'Praise be to God, fine'.
transliteration: Qalet alhamdulillah tamam

arabic: قلتلها عايزة قهوة
english: I told her, 'Do you want coffee?'
transliteration: Oltelha ayza ahwa

arabic: ابتسمت وقالت شكرا مع السلامة
english: She smiled and said, 'Thank you, goodbye'.
transliteration: Ibtasemet w qalet shukran ma'a el salama

arabic: مساء الخير يا سارة ايه خططك للويك اند
english: Good evening, Sarah. What are your plans for the weekend?
transliteration: Masa' el-kheer ya Sara, eh khitatik lel weekend?

arabic: انا بفكر نروح اسكندرية
english: I'm thinking of going to Alexandria.
transliteration: Ana bafakkar nrooh Eskandareya.

arabic: الرحلة هتاخد بالكتير ساعتين بالمرور
english: The trip will take at most two hours with traffic.
transliteration: El rehla hatakhod bel kateer sa'atein bel moroor.

arabic: فكرة حلوة كنا بنروح هناك زمان
english: Good idea, we used to go there a long time ago.
transliteration: Fekra helwa, konna benrooh henāk zaman.

arabic: يلا بينا نحجز دلوقتي قبل ما الوقت يفوت
english: Let's book now before time runs out.
transliteration: Yalla bena nahgez delwa'ti abl ma el wa't yefoot.

arabic: كل يوم جمعة العيلة كلها بتتجمع في بيت تيتا الكبير
english: Every Friday, the whole family gathers at Grandma's big house.
transliteration: Kull yom gom'a el 'ayla kolleha betetgamme' fi bayt teta el kibeer

arabic: امي بتجهز اكل كتير فيه خضار وفاكهة طازة
english: My mother prepares a lot of food with fresh vegetables and fruit.
transliteration: Ommy betegehhez akl kiteer feeh khodaar w fakha taza

arabic: الشباب بيحبوا ياكلوا بيتزا لكن الكبار بنحب الاكل التقليدي
english: The youth love to eat pizza, but the elders love traditional food.
transliteration: Esh-shabab beyhebbou yaklou pizza laken el kobar benhebb el akl el taqleedy

arabic: تيتا دايماً بتسأل بكام اشترينا الفاكهة والخضار من السوق
english: Grandma always asks how much we bought the fruit and vegetables for from the market.
transliteration: Teta dayman betes'al bekam eshtareena el fakha wel khodaar men el soo'

arabic: بالرغم من الاختلافات بنقضي وقت حلو وبنضحك كتير مع بعض
english: Despite the differences, we spend a good time and laugh a lot together.
transliteration: Belraghm men el ekhtelafat benqady wa't helw w benedhak kiteer ma' ba'd

arabic: امبارح كنت بتفرج على ماتش كورة مهم في التليفزيون
english: Yesterday I was watching an important football match on TV
transliteration: Imbaareh kont batfarraj ala match koora mohimm fi el-televezyoun

arabic: الجو كان برد شوية زي الشتا فعملت مشروب سخن
english: The weather was a bit cold like winter, so I made a hot drink
transliteration: El-gaww kaan bard showaya zayy esh-sheta fa amalt mashroub sokhn

arabic: الماتش كان قصير بس كل دقيقة فيه كانت مهمة جدا
english: The match was short, but every minute in it was very important
transliteration: El-match kaan 'aseer bass koll di'ee'a feeh kaanet mohimma geddan

arabic: لما اللعيبة خططوا صح للجون فهمت انهم هيكسبوا
english: When the players planned correctly for the goal, I understood they would win
transliteration: Lamma el-la'eeba khaTTatu saHH lel-goon fahimt innohom hayeksabo

arabic: بعد الماتش اكلت اكلة حلوة واخدت كتاب جديد اقراه عشان احتفل بالفوز
english: After the match, I ate a nice meal and took a new book to read to celebrate the win
transliteration: Ba'd el-match akalt akla Helwa w akhadt ketaab gedeed aqraah ashan aHtifel bel-fouz

arabic: صباح الخير يا عم سيد، عامل إيه؟
english: Good morning, Uncle Sayed, how are you?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya 3amm Sayed, 3amel eih?

arabic: أهو ماشي يا بنتي، بس لسه مشربتش شاي.
english: Just getting by, my daughter, but I haven't had tea yet.
transliteration: Aho mashi ya binti, bas lessa mashrebtish shai.

arabic: معلش يا عم سيد، أجيب لك شاي مظبوط؟
english: Never mind, Uncle Sayed, shall I get you medium-sugar tea?
transliteration: Ma3lesh ya 3amm Sayed, ageeb lak shai mazboot?

arabic: أيوه يا بنتي، يبقى كتر خيرك خالص!
english: Yes, my daughter, that would be very kind of you!
transliteration: Aywa ya binti, yebqa kattar kheirik khales!

arabic: ماشي يا عم سيد، سلام!
english: Okay, Uncle Sayed, bye!
transliteration: Mashi ya 3amm Sayed, salam!

arabic: امبارح رحت المحل عشان اشتري هدوم جديدة
english: Yesterday, I went to the shop to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Imbareh roht el mahall 'ashan ashtari hodoom gedeeda.

arabic: لقيت تيشيرت ازرق جميل
english: I found a beautiful blue t-shirt.
transliteration: Le'eet tishirt azraq gameel.

arabic: سالت بكام واشتريته بفلوسي
english: I asked how much it was and bought it with my money.
transliteration: Sa'alt bekam w ashtarītuh befloosi.

arabic: رجعت البيت مبسوط بالتيشيرت الجديد
english: I went home happy with the new t-shirt.
transliteration: Rege't el beit mabsoot bel tishirt el gedeed.

arabic: بس لما لبسته لقيت انه بتاع طفل
english: But when I wore it, I realized it was for a child!
transliteration: Bas lamma lebistuh le'eet innuh beta' tefl!

arabic: مساء الخير يا ماما احنا لازم نجهز للفرح
english: Good evening mom, we must prepare for the wedding.
transliteration: Masa' el-kheer ya mama e7na lazim negahez lel fara7.

arabic: كنا بنروح محلات الفساتين عشان نختار فستان العروسة
english: We used to go to dress shops to choose the bride's dress.
transliteration: Konna benrooh ma7allat el fasateen 3ashan nekhtar fostan el 3aroosa.

arabic: يا دوب لقينا القاعة الفاضية في الوقت المناسب
english: We barely found an available hall at the right time.
transliteration: Ya doob la'eena el qa3a el fadya fel wa't el monaseb.

arabic: لازم نكلم كل قرايبنا وعيلتنا عشان يجوا الفرح
english: We must call all our relatives and family to come to the wedding.
transliteration: Lazim nekallem kol 'arayebna w 3eiletna 3ashan yegoo el fara7.

arabic: الفرح هيكون كبير وفيه اكل كتير ورقص
english: The wedding will be big with a lot of food and dancing.
transliteration: El fara7 haykoon kebeer w fee akl keteer w ra's.

arabic: انا بصحى بدري كل يوم
english: I wake up early every day
transliteration: Ana bas7a badri koll yom

arabic: انا بشرب قهوة بسرعة
english: I drink coffee quickly
transliteration: Ana bashrab ahwa be sor3a

arabic: بعدين بلبس عشان الشغل
english: Then I get dressed for work
transliteration: Ba3dein balbes 3ashan el shoghl

arabic: انا مفيش وقت افطر
english: I don't have time for breakfast
transliteration: Ana mafeesh wa't aftar

arabic: انا بنزل من البيت الساعة سبعة
english: I leave the house at seven
transliteration: Ana banzel men el beit el sa3a sab3a

arabic: العيلة قاعدة على الترابيزة النهاردة
english: The family is sitting at the table today.
transliteration: El 3eila qa3da 3ala el tarabeeza elnaharda.

arabic: هما بياكلوا وجبة لذيذة
english: They are eating a delicious meal.
transliteration: Homa biyaklo wagba lazeza.

arabic: ماما بتشرب مياه وبابا مبسوط
english: Mom is drinking water and dad is happy.
transliteration: Mama beteshrab mayyah w baba mabsout.

arabic: فجأة قطة صغيرة جت تحت الترابيزة
english: Suddenly a small cat came under the table.
transliteration: Fa-ga'a otta sagheeera gat taht el tarabeeza.

arabic: القطة ابتدت تاكل من الأكل
english: The cat started eating from the food!
transliteration: El otta ebtadet takol men el akl!

arabic: لمياء كانت فرحانة جدا النهاردة عشان رايحة تشتري هدوم جديدة
english: Lamia was very happy today because she was going to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Lamyaa kanet farhana giddan elnaharda ashan rayha teshtari hedoom gedeeda.

arabic: دخلت المحل وشافت فستان احمر كبير اوي عجبها
english: She entered the shop and saw a very big red dress she liked.
transliteration: Dakhalet elmahall w shafet fostan ahmar kabiir awi agabaha.

arabic: لما قاست الفستان طلع واسع عليها وقالت لا مش ده المقاس بتاعي
english: When she tried on the dress, it turned out to be loose on her, and she said, "No, this is not my size."
transliteration: Lamma qaset elfostan talaa' wase' aleiha w qalet la mesh da elmaqaas beta'i.

arabic: البياع قالها ايوه عندنا مقاس اصغر فابتسمت لمياء تاني
english: The salesperson told her, "Yes, we have a smaller size," so Lamia smiled again.
transliteration: Elbayyaa' qalha aywa 'andena maqaas asghar fabtasamet Lamyaa tani.

arabic: لبست الفستان الصغير وكان جميل عليها اوي وقالت شكرا اخيرا لقيته
english: She wore the small dress, and it was very beautiful on her, and she said, "Thank you, I finally found it."
transliteration: Lebset elfostan elsoghayyar w kan gamil aleiha awi w qalet shukran akheeran laqeetoh.

arabic: انا عايزة اشتري هدوم جديدة
english: I want to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Ana ayza ashtari hedoom gedeeda

arabic: انا رحت محل كبير في وسط البلد
english: I went to a big shop downtown.
transliteration: Ana rooht mahal kabeer fi wasat el balad

arabic: سألت البياع لو عنده قميص لونه ازرق
english: I asked the salesperson if he had a blue shirt.
transliteration: Sa'alt el bayya' law a'ando amees loonoh azraq

arabic: قال لي ايوه اتفضلي جربي المقاس ده
english: He told me, "Yes, please try this size."
transliteration: A'al li "aywa etfaddali garrabi el ma'as dah"

arabic: القميص كان حلو اوي وانا اشتريته
english: The shirt was very nice and I bought it.
transliteration: El amees kan helw awi w ana eshtareetoh

arabic: انا رايح السوبر ماركت
english: I am going to the supermarket.
transliteration: Ana rayeh el supermarket.

arabic: بس انا تايه
english: But I am lost.
transliteration: Bas ana tayeh.

arabic: لو سمحت ممكن تساعدني
english: Excuse me, can you help me?
transliteration: Law samaht, momken tsa'edny?

arabic: فين السوبر ماركت ده
english: Where is this supermarket?
transliteration: Feen el supermarket da?

arabic: امشي طوالي وبعدين يمين شكرا
english: Go straight ahead, then turn right. Thank you.
transliteration: Emshy tawali w ba'deen yemeen. Shukran.

arabic: هدى، طالبة، قالت صباح الخير لجارتها.
english: Hoda, a student, said "Good morning" to her neighbor.
transliteration: Hoda, taliba, alat sabah el kheir le garatha.

arabic: جارتها ردت: "صباح النور يا هدى، ازيك؟"
english: Her neighbor replied: "Good morning, Hoda, how are you?"
transliteration: Garatha raddet: "Sabah el noor ya Hoda, ezayek?"

arabic: هي قالت: "الحمد لله، كويسة خالص، شكراً".
english: She said: "Praise be to God, very good, thank you."
transliteration: Heya alat: "Elhamdulellah, kowayesa khales, shukran."

arabic: ثم قابلت زميلها، قال: "سلام عليكم يا هدى!"
english: Then she met her colleague, he said: "Peace be upon you, Hoda!"
transliteration: Thum abilat zameelha, al: "Salam alaikum ya Hoda!"

arabic: هي ردت بسرعة: "وعليكم السلام، مع السلامة!"
english: She replied quickly: "And upon you be peace, goodbye!"
transliteration: Heya raddet besor'a: "Wa alaikum el salam, ma'a el salama!"

arabic: امي بتخطط لحفلة كبيرة في البيت
english: My mother is planning a big party at home.
transliteration: Ommy betkhattat lahafla kibeera fel bayt.

arabic: قالت يلا لازم نشتري فاكهة وخضار من السوق
english: She said, 'Let's go, we need to buy fruit and vegetables from the market'.
transliteration: Aallet yalla lazim neshtary fakha we khodaar men el soo'.

arabic: انا سالت بكام كل الاكل ده
english: I asked, 'How much will all this food be?'
transliteration: Ana sa'alt bekam koll el akl da?

arabic: ردت وقالت احنا بنحب الاكل الحلو عشان كده هيكون غالي
english: She replied, 'We love good food, so it will be expensive!'
transliteration: Raddet we aallet ehna benhebb el akl el helw ashan kida haykoon ghaly.

arabic: الحفلة هتكون كبيرة ومرحة بس محفظتي هتكون فاضية
english: The party will be big and fun, but my wallet will be empty.
transliteration: El hafla hatkoon kibeera we marha bas mahfazty hatkoon fadya.

arabic: النهاردة كان يوم حلو اوي في المدرسة
english: Today was a very nice day at school
transliteration: Ennaharda kan yom helw awi fel madrasa

arabic: قابلت اصحابي ولعبنا مع بعض كتير
english: I met my friends and we played a lot together
transliteration: Qabelt ashabi we le'abna ma' ba'd keteer

arabic: الميس شرحت درس جديد ومفيد لينا كلنا
english: The teacher explained a new and useful lesson for all of us
transliteration: El mis sharahet dars gedeed we mofeed leena kollena

arabic: لما روحت البيت ماما عملت اكل مصري لذيذ
english: When I went home, mom made delicious Egyptian food
transliteration: Lamma roht el beet mama 'amelet akl Masri lazeez

arabic: قعدنا كلنا سوا واتكلمنا عن كل حاجة في اليوم
english: We all sat together and talked about everything in the day
transliteration: Qa'adna kollena sawa we etkallamna 'an koll haga fel yom

arabic: احمد كان ماشي في الشارع بعد الشغل
english: Ahmed was walking in the street after work.
transliteration: Ahmed kan mashi fi ash-shari' ba'd ash-shoghl.

arabic: فجأة حس انه تاه ومش عارف يروح فين
english: Suddenly he felt lost and didn't know where to go.
transliteration: Faga'a hass enno tah w mesh 'aref yerouh fein.

arabic: شاف راجل كبير فقال له مساء الخير يا عمو
english: He saw an old man so he said
transliteration: Shaf ragel kebir fa'al lo masa' el-kheer ya 'ammu.

arabic: الراجل رد مساء النور عامل ايه يا ابني
english: The man replied
transliteration: Ar-ragel radd masa' an-noor 'amel eih ya ebny.

arabic: احمد سأله ازاي اروح محطة المترو لو سمحت
english: Ahmed asked him
transliteration: Ahmed sa'alo ezayy arouh mahaṭṭet el-metro law samaḥt.

arabic: احنا هنرتب رحلة حلوة للويك اند
english: We will organize a nice trip for the weekend.
transliteration: Ehna haneratteb rehla helwa lel weekend.

arabic: امبارح صاحبي رفض فكرة نروح الصحرا
english: Yesterday, my friend rejected the idea of going to the desert.
transliteration: Embareh sahby rafad fekret nrooh el sahra.

arabic: دلوقتي بفكر في حتة على البحر
english: Now, I am thinking of a place by the sea.
transliteration: Delwa'ty bafakkar fi hetta ala el bahr.

arabic: هتصل بيه بكره عشان نكمل الخطة
english: I will call him tomorrow to continue the plan.
transliteration: Hatessel beeh bokra ashan nakammel el khotta.

arabic: يا رب يسمحلي اختار المرة دي
english: I hope he allows me to choose this time!
transliteration: Ya rab yasmahly akhtar el marra de!

arabic: انا بمشي في شارع جديد وانا تايه
english: I am walking on a new street and I am lost
transliteration: Ana bamshi fi shaare' gedeed w ana tayeh

arabic: انا مش لاقي الطريق لبيتي
english: I am not finding the way to my house
transliteration: Ana mish la'i el taree' le beiti

arabic: سالت راجل كبير لو سمحت فين الشارع ده
english: I asked an old man, "Excuse me, where is this street?"
transliteration: Sa'alt ragel kabeer law samaht feen el shaare' da

arabic: الراجل شاور على اليمين وقال امشي طوالي
english: The man pointed to the right and said, "Walk straight."
transliteration: El ragel shawar 'ala el yemeen w 'al emshi tawali

arabic: انا دلوقتي مبسوط وشكرا للراجل
english: I am happy now and thank you to the man
transliteration: Ana delwa'ti mabsoot w shukran lel ragel

arabic: صباح الخير يا عمو! قالت ليلى.
english: Good morning, uncle! said Layla.
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya 3ammo! Qalet Layla.

arabic: صباح النور يا بنتي، وعليكم السلام. ردّ الرجل.
english: Morning of light, my daughter, and upon you be peace. The man replied.
transliteration: Sabah el-nour ya binti, wa 3alaykum es-salam. Radd er-ragul.

arabic: أزيك يا عمو، أنا عايزة هدية. سألت بتردد.
english: How are you, uncle? I want a gift. She asked hesitantly.
transliteration: Azzayik ya 3ammo, ana 3ayza hedeyya. Sa'alet bi-taraddud.

arabic: طب ادخلي يا بنتي، تشربي شاي؟ قال بابتسامة.
english: Well, come in, my daughter, would you like tea? He said with a smile.
transliteration: Tab odkhuli ya binti, tishrabi shay? Qal bi-ibtisama.

arabic: أيوه، السلام عليكم يا عمو. ردت وهي تدخل.
english: Yes, peace be upon you, uncle. She replied as she entered.
transliteration: Aywa, es-salam 3alaykum ya 3ammo. Raddet we hiya tadkhul.

arabic: ليلى بتجهز فرحها الكبير
english: Layla is preparing for her big wedding.
transliteration: Layla betegehhez faraha el kebir.

arabic: هي بتشوف فساتين كتير ومبسوطة اوي
english: She sees many dresses and is very happy.
transliteration: Heya betshoof fasateen keteer we mabsoota awi.

arabic: اخوها بيساعدها بس هو تعبان شوية
english: Her brother helps her, but he is a little tired.
transliteration: Akhooha byesaa'edha bas howa ta'baan showaya.

arabic: الاكل صعب نختاره بس هما لاقوا حل
english: The food is difficult to choose, but they found a solution.
transliteration: El akl sa'b nekhtaro bas homa la'o hall.

arabic: كل الناس متحمسة لليوم الحلو ده
english: Everyone is excited for this beautiful day.
transliteration: Koll el nas methammesa lel yoom el helw da.

arabic: السلام عليكم امبارح كان ماتش كورة حلو في البيت
english: Hello yesterday there was a nice football match at home
transliteration: As-salamu alaykum imbareh kan match koora helw fi el-bayt

arabic: انا وصاحبي كنا بنلعب في الصالة
english: My friend and I were playing in the living room
transliteration: Ana w sahibi kunna benla'ab fi es-sala

arabic: الكورة دخلت طبق الفاكهة بالغلط
english: The ball went into the fruit bowl by mistake
transliteration: El-koora dakhalet tabaq el-fakha bel ghalat

arabic: ماما ضحكت وقالت يا خبر ابيض
english: Mom laughed and said 'Oh my goodness'
transliteration: Mama daheket w 'alet ya khabar abyad

arabic: وعليكم السلام هنلعب برا البيت المرة الجاية
english: And upon you be peace we will play outside the house next time
transliteration: Wa alaykum as-salam hanla'ab barra el-bayt el-marra el-gayya

arabic: صباح الخير يا ماما
english: Good morning, Mama.
transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer ya Mama.

arabic: صباح النور حبيبي ليه السما زرقا
english: Morning of light, my dear. Why is the sky blue?
transliteration: Sabaḥ an-noor ḥabibi. Leih el-sama zarqa?

arabic: وايه ده ليه القطة بتجري
english: And what is that? Why is the cat running?
transliteration: W eih da? Leih el-oṭṭa btegri?

arabic: ماما جاوبت على كل الاسئلة بصبر
english: Mama answered all the questions patiently.
transliteration: Mama gawabet ala kol el-as'ela be-ṣabr.

arabic: بعدين الطفل قال السلام عليكم انت مين
english: Then the child said, "Hello, who are you?"
transliteration: Ba'dein el-ṭefl qal As-salamu alaykum, enta meen?

arabic: علي ولد صغير بيحب يسال كتير
english: Ali is a small boy who loves to ask a lot of questions.
transliteration: Ali walad soghayar bihebb yis'al keteer

arabic: هو بيسال ماما ايه ده وايه ده
english: He asks Mama 'what is this?' and 'what is that?'
transliteration: howa biyes'al Mama eih dah wa eih dah

arabic: ماما بتجاوب وكل حاجه عندها اجابه
english: Mama answers, and everything has an answer with her.
transliteration: Mama bitgawib wa koll haga andaha egaba

arabic: بعدين علي بيسال ليه يا ماما
english: Then Ali asks, 'why, Mama?'
transliteration: ba'dein Ali biyes'al leih ya Mama

arabic: بابا سعيد وبيقول علي شاطر
english: Papa is happy and says Ali is clever.
transliteration: Baba sa'eed wa biy'ool Ali shater

arabic: النهاردة انا رايح السوق
english: Today I am going to the market.
transliteration: El naharda ana rayeh el soo'

arabic: عايز اشتري خضار وفاكهة
english: I want to buy vegetables and fruit.
transliteration: Ayiz ishtiree khaDaar we fakiha

arabic: السوق كبير وفيه ناس كتير
english: The market is big and has many people.
transliteration: El soo' kebeer we feeh nas kiteer

arabic: بشوف طماطم وتفاح حلوين
english: I see nice tomatoes and apples.
transliteration: Bashoof tamatem we tuffah helween

arabic: معايا فلوس عشان اشتري كل حاجة
english: I have money to buy everything.
transliteration: Ma'aya felous 'ashan ishtiree kol haga

arabic: انا رحت السوق النهاردة السوق كان زحمة قوي
english: I went to the market today. The market was very crowded.
transliteration: Ana roht el souq el naharda. El souq kan zahma qawi.

arabic: شفت خضار وفاكهة كتير بالوان حلوة وريحتهم كانت فريش
english: I saw many vegetables and fruits with beautiful colors and their smell was fresh.
transliteration: Shoft khodar w fakha kiteer be alwan helwa w rehet-hom kanet fresh.

arabic: سمعت ناس كتير بتتكلم وصوتهم كان عالي
english: I heard many people talking and their voices were loud.
transliteration: Sema't nas kiteer betetkallem w sawt-hom kan 'aly.

arabic: اشتريت طماطم وفراولة عشان اعمل اكل حلو
english: I bought tomatoes and strawberries to make good food.
transliteration: Eshtarait tamatem w farawla 'ashan a'mel akl helw.

arabic: روحت البيت مبسوطة بعد السوق
english: I went home happy after the market.
transliteration: Roht el beit mabsoota ba'd el souq.

arabic: انا عايز اشتري لبس جديد النهارده
english: I want to buy new clothes today.
transliteration: Ana ayez ashtiri libs gideed ennaharda.

arabic: رحنا محل كبير فيه لبس كتير
english: We went to a big shop with many clothes.
transliteration: Rohna mahal kabeer feeh libs keteer.

arabic: شفت قميص جميل وبنطلون
english: I saw a beautiful shirt and trousers.
transliteration: Shoft amees gameel w bantaloon.

arabic: قست القميص بس كان صغير اوي
english: I tried the shirt on, but it was too small.
transliteration: Aset el amees bas kan saghir awi.

arabic: عرفت ان ده لبس الكلب بتاعي
english: I realized that these were my dog's clothes.
transliteration: Araft in da libs el kalb beta'i.

arabic: انا اشتريت قميص امبارح
english: I bought a shirt yesterday.
transliteration: Ana eshtareet ameesh embareh

arabic: القميص كبير شوية
english: The shirt is a bit big.
transliteration: El ameesh kabeer shwaya

arabic: انا عايز ارجعه المحل
english: I want to return it to the shop.
transliteration: Ana ayiz aragge'oh el mahal

arabic: انا رايح المحل دلوقتي
english: I am going to the shop now.
transliteration: Ana rayih el mahal delwa'ty

arabic: اتمنى يغيروه
english: I hope they change it.
transliteration: Atmanna yighayyirooh

arabic: صباح الخير يا أميرة ازيكِ عاملة ايه النهاردة
english: Good morning Amira, how are you doing today?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheer ya Amira izzayyik amla eh el-naharda?

arabic: أهلاً بيكي يا منى أنا كويسة الحمد لله وربنا يخليكي
english: Welcome to you Mona, I'm good thank God, and may God keep you safe.
transliteration: Ahlan beeki ya Mona ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah w rabena yekhalleeki.

arabic: كنت عايزة أسألك على ولادك عاملين ايه وحشتيني كتير
english: I wanted to ask about your children, how are they doing? I missed you a lot.
transliteration: Kont ayza as'alak ala weladak amleen eh wahhashtini kteer.

arabic: ولادي كويسين بيسلموا عليكي تعالي اشربي معانا شاي
english: My children are fine, they send their regards. Come drink tea with us.
transliteration: Weladi kwayyeseen bisallimoo alayki ta'ali ishrabi ma'ana shay.

arabic: تسلمي يا حبيبتي ان شاء الله اجيلك بعد الظهر مع السلامة
english: Thank you my dear, God willing I'll come to you in the afternoon, goodbye.
transliteration: Teslami ya habibti in sha'Allah agilak ba'd el-dohr ma'a salama.

arabic: رحت السوق انا و امي عشان نشتري خضار و فاكهة
english: I went to the market with my mother to buy vegetables and fruit.
transliteration: Roht es-soo' ana we ommy 'ashan neshtary khodaar we fakha.

arabic: السوق كان كبير و زحمة النهاردة
english: The market was big and crowded today.
transliteration: Es-soo' kaan kibeer we zahma ennaharda.

arabic: فجأة شفت صاحبي القديم احمد
english: Suddenly, I saw my old friend, Ahmed!
transliteration: Fag'a shoft sahby el-adeem Ahmad.

arabic: قلت له ازيك يا احمد بتشتري ايه بكام ده
english: I said to him, 'How are you, Ahmed? What are you buying? How much is this?'
transliteration: Olt loh 'ezayyak ya Ahmad? Beteshtary eh? Bekam dah?

arabic: رد و قال انا كويس بشتري فاكهة للبيت بنحب الفاكهة اوي
english: He replied and said, 'I'm good, I'm buying fruit for the house. We love fruit a lot!'
transliteration: Radd we aal 'ana kwayyes, beshtary fakha lel-bayt. Benhebb el-fakha awi!'

arabic: النهاردة قررت اطبخ اكلة جديدة اول مرة اجربها
english: Today I decided to cook a new dish, the first time I try it.
transliteration: Ennaharda qarart atbokh akla gedida awwel marra agarrabha.

arabic: قلت لنفسي افتح كتاب الطبيخ عشان ابدا بس المكونات كانت غريبة
english: I told myself "open the cookbook" to start, but the ingredients were strange.
transliteration: Olt le-nafsi iftah ketab el-tabkh ashan abda bas el-mokonat kanet ghariba.

arabic: بعد ساعة الطبخة كانت جاهزة بس شكلها كان مختلف شوية
english: After an hour, the dish was ready, but its appearance was a bit different.
transliteration: Ba'd sa'a el-tabkha kanet gahza bas shaklaha kan mokhtalef shwayya.

arabic: دوقة حتة صغيرة وقولت بصوت عالي يا خبر ابيض ده طعمها غريب اوي
english: I tasted a small piece and exclaimed loudly "Oh my God!" its taste is very strange.
transliteration: Do't hetta soghayyara w olt be-sot 'ali "Ya khabar abyad!" da ta'maha gharib awi.

arabic: قلت لنفسي تاني مرة هقعد اقرا الوصفة كويس قبل ما ابدا اي حاجة
english: I told myself, next time I will sit and read the recipe well before I start anything.
transliteration: Olt le-nafsi tani marra ha'od aqra el-wasfa kwayyes abl ma abda ay haga.

arabic: انا كلمت صاحبي على التليفون امبارح
english: I called my friend on the phone yesterday
transliteration: Ana kallamt saHbi 'ala at-telefoon imbaarih
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: هو كان مبسوط بس قال ليه مش رسالة
english: He was happy but said 'Why not a message?'
transliteration: Howwa kaan mabsoot bas 'aal 'leih mish risaala?'
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: انا بحب المكالمات اكتر وهو بيحب يبعت رسايل
english: I like calls more and he likes to send messages
transliteration: Ana bahebb el-mokalamaat aktar w howwa bihebb yib'at rasaayel
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: هو اصغر مني بكتير وده فرق كبير
english: He is much younger than me and this is a big difference
transliteration: Howwa asghar minni bikeer w da far' kibeer
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: احنا قعدنا نتكلم شوية عن اليوم
english: We talked a little about the day
transliteration: Ihna 'a'adna nitkallem showayya 'an el-yoom
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: كل يوم انا بصحى بدري
english: Every day, I wake up early.
transliteration: koll yoom ana baS7a badry

arabic: انا عايز اعمل قهوة بس مفيش مايه
english: I want to make coffee but there is no water.
transliteration: ana 3ayez a3mel ahwa bass mafeesh mayya

arabic: حنفية المطبخ بايظة
english: The kitchen tap is broken.
transliteration: 7anafeyyet el matbakh bayza

arabic: مفروض اكلم حد يجي يصلحها النهاردة
english: I am supposed to call someone to come fix it today.
transliteration: mafrouD akallem Hadd yeegee ySalha ennaharda

arabic: بعد كده هعرف اشرب القهوة بتاعتي
english: After that, I will be able to drink my coffee.
transliteration: ba3d keda ha3raf ashrab el ahwa beta3ty

arabic: اليوم طبخت طبق جديد اول مرة
english: Today I cooked a new dish for the first time.
transliteration: El naharda tabakht taba' gadeed awel marra.
storyTitle: A New Dish for the First Time

arabic: قطعت الخضار ببطء وريحتها كانت حلوة
english: I cut the vegetables slowly and their smell was nice.
transliteration: Qata't el khodaar bebot' w reehet'ha kanet helwa.
storyTitle: A New Dish for the First Time

arabic: حطيت الاكل في الطاسة وسمعت صوت الطشطشة
english: I put the food in the pan and heard the sizzling sound.
transliteration: Hatteit el akl fel taasa w sema't sot el tashtasha.
storyTitle: A New Dish for the First Time

arabic: بعد شوية الريحة بقت جميلة جدا في البيت
english: After a while, the smell became very beautiful in the house.
transliteration: Ba'd showaya el reeha ba'et gameela geddan fel beit.
storyTitle: A New Dish for the First Time

arabic: نفسي ادوق الطعم دلوقتي
english: I want to taste the flavor now.
transliteration: Nafsy adooq el ta'm delwa'ty.
storyTitle: A New Dish for the First Time

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد تيتا وفرحانين كلنا بيها
english: Today is Grandma's birthday, and we are all happy for her.
transliteration: Elnaharda 3eed meelaad teeta we far7aneen kollena beeha

arabic: العيلة كلها متجمعة والجو دافي في بيتنا بتاعنا
english: The whole family is gathered, and the atmosphere is warm in our house.
transliteration: El3eila kollaha metgamme3a wel gaw dafi fi beitna beta3na

arabic: ماما عملت كيكة كبيرة وشوية مخلل جنب الأكل
english: Mom made a big cake and some pickles next to the food.
transliteration: Mama 3amalet keeka kebeera we shwayyet mekhalil ganb el akl

arabic: انا قلت لتيتا الكيكة شكلها هتعجبك اوي يا تيتا
english: I told Grandma, "The cake looks like you will really like it, Grandma."
transliteration: Ana olt leteeta elkeeka shaklaha hat3agebek awi ya teeta

arabic: تيتا قالت يارب يبقى يوم عظيم لينا كلنا
english: Grandma said, "I hope it will be a great day for all of us."
transliteration: Teeta alet ya rab yeb2a yoom 3azeem leena kollena

arabic: ريحة البهارات ملت الخان. منى قالت للبياع: صباح الخير!
english: The spice smell filled the Khan. Mona said to the vendor: Good morning!
transliteration: Rihet el-baharat malet el-Khan. Mona qalet lel-bayya': Sabah el-kheir!

arabic: حضرتكوا تعرفوا ليلى؟ هي يبقى هنا يمكن؟
english: Do you all know Layla? Is she perhaps here?
transliteration: Hadretko ta'rafo Layla? Heya yeb'a hena yemken?

arabic: مساء الخير يا بنتي. بقترح تشوفوها هناك، وهو مشهور.
english: Good evening, my daughter. I suggest you look there, and it's famous.
transliteration: Masaa el-kheir ya benti. Baqtare7 teshofooha henak, w howa mashhour.

arabic: منى شافتها وقالت: سلام عليكوا! إيه جرى؟
english: Mona saw her and said: Peace be upon you all! What happened?
transliteration: Mona shafetha w qalet: Salam aleikou! Eih gara?

arabic: أهلاً يا منى! الكشري بتاعنا والمخلل هتعجبك بيها.
english: Welcome, Mona! Our koshary and pickles, you will like them with it.
transliteration: Ahlan ya Mona! El-koshary beta'na w el-mekhallil hat'agebek beeha.

arabic: صباح الخير يا جماعة انا وصلت الشغل النهارده يوم كبير
english: Good morning everyone, I arrived at work today, it's a big day.
transliteration: sabah el kheer ya gama'a ana wasalt el shoghl ennaharda yom kabiir

arabic: زميلتي قالت اهلا يا سارة تشربي شاي قلت ايوه شكرا
english: My colleague said "Hello Sara, would you like tea?" I said "Yes, thank you."
transliteration: zemiilty qalet ahlan ya Sara teshraby shay qolt aywa shukran

arabic: في الفسحة كلنا اكلنا اكل مصري لذيذ مع بعض
english: During the break, we all ate delicious Egyptian food together.
transliteration: fi el fosha kollona akalna akl masry laziz ma' ba'd

arabic: واحد صاحبي طلب مايه مني اديته مايه ساقعة
english: A friend asked for water from me, I gave him cold water.
transliteration: wahed sahby talab mayya menni addeto mayya saq'a

arabic: بعد الشغل روحت البيت مبسوط من يوم الشغل
english: After work, I went home happy from the workday.
transliteration: ba'd el shoghl rawwaht el bayt mabsoot men yom el shoghl

arabic: الجد الكبير والولد الصغير بيتفرجوا على ماتش كورة في التليفزيون
english: The big grandfather and the small boy are watching a football match on television.
transliteration: El-gadd el-kabeer wel-walad el-soghayyar beytfarragoa ala matsh koora fel-televezyoon.

arabic: الولد الصغير بيحب اللعيبة الجداد اللي بتلعب بسرعة
english: The small boy likes the new players who play fast.
transliteration: El-walad el-soghayyar beyhebb el-la'eeba el-godaad elli betla'ab be-sor'a.

arabic: الجد الكبير بيفتكر اللعيبة القديمة اللي كانت بتلعب زمان
english: The big grandfather remembers the old players who used to play a long time ago.
transliteration: El-gadd el-kabeer beyeftaker el-la'eeba el-adeema elli kanet betla'ab zaman.

arabic: الولد الصغير بيقول الكورة دلوقتي احلى بكتير
english: The small boy says "Football now is much better."
transliteration: El-walad el-soghayyar bey'ool "El-koora delwa'ty ahla be-kteer."

arabic: الجد الكبير بيقول بس وقت زمان كان له طعم تاني
english: The big grandfather says "But the old time had a different taste."
transliteration: El-gadd el-kabeer bey'ool "Bass wa't zaman kan loh ta'm taany."

arabic: رحت محل هدوم جديد
english: I went to a new clothes shop.
transliteration: Roht mahall hodoum gedid.

arabic: كنت مبسوطة اوي اشوف هدوم حلوة
english: I was very happy to see nice clothes.
transliteration: Kont mabsoota awi ashouf hodoum helwa.

arabic: جربت فستان ازرق وكان مقاسي
english: I tried a blue dress and it was my size.
transliteration: Garrabt fostan azraq we kan ma'asi.

arabic: الفستان كان شكله جميل عليا
english: The dress looked beautiful on me.
transliteration: El-fostan kan shaklo gameel 'alayya.

arabic: اشتريت الفستان وانا فرحانة كتير
english: I bought the dress and I was very happy.
transliteration: Ishtareet el-fostan wana farhana kteer.

arabic: ليلي راحت السوق مع جدتها عشان يشتروا خضار
english: Laila went to the market with her grandmother to buy vegetables
transliteration: Laila rahet el-souq ma' geddet-ha 'ashan yishtiru khodar

arabic: الجدة فضلت تسأل عن الاسعار وتتكلم مع البياعين كتير وتقول اهلا بيكي لكل ست بتقابلها
english: The grandmother kept asking about prices and talking a lot with the sellers, saying "Ahlan beeki" to every woman she met
transliteration: El-gedda faddalet tes'al 'an el-as'ar we tetkallem ma' el-bayya'een kiteer we te'ul "Ahlan beeki" le koll sett bet'abelha

arabic: ليلي كانت مستعجلة وعايزة تخلص بسرعة وتشوف الليستة على موبايلها
english: Laila was in a hurry and wanted to finish quickly, checking the list on her phone
transliteration: Laila kanet mosta'gala we 'ayza tekhallas besor'a we tishuf el-lista 'ala mobaylha

arabic: لما خلصوا الجدة قالت للبياع مع السلامة وهو رد الله يسلمك
english: When they finished, the grandmother said to the seller "Ma'a salama" and he replied "Allah yisallimak"
transliteration: Lamma khallasu el-gedda 'alet lel-bayya' "Ma'a salama" we howwa radd "Allah yisallimak"

arabic: رغم اختلاف طريقتهم استمتعوا باليوم مع بعض ورجعوا البيت مبسوطين
english: Despite their different ways, they enjoyed the day together and returned home happy
transliteration: Raghm ekhtelaf taree'ethom estamta'u bel-yom ma' ba'd we reg'u el-beit mabsooteen

arabic: انا كنت ماشي في الشارع بس انا تايه دلوقتي
english: I was walking in the street but I am lost now.
transliteration: Ana kont mashi fi el share' bas ana tayeh delwa'ty.

arabic: انا كنت خايف شوية وقلت لازم اسال حد
english: I was a little scared and I said I must ask someone.
transliteration: Ana kont khayef shwayya w olt lazim as'al had.

arabic: شفت راجل كبير وقلت له لو سمحت ممكن تساعدني انا عايز اروح المحطة فين هي
english: I saw an old man and told him "Excuse me, can you help me? I want to go to the station, where is it?"
transliteration: Shoft ragel kebir w olt lo law samaht momken tesaa'edni ana ayiz arooh el mahatta feen heyya.

arabic: الراجل قالي امشي طوالي وبعدين يمين هي قريبة
english: The man told me to walk straight and then right, it's near.
transliteration: El ragel 'aly emshi tawali w ba'dein yemeen heyya orayyeba.

arabic: انا كنت مبسوط جدا وقلت له شكرا جزيلا
english: I was very happy and told him thank you very much.
transliteration: Ana kont mabsoot geddan w olt lo shokran gazilan.

arabic: انا مش عارف انا فين دلوقتي
english: I don't know where I am now.
transliteration: Ana mish 'aref ana feen delwa'ti.

arabic: معلش يا استاذ فين محطة المترو من فضلك
english: Excuse me, sir, where is the metro station, please?
transliteration: Ma'alesh ya ostaz, feen mahattat el metro men fadlak?

arabic: الراجل قال محطة المترو دي مش بعيدة
english: The man said, 'The metro station? It's not far.'
transliteration: El ragel 'al, 'Mahattat el metro? Di mish ba'eeda.'

arabic: امشي طوالي بعدين يمين في الشارع ده
english: Walk straight, then right on this street.
transliteration: Emshi tawali, ba'dein yemeen fi esh shari' da.

arabic: شكرا جدا يا استاذ مع السلامة
english: Thank you very much, sir, goodbye.
transliteration: Shokran giddan ya ostaz, ma'a salama.

arabic: كان يوم ممطر وانا قاعد في البيت
english: It was a rainy day and I was sitting at home
transliteration: Kaana yom momter w ana qa'ed fel bayt

arabic: صوت المطر كان قوي والجو كان بارد شوية
english: The sound of the rain was strong and the weather was a bit cold
transliteration: Soot el matar kaan qawi wel gaw kaan bared shwayya

arabic: امي كانت بتعمل شاي سخن وكنت باكل فاكهة
english: My mother was making hot tea and I was eating fruit
transliteration: Ommy kanet beta'mel shay sokhn we kont bakol fakha

arabic: بنحب نقعد في البيت لما يكون الجو كده
english: We love to stay at home when the weather is like this
transliteration: Benhebb no'od fel bayt lamma yelkon el gaw keda

arabic: بعدين ممكن ننزل السوق نشتري خضار
english: Later, we might go down to the market to buy vegetables
transliteration: Ba'deen momken nenzel el soo' neshtary khodaar

arabic: الدنيا بتمطر بره كتير النهاردة بعد الضهر
english: It's raining a lot outside today in the afternoon.
transliteration: El donya betmatar barra keteer ennahaarda ba'd el dohr

arabic: ماما قالت لاخويا الصغير يا خالد اقعد هنا جنبي
english: Mom told my little brother, 'Khaled, sit here next to me.'
transliteration: Mama 'alet li akhouya el soghayar ya Khaled o'od hena ganby

arabic: وبعدين قالتله اشرب الشاي السخن ده عشان تدفى
english: And then she told him, 'Drink this hot tea to warm up.'
transliteration: W ba'dein 'aletlo ishrab el shay el sokhn da 'ashan tedfa

arabic: انا كويسة الحمد لله يا ماما وانتِ؟
english: I'm fine, thank God, Mom, and you?
transliteration: Ana kwayyesa el hamdu lillah ya mama w enti?

arabic: كلنا قضينا وقت جميل مع بعض في يوم المطر ده
english: We all spent a beautiful time together on this rainy day.
transliteration: Kollena 'addena wa't gameel ma' ba'd fi yom el matar da

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد مريم
english: Today is Mariam's birthday.
transliteration: Ennaharda eid milad Maryam

arabic: هي بتصحى بدري ومبسوطة اوي
english: She wakes up early and is very happy.
transliteration: Heya betesha badri we mabsoota awi

arabic: مامتها بتعمل فطار حلو عشانها
english: Her mom makes a nice breakfast for her.
transliteration: Mametha betamel fetar helw ashaneha

arabic: صحابها بيجوا بالليل البيت عشان يحتفلوا
english: Her friends come to the house at night to celebrate.
transliteration: Sohabha beyegu bel leil el beit ashan yahtafelo

arabic: كلهم بياكلوا تورته وبيشربوا عصير
english: They all eat cake and drink juice.
transliteration: Kolhom biyaklo torta we biyeshrabo aseer

arabic: كل يوم انا باجي الكافيه ده
english: Every day I come to this cafe.
transliteration: Kol yom ana bagy el kafeeh dah.

arabic: انا باقعد على كرسي جمب الترابيزة
english: I sit on a chair next to the table.
transliteration: Ana ba'od 'ala kursi gamb el tarabeeza.

arabic: انا باستنى صاحبي سامي
english: I wait for my friend Sami.
transliteration: Ana bastanna sahbi Sami.

arabic: هو بيحب يشرب قهوة سادة
english: He likes to drink plain coffee.
transliteration: Howwa bihebb yeshrab ahwa sada.

arabic: انا باطلب شاي بلبن ليا
english: I order tea with milk for myself.
transliteration: Ana batlob shay belaban leya.

arabic: روحت السوق النهاردة
english: I went to the market today.
transliteration: rooht el sooq el naharda

arabic: السوق كان كبير وزحمة
english: The market was big and crowded.
transliteration: el sooq kan kabeer we zahma

arabic: شفت خضار وفاكهة كتير
english: I saw many vegetables and fruits.
transliteration: shoft khodaar we fakiha kiteer

arabic: اشتريت طماطم وبرتقال
english: I bought tomatoes and oranges.
transliteration: eshtarayt tamatem we bortoqal

arabic: وبعدين روحت البيت
english: Then I went home.
transliteration: we ba'deen rooht el beet

arabic: انا رحت السوق النهاردة
english: I went to the market today.
transliteration: Ana roht es-souq en-naharda.

arabic: شفت خضار الوان كتير
english: I saw many colorful vegetables.
transliteration: Shoft khodaar alwaan keteer.

arabic: راجل ظريف كان بيبيع طماطم بصوت عالي
english: A funny man was selling tomatoes loudly.
transliteration: Ragel zareef kan beybee' tamatem be-sout 'aly.

arabic: اشتريت تفاح بس كان كبير اوي
english: I bought apples, but they were very big.
transliteration: Eshtarait tuffah bas kan kibeer awi.

arabic: الشنطة كانت تقيلة اوي كنت هقع
english: The bag was so heavy, I almost fell.
transliteration: Esh-shanta kanet ta'eela awi kont ha'a'.

arabic: ليلى طفلة صغيرة بتحب تسأل كتير اوي كل يوم
english: Layla is a small child who loves to ask many questions every day.
transliteration: Layla tefla soghayyara bethebb tes'al keteer awi kol yom

arabic: باباها كان بيقول اهلا يا ليلى وهي بتسأل ليه السما زرقا يا بابا
english: Her dad would say 'hello Layla' and she would ask 'why is the sky blue, dad?'
transliteration: Babaha kan biy'oul ahlan ya Layla we heya betsa'al leeh el sama zar'a ya baba

arabic: الاب كان بيحاول يجاوب بس ليلى كانت بتسأل سؤال تاني على طول
english: The father tried to answer, but Layla would ask another question right away.
transliteration: El ab kan bihayawel yegaweb bas Layla kanet betsa'al so'al tani ala tool

arabic: قالت ليه البيت ده كبير اوي واحنا بيتنا صغير يا بابا
english: She said 'why is this house so big and our house is small, dad?'
transliteration: Qalet leeh el beit da kabiir awi we ehna beitna soghayyar ya baba

arabic: الاب بص ليها بابتسامة وقال ايوه عندك حق يا بنتي اسألي زي ما انتي عايزه
english: The father looked at her with a smile and said 'yes, you are right my daughter, ask as much as you want.'
transliteration: El ab bass leeha bebtesama we 'al aywa andek haqq ya benty es'aly zay ma enty ayza

arabic: انا رحت القهوة الصبح
english: I went to the cafe in the morning
transliteration: Ana roht el-ahwa el-sobh

arabic: سلمت على الجرسون وقلت صباح الخير
english: I greeted the waiter and said good morning
transliteration: Sallamt ala el-garsoon we olt sabah el-kheer

arabic: هو رد وقال صباح النور
english: He replied and said morning of light
transliteration: Howa radd we al sabah an-noor

arabic: انا قاعد مستني القهوة بتاعتي
english: I am sitting waiting for my coffee
transliteration: Ana aa'ed mestanni el-ahwa beta'ti

arabic: القهوة دي زي بيتي بالظبط
english: This cafe is exactly like my house
transliteration: El-ahwa di zay beiti bel-zabt

arabic: صباح الخير يا سارة ازيك انا كويسة الحمد لله انا قاعدة في قهوة البلد
english: Good morning Sarah, how are you? I'm good, alhamdulillah. I'm sitting at El Balad cafe.
transliteration: Sabah el-kheer ya Sara izzayyik ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah ana qa'eda fi ahwet el-balad

arabic: القهوة زحمة النهاردة والناس بتشرب شاي وقهوة كتير
english: The café is crowded today and people are drinking a lot of tea and coffee.
transliteration: El-ahwa zahma en-naharda wen-nas bitishrab shay w-ahwa keteir

arabic: لما لقيت ترابيزة فاضية قعدت استنى الجرسون يجي ياخد الطلب
english: When I found an empty table, I sat waiting for the waiter to come take the order.
transliteration: Lamma la'eet tarabeeza fadya qa'adt astanna el-garson yigi yakhod et-talab

arabic: بعد شوية جه الجرسون وقالي اهلا وسهلا عاوزة ايه يا مدام
english: After a while, the waiter came and said 'Welcome, what would you like, madam?'
transliteration: Ba'd showayya geh el-garson wa qali ahlan wa sahlan 'awza eih ya madam

arabic: طلبت قهوة مضبوطة وفضلت اتفرج على الشارع والناس اللي رايحة وجاية
english: I ordered a medium coffee and kept watching the street and the people coming and going.
transliteration: Talabt ahwa mazboota w fadalt atfarrag 'ala esh-shari' wen-nas elly rayha w gayya

arabic: كان يوم جمعة والجو كان حلو اوي والماتش هيبدأ
english: It was a Friday and the weather was very nice and the match was about to start.
transliteration: Kan yom gom'a wal gaw kan helw awy wal match hayebda'

arabic: الناس كانت مالية الاستاد والكل بيقول اهلا وسهلا
english: The stadium was full of people and everyone was saying 'welcome'.
transliteration: El nas kanat malya el estad wal kol bi'ool ahlan wa sahlan

arabic: وفجأة لاعب من الفريق الازرق جاب جون عالمي والتشجيع زاد
english: Suddenly, a player from the blue team scored an amazing goal and the cheering increased.
transliteration: Wi faga'a la'eb min el fareeq el azraq gab goon 'alamy wal tashgee' zad

arabic: بس الغريب ان اللاعب ده كان لابس بيجامة مش طقم كورة
english: But the strange thing was that this player was wearing pajamas, not a football kit.
transliteration: Bas el ghareeb en el la'eb da kan labes beigeama mesh ta'm koora

arabic: وبعدين صحيت واكتشفت ان الماتش ده كله كان حلم وانا نايم على الكنبة
english: Then I woke up and discovered that this whole match was a dream and I was sleeping on the couch.
transliteration: Wi ba'dein saheet waktashaft en el match da kollo kan helm wana nayem 'ala el kanaba

arabic: صباح الخير يا احمد اليوم عيد ميلادك
english: Good morning Ahmed, today is your birthday
transliteration: Sabah el-kheer ya Ahmed el-yoom eid miladak

arabic: ماما عملت تورتة كبيرة بس القطة اكلت حتة منها
english: Mama made a big cake, but the cat ate a piece of it
transliteration: Mama amalet torta kebeera bas el-otta akalet hatta menha

arabic: بابا قال يا جماعة السلام عليكم وجاب هدية عجيبة
english: Baba said "Hello everyone" and brought a strange gift
transliteration: Baba qal ya gama'a As-salamu alaykum w gab hedeya ageeba

arabic: كلنا ضحكنا كتير والتورتة كانت لسه حلوة
english: We all laughed a lot, and the cake was still delicious
transliteration: Kollena dahekna keteer wel-torta kanet lessa helwa

arabic: بعدين قلنا صباح النور واليوم كان جميل
english: Then we said "Morning of light" and the day was beautiful
transliteration: Ba'deen olna Sabah an-noor wel-yoom kan gameel

arabic: صحيت بدري قلت صباح الخير
english: I woke up early. I said good morning.
transliteration: Saheet badri. Oult sabah el-kheer.

arabic: لبست بسرعة عشان الشغل
english: I got dressed quickly for work.
transliteration: Libist besor'a ashan el-shoghl.

arabic: فطرت بسرعة كبيرة
english: I ate breakfast very quickly.
transliteration: Fetart besor'a kebeera.

arabic: نزلت من البيت مستعجل
english: I left the house in a hurry.
transliteration: Nazalt men el-beit mesta'gel.

arabic: بعدين افتكرت انه يوم الجمعة مش يوم شغل
english: Then I remembered it was Friday, not a workday.
transliteration: Ba'dein eftakart enno youm el-goma'a mesh youm shoghl.

arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع في يوم جميل وفجأة شفت صاحبي القديم احمد
english: I was walking in the street on a beautiful day, and suddenly I saw my old friend Ahmed.
transliteration: Kunt maashi fi esh-shaare' fi yom gamil wafag'a shoft sahby el-adeem Ahmed.

arabic: قولتله اهلا يا احمد مش معقول انت هنا
english: I told him, "Hello Ahmed, unbelievable, you're here!"
transliteration: Oultelo ahlan ya Ahmed mesh ma'oul enta hena.

arabic: رد ايوه انا ازيك عامل ايه دلوقتي
english: He replied, "Yes, it's me. How are you doing now?"
transliteration: Radd aywa ana ezayyak 'amel eh delwa'ty.

arabic: انا كويس الحمد لله بيتي قريب من هنا تحب تشرب مايه
english: "I'm good, thank God. My house is close by. Would you like to drink some water?"
transliteration: Ana kowayyes el-hamdu lellah. Beyti 'arayyeb men hena. Tehebb teshrob mayya?

arabic: قالي لا شكرا انا لازم امشي دلوقتي واشوفك يوم تاني
english: He told me, "No, thank you, I have to go now, and I'll see you another day."
transliteration: Aly la shukran ana lazim amshi delwa'ty w ashoufak yom tany.

arabic: صباح الخير يا احمد ازيك
english: Good morning Ahmed, how are you?
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya Ahmed, ezzayak?

arabic: الحمد لله يا علي انا كويس انت رايح فين
english: Praise be to God Ali, I'm good. Where are you going?
transliteration: El hamdulillah ya Ali, ana kwayyes. Enta rayeh fein?

arabic: انا رايح الشغل كل يوم في نفس المعاد
english: I'm going to work every day at the same time.
transliteration: Ana rayeh el shoghl kolle yoom fi nafs el me'aad.

arabic: ايه ده الساعة كام دلوقتي
english: Oh, what time is it now?
transliteration: Eih da? El sa'a kam delwa'ty?

arabic: الساعة سبعة انا لازم امشي دلوقتي مع السلامة
english: It's seven o'clock. I have to go now, goodbye.
transliteration: El sa'a saba'a. Ana lazem amshi delwa'ty, ma'a el salama.

arabic: النهاردة الجو مطر
english: Today the weather is rainy
transliteration: Ennaharda el gaww matar

arabic: انا في البيت
english: I am at home
transliteration: Ana fi el bayt

arabic: انا ببص على الشباك المطر كتير
english: I look at the window, the rain is a lot
transliteration: Ana baboss ala esh shibbak el matar keteer

arabic: انا بشرب شاي سخن
english: I drink hot tea
transliteration: Ana bashrab shay sokhn

arabic: فجأة قطة صغيرة عند الباب
english: Suddenly a small cat is at the door
transliteration: Fag'a otta saghira and el bab

arabic: مساء الخير النهاردة كانت ماتش كورة حلو
english: Good evening Today was a nice football match
transliteration: Masa' el-kheer el naharda kanet match kora helw
storyTitle: A Football Match at the Club

arabic: كنا بنروح النادي نشوف الماتش
english: We used to go to the club to watch the match
transliteration: Konna benrooh el nadi neshof el match
storyTitle: A Football Match at the Club

arabic: الجمهور كان بيصوت بصوت عالي
english: The crowd was cheering loudly
transliteration: El gomhour kan beyasawet be soot aali
storyTitle: A Football Match at the Club

arabic: اللعيبة كانت بتجري بسرعة كبيرة
english: The players were running very fast
transliteration: El la'eeba kanet betegri be sor'a kebeera
storyTitle: A Football Match at the Club

arabic: الماتش كان ممتع جداً بالنسبة لي
english: The match was very enjoyable for me
transliteration: El match kan momte' geddan bel nesba li
storyTitle: A Football Match at the Club

arabic: انا قاعد في الكافيه مستني امي
english: I am sitting at the cafe waiting for my mother.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed fel cafe mestanni ommy.

arabic: ريحة القهوة الفريش قوية وجميلة
english: The smell of fresh coffee is strong and beautiful.
transliteration: Rihet el ahwa el fresh qawiya we gameela.

arabic: شايف شجرة كبيرة برا وناس كتير بتتكلم
english: I see a big tree outside and many people talking.
transliteration: Shayef shagara kebeera barra we nas kiteer betetkallem.

arabic: احنا بنحب نقعد هنا ونشرب عصير فاكهة
english: We love to sit here and drink fruit juice.
transliteration: Ehna benhebb no'od hena we neshrab 'aseer fakha.

arabic: امي جاية قريب وهنروح البيت
english: My mother is coming soon and we will go home.
transliteration: Ommy gaya qareeb we hanrooh el bayt.

arabic: نهى كانت بتخطط لفرحها الكبير وكانت زهقانة اوي
english: Noha was planning her big wedding and was very stressed.
transliteration: Noha kanet bitkhattat lifaraha el kebir w kanet zah'ana awi.

arabic: مامتها قالتلها اكتبي كل حاجة عايزنها في ورقة
english: Her mom told her: "Write everything we need on a paper!"
transliteration: Mamatha 'aletlaha oktobi kol haga 'ayzenha fi wara'a.

arabic: باباها قال اشرب شاي يا نهى عشان تهدي شوية
english: Her dad said: "Drink tea, Noha, to calm down a bit."
transliteration: Babaha 'al ishrab shay ya Noha 'ashan tehdi shwaya.

arabic: هي ردت انا كويسة الحمد لله بس الفرح ده محتاج جيش
english: She replied: "I'm fine, thank God, but this wedding needs an army!"
transliteration: Heyya raddet ana kwayyesa el-hamdu lillah bas el-farah da mohtag geish!

arabic: بالليل جوزها قالها تصبحي على خير يا حبيبتي بكره يوم جديد
english: At night her husband told her: "Good night, my dear, tomorrow is a new day."
transliteration: Bil-leil gozha 'alelha tisbahi ala kheir ya habibty bokra yom gedid.

arabic: صحيت بدري عشان افطر فول وطعمية زي كل يوم
english: I woke up early to have ful and ta'ameya for breakfast like every day.
transliteration: Sa7eet badry 3ashan aftar fool we ta3meya zayy koll yoom

arabic: ماما كانت بتحضر الشاي والقهوة عشان يبقى الفطار بتاعنا جاهز
english: Mom was preparing tea and coffee so our breakfast would be ready.
transliteration: Mama kanet bet7addar elshay wel2ahwa 3ashan yeb2a elfetar beta3na gahez

arabic: قالتلي خليهم ياكلوا المخلل اللي عملته هتعجبك طعمه
english: She told me, 'Let them eat the pickles I made, you will like its taste.'
transliteration: 2aletly khaleehom yaklo elmekhalil elli 3amalto hat3agebek ta3mo

arabic: بابا قال بسرعة عشان مفيش وقت والشغل مستنينا
english: Dad said quickly because there's no time and work is waiting for us.
transliteration: Baba 2al besor3a 3ashan mafeesh wa2t welshoghl mestanneena

arabic: بعد الفطار اللذيذ ده كل واحد راح شغله وكان يوم عظيم
english: After this delicious breakfast, everyone went to their work, and it was a great day.
transliteration: Ba3d elfetar ellazeez dah koll wa7ed ra7 shoghlo we kan yoom 3azeem

arabic: ولد صغير بيسأل جده
english: A small boy asks his grandfather.
transliteration: walad soghayyar biyisa'al gadduh

arabic: هو بيسأل ايه ده يا جدو
english: He asks, "What is this, grandpa?"
transliteration: howa biyisa'al eh da ya geddo

arabic: الجد قال زمان كان كل حاجة مختلفة
english: The grandfather said, "In the past, everything was different."
transliteration: el gadd aal zaman kan koll haga mokhtalefa

arabic: دلوقتي كل حاجة جديدة ومختلفة عن زمان
english: Now everything is new and different from the past.
transliteration: delwa'ti koll haga gedida w mokhtalefa an zaman

arabic: الولد لسه بيسأل ليه يا جدو ليه
english: The boy is still asking, "Why, grandpa, why?"
transliteration: el walad lessa biyisa'al leh ya geddo leh

arabic: صباح الخير يا احمد ازيك انا كويسة الحمد لله
english: Good morning Ahmed, how are you? I'm good, praise be to God.
transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer ya Aḥmed, izzayyak? Ana kwayyesa, alhamdulillah.

arabic: أهلاً بيكي يا سارة عاملة ايه النهاردة محتاجين نتكلم عن الفرح
english: Welcome Sarah, how are you today? We need to talk about the wedding.
transliteration: Ahlan beeki ya Sara, amla eh el-naharda? Mehtaageen netkallem an el-farah.

arabic: ايوه انا قلقانة شوية على قاعة الفرح مش لاقية حاجة مناسبة
english: Yes, I'm a bit worried about the wedding hall; I can't find anything suitable.
transliteration: Aywa ana al'ana shwaya ala qa'et el-farah mesh la'ya haga monaseba.

arabic: متقلقيش انا شفت قاعة حلوة اوي امبارح ممكن نشوفها سوا بكرة
english: Don't worry, I saw a really nice hall yesterday. We can see it together tomorrow.
transliteration: Mat'al'eesh ana shoft qa'a helwa awi embareh. Mumkin neshofha sawa bokra.

arabic: تمام فكرة كويسة اوي الله يسلمك ومع السلامة
english: Okay, that's a very good idea. May God keep you safe, and goodbye.
transliteration: Tamam, fekra kwayyesa awi. Allah yisallimak, w ma'a salama.

arabic: مساء الخير وصلت الكافيه
english: Good evening I arrived at the cafe
transliteration: Masa' el-kheer wasalt el-cafe

arabic: كنت مستني صاحبي
english: I was waiting for my friend
transliteration: Kunt mestanni saḥbi

arabic: طلبت شاي
english: I ordered tea
transliteration: Ṭalabt shāy

arabic: صاحبي وصل يا دوب بعد خمس دقايق
english: My friend arrived after barely five minutes
transliteration: Saḥbi waṣal ya doob ba'd khamas da'aye'

arabic: اتكلمنا عن يومنا
english: We talked about our day
transliteration: Itkallimna 'an yūmna

arabic: انا بصحى بدري كل يوم الصبح
english: I wake up early every morning.
transliteration: Ana bas'ha badri kol yom el sobh.

arabic: بروح المدرسة وبسلم على اصحابي
english: I go to school and greet my friends.
transliteration: Barouh el madrasa wa basallem ala as-habi.

arabic: المدرس بيقول يلا بينا نذاكر عربي
english: The teacher says, 'Let's study Arabic'.
transliteration: El modarres bi'oul yalla bina nezaker arabi.

arabic: في الفسحة باكل ساندويتش طعمية
english: During the break, I eat a falafel sandwich.
transliteration: Fil foshha bakol sandwich ta'ameya.

arabic: بعد المدرسة برجع البيت وبقول الحمد لله
english: After school, I go home and say 'Praise be to God'.
transliteration: Ba'd el madrasa barg'a el beit wa ba'oul el hamdulillah.

arabic: صحيت الصبح و افتكرت ان العيش كان وحش امبارح
english: I woke up in the morning and remembered that the bread was bad yesterday.
transliteration: Saheet es-sobḥ w aftakart enn el-eish kan waḥash embarah

arabic: قررت ارجع المحل تاني
english: I decided to return to the shop again.
transliteration: Qarrart arga' el-maḥall tani

arabic: وصلت المحل و قولت السلام عليكم
english: I arrived at the shop and said As-salamu alaykum.
transliteration: Waṣalt el-maḥall w olt As-salamu alaykum

arabic: وريته العيش و ريحته كانت مش حلوة
english: I showed him the bread and its smell was not good.
transliteration: Warreito el-eish w reḥto kanet mesh ḥelwa

arabic: اداني عيش جديد و رجعت البيت مبسوط
english: He gave me new bread and I returned home happy.
transliteration: Eddani eish gideed w rega't el-bayt mabṣoot

arabic: انا رحت بيت خالتي
english: I went to my aunt's house.
transliteration: Ana roht bayt khalti.

arabic: رحت بالعربية في الشارع
english: I went by car on the street.
transliteration: Roht bel-arabiya fel shari'.

arabic: بيت خالتي كبير و جميل
english: My aunt's house is big and beautiful.
transliteration: Bayt khalti kebir w gamil.

arabic: قعدت على الكنبة وشفت تلفزيون
english: I sat on the sofa and watched television.
transliteration: A'adt 'ala el kanaba w shoft televizyon.

arabic: اكلت اكل حلو و روحت البيت
english: I ate good food and went home.
transliteration: Akalt akl helw w rowaht el bayt.

arabic: صباح الخير يا منى ازيك عاملة ايه
english: Good morning Mona, how are you?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheer ya Mona, izzayyik amla eh?

arabic: صباح النور يا سارة انا كويسة الحمد لله انتي ازيك
english: Good morning Sarah, I'm good, praise be to God. How are you?
transliteration: Sabah el-noor ya Sara, ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah, inti izzayyik?

arabic: انا كويسة الحمد لله عندنا حصة عربي دلوقتي
english: I'm good, praise be to God. We have an Arabic class now.
transliteration: Ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah, andena hessa Arabi delwa'ti.

arabic: بعد الحصة قابلوا المدرسة وقالت اهلا وسهلا يا بنات
english: After class, they met the teacher, and she said "Welcome, girls."
transliteration: Ba'd el-hessa abelo el-modarresa w alet ahlan wa sahlan ya banat.

arabic: وفي اخر اليوم قالت منى لسارة مع السلامة الله يسلمك
english: And at the end of the day, Mona said to Sarah: Goodbye, may God keep you safe.
transliteration: W fi akher el-youm alet Mona le Sara: Ma'a salama, Allah yisallimik.

arabic: صباح الخير يا ام احمد ازيك عاملة ايه
english: Good morning, Om Ahmed. How are you?
transliteration: Sabah el kheir ya Om Ahmed ezzayek amla eh

arabic: صباح النور يا جارتي انا بخير الحمد لله تشربي شاي
english: Good morning, my neighbor. I am fine, praise be to God. Would you like to drink tea?
transliteration: Sabah el noor ya garati ana bekhair el hamdulillah teshrebi shay

arabic: ربنا يخليكي الاولاد عاملين ايه النهاردة
english: May God bless you. How are the children today?
transliteration: Rabena yekhalleeki el awlad amleen eh el naharda

arabic: الحمد لله بخير كلهم في المدرسة دلوقتي
english: Praise be to God, they are fine. All of them are at school now.
transliteration: El hamdulillah bekhair kolluhom fel madrasa delwaqti

arabic: تمام لو عايزة اي حاجة انا موجودة جنبك
english: Okay, if you need anything, I am next to you.
transliteration: Tamam law ayza ay haga ana mawgouda ganbek

arabic: عمر طفل صغير بيحب يسال
english: Omar is a small child who loves to ask.
transliteration: Omar tefl soghayyar bihebb yes'al

arabic: كل يوم بيسال مامته اسئلة كتير
english: Every day he asks his mother many questions.
transliteration: Koll yom byes'al mamtoh as'ela keteer

arabic: مامته ساعات بتتعب شوية
english: His mother sometimes gets a little tired.
transliteration: Mamtoh sa'aat betet'ab shwayya

arabic: بس هي كمان مبسوطة بطفلها الشاطر
english: But she is also happy with her smart child.
transliteration: Bas heyya kaman mabsoota be-teflaha el shater

arabic: عمر دايما عايز يتعلم حاجات جديدة
english: Omar always wants to learn new things.
transliteration: Omar dayman ayiz yet'allam hagaat gedeeda

arabic: اهلا ازيك انا كويسة
english: Hello, how are you? I am good.
transliteration: Ahlan ezzayek ana kwayyesa

arabic: النهاردة هاطبخ اكلة جديدة
english: Today I will cook a new dish.
transliteration: Elnaharda hatbokh akla gedeeda

arabic: هاجهز الخضار الاول
english: I will prepare the vegetables first.
transliteration: Hagehhez elkhodar elawwal

arabic: الطبق ده شكله حلو اوي
english: This dish looks very nice.
transliteration: Eltabaq da shaklo helw awy

arabic: انا باكل العشا كل يوم في البيت
english: I eat dinner every day at home.
transliteration: Ana bakol el'asha kol yom fel beit

arabic: مساء الخير يا عيلة احمد اتجمعوا على الاكل
english: Good evening, Ahmed's family gathered for the meal.
transliteration: Masa' el-kheer ya 'eilet Ahmad etgam'u 'ala el-akl.

arabic: الام قالت السلام عليكم لما دخلت المطبخ
english: The mother said "As-salamu alaykum" when she entered the kitchen.
transliteration: El-omm 'alet As-salamu alaykum lamma dakhalet el-matbakh.

arabic: الاب رد وعليكم السلام يا حبيبتي
english: The father replied "Wa alaykum as-salam, my dear."
transliteration: El-ab radd Wa alaykum as-salam ya habibti.

arabic: كل واحد اكل مبسوط والجو كان دافي
english: Everyone ate happily, and the atmosphere was warm.
transliteration: Koll wahed akal mabsoot wel-gaww kan dafi.

arabic: هم بيحبوا اللمة دي كتير كل اسبوع
english: They love this gathering a lot every week.
transliteration: Homm biḥebbu el-lamma di keteer koll osboo'.

arabic: عيد ميلاد تيتا كان امبارح وكل العيلة اتجمعت
english: Grandma's birthday was yesterday and all the family gathered
transliteration: Eid milad teta kan embareh we kol el-eila etgammet

arabic: الجدود كانوا مبسوطين اوي وبيقولوا اُقعُدوا معانا شوية واتكلموا
english: The grandparents were very happy and said "Sit with us for a while and talk"
transliteration: El-gedood kano mabsooteen awi we bey'oulo o'odou ma'ana shwaya we etkallemou

arabic: الشباب كانوا بيحبوا يفتحوا الهدايا ويشربوا بيبسي كتير
english: The young people liked to open the gifts and drink a lot of Pepsi
transliteration: El-shabab kano bihebbou yiftahou el-hadaya we yishrabou Pepsi kteer

arabic: تيتا سألت حفيدها الكبير ازيك يا احمد انا كويسة الحمد لله وانت
english: Grandma asked her eldest grandson "How are you Ahmed? I'm fine thank God and you?"
transliteration: Teta sa'alet hafeedha el-keteer "Ezayyak ya Ahmed? Ana kwayyesa el-hamdu lillah w enta?"

arabic: في الآخر الجيل الجديد قال تصبحي على خير يا تيتا ومشيوا
english: In the end the new generation said "Good night Grandma" and left
transliteration: Fil-akher el-geel el-gedeeda 'al "Tisbahi ala kheir ya teta" we meshiw

arabic: كان فيه طفل صغير بيحب يسأل اسئلة كتير
english: There was a small child who loved to ask many questions.
transliteration: Kan fi tefl soghayyar beyhebb yes'al as'ela keteer.

arabic: هو كان بيسأل مامته ليه السما زرقا
english: He would ask his mother, "Why is the sky blue?"
transliteration: Howa kan beyse'al mamto leih el sama zar'a?

arabic: مامته كانت بترد عليه بس هو بيسأل اسئلة اكتر
english: His mother would answer him, but he would ask more questions.
transliteration: Mamto kanet betrodd aleih bass howa beyse'al as'ela aktar.

arabic: ساعات باباه كان بيحس انه تعبان اوي من الاسئلة
english: Sometimes, his father felt very tired from the questions.
transliteration: Sa'at babah kan beyhess enno ta'ban awy men el as'ela.

arabic: لكن هما الاتنين كانوا بيحبوا طفلهم واسئلته الكتير
english: But they both loved their child and his many questions.
transliteration: Laken homa el etnein kanu byhebbou teflahom w as'elto el keteer.

arabic: عندي ولد صغير بيسأل كتير
english: I have a small boy who asks a lot.
transliteration: Andy walad saghir biyes'al keteer
storyTitle: The Boy Who Asks a Lot

arabic: كل يوم بيسأل ايه ده وايه ده
english: Every day he asks what is this and what is this.
transliteration: Kol youm biyes'al eih da wa eih da
storyTitle: The Boy Who Asks a Lot

arabic: وبعدين يسأل ليه كل حاجة كده
english: And then he asks why everything is like this.
transliteration: W ba'dein yes'al leih kol haga keda
storyTitle: The Boy Who Asks a Lot

arabic: انا بتعب من اسئلة كتير
english: I get tired from many questions.
transliteration: Ana bat'ab min as'ela keteer
storyTitle: The Boy Who Asks a Lot

arabic: بس هو ولد ذكي جدا
english: But he is a very smart boy.
transliteration: Bas howa walad zaki geddan
storyTitle: The Boy Who Asks a Lot

arabic: منى وصلت كافيه زمالك الساعة سبعة إلا ربع، شافت حاجة غريبة في المنيو.
english: Mona arrived at Zamalek Café at a quarter to seven, she saw something strange on the menu.
transliteration: Mona wasalet kafeh Zamalek el-sa'a sab'a ella rob', shafet haga ghariba fel-menyu.
storyTitle: A Strange Drink at Zamalek Café

arabic: نادت على الجارسون وقالتله: "اِفتَح المنيو ده، إيه الكركديه فرابيتشينو ده؟"
english: She called the waiter and told him: "Open this menu, what is this Karkade Frappuccino?"
transliteration: Nadet 'ala el-garsoon we 'alotle: "Eftah el-menyu dah, eh el-karkadeh Frappuccino dah?"
storyTitle: A Strange Drink at Zamalek Café

arabic: الجارسون قعد جنبها وقال: "ده كركديه ساقع باللبن يا فندم، تحبي تِشرَبيه؟"
english: The waiter sat next to her and said: "This is cold karkade with milk, madam, would you like to drink it?"
transliteration: El-garsoon qa'ad gambaha we 'al: "Dah karkadeh saqe' bel-laban ya fandem, tehebbay tishrabieh?"
storyTitle: A Strange Drink at Zamalek Café

arabic: منى فكرت شوية وقالت: "أنا كويسة، الحمد لله، بس أهو، اِكتُبلي واحد!"
english: Mona thought a little and said: "I'm fine, thank God, but alright, write me one!"
transliteration: Mona fakkarat shwayya we 'alet: "Ana kwayyesa, el-hamdu lellah, bas aho, oktobli wahed!"
storyTitle: A Strange Drink at Zamalek Café

arabic: الجارسون ابتسم وراح يِكتِب الطلب، ومنى بصت حواليها وسألت: "الساعة كام دلوقتي؟"
english: The waiter smiled and went to write the order, and Mona looked around and asked: "What time is it now?"
transliteration: El-garsoon ebtasam we rah yekteb el-talab, we Mona basset hawalieha we sa'alet: "El-sa'a kam delwa'ti?"
storyTitle: A Strange Drink at Zamalek Café

arabic: انا بروح المقهى كل صباح
english: I go to the café every morning.
transliteration: Ana barooh el mahwa kol sabah

arabic: انا بنتظر صديقي هناك
english: I wait for my friend there.
transliteration: Ana bantazir sadeeqi henak

arabic: انا عايز فنجان قهوة
english: I want a cup of coffee.
transliteration: Ana ayiz fingaan ahwa

arabic: هو بيشرب شاي
english: He drinks tea.
transliteration: Howa bishrab shay

arabic: إحنا بنتكلم كتير
english: We talk a lot.
transliteration: Ehna benetkallem keteer

arabic: انا كنت رايح الشغل كل يوم النهاردة شفت صديق قديم
english: I was going to work every day. Today I saw an old friend.
transliteration: Ana kont rayih el-shoghl kull yoom. El-naharda shoft sadeeq adeem.

arabic: انا قلت له صباح الخير ازيك
english: I said to him "Good morning, how are you?"
transliteration: Ana oltelo Sabah el-kheir, izzayak?

arabic: هو قال انا كويس بس انا مشغول في الشغل
english: He said "I am fine, but I am busy with work."
transliteration: Howa 'al: Ana kwayyis bas ana mashghool fel-shoghl.

arabic: انا قلت وانا كمان رايح اشرب قهوة
english: I said "Me too, I am going to drink coffee."
transliteration: Ana olt: W ana kaman rayih ashrab ahwa.

arabic: احنا قلنا مع السلامة ورحنا شغلنا
english: We said goodbye and went to our work.
transliteration: Ehna olna ma'a salama w rohna shoghlena.

arabic: احمد رجع القميص للمحل عشان كان صغير
english: Ahmed returned the shirt to the shop because it was small.
transliteration: Ahmed ragga' el-amees lel-mahal a'ashan kan sagheer.

arabic: هو كان مكسوف شوية لكن البياع كان لطيف
english: He was a little embarrassed but the salesman was kind.
transliteration: Howa kan maksoof shwaya laken el-bayya' kan lateef.

arabic: البياع قال له عندي قهوة شاي وعصير تحب ايه
english: The salesman told him, "I have coffee, tea, and juice. What do you like?"
transliteration: El-bayya' al-lo a'andy ahwa shay wa a'seer teheb eh.

arabic: احمد رد تمام قهوة مظبوط من فضلك
english: Ahmed replied, "Okay, coffee with medium sugar please."
transliteration: Ahmed radd tamam ahwa mazboot men fadlak.

arabic: البياع ابتسم وقال خمسين جنيه هو سعر القهوة يا فندم
english: The salesman smiled and said, "Fifty pounds is the price of the coffee, sir."
transliteration: El-bayya' ebtasam w a'al khamsin geneh howa sa'r el-ahwa ya fandem.

arabic: عمر طفل بيحب يسال كتير
english: Omar is a child who loves to ask a lot of questions.
transliteration: Omar tifl biyhebb yis'al kitiir.

arabic: هو دايما بيسال جده ليه زمان كان كده
english: He always asks his grandpa: "Why was it like that in the past?"
transliteration: Howa dayman biyis'al geddoh leih zaman kan kidah?

arabic: جده بيقول زمان ما كانش فيه موبايل
english: His grandpa says: "In the past, there was no mobile phone."
transliteration: Geddoh biy'uul: Zaman ma kanish fiih mobayil.

arabic: عمر بيسال طب كنتو بتعرفو ازاي
english: Omar asks: "So how did you know things then?"
transliteration: Omar biyis'al: Tab kuntu bit'rafu izzay?

arabic: جده بيبتسم ويقول كنا بنسال الناس
english: His grandpa smiles and says: "We used to ask people."
transliteration: Geddoh biyibtisim wiy'uul: Kunna binis'al innas.

arabic: العيلة كلها قاعدة على السفرة عشان تاكل الغدا
english: The whole family is sitting at the dining table to eat lunch.
transliteration: El-eila kolaha qa'da 'ala el-sofra 'ashan takol el-ghada.

arabic: ماما قالت عندي قهوة شاي وعصير
english: Mom said I have coffee tea and juice.
transliteration: Mama qalet a'andy ahwa shay wa a'seer.

arabic: يا احمد تحب تشرب إيه
english: Oh Ahmed what would you like to drink?
transliteration: Ya Ahmed teheb tishrab eh?

arabic: احمد قال انا عايز عصير
english: Ahmed said I want juice.
transliteration: Ahmed qal ana a'ayez a'seer.

arabic: ماما قالت عندي عصير برتقال وعصير تفاح
english: Mom said I have orange juice and apple juice.
transliteration: Mama qalet a'andy a'seer borto'aal wa a'seer toffaah.

arabic: اهلا بيكي انا جاية اشوف هدوم جديدة
english: Welcome to you, I'm here to see new clothes.
transliteration: Ahlan beeki ana gayya ashoof hodoom gedeeda

arabic: عندك فساتين حلوة يا سارة
english: Do you have nice dresses, Sara?
transliteration: Andik fasateen helwa ya Sara

arabic: الفستان الازرق ده عجبني ممكن اقيسه
english: I liked this blue dress, can I try it on?
transliteration: El-fustan el-azraq da agabni mumkin aqeesso

arabic: المقاس مظبوط انا هاخد الفستان ده
english: The size is right, I will take this dress.
transliteration: El-ma'as mazboot ana hakhod el-fustan da

arabic: شكرا ليكي يا سارة مع السلامة
english: Thank you, Sara, goodbye.
transliteration: Shukran leeki ya Sara ma'a salama

arabic: ايه رايك نروح في رحلة يوم الجمعة
english: What do you think about going on a trip on Friday?
transliteration: Eih ra'yak nrouh fi re7la yom elgom'a?

arabic: فين ممكن نروح
english: Where can we go?
transliteration: Feen momken nrouh?

arabic: ممكن نروح البحر ونشوف اصحابنا
english: Maybe we can go to the sea and see our friends.
transliteration: Momken nrouh elba7r we nshouf as7abna.

arabic: تمام نجهز شنطة وهدوم
english: Okay, let's prepare a bag and clothes.
transliteration: Tamam ngehhez shanta we hedoum.

arabic: هيبقى يوم جميل جدا
english: It will be a very beautiful day.
transliteration: Hayeb'a yom gameel giddan.

arabic: امبارح انا روحت بيت خالتي
english: Yesterday I went to my maternal aunt's house.
transliteration: Imbareh ana rooht beit khalti.

arabic: هي كانت مبسوطة وشربنا شاي
english: She was happy and we drank tea.
transliteration: Heya kanet mabsoota we sherebna shay.

arabic: اكلنا اكل لذيذ كتير في المطبخ
english: We ate a lot of delicious food in the kitchen.
transliteration: Akalna akl laziz kiteer fel matbakh.

arabic: لكن فجأة قالت انا مش خالتي
english: But suddenly she said, 'I am not your aunt!'
transliteration: Laken faga'a aalet 'ana mesh khalti'.

arabic: احنا سالنا مين انتي وكانت بتضحك
english: We asked, 'Who are you?' and she was laughing.
transliteration: Ehna sa'alna 'meen enti?' we kanet betedhak.

arabic: النهاردة الصبح انا بصحى تعبان
english: This morning I wake up tired.
transliteration: El nahardah el sobh ana bas'ha ta'ban

arabic: انا بشرب قهوة بسرعة
english: I drink coffee fast.
transliteration: Ana bashrab ahwa be sor'a

arabic: بعدين بروح الشغل
english: Then I go to work.
transliteration: Ba'dein barooh el shoghl

arabic: انا مشغول النهاردة
english: I am busy today.
transliteration: Ana mashghool el nahardah

arabic: انا عايز امشي دلوقتي
english: I want to leave now.
transliteration: Ana ayz amshi delwa'ty

arabic: منى دخلت القهوة، وقالت: السلام عليكم، صباح الخير!
english: Mona entered the coffeehouse and said: Hello, good morning!
transliteration: Mona dakhalet el-ahwa, we qalet: As-salamu alaykum, sabah el-kheir!

arabic: عم حسن ابتسم وقال: أهلاً بيكي يا منى، إزيكِ؟
english: Uncle Hassan smiled and said: Welcome, Mona, how are you?
transliteration: Amm Hassan ebtasam we qal: Ahlan beeki ya Mona, ezayyik?

arabic: منى ردت بتوتر: أنا كويسة، الحمد لله، عايزة كركديه.
english: Mona replied nervously: I'm good, praise be to God, I want karkade.
transliteration: Mona raddet be tawattor: Ana kwayyesa, el-hamdu lellah, ayza karkadeh.

arabic: بعد تردد، قالت: طب، ينفع خصم بسيط عشان أنا طالبة؟
english: After hesitation, she said: Well, can I get a small discount because I am a student?
transliteration: Ba'd taraddod, qalet: Tab, yenfa' khasm baseet ashan ana talba?

arabic: عم حسن قال: ماشي يا بنتي! وقالت منى: شكراً، مع السلامة! فرد: الله يسلمك.
english: Uncle Hassan said: Okay, my daughter! And Mona said: Thank you, goodbye! So he replied: May God keep you safe.
transliteration: Amm Hassan qal: Mashi ya benty! We qalet Mona: Shokran, ma'a as-salama! Fa radd: Allah yesallimak.

arabic: النهاردة امي قالت يلا نعمل اكلة جديدة في البيت
english: Today my mother said let's make a new dish at home.
transliteration: El-naharda ommy 'alet yalla ne'mel akla gedida fel-bayt

arabic: نزلنا السوق الكبير عشان نشتري خضار طازة
english: We went down to the big market to buy fresh vegetables.
transliteration: Nezelna el-soo' el-kibeer 'ashan neshtary khodaar taze

arabic: سالت الراجل بكام الطماطم والفاكهة
english: I asked the man how much are the tomatoes and fruit.
transliteration: Sa'alt el-ragel bekam el-tamatem wel-fakha

arabic: رجعنا البيت وبدانا نجهز الاكل سوا
english: We returned home and started preparing the food together.
transliteration: Raga'na el-bayt we bada'na negahez el-akl sawa

arabic: احنا بنحب الاكل الجديد وكان طعمه حلو اوي
english: We love new food and its taste was very good.
transliteration: Ehna benhebb el-akl el-gedid we kan ta'mo helw awi

arabic: سارة قالت صباح الخير يا منى ازيك
english: Sara said Good morning Mona how are you?
transliteration: Sara qalet Sabah el kheer ya Mona ezzayek?

arabic: منى ردت صباح النور يا سارة انا كويسة الحمد لله
english: Mona replied Good morning Sara I'm good thank God.
transliteration: Mona raddet Sabah el noor ya Sara ana kwayyesa el Hamdulillah.

arabic: سارة قالت انا كل يوم اشرب قهوة قبل ما اروح الشغل
english: Sara said I drink coffee every day before I go to work.
transliteration: Sara qalet ana kol yom ashrab ahwa qabl ma arouh el shoghl.

arabic: منى قالت وانا لازم افتح الشباك عشان اشوف الشمس
english: Mona said And I must open the window to see the sun.
transliteration: Mona qalet wana lazim aftah el shobak 3ashan ashouf el shams.

arabic: سارة قالت يومك سعيد يا منى
english: Sara said Have a good day Mona.
transliteration: Sara qalet yomek sa3eed ya Mona.

arabic: النهاردة انا زرت بيت خالتي
english: Today I visited my aunt's house.
transliteration: El naharda ana zort beit khalti.
storyTitle: A visit to my aunt's house

arabic: ريحة اكل حلوة كانت مالية البيت
english: A sweet smell of food was filling the house.
transliteration: Reehet akl helwa kanet malya el beit.
storyTitle: A visit to my aunt's house

arabic: انا سمعت صوت ضحك عالي جدا
english: I heard a very loud sound of laughter.
transliteration: Ana sema't sot dahek 'aly giddan.
storyTitle: A visit to my aunt's house

arabic: خالتي عملت شاي سخن لينا كلنا
english: My aunt made hot tea for all of us.
transliteration: Khalti 'amelet shay sokhn leena kollena.
storyTitle: A visit to my aunt's house

arabic: انا كنت مبسوط جدا مع اهلي
english: I was very happy with my relatives.
transliteration: Ana kont mabsout giddan ma' ahly.
storyTitle: A visit to my aunt's house

arabic: احنا بنخطط لحفلة الفرح الكبيرة وقابلنا المنظم
english: We are planning the big wedding party and we met the organizer.
transliteration: Ehna benkhatat lehaflat elfarah elkebeera we 2abelna elmonazem.
storyTitle: The Wedding Party and the Pickles

arabic: قلنا له عايزين مكان مشهور للحفلة يا حضرتكوا
english: We told him, 'We want a famous place for the party, esteemed sirs/madams'.
transliteration: 2olna loh 3ayzeen makan mashhoor lelhafla ya 7adaratkoo.
storyTitle: The Wedding Party and the Pickles

arabic: المنظم اقترح قائمة اكل وقلنا نتمنى ان الاكل يبقى لذيذ وهتبقى ذكرى عظيمة لينا
english: The organizer suggested a food menu, and we said, 'We hope the food will be delicious, and it will be a great memory for us'.
transliteration: Elmonazem eqtara7 qa2emet akl we 2olna netmanna en elakl yeb2a lazeez we hatetba zekra 3azeema leena.
storyTitle: The Wedding Party and the Pickles

arabic: هو قال ما تقلقوش الاكل ده هتعجبكوا جدا وخليهم كل حاجة بسيطة
english: He said, 'Don't worry, you will really like this food, and let's keep everything simple'.
transliteration: Howa 2al ma te2la2oosh elakl dah hat3agebkoo geddan we khaleehom kol haga baseeta.
storyTitle: The Wedding Party and the Pickles

arabic: بس احنا اصررنا ان اهم حاجة يبقى في مخلل كتير مع كل طبق بتاعنا
english: But we insisted that the most important thing is to have a lot of pickles with every dish of ours.
transliteration: Bas ehna asrarna en aham haga yeb2a fe mekhalil keteer ma3 kol taba2 beta3na.
storyTitle: The Wedding Party and the Pickles

arabic: أنا قاعد في القهوة دلوقتي
english: I am sitting in the cafe now.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed fi el-ahwa dilwa'ti

arabic: أنا مستني صاحبي
english: I am waiting for my friend.
transliteration: Ana mestanni sahbi

arabic: هو متأخر كتير
english: He is very late.
transliteration: Howwa meta'akher keteer

arabic: أنا زعلان شوية
english: I am a little upset.
transliteration: Ana za'lan shwaya

arabic: بس أنا عايز قهوة
english: But I want coffee.
transliteration: Bas ana ayiz ahwa

arabic: طفل صغير بيسال اسئلة كتير اوي
english: A small child asks many many questions.
transliteration: Tifl soghayar biyes'al as'ela kteer awi

arabic: ماما كانت تعبانة من الشغل بس سمعته
english: Mom was tired from work but listened to him.
transliteration: Mama kanet ta'bana men el shoghl bas sem'etu

arabic: هو قال ليه الشمس صفرا وايه ده يا ماما
english: He said, "Why is the sun yellow, and what is this, Mom?"
transliteration: Howa 'al leih el shams safra w eih dah ya mama

arabic: هي بصت عليه بحب بس كانت عايزة تنام
english: She looked at him with love, but she wanted to sleep.
transliteration: Heya basset 'aleih be hob bas kanet 'ayza tenam

arabic: الولد كان مبسوط لما ماما ردت على سؤاله
english: The boy was happy when Mom answered his question.
transliteration: El walad kan mabsoot lamma mama raddet 'ala so'alo

arabic: الاسبوع ده العيلة كلها كانت بتخطط للاجازة
english: This week, the whole family was planning for the weekend.
transliteration: El-usbū' dah el-'ēlah kullaha kānīt bitkhaṭṭaṭ lel-igāza.

arabic: الشباب كانوا متحمسين جدا لفكرة مغامرة جديدة
english: The youth were very enthusiastic about the idea of a new adventure.
transliteration: El-shabāb kānū motḥammisīn giddan lefikrit moghāmara gedīda.

arabic: بس الكبار كانوا بيفضلوا مكان مريح بعيد عن الروتين
english: But the adults preferred a comfortable place away from routine.
