transliteration: Bass el-kobār kānū biyfaḍḍalū makān morīḥ ba'īd 'an el-rotiīn.

arabic: الفرق بين الاجيال كان واضح في كل اقتراح
english: The difference between generations was clear in every suggestion.
transliteration: El-far' bēn el-agyāl kān wāḍiḥ fī kull eqterāḥ.

arabic: المفروض نلاقي حاجة الكل يستمتع بيها
english: We are supposed to find something everyone enjoys.
transliteration: El-mafrūḍ nilā'ī ḥāgah el-kull yestamte' bīhā.

arabic: اليوم عيد ميلاد امي الحبيبة
english: Today is my beloved mother's birthday
transliteration: El-naharda eid milad ommy el-habiba

arabic: يلا نروح السوق الكبير عشان نشتري حاجات للحفلة
english: Let's go to the big market to buy things for the party
transliteration: Yalla nrooh el-soo' el-kibeer 'ashan neshtary hagāt lel-hafla

arabic: في السوق بنحب نشتري فاكهة وخضار طازة
english: In the market we love to buy fresh fruit and vegetables
transliteration: Fi el-soo' benhebb neshtary fakha we khodaar taze

arabic: سألت البياع الفاكهة بكام النهاردة
english: I asked the seller how much the fruit is today
transliteration: Sa'alt el-bayya' el-fakha bekam el-naharda

arabic: بعد ما خلصنا رجعنا البيت عشان نحضر كل حاجة
english: After we finished, we returned home to prepare everything
transliteration: Ba'd ma khallasna rega'na el-bayt 'ashan nehaddar koll haga

arabic: رحنا عند خالتي
english: We went to my aunt's place
transliteration: roHna 3and khalty

arabic: هي كانت فرحانة قوي تشوفنا
english: She was very happy to see us
transliteration: hiyya kanat farHana qawi tishufna

arabic: شربنا شاي واكلنا بسكويت
english: We drank tea and ate biscuits
transliteration: shiribna shay wa akalna biskuit

arabic: اتكلمنا عن العيلة
english: We talked about the family
transliteration: itkallimna 3an il-3eila

arabic: كان يوم حلو
english: It was a nice day
transliteration: kan yom Helw

arabic: صباح الخير رحت ازور خالتي
english: Good morning I went to visit my aunt
transliteration: Sabah el kheer roht azour khalti

arabic: لما فتحت الباب قلت لها ازيك يا خالتي
english: When she opened the door I told her How are you auntie
transliteration: Lamma fatahet el bab oltelha ezzayak ya khalti

arabic: قعدنا نشرب شاي ونتكلم كتير
english: We sat and drank tea and talked a lot
transliteration: Qa3adna neshrab shay w netkallem keteer

arabic: هي دايما بتصحى بدري وتجهز الفطار
english: She always wakes up early and prepares breakfast
transliteration: Heya dayman betes7a badry w tegehhez el fetar

arabic: قضيت يوم جميل معاها والحمد لله
english: I spent a beautiful day with her thank God
transliteration: Qadeit yom gameel ma3aha wel hamdulillah

arabic: كنت ماشية في الشارع وشفت صاحبي القديم احمد
english: I was walking in the street and saw my old friend Ahmed.
transliteration: Kunt mashya fel share3 w shoft sa7by el adeem Ahmed.

arabic: قلت له مساء الخير يا احمد ازيك عامل ايه؟
english: I told him 'Good evening Ahmed, how are you doing?'
transliteration: Oltelo Masa' el kheer ya Ahmed, ezzayak 3amel eh?

arabic: ابتسم وقال مساء النور يا سارة انا كويس الحمد لله ازيك انتي؟
english: He smiled and said 'Good evening Sara, I'm good, thank God, how are you?'
transliteration: Ebtasam w 'al Masa' el noor ya Sara, ana kwayyes el Hamdulillah, ezzayek enty?

arabic: رديت وقلت انا كويسة الحمد لله كل العيلة كويسين؟
english: I replied 'I'm good, thank God, is the whole family doing well?'
transliteration: Raddayt w olt ana kwayyesa el Hamdulillah, kol el 3eila kwayyeseen?

arabic: قال الحمد لله كله تمام وفرحنا اوي اننا شفنا بعض
english: He said 'Thank God, all is well' and we were very happy to see each other.
transliteration: 'Al el Hamdulillah, kollo tamam, w fere7na awi ennena shoftna ba3d.

arabic: صحى سيد متحمس لرحلته لسياتل.
english: Sayed woke up excited for his trip to Seattle.
transliteration: Sa7a Sayed mota7ammes le-re7leto le-Seattle.

arabic: فحص جواز سفره القديم.
english: He checked his old passport.
transliteration: Fa7as gawaz safaro el-qadeem.

arabic: يا نهار أبيض! صلاحيته منتهية.
english: Oh my god! Its validity is expired.
transliteration: Ya nahaar abyaḍ! Sala7eyato monteheya.

arabic: حلمه بمشاهدة مصر وإيران في خطر.
english: His dream of watching Egypt and Iran is in danger.
transliteration: 7elmo be-moshahadet Masr w Iran fi 5aṭar.

arabic: حس بحزن شديد خالص.
english: He felt very sad.
transliteration: 7ass be-7ozn shadeed 5aales.

arabic: طب، اتصل بصديقه كريم.
english: So, he called his friend Karim.
transliteration: Tab, ettaṣal be-ṣadee'o Karim.

arabic: كريم قاله: روح مجمع التحرير.
english: Karim told him: Go to Mogamma' El Tahrir.
transliteration: Karim 'alo: roo7 Mogamma' El Ta7reer.

arabic: هيكلفك كتير، يعني فلوس كتير.
english: It will cost you a lot, meaning a lot of money.
transliteration: Haykallifak keteer, ya3ni feloos keteer.

arabic: سيد كان معاه بس خمسين جنيه.
english: Sayed only had fifty pounds.
transliteration: Sayed kan ma3ah bas 5amseen geneh.

arabic: قرر يطلب مساعدة من خاله.
english: He decided to ask for help from his uncle (maternal).
transliteration: Qarrar yoṭlob mosa3ada men 5alo.

arabic: خاله ساكن في المعادي.
english: His uncle lives in Maadi.
transliteration: 5alo saken fi el-Ma3adi.

arabic: ركب ميكروباص وراح المعادي.
english: He took a microbus and went to Maadi.
transliteration: Rekeb microbus w ra7 el-Ma3adi.

arabic: شرح المشكلة لخاله بالظبط.
english: He explained the problem to his uncle exactly.
transliteration: Shara7 el-moshkela le-5alo bel-ẓabṭ.

arabic: خاله اداله خمسمية جنيه.
english: His uncle gave him five hundred pounds.
transliteration: 5alo eddalo 5omṣomeya geneh.

arabic: سيد حس بالأمل تاني.
english: Sayed felt hopeful again.
transliteration: Sayed 7ass bel-amal tani.

arabic: يا عم، الماتش ده لازم أشوفه!
english: Man, I have to see this match!
transliteration: Ya 'amm, el-matsh da lazim ashoofoh!

arabic: مصر ضد إيران في كأس العالم، تخيل!
english: Egypt against Iran in the World Cup, imagine!
transliteration: Masr ded Iran fi kaas el-'alam, takhayyal!

arabic: أنا قاعد في قهوة في الزمالك مع صاحبي عمر.
english: I am sitting in a coffee shop in Zamalek with my friend Omar.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed fi 'ahwa fi el-Zamalek ma'a sahbi 'Omar.

arabic: نفسي أسافر سياتل، بس التذكرة غالية خالص.
english: I wish to travel to Seattle, but the ticket is very expensive.
transliteration: Nafsi asafer Seattle, bas el-tazkara ghaliyah khales.

arabic: عمر قالي: "يا عم، دي بكام يعني؟"
english: Omar told me: "Man, how much is this, I mean?"
transliteration: 'Omar 'aly: "Ya 'amm, di be-kam ya'ni?"

arabic: معايا خمسمية جنيه بس، وده مش كفاية أبداً.
english: I only have five hundred pounds, and this is never enough.
transliteration: Ma'aya khomsumiyah geneh bas, we da mesh kefayah abadan.

arabic: عمر قال لي: "كلم عمك بتاع السياحة".
english: Omar told me: "Call your uncle, the tourism one."
transliteration: 'Omar 'aal li: "Kallem 'ammak beta' el-siyahah."

arabic: عمي ممكن يلاقي لي سعر كويس للطيران.
english: My uncle might find me a good price for the flight.
transliteration: 'Ammy mumkin yela'i li se'r kowayyes lel-tayaran.

arabic: الفكرة دي خلتني أحس بأمل كبير.
english: This idea made me feel great hope.
transliteration: El-fekrah di khallitni ahiss be-amal kebir.

arabic: طلبت قهوة مظبوطة عشان أركز.
english: I ordered a mazboot coffee to focus.
transliteration: Talabt 'ahwa mazbouta 'ashan arkkez.

arabic: عمر ضحك وقالي: "يلا، كلم عمك!"
english: Omar laughed and told me: "Come on, call your uncle!"
transliteration: 'Omar dehek we qaaly: "Yalla, kallem 'ammak!"

arabic: طلعت موبايلي بسرعة عشان أكلمه.
english: I took out my mobile quickly to call him.
transliteration: Talla't mobaily be-sor'ah 'ashan akallemoh.

arabic: يا رب عمي يلاقي لي حل للسفر.
english: Oh Lord, may my uncle find me a solution for travel.
transliteration: Ya rabb 'ammy yela'i li hall lel-safar.

arabic: تخيل لو مصر تكسب الكاس ده.
english: Imagine if Egypt wins this cup.
transliteration: Takhayyal law Masr teksab el-kaas da.

arabic: حلم كبير بس ممكن يحصل، مش كده؟
english: A big dream but it might happen, right?
transliteration: Helm kebir bas mumkin yahsal, mesh keda?

arabic: ريحة البن المحوج كانت مالية قهوة أبو شقرة في الزمالك الساعة تمانية الصبح.
english: The scent of spiced coffee filled Ahwa Abu Shakra in Zamalek at eight in the morning.
transliteration: Riihet el-bunn el-mahaweeg kanet malya 'ahwet Abu Shaqra fi el-Zamalek el-sa'a tamanya el-sob7.

arabic: هدى دخلت، وقالت بصوت هادي: "صباح الخير يا عمو أحمد، إزيك عامل إيه؟"
english: Hoda entered and said in a quiet voice: "Good morning, Uncle Ahmed, how are you doing?"
transliteration: Hoda dakhalet, w 'alet be-sot hady: "Sabah el-kheir ya 'ammo Ahmed, ezzayak 'amel eh?"

arabic: عمو أحمد، صاحب القهوة، رد بابتسامة: "صباح الفل يا هدى، أنا كويس خالص، وإنتي كويسة؟"
english: Uncle Ahmed, the coffeehouse owner, replied with a smile: "Good morning, Hoda, I'm very good, and are you good?"
transliteration: 'Ammo Ahmed, saheb el-'ahwa, radd be-ebtesama: "Sabah el-full ya Hoda, ana kwayyes khales, w enti kwayyesa?"

arabic: "آه، الحمد لله، كويسة يا عمو، من فضلكَ واحد قهوة مظبوط."
english: "Yes, thank God, I'm good, Uncle, please, one 'mazboot' coffee."
transliteration: "Ah, el-hamd lellah, kwayyesa ya 'ammo, men fadlak wahed 'ahwa mazboot."

arabic: فجأة صاحبتها منى جت من بعيد وقالت: "يا هلا هدى! إزيك يا بنتي؟ أنتِ منين النهاردة؟"
english: Suddenly, her friend Mona came from afar and said: "Welcome Hoda! How are you, my daughter? Where are you from today?"
transliteration: Fag'a sa7ebetha Mona gat men ba'eed w 'alet: "Ya hala Hoda! Ezzayek ya benty? Enti menein el-naharda?"

arabic: هدى ضحكت وقالت: "أنا من البيت يا منى، كنت جاية أشتغل، وإنتي؟"
english: Hoda laughed and said: "I'm from home, Mona, I was coming to work, and you?"
transliteration: Hoda dehekt w 'alet: "Ana men el-beit ya Mona, kont gaya ashtaghal, w enti?"

arabic: منى بصت حواليها، "لأ، مش معقول، إيه ده؟ هو الأستاذ كريم لسه هنا؟ أنتَ منين يا أستاذ؟"
english: Mona looked around, "No, unbelievable, what is this? Is Professor Karim still here? Where are you from, Professor?"
transliteration: Mona baset 7awaliha, "La', mesh ma'oul, eh dah? Howa el-ostaz Karim lessa hena? Enta menein ya ostaz?"

arabic: الأستاذ كريم، اللي كان بيقرا جورنال، رفع راسه وقال: "صباح النور يا منى، أنا كويس يا بنتي، شكراً."
english: Professor Karim, who was reading a newspaper, raised his head and said: "Good morning, Mona, I'm good, my daughter, thank you."
transliteration: El-ostaz Karim, elle kan bey'ra gornal, rafa' rasoh w 'al: "Sabah el-noor ya Mona, ana kwayyes ya benty, shokran."

arabic: هدى بصت لساعتها؛ يا دوب فاضل ساعتين على ميعاد التسليم، "منى، من فضلكِ، ممكن نشتغل سوا؟"
english: Hoda looked at her watch; there were barely two hours left until the deadline, "Mona, please, can we work together?"
transliteration: Hoda baset le-sa'etha; ya doob fadel sa'atein 'ala me'ad el-taslim, "Mona, men fadlek, momken neshtaghal sawa?"

arabic: منى ابتسمت وقالت: "آه طبعاً، تمام، يلا بينا نبدأ! وباي لأي مقاطعة تانية!"
english: Mona smiled and said: "Yes, of course, okay, let's start! And bye to any other interruptions!"
transliteration: Mona ebtasemet w 'alet: "Ah tab'an, tamam, yalla bena nabda'! W bye le-ay moqata'a tanya!"

arabic: صباح الخير انا رايح المدرسة دلوقتي
english: Good morning I am going to school now
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ana rayih el madrasa delwa'ti

arabic: في المدرسة قابلت صاحبي احمد وقلتله ازيك يا احمد
english: At school I met my friend Ahmed and I told him How are you Ahmed
transliteration: Fil madrasa qabelt saHbi Ahmad w qultelo izzayak ya Ahmad

arabic: احمد رد وقالي انا كويس الدرس بتاع النهارده سهل
english: Ahmed replied and told me I'm good today's lesson is easy
transliteration: Ahmad radd w qali ana kwayyis el dars beta' ennaharda sahl

arabic: انا قلتله ايوه الدرس سهل بس الواجب كان صعب
english: I told him yes the lesson is easy but the homework was difficult
transliteration: Ana qultelo aywa el dars sahl bas el wagib kan sa'b

arabic: بعد المدرسة قلتله شكرا يا احمد مع السلامة
english: After school I told him Thank you Ahmed goodbye
transliteration: Ba'd el madrasa qultelo shokran ya Ahmad ma'a el salama

arabic: اليوم في بيتنا عزومة كبيرة والعيلة كلها هنا
english: Today at our house there's a big gathering and the whole family is here.
transliteration: El-yoom fi beitna a'azouma kebeera wel-a'eila kollaha hena.

arabic: الاكل كتير ولذيذ على السفرة
english: The food is a lot and delicious on the table.
transliteration: El-akl keteer wa ladheed a'ala el-sofra.

arabic: انا بسأل اختي عندي قهوة وشاي وعصير تحبي ايه
english: I ask my sister, "I have coffee, tea, and juice. What do you like?"
transliteration: Ana bas'al okhti a'andy ahwa wa shay wa a'seer tehebbi eh?

arabic: هي قالت انا احب عصير برتقال من فضلك
english: She said, "I like orange juice, please."
transliteration: Heya a'alet ana ahebb a'aseer borto'aal men fadlak.

arabic: كلنا بناكل وبنتكلم والجو جميل جدا
english: We all eat and talk, and the atmosphere is very beautiful.
transliteration: Kollena bena'kol wa benetkallem wel-gaw gameel geddan.

arabic: امبارح بالليل كانت حفلة عيد ميلاد صاحبي احمد
english: Last night was my friend Ahmed's birthday party
transliteration: Imbareh billeil kanat haflat eid milad sahby Ahmed

arabic: البيت كان مليان زينة بالونات والوانها كانت مبهجة اوي
english: The house was full of decorations and balloons, and their colors were very cheerful
transliteration: El beit kan malyan zeina w balloonat w alwanha kanet mobhega awi

arabic: انا مصري وفرحان اوي بصاحبي احمد اللي كان مبسوط وهو بيقطع التورتة الكبيرة
english: I am Egyptian and very happy for my friend Ahmed, who was glad while cutting the big cake
transliteration: Ana masry w farhan awi be sahby Ahmed elli kan mabsoot we howwa beye'ta' el torta el kebeera

arabic: ريحة التورتة الشوكولاتة كانت مالية المكان والاغاني كانت عالية
english: The smell of the chocolate cake filled the place and the music was loud
transliteration: Reehet el torta el shokolata kanet malya el makan wel aghany kanet 'alya

arabic: كلنا قضينا وقت حلو ورقصنا كتير لحد ما تعبنا من الفرحة
english: We all had a good time and danced a lot until we were tired from joy
transliteration: Kollena addeina wa't helw w ra'asna keteer hadd ma ta'ebna men el farha

arabic: رحت ازور خالتي امبارح وكانت مبسوطة اوي اني جيت
english: I went to visit my aunt yesterday and she was very happy I came
transliteration: Roḥt azūr khaltī embāreḥ w kānət mabsoṭa awi innī gīt

arabic: قعدنا نتكلم شوية كتير عن اخبار العيلة والبلد
english: We sat and talked a lot about family news and the country
transliteration: Qaʿadnā netkallem shwaya kitīr ʿan akhbār el-ʿēla wel-balad

arabic: خالتي قالتلي ان في مرشح جديد للانتخابات الكل بيتكلم عنه
english: My aunt told me there's a new candidate for the elections everyone is talking about
transliteration: Khaltī qāletlī inn fī morashshaḥ gedīd lel-entikhābāt el-koll biyitkallem ʿannoh

arabic: كنا بنتمنى ان الحكم يكون احسن في الفترة اللي جاية
english: We were hoping that the governance would be better in the coming period
transliteration: Kunnā bentetmannā inn el-ḥokm yekūn aḥsan fil-fatara illī gāyya

arabic: شربنا شاي اكلنا كحك وقضيت معاها وقت جميل قبل ما امشي
english: We drank tea, ate kahk, and I spent a beautiful time with her before I left
transliteration: Sheribnā shāy akalnā kaḥk w qaḍḍēt maʿāhā waqt gamīl qabl mā amshī

arabic: زرنا خالتنا في طنطا وكانت فرحانة اوي لما شافتنا
english: We visited our aunt in Tanta and she was very happy when she saw us.
transliteration: Zorna khaltana fi Tanta w kanet farhana awi lama shafetna

arabic: عملت اكلة مشهورة اوي هي بتعرف تعملها كويس
english: She made a very famous dish that she knows how to make well.
transliteration: 3amalet akla mashhoora awi heya bet3raf ta3melha kwayes

arabic: ابن خالتي قال هتعجبكوا الاكلة دي وماتنسوش المخلل معاها
english: My cousin said "You will like this dish, and don't forget the pickles with it."
transliteration: Ibn khaltiy 2al hat3agebkoo el akla di w matensoush el mekhalil ma3aha

arabic: كلنا اتجمعنا حوالين السفرة والجو يبقى عظيم
english: We all gathered around the table, and the atmosphere became great.
transliteration: Kollena etgama3na hawaleen el sofra wel gaw yeb2a 3azeem

arabic: خالتي قالت خليهم ييجوا عندنا دايما عشان افرح بيكوا
english: My aunt said "Keep visiting us always so I can be happy with you all."
transliteration: Khaltiy 2alet khaleehom yeegoo 3andena dayman 3ashan afra7 beekoo

arabic: هاني، 25 سنة، قاعد في قهوة زينب، بيحاول يعد فلوسه: معايا 30 جنيه بس، يارب يكفوا لواحد شاي وفطيرتين.
english: Hany, 25 years old, sitting in Zeinab's Ahwa, tries to count his money: I only have 30 pounds, I hope it's enough for one tea and two feteer.
transliteration: Hany, 25 sana, qa3id fi ahwet Zeinab, biyhawel yi3idd fuluso: ma3aya 30 geneh bas, ya rabb yikfu li-wahed shay w feteertein.

arabic: القهوجي، راجل كبير عنده 60 سنة، جابله طلباته: الشاي أبو 8 جنيه والمخلل المشهور بتاعنا اللي سعره 5 جنيه، هتعجِبك!
english: The ahwagi, an old man of 60, brought him his order: The tea for 8 pounds and our famous pickles which cost 5 pounds, you will like it!
transliteration: El-ahwagi, ragel kebir 3ando 60 sana, gablu talabatu: El-shay abu 8 geneh wel-mokhalel el-mashhur beta3na elly se3ro 5 geneh, hat3gebak!

arabic: أهو يبقى كده 13 جنيه بس! هاني قال بصوت واطي، حس إنها صفقة عظيمة معاه.
english: So, that makes it 13 pounds only! Hany said in a low voice, feeling it was a great deal for him.
transliteration: Aho yibqa kida 13 geneh bas! Hany qal b-sot wati, hass innaha safqa 3azima ma3ah.

arabic: حضرتكوا ممكن تخليهم 20 جنيه بس لو سمحت، بقترح عليكوا تدوقوا كركديه، وهو بنقترحه.
english: Your excellencies, you can make them 20 pounds only please, I suggest you try karkadeh, and we recommend it.
transliteration: Hadretko mumkin takhallihom 20 geneh bas law samaht, baqtarah 3aleyko tedoo'o karkadeh, w howa binqtarho.

arabic: هاني دفع الـ 20 جنيه ومبسوط، عرف إنه لسه معاه 10 جنيه زيادة، وده جرى بسرعة.
english: Hany paid the 20 pounds and was happy, he knew he still had 10 extra pounds with him, and this happened quickly.
transliteration: Hany dafa3 el-20 geneh w mabsut, 3iref inno lessa ma3ah 10 geneh ziyada, w dah gara b-sor3a.

arabic: اليوم كان عيد ميلاد تيتا في البيت
english: Today was Grandma's birthday at home.
transliteration: El-yom kan 3eid milad teta fel beit.

arabic: العائلة كلها كانت موجودة في الحفلة
english: The whole family was present at the party.
transliteration: El-3a2ila kol-laha kanet mawgoda fel 7afla.

arabic: الاطفال لعبوا وغنوا كتير وكانوا مبسوطين
english: The children played and sang a lot and were happy.
transliteration: El-atfal la3abu w ghannu kiteer w kanu mabsooteen.

arabic: الكبار كانوا قاعدين بيتكلموا وبيضحكوا
english: The adults were sitting talking and laughing.
transliteration: El-kobar kanu 2a3deen biyitkallimu w biyid7aku.

arabic: كلهم بيحبوا اليوم ده وبيستمتعوا بالوقت مع بعض
english: Everyone loves this day and enjoys time together.
transliteration: Kollohom biyihibbu el-yom da w biyistamti3u bel-wa2t ma3 ba3d.

arabic: مساء الخير يا جماعة العيلة كلها اتجمعت النهاردة
english: Good evening everyone, the whole family gathered today.
transliteration: Masa' el-kheer ya gama'a el-'eila kolaha etgama'et ennaharda

arabic: اول ما دخلوا كل واحد سلم بحرارة وقال السلام عليكم
english: As soon as they entered, everyone greeted warmly and said "Peace be upon you".
transliteration: Awwel ma dakhalu kol wahed sallam beharaara w al As-salamu alaykum

arabic: ورد الكبار وعليكم السلام ورحمة الله وبركاته يلا بينا ناكل
english: The elders responded "And upon you be peace and God's mercy and blessings" and "Let's eat".
transliteration: W radd el-kobaar Wa alaykum as-salam w rahmet Allah w barakatuh yalla bina nakol

arabic: سفرة الاكل كانت مليانة اطباق شهية وكلنا بناكل من طبق واحد وده عادة جميلة
english: The dining table was full of delicious dishes, and we all ate from one plate, which is a beautiful custom.
transliteration: Sofret el-akl kanet malyana atba' shahia w kolena banakol men taba' wahed w da 'aada gameela

arabic: الضحك والكلام الحلو مال البيت والقلوب كانت فرحانة بلمة العيلة دي
english: Laughter and sweet talk filled the house, and hearts were happy with this family gathering.
transliteration: El-dehk wel-kalam el-helw mal el-beit wel-'oloub kanet farhana belammet el-'eila di

arabic: صباح الخير يا سلمى ازيك
english: Good morning Salma How are you
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya Salma ezzayek

arabic: صباح النور يا منى الحمد لله كويسة انا انت عاملة ايه
english: Good morning Mona Praise be to God I'm good How are you
transliteration: Sabah el noor ya Mona el hamdu lellah kwayyesa ana enty amla eih

arabic: الحمد لله انا كويسة ممكن شوية سكر
english: Praise be to God I'm good Can I have a little sugar
transliteration: El hamdu lellah ana kwayyesa momken shwayyet sukkar

arabic: اه طبعا مفيش مشكلة تعالي هنا البيت فيه سكر
english: Oh of course no problem Come here the house has sugar
transliteration: Ah tab'an mafeesh moshkela ta'ali hena el beit feeh sukkar

arabic: شكرا جدا يا جارتي العزيزة
english: Thank you very much my dear neighbor
transliteration: Shokran geddan ya gaarty el aziza

arabic: صباح الخير يا سارة ازيك
english: Good morning Sarah, how are you?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheer ya Sara izzayyik

arabic: اهلا بيكي يا منى انا كويسة الحمد لله
english: Welcome to you Mona, I'm good alhamdulillah.
transliteration: Ahlan beeki ya Mona ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah

arabic: انا كويسة برضو انتي عاملة ايه
english: I'm good too, how are you doing?
transliteration: Ana kwayyesa bardoo inti amla eih

arabic: انا تمام الحمد لله كل حاجة كويسة
english: I'm fine alhamdulillah, everything is good.
transliteration: Ana tamam alhamdulillah kull haga kwayyesa

arabic: تمام مع السلامة يا سارة الله يسلمك
english: Okay goodbye Sarah, may God keep you safe.
transliteration: Tamam ma'a salama ya Sara Allah yisallimik

arabic: صباح الخير يا جاري
english: Good morning, my neighbor.
transliteration: Sabah el kheir ya gari

arabic: ازيك عامل ايه
english: How are you doing? (male)
transliteration: Ezzayak 'amel eh

arabic: انا كويس الحمد لله
english: I am good, thank God.
transliteration: Ana kwayes el hamdulillah

arabic: بيت جديد جميل
english: A new beautiful house.
transliteration: Beit gedid gameel

arabic: مع السلامة
english: Goodbye.
transliteration: Ma'a el salama

arabic: انا رحت السوق امبارح عشان اشتري خضار
english: I went to the market yesterday to buy vegetables.
transliteration: Ana roht el souq embareh ashan ashtari khodar.
storyTitle: A Funny Trip to the Market

arabic: السوق كان زحمة قوي وفيه حاجات كتير
english: The market was very crowded and had many things.
transliteration: El souq kan zahma qawi w feeh hagaat keteer.
storyTitle: A Funny Trip to the Market

arabic: شفت طماطم شكلها حلو قوي وسألت بكام دي
english: I saw very nice-looking tomatoes and asked, "How much is this?"
transliteration: Shoft tamatem shaklaha helw qawi w sa'alt bekam di?
storyTitle: A Funny Trip to the Market

arabic: البياع قالي الكيلو بخمسين جنيه انا ضحكت كتير
english: The seller told me the kilo is fifty pounds, I laughed a lot.
transliteration: El bayya' qali el kilo bekhamsin geneh ana dehekt keteer.
storyTitle: A Funny Trip to the Market

arabic: انا اشتريت طماطم قليلة ورجعت البيت مبسوط
english: I bought a little bit of tomatoes and returned home happy.
transliteration: Ana eshtarait tamatem qalila w rega't el beit mabsoot.
storyTitle: A Funny Trip to the Market

arabic: عيد ميلاد صاحبي النهارده
english: Today is my friend's birthday.
transliteration: Eid milad saHbi ennaharda

arabic: احنا اشترينا تورته كبيره
english: We bought a big cake.
transliteration: E7na eshtarayna torta kebira

arabic: هو كان مبسوط اوي بالهديه
english: He was very happy with the gift.
transliteration: Howwa kan mabsoot awi belhediya

arabic: كل الناس ضحكوا وغنوا
english: Everyone laughed and sang.
transliteration: Koll ennas DeHku we ghannu

arabic: كان يوم جميل
english: It was a beautiful day.
transliteration: Kan yom gameel

arabic: صاحبي عمر اتصل بيا النهاردة
english: My friend Omar called me today.
transliteration: Sa7bi Omar ettasal beya elnaharda.

arabic: قولت الو يا عمر ازيك
english: I said 'Hello Omar, how are you?'
transliteration: Olt 'Allo ya Omar izzayak?'

arabic: هو قال انا كويس الحمد لله انت عامل ايه
english: He said 'I'm good, praise be to God, how are you?'
transliteration: Howa 'al 'Ana kwayyes elhamdulillah, enta 'amel eh?'

arabic: احنا اتكلمنا شوية عن يومنا
english: We talked a little about our day.
transliteration: E7na etkallamna shwayya 'an yomna.

arabic: بعدين انا قولت تمام اشوفك بعدين
english: Then I said 'Okay, see you later.'
transliteration: Ba'dein ana olt 'Tamam, ashoofak ba'dein.'

arabic: انا رحت السوق النهاردة
english: I went to the market today.
transliteration: Ana roht el souq el naharda
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: سلمت على البائع وقلت صباح الخير
english: I greeted the seller and said good morning.
transliteration: Sallamt ala el baa'e' w olt sabah el kheer
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: سألت بكام الطماطم دي
english: I asked 'How much are these tomatoes?'
transliteration: Sa'alt 'bekam el tamaatem dee?'
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: اشتريت كيلو خضار وكيس فاكهة
english: I bought a kilo of vegetables and a bag of fruit.
transliteration: Eshtareet kilo khodaar w kees fakiha
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: البائع قالي اتفضل وشكرته
english: The seller told me 'here you go' and I thanked him.
transliteration: El baa'e' qali 'etfaddal' w shakarto
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: انا كنت بتكلم في التليفون مع صاحبتي سارة
english: I was talking on the phone with my friend Sarah.
transliteration: Ana kont batkallem fi el-telefoon ma'a sahbeti Sara.

arabic: هي سالتني بتعملي ايه يا بنتي رديت امي عايزة خضار وفاكهة
english: She asked me 'What are you doing, girl?' I replied 'My mother wants vegetables and fruit.'
transliteration: Heyya sa'aletni 'bet'amali eih ya benti?' raddayt 'Ommy 'ayza khodaar w fakha.'

arabic: سارة قالت يلا بينا نروح السوق الكبير يمكن نلاقي حاجات حلوة
english: Sarah said 'Let's go to the big market, maybe we'll find nice things.'
transliteration: Sara qalet 'Yalla bina nrooh el-soo' el-kibeer yemken nla'i hagāt helwa.'

arabic: قلت لها فكره حلوة بس عارفة بكام الطماطم دلوقتي
english: I told her 'Good idea, but do you know how much the tomatoes are now?'
transliteration: Oltelaha 'Fekra helwa bas 'arfa bekam el-tamātem delwa'ty?'

arabic: ضحكنا وقلنا اهم حاجه اننا بنحب الاكل الصحي حتى لو غالي
english: We laughed and said 'The most important thing is that we love healthy food, even if it's expensive.'
transliteration: Deheknā w olna 'Aham haga ennena benhebb el-akl el-sehhy hatta law ghaly.'

arabic: صباح الخير يا جارتي ازيك عاملة ايه
english: Good morning, my neighbor, how are you doing?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya garti, izzayek ʿamla eih?

arabic: الحمد لله بخير بتهيألي الانتخابات قربت
english: Praise be to God, I'm fine. I think the elections are close.
transliteration: El-ḥamdulillah be-kheir, betaḥayyalī el-entikhābāt orrabit.

arabic: اه صحيح لازم نشوف المرشحين كويسين ولا لا قبل التصويت
english: Oh, that's right. We need to see if the candidates are good or not before voting.
transliteration: Ah saḥīḥ, lāzem nishūf el-morashshaḥīn kwayyisīn walla laʾ abl et-taṣwīt.

arabic: مهم نختار رئيس الجمهورية اللي يقود البلد كويس
english: It's important to choose the President of the Republic who will lead the country well.
transliteration: Mohimm nekhtār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya elli yaʾūd el-balad kwayyis.

arabic: عندك حق طب تعالي اشربي معايا شاي
english: You are right. Come, drink tea with me then.
transliteration: ʿAndek ḥaʾʾ. Ṭab taʿālī ishrabī maʿāya shāy.

arabic: النهاردة انا عايز اشتري هدوم جديدة
english: Today I want to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Elnaharda ana ayiz ashtiri hedoom gedeeda.
storyTitle: A Day of New Clothes Shopping

arabic: يلا بينا نروح محل هدوم كبير
english: Let's go to a big clothes shop.
transliteration: Yalla beena nrouh mahal hedoom kibeer.
storyTitle: A Day of New Clothes Shopping

arabic: شفت تيشيرت ازرق وبنطلون اسود
english: I saw a blue t-shirt and black trousers.
transliteration: Shoft tishirt azraq w bantalon aswad.
storyTitle: A Day of New Clothes Shopping

arabic: التيشيرت ده عجبني اوي والبنطلون كمان
english: I really liked this t-shirt and the trousers too.
transliteration: Eltishirt da agabni awi welbantalon kaman.
storyTitle: A Day of New Clothes Shopping

arabic: دلوقتي انا بشتري الهدوم الجديدة دي
english: Now I am buying these new clothes.
transliteration: Delwa'ti ana bashtiri elhedoom elgedeeda di.
storyTitle: A Day of New Clothes Shopping

arabic: النهاردة الصبح لما برجع البيت لقيت النت مش شغال خالص
english: This morning when I return home, I found the internet not working at all.
transliteration: Elnaharda elsobh lamma barg'a elbeit laqeet elnet mesh shaghghal khales

arabic: انا واخويا عايزين نكلم فني يصلحه بس جدي بيقول نصبر شوية
english: My brother and I want to call a technician to fix it, but my grandfather says to wait a bit.
transliteration: Ana wakhoya ayzeen nekallem fanni yessallahoh bass Geddi bi'ool nesbor showaya

arabic: تيتتي بتقول يمكن السلك بس اللي مفصول مش محتاجين حد غريب يدخل بيتنا
english: My grandmother says maybe it's just the cable disconnected, we don't need a stranger to enter our house.
transliteration: Teteti bet'ool yemken elsellk bass elli mafsoul mesh mehtageen had ghareeb yedkhol beitna

arabic: انا عايز حل سريع عشان عندي شغل بدري بكرة وهو بيقول الدنيا مش بتطير يا ابني
english: I want a quick solution because I have early work tomorrow, and he says the world isn't flying, my son.
transliteration: Ana ayz hall sareea ashan andy shoghl badri bokra wehowwa bi'ool eldunya mesh betteer ya ebny

arabic: يلا بينا نشوف السلك طيب يمكن كلام تيتتي صح
english: Come on, let's go check the cable then, maybe Teteti's words are right.
transliteration: Yalla bina neshoof elsellk tayyeb yemken kalam Teteti sah

arabic: انا قاعد في القهوة
english: I am sitting at the cafe.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed fi el ahwa.

arabic: انا مستني صاحبي يجي
english: I am waiting for my friend to come.
transliteration: Ana mestanni sahbi yigi.

arabic: عايز اشرب قهوة سادة
english: I want to drink plain coffee.
transliteration: Ayez ashrab ahwa sada.

arabic: المكان هادي وحلو
english: The place is quiet and nice.
transliteration: El makan hadi w helw.

arabic: بس صاحبي لسه متاخر
english: But my friend is still late.
transliteration: Bas sahbi lessa meta'akher.

arabic: ليلى راحت المحل زعلانة شوية
english: Layla went to the shop a little upset
transliteration: Layla rahet el-mahal za'lana shwaya

arabic: هي عايزة ترجع العصير اللي اشترته امبارح
english: She wants to return the juice she bought yesterday
transliteration: Heya ayza terga' el-a'seer elly eshtarito embarah

arabic: الراجل في المحل قال لها اهلا بيكي يا مدام
english: The man in the shop said to her "Welcome madam"
transliteration: El-ragel fi el-mahal 'al laha "Ahlan beeki ya madam"

arabic: ليلى قالت عندي عصير برتقال بس عايزة شاي
english: Layla said "I have orange juice but I want tea"
transliteration: Layla 'alet "A'andy a'seer borto'aal bas ayza shay"

arabic: الراجل ابتسم وقال تمام ممكن تشربي شاي
english: The man smiled and said "Okay you can drink tea"
transliteration: El-ragel ebtasam w 'al "Tamam mumkin tishrabi shay"

arabic: صباح الخير يا ماما انا رايحة المدرسة
english: Good morning mom, I'm going to school.
transliteration: Sabah el kheir ya mama ana rayha el madrasa.
storyTitle: A Day at School and with Family

arabic: مع السلامة يا حبيبتي خدي ساندويتشاتك دي
english: Goodbye my dear, take these sandwiches.
transliteration: Ma'a el salama ya habibty khodi sandwiches-atek di.
storyTitle: A Day at School and with Family

arabic: في المدرسة لعبت مع اصحابي كتير وفرحت اوي
english: At school I played a lot with my friends and was very happy.
transliteration: Fi el madrasa le'ebt ma'a ashabi keteir we fereht awi.
storyTitle: A Day at School and with Family

arabic: بعد الظهر روحت البيت واكلت غدا لذيذ مع بابا
english: In the afternoon I went home and ate a delicious lunch with dad.
transliteration: Ba'd el dohr rohwaht el beit we akalt ghada laziz ma'a baba.
storyTitle: A Day at School and with Family

arabic: بالليل كل العيلة اتجمعت واتكلمنا كتير
english: At night, the whole family gathered and we talked a lot.
transliteration: Bel leil kol el 'eila etgama'et we etkallamna keteir.
storyTitle: A Day at School and with Family

arabic: انا ماشي في الشارع و فجاة حسيت اني تايه
english: I was walking in the street and suddenly I felt lost.
transliteration: Ana mashi fi el share' w faga'a hassayt enni tayeh

arabic: بقيت قلقان شوية و مش عارف اروح فين
english: I became a little worried and didn't know where to go.
transliteration: Ba'eet 'al'aan shwayya w mish 'aref arooH feen

arabic: شفت راجل كبير فقررت اساله على الطريق
english: I saw an old man so I decided to ask him about the way.
transliteration: Shoft ragel kabeer fa qarart as'alo 'ala el tareeq

arabic: قلت له لو سمحت انا عايز اروح البيت بتاعي
english: I told him, 'Excuse me, I want to go to my house'.
transliteration: Oltelo law samaht ana 'ayez arooH el beet beta'i

arabic: هو قالي امشي طوالي وبعدين يمين شكرا
english: He told me, 'Walk straight and then right.' Thank you!
transliteration: Howa 'ali emshi tawali w ba'dein yameen shokran

arabic: كريم: إيه ده، المطعم قافل النهاردة!
english: Karim: What's this, the restaurant is closed today!
transliteration: Karim: 'Eh da, el mat'am 'afel ennaharda!

arabic: تامر: بجد؟ أنا في طريقي بالعربية!
english: Tamer: Really? I'm on my way in the car!
transliteration: Tamer: Begad? Ana fi taree'i bel arabeya!

arabic: كريم: معلش، طب تيجي بيتي؟
english: Karim: Never mind, so will you come to my house?
transliteration: Karim: Ma'lesh, tab teegi beiti?

arabic: تامر: بيتك؟ ماشي، عندك أكل؟
english: Tamer: Your house? Okay, do you have food?
transliteration: Tamer: Beitak? Mashi, 'andak akl?

arabic: كريم: أيوه، عامل كشري حلو.
english: Karim: Yes, I made good koshary.
transliteration: Karim: Aywa, 'amel koshary helw.

arabic: تامر: يا سلام! أنا جاي بسرعة.
english: Tamer: Wow! I'm coming quickly.
transliteration: Tamer: Ya salam! Ana gay be sor'a.

arabic: كريم: بيتي في المعادي، جنب المحطة.
english: Karim: My house is in Maadi, next to the station.
transliteration: Karim: Beiti fel Ma'adi, gamb el mahatta.

arabic: تامر: تمام، أنا عارف بيتك.
english: Tamer: Okay, I know your house.
transliteration: Tamer: Tamam, ana 'aref beitak.

arabic: كريم: يلا، جهزت الشاي.
english: Karim: Come on, I prepared the tea.
transliteration: Karim: Yalla, gahhazt el shay.

arabic: تامر: كويس خالص! عشر دقايق وأوصل.
english: Tamer: Very good! Ten minutes and I'll arrive.
transliteration: Tamer: Kowayyes khales! 'Ashar da'ayeq w awsal.

arabic: امبارح رحت بيت خالتي
english: Yesterday I went to my aunt's house.
transliteration: Imbaarih roht beet khalti.

arabic: بيتها كبير وحلو
english: Her house is big and beautiful.
transliteration: Beetha kibeer we helw.

arabic: اكلنا اكل وشربنا شاي
english: We ate food and drank tea.
transliteration: Akalna akl we sheribna shay.

arabic: خالتي كانت مبسوطة اوي انها شفتنا
english: My aunt was very happy that she saw us.
transliteration: Khalti kanet mabsoota awi ennaha shaafitna.

arabic: كان يوم جميل مع العيلة
english: It was a beautiful day with the family.
transliteration: Kan yawm gameel ma' el-'ayla.

arabic: الدنيا بتمطر كتير برا البيت
english: It's raining a lot outside the house.
transliteration: El donya betmatar kteer barra el beit.

arabic: انا قاعد في البيت ومبسوط انا من القاهرة
english: I am sitting at home and happy. I am from Cairo.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed fel beit we mabsoot. Ana min el Qahera.

arabic: اسمي عمر وبحب المطر
english: My name is Omar and I love the rain.
transliteration: Esmi Omar we bahebb el matar.

arabic: شفت قطتي الصغيرة وسألتها انت منين
english: I saw my little cat and asked her, "Where are you from?"
transliteration: Shoft qotteti el soghayyara we sa'altaha enti min fein?

arabic: القطة بصتلي بس وماردتش
english: The cat just looked at me and didn't reply.
transliteration: El qotta bassetli bass we ma raddetsh.

arabic: وصلت الكافيه بدري عشان اقابل صاحبتي سارة
english: I arrived at the cafe early to meet my friend Sarah.
transliteration: Waṣalt el-kaafīh badri 3ashaan aqabel ṣāḥibti Saara
storyTitle: The Cafe Appointment That Never Ends

arabic: قعدت استناها اكتر من نص ساعة وهي لسه مجتش
english: I waited for her for more than half an hour and she still hadn't come.
transliteration: Qa3adt estannaha aktar men noṣṣ saa3a we hiyya lessa ma gatsh
storyTitle: The Cafe Appointment That Never Ends

arabic: طلبت قهوة زيادة سكر عشان اعرف اصحصح وانا مستني
english: I ordered coffee with extra sugar so I could stay awake while waiting.
transliteration: Ṭalabt ahwa ziyaada sokkar 3ashaan a3raf aṣaḥṣaḥ wana mestanni
storyTitle: The Cafe Appointment That Never Ends

arabic: شكلها فاكرة اني خالها ومش مستعجل على حاجة
english: It seems she thinks I'm her maternal uncle and not in a hurry for anything.
transliteration: Shaklaha fakra enni khaalha we mesh mista3gel 3ala ḥaaga
storyTitle: The Cafe Appointment That Never Ends

arabic: اخيرا شفتها جاية وبتضحك كانها معملتش حاجة غلط
english: Finally, I saw her coming and laughing as if she hadn't done anything wrong.
transliteration: Akheeran shoftaha gayya we betḍaḥḥak ka'ennaha ma3melitsh ḥaaga ghalaṭ
storyTitle: The Cafe Appointment That Never Ends

arabic: امي وانا بنخطط لحفلة كبيرة في البيت
english: My mother and I are planning a big party at home.
transliteration: Ommy w ana benkhattat le hafla kibeera fel bayt.

arabic: بنحب الفاكهة والخضار اوي عشان كده لازم نشتري كتير
english: We love fruit and vegetables a lot so we must buy a lot.
transliteration: Benhebb el fakha wel khodaar awy ashan keda lazim neshtary keteer.

arabic: يلا بينا على السوق عشان نجيب كل حاجة
english: Let's go to the market to get everything.
transliteration: Yalla bena ala el soo' ashan nigeeb kol haga.

arabic: سألت البياع بكام المانجة دي كلها
english: I asked the seller how much all these mangoes were.
transliteration: Sa'alt el bayyaa' bekam el manga di kolaha.

arabic: امي ضحكت وقالت الحفلة الكبيرة دي هتخلينا نفلس
english: My mother laughed and said 'This big party will make us broke!'
transliteration: Ommy daheket w 'alet el hafla el kibeera di hatkhalina neflis.

arabic: النهاردة الصبح وانا نازل شفت جارتي ام احمد على السلم سلمت عليها
english: This morning as I was going down, I saw my neighbor Umm Ahmed on the stairs and greeted her.
transliteration: Ennaharda eṣ-ṣobḥ wana nāzel shoft gārti Omm Aḥmed ʿala s-sollem sallamt ʿalēha

arabic: قالت لي صباح الخير يا استاذ عامل ايه سمعت ان في مرشح جديد جاي المنطقة
english: She told me "Good morning, teacher, how are you? I heard there's a new candidate coming to the area."
transliteration: Qāletli "Sabāḥ el-khēr ya ostāz ʿāmel ēh? Semeʿt en fī morashshaḥ gedīd gāy el-minṭaqa."

arabic: رديت عليها ايوه صحيح الاحزاب السياسية بتقدم مرشحين كتير للانتخابات الجاية
english: I replied to her "Yes, that's right, political parties are presenting many candidates for the upcoming elections."
transliteration: Raddēt ʿalēha "Aywa ṣaḥīḥ el-aḥzāb as-sīyāsīya betʾaddem morashshaḥīn ketīr lel-entikhābāt el-gāyya."

arabic: هي سألتني تفتكر مين هيكسب وهل رئيس الجمهورية الحالي هيترشح تاني
english: She asked me "Who do you think will win and will the current President of the Republic run again?"
transliteration: Heyya saʾaletni "Teftiker mīn hayeksab w hal raʾīs el-gomhūrīya el-ḥāli hayetrashshaḥ tāni?"

arabic: قلت لها ده كله هيتحدد لما الناس تنزل تعمل تصويت وتختار اللي شايفاه مناسب للحكم
english: I told her "All of this will be determined when people go down to vote and choose who they see as suitable for governance."
transliteration: Oltelha "Da kollo hayetḥaddad lamma en-nās tenzel teʿmel taṣwīt w tekhtār elli shāyfāh monāseb lel-ḥokm."

arabic: انا كنت ماشي للماركت
english: I was walking to the market.
transliteration: Ana kont maashi lel-market.

arabic: انا تهت ومش عارف الماركت فين
english: I got lost and don't know where the market is.
transliteration: Ana tehet w mish aref el-market feen.

arabic: سالت راجل لو سمحت الماركت هنا ولا بعيد
english: I asked a man: 'Excuse me, is the market here or far?'
transliteration: Sa'alt ragel: 'Law samaht, el-market hena walla ba'eed?'

arabic: هو قال الماركت مش بعيد امشي طوالي وبعدين يمين
english: He said: 'The market is not far, go straight then right.'
transliteration: Howwa 'al: 'El-market mish ba'eed, emshi tawali w ba'dein yemeen.'

arabic: انا قلت شكرا جزيلا ليك
english: I said: 'Thank you very much.'
transliteration: Ana olt: 'Shukran jazeelan leek.'

arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع امبارح
english: I was walking in the street yesterday.
transliteration: Kunt maashy fi esh-shaare' imbaarih

arabic: فجأة شفت واحد صاحبي قديم
english: Suddenly, I saw an old friend of mine.
transliteration: Faga'a shoft waahed saaHby 'adeem

arabic: انا قلت له اهلا ازيك عامل ايه
english: I told him "Hello, how are you doing?"
transliteration: Ana 'ultilu ahlan izzayyak 'aamil eh

arabic: هو قال لي انا كويس الحمد لله وانت عامل ايه
english: He told me "I am good, thank God, and how are you doing?"
transliteration: Huwwa 'aal-li ana kwayyis el-Hamdulillah wenta 'aamil eh

arabic: انا كنت مبسوط اوي اني شفته
english: I was very happy that I saw him.
transliteration: Ana kunt mabsooT 'awi inni shoftu

arabic: انا بزور خالتي كل اسبوع
english: I visit my aunt every week.
transliteration: Ana bazoor khalti koll osboo'

arabic: بيتها قديم وجميل
english: Her house is old and beautiful.
transliteration: Beit-ha adeem w gameel

arabic: هي بتحب تتفرج على التلفزيون القديم
english: She likes to watch the old TV.
transliteration: Hiyya bithebb tetfarag 'ala el-telefizyoon el-adeem

arabic: انا بحب العب على الموبايل الجديد بتاعي
english: I like to play on my new phone.
transliteration: Ana bahebb al'ab 'ala el-mobayl el-gideed beta'i

arabic: بس احنا بنتبسط اوي مع بعض
english: But we enjoy ourselves a lot together.
transliteration: Bas ehna benetbasat awi ma' ba'd

arabic: صباح الخير يا جار عامل ايه
english: Good morning neighbor how are you
transliteration: Sabah el kheir ya gar a'amel eh

arabic: صباح النور انا كويس عندي قهوة شاي وعصير تحب ايه
english: Good morning I'm good I have coffee tea and juice What do you like
transliteration: Sabah el noor ana kwayes a'andy ahwa shay wa a'seer teheb eh

arabic: ممكن قهوة لو سمحت
english: Coffee please
transliteration: Mumkin ahwa law samaht

arabic: تمام قهوة سادة ولا سكر زيادة
english: Okay black coffee or extra sugar
transliteration: Tamam ahwa sada wala sokkar ziada

arabic: قهوة مظبوط لو سمحت
english: Coffee with medium sugar please
transliteration: Ahwa mazboot law samaht

arabic: صباح الخير انا روحت الشغل بدري
english: Good morning I went to work early
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ana rooht el-shoghl badri

arabic: شفت زميلي احمد وقولتله ازيك
english: I saw my colleague Ahmed and said to him how are you
transliteration: Shoft zameeli Ahmad w oltelo ezzayak

arabic: احمد قالي الحمد لله انا كويس
english: Ahmed said to me thank God I am good
transliteration: Ahmad 'ali el-hamdu lellah ana kwayyes

arabic: قعدت على مكتبي واشتغلت على الكمبيوتر
english: I sat at my desk and worked on the computer
transliteration: 'A'adt 'ala maktabi w eshtaghlt 'ala el-computer

arabic: شربت قهوة وقريت كتاب صغير
english: I drank coffee and read a small book
transliteration: Sheribt 'ahwa w 'areet ketab saghir

arabic: انا كنت ماشي في الشارع وشفت صاحبي القديم احمد
english: I was walking in the street and saw my old friend Ahmed.
transliteration: Ana kont mashi fi el share' w shoft sahby el adim Ahmed.

arabic: كان شكله متغير شوية ولابس هدوم جديدة
english: He looked a bit different and was wearing new clothes.
transliteration: Kan shaklo motghayyer shwaya w labes hedoom gedida.

arabic: انا عندي قهوة شاي وعصير تحب تشرب ايه
english: I have coffee, tea, and juice. What do you like to drink?
transliteration: Ana a'andy ahwa shay w a'seer teheb tishrab eh?

arabic: احمد قال لي انا عايز قهوة بس خمسين جنيه هو سعر القهوة دلوقتي
english: Ahmed told me: 'I want coffee, but is fifty pounds the price of coffee now?'
transliteration: Ahmed al li ana a'ayez ahwa bas khamsin geneh howa sa'r el ahwa delwa'ty?

arabic: ابتسمت وقلت له ايوه يا احمد كل حاجة اتغيرت
english: I smiled and told him: 'Yes, Ahmed, everything has changed.'
transliteration: Ebtasamt w oltelo aywa ya Ahmed kol haga etghayyaret.

arabic: احنا بنخطط لفرح كبير
english: We are planning a big wedding
transliteration: Ehna benkhatet lefarah kabeer

arabic: اول حاجة هنختار قاعة حلوة
english: First, we will choose a nice hall
transliteration: Awal haga hanekhtar qa'a helwa

arabic: ماما هتساعد في الاكل
english: Mom will help with the food
transliteration: Mama hatasa'ed fel akl

arabic: وهنعزم العيلة والاصحاب
english: And we will invite the family and friends
transliteration: Wahan3azem el 3eila wel ashab

arabic: هيكون يوم سعيد جدا
english: It will be a very happy day
transliteration: Haykoon yom sa3eed geddan

arabic: الصبح بدري جدي بيصحى
english: Early in the morning, my grandpa wakes up.
transliteration: El-sobḥ badri gaddi biyisḥa

arabic: هو لابس جلابية بيضا وحلوة
english: He is wearing a white and nice galabeya.
transliteration: Howwa labes galabeyya beyḍa we ḥelwa

arabic: انا بصحى بعده وعايز البس بسرعة
english: I wake up after him and want to get dressed quickly.
transliteration: Ana basḥa baʿdo we ʿayez albes besorʿa

arabic: انا لابس قميص ازرق وبنطلون اسود
english: I am wearing a blue shirt and black pants.
transliteration: Ana labes amees azraʾ we bantaloon aswad

arabic: جدي بيقول صباح الخير يا ابني الشغل ده مهم
english: My grandpa says 'Good morning, my son, this work is important.'
transliteration: Gaddi biyʾool ṣabaḥ el-kheir ya ebny esh-shoġl da mohem

arabic: النهاردة كلمت صاحبتي منار في التليفون عشان اطمن عليها
english: Today I called my friend Manar on the phone to check on her
transliteration: Elnaharda kallimt saḥibtī Manar fī eltelifōn 3ashan aṭammen 3alēha

arabic: هي بتحب تتكلم كتير على عكس الشباب اللي بيفضلوا الرسايل السريعة
english: She loves to talk a lot, unlike young people who prefer quick messages
transliteration: Heyya betḥebb tetkallim kitīr 3ala 3aks esh-shabāb ellī befaḍḍalū er-rasāyel es-sarī3a

arabic: قالتلي انها كانت بتزور جدتها امبارح وحكتلي عن يومهم كله بالتفصيل
english: She told me she was visiting her grandmother yesterday and told me about their whole day in detail
transliteration: Qālitlī innaha kānet betzūr giddetha imbāreḥ waḥaketlī 3an yōmuhom kulluh bi-t-tafṣīl

arabic: انا بستغرب ازاي ممكن الناس تقعد ساعات تتكلم عن كل حاجة صغيرة
english: I wonder how people can sit for hours talking about every small thing
transliteration: Ana bastaghreb izzay mumkin en-nās tiq3od sā3āt tetkallim 3an kull ḥāga ṣughayyara

arabic: جيلنا بيحب ينجز الكلام بسرعة ومش بنلاقي وقت للمكالمات الطويلة زي زمان
english: Our generation likes to get to the point quickly and we don't find time for long calls like before
transliteration: Gīlna beḥebb yingiz elkalām besur3a wamish benlāʾī waʾt lel-mukālamāt eṭ-ṭawīla zayy zamān

arabic: انا بمسك التليفون بتاعي
english: I pick up my phone.
transliteration: Ana bamsik el-telefoon beta'i.

arabic: الو ازيك يا صاحبي عامل ايه
english: Hello, how are you my friend, how are you doing?
transliteration: Allo ezzayak ya sahby aamel eh?

arabic: هو رد وقال الحمد لله كله تمام
english: He replied and said praise be to God, everything is fine.
transliteration: Howwa radd we 'al alhamdulillah kollo tamam.

arabic: احنا بنتكلم شوية عن اليوم بتاعنا
english: We talk a little about our day.
transliteration: Ehna benetkallem shwayya 'an el-yoom beta'na.

arabic: بعدين قلنا مع السلامة وقفلنا المكالمة
english: Then we said goodbye and ended the call.
transliteration: Ba'dein olna ma'a salama we 'afelna el-mokallama.

arabic: النهاردة حضرتكوا منورين البيت عشان الغدا الكبير بتاعنا
english: Today, you all are lighting up the house for our big lunch.
transliteration: Elnaharda 7adaratkoo menawwarin elbeit 3ashan elghada elkebeer beta3na

arabic: ماما عملت اكل مصري مشهور جدا وعليه صلصة رهيبة
english: Mom made very famous Egyptian food with a terrific sauce.
transliteration: Mama 3amalet akl masry mashhoor geddan w 3aleih salsa raheeba

arabic: خالي قال خليهم يحطوا مخلل كتير عشان الاكل يبقى احلى
english: My uncle said, "Let them put a lot of pickles so the food becomes tastier."
transliteration: Khali 2al khaleehom ya7ottu mekhalel keteer 3ashan elakl yeb2a a7la

arabic: وبعد اول لقمة تيتا قالت الاكل ده هتعجبك بيها جدا
english: And after the first bite, Grandma said, "You will really like this food with it."
transliteration: W ba3d awwal lo2ma teeta 2alet elakl da hat3agebek beeha geddan

arabic: الكل ضحك وقال ده يوم عظيم ومش هننساه ابدا
english: Everyone laughed and said, "This is a great day and we will never forget it."
transliteration: Elkol de7ek w 2al da yom 3azeem w mesh hanensah abadan

arabic: كان الجو بيمطر كتير النهارده بعد الضهر
english: It was raining a lot this afternoon.
transliteration: Kan el gaw beyemattar kiteer ennaharda ba'd el dohr.

arabic: كل العيلة كانت قاعدة في البيت
english: The whole family was sitting at home.
transliteration: Koll el 'eila kanet 'a'da fel beet.

arabic: البيت كان دافي ومريح جدا
english: The house was very warm and comfortable.
transliteration: El beet kan dafi we mureeh geddan.

arabic: ماما قالت لبنتها أهلاً بيكي يا حبيبتي إزيكِ
english: Mom said to her daughter: Welcome my dear, how are you?
transliteration: Mama 'alet le benteha: Ahlan beeki ya habibti, izzayyik?

arabic: البنت ردت أنا كويسة الحمد لله يا ماما
english: The daughter replied: I'm good, praise be to God, Mom.
transliteration: El bent raddet: Ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah ya Mama.

arabic: انا بصحى الصبح والمطبخ مش نظيف
english: I wake up in the morning and the kitchen is not clean
transliteration: Ana basHa el sobh wel matbakh mish naddif

arabic: فيه مشكلة كبيرة اطباق كتير قذرة
english: There is a big problem many dirty dishes
transliteration: Fih mushkila kebira atba' keteir qazra

arabic: انا عايز اغسل الاطباق دي دلوقتي
english: I want to wash these dishes now
transliteration: Ana ayiz aghsil el atba' di delwa'ti

arabic: بس مفيش صابون في البيت
english: But there is no soap in the house
transliteration: Bas mafish saboon fel beit

arabic: لازم اشتري صابون جديد علشان اغسل
english: I need to buy new soap to wash
transliteration: Lazem ashtri saboon gedid 'alashan aghsil

arabic: انا عايز هدوم جديدة
english: I want new clothes
transliteration: Ana ayiz hudum gedida

arabic: انا رحت السوق امبارح
english: I went to the market yesterday
transliteration: Ana roht es-souq embareh

arabic: انا شفت قميص حلو وبنطلون
english: I saw a nice shirt and pants
transliteration: Ana shoft amees helw w bantaloon

arabic: انا اشتريتهم وروحت البيت
english: I bought them and went home
transliteration: Ana eshtaraituhom w rowwaht el-beit

arabic: بس القميص كان لقطة
english: But the shirt was for a cat
transliteration: Bass el-amees kaan leqitta

arabic: عندنا مشكلة في البيت الوايفاي مش شغال خالص
english: We have a problem at home, the Wi-Fi is not working at all.
transliteration: 3andina moshkela fel beit el-wifi mesh shaghghal khales

arabic: جدي قال يمكن السلك فيه حاجة لازم نشوفه كويس
english: My grandpa said maybe there's something wrong with the wire, we need to check it well.
transliteration: gaddi 2al yimkin el-selk feeh haga lazim neshofo kwayyes

arabic: لكن انا رديت عليه وقلتله يمكن الراوتر محتاج يتطفي ويتفتح تاني
english: But I responded to him and told him maybe the router needs to be turned off and on again.
transliteration: lakin ana raddeit 3aleih w 2ultelo yimkin el-router mehtag yettafi w yetfeta7 tani

arabic: كان فيه حوار صغير بينا عشان كل واحد عنده فكرة مختلفة
english: There was a small discussion between us because each one had a different idea.
transliteration: kan feeh 7awar soghayyar beina 3ashan koll wa7ed 3ando fekra mokhtalefa

arabic: في الاخر شغلنا الراوتر تاني والوايفاي اشتغل والكل كان مبسوط
english: In the end, we turned the router on again, and the Wi-Fi worked, and everyone was happy.
transliteration: fel akher shaghghalna el-router tani wel-wifi eshtaghal wel-kol kan mabsoot

arabic: سارة وعمر راحوا المحل عشان يشتروا هدوم جديدة
english: Sara and Omar went to the store to buy new clothes
transliteration: Sara w Omar raho el-maḥal 'ashan yeshtaru hedum gedida

arabic: سارة قالت انا عايزة اشتري فستان ازرق
english: Sara said I want to buy a blue dress
transliteration: Sara 'alet ana 'ayza ashtry fostan azra'

arabic: عمر شاف بنطلون اسود وقال انا عايز اشتري بنطلون اسود ده
english: Omar saw black pants and said I want to buy these black pants
transliteration: Omar shaf bantaloon aswad w 'al ana 'ayez ashtry bantaloon aswad da

arabic: سارة بصت على الفستان وقالت الفستان ده حلو اوي
english: Sara looked at the dress and said this dress is very beautiful
transliteration: Sara baṣṣet 'ala el-fostan w 'alet el-fostan da ḥelw awi

arabic: عمر قال البنطلون ده مش غالي خالص
english: Omar said these pants are not expensive at all
transliteration: Omar 'al el-bantaloon da mesh ghaly khaleṣ

arabic: انا عايز اشتري هدوم جديدة
english: I want to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Ana ayiz ashtary hedoom gedeeda

arabic: رحت محل كبير في السوق
english: I went to a big store in the market.
transliteration: Roht mahal kabeer fel sooq

arabic: شفت قميص ازرق جميل
english: I saw a beautiful blue shirt.
transliteration: Shoft qamees azraq gameel

arabic: سألت البياع بكام القميص ده
english: I asked the seller, 'How much is this shirt?'
transliteration: Sa'alt el bayya' be kam el qamees da

arabic: قال لي انه غالي شوية قلت شكرا
english: He told me it was a bit expensive, I said 'thank you'.
transliteration: Qal li enno ghali showaya olt shokran

arabic: صباح الخير يا جارتي ام احمد ازيك عاملة ايه
english: Good morning, my neighbor Umm Ahmed, how are you?
transliteration: Sabāḥ el-kheir ya gartī Omm Aḥmed ezayyik ʿamla eih?

arabic: زمان كان التصويت ده حاجة مهمة والناس كلها بتشارك عشان تختار رئيس الجمهورية
english: Back in the day, voting was something important, and everyone participated to choose the President of the Republic.
transliteration: Zamān kān et-taṣwīt da ḥaga mohimma w en-nās kolaha betshārek ʿashān tekhtār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya.

arabic: اه دلوقتي الاحزاب السياسية بتقدم مرشحين كتير والشباب مش مهتم زي زمان
english: Ah, nowadays political parties present many candidates, and young people aren't as interested as before.
transliteration: Ah delwaʾti el-aḥzāb as-sīyāsīya betaʾaddem morashshaḥīn ketīr w esh-shabāb mesh mohtamm zayy zamān.

arabic: بس زمان كان فيه احساس تاني بالحكم وان البلد دي بتاعتنا كلنا مش مجرد احزاب وخلاص
english: But back then there was a different feeling about governance, and that this country was all ours, not just parties and that's it.
transliteration: Bas zamān kān fīh eḥsās tānī bel-ḥokm w en el-balad dī betaʿetna kollena mesh mogarrad aḥzāb w khalas.

arabic: عندك حق يا ام احمد الاجيال بتتغير والافكار كمان
english: You're right, Umm Ahmed, generations change and so do ideas.
transliteration: ʿAndik ḥaqq ya Omm Aḥmed el-agyāl bettaghayyar w el-afkār kamān.

arabic: انا عايز اشتري هدوم جديدة
english: I want to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Ana 'ayiz ashtari hudum gedida.

arabic: رحت السوق مع صاحبي امبارح
english: I went to the market with my friend yesterday.
transliteration: Ruht el souq ma'a sahbi imbareh.

arabic: لقيت تي شيرت كبير اوي لونه احمر
english: I found a very big red t-shirt.
transliteration: La'et teeshirt kebir awi lohnoh ahmar.

arabic: لما لبسته كان شكله عليا زي خيمة
english: When I wore it, it looked like a tent on me.
transliteration: Lamma labastoh, kan shakloh 'alayya zayy kheima.

arabic: ضحكت كتير واشتريت بنطلون صغير لوني المفضل
english: I laughed a lot and bought small pants in my favorite color.
transliteration: Dihikt kiteer w ashtarayt bantaloun soghayar lohni el mufaddal.

arabic: الصبح بدري صحيت وفطرت فول وطعمية زي العادة
english: Early in the morning I woke up and had ful and ta'ameya for breakfast as usual
transliteration: El Sobh badri saHit we fatart fool we ta3meya zay el 3ada

arabic: في الشغل قابلت صاحبتي مروة وسلمت عليها بحرارة
english: At work I met my friend Marwa and greeted her warmly
transliteration: Fi esh-shoghl qabelt saHibtī Marwa we sallimt 3aleha bi-Harara

arabic: شربنا الشاي سوا واتكلمنا شوية عن اخبار عمّها اللي مسافر
english: We drank tea together and talked a bit about the news of her uncle who is traveling
transliteration: Sheribna esh-shay sawa we tkallimna shwaya 3an akhbar 3ammha elli msafer

arabic: بعدين بدأنا شغلنا ومروة ساعدتني في مشروع جديد كان صعب شوية
english: Then we started our work and Marwa helped me with a new project that was a bit difficult
transliteration: Ba3dein bada'na shoghlina we Marwa sa3adetni fi mashroo3 gedid kan sa3b shwaya

arabic: لما اليوم خلص ودعت صاحبتي وروحت البيت اريح شوية قبل ما اشوف جدتي
english: When the day finished, I said goodbye to my friend and went home to rest a bit before seeing my grandmother
transliteration: Lamma el youm khilis wadda3t saHibtī we rowwaHt el beit areyyaH shwaya qabl ma ashoof gaddeti

arabic: انا وصاحبي روحنا ماتش كورة
english: My friend and I went to a football match.
transliteration: Ana we sahby rohna match koora

arabic: الفريق بتاعي كان بيلعب كويس
english: My team was playing well.
transliteration: El faree' beta'y kan beyel'ab kwayyes

arabic: كلنا كنا عايزين جون
english: We all wanted a goal.
transliteration: Kollena konna ayzeen goon

arabic: لاعب جاب جون حلو اوي
english: A player scored a very nice goal.
transliteration: La'eb gab goon helw awy

arabic: بس بعد الماتش عرفنا ان دي مش كورة حقيقية
english: But after the match, we knew that this wasn't a real ball.
transliteration: Bas ba'd el match 'erefna en dee mesh koora haqee'eya

arabic: يا عمو، صباح الخير، عامل إيه؟ قالت هدى بسرعة.
english: Oh uncle, good morning, how are you? Hoda said quickly.
transliteration: Ya 'ammu, sabah el-kheir, 'amel eh? Qalet Hoda be-sor'a.

arabic: صباح النور يا بنتي، أنا تمام. إزيك؟ رد البياع.
english: Good morning, my daughter, I'm fine. How are you? replied the vendor.
transliteration: Sabah el-nour ya benti, ana tamam. Ezzayek? Rad el-bayya'.

arabic: الحمد لله، معلش يا عمو، شارع الدقي فين؟ سألت هدى.
english: Thank God, excuse me uncle, where is Dokki Street? Hoda asked.
transliteration: El-hamd lellah, ma'lesh ya 'ammu, share' el-Doqqi fein? Sa'alet Hoda.

arabic: أهلاً بيكي، الدقي شمالك هنا بالظبط! قال عمو بابتسامة.
english: Welcome, Dokki is exactly to your left here! said uncle with a smile.
transliteration: Ahlan biki, el-Doqqi shemalek hena bel-zabt! Qal 'ammu be-ebtesama.

arabic: شكراً يا عمو، مع السلامة! قالت هدى وجريت.
english: Thank you, uncle, goodbye! Hoda said and ran.
transliteration: Shukran ya 'ammu, ma'a el-salama! Qalet Hoda we-gereet.

arabic: النهاردة انا زرت خالتي
english: Today I visited my maternal aunt.
transliteration: El-nahardah ana zort khalti

arabic: هي كانت فرحانة قوي لما شافتني
english: She was very happy when she saw me.
transliteration: Heya kanet farhana awi lamma shafetny

arabic: شربنا شاي سوا واتكلمنا كتير
english: We drank tea together and talked a lot.
transliteration: Sheribna shay sawa wetkallemna keteer

arabic: بيتها دايما مليان دفء وحب
english: Her house is always full of warmth and love.
transliteration: Beitha dayman malyan def' we hob

arabic: قضينا وقت جميل ومبسوطة اني روحت
english: We spent a beautiful time and I'm happy I went.
transliteration: Addina wa't gameel we mabsoota enny rowaht

arabic: انا رحت المحل امبارح
english: I went to the shop yesterday.
transliteration: Ana roht el mahal embareh.

arabic: كان عندي قميص كبير عايز ارجعه
english: I had a big shirt I wanted to return.
transliteration: Kan a'andy amees kebir aayez aragga'oh.

arabic: صاحب المحل كان كويس جدا
english: The shop owner was very kind.
transliteration: Saheb el mahal kan kwayyes geddan.

arabic: خد القميص و اداني قميص تاني صغير
english: He took the shirt and gave me another small shirt.
transliteration: Khad el amees w eddany amees tany soghayyar.

arabic: انا كنت مبسوط اوي بالقميص الجديد
english: I was very happy with the new shirt.
transliteration: Ana kont mabsoot awi bel amees el gedeed.

arabic: انا ماشي في الشارع وفجأة حسيت اني تايه
english: I was walking in the street and suddenly I felt that I was lost.
transliteration: Ana mashi fi el share' w faga'a hasset enny tayeh

arabic: شفت راجل كبير وقولت له معلش ممكن تساعدني
english: I saw an old man and told him "Excuse me, can you help me?"
transliteration: Shoft ragel kibeer w oltelo ma'lesh mumkin tisa'idni

arabic: انا عايز اروح المتحف فين هو لو سمحت
english: I want to go to the museum, where is it please?
transliteration: Ana 'ayez arooh el mat7af feen howa law samaht

arabic: الراجل قالي امشي طوالي وبعدين لف يمين عند الاشارة
english: The man told me "Walk straight and then turn right at the traffic light."
transliteration: El ragel 'aly emshi tawali w ba'deen leff yameen 'and el ishara

arabic: قولت له شكرا جزيلا مبتسم وهو رد العفو
english: I told him "Thank you very much" smiling, and he replied "You're welcome."
transliteration: Oltelo shukran gazilan mobtasem w howa radd el 'afw

arabic: الويك اند قرب وانا عايز اسافر
english: The weekend is close and I want to travel.
transliteration: El week end arrab w ana ayez asafer.

arabic: ممكن نروح اسكندرية نشرب قهوة على البحر
english: Maybe we can go to Alexandria to drink coffee by the sea.
transliteration: Mumkin nerouh Eskendereyya neshrab ahwa ala el bahr.

arabic: هناك عندي قهوة وشاي وعصير تحب إيه لما نوصل
english: There, I have coffee, tea, and juice, what do you like when we arrive?
transliteration: Henak a'andy ahwa w shay w a'seer teheb eh lamma nowsal.

arabic: اكيد هطلب قهوة مظبوط
english: Certainly I will order coffee with medium sugar.
transliteration: Akid hatlob ahwa mazboot.

arabic: وعارف ان خمسين جنيه هو سعر القهوة هناك
english: And I know that fifty pounds is the price of coffee there.
transliteration: W a'aref en khamsin geneh howa sa'r el ahwa henakk.

arabic: وصلت بيت عمتي متأخر شوية
english: I arrived at my aunt's house a bit late.
transliteration: Waṣalt beyt ʿammati metaʾakhkhar shwayya.

arabic: قلت انا آسف على التأخير لكل العيلة
english: I said 'I'm sorry for the delay' to the whole family.
transliteration: Oult 'Ana āsef ʿala et-taʾkhīr' le koll el-ʿeila.

arabic: كلنا قعدنا ناكل اكل حلو اوي
english: We all sat down to eat very delicious food.
transliteration: Kollena qaʿadnā nākul akl ḥelw awi.

arabic: اخويا قال فكرة حلوة وانا قلت انا موافق على الفكرة دي
english: My brother said a good idea and I said 'I agree with this idea'.
transliteration: Akhūya qāl fekra ḥelwa w ana oult 'Ana mowāfeʾ ʿala el-fekrah di'.

arabic: بعد الاكل انا سألت فين الحمام
english: After eating, I asked 'Where is the bathroom?'
transliteration: Baʿd el-akl ana saʾalt 'Fēn el-ḥammām?'

arabic: كان يوم مطر جدا امبارح بعد الضهر وانا قاعدة في البيت
english: It was a very rainy day yesterday afternoon, and I was sitting at home
transliteration: Kan yom matar geddan embarah ba3d el-dohr wana 2a3da fel-beit

arabic: سمعت صوت الباب خبط ففتحت لقيت صاحبتي سارة واقفه
english: I heard the door knock, so I opened it and found my friend Sara standing there
transliteration: Seme3t sot el-bab khabbat fa-fata7t la2eit sa7ebty Sara wa2fa

arabic: سارة قالت الدنيا بتمطر جامد اوي ممكن ادخل فرديت عليها طبعا اتفضلي
english: Sara said 'It's raining very heavily, may I come in?' and I responded 'Of course, please come in'
transliteration: Sara 2alet 'el-donya be-tmatar gamed awy momken adkhol' fa-raddeit 3aleha 'tab3an etfaddaly'

arabic: قعدنا نعمل حوار عن الجو وخططنا لباقي اليوم
english: We sat down to have a conversation about the weather and our plans for the rest of the day
transliteration: 2a3adna ne3mel 7awar 3an el-gaww we-khattatna le-ba2y el-yom

arabic: هي كانت بتحاول تتكلم عربي والنطق بتاعها كان لسه ناقصه شوية تدريب
english: She was trying to speak Arabic, and her pronunciation was still missing a bit of practice
transliteration: Heya kanet be-t7awel tetkallem 3araby wel-not2 beta3ha kan lessa na2so shwayet tadrib

arabic: ليلى صحيت الصبح ودخلت المطبخ عشان تفطر
english: Layla woke up in the morning and entered the kitchen to have breakfast.
transliteration: Layla saheet el-sobh we dakhalet el-matbakh 'ashan teftarr

arabic: لقت التلاجة عطلانة وكل الاكل باظ
english: She found the fridge broken and all the food spoiled.
transliteration: La'at el-talaga 'atlana we koll el-akl baz

arabic: كانت زعلانة قوي ومش عارفة تعمل ايه دلوقتي
english: She was very upset and didn't know what to do now.
transliteration: Kanet za'lana 'awee we mesh 'arfa te'mel eh delwa'ti

arabic: فكرت تتصل بصديقتها نادية عشان تساعدها تلاقي حد يصلحها
english: She thought about calling her friend Nadia to help her find someone to fix it.
transliteration: Fakkaret tettasel be-sadee'etha Nadia 'ashan tesa'edha tela'i hadd yeslahha

arabic: يمكن نادية تعرف فني كويس يجي بسرعة
english: Maybe Nadia knows a good technician who can come quickly.
transliteration: Yomken Nadia te'raf fanni kowayyes yeegy be-sor'a

arabic: النهاردة الصبح انا كنت مبسوطة اوي عشان رايحة المدرسة
english: This morning I was very happy because I was going to school
transliteration: El naharda el sobh ana kont mabsoota awy 3ashan ray7a el madrasa

arabic: كان عندنا امتحان عربي وصعب شوية
english: We had an Arabic exam and it was a bit difficult
transliteration: Kan 3andena emte7an 3araby w sa3b shwaya

arabic: بعد الامتحان حسيت اني تعبانة وكنت عاوزة اسمع مزيكا
english: After the exam, I felt tired and wanted to listen to music
transliteration: Ba3d el emte7an 7asseit enny ta3bana w kont 3awza asma3 mazika

arabic: صاحبتي قالت لي احنا بنحب نقرا كتب سوا في المكتبة
english: My friend told me, 'We like to read books together in the library.'
transliteration: Sa7ebty 'alet ly e7na ben7ebb ne'ra kotob sawa fel maktaba

arabic: في وقت فراغي انا بحب اتفرج على افلام عشان اكون مبسوطة
english: In my free time, I like to watch movies to be happy
transliteration: Fi wa't faraġy ana ba7ebb atfarraġ 3ala aflam 3ashan akoun mabsoota

arabic: اليوم مفيش خضار ولا فاكهة في البيت
english: Today there are no vegetables or fruit in the house
transliteration: El-youm mafeesh khodaar wala fakha fe el-bayt

arabic: انا زعلان اوي وامي كمان كانت قلقانة
english: I was very sad and my mother was also worried
transliteration: Ana za'laan awy w ommy kamaan kanet al'ana

arabic: امي قالت احنا بنحب ناكل اكل صحي
english: My mother said we love to eat healthy food
transliteration: Ommy alet ehna benhebb nakol akl sehhy

arabic: يلا نروح السوق الكبير عشان نشتري كل حاجة
english: Let's go to the big market to buy everything
transliteration: Yalla nrouh el-soo' el-kibeer 'ashan neshtary kol haga

arabic: انا مبسوط اوي دلوقتي وهنشتري فاكهة وخضار كتير
english: I am very happy now and we will buy a lot of fruit and vegetables
transliteration: Ana mabsoot awy delwa'ty we haneshtary fakha w khodaar keteer

arabic: انا كنت بمشي في الشارع النهاردة
english: I was walking in the street today.
transliteration: Ana kont bamtshy fel share' el naharda

arabic: شفت صاحب قديم
english: I saw an old friend.
transliteration: Shuft saheb adeem

arabic: قلت له ازيك
english: I said to him 'How are you?'
transliteration: Oltelo ezzayak

arabic: هو قال انا تمام شكرا
english: He said 'I'm fine, thank you.'
transliteration: Howa al ana tamam shukran

arabic: بس هو كان قطة
english: But he was a cat!
transliteration: Bas howa kan qotta

arabic: النهاردة كان اول يوم شغل ليا في شركة جديدة
english: Today was my first day at a new company.
transliteration: Elnaharda kaan awwal yom shoġl leya fi sharika gedida.
storyTitle: A Day at Work: Different Generations

arabic: صاحبة المكتب اللي قاعدة جنبي اسمها مدام فاطمة وهي اكبر مني بكتير
english: My desk companion sitting next to me is Madam Fatma, and she is much older than me.
transliteration: Ṣāḥibet elmaktab elli qa3da gambi esmaha Madame Fatma we heya akbar menni bikteer.
storyTitle: A Day at Work: Different Generations

arabic: هي بتفضل تكتب كل حاجة في ورق وانا بستخدم الكمبيوتر والتليفون لكل حاجة
english: She prefers to write everything on paper, while I use the computer and phone for everything.
transliteration: Heya bitfaḍḍal tektib kol ḥaga fi waraq wana bastaḫdem elkombuytar wettelifoun lekoll ḥaga.
storyTitle: A Day at Work: Different Generations

arabic: قالت لي ان جدّها كان بيشتغل كده زمان وانه مكنش يعرف يعني ايه ايميل
english: She told me that her grandfather used to work like that a long time ago and that he didn't know what an email was.
transliteration: Qalet li en gaddaha kaan biyeshtaġal keda zaman we enno makansh ya3raf ya3ni eh email.
storyTitle: A Day at Work: Different Generations

arabic: مع اننا مختلفين بس بنتعلم من بعض كل يوم في الشغل
english: Even though we are different, we learn from each other every day at work.
transliteration: Ma3 ennena moḫtalefin bass binta3allam men ba3ḍ kol yom fi eshshoġl.
storyTitle: A Day at Work: Different Generations

arabic: انا بصحى بدري كل يوم الصبح
english: I wake up early every morning.
transliteration: Ana bas7a badri koll yom el sob7.

arabic: بروح الشغل الساعة تمانية
english: I go to work at eight o'clock.
transliteration: Baro7 el shoghl el sa3a tamanya.

arabic: بشتغل كتير هناك
english: I work a lot there.
transliteration: Bashtaghal kiteer henāk.

arabic: بعدين بخلص شغل الساعة خمسة
english: Then I finish work at five o'clock.
transliteration: Ba3dein bakhalas shoghl el sa3a khamsa.

arabic: برجع البيت بالليل
english: I return home in the evening.
transliteration: Barga3 el beit bel leil.

arabic: لمبة المطبخ مش شغالة ماما زعلانة جدا
english: The kitchen lightbulb isn't working. Mom is very upset.
transliteration: Lombet el-maṭbakh mesh shaghghāla. Mama zaʿlāna geddan.

arabic: هي بتقول يا ريت حد يصلحها دلوقتي
english: She says: "I wish someone would fix it now."
transliteration: Heyya bet'ūl: "Ya rēt ḥadd yiṣlaḥha delwaʾti."

arabic: بابا دخل البيت وقال أنا آسف على التأخير أنا ممكن أساعد
english: Dad entered the house and said: "I'm sorry for the delay, I can help."
transliteration: Baba dakhal el-bēt w 'āl: "Ana āsef ʿala et-taʾkhīr, ana momken asāʿed."

arabic: ماما قالت أنا موافقة على الفكرة دي عايزين لمبة جديدة
english: Mom said: "I agree with this idea, we need a new lightbulb."
transliteration: Mama 'ālet: "Ana mowāfeʾa ʿala el-fekrah di, ʿāyzīn lamba gedīda."

arabic: هما راحوا المحل عشان يشتروا لمبة تانية
english: They went to the shop to buy another lightbulb.
transliteration: Homma rāḥū el-maḥall ʿashān yeshtarū lamba tanya.

arabic: صباح الخير يا جارتي شكلك زعلانة النهاردة
english: Good morning, my neighbor, you look sad today.
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya garti, shaklek za'lana ennaharda.

arabic: صباح النور يا ام احمد فيه ايه
english: Good morning, Um Ahmed, what's wrong?
transliteration: Sabah en noor ya om Ahmed, fee eh?

arabic: قطتي الصغيرة ضاعت وملاقيهاش
english: My little cat is lost and I can't find her.
transliteration: Otty es sagheera da'et w mal2ehaash.

arabic: يا حبيبتي متزعليش انا هساعدك ندور عليها
english: Oh dear, don't be sad, I will help you look for her.
transliteration: Ya habeebty matza'aleesh, ana hasa'adek nedawoor 'aleiha.

arabic: ربنا يخليكي ليا يا ام حسن ده كلام يفرح
english: May God bless you, Um Hassan, that's comforting words.
transliteration: Rabbena yekhaleeki leya ya om Hassan, da kalam yefarra7.

arabic: السخان باظ فجأة الصبح
english: The water heater broke down suddenly in the morning.
transliteration: Es-sakhkhaan baaz faga'a es-sobh

arabic: امي زعلت قوي وقالت هنعمل ايه دلوقتي
english: My mother got very upset and said 'What will we do now?'
transliteration: Ommi za3alet awi we alet hanemil eh delwa'ti

arabic: انا وبابا اختلفنا مين يكلم الصنايعي او نحاول نصلحه احنا
english: My father and I differed on who should call the technician or if we should try to fix it ourselves.
transliteration: Ana we baba ikhtalafna min yekallem es-sanaye3i aw nehawel nesalla7oh ehna

arabic: بعد نقاش طويل بابا وافق نطلب الصنايعي
english: After a long discussion, my father agreed to call the technician.
transliteration: Ba3d ne'aash taweel baba wāfiʔ notlob es-sanaye3i

arabic: قال اتمنى الصنايعي يصلحه بسرعة ونرضى بشغله
english: He said 'I hope the technician fixes it quickly and we approve of his work.'
transliteration: 'Aal atamanna es-sanaye3i yesalla7oh besor3a we nerda be shoghluh

arabic: النهاردة امي وانا رحنا السوق الكبير عشان نشتري فاكهة وخضار
english: Today, my mother and I went to the big market to buy fruit and vegetables.
transliteration: Elnaharda ommy w ana rohna el soo' el kibeer ashan neshtary fakha w khodaar

arabic: هناك شفت صاحبي القديم عم حسن كان شكله مختلف اوي
english: There, I saw my old friend, Uncle Hassan, he looked very different.
transliteration: Henak shoft sahby el adeem Amm Hassan kan shaklo mokhtalef awy

arabic: سأل بكام الفاكهة دي دلوقتي وقال كل حاجة كانت ارخص زمان
english: He asked, 'How much is this fruit now?' and said everything was cheaper in the past.
transliteration: Sa'al bekam el fakha di delwa'ty w 'al kol haga kanet arkhas zaman

arabic: انا قولتله احنا بنحب حاجات جديدة لبيتنا وهو بيحب الهدوء وبس
english: I told him we love new things for our house, but he just wants peace and quiet.
transliteration: Ana oltelo ehna benhebb hagaat gedeeda le baytna w howa byhebb el hudoo' w bas

arabic: ضحكنا وفهمنا ان الايام اتغيرت بجد لينا احنا الاتنين
english: We laughed and understood that times have truly changed for us both.
transliteration: Dehekna w fehemna en el ayyam etghayyaret begad leena ehna el etneen

arabic: انا عايزة اشتري هدوم جديدة
english: I want to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Ana ayza ashtiri hodoum gedida.

arabic: النهاردة هروح السوق مع ماما
english: Today I will go to the market with mom.
transliteration: Ennaharda harouh es-souq ma'a mama.

arabic: هناك هنشوف محل كبير للهدوم
english: There we will see a big shop for clothes.
transliteration: Henak hanshouf mahall kibeer lel-hodoum.

arabic: ماما هتسال البياع بكم الفستان ده
english: Mom will ask the seller "how much is this dress?".
transliteration: Mama hatis'al el-bayya' bi-kam el-fostan da.

arabic: بعدين هنشتري فستان جميل وجديد
english: Then we will buy a beautiful and new dress.
transliteration: Ba'dein hanishtiri fostan gameel we gedid.

arabic: انا بروح المدرسة كل يوم
english: I go to school every day.
transliteration: Ana barooh el madrasa kull yom.

arabic: النهارده انا تعبان شوية في الفصل
english: Today I am a little tired in class.
transliteration: El naharda ana ta'baan shwaya fi el fasl.

arabic: زميلي بيضحك كتير وبيقول نكتة
english: My classmate laughs a lot and tells a joke.
transliteration: Zameeli biyedhak keteer w bi'ool nokta.

arabic: بعد المدرسة انا وزميلي بناكل اكل حلو ونشرب قهوة
english: After school, my classmate and I eat good food and drink coffee.
transliteration: Ba'd el madrasa ana w zameeli benakol akl helw w neshrab ahwa.

arabic: انا مبسوط وبقول لزميلي مع السلامة وبروح البيت
english: I am happy and I say goodbye to my classmate and go home.
transliteration: Ana mabsoot w ba'ool li zameeli ma'a salama w barooh el beit.

arabic: صحيت متاخر النهاردة الصبح
english: I woke up late this morning.
transliteration: Saheet meta'akhar ennaharda elsobh.

arabic: كنت مستعجل جدا عشان الشغل
english: I was very rushed because of work.
transliteration: Kunt mesta'gel geddan 'ashan elshoghl.

arabic: انا لابس قميص ابيض وبنطلون اسود
english: I am wearing a white shirt and black pants.
transliteration: Ana labes amees abyaḍ w bantaloon aswad.

arabic: القميص ده حلو لكن عايز اشتري واحد جديد
english: This shirt is nice but I want to buy a new one.
transliteration: El-amees da ḥelw laken aayez ashtry wahed gedeed.

arabic: لازم امشي دلوقتي انا متاخر
english: I have to leave now, I am late.
transliteration: Lazim amshi delwa'ty ana meta'akher.

arabic: انا النهاردة في الكافيه
english: Today I am at the cafe.
transliteration: Ana ennaharda fi el-kafeh.

arabic: انا مستني صاحبي
english: I am waiting for my friend.
transliteration: Ana mestanni sahby.

arabic: شايف ترابيزة كبيرة و كرسي صغير اوي
english: I see a very big table and a very small chair.
transliteration: Shayef tarabeeza kebeera w korsi soghayyar awy.

arabic: راجل جه ياخد الاوردر قلتله استنى
english: A man came to take the order, I told him 'wait'.
transliteration: Ragel geh yakhod el-order, oltelloh estanna.

arabic: هو ضحك وانا كمان ضحكت مستني القهوة
english: He laughed and I also laughed, waiting for the coffee.
transliteration: Howa dahak w ana kaman dahakt, mestanni el-ahwa.

arabic: انا وصاحبتي سلمى كنا بنرتب لفرح اختي الكبيرة
english: My friend Salma and I were arranging my older sister's wedding.
transliteration: Ana we sahebti Salma kunna binrattib le farah okhti el kabira

arabic: بابا قال إن عمي احمد وخالتي منى هيساعدونا في قائمة المعازيم
english: Dad said that my paternal uncle Ahmed and my maternal aunt Mona will help us with the guest list.
transliteration: Baba qal inn 3ammy Ahmad we khalti Mona hayisa3duna fi qa'emet el ma3azim

arabic: ماما سالتني ايه رايك في الوان الديكور الجديدة دي يا بنتي
english: Mom asked me 'What do you think of these new decor colors, my daughter?'
transliteration: Mama sa'aletni eh ra'yek fi alwan el dikor el gedida di ya binti

arabic: قلتلها بصراحة الالوان دي شكلها تحفة وهتخلي الفرح جميل اوي
english: I told her 'Honestly, these colors look amazing and will make the wedding very beautiful.'
transliteration: Qoltellaha bi sara7a el alwan di shaklaha to7fa we hatkhalli el far7 gameel awi

arabic: كلنا كنا متحمسين جدا عشان نشوف يوم الفرح والتجهيزات الاخيرة
english: We were all very excited to see the wedding day and the final preparations.
transliteration: Kullena kunna mota7ammesin geddan 3ashan nishuf yom el far7 wel taghizat el akhira

arabic: الدنيا بتمطر بره
english: It's raining outside.
transliteration: El donya betmatar barra.

arabic: انا قاعد في البيت
english: I am sitting at home.
transliteration: Ana aa'ed fel beit.

arabic: بشرب شاي سخن دلوقتي
english: I am drinking hot tea now.
transliteration: Bashrab shai sokhn delwa'ty.

arabic: الجو جميل وهادي
english: The weather is beautiful and quiet.
transliteration: El gaww gameel we hady.

arabic: انا بحب اليوم ده اوي
english: I really like this day.
transliteration: Ana baheb el yom da awi.

arabic: انا اشتريت كتاب امبارح من المحل ده
english: I bought a book yesterday from this shop.
transliteration: Ana ishtarēt kitaab imbaarih min el-maḥall da.

arabic: الكتاب كان كبير اوي مش اللي انا عايزه
english: The book was too big, not the one I wanted.
transliteration: El-kitaab kaan kibiir awi miš elli ana ʿayzoh.

arabic: النهاردة انا رجعت المحل عشان ارجع الكتاب
english: Today I went back to the shop to return the book.
transliteration: Ennahardah ana rajjaʿt el-maḥall ʿashaan araggaʿ el-kitaab.

arabic: الراجل في المحل قال لي ده مش كتابنا
english: The man in the shop told me "this is not our book".
transliteration: Er-raagil fi el-maḥall ʾaal li "da miš kitaabna".

arabic: يا الهي انا رجعت كتاب غلط
english: Oh my God! I returned the wrong book!
transliteration: Ya ilaahi! Ana rajjaʿt kitaab ghalaṭ!

arabic: اليوم انا رحت بيت خالتي
english: Today I went to my aunt's house.
transliteration: El yoom ana roht beit khalti.

arabic: قلت لها صباح الخير
english: I said to her Good morning
transliteration: Oult laha sabah el kheer.

arabic: هي قالت اهلا وسهلا كيف حالك
english: She said Welcome how are you
transliteration: Heya aalet ahlan wa sahlan keif halik.

arabic: انا قلت لها انا بخير الحمد لله
english: I told her I am fine thank God
transliteration: Ana oult laha ana bekhair el hamdu lellah.

arabic: كنت سعيد اوي شكرا مع السلامة
english: I was very happy thank you goodbye
transliteration: Kunt sa'eed awi shukran ma'a el salama.

arabic: اليوم الجمعة احنا عايزين نسافر
english: Today is Friday, we want to travel.
transliteration: El naharda El gom'aa ehna 'ayzin nisafer.

arabic: ماما بتقول نروح اسكندرية
english: Mom says we go to Alexandria.
transliteration: Mama bet'ul neruh Eskendereyya.

arabic: بابا بيقول الجو هناك حلو
english: Dad says the weather there is nice.
transliteration: Baba bi'ul el gaw henk helw.
