arabic: كلنا بنحب البحر الكبير
english: We all love the big sea.
transliteration: Kollena benhebb el bahr el kebir.

arabic: احنا مبسوطين جدا عشان السفرية دي
english: We are very happy for this trip.
transliteration: Ehna mabsuTin geddan 'ashan el safareyya di.

arabic: انا وماما كنا ماشيين في الشارع عشان نزور تيتا وفجأة تهنا
english: My mom and I were walking in the street to visit Grandma, and suddenly we got lost.
transliteration: Ana w mama kunna mashiyeen fel shareʿ ʿashan nezor teeta we fagʾa tehna

arabic: ماما كانت قلقانة شوية وقالت يا ترى هنوصل إمتى
english: Mom was a little worried and said, "I wonder when we will arrive?"
transliteration: Mama kanet ʾalqāna showayya w ʾalet ya tarā hanewṣal emta

arabic: شفت راجل كبير قاعد على قهوة شكله طيب فروحت اسأله على العنوان
english: I saw an old man sitting at a coffee shop, he looked kind, so I went to ask him for directions.
transliteration: Shoft ragel kebir ʾaʿed ʿala ʾahwa shaklo ṭayyeb fa roḥt asʾalo ʿal el-ʿenwān

arabic: هو ابتسم وقال لي متقلقوش يا ولادي البيت قريب من هنا
english: He smiled and told me, "Don't worry, my children, the house is close by."
transliteration: Howwa ebtasam w ʾal li matʾalʾoosh ya weladi el-beit ʾarayyeb men hena

arabic: وشكرناه كتير ومشينا ووصلنا لتيتا وكانت مبسوطة اوي بينا
english: We thanked him a lot, walked, and arrived at Grandma's, and she was very happy with us.
transliteration: We shakarnah keteir we mesheena w weṣalna le-teeta w kanet mabsoota ʾawi beina

arabic: النهاردة قررت اطبخ اكلة جديدة خالص اول مرة اجربها
english: Today I decided to cook a completely new dish, the first time I try it.
transliteration: El-naharda qarrart atbokh akla gedida khales awwal marra agarrebha.

arabic: رحت السوق وسألت البياع عن احسن خضار ليها
english: I went to the market and asked the seller about the best vegetables for it.
transliteration: Roht el-souq we sa'alt el-bayya' 3an ahsan khodar leha.

arabic: طول وانا بطبخ كنت مركزة جداً عشان متطلعش وحشة
english: All the time I was cooking, I was very focused so it wouldn't turn out bad.
transliteration: Tool wana batbokh kont merakkaza geddan 3ashan ma tetla3sh wehsha.

arabic: لما دقتها حسيت بطعم مختلف بس حلو اوي
english: When I tasted it, I felt a different but very delicious taste.
transliteration: Lamma do'toha hasset be ta3m mokhtalef bas helw awi.

arabic: يارب جوزي يرضى بيها لما يدوقها بليل
english: I hope my husband approves of it when he tastes it tonight.
transliteration: Ya rab gozi yerda beha lamma yedu'ha bel-leil.

arabic: صحيت متأخر كالعادة الصبح
english: I woke up late as usual in the morning.
transliteration: Saḥīt metaʾakhkhar kalʿāda el-ṣubḥ

arabic: دورت على الشراب بتاعي كتير وملاقيتوش
english: I looked for my sock a lot and didn't find it.
transliteration: Dawwart ʿala el-sharāb betaʿī kitīr wemalaʾītūsh

arabic: شربت القهوة بسرعة عشان ألحق الشغل
english: I drank the coffee quickly to catch work.
transliteration: Sharibt el-ʾahwa be-sorʿa ʿashān alḥaq el-shoghl

arabic: كنت حاسس إني مش متحكم في أي حاجة الصبح ده
english: I felt like I wasn't in control of anything this morning.
transliteration: Kunt ḥāssis innī mish motaḥakkem fī ayyi ḥāga el-ṣubḥ dah

arabic: نزلت أجري على السلم وكلي أمل إني أوصل في ميعادي
english: I ran down the stairs, full of hope to arrive on time.
transliteration: Nazalt agri ʿala el-sallem we-kollī amal innī awṣal fī mīʿādī

arabic: كل يوم جمعة امي بتقولي يلا نروح السوق الكبير
english: Every Friday, my mother tells me, "Let's go to the big market."
transliteration: Kol yom gom'a ommy bet'ouly yalla nrooh el soo' el kibeer

arabic: بنحب نشتري خضار طازة عشان نعمل اكل جديد في البيت
english: We love to buy fresh vegetables to make new food at home.
transliteration: Benhebb neshtary khodaar tazza 'ashan na'mel akl gedid fel bayt

arabic: النهاردة قررنا نعمل طبخة اول مرة نجربها
english: Today we decided to make a dish we're trying for the first time.
transliteration: Elnaharda qarrarna na'mel tabkha awwal marra ngarrabha

arabic: امي ساعدتني اقطع الخضار وانا طبختها بهدوء
english: My mother helped me cut the vegetables and I cooked it slowly.
transliteration: Ommy sa'detni a'atta' el khodaar wana tabakhtaha behedoo'

arabic: الاكل كان طعمه حلو اوي وكلنا اتبسطنا بيه
english: The food tasted very good, and we all enjoyed it.
transliteration: El akl kan ta'mo helw awy we kollena etbasatna beih

arabic: منى كانت بتجري وسط زحمة خان الخليلي الصبح بدري، وعقلها كله في اللمبة النادرة اللي لازم تلاقيها قبل ميعاد اجتماعها المهم.
english: Mona was running through the crowded Khan el-Khalili early in the morning, her mind completely focused on the rare lamp she absolutely had to find before her important meeting.
transliteration: Mona kanet betegri west za7met Khan el-Khalili el-sob7 badry, we 3a2laha kollo fel-lamba el-nadera elle lazim tela2eeha abl me3ad egtema3aha el-mohem.
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: عدّت على بياع أنتيكات قديم، وقالتله بسرعة وهي بتنهج: "صباح الخير يا عمو!"
english: She passed an old antique seller and quickly said to him, panting: "Good morning, uncle!"
transliteration: 3addet 3ala bayya3 antikate adim, we 2aletlo besor3a we heya betenheg: "Sabah el-kheir ya 3ammu!"
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: رد عليها البياع وهو بيرص بضاعته بهدوء: "صباح النور يا بنتي، إزيك عاملة إيه النهاردة؟"
english: The seller replied to her calmly while arranging his goods: "Morning of light, my daughter, how are you doing today?"
transliteration: Radd 3aleiha el-bayya3 we howa biros baḍa3to be-hodoo2: "Sabah el-noor ya benti, izzayek 3amla eh el-naharda?"
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: قالتله منى وهي بتشاور على ساعتها: "الحمد لله، بس مستعجلة خالص بدور على لمبة معينة لشغل ضروري."
english: Mona told him, pointing to her watch: "Thank God, but I'm really in a hurry, looking for a specific lamp for urgent work."
transliteration: 2aletlo Mona we heya betshawer 3ala sa3etha: "El-ḥamdulillah, bas mesta3gala khales badoawar 3ala lamba mo3ayyana le-shoghl daroori."
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: فجأة خبطت في شاب ماشي بسرعة، فقالها الشاب بابتسامة: "السلام عليكم، معلش يا أستاذة."
english: Suddenly she bumped into a young man walking quickly, and the young man said to her with a smile: "Peace be upon you, excuse me, madam."
transliteration: Fa-ga'a khabṭet fi shabb mashi be-sor3a, fa-2alha el-shabb be-ebtesama: "As-salamu 3alaykum, ma3lesh ya ostaza."
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: ردت منى وهي بتعتذر: "وعليكم السلام يا ابني، أنا اللي آسفة، كنت سرحانة شوية."
english: Mona replied, apologizing: "And upon you be peace, my son, I'm the one who's sorry, I was a bit distracted."
transliteration: Raddet Mona we heya bet3tezer: "Wa 3alaykum as-salam ya ebni, ana elly asfa, kont sarḥana shwayya."
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: دخلت قهوة صغيرة في حارة ضيقة، وقالت للقهوجي بسرعة: "مساء الخير، عايزة قهوة مظبوطة تيك أواي."
english: She entered a small coffee shop in a narrow alley and quickly said to the barista: "Good evening, I want a medium coffee to go."
transliteration: Dakhalet 2ahwa soghayyara fi ḥara ḍayye2a, we 2alet lel-2ahwagi be-sor3a: "Masa' el-kheir, 3ayza 2ahwa mazbuṭa take away."
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: رد القهوجي وهو بيجهز الفنجان: "مساء النور يا فندم، تحبي تقعدي ولا تاخديها؟"
english: The barista replied while preparing the cup: "Evening of light, madam, would you like to sit or take it?"
transliteration: Radd el-2ahwagi we howa bi-gahaaz el-fengan: "Masa' el-noor ya fandam, teḥebbi to3odi wala takhdeha?"
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: دفعت منى الخمسة جنيه بسرعة وهي بتعتذر، وقالت لبواب العمارة اللي جنب القهوة: "السلام عليكم يا عم الحاج، معلش مستعجلة."
english: Mona quickly paid the five pounds, apologizing, and said to the building doorman next to the coffee shop: "Peace be upon you, Uncle Al-Hajj, excuse me, I'm in a hurry."
transliteration: Dafa3et Mona el-khamsa geneh be-sor3a we heya bet3tezer, we 2alet le-bawwab el-3emara elly gamb el-2ahwa: "As-salamu 3alaykum ya 3amm el-ḥagg, ma3lesh mesta3gala."
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: رد البواب بهدوء وهو بيسقي الزرع: "وعليكم السلام يا بنتي، ربنا معاكي، بس بالراحة شوية."
english: The doorman replied calmly while watering the plants: "And upon you be peace, my daughter, may God be with you, but take it easy a bit."
transliteration: Radd el-bawwab be-hodoo2 we howa bi-yes2i ez-zar3: "Wa 3alaykum as-salam ya benti, Rabbena ma3aki, bas bel-raḥa shwayya."
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: فجأة، لمحت لمعة خافتة من محل صغير شبه مهجور في آخر الحارة، يا ترى هي دي اللمبة؟
english: Suddenly, she glimpsed a faint sparkle from a small, almost abandoned shop at the end of the alley, could it be the lamp?
transliteration: Fa-ga'a, lamaḥet lam3a khafta men maḥall soghayyar shebh mahgoor fi akher el-ḥara, ya tara heya di el-lamba?
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: دخلت بسرعة قبل ما الراجل يقفل بابه، وقالت بلهفة: "مساء الخير يا حاج، ممكن لحظة من فضلك؟"
english: She quickly entered before the man closed his door, and said eagerly: "Good evening, Hajj, a moment please?"
transliteration: Dakhalet be-sor3a abl ma el-ragel ye2fel babo, we 2alet be-lahfa: "Masa' el-kheir ya ḥagg, momken laḥza men faḍlak?"
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: رد صاحب المحل وهو بيزيح الكرسي بتعب: "مساء النور يا بنتي، خير؟ المحل خلاص بيقفل."
english: The shop owner replied, pushing his chair tiredly: "Evening of light, my daughter, what's good? The shop is already closing."
transliteration: Radd saḥeb el-maḥall we howa bi-yiziḥ el-korsi be-ta3ab: "Masa' el-noor ya benti, kheir? El-maḥall khalas bi-ye2fel."
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: منى شرحت له بسرعة عن اللمبة المطلوبة لمشروع مهم، وعرضت عليه سعر كويس، وهو بيستمع باهتمام.
english: Mona quickly explained to him about the required lamp for an important project, and offered him a good price, while he listened with interest.
transliteration: Mona sharaḥet lo be-sor3a 3an el-lamba el-maṭlooba le-mashroo3 mohem, we 3araḍet 3aleih se3r kowayyes, we howa bi-yestame3 be-ehtimam.
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: الراجل ابتسم وقبل العرض، وقالت منى وهي بتشيل اللمبة بفرحة: "شكراً يا حاج، السلام عليكم، وأشوفك تاني قريب!"
english: The man smiled and accepted the offer, and Mona said, carrying the lamp joyfully: "Thank you, Hajj, peace be upon you, and I'll see you again soon!"
transliteration: El-ragel ebtasam we 2abel el-3arḍ, we 2alet Mona we heya betsheel el-lamba be-farḥa: "Shokran ya ḥagg, as-salamu 3alaykum, we ashoofak tani 2areeb!"
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: خرجت منى من المحل الصغير وهي ماسكة اللمبة الثمينة، وشعور بالفخر والرضا بيغمرها تمامًا.
english: Mona left the small shop, holding the precious lamp, a feeling of pride and satisfaction completely engulfing her.
transliteration: Kharaget Mona men el-maḥall el-soghayyar we heya mas'ka el-lamba el-samina, we sho3oor bel-fakhr wel-reḍa bi-yeghmorha tamaman.
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: وهي في طريقها للمترو، عدّت على ست كبيرة كانت بتبيع فول، فقالتلها: "صباح الخير يا والدة! الفول لسه سخن؟"
english: On her way to the metro, she passed an old woman selling fūl, and said to her: "Good morning, mother! Is the fūl still hot?"
transliteration: We heya fi ṭari2ha lel-metro, 3addet 3ala sett kebira kanet betibee3 fūl, fa-2aletlaha: "Sabah el-kheir ya walda! El-fūl lessa sokhn?"
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: ردت الست بابتسامة دافئة: "صباح النور يا بنتي، أيوه لسه طازة، تحبي طبق؟"
english: The woman replied with a warm smile: "Morning of light, my daughter, yes, it's still fresh, would you like a plate?"
transliteration: Raddet el-sett be-ebtesama dafi'a: "Sabah el-noor ya benti, aywa lessa taze, teḥebbi ṭaba2?"
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: اعتذرت منى بلباقة، وشكرتها على لطفها، قائلة: "شكراً خالص يا والدة، معلش مستعجلة للمقابلة، بس هارجعلك تاني قريب."
english: Mona politely apologized and thanked her for her kindness, saying: "Thank you very much, mother, excuse me, I'm in a hurry for the meeting, but I'll come back to you again soon."
transliteration: E3tazarat Mona be-labaqa, we shakratha 3ala loṭfaha, 2a'ela: "Shokran khales ya walda, ma3lesh mesta3gala lel-mo2abala, bas harge3lek tani 2areeb."
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: في النهاية، وصلت منى لميعادها على المترو في الوقت المناسب، وهي بتفكر في كل التحيات اللي سمعتها الصبح ده.
english: In the end, Mona arrived at her metro appointment just in time, thinking about all the greetings she had heard that morning.
transliteration: Fil-nehaya, waṣalet Mona le-me3adha 3ala el-metro fil-wa2t el-monaseb, we heya betfakkar fi kol el-taḥeyyat elly seme3etha el-sobḥ dah.
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: كل كلمة قالتها أو سمعتها كانت جزء من يومها الطبيعي في القاهرة، بتضيف لجمال وتنوع الحياة اليومية هناك.
english: Every word she said or heard was a part of her normal day in Cairo, adding to the beauty and diversity of daily life there.
transliteration: Kol kelma 2aletha aw seme3etha kanet goz' men yomha el-ṭabi3i fi el-Qahira, betḍeef le-gamal we tanawwo3 el-ḥaya el-yawmeyya henāk.
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: ابتسامة خفيفة ارتسمت على وشها وهي بتفكر إزاي التحيات البسيطة دي ممكن تخلي اليوم أحسن وأكثر إنسانية.
english: A faint smile appeared on her face as she thought about how these simple greetings could make the day better and more humane.
transliteration: Ebtesama khafifa ertasamet 3ala wishaha we heya betfakkar izzay el-taḥeyyat el-basiṭa di momken tekhalli el-yom aḥsan we akthar ensaneyya.
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: وصلت منى للمكتب متأخرة خمس دقايق بس، بس معاها لمبة فريدة وقصة صباح مليان بتحيات الناس الطيبة.
english: Mona arrived at the office only five minutes late, but she had a unique lamp and a story of a morning filled with the greetings of kind people.
transliteration: Waṣalet Mona lel-maktab meta'akhra khams da2aye2 bas, bas ma3aha lamba farida we 2eṣṣet ṣabaḥ malyan be-taḥeyyat el-nas el-ṭayyeba.
storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

arabic: بدأنا ماتش الكورة الخماسي بعد ما الكل قال مساء الخير لبعضه في عز حر الصيف اللي مش بيرحم حد
english: We started the five-a-side football match after everyone said good evening to each other in the scorching summer heat that spares no one.
transliteration: Bada'na match el-koora el-khomasi ba'd ma el-kol qal masa' el-kheer leba'do fi 'ezz harr es-seif elly mesh biyirham hadd.

arabic: الفريقين كانوا متحمسين جدا وكل واحد فيهم كان فاكر انه هيحقق مجد كروي عالمي بس الحقيقة كانت ابعد ما يكون
english: Both teams were very enthusiastic and each one thought they would achieve global football glory but the reality was far from it.
transliteration: El-fareeqein kanu muthammasin giddan we koll wahed feehom kan faker enno hayhaqqeq magd korawy 'alamy bass el-haqeeqa kanet ab'ad ma yekoon.

arabic: وفي لقطة كوميدية لا تنسى زميلنا علي قرر يشوط الكورة بكل قوته في سلة الزبالة اللي كانت جنب الجون بدل ما يجيبها جوه الشبكة
english: And in an unforgettable comedic moment, our colleague Ali decided to kick the ball with all his might into the trash can next to the goal instead of putting it inside the net.
transliteration: We fi laqta komedeya la tounsa zemeelna Ali qarar yeshoot el-koora be koll qowweto fi sallit ez-zebala elly kanet ganb el-goon badal ma yegibha gowwa esh-shabaka.

arabic: الكل انفجر من الضحك وواحد فينا قاله وعليكم السلام يا كابتن هو ده الجون الجديد اللي بنلعب عليه ولا إيه
english: Everyone burst into laughter and one of us told him, and upon you be peace, Captain, is this the new goal we are playing for or what?
transliteration: El-kol enfagar men ed-dahk we wahed feena qal-lo wa 'alaykum as-salam ya captain howwa da el-goon el-gedeid elly benil'ab 'aleih walla eih.

arabic: بعد الموقف دا المباراة اتحولت لمهرجان هزار وضحك أكتر منها ماتش كورة عادي وفهمنا إن الأهم هو الروح الحلوة مش الفوز وبس
english: After that situation, the match turned into more of a festival of jokes and laughter than a regular football match, and we understood that the good spirit is more important than just winning.
transliteration: Ba'd el-maw'ef da el-mobara et-hawwelet le-mahragan hezar we dahk aktar menha match koora 'ady we fehemna en el-aham howwa er-rooh el-helwa mesh el-fooz we bass.

arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع الصبح وشفت صاحب قديم
english: I was walking in the street in the morning and saw an old friend.
transliteration: Kunt mashi fi el shari' el sobh w shoft sahib qadeem.

arabic: صباح الخير ازيك يا احمد
english: Good morning! How are you, Ahmed?
transliteration: Sabah el kheir! Izzayak ya Ahmed?

arabic: الحمد لله انا كويس وانت عامل ايه
english: Praise be to God, I'm good. And how are you?
transliteration: Elhamdulillah, ana kowayyes. W enta 'amel eh?

arabic: انا كمان كويس كنت فين كل ده
english: I'm good too. Where have you been all this time?
transliteration: Ana kaman kowayyes. Kunt fein kol da?

arabic: يلا بينا نشرب قهوة سوا
english: Let's go drink coffee together.
transliteration: Yalla bina neshrab ahwa sawa.

arabic: انا صحيت بدري عشان اروح الشغل
english: I woke up early to go to work.
transliteration: Ana saheet badri 'ashan arooh el shoghl.

arabic: كان فيه زحمة كتير في الطريق
english: There was a lot of traffic on the way.
transliteration: Kan fe zahma kiteer fel taree'.

arabic: صاحبي كلمني وسالني انت فين
english: My friend called me and asked 'Where are you?'.
transliteration: Saahbi kallimni w sa'alni 'Inta fein?'.

arabic: قلتله انا لسه في العربية
english: I told him 'I'm still in the car'.
transliteration: Qultilu ana lissa fel 'arabeyya.

arabic: اخيرا وصلت متاخر بس كنت بضحك
english: Finally I arrived late, but I was laughing.
transliteration: Akheeran wasalt muta'akhkhar bas kunt badhak.

arabic: صباح الخير يا احمد الوقت شغل دلوقتي
english: Good morning Ahmed, it's work time now.
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya Ahmed el wa't shoghl delwa'ti.

arabic: انا عايز قهوة من فضلك
english: I want coffee please.
transliteration: Ana aayez ahwa men fadlak.

arabic: فيه لبن للقهوة
english: Is there milk for the coffee?
transliteration: Fih laban lel ahwa?

arabic: لا مفيش لبن خلص امبارح
english: No, there's no milk, it finished yesterday.
transliteration: La mafish laban khalas embareh.

arabic: خلاص انا هشرب شاي
english: Okay, I will drink tea.
transliteration: Khalas ana hashrob shay.

arabic: رحت ماتش كورة امبارح وكان الجو حر قوي
english: I went to a football match yesterday and the weather was very hot.
transliteration: roht matsh kora embareh w kan el gaw har qawi

arabic: كنت مركزة طول الماتش عشان اشوف الجون
english: I was focused throughout the whole match to see the goal.
transliteration: kont merakkaza tool el matsh 3ashan ashoof el goon

arabic: بعد الشوط الاول شفت البياع بيبيع حاجة شكلها مختلف
english: After the first half, I saw the vendor selling something that looked different.
transliteration: ba3d el shoot el awwal shoft el bayya3 byebii3 haga shaklaha mokhtalef

arabic: دقتها وحسيت انها مش حلوة اوي الصراحة
english: I tasted it and felt that it wasn't very good, honestly.
transliteration: do'toha w hasset ennaha mesh helwa awi el sara7a

arabic: قررت المرة الجاية مش هاكل اي حاجة مش معروفة عشان متطلعش وحشة
english: I decided next time I won't eat anything unknown so it doesn't turn out bad.
transliteration: qarrart el marra el gayya mesh hakol ay haga mesh ma3roofa 3ashan ma tetla3sh wa7sha

arabic: صباح الخير يا جارتي
english: Good morning, my neighbor.
transliteration: Sabah el kher ya garti

arabic: صباح النور ازيك
english: Good morning, how are you?
transliteration: Sabah el nour ezzayek

arabic: انا الحمد لله كويسة
english: I am good, praise be to God.
transliteration: Ana alhamdulillah kwaysa

arabic: وانتي عاملة ايه
english: And how are you doing?
transliteration: W enty amla eh

arabic: الجو حلو النهاردة
english: The weather is nice today.
transliteration: El gaw helw el naharda

arabic: انا كلمت صاحبتي ريم في التليفون امبارح.
english: I called my friend Reem on the phone yesterday.
transliteration: Ana kallamt sahbeti Reem fel telephon embareh.
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: هي قالت لي يلا نروح السوق الكبير نشتري خضار وفاكهة لبيت امي.
english: She told me
transliteration: Heya 'aletli
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: انا قلت لها فكرة حلوة احنا بنحب الفاكهة والخضار الطازة.
english: I told her
transliteration: Ana 'olt laha
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: هي سألتني تفتكري الفاكهة بكام النهاردة؟
english: She asked me
transliteration: Heya sa'aletni
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: اتفقنا نتقابل عند السوق الساعة عشرة الصبح.
english: We agreed to meet at the market at ten in the morning.
transliteration: Ettefa'na net'abel 'and el soo' el sa'a 'ashara el sobh.
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: انا رحت السوق امبارح عشان عايز اشتري حاجات
english: I went to the market yesterday because I want to buy things.
transliteration: Ana roht el-sooʾ embarah ʿashan ʿayez ashtry hagaat.

arabic: انا عايز اشتري بنطلون اسود بس كان غالي قوي
english: I want to buy black pants but they were very expensive.
transliteration: Ana ʿayez ashtry bantaloon aswad bas kaan ghali qawi.

arabic: سالت البياع هو ليه ده غالي كده
english: I asked the seller why this is so expensive.
transliteration: Saʾalt el-bayaaʿ howa leeh da ghali keda.

arabic: قال لي يا استاذ ده مش غالي ده تحفة
english: He told me 'Sir, this is not expensive, it's a masterpiece!'
transliteration: Qal li 'ya ostaz da mesh ghali da tohfa!'

arabic: في الاخر اشتريت قميص ابيض رخيص وضحكت
english: In the end, I bought a cheap white shirt and laughed.
transliteration: Fi el-akher eshtarayt amees abyaḍ rakheeṣ we dehekt.

arabic: النهاردة ماتش كورة مهم
english: Today is an important football match
transliteration: Elnaharda match kora mohem
storyTitle: The Football Match at the Cafe

arabic: كلنا بنروح القهوة عشان نتفرج
english: We all go to the cafe to watch
transliteration: Kollena benrouh el'ahwa 'ashan netfarag
storyTitle: The Football Match at the Cafe

arabic: بنطلب شاي و كشري
english: We order tea and koshary
transliteration: Bentolob shay w koshary
storyTitle: The Football Match at the Cafe

arabic: الجمهور بيشجع فريقه بصوت عالي
english: The crowd cheers for its team loudly
transliteration: Elgomhour bīshagga' faree'o besout 'aly
storyTitle: The Football Match at the Cafe

arabic: الجو بيبقى حلو اوي
english: The atmosphere is really nice
transliteration: Elgaww beye'ba helw awi
storyTitle: The Football Match at the Cafe

arabic: انا قاعد في القهوة مستني صاحبي
english: I am sitting in the cafe waiting for my friend.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed fil-ahwa mestanni sahby.

arabic: الساعة بتجري بسرعة وهو لسه مجاش
english: The hour is passing quickly and he still hasn't come.
transliteration: Es-sa'a betegri be-sor'a w howa lessa magash.

arabic: انا حاسس اني زهقان شوية دلوقتي
english: I feel a little bored now.
transliteration: Ana hases enni zah'aan shwaya delwa'ty.

arabic: بصيت حواليا مفيش حد اعرفه
english: I looked around, there's no one I know.
transliteration: Bassayt hawalayya mafeesh had a'rafoh.

arabic: يا رب يجي بسرعة عشان نشرب قهوة سوا
english: I hope he comes quickly so we can drink coffee together.
transliteration: Ya rab yigi be-sor'a 'ashan neshrab ahwa sawa.

arabic: منى شافت طارق قدام القهوة.
english: Mona saw Tarek in front of the coffee shop.
transliteration: Mona shafet Tarek oddam el-ahwa.

arabic: طارق قال: "إزيك يا منى؟"
english: Tarek said: "How are you, Mona?"
transliteration: Tarek al: "Ezzayek ya Mona?"

arabic: هي ردت: "الحمد لله، بس نسيت المحفظة."
english: She replied: "Praise be to God, but I forgot my wallet."
transliteration: Heyya raddet: "Elhamdulellah, bas neseet el-mahfaza."

arabic: طارق قال: "معلش، أنا هدفع الحساب."
english: Tarek said: "Never mind, I will pay the bill."
transliteration: Tarek al: "Ma'lesh, ana hadfa' el-hesab."

arabic: منى شكرته وقالت: "سلام، أشوفك بكرة!"
english: Mona thanked him and said: "Goodbye, see you tomorrow!"
transliteration: Mona shakarato wa alet: "Salam, ashoofak bokra!"

arabic: كل العيلة قعدت تخطط للفرح
english: The whole family sat down to plan the wedding.
transliteration: Koll el-ʿeila qaʿadet tekhaṭṭeṭ lel-faraḥ.

arabic: ماما قالت فكرة حلوة للاكل
english: Mom suggested a nice idea for the food.
transliteration: Mama qalet fekrah ḥelwah lel-akl.

arabic: بابا قال انا موافق على الفكرة دي
english: Dad said, "I agree with this idea."
transliteration: Baba qal ana mowāfeʾ ʿala el-fekrah di.

arabic: اختي قالت انا محتاجة اروح البنك دلوقتي
english: My sister said, "I need to go to the bank now."
transliteration: Okhti qalet ana meḥtāga arūḥ el-bank delwaʾti.

arabic: اخويا قالها امشي طوالي لحد ما تشوفي البنك
english: My brother told her, "Go straight until you see the bank."
transliteration: Akhūya qalha emshi tawalli laḥadd ma teshūfi el-bank.

arabic: النهاردة انا هاطبخ اكلة جديدة
english: Today I will cook a new dish.
transliteration: El naharda ana hatbokh akla gedeeda.
storyTitle: A New Dish for the Family

arabic: ماما وبابا هيساعدوني في المطبخ
english: Mom and Dad will help me in the kitchen.
transliteration: Mama w baba hayesa'doony fel matbakh.
storyTitle: A New Dish for the Family

arabic: احنا هنقطع خضار كتير سوا
english: We will cut many vegetables together.
transliteration: Ehna hana'ta' khodaar keteer sawa.
storyTitle: A New Dish for the Family

arabic: ريحته حلوة اوي في البيت
english: Its smell is very nice in the house.
transliteration: Reehto helwa awi fel beit.
storyTitle: A New Dish for the Family

arabic: كلنا مبسوطين بناكل اكل جديد
english: We are all happy eating new food.
transliteration: Kollena mabsooteen bena'kol akl gedeed.
storyTitle: A New Dish for the Family

arabic: كل يوم الصبح قررت إني لازم أشتري هدوم جديدة للشغل
english: Every morning, I decided that I must buy new clothes for work.
transliteration: Kull yoom el-sobh qarrart enni lazem ashtari hedoom gedeeda lel-shoghl

arabic: دخلت المحل وكنت مركزة طول الوقت على إني ألاقي حاجة مختلفة ومريحة
english: I entered the store and was focused all the time on finding something different and comfortable.
transliteration: Dakhalet el-mahall w kont merakkaza tool el-wa't 3ala enni ala'i haga mokhtalefa w moreeha

arabic: البياع وراني ألوان كتير بس أنا حسيت إن مفيش حاجة عجباني
english: The seller showed me many colors, but I felt that nothing pleased me.
transliteration: El-bayya' warrani alwan keteer bas ana hasset en mafeesh haga 3agbani

arabic: جربت فستان لونه أزرق بس حسيت إنه متطلعش حلو عليا خالص
english: I tried on a blue dress, but I felt it didn't look good on me at all.
transliteration: Garrabt fostan loonoh azraq bas hasset enno ma tetla3sh helw 3alayya khales

arabic: في الآخر لقيت بنطلون وبلوزة البياع قال إنهم هيعجبوني وفعلا رضيت بيهم
english: In the end, I found trousers and a blouse that the seller said I would like, and indeed I was pleased with them.
transliteration: Fi el-akher laqeet bantaloon wablooza el-bayya' 'al ennohom haye3gobooni w fe3lan radeet beehom

arabic: الويك إند ده هنروح نعمل رحلة حلوة
english: This weekend we will go on a nice trip
transliteration: El week end dah hanrooh na'mel rehla helwa

arabic: امي قالت لازم نشتري اكل كتير
english: My mother said we must buy a lot of food
transliteration: Ommy 'alet lazem neshtary akl kiteer

arabic: بنحب فاكهة وخضار عشان كده هنروح السوق
english: We love fruit and vegetables, so we will go to the market
transliteration: Benhebb fakha we khodaar 'ashan kedah hanrooh el soo'

arabic: السوق كبير وهنشتري كل حاجة من هناك
english: The market is big and we will buy everything from there
transliteration: El soo' kibeer we haneshtary kol haga men henak

arabic: يلا نجهز الشنط ونستعد للرحلة
english: Let's pack the bags and get ready for the trip
transliteration: Yalla nigahez el shonat we nest'ed lel rehla

arabic: صحيت متاخر النهاردة
english: I woke up late today
transliteration: Sa7eet meta'akhar elnaharda

arabic: كل حاجة كانت مستعجلة
english: Everything was rushed
transliteration: Koll 7aga kanet masta3gala

arabic: ماما وبابا كانوا في البيت
english: Mom and Dad were in the house
transliteration: Mama we Baba kanu fel beit

arabic: شربت قهوتي بسرعة وودعت عائلتي
english: I quickly drank my coffee and said goodbye to my family
transliteration: Sherbet qahweti besor3a we wada3t 3aylti

arabic: دلوقتي رايح الشغل واتمنى ماتأخرش
english: Now I'm going to work and I hope I don't get late
transliteration: Delwaqty rayeh elshoghl we atamanna ma'at'akharksh

arabic: كنت ماشي في شارع زحمة و الدنيا حر
english: I was walking on a crowded street and the weather was hot.
transliteration: Kont mashi fi share3 zahma we el donya harr.

arabic: فجأة لقيت نفسي في مكان غريب و مفيش اي حاجة اعرفها
english: Suddenly I found myself in a strange place and there was nothing I recognized.
transliteration: Faga'a leqet nafsi fi makan ghareeb we mafeesh ay haga a3rafha.

arabic: قلبي دق بسرعة و افتكرت ماما و بابا في البيت
english: My heart beat fast and I remembered Mom and Dad at home.
transliteration: Albi da'' be sor3a we eftakart Mama we Baba fel beit.

arabic: شفت راجل كبير واقف لوحده فقررت اسأله عن الطريق
english: I saw an old man standing alone, so I decided to ask him for directions.
transliteration: Shoft ragel kebeer wa'ef lewa7do fa qarart as'alo 3an el taree'.

arabic: هو كان طيب جدا و وراني الطريق الصح و حسيت براحة كبيرة
english: He was very kind and showed me the correct way, and I felt great relief.
transliteration: Howa kan tayeb geddan we warrani el taree' el sa7 we hassait be ra7a kebeera.

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد اختي
english: Today is my sister's birthday.
transliteration: El naharda Eid meelad okhty

arabic: احنا بنحتفل في البيت
english: We are celebrating at home.
transliteration: Ehna benhetfel fi el beit

arabic: التورتة كبيرة وحلوة
english: The cake is big and sweet.
transliteration: El torta kabeera we helwa

arabic: احنا بناكل اكل كتير وبنشرب عصير
english: We eat a lot of food and drink juice.
transliteration: Ehna benakl akl keteer we benashrab aseer

arabic: انا سعيد اوي واختي سعيدة كمان
english: I am very happy and my sister is happy too.
transliteration: Ana sa'eed awi we okhty sa'eeda kaman

arabic: انا في القهوة
english: I am at the cafe.
transliteration: Ana fel ahwa

arabic: انا قاعد مستني صاحبي
english: I am sitting waiting for my friend.
transliteration: Ana aa'ed mestanni sahby

arabic: الجرسون جه وقال عايز ايه
english: The waiter came and said 'What do you want?'
transliteration: El garsoon geh we aal 'Ayiz eh?'

arabic: انا قولت واحد قهوة من فضلك
english: I said 'One coffee please'.
transliteration: Ana olt wahed ahwa min fadlak

arabic: دلوقتي انا مستني القهوة وصاحبي
english: Now I am waiting for the coffee and my friend.
transliteration: Delwa'ty ana mestanni el ahwa we sahby

arabic: ماما جابت حاجة جديدة للبيت من المحل بس كانت صغيرة شوية
english: Mama brought a new thing for the house from the shop, but it was a bit small.
transliteration: Mama gaabet 7aga gdeeda lelbeet men elma7al bas kanet soghayyara shwayya

arabic: انا قلت ليها انا عايز ارجع الحاجة دي يا ماما مش مشكلة
english: I told her, "I want to return this thing, Mom, no problem."
transliteration: Ana olt leeha ana 3ayez aragga3 el7aga di ya mama mesh moshkela

arabic: روحت المحل و قلت للبايع انا عايز ارجع الحاجة دي معلش
english: I went to the shop and told the seller, "I want to return this thing, sorry."
transliteration: Ro7t elma7al w olt lelba2e3 ana 3ayez aragga3 el7aga di ma3lesh

arabic: هو كان كويس اوي و رجعلي الفلوس كلها في ساعتها
english: He was very good and returned all the money to me immediately.
transliteration: Howa kan kwayyes awi w ragga3li elfeloos kollaha fe sa3etha

arabic: ماما فرحت اوي و قالتلي شكرا يا حبيبي انت كويس اوي
english: Mama was very happy and told me, "Thank you, my dear, you are very good."
transliteration: Mama fer7et awi w 2aletli shokran ya habibi enta kwayyes awi

arabic: النهاردة فيه مطر كتير
english: Today there is a lot of rain.
transliteration: Ennaharda feeh matar keteer.

arabic: انا قاعد في البيت دلوقتي
english: I am sitting at home now.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed fi el-bayt delwa'ti.

arabic: انا عايز اشرب شاي سخن
english: I want to drink hot tea.
transliteration: Ana ayiz ashrab shay sokhn.

arabic: قطتي نايمة على الكرسي الصغير
english: My cat is sleeping on the small chair.
transliteration: O'Tati nayma 'ala el-kursi es-soghayyar.

arabic: ده يوم حلو ومبسوط في البيت
english: This is a nice and happy day at home.
transliteration: Dah yom helw w mabsoot fi el-bayt.

arabic: انا اشتريت حاجة امبارح
english: I bought something yesterday.
transliteration: Ana ishtareet haga embaareh.

arabic: انهاردة عايز ارجعها للمحل
english: Today I want to return it to the shop.
transliteration: Ennaharda ayiz aragga'ha lel mahall.

arabic: روحت المحل تاني
english: I went to the shop again.
transliteration: Roht el mahall taany.

arabic: قلت للبياع انا عايز ارجع ده
english: I told the seller, "I want to return this."
transliteration: Olt lel bayya' ana ayiz aragga' da.

arabic: هو قال لي لا ده مش المحل بتاعنا
english: He told me, "No, this is not our shop."
transliteration: Howa 'al li la da mesh el mahall beta'na.

arabic: كنا بنعمل كشري للعشا بس طعمها كان مختلف شوية
english: We were making koshary for dinner, but its taste was a little different this time.
transliteration: Konna bene3mel koshary lel asha bas ta3maha kan mokhtalef shwayya

arabic: ماما كانت قلقانة طول الوقت إنها متطلعش حلوة زي كل مرة
english: Mom was worried all the time that it wouldn't turn out as good as every time.
transliteration: Mama kanet al2ana tool el wa't enaha ma tetla3sh helwa zayy kol marra

arabic: بابا جه وطلب يدوقها عشان يعرف ايه المشكلة
english: Dad came and asked to taste it to know what the problem was.
transliteration: Baba geh we talab yedu'ha ashan ye3raf eh el moshkela

arabic: حسيت بفرحة كبيرة لما شوفتهم بيحلوا المشكلة مع بعض
english: I felt a great joy when I saw them solving the problem together.
transliteration: Hasset befarha kebira lamma shoftohom beyhellu el moshkela ma3 ba3d

arabic: قررت ماما نجيب مكون مختلف وبابا راح للبياع يجيبه بسرعة
english: Mom decided we should get a different ingredient, and Dad went to the seller to bring it quickly.
transliteration: Qarrart Mama negeeb mokawwen mokhtalef we Baba rah lel bayya3 yegeebo besor3a

arabic: امي اشترت فاكهة من السوق
english: My mother bought fruit from the market
transliteration: Ommy eshtaret fakha men el soo'

arabic: لما رجعت البيت لقت ان فيه كام واحدة مش كويسة
english: When she returned home, she found that a few pieces were not good
transliteration: Lamma rege'et el bayt la'et en fee kam waheda mesh kwayesa

arabic: قالتلي يلا بينا نرجع للمحل
english: She told me Let's go back to the shop
transliteration: A'aletli yalla bina nerga' lel mahal

arabic: صاحب المحل غير الفاكهة على طول من غير اي كلام
english: The shop owner immediately replaced the fruit without any discussion
transliteration: Saheb el mahal ghayyar el fakha 'ala tool men gheir ay kalam

arabic: احنا بنحب الكرم ده في مصر
english: We love this generosity in Egypt
transliteration: Ehna benhebb el karam da fi Masr

arabic: شفت جارتي النهاردة
english: I saw my neighbor today.
transliteration: Shoft garti en-naharda.

arabic: قلتلها صباح الخير
english: I told her "Good morning".
transliteration: Oltelha sabah el kheer.

arabic: قالتلي صباح النور ازيك
english: She told me "Good morning, how are you?".
transliteration: Qaletli sabah el noor izzayik.

arabic: قلتلها الحمد لله كويسة
english: I told her "Thank God, I am fine".
transliteration: Oltelha alhamdulillah kwayyisa.

arabic: احنا اتكلمنا شوية
english: We talked a little.
transliteration: Ehna etkallimna showayya.

arabic: صباح الخير يا ام محمود كيفك النهاردة
english: Good morning, Umm Mahmoud, how are you today?
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya Om Mahmoud, keifek el naharda?

arabic: يا صباح الفل يا ام حسن انا تمام الحمد لله
english: Lovely morning, Umm Hassan, I'm good, praise be to God.
transliteration: Ya sabah el foll ya Om Hassan, ana tammam el hamdulillah.

arabic: عندي مشكلة صغيرة في الشقة يا ام محمود
english: I have a small problem in the apartment, Umm Mahmoud.
transliteration: Andy moshkela soghayara fel sha'a ya Om Mahmoud.

arabic: ايه ده ايه المشكلة الجديدة
english: What is this? What's the new problem?
transliteration: Eih da? Eih el moshkela el gedida?

arabic: القط بتاعك بياكل الورد بتاعي كل يوم
english: Your cat eats my flowers every day!
transliteration: El ott beta'ek byakl el ward beta'y kol youm!

arabic: كل يوم الصبح بصحى بدري عشان الشغل
english: Every day in the morning I wake up early for work.
transliteration: Kull yoom el-sobh bas'ha badry 3ashan el-shoghl.

arabic: بلبس قميص ابيض وبنطلون اسود
english: I wear a white shirt and black pants.
transliteration: Balbes amees abyaḍ w bantaloon aswad.

arabic: بعد الشغل انا عايزة اشتري حاجات جديدة
english: After work I want to buy new things.
transliteration: Ba3d el-shoghl ana aayza ashtry hagaat gedida.

arabic: رحت السوق وسالت البياع على فستان ازرق
english: I went to the market and asked the seller for a blue dress.
transliteration: Roht el-soo' w sa'alt el-bayaa3 3ala fostan azra'.

arabic: كان الفستان مش غالي كان رخيص قوي وضحكت
english: The dress was not expensive, it was very cheap and I laughed.
transliteration: Kan el-fostan mesh ghali kan rakheeṣ qawi w dehekt.

arabic: الدنيا بتمطر برا البيت دلوقتي
english: It's raining outside the house now.
transliteration: El donya bitmatar barra el beit dilwa'ty.

arabic: جدتي قاعدة بتقرا كتابها القديم
english: My grandmother is sitting reading her old book.
transliteration: Giddety qa'ida bit'ara kitabha el 'adeem.

arabic: اختي الصغيرة قاعدة ماسكة تليفونها الجديد
english: My little sister is sitting holding her new phone.
transliteration: Okhty el soghayara qa'ida mas'ka tilifonha el gideed.

arabic: هي بتحب تتفرج على فيديوهات كتير
english: She likes to watch many videos.
transliteration: Heya bithebb titfarrag 'ala videohat kiteer.

arabic: كل واحد عنده حاجة مختلفة بيحبها في البيت
english: Everyone has a different thing they like at home.
transliteration: Kull wahed 'ando haga mokhtalefa biyhebbaha fel beit.

arabic: انا بصحي بدري كل يوم
english: I wake up early every day.
transliteration: Ana basaha badry kol yawm

arabic: بشرب قهوة بسرعة وبعدين بفطر
english: I drink coffee quickly and then I eat breakfast.
transliteration: Bashrab ahwa besor'a w ba'dein baftar

arabic: بجهز شنطتي وبلبس هدومي
english: I prepare my bag and wear my clothes.
transliteration: Bagahez shanteti w balbes hedomi

arabic: مفيش وقت كتير دلوقتي
english: There isn't much time now.
transliteration: Mafish wa't ketir delwa'ti

arabic: يلا رايح الشغل
english: Let's go to work.
transliteration: Yalla rayeh el shoghl

arabic: خطوبة أختي قربت وبنحتفل كل يوم بخطة جديدة للحفلة
english: My sister's engagement is approaching and every day we celebrate with a new plan for the party.
transliteration: Khotoubet okhty arrabet w benhetfel kol youm be khotta gedida lelhafla.

arabic: المشكلة إن مفيش حد فينا بيرضى على أي كيكة وخصوصا أخويا اللي لازم يدوقها عشرين مرة
english: The problem is that none of us approves of any cake, especially my brother who must taste it twenty times.
transliteration: El moshkela en mafish had fina biyirda 3ala ay keika w khosousan akhouya elli lazim yedu'ha 3eshreen marra.

arabic: أنا حسيت إن كل كيكة بندوقها طعمها مختلف عن اللي قبلها
english: I felt that every cake we tasted had a different flavor than the one before it.
transliteration: Ana hasset en kol keika bendou'ha ta3maha mokhtalef 3an elli abliha.

arabic: ماما بتقول لو الكيكة متطلعش حلوة هنضطر ارجعها للمحل
english: Mom says if the cake doesn't turn out good, we'll have to return it to the shop.
transliteration: Mama bet'oul law el keika ma tetla3sh helwa hanedtar aragga'ha lel mahal.

arabic: طول اليوم بنفكر في التفاصيل الصغيرة ومركزة عشان الحفلة تكون مثالية
english: All day we think about the small details and I am focused so the party can be perfect.
transliteration: Tool el youm benfakar fel tafaseel el soghayara w merakkaza 3ashan el hafla takoun methaliya.

arabic: انا صحيت بدري النهارده
english: I woke up early today.
transliteration: Ana saheet badri ennaharda.

arabic: انا لبست بسرعة
english: I got dressed quickly.
transliteration: Ana libist besor'a.

arabic: انا شربت قهوة واكلت فطار صغير
english: I drank coffee and ate a small breakfast.
transliteration: Ana sherebt ahwa wa akalt fetar soghayar.

arabic: انا نزلت من البيت عشان اروح الشغل
english: I left the house to go to work.
transliteration: Ana nezelt men elbeit 'ashan arooh esh-shoghl.

arabic: الشارع كان زحمة ناس كتير
english: The street was crowded with many people.
transliteration: Esh-shari' kan zahma nas kiteer.

arabic: كان فيه مشكلة كبيرة في البيت النهاردة
english: There was a big problem at home today.
transliteration: Kan feh moshkela kibeera fel bayt elnaharda

arabic: امي قالت مفيش فاكهة ولا خضار كفاية
english: My mother said there's not enough fruit or vegetables.
transliteration: Ommy alet mafish fakha wala khodaar kefaya

arabic: احنا بنحب الاكل الصحي بس لازم نشتري اكتر
english: We love healthy food but we need to buy more.
transliteration: Ehna benhebb elakl elsehhy bas lazim neshtary aktar

arabic: يلا بينا نروح السوق دلوقتي بسرعة
english: Let's go to the market right now quickly.
transliteration: Yalla bena nrooh elsoo' delwa'ty besor'a

arabic: بابا كان عايز ينام بس دلوقتي هيشيل الشنط التقيلة
english: Dad wanted to sleep but now he'll carry the heavy bags.
transliteration: Baba kan 'ayez yanam bas delwa'ty hayesheel elshanat elte'eela

arabic: سارة فرحانة اوي عشان عيد ميلادها بكرة
english: Sara is very happy because her birthday is tomorrow.
transliteration: Sara far7aana awi 3ashan 3eid miladha bokra.

arabic: منى قالت لها كل سنة وانتي طيبة يا سارة
english: Mona told her 'Happy birthday, Sara'.
transliteration: Mona qalet laha kol sana wenti tayeba ya Sara.

arabic: سارة ردت وقالت شكرا يا منى الحفلة في البيت
english: Sara replied, 'Thank you, Mona, the party is at home'.
transliteration: Sara raddet we qalet shokran ya Mona el 7afla fel beit.

arabic: منى سألت هو فيه تورتة كبيرة وحلوة
english: Mona asked, 'Will there be a big and beautiful cake?'
transliteration: Mona sa2alet howa fee torta kabeera we 7elwa?

arabic: سارة قالت ايوه اكيد تورتة جميلة وهدايا كمان
english: Sara said, 'Yes, certainly, a beautiful cake and gifts too'.
transliteration: Sara qalet aywa akeed torta gameela we hadaya kaman.

arabic: انا رايح السوق النهاردة
english: I am going to the market today.
transliteration: Ana rayeh el souq el naharda.

arabic: عايز اشتري خضار وفاكهة
english: I want to buy vegetables and fruit.
transliteration: Ayiz ashtari khodaar w fakiha.

arabic: السوق فيه حاجات طازة كتير
english: The market has many fresh things.
transliteration: El souq feeh hagaat taaza keteer.

arabic: بشم ريحة فاكهة جميلة
english: I smell a beautiful fruit smell.
transliteration: Bashomm reehet fakiha gameela.

arabic: اليوم جميل في السوق
english: The day is beautiful at the market.
transliteration: El youm gameel fel souq.

arabic: يلا يا امي نروح السوق الكبير عشان نشتري فاكهة وخضار طازة
english: Let's go, my mother, to the big market to buy fresh fruit and vegetables.
transliteration: Yalla ya ommy nrooh el soo' el kibeer 'ashan neshtary fakha we khodaar tazza

arabic: بنحب نشتري حاجتنا من هناك دايما
english: We always love to buy our things from there.
transliteration: Benhebb neshtary hagetna men henak dayman

arabic: بس واحنا راجعين تهنا شوية في السوق الكبير
english: But while we were returning, we got a little lost in the big market.
transliteration: Bas we ehna rag'een tehna shwaya fel soo' el kibeer

arabic: امي سألت راجل طيب وقالت لو سمحت يا عمو بيت اهلي فين
english: My mother asked a kind man and said 'Excuse me uncle, where is my family's house?'
transliteration: Ommy sa'alet ragel tayeb we 'alet law samaht ya 'ammu bayt ahly fein

arabic: هو ابتسم وورانا الطريق للبيت بسرعة
english: He smiled and showed us the way home quickly.
transliteration: Howa ebtasam we warana el taree' lel bayt besor'a

arabic: كان فيه ولد صغير اسمه علي
english: There was a small boy named Ali.
transliteration: Kan feeh walad saghir esmo Ali.
storyTitle: The Little Boy and the Questions

arabic: علي بيسأل جده ليه السما زرقا
english: Ali asks his grandfather why the sky is blue.
transliteration: Ali byes'al geddo leih es-sama zarqa.
storyTitle: The Little Boy and the Questions

arabic: جده كبير قال زمان مكنش فيه اسئلة كتير كده
english: His old grandfather said in the past there weren't many questions like this.
transliteration: Geddo kabeer 'al zaman makansh feeh as'ela keteer keda.
storyTitle: The Little Boy and the Questions

arabic: علي سأل جده ايه الفرق بين زمان ودلوقتي
english: Ali asked his grandfather what is the difference between the past and now.
transliteration: Ali sa'al geddo eih el-far' bein zaman we delwa'ti.
storyTitle: The Little Boy and the Questions

arabic: جده قال يا علي انا تعبت من الكلام ده
english: His grandfather said, "Oh Ali, I'm tired of this talk."
transliteration: Geddo 'al ya Ali ana te'ebt men el-kalam dah.
storyTitle: The Little Boy and the Questions

arabic: النهاردة انا هزور خالتي
english: Today I will visit my aunt.
transliteration: Elnaharda ana hazor khalty.

arabic: روحت عندها بالعربية
english: I went to her by car.
transliteration: Roht 'andaha bel'arabeya.

arabic: سلمت عليها وقولت ازيك يا خالتي
english: I greeted her and said 'How are you, my aunt?'
transliteration: Sallamt 'aleha we olt ezzayek ya khalty.

arabic: هي عملتلي شاي وكيك
english: She made me tea and cake.
transliteration: Heya 'amaletly shay we keek.

arabic: قضيت وقت حلو معاها ورجعت البيت
english: I spent a nice time with her and returned home.
transliteration: Addeit wa't helw ma'aha we rega't elbeet.

arabic: انا رحت الاستاد امبارح
english: I went to the stadium yesterday.
transliteration: Ana roht el-estad embareh.

arabic: كانت ماتش كورة حلوة اوي
english: It was a very nice football match.
transliteration: Kanet match kora helwa awi.

arabic: صاحبي قال لي الفريق بتاعنا كسب
english: My friend told me our team won.
transliteration: Sahbi 'al-li el-fari' beta'na keseb.

arabic: انا كنت مبسوط جدا بالنتيجة
english: I was very happy with the result.
transliteration: Ana kont mabsoot geddan bel-neteeja.

arabic: هنروح ماتش تاني قريب ان شاء الله
english: We will go to another match soon, God willing.
transliteration: Hanrooh match tani 'orayyeb insha'allah.

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد منى
english: Today is Mona's birthday
transliteration: Elnaharda eid milad Mona

arabic: أصدقائها عملوا حفلة ليها
english: Her friends made a party for her
transliteration: Asdeqaa'aha amalu hafla leeha

arabic: التورتة كانت كبيرة وشكلها غريب شوية
english: The cake was big and looked a bit strange
transliteration: El torta kanet kabeera we shaklaha ghareeb shwaya

arabic: كلهم غنوا وضحكوا كتير
english: They all sang and laughed a lot
transliteration: Kolluhum ghannu we daheku keteer

arabic: واحد منهم وقع على الارض بس التورتة كانت سليمة
english: One of them fell on the ground but the cake was safe
transliteration: Wahed minhum weqa' ala el ard bas el torta kanet saleema

arabic: سارة و احمد عايزين يعملوا فرح كبير
english: Sara and Ahmed want to have a big wedding.
transliteration: Sara w Ahmed ayzeen ya'meloo farah kabeer.

arabic: بكرة هنروح نشوف قاعة
english: Tomorrow we will go see a hall.
transliteration: Bokra hanrooh neshoof qa'a.

arabic: ايه رايك في اللون ده يا احمد
english: "What do you think of this color, Ahmed?"
transliteration: "Eih ra'yak fi el loon da ya Ahmed?"

arabic: احمد قال اللون ده حلو اوي
english: Ahmed said, "This color is very nice."
transliteration: Ahmed 'al "el loon da helw awi."

arabic: الفرح ده مهم لينا و محتاج فلوس كتير
english: This wedding is important to us and needs a lot of money.
transliteration: El farah da mohem leena w mehtag felous keteer.

arabic: امبارح رحت ازور قريبي
english: Yesterday I went to visit my relative.
transliteration: Embaareh roht azoor areebi.

arabic: بيتهم مش بعيد من بيتنا
english: Their house is not far from our house.
transliteration: Beit'hom mesh ba'eed men beitna.

arabic: لما وصلت كانوا سعداء جدا انهم شافوني
english: When I arrived, they were very happy to see me.
transliteration: Lamma wasalt kaanu so'adaa' giddan ennahom shaafuuni.

arabic: شربنا شاي واكلنا كحك كتير مع بعض
english: We drank tea and ate a lot of cookies together.
transliteration: Sheribna shay w akalna ka'hk kiteer ma' ba'd.

arabic: كان وقت جميل قوي مع العيلة
english: It was a very beautiful time with the family.
transliteration: Kaan wa't gameel 'awee ma' el'eila.

arabic: انا بصحى بدري كل يوم
english: I wake up early every day.
transliteration: Ana bas'ha badri koll yom

arabic: بشرب قهوة بسرعة وبعدين باكل فطار خفيف
english: I drink coffee quickly, then I eat a light breakfast.
transliteration: Bashrab ahwa be-sor'a w ba'dein bakol fetar khafif

arabic: بعدين بلبس هدومي وبجهز شنطتي للشغل
english: Then I put on my clothes and prepare my bag for work.
transliteration: Ba'dein balbes hedoumi w ba'gahez shanteti lel shoghl

arabic: الوقت بيجري بسرعة الصبح
english: Time passes quickly in the morning.
transliteration: El wa't beyegri be-sor'a el sobh

arabic: انا بروح الشغل عشان عندي شغل كتير
english: I go to work because I have a lot of work.
transliteration: Ana barouh el shoghl 'ashan 'andi shoghl keteir

arabic: صباح الخير يا جارتي ازيك
english: Good morning, my neighbor, how are you?
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya garti izzayek

arabic: انا كويسة الحمد لله وانتي عاملة ايه
english: I am good, thank God, and how are you?
transliteration: Ana kwayyesa el hamdulillah w enty amla eh

arabic: انا كويسة بس شقتك الجديدة حلوة اوي
english: I am good, but your new apartment is very beautiful.
transliteration: Ana kwayyesa bas sha'etak el gedida helwa awi

arabic: شقتي الجديدة دي مش جديدة دي شقتي القديمة
english: My new apartment? This is not new, this is my old apartment.
transliteration: Sha'eti el gedida di mesh gedida di sha'eti el adeema

arabic: ايه ده انا بتكلم على شقة تانية خالص
english: What is this? I am talking about a completely different apartment.
transliteration: Eih da ana batkallam ala sha'a tanya khales

arabic: امبارح رحت محل كبير
english: Yesterday, I went to a big shop.
transliteration: Imbaareh roht maHal kibeer

arabic: كنت عايزة اشتري هدوم جديدة
english: I wanted to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Kont 3ayza eshtari hedoom gdeeda

arabic: شفت فستان احمر حلو وقمصان بالوان كتير جميلة
english: I saw a beautiful red dress and many shirts with nice colors.
transliteration: Shoft fustaan ahmar helw w omsan be'alwaan keteer gameela

arabic: جربت الفستان كان مظبوط عليا
english: I tried on the dress, it fit me perfectly.
transliteration: Garabt el fustaan kaan mazboot 3alaya

arabic: اشتريته وكنت مبسوطة جدا النهاردة
english: I bought it and I was very happy today.
transliteration: Eshtareetoh w kont mabsoota giddan el naharda

arabic: سارة طفلة صغيرة بتحب تسأل كتير
english: Sara is a small child who loves to ask a lot.
transliteration: Sara tefla soghayara bethebb tes'al keteer

arabic: كل يوم الصبح ماما تقول عندي قهوة شاي وعصير تحب ايه
english: Every morning Mom says "I have coffee, tea, and juice. What do you like?"
transliteration: Koll yom el sobh mama ta'ool a'andy ahwa shay wa a'seer teheb eh

arabic: سارة تسأل ممكن اشرب اي حاجة تانية
english: Sara asks "Can I drink anything else?"
transliteration: Sara tes'al mumkin ashrab ay haga tanya

arabic: ماما تقول ايوه عندي عصير برتقال وعصير تفاح
english: Mom says "Yes, I have orange juice and apple juice."
transliteration: Mama ta'ool aywa a'andy a'aseer borto'aal wa a'aseer toffaah

arabic: سارة تسأل هو العصير بخمسين جنيه
english: Sara asks "Is the juice fifty pounds?"
transliteration: Sara tes'al howa el a'seer bekhamsin geneh

arabic: صباح الخير يا ماما احنا رايحين نشتري هدوم جديدة
english: Good morning mom, we are going to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer ya mama eḥna rayḥeen neshtiri hedoom gedeeda.
storyTitle: A Shopping Day at the Market

arabic: رحنا السوق الكبير نشوف المحلات
english: We went to the big market to see the shops.
transliteration: Roḥna es-sooʾ el-kabeer neshoof el-maḥallat.
storyTitle: A Shopping Day at the Market

arabic: السلام عليكم عمو ممكن اشوف الفستان ده
english: Hello uncle, can I see this dress?
transliteration: As-salamu alaykum ammo mumkin ashoof el-fustan da?
storyTitle: A Shopping Day at the Market

arabic: قال عمو وعليكم السلام وعملنا فصال على السعر
english: Uncle said, 'And upon you be peace,' and we bargained on the price.
transliteration: ʾAl ammo wa alaykum as-salam we ʿamalna feṣal ʿala es-seʿr.
storyTitle: A Shopping Day at the Market

arabic: اشتريت فستان جميل وقلت شكرا مع السلامة
english: I bought a beautiful dress and said thank you, goodbye.
transliteration: Eshtarait fustan gameel we ʾolt shukran maʿ es-salama.
storyTitle: A Shopping Day at the Market

arabic: النهاردة قررت اعمل اكلة جديدة اول مرة
english: Today I decided to make a new dish for the first time.
transliteration: El-naharda qarrart a'mel akla gedida awwel marra.

arabic: كنت متحمسة اوي بس قلقت شوية
english: I was very excited but a little worried.
transliteration: Kont metḥammisa awi bas qalaqt shwayya.

arabic: غلطتي اني نسيت مكون مهم في الوصفة
english: My mistake was that I forgot an important ingredient in the recipe.
transliteration: Ghalaṭti enni nesīt mokawwen mohemm fel-waṣfa.

arabic: الاكلة طلعت شكلها غريب شوية بس طعمها حلو
english: The dish looked a bit strange, but its taste was good.
transliteration: El-akla ṭelʿet shaklaha gharīb shwayya bas ṭaʿmaha ḥelw.

arabic: انا موافقة اعملها تاني اكيد المرة الجاية هتبقى احسن
english: I agree to make it again, next time it will definitely be better.
transliteration: Ana mowāfeʾa aʿmelha tāni akīd el-marra el-gayya hatibʾa aḥsan.

arabic: تليفوني رن بصوت عالي و رديت عليها
english: My phone rang loudly and I answered her.
transliteration: Telefony rann besoot aaly we radeit aleiha
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: صاحبتي قالت لي يلا نروح السوق الكبير النهاردة
english: My friend told me "Let's go to the big market today!"
transliteration: Sahabty qaletly yalla nrooh el soo' el kibeer el naharda
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: قلت لها ماشي بس محتاجين نشتري خضار وفاكهة لامي في البيت
english: I told her "Okay, but we need to buy vegetables and fruit for my mother at home."
transliteration: Oltelha mashy bas mehtageen neshtary khodaar we fakha le ommy fel bayt
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: هي سألت بكام التفاح هناك يا رب يكون طازة
english: She asked "How much are the apples there? I hope they are fresh."
transliteration: Heya sa'alet bekam el toffah henak ya rabb yekoon tazza
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: رديت معرفش بس بنحب نروح السوق ده عشان دايما زحمة وحاجته حلوة
english: I replied "I don't know, but we love going to that market because it's always busy and has good things."
transliteration: Raddet ma'rafsh bas benhebb nrooh el soo' da ashan dayman zahma we hageto helwa
storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

arabic: تليفون صاحبي رن فجأة الصبح
english: My friend's phone rang suddenly in the morning.
transliteration: Telephon ṣaḥby rann fagʾa el-ṣobḥ

arabic: رديت وقولت ايوا يا حبيبي صباح الخير
english: I answered and said 'Yes, my dear, good morning'.
transliteration: Raddayt w ʾolt 'aywa ya ḥabibi ṣabaḥ el-kheer'

arabic: هو بيتكلم بسرعة اوي وبيقول انا عايز اكل كشري حالا
english: He's talking very fast and saying 'I want to eat Koshary right now'.
transliteration: Howwa beyetkallem besorʿa awy w beyʾool 'ana ʿayez akol koshary ḥalan'

arabic: انا ضحكت وقولتله انت دايما جعان يا صاحبي
english: I laughed and told him 'You are always hungry, my friend'.
transliteration: Ana ḍeḥekt w ʾoltelo 'enta dayman gaʿaan ya ṣaḥby'

arabic: قولتله طيب يلا بينا نروح ناكل دلوقتي
english: I told him 'Okay, let's go eat now'.
transliteration: ʾOltelo 'ṭayyeb yalla bina nerooḥ nakol delwaʾty'

arabic: انا بفكر في اجازة نهاية الاسبوع
english: I am thinking about the weekend holiday.
transliteration: Ana bafakar fi agaza nihayet el usbua.

arabic: انا عايز اروح مع صحابي مكان جديد
english: I want to go with my friends to a new place.
transliteration: Ana ayiz aruh maa sahabi makan gedid.

arabic: يمكن نروح يوم الجمعة او السبت
english: Maybe we will go on Friday or Saturday.
transliteration: Yomken nuruh youm el gomaa aw el sabt.

arabic: هنتكلم بالليل بخصوص المشوار
english: We will talk tonight about the trip.
transliteration: Hanetkallim belleil bekhosus el mashwar.

arabic: انا بحب الرحلة مع صحابي
english: I love the trip with my friends.
transliteration: Ana baheb el rehla maa sahabi.

arabic: النهاردة الصبح نزلت السوق الشعبي اللي قريب من بيتنا
english: This morning I went down to the popular market near our house.
transliteration: En-naharda es-sobḥ nezelt es-souq esh-sha'aby elly ʾarayyeb men beitna.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Popular Market

arabic: السوق كان مليان ناس وكل واحد بيفاصل على سعر الخضار والفاكهة
english: The market was full of people and everyone was bargaining over the price of vegetables and fruits.
transliteration: Es-souq kān malyān nās we koll wāḥed biyefāṣel ʿala seʿr el-khoḍār wel-fākha.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Popular Market

arabic: شفت جارتي أم أحمد وسلمت عليها بحرارة وسألنا على بعض
english: I saw my neighbor Umm Ahmed and greeted her warmly, and we asked about each other.
transliteration: Shoft gārti ʾom ʾAḥmad we sallamt ʿaleihā beḥarāra we saʾalna ʿala baʿḍ.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Popular Market

arabic: هي نصحتني أشتري جبنة قديمة من عم سعيد عشان جبنته حلوة أوي
english: She advised me to buy old cheese from Uncle Sa'eed because his cheese is very good.
transliteration: Heyya naṣaḥetni ashtari gebna ʾadīma men ʿamm Saʿīd ʿashān gebneto ḥelwa ʾawi.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Popular Market

arabic: اشتريت الحاجات اللي عايزها ورجعت البيت مبسوطة من الزحمة والجو الجميل
english: I bought the things I wanted and returned home happy with the crowd and the beautiful atmosphere.
transliteration: Eshtarēt el-ḥāgāt elly ʿāyezha we regaʿt el-beit mabsūṭa men ez-zaḥma wel-gaww el-gamīl.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Popular Market

arabic: كل يوم جمعة انا بروح السوق البلدي مع امي
english: Every Friday, I go to the local market with my mom.
transliteration: Kol youm gom'a ana baruuh el soo' el baladi ma'a ommy
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: هناك بنشوف خضار وفاكهة كتير وناس بتشتري وتتكلم
english: There, we see a lot of vegetables and fruits, and people buying and talking.
transliteration: Henaak banashuuf khodaar we fakha keteer we naas batashtary we titkallem
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: امي بتحب تتكلم مع البياعين عشان تعرف احسن الاسعار
english: My mom likes to talk with the sellers to know the best prices.
transliteration: Ommy betehebb titkallem ma'a el bayya'een 'ashaan ta'raf ahsan el as'aar
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: بعد ما بنشتري انا باكل سندويتش طعمية سخن من عربية الفول
english: After we buy, I eat a hot ta'ameya sandwich from the fava bean cart.
transliteration: Ba'd ma banashtary ana baakol sandwich ta'ameya sokhn men 'arabeyet el fool
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: السوق مكان جميل ومليان حياة وكل الناس بتعمل شوبينج مبسوطة
english: The market is a beautiful place full of life, and everyone is happily doing their shopping.
transliteration: El soo' makaan gameel we malyaan hayaat we kol el naas beta'mel shopping mabsoota
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع امبارح وكنت سرحان في افكاري
english: I was walking in the street yesterday, lost in my thoughts
transliteration: Kunt maashy fel shaare' embaareh w kunt sarhaan fi afkaary

arabic: فجأة لمحت وش حد اعرفه من زمان
english: Suddenly I spotted a face I've known for a long time
transliteration: Faga'a lamaht wish hadd a'rafo men zamaan

arabic: قربت عشان اسلم عليه وطلع صاحبي احمد اللي مشفتهوش من سنين
english: I approached to greet him, and it turned out to be my friend Ahmed, whom I hadn't seen in years
transliteration: Arrabet 'ashan asallem 'aleih we tala' saahby Ahmed elle ma shuftuhush men sneen

arabic: قعدنا نتكلم شوية عن شغلنا وحياتنا وكل واحد فينا حكى التاني عمل ايه
english: We sat and talked a bit about our work and lives, and each of us told the other what they had been doing
transliteration: Qa'adna netkallem shwaya 'an shoghlana w hayaatna we koll wahed feena haka el taany 'amel eh

arabic: وفي الاخر اكتشفت ان اللي قدامي ده مش احمد اصلا ده توأمه اللي كان عايش بره البلد
english: And in the end, I discovered that the person in front of me wasn't Ahmed at all, but his twin brother who had been living abroad
transliteration: We fel akher ektashaft enn elli oddaami da mesh Ahmed aslan da taw'amo elli kaan 'aayesh barra el balad

arabic: صحيت الصبح بدري وروحت السوق البلدي كان الهوا لطيف وشمس الصبح داخلة
english: I woke up early in the morning and went to the local market; the air was pleasant and the morning sun was coming in.
transliteration: Sahyt el sobh badry w roht el souq el balady kan el hawa latif w shams el sobh dakhla.
storyTitle: A Day at the Local Market

arabic: اول ما دخلت شميت ريحة الفاكهة والخضار الطازة وسمعت صوت الباعة بيعيطوا
english: As soon as I entered, I smelled the fresh fruits and vegetables and heard the vendors shouting.
transliteration: Awl ma dakalt shameet rehet el fawakeh w el khodar el tazza w sam3et sowt el ba'a'a bey3ayato.
storyTitle: A Day at the Local Market

arabic: الطماطم كانت حمرا اوي وبتلمع والخس كان اخضر غامق زي الورد
english: The tomatoes were very red and shining, and the lettuce was dark green like roses.
transliteration: El tamatem kanet hamra awy w betlame3 w el khass kan akhdar ghameq zay el ward.
storyTitle: A Day at the Local Market

arabic: اشتريت من كل حاجة نص كيلو والراجل اداني كوسة زيادة عشان انا زبونة قديمة
english: I bought half a kilo of everything, and the man gave me extra zucchini because I am an old customer.
transliteration: Eshtereet men kol haga noss kilo w el raagel edani kosa zeyada 3ashan ana zabona qadeema.
storyTitle: A Day at the Local Market

arabic: رجعت البيت وانا فرحانة اوي والشقايل مليانة خير من السوق اللي جنب البيت
english: I returned home very happy and the bags were full of goodness from the market next to the house.
transliteration: Raj3et el beit w ana farhana awy w el shakayel malyana kher men el souq elli gamb el beit.
storyTitle: A Day at the Local Market

arabic: صحيت النهاردة الصبح بدري وفكرت في اجازة اخر الاسبوع
english: I woke up early this morning and thought about the weekend holiday.
transliteration: Saḥīt en-nahārda eṣ-ṣobḥ badrī we fakart fī igāzet ākhir el-osbūʿ.

arabic: كلمت صاحبتي سارة عشان نشوف هنعمل ايه
english: I called my friend Sarah to see what we would do.
transliteration: Kallimt ṣaḥibtī Sāra ʿashān nishūf haneʿmel ēh.

arabic: سارة كانت عايزة نروح البحر وانا كنت عايزة نروح الجبل
english: Sarah wanted to go to the sea and I wanted to go to the mountain.
transliteration: Sāra kānet ʿayza nerūḥ el-baḥr wana kont ʿayza nerūḥ el-gabal.

arabic: عملنا تصويت سريع عشان نختار المكان اللي هنروحه
english: We did a quick vote to choose the place we would go.
transliteration: ʿAmalnā taṣwīt sarīʿ ʿashān nekhtār el-makān ellī hanerūḥo.

arabic: قررنا نروح البحر عشان الجو حلو وهنرجع يوم الاحد بالليل
english: We decided to go to the sea because the weather is nice and we will return on Sunday night.
transliteration: Qarrarnā nerūḥ el-baḥr ʿashān el-gaww ḥelw wa hanergaʿ yōm el-Aḥad bel-lēl.

arabic: النهاردة انا و جدتي روحنا السوق
english: Today, I and my grandmother went to the market.
transliteration: Elnaharda ana w geddeti rohna el souk

arabic: هي بتحب تشتري خضار و فاكهة
english: She likes to buy vegetables and fruit.
transliteration: Heya bethebb teshtari khodar w fakha

arabic: جدتي بتسال عن السعر القديم
english: My grandmother asks about the old price.
transliteration: Geddeti betes'al 'an el se'r el adim

arabic: انا بشوف حاجات جديدة و هي بتقول لا
english: I see new things and she says "no".
transliteration: Ana bashoof hagāt gedida w heya beta'ol la

arabic: السوق فيه ناس كتير لكن الاذواق مختلفة
english: The market has many people but the tastes are different.
transliteration: El souk fih nas keteer laken el azwa' mokhtalefa

arabic: النهاردة الصبح صحيت بدري
english: This morning I woke up early.
transliteration: El naharda el sobh seheet badry.

arabic: كانت الاوضة ضلمة قوي
english: The room was very dark.
transliteration: Kanet el oda dalma awy.

arabic: اللمبة بايظة ومش شغالة
english: The light bulb is broken and not working.
transliteration: El lamba bayza w mish shaghala.

arabic: انا لازم اشتري لمبة جديدة
english: I must buy a new light bulb.
transliteration: Ana lazem ashtry lamba gedida.

arabic: انا هاروح السوق دلوقتي
english: I will go to the market now.
transliteration: Ana harouh el souq delwa'ty.

arabic: انا تايه هنا صباح الخير
english: I am lost here, good morning.
transliteration: Ana tayeh hena sabah el kheer
storyTitle: Getting Lost and Asking for Directions

arabic: من فضلك ممكن تساعدني
english: Please, can you help me?
transliteration: Min fadlak mumkin tesa'edni
storyTitle: Getting Lost and Asking for Directions

arabic: فين اقرب سوق
english: Where is the nearest market?
transliteration: Fein aqrab souq
storyTitle: Getting Lost and Asking for Directions

arabic: امشي على طول وبعدين يمين
english: Walk straight ahead and then right.
transliteration: Emshi 'ala tool w ba'deen yameen
storyTitle: Getting Lost and Asking for Directions

arabic: الف شكر يا فندم
english: A thousand thanks, sir/madam.
transliteration: Alf shokr ya fandam
storyTitle: Getting Lost and Asking for Directions

arabic: انا كلمت صاحبي احمد النهارده
english: I called my friend Ahmed today.
transliteration: Ana kallamt sahby Ahmad ennaharda

arabic: هو اكبر مني
english: He is older than me.
transliteration: Howa akbar menni

arabic: هو بيحب يتكلم في التليفون كتير
english: He likes to talk on the phone a lot.
transliteration: Howa byhebb yetkallem fel telefoan keteer

arabic: انا بفضل ابعت رسايل بسرعة
english: I prefer to send messages quickly.
transliteration: Ana bafaddal ab3at rasayel be sor3a

arabic: دي حاجة مختلفة بينا
english: This is a difference between us.
transliteration: Di haga mokhtalefa beina

arabic: تليفوني رن وانا فتحت الخط
english: My phone rang, and I answered the call.
transliteration: Tilifoni rann wana fataht el khat.

arabic: صاحبي احمد اتصل وانا سالته عامل ايه واهله كويسين
english: My friend Ahmed called, and I asked him how he was and if his family was well.
transliteration: Sahbi Ahmad ettasal wana sa'alto 'amel eh w ahlo kwayseen.

arabic: هو قالي انه كويس ومامته بتسلم عليا
english: He told me he was good and that his mother sends her greetings to me.
transliteration: Howa 'aly enno kwayyes w mamto betsalem alayya.

arabic: انا بحب اتكلم معاه اوي هو بيضحكني
english: I really like talking to him, he makes me laugh.
transliteration: Ana bahebb atkallem ma'ah awy howa biyidhakni.

arabic: بعد ما خلصنا كلام انا قفلت التليفون وابتسمت
english: After we finished talking, I hung up the phone and smiled.
transliteration: Ba'd ma khallasna kalam ana afalt el tilifone w ebtasamt.

arabic: النهاردة قررت اعمل اكلة جديدة في البيت
english: Today I decided to make a new dish at home.
transliteration: El Naharda qarrart a'amel akla gedida fel beit

arabic: جبت بصل وطماطم وريحتهم كانت حلوة اوي
english: I got onions and tomatoes and their smell was very nice.
transliteration: Gibt basal we tamatem we rehet'hom kanet helwa awi

arabic: حطيتهم في الحلة وسمعت صوت الطشطشة
english: I put them in the pot and heard the sizzling sound.
transliteration: Hattett'hom fel hella we sema't sot el tashtasha

arabic: الاكلة شكلها بقى جميل ولونها احمر
english: The dish's appearance became beautiful and its color red.
transliteration: El akla shaklaha ba'a gameel we lonha ahmar

arabic: دقتها وكانت طعمها لذيذ اوي
english: I tasted it and its taste was very delicious.
transliteration: Do'et'ha we kanet ta'maha laziz awi

arabic: انا رحت المحل النهاردة
english: I went to the shop today.
transliteration: Ana roht el mahall ennaharda

arabic: انا عايز ارجع الحاجة دي
english: I want to return this thing.
transliteration: Ana ayiz arga'a el haga di

arabic: هي كبيرة عليا اوي
english: It is too big for me.
transliteration: Heya kibeera 'alaya awi

arabic: الراجل في المحل اداني فلوسي
english: The man in the shop gave me my money.
transliteration: Er ragel fi el mahall eddani feloosi

arabic: انا قلت شكرا
english: I said thank you.
transliteration: Ana olt shokran

arabic: النهاردة اتفرجنا على ماتش كورة
english: Today we watched a football match.
transliteration: El naharda etfaragna ala match kora.

arabic: بابا وماما كانوا فرحانين قوي
english: Dad and Mom were very happy.
transliteration: Baba w mama kanu farhanin qawi.

arabic: الماتش كان في البيت عندنا
english: The match was at our home.
transliteration: El match kan fel beit andena.

arabic: ده كان يوم جميل مع العيلة
english: It was a beautiful day with the family.
transliteration: Da kan yom gamil ma' el 'eila.

arabic: كلنا حبينا اللعبة دي
english: We all loved this game.
transliteration: Kollena habbeina el lo'ba di.

arabic: صباح الخير يا ماما انا رايح الشغل
english: Good morning, Mom. I'm going to work.
transliteration: Sabah el kheir ya mama ana rayeh el shoghl.

arabic: بابا كمان رايح الشغل معايا
english: Dad is also going to work with me.
transliteration: Baba kaman rayeh el shoghl ma'aya.

arabic: الشغل كان كويس النهاردة
english: Work was good today.
transliteration: El shoghl kan kwayyes el naharda.

arabic: بعد الشغل روحت البيت
english: After work, I went home.
transliteration: Ba'd el shoghl roht el beit.

arabic: كنت مبسوط لما شفت ماما وبابا تاني
english: I was happy when I saw Mom and Dad again.
transliteration: Kont mabsoot lamma shoft mama w baba tani.

arabic: انا رحت السوق النهاردة
english: I went to the market today.
transliteration: Ana roht el souq el naharda.

arabic: كان فيه خضار وفاكهة كتير حلوين
english: There were a lot of fresh vegetables and fruits.
transliteration: Kan fe khodar w fakiha keteer helween.

arabic: كنت عايز اشتري فاكهة فسالت البائع
english: I wanted to buy some fruit, so I asked the seller.
transliteration: Kont ayiz ashtari fakiha fa sa'alt el ba'ie'.

arabic: سالته بكام كيلو التفاح ده يا عمو
english: I asked him 'How much is this kilo of apples, uncle?'
transliteration: Sa'alto be kam kilo el toffah dah ya 'ammu.

arabic: اشتريته وقلت شكرا
english: I bought it and said thank you.
transliteration: Ishtareeto w olt shukran.

arabic: اليوم فيه مطر كتير
english: Today has a lot of rain.
transliteration: El youm feeh matar keteer

arabic: انا في البيت دلوقتي
english: I am at home now.
transliteration: Ana fel beit delwa'ty

arabic: انا باشرب شاي سخن
english: I am drinking hot tea.
transliteration: Ana bashrab shay sokhn

arabic: انا باقرا كتاب جديد
english: I am reading a new book.
transliteration: Ana baqra kitaab gedeed

arabic: انا باحب اليوم ده
english: I like this day.
transliteration: Ana bahebb el youm da

arabic: امبارح قررت اطبخ طبخة مختلفة جديدة خالص
english: Yesterday, I decided to cook a totally new, different dish.
transliteration: Embareh qarart atbokh tabkha mokhtalefa gedida khales.

arabic: كنت مركزة طول الوقت وانا بحضرها علشان متطلعش وحشة
english: I was focused all the time while preparing it so it wouldn't turn out bad.
transliteration: Kont merakkaza tool el wa't wana bahaddarha 'alashan ma tetla3sh wahsha.

arabic: لما دقتها حسيت ان طعمها حلو اوي ومختلف شوية
english: When I tasted it, I felt its taste was very good and a bit different.
transliteration: Lamma do'toha hasset en ta'maha helw awi w mokhtalef shwaya.

arabic: اخويا جه البيت وطلب يدوقها وكان يرضى عن طعمها الغريب
english: My brother came home and asked to taste it, and he was pleased with its strange taste.
transliteration: Akhoya geh el beit we talab yedu'ha we kan yerda 'an ta'maha el ghareeb.

arabic: بس بعدين اكتشفت اني حطيت ملح بدل السكر بالغلط
english: But then I discovered that I had put salt instead of sugar by mistake.
transliteration: Bas ba'dein ektashaft enni hateit malh badal el sokkar bel ghalat.

arabic: الجارة ام احمد بتكلم الجار الجديد احمد
english: The neighbor Um Ahmed is talking to the new neighbor Ahmed.
transliteration: El-gara Om Ahmed betkallem el-gar el-gedid Ahmed.

arabic: ام احمد بتقول زمان كان كل حاجة بسيطة
english: Um Ahmed says, 'In the old days, everything was simple.'
transliteration: Om Ahmed bet'oul zaman kan kol haga basita.

arabic: احمد بيقول دلوقتي كل حاجة سهلة بالتليفون
english: Ahmed says, 'Now everything is easy with the phone.'
transliteration: Ahmed bey'oul delwa'ti kol haga sahla bel-telefoon.

arabic: ام احمد مش فاهمة ليه الشباب بيحبوا التليفونات اوي
english: Um Ahmed doesn't understand why youth love phones so much.
transliteration: Om Ahmed mish fahma leeh el-shabab bihebbou el-telefoonat awi.

arabic: كل واحد شايف الدنيا بطريقة مختلفة بس ده كويس
english: Everyone sees the world differently, but that's good.
transliteration: Kol wahed shayef el-donya be-tari'a mokhtalefa bas dah kwayyes.

arabic: عمر ولد بيسال اسئلة كتير
english: Omar is a boy who asks many questions.
transliteration: Omar walad biyes'al as'ela keteer

arabic: هو بيسال ماما امتى بناكل الفطار الصبح
english: He asks, "Mama, when do we eat breakfast in the morning?"
transliteration: Howa biyes'al Mama emta benakel el fetar el sobh

arabic: مامته بتقول له بناكل دلوقتي يا عمر
english: His mother tells him, "We eat now, Omar."
transliteration: Mameto bet'ool loh benakel delwa'ty ya Omar

arabic: وبعدين بيسال بابا بيروح فين الشغل
english: And then he asks, "Where does Baba go to work?"
transliteration: Wa ba'dein biyes'al Baba birooh fein el shoghl

arabic: مامته بترد بابا بيروح الشغل كل يوم
english: His mother replies, "Baba goes to work every day."
transliteration: Mameto beterod Baba birooh el shoghl kol yom

arabic: انا روحت القهوة وقعدت بره
english: I went to the café and sat outside.
transliteration: Ana roht el-ahwa we a'adt barra

arabic: انا بستنى صاحبي دلوقتي
english: I am waiting for my friend now.
transliteration: Ana bastanna sahby delwa'ti

arabic: طلبت كوباية شاي عشان الجو كويس
english: I ordered a cup of tea because the weather is good.
transliteration: Talabt kobayet shay 'ashan el-gaw kwayyes

arabic: الناس قاعدة وبتشرب قهوة كتير
english: People are sitting and drinking a lot of coffee.
transliteration: El-nas qa'da we beteshrab ahwa keteer

arabic: كمان شوية صاحبي هيجي
english: My friend will come in a little while.
transliteration: Kaman shwayya sahby hayigi

arabic: انا صحيت الصبح وقلت صباح الخير لنفسي
english: I woke up in the morning and said good morning to myself.
transliteration: Ana saheet es-sobh we olt sabah el-kheer le nafsi.

arabic: كان عيد ميلادي النهاردة
english: It was my birthday today.
transliteration: Kan eid meelady en-naharda.

arabic: كل اصحابي جم البيت وجابولي هدية حلوة
english: All my friends came home and brought me a nice gift.
transliteration: Koll as-haby gem el-beit we gabouly hedeya helwa.

arabic: لما دخلوا قلتلهم مساء الخير وهما ردوا مساء النور
english: When they entered I told them good evening and they responded evening of light.
transliteration: Lamma dakhalu oltelhom masa' el-kheer we homa raddu masa' an-noor.

arabic: اكلنا كيكة كبيرة وكنت مبسوط اوي
english: We ate a big cake and I was very happy.
transliteration: Akalna keeka kebeera we kont mabsoot awy.

arabic: انا كنت رايح الشغل الصبح
english: I was going to work in the morning.
transliteration: Ana kont rayeh el shoghl el sobh.

arabic: شفت صاحبي القديم في الشارع
english: I saw my old friend on the street.
transliteration: Shoft sahbi el adeem fel share'a.

arabic: قولتله ازيك قالي الحمد لله تمام
english: I said to him, "How are you?" He said, "I'm good, praise be to God."
transliteration: Oltelo izzayak? ali el hamdulillah tamam.

arabic: سالته رايح فين دلوقتي
english: I asked him, "Where are you going now?"
transliteration: Sa'alto rayeh fein delwa'ti?

arabic: قالي انا رايح البيت
english: He said to me, "I am going home."
transliteration: ali ana rayeh el beit.

arabic: انا عايزة اشتري هدوم جديدة
english: I want to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Ana ayza ashtari hedoom gedeeda

arabic: روحت محل هدوم كبير
english: I went to a big clothes shop.
transliteration: Roht mahal hedoom kabeer

arabic: شفت قميص احمر وبنطلون اسود جميل
english: I saw a beautiful red shirt and black pants.
transliteration: Shoft amees ahmar w bantalon aswad gameel

arabic: القميص كان مقاسه كبير والبنطلون صغير
english: The shirt's size was big and the pants were small.
transliteration: El amees kan ma'aso kabeer wel bantalon saghir

arabic: بعدين لقيت قطتي نايمة جوه القميص
english: Then I found my cat sleeping inside the shirt!
transliteration: Ba'deen la'eet otteti nayma gowa el amees

arabic: صباح الخير يا جار
english: Good morning, neighbor.
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya gaar.

arabic: صباح النور ازيك عامل ايه
english: Good morning, how are you doing?
transliteration: Sabah el-noor, izzayak 'amel eh?

arabic: الحمد لله انا كويس اولادك بخير
english: Praise be to God, I am good. Are your children well?
transliteration: El-hamdu lellah ana kwayyes. Awladak bekheir?

arabic: ايوا كلهم بخير الحمد لله
english: Yes, all of them are well, praise be to God.
transliteration: Aywa kollohom bekheir el-hamdu lellah.

arabic: تمام مع السلامة
english: Okay, goodbye.
transliteration: Tamaam, ma'a el-salama.

arabic: انا صحيت متاخر النهارده الصبح
english: I woke up late this morning.
transliteration: Ana saheet met'akher ennaharda essobh.

arabic: انا كنت مستعجل جدا
english: I was very rushed.
transliteration: Ana kont mesta'gel geddan.

arabic: شربت قهوة بسرعة
english: I drank coffee quickly.
transliteration: Sharibt ahwa besor'a.

arabic: مفيش وقت خالص للشغل
english: There is no time at all for work.
transliteration: Mafeesh wa't khales lel shoghl.

arabic: نزلت الشغل وانا تعبان
english: I went to work while I was tired.
transliteration: Nezelt esh shoghl wana ta'ban.

arabic: النهاردة يوم مهم عشان حفلة الفرح
english: Today is an important day for the wedding party.
transliteration: Elnaharda yom mohem ashan haflat elfarah.

arabic: الفرح هيكون كبير اوي
english: The wedding will be very big.
transliteration: Elfarah haykoon kebeer awi.

arabic: لازم نختار اكل حلو للناس
english: We must choose nice food for the people.
transliteration: Lazem nekhtar akl helw lel nas.

arabic: صحاب كتير وجيران هييجوا
english: Many friends and neighbors will come.
transliteration: Sohab keteer we geran hayeegoo.

arabic: انا مبسوط جدا باليوم ده
english: I am very happy about this day.
transliteration: Ana mabsoot geddan bel yom dah.

arabic: النهاردة الصبح الجو كان حلو خالص
english: This morning the weather was very nice.
transliteration: Elnaharda elsobh elgaw kan helw khales

arabic: فكرت في رحلة للبحر الاسبوع الجاي
english: I thought about a trip to the sea next week.
transliteration: Fakkart fi rehla lelba7r elosbou3 elgay

arabic: عايز اشرب عصير برتقال بارد على الشط
english: I want to drink cold orange juice on the beach.
transliteration: A'ayez ashrab a'aseer borto'aal bared a'ala elshatt

arabic: الشمس هتبقى دافية والمياه زرقا وجميلة
english: The sun will be warm and the water blue and beautiful.
