transliteration: Elshams hatetba dafya walmeyah zar'a wgameela

arabic: ممكن اشتري قهوة بخمسين جنيه هناك
english: I can buy coffee for fifty pounds there.
transliteration: Momken ashtri ahwa bikhamsin geneh henāk

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد منى في بيتنا
english: Today is Mona's birthday at our house.
transliteration: El-naharda eid milad Mona fi beitna.

arabic: أهلاً وسهلاً يا ماما إزيكِ أنا كويسة الحمد لله
english: Welcome Mom how are you I'm good thank God.
transliteration: Ahlan wa sahlan ya mama izzayyik ana kwayyesa alhamdulillah.

arabic: كل العيلة موجودة والجو جميل أوي
english: All the family is here and the atmosphere is very beautiful.
transliteration: Koll el-ayla mawgoda wel gaw gameel awi.

arabic: في تورته كبيرة وشمع كتير
english: There is a big cake and many candles.
transliteration: Fi torta kebeera we shama' keteer.

arabic: الكل مبسوط وبنضحك مع بعض كتير
english: Everyone is happy and we laugh a lot together.
transliteration: El-koll mabsoot we benḍaḥak ma' ba'ḍ keteer.

arabic: جدة وحفيدتها راحوا يشتروا هدوم جديدة
english: Grandma and her granddaughter went to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Gedda w hafidetha raho yeshtaro hedoom gedida

arabic: الحفيدة شافت فستان حلو اوي ومودرن
english: The granddaughter saw a very nice and modern dress.
transliteration: El hafeeda shafet fostan helw awy w modern

arabic: الجدة قالت لا مش عاجبني ايه ده واشارت على فستان تاني قديم
english: Grandma said "No, I don't like it, what is this?" and pointed to another old dress.
transliteration: El gedda qalet la mesh agabny eh da w asharat ala fostan tani qadeem

arabic: الحفيدة قالت ازاي يا جدتي ده كويس جدا وشيك
english: The granddaughter said "How, grandma? This is very good and chic."
transliteration: El hafeeda qalet ezzay ya geddety da kwayyes geddan w sheek

arabic: بعد كلام كتير قرروا يشتروا فستانين واحد ليها وواحد لجدتها
english: After a lot of talking, they decided to buy two dresses, one for her and one for her grandma.
transliteration: Ba'd kalam kteer qarraro yeshtaro fostanein wahed leeha w wahed le geddetha

arabic: النهاردة روحت ازور خالتي في البيت
english: Today I went to visit my aunt at home.
transliteration: Ennaharda roḥt azūr khalti fel-bēt.

arabic: كان الجو حلو وقعدنا نتكلم كتير
english: The weather was nice and we sat and talked a lot.
transliteration: Kān el-gaww ḥelw wa qaʿadna netkallem kitīr.

arabic: خالتي بتحب تتكلم عن الاخبار السياسية وعن رئيس الجمهورية
english: My aunt loves to talk about political news and about the President of the Republic.
transliteration: Khalti betḥebb tetkallem ʿan el-akhbār es-siyāsīya wa ʿan raʾīs el-gomhūrīya.

arabic: قالتلي ان فيه مرشح جديد عجبها اوي وانه ممكن يكسب بالتصويت
english: She told me there's a new candidate she really likes and that he might win by voting.
transliteration: Qāletli en fīh morashshaḥ gedīd ʿagabha awi w'ennaho mumkin yeksab bet-taṣwīt.

arabic: انا بحب قعدتها اوي وبتعلم منها حاجات كتير عن الحكم
english: I really love sitting with her and learn many things from her about governance.
transliteration: Ana baḥebb qaʿdet'ha awi w'betʿallem menha ḥāgāt kitīr ʿan el-ḥokm.

arabic: كان فيه طفل صغير بيسال اسئلة كتير اوي
english: There was a small child asking so many questions.
transliteration: Kaana fee tefl soghayyar biyes'al as'ela keteer awi

arabic: هو دايما يقول ليه يا بابا احنا بنعمل ده دلوقتي
english: He always says, "Why, Dad, are we doing this now?"
transliteration: Howa dayman yeqool leh ya baba ehna bena'mel dah delwa'ty

arabic: جدي بيقول زمان مكنش فيه الحاجات دي خالص
english: My grandfather says, "A long time ago, there were no such things at all."
transliteration: Geddy biyo'ool zaman makanesh feeh el-hagaat di khales

arabic: جدي مبيفهمش ليه كل حاجة جديدة على التليفون
english: My grandfather doesn't understand why everything is new on the phone.
transliteration: Geddy mabiyefhamsh leh kol haga gedeeda 'ala el-telephon

arabic: الطفل لسه عايز يفهم كل حاجة حواليه
english: The child still wants to understand everything around him.
transliteration: El-tefl lesa 'ayez yefham kol haga hawalih

arabic: اليوم احنا في بيت ماما وبابا
english: Today we are at mom and dad's house.
transliteration: El-yoom ehna fi beit mama w baba.

arabic: كل العيلة قاعدة تاكل اكل حلو
english: The whole family is sitting eating nice food.
transliteration: Koll el-eila qa'da takol akl helw.

arabic: اخويا بيشرب عصير وانا باكل رز
english: My brother is drinking juice and I am eating rice.
transliteration: Akhoya bieshrab 'aseer wana bakol rozz.

arabic: فجأة اخويا الصغير بيقول حاجة
english: Suddenly my little brother says something.
transliteration: Faga'a akhoya el-soghayyar bi'ool haga.

arabic: القطة بتاكل الاكل بتاعي
english: The cat is eating my food!
transliteration: El-qotta btaakol el-akl beta'i!

arabic: صباح الخير يا عمو، ازي حضرتك؟ قالت منى وهي تدخل المكتبة الصغيرة.
english: "Good morning, uncle, how are you?" said Mona as she entered the small bookstore.
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya 3ammo, ezzy haDretak? qalet Mona w hiyya tedkhol el-maktaba el-soghayyara.

arabic: رد صاحب المكتبة بابتسامة: "اهلا يا بنتي، تمام الحمد لله، انتي عاملة ايه؟"
english: The bookstore owner replied with a smile: "Welcome, my daughter, fine praise be to God, how are you doing?"
transliteration: Radd saHeb el-maktaba be ebtesama: "Ahlan ya benty, tamam el-hamdullah, enty 3amla eih?"

arabic: منى قالت: "انا كويسة، كنت بدور على كتاب معين ومش لاقياه."
english: Mona said: "I am good, I was looking for a specific book and couldn't find it."
transliteration: Mona qalet: "Ana kwayyesa, kont badawwar 3ala ketab mo3ayyan w mesh la2yah."

arabic: "اه اهلا بيكي تاني، طب استني، يمكن يكون عندي، شفته من فترة."
english: "Oh, welcome again, well wait, maybe I have it, I saw it a while ago."
transliteration: "Ah ahlan beeky tany, Tab estanny, yemken yekoon 3andy, shoftoh men fatra."

arabic: منى ردت بفرحة: "يا الف شكر يا عمو، بجد متشكرة خالص!"
english: Mona replied with joy: "A thousand thanks, uncle, really, I'm very grateful!"
transliteration: Mona raddet be farHa: "Ya alf shokr ya 3ammo, be gad metshakkera khales!"

arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع
english: I was walking in the street.
transliteration: kunt mashi fi el-share'

arabic: شفت صاحبي القديم
english: I saw my old friend.
transliteration: shoFt saHbi el-qadiim

arabic: اسمه احمد
english: His name is Ahmed.
transliteration: ismu aHmad

arabic: انا كنت مبسوط اوي
english: I was very happy.
transliteration: ana kunt mabsooT awy

arabic: اتكلمنا شوية
english: We talked a little.
transliteration: itkallimna shwayya

arabic: احنا بنخطط لفرح اخويا
english: We are planning my brother's wedding.
transliteration: Ehna binkhaṭṭeṭ le farḥ akhūya.

arabic: كل يوم الصبح بنتكلم في التفاصيل
english: Every morning we talk about the details.
transliteration: Koll yōm el ṣubḥ bentkallem fī el tafāṣīl.

arabic: النهاردة لازم نختار فستان الفرح
english: Today we must choose the wedding dress.
transliteration: El nahārda lāzem nekhtār fostān el farḥ.

arabic: بكرة هنشوف قاعة الافراح
english: Tomorrow we will see the wedding hall.
transliteration: Bokra hanishūf qāʿet el afrāḥ.

arabic: الفرح بعد شهر واحد
english: The wedding is after one month.
transliteration: El farḥ baʿd shahr wāḥed.

arabic: امبارح كنت ماشي في الشارع
english: Yesterday I was walking in the street.
transliteration: Imbareh kont mashy fe el share'

arabic: قابلت صاحبي القديم احمد
english: I met my old friend Ahmed.
transliteration: Qabelt sahby el qadeem Ahmed

arabic: سلمت عليه و قولتله ازيك يا صاحبي
english: I greeted him and said, 'How are you, my friend?'
transliteration: Sallamt 'aleih w oltelloh ezzayak ya sahby

arabic: هو لسه بيحب التليفونات القديمة و انا بحب الجديد
english: He still likes old phones, and I like the new ones.
transliteration: Howwa lessa bihebb el telefonat el adima w ana bahebb el gedid

arabic: المحادثة كانت حلوة بس افكارنا مختلفة شوية
english: The conversation was nice, but our ideas were a bit different.
transliteration: El mohadtha kanet helwa bas afkarna mokhtalefa shwaya

arabic: كان النهاردة عيد ميلاد منى حبيبتي عملنا ليها حفلة صغيرة
english: Today was Mona's birthday, my dear, we made a small party for her.
transliteration: Kan innahārda ʿīd mīlād Mona ḥabībti ʿamalna līha ḥafla ṣughayyara.

arabic: جبنا تورتة كبيرة بس نسيت الشمع
english: We brought a big cake but I forgot the candles.
transliteration: Gibna torta kabīra bas nisīt ish-shamʿ.

arabic: كل اصحابها و اهلها جم واكلوا وشربوا كتير
english: All her friends and family came and ate and drank a lot.
transliteration: Kull aṣḥābha w ahliha gum w akalu w shirbu kitīr.

arabic: منى فتحت الهدية وكانت قطة لعبة صغيرة بتضحك
english: Mona opened the gift, and it was a small laughing toy cat.
transliteration: Mona fataḥit il-hadiyya w kanit ʾiṭṭa luʿba ṣughayyara bitidḥak.

arabic: كلنا ضحكنا كتير على القطة وعيد ميلاد سعيد يا منى
english: We all laughed a lot at the cat, and happy birthday, Mona.
transliteration: Kullina ḍiḥikna kitīr ʿalā il-ʾiṭṭa w ʿīd mīlād saʿīd ya Mona.

arabic: امي قالت محتاجين خضار وفاكهة للبيت
english: My mother said we need vegetables and fruit for the house
transliteration: Ommy aalet mehtageen khodaar w fakha lel bayt

arabic: هي بتحب تروح السوق الكبير عشان تشتري كل حاجة بنفسها
english: She loves to go to the big market to buy everything herself
transliteration: Heya bethebb terouh el soo' el kibeer ashan teshtary kol haga be nafsaha

arabic: انا قلت لها ممكن نطلب اونلاين اسهل واسرع
english: I told her we can order online, it's easier and faster
transliteration: Ana oltelaha momken notlob online ashal w asraa

arabic: لكن امي قالت عايزة تشوف الخضار والفاكهة بكام عشان نختار الاحسن
english: But my mother said she wants to see the vegetables and fruit to know how much they are, so we choose the best
transliteration: Laken ommy aalet aayza teshuf el khodaar wel fakha bekam ashan nekhtar el ahsan

arabic: اتفقنا انا اطلب بعض الحاجات وهي تروح السوق لباقي البيت
english: We agreed I would order some things and she would go to the market for the rest of the house
transliteration: Et'afana ana otlob ba'd el hagatt we heya terouh el soo' le ba'y el bayt

arabic: كل يوم ابني بيسالني اسئلة كتير اوي
english: Every day my son asks me so many questions.
transliteration: Kol yom ebni byes'alni as'ela keteer awi.

arabic: هو دايما بيسال ليه السما زرقا وليه العصفورة بتطير
english: He always asks why the sky is blue and why the bird flies.
transliteration: Howa dayman byes'al leh el sama zar'a w leh el asfoora betteer.

arabic: انا بحاول اجاوب بس ببقى تعبان بعد كل ده
english: I try to answer but I get tired after all of this.
transliteration: Ana bahawel agawel bas babqa ta'ban ba'd kol da.

arabic: هو عايز يعرف كل حاجة عن اي حاجة بيشوفها
english: He wants to know everything about anything he sees.
transliteration: Howa ayz ye'raf kol haga 'an ay haga biyshofha.

arabic: ولسه مخلصش اسئلته حتى دلوقتي
english: And he still hasn't finished his questions even now.
transliteration: W lessa makhalashesh as'elto hatta delwa'ti.

arabic: امبارح سارة اشترت فستان جديد من المحل
english: Yesterday Sarah bought a new dress from the shop.
transliteration: Imbareh Sara eshtaret fostan gedid men el mahal.

arabic: النهاردة هي مش عايزة الفستان ده
english: Today she does not want this dress.
transliteration: El naharda heya mesh 'ayza el fostan da.

arabic: سارة كانت زعلانة شوية عشان ترجع الحاجة
english: Sarah was a little upset because she had to return the thing.
transliteration: Sara kanet za'lana shwaya 'ashan teragga' el haga.

arabic: الراجل في المحل قال مفيش مشكلة
english: The man in the shop said no problem.
transliteration: El ragel fi el mahal 'al mafeesh moshkela.

arabic: سارة بقت مبسوطة تاني وشكرت الراجل
english: Sarah became happy again and thanked the man.
transliteration: Sara ba'et mabsouta tani we shakaret el ragel.

arabic: النهاردة إحنا رحنا السوق
english: Today we went to the market.
transliteration: Elnaharda ehna rohna es-souq

arabic: ماما وبابا كانوا عايزين خضار وفاكهة حلوة
english: Mom and Dad wanted sweet vegetables and fruits.
transliteration: Mama w Baba kanu ayzin khodaar w fakeha helwa

arabic: السوق كان كبير وجميل
english: The market was big and beautiful.
transliteration: Es-souq kan kabeer w gameel

arabic: إحنا اشترينا عيش وطماطم كتير
english: We bought a lot of bread and tomatoes.
transliteration: Ehna eshtereina aish w tamaatem keteer

arabic: كلنا كنا مبسوطين أوي
english: All of us were very happy.
transliteration: Kollena kunna mabsooteen awi

arabic: انا رحت السوق مع امي
english: I went to the market with my mother.
transliteration: Ana roht el-soo' ma' ommy.

arabic: هي بتحب الهدوم القديمة
english: She likes old clothes.
transliteration: Heyya bethebb el-hedoom el-adeema.

arabic: انا بحب الهدوم الجديدة
english: I like new clothes.
transliteration: Ana bahebb el-hedoom el-gedeeda.

arabic: هي بتقول ده مش حلو وانا بقول ده حلو
english: She says 'this is not nice' and I say 'this is nice'.
transliteration: Heyya bet'ool da mesh helw w ana ba'ool da helw.

arabic: احنا بنشوف حاجات كتير مختلفة
english: We see many different things.
transliteration: Ehna benshoof hagaat keteer mokhtalefa.

arabic: روحنا نزور عمتي منى في بيتها الجميل
english: We went to visit my Aunt Mona at her beautiful home.
transliteration: Rohna nizor ameti Mona fi bet'ha elgameel

arabic: هي فتحت الباب و رحبت بينا بحرارة كبيرة
english: She opened the door and welcomed us with great warmth.
transliteration: Heya fatahet elbab w rahabet bina biharara kebira

arabic: عمتي بتحب تعمل شاي و حلويات لضيوفها دايما
english: My aunt loves to make tea and sweets for her guests always.
transliteration: Ameti bethebb taamel shay w halawiyat le diofha daiman

arabic: ماما بتسالها عن اخبار اسرتها و صحتها دايما
english: Mom always asks her about her family's news and health.
transliteration: Mama betsala an akhbar osretha w sehetaha daiman

arabic: بنقولها سلام و نوعدها نزورها قريب تاني عشان هي بتحبنا
english: We say goodbye to her and promise to visit her again soon because she loves us.
transliteration: Benolha salam w nowedha nizorha areeb tani ashan heya bethebbena

arabic: فيه مشكلة في اوضة المعيشة النهاردة
english: There is a problem in the living room today.
transliteration: Fiih moshkela fi odet el ma'isha el naharda.

arabic: المكنسة القديمة مش شغالة خالص
english: The old vacuum cleaner is not working at all.
transliteration: El maknasa el adeema mesh shaghala khales.

arabic: السجادة كلها وسخة وعايزة تتنضف
english: The whole carpet is dirty and needs to be cleaned.
transliteration: El saggada kolaha wesekha w ayza tetnaddaf.

arabic: عندي فكرة كبيرة ممكن استخدم مكنسة صغيرة
english: I have a big idea, maybe I can use a small broom.
transliteration: Andi fekrah kabeera momken astakhdem maknasa soghayyara.

arabic: دي طريقة صعبة بس ماشي الحال دلوقتي
english: This is a difficult way but it's okay for now.
transliteration: Di taree'a sa'ba bas mashi el hal delwa'ti.

arabic: صحيت متاخر النهاردة وكنت تعبان شوية
english: I woke up late today and was a little tired.
transliteration: Sahiet meta'akhkhar ennaharda we kont ta'baan shwaya

arabic: كنت مستعجل قوي ومعملتش فطار
english: I was in a great hurry and didn't make breakfast.
transliteration: Kont mosta'gel qawi we ma'amaltesh fataar

arabic: انا قلقان اكون متاخر على الشغل
english: I'm worried I'll be late for work.
transliteration: Ana alqan akoun meta'akhkhar 'ala el shoghl

arabic: الطريق كان زحمة جدا زي كل يوم
english: The road was very crowded, like every day.
transliteration: Et tareeq kan zahma geddan zayy koll yom

arabic: دلوقتي انا عايز قهوة سريعة عشان ابدا يومي
english: Now I want a quick coffee to start my day.
transliteration: Delwa'ti ana 'ayez qahwa saree'a 'ashan abda' yomi

arabic: كنت ماشي في القاهرة وفجاة حسيت اني تايه
english: I was walking in Cairo and suddenly felt that I was lost.
transliteration: Kont mashi fel qahera w faga'a hasseit enni tayeh.

arabic: شفت راجل كبير وقولت له لو سمحت انا تايه
english: I saw an old man and told him "Excuse me, I am lost".
transliteration: Shoft ragel kebir w oltelo law samaht ana tayeh.

arabic: عايز اروح محطة المترو هي فين لو سمحت
english: I want to go to the metro station, where is it please?
transliteration: Ayz arooh mahattit el metro hiyya feen law samaht.

arabic: قالي امشي طوالي وبعدين خد يمين وبعدين شمال
english: He told me "Go straight, then take a right, then a left".
transliteration: Qali emshi tawali w ba'dein khod yemeen w ba'dein shemal.

arabic: مشيت كتير ولما رجعت لقيته لسه واقف وتايه زيي بالظبط
english: I walked a lot, and when I came back, I found him still standing there, also lost exactly like me!
transliteration: Mesheet keteer w lama rega't le'eeto lessa wa'ef w tayeh zayyey belzabbt.

arabic: صباح الخير يا احمد ازيك عامل ايه
english: Good morning, Ahmed, how are you?
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya Ahmed ezzayak 3amel eh?

arabic: صباح النور يا صاحبي انا كويس الحمد لله انت عامل ايه
english: Good morning, my friend, I'm good, thank God. How are you?
transliteration: Sabah el noor ya sa7by ana kwayyes el Hamdulillah enta 3amel eh?

arabic: انا صحيت بدري وشربت قهوتي ودلوقتي باكل الفطار
english: I woke up early, drank my coffee, and now I'm eating breakfast.
transliteration: Ana sa7eet badry we sherebt ahwety we delwa2ty ba'kol el fetaar

arabic: انا لسه في الشغل وبخلص كمان شوية وبرجع البيت
english: I'm still at work and will finish in a bit and go home.
transliteration: Ana lessa fy el shoghl we bakhalas kaman showaya we barg3 el beet

arabic: تمام كده تصبح على خير يا صاحبي اشوفك بكرة
english: Okay then, good night, my friend, see you tomorrow.
transliteration: Tamam keda tesba7 ala kheer ya sa7by ashoofak bokra

arabic: امبارح رحت السوق عشان اشتري خضار وفاكهة
english: Yesterday I went to the market to buy vegetables and fruits.
transliteration: Imbaarih roḥt il-sooʾ 3ashaan ashtiri khuḍaar w faakiha.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: هناك قابلت خالتي فاطمة اللي كانت بتشتري حاجات للبيت برضه
english: There I met my maternal aunt Fatma who was also buying things for the house.
transliteration: Hinaak qabilt khaalti Faṭma illi kaanit bitishtiri ḥagaat lil-beet barḍo.
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: قالتلي ايه رأيك في الطماطم دي شكلها حلو اوي النهاردة
english: She told me 'What do you think of these tomatoes? They look very good today.'
transliteration: Qalitli 'Eh ra'yik fiṭ-ṭamaaṭim di shaklaha ḥilw awi in-naharda?'
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: رديت عليها اه فعلا شكلها طازة انا هاخد شوية منها
english: I replied to her 'Yes, indeed, they look fresh, I will take some of them.'
transliteration: Raddayt 3aleeha 'Ah fa3lan shaklaha ṭaaza ana haakhod shwayya minha.'
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: بعد ما خلصنا قالتلي مع السلامة اشوفك بكرة يا حبيبتي
english: After we finished, she told me 'Goodbye, see you tomorrow, my dear.'
transliteration: Ba3d ma khallaṣna qalilti 'Ma3a s-salaama ashoofik bokra ya ḥabibti.'
storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

arabic: سارة واحمد بيخططوا لفرحهم
english: Sarah and Ahmed are planning their wedding.
transliteration: Sara w Ahmad biykhattetu li farahhom.

arabic: سارة مبسوطة اوي ده يوم كبير
english: Sarah is very happy, this is a big day.
transliteration: Sara mabsouta awi dah yom kabeer.

arabic: احمد قلقان شوية على الفلوس
english: Ahmed is a little worried about the money.
transliteration: Ahmad qal'aan shwaya 'ala el felous.

arabic: سارة قالت متقلقش الفرح هيكون جميل
english: Sarah said "Don't worry, the wedding will be beautiful."
transliteration: Sara qalet matqalqesh el farah haykoun gameel.

arabic: هما عاوزين كل الناس تكون سعيدة في اليوم ده
english: They want all the people to be happy on that day.
transliteration: Homa aawzin kol el nas takoun sa'eeda fi el yom dah.

arabic: انا عملت مكالمه لصاحبي احمد
english: I made a call to my friend Ahmed.
transliteration: Ana amalt makalma le sahby Ahmed.

arabic: هو قاللي ايه التطبيق الجديد ده
english: He asked me, "What is this new app?"
transliteration: Howa a'ally "Eh el tatbi' el gedid da?"

arabic: انا شرحتله بس هو مش فاهم
english: I explained to him, but he doesn't understand.
transliteration: Ana sharahteloh bas howa mish fahm.

arabic: هو قال انا خلاص بقيت كبير على الحاجات دي
english: He said, "I'm already old for these things."
transliteration: Howa a'al "Ana khalas ba'et kbeer 'ala el hagāt di".

arabic: احنا ضحكنا كتير على فرق الجيل ده
english: We laughed a lot about this generation gap.
transliteration: Ehna daḥakna kiteer 'ala far' el geel da.

arabic: الصبح بدري ريحة الفول كانت مالية الشارع
english: Early in the morning the smell of foul was filling the street.
transliteration: El sobh badri reehet el fool kanet malya el shaare'

arabic: ام احمد فتحت باب شقتها وسلمت على ام علي
english: Umm Ahmed opened her apartment door and greeted Umm Ali.
transliteration: Omm Ahmed fatahet baab sha'et-ha we sallimet ala Omm Ali

arabic: قالت لها يا صباح الخير ازيك يا ام علي ريحة اكلك النهاردة جميل
english: She said to her 'Good morning Umm Ali how are you Your food smells wonderful today.'
transliteration: 'Alet leha ya sabah el kheir ezzayyik ya Omm Ali reehet akl-ik el naharda gameel

arabic: ردت ام علي وقالت تسلمي يا حبيبتي تعالي كلي معانا
english: Umm Ali replied 'Thank you my dear Come eat with us.'
transliteration: Raddet Omm Ali we 'alet teslami ya habibti ta'ali koli ma'ana

arabic: ام احمد ابتسمت وقالت بجد تسلم ايدك يا جارتي انا جاية حالا
english: Umm Ahmed smiled and said 'Really Thank you so much my neighbor I'm coming right away.'
transliteration: Omm Ahmed ibtasamet we 'alet begad teslam eidek ya garti ana gayya halan

arabic: النهاردة كان فيه اجتماع عيلة كبير في بيت تيتا
english: Today there was a big family gathering at grandma's house.
transliteration: Elnaharda kan feh igtima3 3eila kabeer fi beit teeta.

arabic: كل واحد كان مبسوط بالاكل اللذيذ اللي تيتا عملته وكان طعمه يجنن
english: Everyone was happy with the delicious food grandma made, and its taste was amazing.
transliteration: Kull waHid kan mabsuut bel akl el ladheedh elli teeta 3amalto w kan Ta3mo yigannin.

arabic: عماد بصراحة كان حاسس بشكر كبير لكل المجهود اللي اتعمل
english: Emad, frankly, was feeling great gratitude for all the effort that was made.
transliteration: 3emad biSaraHa kan Hasis bi shukr kabeer li kull el maghood elli et3amal.

arabic: الجو كان كله ضحك وهزار والمشكلة الوحيدة ان الوقت بيعدي بسرعة
english: The atmosphere was full of laughter and joking, and the only problem was that time passed quickly.
transliteration: El gaww kan kullo DiHik w hazaar wel mushkila el waHeeda inn el waqt biye3addi bi sur3a.

arabic: اللحظات دي مهمة جدا وبتخلينا نحس بقيمة العيلة
english: These moments are very important and make us feel the value of family.
transliteration: El laHazaat di muhimma giddan w bitkhalleena naHiss bi qeimet el 3eila.

arabic: صباح الخير يا جارتي ازيك عاملة ايه
english: Good morning, my neighbor, how are you doing?
transliteration: Sabah el kheir ya garti ezzyak amla eh?
storyTitle: The Neighbor and the Adventurous Cat

arabic: الحمد لله يا حبيبتي كويسة انتي كمان كويسة ايه الصوت ده
english: Praise be to God, my dear, I am well, are you also well? What is that sound?
transliteration: Elhamdulellah ya habibti kwayyesa enti kaman kwayyesa eh el sot da?
storyTitle: The Neighbor and the Adventurous Cat

arabic: انا قطتي جوه العربية بتاعتي عايزة تروح الشغل معايا
english: My cat inside my car wants to go to work with me.
transliteration: Ana ottati gowwa el arabeya beta'ti ayza terou7 el shoghl ma'aya.
storyTitle: The Neighbor and the Adventurous Cat

arabic: يا سلام قطة عايزة تشتغل ده حلو قوي
english: Wow, a cat that wants to work, that's really nice!
transliteration: Ya salam otta ayza teshtaghal da helw awi.
storyTitle: The Neighbor and the Adventurous Cat

arabic: ايوة بس هي مش عايزة تاكل اكل القطط هي عايزة تاكل جبنة
english: Yes, but she doesn't want to eat cat food, she wants to eat cheese.
transliteration: Aywa bas heya mesh ayza takul akl el otat heya ayza takul gebna.
storyTitle: The Neighbor and the Adventurous Cat

arabic: النهاردة فيه مطر بره
english: Today there is rain outside.
transliteration: ennaharda feeh matar barra

arabic: انا قاعد في البيت
english: I am sitting at home.
transliteration: ana qa'ed fel beit

arabic: ببص من الشباك
english: I am looking from the window.
transliteration: babos men el shibbak

arabic: وبشرب شاي سخن
english: And I am drinking hot tea.
transliteration: w bashrab shay sokhn

arabic: يوم جميل جوا البيت
english: It's a beautiful day inside the house.
transliteration: yom gameel gowwa el beit

arabic: صباح الخير يا جارتي ازيك يا سارة
english: Good morning, my neighbor. How are you, Sara?
transliteration: sabah el kheer ya gaarti izzayek ya Sara

arabic: صباح النور يا طنط انا كويسة الحمد لله
english: Good morning, Auntie. I am fine, thank God.
transliteration: sabah el noor ya tant ana kwayyessa el hamdulillah

arabic: زمان كنا بنلعب في الشارع طول اليوم
english: In the old days, we used to play in the street all day.
transliteration: zamaan kunna benlaab fel sharea tool el yoom

arabic: دلوقتي كل الشباب على التليفون طول الوقت
english: Now all the youth are on their phones all the time.
transliteration: dilwa'ti koll el shabab ala el telefoon tool el wa't

arabic: اه الدنيا اتغيرت كتير اوي
english: Ah, the world has changed so much.
transliteration: ah el donya etghayyarit kiteer awy

arabic: النور في اوضة المعيشة بايظ
english: The light in the living room is broken.
transliteration: El-noor fi odet el-ma'eesha bayez.

arabic: ماما قالت يا بابا لو سمحت صلح النور
english: Mama said: "Dad, please fix the light."
transliteration: Mama qalet: "Ya baba, law samaht salah el-noor."

arabic: بابا قال حاضر انا هصلحه دلوقتي
english: Dad said: "Okay, I will fix it now."
transliteration: Baba qaal: "Hader, ana ha-sallaħo delwa'ty."

arabic: الاولاد ساعدوا بابا شوية
english: The children helped Dad a little.
transliteration: El-awlad sa'ado baba showaya.

arabic: دلوقتي النور كويس وكلنا مبسوطين
english: Now the light is good, and we are all happy.
transliteration: Delwa'ty el-noor kowayyes wa kollena mabsooteen.

arabic: سارة ومصطفى كانوا مبسوطين اوي وهما بيخططوا لفرحهم
english: Sara and Mostafa were very happy while planning their wedding.
transliteration: Sara w Mostafa kanu mabsooteen awi w homa biyikhaṭṭeṭu lifarḥehom

arabic: سارة شافت الفستان وقالت ايه دي الفستان ده حلو اوي
english: Sara saw the dress and said what is this, this dress is very beautiful.
transliteration: Sara shafet el fustan w qalet eeh di el fustan da ḥelw awi

arabic: مصطفى كان قلقان شوية من الاكل بس سارة قالت السمك والرز هيكونوا حلوين
english: Mostafa was a little worried about the food but Sara said the fish and rice would be good.
transliteration: Mostafa kan 'alqan shwaya men el akl bas Sara qalet el samak wel rozz haykonu ḥelween

arabic: بعدين شافوا زينة قاعة الفرح بس مصطفى قال الزينة دي مش حلوة خالص
english: Then they saw the decorations for the wedding hall, but Mostafa said these decorations are not good at all.
transliteration: Ba'deen shafu zeenet qa'et el farah bas Mostafa qal el zeena di mush ḥelwa khales

arabic: في الاخر اتفقوا على كل حاجة وكانوا فرحانين ان اليوم قرب
english: In the end, they agreed on everything and were happy that the day was near.
transliteration: Fil akher ettafa'u 'ala kol ḥaga w kanu farḥaneen en el yom qarrab

arabic: فيه ولد صغير بيسال اسئلة كتير كل يوم
english: There is a small boy who asks many questions every day.
transliteration: fīh walad ṣaghīr biyesʾal asʾila kitīr kull yōm

arabic: جده بيقوله انت ليه بتسال كل ده يا حبيبي
english: His grandfather tells him, "Why do you ask all this, my dear?"
transliteration: geddo biʾūl-lo inta lēh bitisʾal kull dah ya ḥabībī

arabic: الولد عايز يعرف كل حاجة جديدة وقديمة
english: The boy wants to know everything new and old.
transliteration: el-walad ʿayiz yaʿraf kull ḥāga gidīda we ʾadīma

arabic: جده كان فاهم زمان ان الحياة بسيطة
english: His grandfather understood in the past that life was simple.
transliteration: geddo kān fāhim zamān inn el-ḥayāh basīṭa

arabic: لكن الولد عنده سؤال جديد دلوقتي كل ثانية
english: But the boy has a new question now every second.
transliteration: lakin el-walad ʿando suʾāl gidīd dilwaʾti kull sānya

arabic: انا قاعد في القهوة مع ماما وبابا
english: I am sitting in the cafe with Mom and Dad.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed fel 'ahwa ma'a Mama we Baba.
storyTitle: At the Cafe with My Family

arabic: احنا مستنيين قهوة وشاي
english: We are waiting for coffee and tea.
transliteration: Ehna mestannyin 'ahwa we shay.
storyTitle: At the Cafe with My Family

arabic: القهوة كبيرة وجميلة
english: The cafe is big and beautiful.
transliteration: El 'ahwa kebira we gamila.
storyTitle: At the Cafe with My Family

arabic: ماما بتحب الشاي وبابا بيحب القهوة
english: Mom loves tea and Dad loves coffee.
transliteration: Mama bethebb esh-shay we Baba beyhebb el 'ahwa.
storyTitle: At the Cafe with My Family

arabic: احنا مبسوطين اوي مع بعض
english: We are very happy together.
transliteration: Ehna mabsooteen awi ma'a ba'd.
storyTitle: At the Cafe with My Family

arabic: كان فيه طفل صغير بيحب يسال كتير
english: There was a small child who loved to ask many questions.
transliteration: Kan fi tefl soghayyar byhebb yis'al keteer.

arabic: سال مامته ليه السما زرقا
english: He asked his mom, 'Why is the sky blue?'
transliteration: Sa'al mamtoh leih el sama zar'a?

arabic: سال باباه فين القطة بتنام
english: He asked his dad, 'Where does the cat sleep?'
transliteration: Sa'al babah fein el otta betnam?

arabic: سال جدته ايه الشجرة الكبيرة دي
english: He asked his grandma, 'What is that big tree?'
transliteration: Sa'al geddetoh eih el shagara el kebeera di?

arabic: فجاة الطفل قال انا ماما
english: Suddenly, the child said, 'I am mom!'
transliteration: Foga'a el tefl 'al 'Ana mama!'

arabic: رحت السوق امبارح واشتريت جاكت كبير اوي لخالي
english: Yesterday I went to the market and bought a very big jacket for my maternal uncle.
transliteration: roḥt is-soo' imbaareḥ w ishtarayt jaaket kibeer awi li-khaali

arabic: لما روحت البيت اكتشفت ان خالي اصلا عايش في اسوان ومحتاجش جواكت
english: When I went home, I discovered that my uncle actually lives in Aswan and doesn't need jackets.
transliteration: lamma rowwaḥt il-beet iktashaft in khaali aṣlan 3aayish fi Aswan w ma-ḥtaagsh gawaakit

arabic: النهاردة الصبح رجعت المحل وقابلت صاحب المحل اللطيف عشان ارجع الجاكت
english: This morning I returned to the shop and met the nice shop owner to return the jacket.
transliteration: in-naharda s-subḥ ragga3t il-maḥall w qabalt ṣaḥib il-maḥall il-laṭeef 3ashaan aragga3 il-jaaket

arabic: قلت له معلش الجاكت طلع بتاع خالتي مش خالي وكان كبير عليها شوية
english: I told him, 'Excuse me, the jacket turned out to be for my maternal aunt, not my uncle, and it was a bit too big for her.'
transliteration: olt lo ma3lesh il-jaaket tala3 bitaa3 khaalti mish khaali w kaan kibeer 3aleeha shwayya

arabic: الراجل ضحك وقالي ماشي مع السلامة اشوفك بكرة لما ترجع حاجة تانية
english: The man laughed and told me, 'Okay, goodbye, see you tomorrow when you return something else.'
transliteration: ir-raagil daḥak w aali maashi ma3a s-salaama ashoofak bokra lamma tirga3 ḥaaga tanya

arabic: النهاردة كل العيلة متجمعة في بيت جدي عشان الغدا
english: Today, the whole family is gathered at my grandfather's house for lunch.
transliteration: Elnaharda koll el 'eila metgam'a fi bayt geddy 'ashan el ghada

arabic: امي قالت الاكل شكله حلو اوي
english: My mother said 'The food looks very good'.
transliteration: Ommy 'alet 'El akl shaklo helw awy'

arabic: اخويا رد ايوه الخضار والفاكهة دول بنحبهم كتير
english: My brother replied 'Yes, we really love these vegetables and fruit'.
transliteration: Akhoya radd 'Aywa el khodaar wel fakha dol benhebbhom keteer'

arabic: ماما قالت طيب يلا نروح السوق الكبير نشتري منهم تاني
english: Mom said 'Okay, let's go to the big market to buy more from them'.
transliteration: Mama 'alet 'Tayyeb yalla nrooh el soo' el kibeer neshtary menhom tany'

arabic: وكلنا فرحنا باللمة والاكل الحلو
english: And we all were happy with the gathering and the delicious food.
transliteration: W kollena faraḥna bel lamma wel akl el helw

arabic: موبايلي رن
english: My phone rang.
transliteration: Mobayli rann.

arabic: كان صاحبي احمد
english: It was my friend Ahmed.
transliteration: Kan sahbi Ahmad.

arabic: صوته كان واضح ومبسوط
english: His voice was clear and happy.
transliteration: Soto kan wadeh we mabsout.

arabic: اتكلمنا عن يومنا
english: We talked about our day.
transliteration: Etkallemna an yomna.

arabic: حسيت بسعادة كبيرة بعد المكالمة
english: I felt great happiness after the call.
transliteration: Hassayt bi sa'ada kebira ba'd el mokalama.

arabic: صباح الفل يا عمو سيد، إزيك عامل إيه؟
english: Good morning, Uncle Sayyed, how are you doing?
transliteration: Sabah el-fol ya 3ammu Sayyed, ezayyik 3amel eh?

arabic: أهلا يا بنتي، صباح النور عليكي، كويس خالص الحمد لله، إنتي عاملة إيه؟
english: Welcome, my daughter, good morning to you too, I'm very well, thank God, how are you?
transliteration: Ahlan ya binti, sabah en-nour 3alayki, kwayyis khales el-ḥamdulillah, inti 3amla eh?

arabic: أنا كويسة يا عمو، بس كنت بدور على كتاب قديم أوي لدراستي، مش لاقياه خالص.
english: I'm good, Uncle, but I was looking for a very old book for my studies, I can't find it at all.
transliteration: Ana kwayyisa ya 3ammu, bas kunt badawwar 3ala kitab 'adeem awi li-dirasti, mish la'yah khales.

arabic: طيب يعني معلش، روحي عند الحاج إبراهيم هناك، يمكن تلاقيه عنده. يا حاج إبراهيم، صباح الخير!
english: Okay, I mean, no worries, go to Haj Ibrahim over there, maybe you'll find it with him. Haj Ibrahim, good morning!
transliteration: Tayyeb ya3ni ma3lesh, roo7i 3and el-7agg Ibrahim honak, yumkin tala'eeh 3andu. Ya 7agg Ibrahim, sabah el-kheir!

arabic: السلام عليكم يا حاج إبراهيم، ممكن أدخل؟
english: Peace be upon you, Haj Ibrahim, may I come in?
transliteration: As-salamu 3alaykum ya 7agg Ibrahim, mumkin adkhol?

arabic: وعليكم السلام ورحمة الله. أهلاً يا بنتي، خير؟ إيه طلبك بالظبط؟
english: And upon you be peace and God's mercy. Welcome, my daughter, what is it? What exactly is your request?
transliteration: Wa 3alaykum as-salam wa raḥmat Allah. Ahlan ya binti, kheir? Eh talabik bel-zabt?

arabic: كنت بأسأل لو عندك كتاب "تاريخ القاهرة" للمقريزي، يعني هو نادر شوية.
english: I was asking if you have the book "History of Cairo" by Al-Maqrizi, I mean, it's a bit rare.
transliteration: Kunt ba'sa'al law 3andak kitab "Tarikh el-Qahira" lel-Maqrizi, ya3ni howa nader shwayya.

arabic: أهو لقيته! بس ده كتاب قديم وغالي شوية يا بنتي، هاعملهولك بـ 250 جنيه.
english: Here it is, I found it! But this is an old and a bit expensive book, my daughter, I'll give it to you for 250 pounds.
transliteration: Aho la'eetoh! Bas da kitab 'adeem w ghali shwayya ya binti, ha3melhoulak bi 250 geneeh.

arabic: يا حاج، معلش ممكن ينزل شوية؟ طب 200 جنيه؟ ماشي، خلاص هاخده كده.
english: Haj, no worries, can it go down a bit? How about 200 pounds? Okay, fine, I'll take it like this.
transliteration: Ya 7agg, ma3lesh mumkin yenzil shwayya? Tab 200 geneeh? Mashi, khalas haakhodoh keda.

arabic: متشكرة أوي يا حاج، سلام عليكم بقى، يومك سعيد.
english: Thank you very much, Haj, goodbye then, have a good day.
transliteration: Mutashakkira awi ya 7agg, salam 3alaykum ba'a, youmak sa3eed.

arabic: صحيت بدري النهاردة لكن حسيت اني متأخرة
english: I woke up early today, but I felt like I was late.
transliteration: Saheet badri ennaharda laken hassayt enni meta'akhkhara.

arabic: عملت فطاري بسرعة وشربت قهوتي
english: I made my breakfast quickly and drank my coffee.
transliteration: Amalt fataari bisor'a we sheribt ahwati.

arabic: لبست هدومي واستعديت للشغل
english: I put on my clothes and got ready for work.
transliteration: Libist hedoomi we esta'addayt le shoghl.

arabic: عارفة ان الطريق هيبقى زحمة النهاردة عشان كده لازم انزل دلوقتي
english: I know the road will be crowded today, that's why I must leave now.
transliteration: Arfa ennet taree' hayeb'a zahma ennaharda ashan keda lazem anzil delwa'ti.

arabic: يالا بينا مع السلامة لحد ما ارجع
english: Let's go, goodbye until I return.
transliteration: Yalla beena ma'a essalama lehad ma arga'.

arabic: كل اسبوع بروح السوق
english: Every week, I go to the market.
transliteration: Kull isbu' barooh il-su'

arabic: عايز اشتري هدوم جديدة
english: I want to buy new clothes.
transliteration: 'Ayiz ashtiri hiduum gidiida

arabic: انا بحب القميص ده
english: I like this shirt.
transliteration: Ana bahebb il-amiis da

arabic: هو لونه احمر وجميل
english: It is red and beautiful.
transliteration: Huwa loonuh ahmar w-gamiil

arabic: هلبسه بكرة
english: I will wear it tomorrow.
transliteration: Halbisu bukra

arabic: اليوم انا وجدي بنشوف كورة
english: Today, my grandfather and I are watching football.
transliteration: El yoom ana we geddy ben-shouf kora.

arabic: هو بيحب اللعيبة القديمة
english: He loves the old players.
transliteration: Howa bi-hebb el la'eeba el adeema.

arabic: انا بحب اللعيبة الجديدة
english: I love the new players.
transliteration: Ana ba-hebb el la'eeba el gedeeda.

arabic: هو بيقول الكورة زمان كانت احلى
english: He says football used to be better in the past.
transliteration: Howa bi-y'oul el kora zaman kanet ahla.

arabic: انا بقول دلوقتي اللعبة اسرع واقوى
english: I say now the game is faster and stronger.
transliteration: Ana ba-y'oul delwa'ty el la'ba asra' w aqwa.

arabic: رحت ازور خالتي في بيتها الكبير
english: I went to visit my aunt in her big house
transliteration: Roht azour khalti fi beitha el kabeer

arabic: اول ما دخلت قالتلي ازيك يا حبيبي عامل ايه
english: As soon as I entered, she said to me, 'How are you, my dear? How are you doing?'
transliteration: Awwel ma dakhalet, 'aletli izzayak ya habibi, 'amel eih

arabic: عملتلي شاي بس حطت سكر كتير اوي
english: She made me tea, but she put a lot of sugar
transliteration: 'Amaletli shay bas hatet sukkar kiteer awi

arabic: شربت الشاي وحسيت اني شاطر اوي وعايز اجري
english: I drank the tea and felt very clever and wanted to run
transliteration: Sheribt el shay w hassayt enni shater awi w 'ayez agry

arabic: دلوقتي اقدر انضف كل البيت لوحدي
english: Now I can clean the whole house by myself
transliteration: Dilwa'ti a'dar anaddaf koll el bayt lewahdi

arabic: انا رحت السوق
english: I went to the market
transliteration: Ana roht es sooq

arabic: اشتريت خضار وفاكهة
english: I bought vegetables and fruit
transliteration: Eshtareet khodaar we fakha

arabic: السوق كان كبير والفاكهة كانت حلوة
english: The market was big and the fruit was sweet
transliteration: Es sooq kaan kabeer wel fakha kanet helwa

arabic: كنت عايزة اشتري تاني بس نسيت فلوسي
english: I wanted to buy more, but I forgot my money
transliteration: Kont ayza eshtary taany bas neseet felousy

arabic: فروحت البيت
english: So I went back home
transliteration: Fa roht el beit

arabic: كان يوم مطرة بعد الضهر والكل كان في البيت
english: It was a rainy afternoon and everyone was at home.
transliteration: kan yom matara ba'd el dohr wel kol kan fel beit

arabic: جدتي بتحب تقرا كتاب لما الدنيا بتمطر
english: My grandma likes to read a book when it rains.
transliteration: geddeti bethebb te'ra ketab lamma el donya betmatar

arabic: بس اخويا بيحب يلعب على موبايله ومبيقراش
english: But my brother likes to play on his phone and doesn't read.
transliteration: bas akhuya bihebb yel'ab 'ala mobaylo w mabiyiraash

arabic: جدتي سالته ليه مبتجبش كتاب تقراه زيي
english: Grandma asked him "Why don't you take a book to read like me?"
transliteration: geddeti sa'aleto "leih mabtgebsh ketab te'raah zayyi?"

arabic: هو قال انا مبفهمش الكتب اوي وبحب الموبايل اكتر
english: He said "I don't understand books much and I like my phone more."
transliteration: howa 'al "ana mabafhamsh el kotob awi w bahebb el mobayl aktar"

arabic: اليوم انا عايز اعمل اكل جديد
english: Today I want to make a new dish.
transliteration: El-yoom ana 'ayez a'mel akl gedid

arabic: رحت السوق عشان اشتري حاجات
english: I went to the market to buy things.
transliteration: Roht el-souq 'ashan eshtery hagāt

arabic: ماما ساعدتني في الوصفة
english: My mother helped me with the recipe.
transliteration: Mama sa'adetni fel-wasfa

arabic: طبخنا سوا في المطبخ
english: We cooked together in the kitchen.
transliteration: Tabakhna sawa fel-matbakh

arabic: الاكل كان حلو اوي واكلنا مع العيلة
english: The food was very delicious and we ate with the family.
transliteration: El-akl kan helw awi w'akalna ma'a el-'eila

arabic: امبارح كنت عايز اجرب اعمل اكل جديد اول مرة
english: Yesterday I wanted to try cooking a new dish for the first time
transliteration: Embaareh kont aayez agarrab aamel akl gadeed awel marra

arabic: حطيت كتير ملح وشوية سكر بالغلط في الحلة
english: I put a lot of salt and a little sugar by mistake in the pot
transliteration: Hattayt keteer malh w shewaya sukkar belghalat fel hella

arabic: شكل الاكل كان غريب مش زي الصورة خالص
english: The food's shape was strange not like the picture at all
transliteration: Shakl el akl kaan ghareeb mesh zayy el soora khaales

arabic: لما صاحبي داقها ضحك كتير وقال ايه ده
english: When my friend tasted it he laughed a lot and said 'What is this?'
transliteration: Lamma sahbi daa'aha dehek keteer w 'aal eih da

arabic: قلت له ده اكل جديد يمكن يكون لذيذ بكرة
english: I told him 'It's a new dish maybe it will be delicious tomorrow!'
transliteration: Oltelo da akl gadeed yimkin yekoon lazeedh bokra

arabic: انا اصحى الصبح بدري كل يوم
english: I wake up early every morning.
transliteration: Ana as7a el sob7 badry kol yoom.

arabic: اكل فطار فول واشرب شاي
english: I eat foul for breakfast and drink tea.
transliteration: Akol fitaar fool w ashrab shay.

arabic: البس هدومي عشان اروح الشغل
english: I get dressed to go to work.
transliteration: Albas hedoommy 3ashan aroo7 el shoghl.

arabic: اقول مع السلامة لاهلي
english: I say goodbye to my family.
transliteration: A'ool ma3 el salama la ahly.

arabic: اروح الشغل بالاتوبيس
english: I go to work by bus.
transliteration: Aroo7 el shoghl bel atoobees.

arabic: كنت ماشية بره وشفت صاحبة قديمة
english: I was walking outside and saw an old friend.
transliteration: Kunt mashya barra we shoft ṣāḥiba qadīma.

arabic: سلمنا على بعض واتكلمنا عن قد ايه الدنيا اتغيرت
english: We greeted each other and talked about how much the world has changed.
transliteration: Sallamna 3ala ba3ḍ we tkallamna 3an qadd eih id-dunya itghayyarit.

arabic: قالتلي ان ولادها طول الوقت ماسكين الموبايلات مش زينا زمان
english: She told me her kids are always holding their phones, not like us back then.
transliteration: Qālitli in wilādha tool il-waqt maskīn il-mobilāt mish zayyina zamān.

arabic: وافقتها و افتكرت ازاي كنا بنلعب بره طول اليوم
english: I agreed with her and remembered how we used to play outside all day.
transliteration: Wāfaqtaha we iftakart izzay kunna binil3ab barra tool il-yōm.

arabic: ضحكنا على الفرق ووعدنا اننا نتقابل تاني قريب
english: We laughed at the difference and promised to meet again soon.
transliteration: Ḍiḥikna 3ala il-far' we wa3adna innana nit'ābil tāni qarayyib.

arabic: احنا عايزين نعمل فرح كبير
english: We want to organize a big wedding
transliteration: Ehna ayzeen na'mel fara7 kabeer

arabic: ماما وبابا هيساعدونا كتير
english: Mom and Dad will help us a lot
transliteration: Mama w Baba hayesa'edona keteer

arabic: احنا عايزين نشتري هدوم جديدة للفرح
english: We want to buy new clothes for the wedding
transliteration: Ehna ayzeen neshtiry hedoom gedida lel fara7

arabic: بكرة هنروح السوق نشتري حاجات
english: Tomorrow we will go to the market to buy things
transliteration: Bokra hanrooh es-soo' neshtiry hagaat

arabic: هيكون فيه اكل حلو كتير للكل
english: There will be a lot of delicious food for everyone
transliteration: Haykoon feeh akl helw keteer lel kol

arabic: انا عايز اروح مكان جديد بكرة
english: I want to go to a new place tomorrow.
transliteration: Ana ayiz arooh makan gedeed bokra.

arabic: احنا هنروح قرية صغيرة عند النيل
english: We will go to a small village by the Nile.
transliteration: Ehna hanrooh qarya soghayyara 'and el Neel.

arabic: هناك هنزور العيلة وناكل اكل بلدي حلو
english: There, we will visit family and eat delicious local food.
transliteration: Henaak hanzoor el 'eila w nakol akl balady helw.

arabic: قبل ما نمشي لازم نشتري هدايا من السوق
english: Before we leave, we must buy gifts from the market.
transliteration: Qabl ma nemshi lazem neshtiry hadaya min el souq.

arabic: و اهم حاجة نقول صباح الخير لكل الناس
english: And the most important thing, we say 'Good morning' to all people.
transliteration: W ahamm haga ne'ool 'Sabah el kheer' le koll el nas.

arabic: احنا دلوقتي في القهوة
english: We are at the café now.
transliteration: Ehna delwa'ti fi el-ahwa

arabic: عيلتي معايا
english: My family is with me.
transliteration: Eilty ma'aya

arabic: انا مستني بابا
english: I am waiting for my father.
transliteration: Ana mestanni baba

arabic: الجو دافي وحلو
english: The weather is warm and nice.
transliteration: El-gaw dafi we helw

arabic: هنشرب شاي سوا
english: We will drink tea together.
transliteration: Hanishrab shay sawa

arabic: امبارح اشتريت كتاب عن الاحزاب السياسية بس اكتشفت انه مش اللي كنت عايزاه
english: Yesterday I bought a book about political parties but I discovered it wasn't what I wanted.
transliteration: Embāreḥ eshtarayt ketāb ʿan el-aḥzāb es-sīyāsīya bas aktashaft ennoh mesh elly kont ʿayzāh.

arabic: الصبح صحيت بدري عشان ارجعه للمحل
english: In the morning I woke up early to return it to the shop.
transliteration: Es-ṣobḥ saḥīt badri ʿashan argāʿoh lel-maḥall.

arabic: المحل كان زحمة شوية والناس كانت بتتكلم عن التصويت اللي جاي
english: The shop was a bit crowded and people were talking about the upcoming voting.
transliteration: El-maḥall kān zaḥma showayya w-en-nās kānet betetkallem ʿan et-taṣwīt elly gāy.

arabic: الموظف كان لطيف جدا وقبل يرجع الكتاب بسهولة
english: The employee was very kind and accepted to return the book easily.
transliteration: El-moẓẓaf kān laṭīf geddan w-ʾabel yeraggaʿ el-ketāb be-sohūla.

arabic: دلوقتي اقدر اشتري الكتاب الصح اللي كنت بدور عليه
english: Now I can buy the correct book I was looking for.
transliteration: Delwaʾty aqdar eshtari el-ketāb es-saḥḥ elly kont badawwar ʿalēh.

arabic: أيوة، عايزة كركديه.
english: Yes, I want karkade.
transliteration: Aywa, ayza karkadeh.

arabic: منى في خان الخليلي، ناس كتير هناك.
english: Mona is in Khan el-Khalili, many people are there.
transliteration: Mona fi Khan el-Khalili, nas keteer henāk.

arabic: هي عايزة كركديه جديد، ورأت كلب صغير.
english: She wants new karkade, and she saw a small dog.
transliteration: Hiya ayza karkadeh gedid, wa ra'at kalb sagheer.

arabic: معلش، قالت للبائع بهدوء.
english: Excuse me, she told the vendor calmly.
transliteration: Ma'lesh, alit lel-baye3 be-hodoo'.

arabic: دفعت خمسة جنيه، وكانت فرحانة.
english: She paid five pounds, and she was happy.
transliteration: Dafa'at khamsa geneh, wa kanat farhana.

arabic: الصبح قمت بدري علشان اروح المدرسة
english: In the morning, I woke up early to go to school.
transliteration: El sobh omet badri alashan arouh el madrasa.

arabic: سمعت صوت العصافير برا الشباك
english: I heard the sound of birds outside the window.
transliteration: Sema't sot el asafeer barra el shebbak.

arabic: في المدرسة شفت صحابي وضحكنا كتير
english: At school, I saw my friends and we laughed a lot.
transliteration: Fel madrasa shoft sohabi w dehekna keteer.

arabic: كان فيه ريحة اكل حلوة جاية من الكانتين
english: There was a nice smell of food coming from the canteen.
transliteration: Kan fe rehet akl helwa gaya men el kanteen.

arabic: بعد اليوم رجعت البيت وانا فرحان
english: After the day, I returned home and I was happy.
transliteration: Ba'd el yom rege't el beit wana farhan.

arabic: العيلة قاعدة على السفرة
english: The family is sitting at the dining table.
transliteration: El-3eila 2a3da 3ala el-sofra.

arabic: هما بياكلوا رز وفراخ
english: They are eating rice and chicken.
transliteration: Homa byaklū rozz we farākh.

arabic: كل واحد سعيد وبيضحك
english: Everyone is happy and laughing.
transliteration: Koll wāḥed sa3īd we byedḥak.

arabic: فجأة الكلب الصغير دخل المطبخ
english: Suddenly the small dog entered the kitchen.
transliteration: Fag2a el-kalb el-ṣoghayyar dakhal el-maṭbakh.

arabic: كلهم ضحكوا بصوت عالي
english: They all laughed loudly.
transliteration: Kolluhom ḍeḥku be-ṣōt 3āli.

arabic: الصبح بدري البيت زحمة
english: Early morning the house is busy
transliteration: El sobh badri el beit zahma

arabic: ماما بتجهز الفطار بسرعة
english: Mom prepares breakfast quickly
transliteration: Mama betegehhez el fetar besor3a

arabic: انا بشرب الشاي مع بابا
english: I drink tea with dad
transliteration: Ana bashrab el shay ma3a baba

arabic: اخويا الصغير بيلعب في الاوضة
english: My little brother plays in the room
transliteration: Akhouya el sagheer beyel3ab fi el oda

arabic: كلنا بنروح الشغل دلوقتي
english: We all go to work now
transliteration: Kollena benrouh el shoghl delwa'ti

arabic: انا كنت عايز اشتري هدوم جديدة
english: I wanted to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Ana kont ayiz ishtari hedoum gedida

arabic: رحت محل كبير في وسط البلد
english: I went to a big shop downtown.
transliteration: Roht mahall kibeer fi wast el balad

arabic: شفت قميص لونه ازرق جميل جدا وعجبني اوي
english: I saw a very beautiful blue shirt and I liked it a lot.
transliteration: Shoft amees lonoh azraq gameel geddan we agabni awi

arabic: بس لما سالت على السعر حسيت انه غالي شوية
english: But when I asked about the price, I felt it was a bit expensive.
transliteration: Bas lamma sa'alt ala el se'r hassayt inno ghali shwayya

arabic: في الاخر قررت اشتريه لاني كنت مبسوط بيه
english: In the end, I decided to buy it because I was happy with it.
transliteration: Fil akher qarrart ashtareeh le'anni kont mabsout beih

arabic: سارة ساكنة في بيت كبير
english: Sara lives in a big house.
transliteration: Sara sakna fi beit kabeer.

arabic: النهاردة مفيش أكل في البيت
english: Today there is no food in the house.
transliteration: El Naharda mafeesh akl fi el beit.

arabic: هي عايزة تاكل رز وسمك
english: She wants to eat rice and fish.
transliteration: Heya ayza takol rozz w samak.

arabic: بنت صغيرة بتلعب بكتب كتير في المطبخ
english: A small girl is playing with many books in the kitchen.
transliteration: Bent soghayara betla'b b kotob kiteer fi el matbakh.

arabic: لقيت الأكل كله تحت الكتب
english: She found all the food under the books!
transliteration: La'eit el akl kollu ta7t el kotob!

arabic: اليوم طبخت اكلة جديدة اول مرة
english: Today I cooked a new dish for the first time.
transliteration: El-youm tabakht akla gedida awwal marra.

arabic: ماما وبابا ساعدوني في المطبخ
english: Mom and Dad helped me in the kitchen.
transliteration: Mama we baba sa'adooni fil matbakh.

arabic: الريحة كانت حلوة اوي في البيت
english: The smell was very nice in the house.
transliteration: El-reeha kanet helwa awi fil beit.

arabic: كلنا اكلنا سوا وكان طعمها جميل
english: We all ate together and it tasted delicious.
transliteration: Kullena akalna sawa we kan ta'maha gameel.

arabic: العيلة كانت مبسوطة والاكل كان دافي وحلو
english: The family was happy and the food was warm and nice.
transliteration: El-3eila kanet mabsoota wel akl kan dafy we helw.

arabic: النهاردة انا رحت محل هدوم جديد
english: Today I went to a new clothes shop.
transliteration: Elnaharda ana roht mahal hedoom gedeed.

arabic: المحل كان كبير اوي وفيه الوان كتير
english: The shop was very big and had many colors.
transliteration: Elmahal kan kabeer awi we fee alwan kiteer.

arabic: انا شفت قميص احمر و بنطلون ازرق
english: I saw a red shirt and blue trousers.
transliteration: Ana shoft amees ahmar we bantaloon azraq.

arabic: القميص كان جميل بس سعره غالي شوية
english: The shirt was beautiful but its price was a bit expensive.
transliteration: Elamees kan gameel bas se'ro ghaly shwaya.

arabic: اخدت بنطلون ازرق عشان كان رخيص ومقاسي
english: I bought the blue trousers because they were cheap and my size.
transliteration: Akhadt bantaloon azraq ashan kan rakhees we ma'asy.

arabic: أحمد ومحمد بيتفرجوا على ماتش كورة مهم في التلفزيون
english: Ahmed and Mohamed are watching an important football match on TV.
transliteration: Ahmed we Mohamed beitfaraggu ala matsh koora mohem fel-telefizyoon.

arabic: أحمد بيقول أنا بحب الفرقة دي أوي
english: Ahmed says 'I really like this team'.
transliteration: Ahmed bi'ool 'ana bahebb el-fer'a di awi'.

arabic: محمد بيسأل هما ليه بيلعبوا كده النهاردة
english: Mohamed asks 'Why are they playing like this today?'
transliteration: Mohamed biyis'al 'homa leih beyl'abo keda el-naharda'.

arabic: أحمد بيقول مش فاهم يمكن اللعيبة تعبانة شوية
english: Ahmed says 'I don't understand, maybe the players are a bit tired'.
transliteration: Ahmed bi'ool 'mesh fahem yimkin el-la'eeba ta'bana shwaya'.

arabic: محمد بيقول يلا ناخد فشار واحنا بنتفرج
english: Mohamed says 'Let's take popcorn while we're watching'.
transliteration: Mohamed bi'ool 'yalla nakho fushar we ehna bentfarag'.

arabic: موبايلي رن فجأة
english: My mobile phone rang suddenly.
transliteration: mobaily rann foga'a

arabic: كان صديقي احمد بيتصل بيا
english: It was my friend Ahmed calling me.
transliteration: kaan sadeeqi Ahmed biyettasel beya

arabic: انا رديت عليه وكنت مبسوط اوي
english: I answered him and was very happy.
transliteration: ana radeet 'aleih w kont mabsoot awi

arabic: هو قال لي خبر حلو فضحكت
english: He told me good news, so I laughed.
transliteration: howa 'al li khabar helw fa dehekt

arabic: اتفقنا نتقابل قريب نتكلم اكتر
english: We agreed to meet soon to talk more.
transliteration: ettafaqna net'abel 'orayeb netkallem aktar

arabic: انا تايه هنا في القاهرة
english: I am lost here in Cairo
transliteration: Ana tayeh hena fel Qahera

arabic: سألت راجل كبير فين شارع الشجرة من فضلك
english: I asked an old man 'Where is El Shagara street, please?'
transliteration: Sa'alt ragel kabeer feen share' el shagara men fadlak

arabic: هو قال امشي على طول وبعدين يمين عند الجامع الكبير
english: He said 'Go straight then right at the big mosque'
transliteration: Howa 'al emshy 'ala tool w ba'deen yemeen 'and el game' el kabeer

arabic: انا ما فهمتش كويس فسألت بنت صغيرة فين الشارع ده
english: I didn't understand well so I asked a young girl 'Where is this street?'
transliteration: Ana ma fehemtesh kwayyes fa sa'alt bent sagheera feen el share' dah

arabic: هي قالت امشي يمين وبعدين شمال عند المترو
english: She said 'Go right then left at the metro'
transliteration: Hiyya 'alet emshy yemeen w ba'deen shemal 'and el metro

arabic: النهاردة انا كنت رايح السوق بس تهت
english: Today I was going to the market but I got lost.
transliteration: El naharda ana kunt rayeh el souq bass tehet

arabic: شفت راجل كبير وانا قلتلو من فضلك
english: I saw an old man and I told him, 'Please'.
transliteration: Shaft raagil kibeer wa ana oltelo min fadlak

arabic: انا قلتلو يا استاذ ازاي اروح السوق
english: I told him, 'Sir, how do I get to the market?'
transliteration: Ana oltelo ya ustaz ezay arouh el souq

arabic: هو قلي امشي على طول هتلاقي السوق
english: He told me, 'Walk straight, you will find the market'.
transliteration: Howa qalli emshi ala tool hatlaqi el souq

arabic: انا قلتلو شكرا جدا يا استاذ
english: I told him, 'Thank you very much, sir'.
transliteration: Ana oltelo shukran gidan ya ustaz

arabic: انا تهت في الشارع ده
english: I got lost on this street.
transliteration: Ana teht fi esh-shaare' da.

arabic: سألت بنت معلش فين البيت الكبير
english: I asked a girl, "Excuse me, where is the big house?"
transliteration: Sa'alt bent "Ma'lesh feen el beit el kabeer?"

arabic: هي شاورت وقالت البيت الكبير ده بتاعي
english: She pointed and said, "That big house is mine."
transliteration: Heya shawwaret w qalet "El beit el kabeer da beta'i."

arabic: انا قلت اه خلاص شكرا
english: I said, "Oh, okay, thank you."
transliteration: Ana olt "Ah, khalas shokran."

arabic: هي ابتسمت وقالت انا كويسة الحمد لله
english: She smiled and said, "I am good, thank God."
transliteration: Heya ebtasmet w qalet "Ana kwayyesa el7amdulellah."

arabic: صحيت الصبح ولقيت الغسالة بايظة خالص
english: I woke up in the morning and found the washing machine completely broken.
transliteration: Saḥeet eṣ-ṣobḥ wel'eet el-ghassāla bayẓa khāleṣ.

arabic: كل الهدوم اللي عايزه تتغسل كانت مكومة بره على البلكونة
english: All the clothes that needed washing were piled up outside on the balcony.
transliteration: Koll el-hedoom elli 3ayza tetghasel kānet mekawwama barra 3ala el-balkōna.

arabic: كلمت صاحبتي سارة عشان اشوف لو عندها فكرة
english: I called my friend Sara to see if she had an idea.
transliteration: Kallamt ṣāḥebti Sāra 3ashān ashoof law 3andaha fekra.

arabic: قالتلي ان عمها ميكانيكي شاطر وممكن يصلحها
english: She told me that her paternal uncle is a skilled mechanic and could fix it.
transliteration: 'Aletli en 3ammaha mīkānīki shāṭer w momken yeṣlaḥha.

arabic: يارب يعرف يجي النهارده عشان نخلص من المشكلة دي
english: I hope he can come today so we can get rid of this problem.
transliteration: Ya rabb ye3raf yīgi en-naharda 3ashān nekhlaṣ men el-moshkela dī.

arabic: انا عايزة اعمل طبق جديد النهاردة
english: I want to make a new dish today.
transliteration: Ana ayza a'mel tabaq gedid elnaharda.

arabic: ماما قالتلي الوصفة بس انا بحب اشوفها اونلاين
english: Mom told me the recipe but I like to see it online.
transliteration: Mama 'aletli elwasfa bas ana baheb ashofha online.

arabic: زمان ماما كانت بتعمل الاكل من غير وصفة مكتوبة
english: Long ago, Mom used to make food without a written recipe.
transliteration: Zaman mama kanet bete'mel elakl men gheir wasfa maktouba.

arabic: دلوقتي كل بنت بتشوف وصفات جديدة على الموبايل
english: Now every girl sees new recipes on the mobile.
transliteration: Delwa'ti kol bint betshouf wasafat gedida 'ala elmobile.

arabic: الاكل طلع حلو بس مش زي اكل ماما زمان
english: The food turned out good but not like mom's food from long ago.
transliteration: Elakl tele' helw bas mish zayy akl mama zaman.

arabic: صباح الخير يا احمد
english: Good morning, Ahmed.
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya Ahmed.

arabic: احمد قال لي ازيك يا هدى
english: Ahmed asked me 'How are you, Hoda?'
transliteration: Ahmed 'al li izzayek ya Hoda.

arabic: انا قلت الحمد لله انا كويسة
english: I said 'Praise be to God, I am good.'
transliteration: Ana 'olt alhamdulillah ana kwayyesa.

arabic: هو سال عن الاسرة
english: He asked about the family.
transliteration: Howwa sa'al 'an el osra.

arabic: انا قلت كلهم كويسين شكرا
english: I said 'They are all good, thank you.'
transliteration: Ana 'olt kollohom kwayyesin shokran.

arabic: النهاردة ماما وبابا قرروا نروح نشتري هدوم جديدة للشتا
english: Today, Mom and Dad decided we would go buy new clothes for winter.
transliteration: El-naharda mama we baba qararaw nerouh neshtari hedom gedida lel-sheta.

arabic: اختي الصغيرة فرحت اوي عشان هتلبس فستان احمر جميل
english: My little sister was very happy because she would wear a beautiful red dress.
transliteration: Okhty es-soghayyara farehet awi ʿashan hatelbes fostan ahmar gameel.

arabic: انا دورت على جاكيت تقيل عشان الجو بيبقى برد جدا
english: I looked for a heavy jacket because the weather gets very cold.
transliteration: Ana dawwart ʿala jacket taʾeel ʿashan el-gaww beyebʾa bard geddan.

arabic: بابا اختار قميص ازرق وماما قالت له انه لايق عليه اوي
english: Dad chose a blue shirt and Mom told him it suited him very much.
transliteration: Baba ekhtar qamees azraq we mama qalet lo enno layeq ʿaleih awi.

arabic: كلنا كنا مبسوطين بالهدوم الجديدة واليوم الجميل ده
english: All of us were happy with the new clothes and this beautiful day.
transliteration: Kollena konna mabsooteen bel-hedom el-gedida wel-yom el-gameel dah.

arabic: انا بروح السوق كل يوم
english: I go to the market every day.
transliteration: Ana barooh is-soo' kull yoom.

arabic: انا عايز اشتري فواكه وخضار
english: I want to buy fruits and vegetables.
transliteration: Ana 3ayez ashtiri fawakeh wi KhoDaar.

arabic: السوق كبير وفيه اكل كتير
english: The market is big and has a lot of food.
transliteration: Is-soo' kibeer wi feeh akl kiteer.

arabic: انا معايا شوية فلوس
english: I have a little money.
transliteration: Ana ma3aya showayet feloos.

arabic: وبعدين بروح البيت
english: Then I go home.
transliteration: Wi ba3dein barooh il-beit.

arabic: صحيت متأخر النهاردة وكنت قلقانة
english: I woke up late today and was worried.
transliteration: Sa7eet meta'akher ennaharda we kont qalqana.

arabic: جريت بسرعة عشان ألبس هدومي
english: I ran quickly to get dressed.
transliteration: Gareet besor3a 3ashan albes hedoumi.

arabic: مفيش وقت للفطار خالص
english: There's no time for breakfast at all.
transliteration: Mafeesh wa't lel fetar khales.

arabic: نزلت من البيت بسرعة عشان أروح الشغل
english: I left the house quickly to go to work.
transliteration: Nezelt men elbeet besor3a 3ashan aroo7 esh-shoghl.

arabic: كنت تعبانة بس لازم أشتغل
english: I was tired but I have to work.
transliteration: Kont ta3bana bass lazem ashtaghal.

arabic: انا طبخت اكل جديد النهاردة
english: I cooked new food today.
transliteration: Ana tabakht akl gedid elnaharda.
storyTitle: A New Dish for My Grandmother

arabic: كان صعب شوية عشان الوصفة طويلة
english: It was a bit difficult because the recipe was long.
transliteration: Kan sa'b shwayya 'ashan elwasfa tawila.
storyTitle: A New Dish for My Grandmother

arabic: جدتي جت و شافت الاكل
english: My grandmother came and saw the food.
transliteration: Geddety gat we shafet elakl.
storyTitle: A New Dish for My Grandmother

arabic: هي قالت الاكل بتاع زمان كان اسهل و احلى
english: She said the food from old times was easier and better.
transliteration: Heya 'alet elakl beta' zaman kan ashal we ahla.
storyTitle: A New Dish for My Grandmother

arabic: بس انا حبيت الاكل الجديد بتاعي جدا
english: But I liked my new food very much.
transliteration: Bas ana habbayt elakl elgedid beta'i geddan.
storyTitle: A New Dish for My Grandmother

arabic: جدتي وانا بنروح السوق كل جمعة
english: My grandma and I go to the market every Friday.
transliteration: Giddeti w ana binrooh is-soo' kull gam'a

arabic: هي بتحب تتكلم مع البياعين كتير وتشتري خضار طازج
english: She likes to talk a lot with the sellers and buy fresh vegetables.
transliteration: Heyya bithebb titkallem ma' el-bayya'een kiteer we tishtiri khodaar taazig

arabic: انا بفضل اشتري بسرعة وادفع بالموبايل
english: I prefer to buy quickly and pay with my phone.
transliteration: Ana bafraddal ishtiri bisor'a we adfa' bil-mobaayil

arabic: جدتي بتقول السوق زمان كان احلى بكتير
english: My grandma says the market in the past was much nicer.
transliteration: Giddeti bit'ool is-soo' zamaan kaan ahla bikteer

arabic: انا بشوف السوق دلوقتي سهل ومريح اكتر
english: I see the market now as easier and more comfortable.
transliteration: Ana bashoof is-soo' dilwa'ti sahl we moreeh aktar

arabic: انا وسارة بنحب نسافر في الويك إند
english: Sarah and I love to travel on weekends
transliteration: Ana w Sara bihebb nsafer fil week end

arabic: سارة كانت بتقرا عن اماكن جديدة وبتسألني ايه رأيي
english: Sarah was reading about new places and asking me my opinion
transliteration: Sara kanit bitira an amaken gedida w bitsalni eh ra'yi

arabic: انا قلت لها اني عايز اروح البحر وهي قالت انا كمان بحب البحر
english: I told her I wanted to go to the sea, and she said 'I also love the sea'
transliteration: Ana ultelha inni ayiz arouh el bahr w heya alit 'ana kaman bahebb el bahr'

arabic: اتفقنا ناخد شنطنا ونصحى بدري يوم الجمعة
english: We agreed to take our bags and wake up early on Friday
transliteration: Ettefa'na nakhod shonatina w nisha badri yom el goma'a

arabic: لكن لما صحينا الصبح لقينا الباب مقفول والمفتاح مش موجود
english: But when we woke up in the morning, we found the door closed and the key missing!
transliteration: Lakin lamma sihina el sobh le'ina el bab ma'fool wel moftah mish mawgoud!

arabic: هدى شافت فانوس قديم بخان الخليلي.
english: Hoda saw an old lamp in Khan el-Khalili.
transliteration: Hoda shafet fanoos adeem be Khan el-Khalili.

arabic: عايزاه لمشروعها بس كانت مكسوفة.
english: She wanted it for her project but was shy.
transliteration: Ayzaha le mashro'aha bas kanet maksoofa.

arabic: عمو أحمد، البائع، قال: أهلاً.
english: Uncle Ahmed, the vendor, said: Hello.
transliteration: Ammu Ahmed, el-baa'e', qal: Ahlan.

arabic: هدى ردت: أهلاً يا عمو.
english: Hoda replied: Hello, Uncle.
transliteration: Hoda raddet: Ahlan ya ammu.

arabic: سألها: إزيك؟ هدى ابتسمت.
english: He asked her: How are you? Hoda smiled.
transliteration: Sa'alha: Izzayik? Hoda ibtisamet.

arabic: منى تعبانة النهاردة في البيت
english: Mona is tired today at home.
transliteration: Mona ta'bana ennaharda fi elbeit.

arabic: فيه مشكلة صغيرة في المطبخ النور مش شغال
english: There is a small problem in the kitchen, the light is not working.
transliteration: Fih moshkela saghira fi elmatbakh ennoor mesh shaghghal.

arabic: هي زعلانة عشان عايزة تعمل اكل
english: She is sad because she wants to make food.
transliteration: Heya za'lana 'ashan 'ayza ta'mel akl.

arabic: اخوها جه البيت عشان يساعدها
english: Her brother came home to help her.
transliteration: Akhooha geh elbeit 'ashan yesa'edha.

arabic: دلوقتي النور كويس ومنى مبسوطة جدا
english: Now the light is good and Mona is very happy.
transliteration: Delwa'ty ennoor kwayyes w Mona mabsoota geddan.

arabic: كنت ماشي في القاهرة وزهقت من الطريق فتهت
english: I was walking in Cairo and got tired of the road, so I got lost.
transliteration: Kont mashi fi el Qahira we zehe't men el taree', fa tehet.

arabic: سألت شاب صغير ازاي اروح محطة المترو قالي امشي شمال عند المول الجديد
english: I asked a young man how to get to the metro station, he told me to go left at the new mall.
transliteration: Sa'alt shabb soghayar ezay aroo7 ma7attet el metro, qali emshi shemal 3and el mall el gedid.

arabic: المول ده انا مش عارفه هو لسه فاتح قريب
english: I don't know this mall; it just opened recently.
transliteration: El mall da ana mesh 3arfo, howa lessa fate7 o'rayeb.

arabic: سألت راجل عجوز قالي امشي طوالي لغاية ما تلاقي كوبري ابو العلا وبعدين يمين
english: I asked an old man, he told me to walk straight until you find the Abu El Ela bridge, then turn right.
transliteration: Sa'alt ragel 3agooz, qali emshi tawali leghayet ma tla'i kobri Abu El Ela we ba3den yemeen.

arabic: كده فهمت الطريق كويس انا دايما باكل فول جنب الكوبري ده
english: This way I understood the path well. I always eat foul (beans) next to this bridge.
transliteration: Keda fehemt el taree' kwayes. Ana dayman bakol fool gamb el kobri da.

arabic: النهاردة رحنا نزور خالتي
english: Today we went to visit my aunt.
transliteration: El Naharda rohna nzoor khalty.

arabic: ركبنا سكوتر عشان نوصل لبيتها
english: We rode a scooter to reach her house.
transliteration: Rekebna skooter ashan nowsal le beitaha.

arabic: كان لازم نحود يمين عند الناصية الكبيرة
english: We had to turn right at the big street corner.
transliteration: Kan lazim na7uud yemeen 3and el nasiya el kebeera.

arabic: لما وصلنا خالتي قالت اهلا بيكم
english: When we arrived, my aunt said 'Welcome'.
transliteration: Lamma wesalna khalty qalet ahlan beekum.

arabic: شربنا شاي سوا واتكلمنا شوية
english: We drank tea together and talked a little.
transliteration: Sheribna shay sawa wetkallamna shwaya.

arabic: انا النهاردة طبخت اكلة جديدة لاول مرة
english: Today I cooked a new dish for the first time.
transliteration: Ana elnaharda tabakht akla gedida le awwal marra.
storyTitle: A New Dish in the Big House

arabic: انا ساكنة في بيت كبير وعزمت صحابي
english: I live in a big house and invited my friends.
transliteration: Ana sakna fi beit kabeer we 'azamt ashaby.
storyTitle: A New Dish in the Big House

arabic: احنا بناكل عيش و رز مع الاكلة دي
english: We eat bread and rice with this dish.
transliteration: E7na benakol 'eish we rozz ma'a el akla di.
storyTitle: A New Dish in the Big House

arabic: كل بنت كان ليها طبقها الخاص
english: Every girl had her own plate.
transliteration: Koll bent kan leeha tabakha el khas.
storyTitle: A New Dish in the Big House

arabic: الاكل كان حلو قوي وانا كويسة الحمد لله
english: The food was very good and I am good, thank God.
transliteration: El akl kan 7elw awy we ana kwayyesa el7amdulellah.
storyTitle: A New Dish in the Big House

arabic: سارة كانت قاعدة بتتفرج على التلفزيون ومبسوطة جدا
english: Sara was sitting watching TV and was very happy.
transliteration: Sara kanet a'da betetfarag a'la el televisyoun we mabsoota geddan

arabic: فجأة الريموت وقع منها واتكسر نصين
english: Suddenly the remote fell from her hand and broke into two pieces.
transliteration: Faga'a el remote wa'a menha we etkassar nossein

arabic: زعلت قوي ومبقيتش عارفة تعمل ايه
english: She got very sad and didn't know what to do.
transliteration: Ze'let qawi we mabqetsh a'arfa ta'mel eh

arabic: اخوها احمد دخل وشافها زعلانة وسألها فيه ايه
english: Her brother Ahmed came in and saw her sad and asked her what was wrong.
transliteration: Akhooha Ahmed dakhal we shafha za'lana we sa'alha feh eh

arabic: احمد قالها متقلقيش احنا هنلاقي حل للمشكلة دي
english: Ahmed told her "Don't worry, we will find a solution for this problem."
transliteration: Ahmed a'alha mat'ala'ish ehna hanla'i hall lel moshkela di

arabic: امبارح ماما اشترت قميص لبابا من المحل
english: Yesterday, Mama bought a shirt for Baba from the shop.
transliteration: Embareh Mama eshtaret qamees le Baba men el mahal.

arabic: بس القميص دا كان كبير شوية على بابا
english: But this shirt was a bit big for Baba.
transliteration: Bas el qamees da kan kbeer shwayya ala Baba.

arabic: ماما قالتلي يا بنتي ممكن ترجعي الحاجة دي
english: Mama told me 'My daughter, can you return this thing?'
transliteration: Mama qaletli ya benty momken teragga'i el haga di?

arabic: انا وبابا رحنا المحل الصبح بدري
english: Baba and I went to the shop early in the morning.
transliteration: Ana w Baba rohna el mahal el sobh badry.

arabic: المحل رجعلنا الفلوس وشكرناهم
english: The shop returned the money to us and we thanked them.
transliteration: El mahal ragga'elna el feloos w shokranahom.

arabic: صباح الخير يا أم علي ازيك النهاردة
english: Good morning, Umm Ali, how are you today?
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya Umm Ali izzayek el naharda?

arabic: صباح النور يا أم محمد انا كويسة الحمد لله
english: Good morning, Umm Mohammad, I am good, praise be to God.
transliteration: Sabah el noor ya Umm Mohammad ana kwayyesa el hamdulillah.

arabic: اتفضلي ادخلي بيتي اشربي شاي
english: Please, come into my house, drink tea.
transliteration: Etfaddali odkhuli beity eshrabi shay.

arabic: شكرا يا حبيبتي مش دلوقتي بكرة ان شاء الله
english: Thank you, my dear, not now, tomorrow God willing.
transliteration: Shukran ya habibty mesh delwa'ty bokra in sha' Allah.

arabic: مع السلامة يا أم علي مع السلامة
english: Goodbye, Umm Ali, goodbye.
transliteration: Ma3 el salama ya Umm Ali ma3 el salama.

arabic: النهاردة قررت اطبخ اكلة جديدة خالص مكلتهاش قبل كده
english: Today I decided to cook a completely new dish I've never eaten before.
transliteration: Ennaharda qarart aṭbokh akla gedida khales makaltahash qabl keda.

arabic: كنت قلقانة شوية اني ابوظ الدنيا بس كان عندي امل ان الطبخة تطلع حلوة
english: I was a little worried I'd mess things up but I had hope the dish would turn out good.
transliteration: Kont qal'ana showaya enni abawwaz ed-donya bas kan ʿandi amal enn et-tabkha tetlaʿ helwa.

arabic: بدأت احضر المكونات بعناية وكل مرشح من التوابل كان لازم يتوزن صح
english: I started preparing the ingredients carefully, and every candidate spice had to be weighed correctly.
transliteration: Badaʾt aḥaḍḍar el-mokawwenat beʿenaya we koll morashshaḥ men et-tawabel kan lazim yetwazen saḥḥ.

arabic: فضلت اراقب النار واحاول اتحكم في درجة الحرارة عشان الطبخة تستوي مظبوط
english: I kept watching the fire and trying to control the temperature so the dish would cook perfectly.
transliteration: Faḍḍalt araʾeb en-nar wa aḥawel ataḥakkam fi daraget el-ḥarara ʿashan et-tabkha testewi maẓbuṭ.

arabic: وفي الآخر لما دقتها حسيت بسعادة كبيرة وطعمها كان رائع بجد
english: And in the end, when I tasted it, I felt great happiness and its taste was truly wonderful.
transliteration: We fel akher lamma doʾtaha ḥaseet be-saʿada kebira we ṭaʿmaha kan raʾeʿ begad.

arabic: كان فيه ماتش كورة في الملعب
english: There was a football match in the stadium.
transliteration: Kan feeh match kora fil-mal'ab.

arabic: فريقي كان بيلعب كويس قوي
english: My team was playing very well.
transliteration: Faree'i kan beyil'ab kwayyes 'awi.

arabic: واحد من اللعيبة جري بسرعة على الجول
english: One of the players ran quickly towards the goal.
transliteration: Wahed men el-le'eeba geri besur'a 'ala el-goal.

arabic: بس بدل ما يشوط الكورة دخل هو الجول
english: But instead of kicking the ball, he entered the goal himself!
transliteration: Bas badal ma yishoot el-kora dakhal howa el-goal!

arabic: كل الجمهور ضحك عشان الموقف كان مضحك
english: All the fans laughed because the situation was funny.
transliteration: Koll el-gomhoor dahak 'ashan el-maw'ef kan modhek.

arabic: منى، طالبة في جامعة القاهرة وعندها 28 سنة، دخلت خان الخليلي الضهر بدري شوية، وهي مدوخة من الحر، وفاكرت إنها شافت ولد عمها المسافر.
english: Mona, a 28-year-old Cairo University student, entered Khan el-Khalili a bit early in the afternoon, feeling dizzy from the heat, and thought she saw her traveling cousin.
transliteration: Mona, taleba fi game3et el-qahera w 3andaha 28 sana, dakhlet khan el-khalili el-dohr badri shwaya, w heya medawwakha men el-harr, w fakaret enaha shafet walad 3amha el-mosafer.
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: إيه ده! مش معقول أنت هنا؟ إزيك يا أحمد، عامل إيه؟ سألت بصدمة وهي بتجري ناحيته وسط الزحمة.
english: "What is this! You can't be here? How are you, Ahmed, how are you doing?" she asked in shock, running towards him amidst the crowd.
transliteration: Eih da! Mish ma3'oul enta hena? Izzayak ya Ahmed, 3amel eih? Sa'alet be-sadma w heya betegri na7yto west el-za7ma.
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: رد الشاب بابتسامة واسعة، أهلاً بيكي يا منى! أنا كويس خالص الحمد لله، بس إيه اللي جابك هنا الجو حر جدا دلوقتي؟
english: The young man replied with a wide smile, "Welcome, Mona! I'm perfectly fine, thank God, but what brought you here? The weather is very hot now!"
transliteration: Radd el-shabb be-ebtesama wase3a, "Ahlan beiki ya Mona! Ana kwayyes khales el-hamdolellah, bas eih elly gabek hena el-gaww harr geddan delwa'ty?"
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: والله يا أحمد أنا بدور على هدية لجدتي، بس معلش لازم أمشي دلوقتي عشان ألحق أختي مروة، سلام! قالت وهي بتلوح له وبتعدي جنب بياع فُل.
english: "Honestly, Ahmed, I'm looking for a gift for my grandmother, but sorry, I have to go now to catch up with my sister Marwa, bye!" she said, waving to him and passing by a ful vendor.
transliteration: Wallahi ya Ahmed ana badawwar 3ala hedeyya le-geddety, bas ma3lesh lazim amshi delwa'ty 3ashan al7a' okhty Marwa, salam! Qalet w heya betlawwa7lo w bet3addi gamb bayya3 ful.
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: بياع الفُل، اللي كان شايل حلة كبيرة، ابتسم وقال بصوت عالي: صباح الخير يا ست البنات! تحبي تاكلي فُل سخن؟
english: The ful vendor, who was carrying a large pot, smiled and said loudly: "Good morning, lady of all girls! Would you like to eat hot ful?"
transliteration: Bayya3 el-ful, elly kan shayel 7ella kebira, ebtesem w 'al be-sout 3ali: "Sabah el-kheir ya sett el-banat! Te7ebbi takli ful sokhn?"
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: فجأة شافت مروة واقفة جنب محل فضة قديم، يا مروة! أهو أنا هنا! إزيك يا حبيبتي، عاملة إيه في الحر ده؟ نادت عليها منى بفرحة.
english: Suddenly she saw Marwa standing next to an old silver shop, "Marwa! Here I am! How are you, my darling, how are you doing in this heat?" Mona called out to her joyfully.
transliteration: Fag'a shafet Marwa wa'fa gamb ma7all fedda 'adeem, "Ya Marwa! Aho ana hena! Izzayek ya 7abibty, 3amla eih fel 7arr da?" Naddet 3aleha Mona be-far7a.
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: مروة لفت وقالت وهي بتعدل طرحتها، أهلاً يا منى! كويس الحمد لله، بس تأخرتي خالص، يلا بينا نخلص قبل ما نقفل؟
english: Marwa turned and said while adjusting her headscarf, "Welcome, Mona! Fine, thank God, but you're very late, let's finish before they close?"
transliteration: Marwa laffet w 'alet w heya bet3addel tar7etha, "Ahlan ya Mona! Kwayyes el-hamdolellah, bas ta'akharty khales, yalla bina nekhalas abl ma ne'fel?"
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: أيوة بالظبط، يا دوبك لقيت خاتم فضة عجبني بـ 250 جنيه، معلش يا عمو، بعد إذنك، قالت منى لبياع تاني وهي بتشاور على الخاتم.
english: "Yes, exactly, I just found a silver ring I liked for 250 EGP, excuse me, uncle, if you please," Mona said to another vendor while pointing to the ring.
transliteration: Aywa bel-zabt, ya doubak la'eit khatem fedda 3agabni be-250 geneih, ma3lesh ya 3ammu, ba3d eznek, 'alet Mona le-bayya3 tani w heya betshawwer 3ala el-khatem.
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: بعد ما اشترت الخاتم، لفت منى عشان تكلم مروة، بس مالقتهاش، يا مروة! إيه ده، راحت فين؟ نادت بصوت قلقان.
english: After buying the ring, Mona turned to speak to Marwa, but couldn't find her, "Marwa! What is this, where did she go?" she called out in a worried voice.
transliteration: Ba3d ma eshtarret el-khatem, laffet Mona 3ashan tekallem Marwa, bas mal'ethaash, "Ya Marwa! Eih da, ra7et fein?" Naddet be-sout 'al'aan.
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: رجعت لبياع الفضة وقالت، معلش يا عمو، ممكن أستأذنك، صاحبتي اختفت خالص، لازم أروح أدور عليها، سلام!
english: She returned to the silver vendor and said, "Excuse me, uncle, may I take your leave, my friend completely disappeared, I have to go look for her, bye!"
transliteration: Reg3et le-bayya3 el-fedda w 'alet, "Ma3lesh ya 3ammu, momken asta'zenak, sa7ebty ekhtafet khales, lazim arou7 adawwar 3aleha, salam!"
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: في طريقها لمخرج السوق المزدحم، قابلت منى بواب عمارة كان بيشرب شاي على ناصية الشارع، وسألته: صباح الخير، شفت مروة؟
english: On her way to the crowded market exit, Mona met a building doorman who was drinking tea at the street corner, and asked him: "Good morning, did you see Marwa?"
transliteration: Fi tari'ha le-makhreg el-sou' el-mozda7em, 'ablet Mona bawab 3emara kan biyeshrab shay 3ala nasyet el-share3, w sa'aleto: Sabah el-kheir, shoft Marwa?
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: رد البواب وهو بيشاور بإيده على طريق فرعي، أهلاً يا بنتي، لأ والله مشفتهاش النهاردة، بس ممكن تكون دخلت الحارة دي، مع السلامة.
english: The doorman replied, pointing with his hand to a side street, "Welcome, my daughter, no, honestly, I haven't seen her today, but she might have entered this alley, goodbye."
transliteration: Radd el-bawab w howa biyeshawwer be-eido 3ala tari' far3i, "Ahlan ya benty, la' wallahi ma shoftahaash el-naharda, bas momken tekoun dakhlet el-7ara di, ma3 el-salama."
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: منى شكرته بسرعة وقالت: تمام يا عمو، متشكرة جداً، تصبح على خير! وهي بتدخل الحارة المظلمة وقلبها بيدق بسرعة.
english: Mona quickly thanked him and said: "Okay, uncle, thank you very much, good night!" as she entered the dark alley, her heart pounding fast.
transliteration: Mona shakareto be-sor3a w 'alet: "Tamam ya 3ammu, motashakkera geddan, tesba7 3ala kheir!" W heya betedkhol el-7ara el-mozlema w 'albaha biyedo'' be-sor3a.
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: بعد خطوات قليلة، سمعت منى صوت مألوف بين المحلات القديمة: إزيك يا منى، أخيرا لقيتك، كنت بفكر أروح خلاص!
english: After a few steps, Mona heard a familiar voice among the old shops: "How are you, Mona, I finally found you, I was thinking of leaving already!"
transliteration: Ba3d khotowat 'alila, sem3et Mona sout ma'louf bein el-ma7allat el-'adima: "Izzayek ya Mona, akhiran la'eitki, kont ba'fakkar arou7 khalas!"
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: كانت مروة، أختها اللي بتشتغل مدرسة تاريخ، واقفة جنب بياع عطور، وبتبص على الساعتها، وقالت: أهلاً بيكي، كنت قلقانة جداً!
