english: It was Marwa, her sister who works as a history teacher, standing next to a perfume vendor, looking at her watch, and said: "Welcome, I was very worried!"
transliteration: Kanet Marwa, okhtaha elly beteshtaghal modarreset tareekh, wa'fa gamb bayya3 3otour, w beteboss 3ala sa3etha, w 'alet: "Ahlan beiki, kont 'al'ana geddan!"
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: منى ابتسمت براحة وقالت: الحمد لله إني لقيتك، الجو حر جدا دلوقتي، يلا بينا نروّح ونتغدى كشري في البيت.
english: Mona smiled with relief and said: "Thank God I found you, the weather is very hot now, let's go home and have koshary for lunch at home."
transliteration: Mona ebtesemet be-ra7a w 'alet: "El-hamdolellah enni la'eitki, el-gaww harr geddan delwa'ty, yalla bina nerawwa7 w netghadda koshary fel beit."
storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

arabic: انا بصحى بدري النهاردة وانا تعبان شوية
english: I wake up early today and I am a little tired.
transliteration: Ana bas7a badri enharda w ana ta3baan shwaya

arabic: انا بقوم بسرعة عشان اجهز للشغل
english: I get up quickly to get ready for work.
transliteration: Ana ba'oom be sur3a 3ashan a'gahhez lel shoghl

arabic: بشرب شاي وبفطر سندويتش صغير
english: I drink tea and eat a small sandwich for breakfast.
transliteration: Bashrab shay w baftarr sandwich soghayyar

arabic: الوقت بيجري وانا لازم امشي دلوقتي
english: Time is running and I have to leave now.
transliteration: El wa't beyegri w ana lazem amshi delwa'ti

arabic: انا رايح الشغل النهاردة ومبسوط
english: I am going to work today and I am happy.
transliteration: Ana rayeh el shoghl enharda w mabsoot

arabic: انا بصحى بدري كل يوم عشان الشغل
english: I wake up early every day for work.
transliteration: Ana bas'ha badri koll yom 'ashan el shoghl.

arabic: بلبس هدومي بسرعة وبجهز فطار خفيف
english: I get dressed quickly and prepare a light breakfast.
transliteration: Balbes hedomi be sur'a w bagehhez fetar khafif.

arabic: بشرب قهوة وبقرا الاخبار شوية
english: I drink coffee and read the news a little.
transliteration: Bashrab 'ahwa w ba'ra el akhbar shwaya.

arabic: الوقت بيجري ومفيش وقت اضيع
english: Time flies and there's no time to waste.
transliteration: El wa't beyegri w mafeesh wa't adaya'.

arabic: لازم انزل دلوقتي عشان اوصل الشغل بدري
english: I must leave now to arrive at work early.
transliteration: Lazim anzel delwa'ti 'ashan awsal el shoghl badri.

arabic: ريحة الكركديه الفريش كانت مالية الريسبشن وأمي، أم حسن، بترص الكوبايات بالراحة لكل واحد فينا.
english: The smell of fresh karkade filled the reception, and my mother, Um Hassan, was gently arranging the glasses for each one of us.
transliteration: Rihet el-karkadeh el-fresh kanet malya el-reception w ommi, Om Hassan, betross el-kobayat bel-raha le koll wahed fina.

arabic: والدي، أبو حسن، كان بيحاول يصلح المروحة القديمة في الصالة، وهو بيقول "الجو حر جدا دلوقتي يا جماعة!"
english: My father, Abu Hassan, was trying to fix the old fan in the hall, saying, "The weather is very hot now, folks!"
transliteration: Walidi, Abu Hassan, kan bihayawel yessalah el-marwaha el-adeema fel-sala, we howa bi'ool "El-gaww harr geddan delwa'ti ya gama'a!"

arabic: أختي سارة كانت بتساعد أمي في المطبخ بتجهز طبق الفتير المشلتت اللي كلنا بنحبه.
english: My sister Sara was helping my mother in the kitchen, preparing the feteer meshaltet dish that we all love.
transliteration: Okhti Sara kanet betsa'ed ommi fel-matbakh betgahez taba' el-feteer el-meshaltet elli kollena benhebbuh.

arabic: أخويا الكبير، أيمن، كان قاعد بيلعب طاولة مع جدي بهدوء، بس عينيه كانت على المروحة اللي مش شغالة.
english: My older brother, Ayman, was quietly playing backgammon with my grandfather, but his eyes were on the non-working fan.
transliteration: Akhoya el-kebeer, Ayman, kan qa'ed biyel'ab tawla ma' geddi be-hedoo', bas 'eineih kanet 'ala el-marwaha elli mesh shaghala.

arabic: جدتي، ست الكل، كانت بتشاور على والدتي وبتقول "يا حبيبتي، ريحي نفسك شوية" وهي بتقدم طبق الكشري.
english: My grandmother, the lady of the house, was gesturing to my mother and saying, "My dear, rest a little," as she offered the koshary dish.
transliteration: Gaddeti, sett el-koll, kanet betshawer 'ala waldeti we bet'ool "Ya habibti, rayyehi nafsik shwayya" we heya bet'addem taba' el-koshary.

arabic: أنا، حسن، مهندس معماري عندي تلاتين سنة ودايماً بفكر في حلول، قررت أساعد والدي أفك المروحة دي بنفسي.
english: I, Hassan, a 30-year-old architect always thinking of solutions, decided to help my father dismantle this fan myself.
transliteration: Ana, Hassan, mohandes me'mari 'andy talateen sana w dayman bafakkar fi helool, qarrart asa'ed walidi afokk el-marwaha di be-nafsi.

arabic: خالي، عماد، كان بيشرب قهوة مظبوط وبيتفرج علينا وهو بيقول "يا ابني، دي عايزة ميكانيكي شاطر مش مهندس."
english: My uncle, Emad, was drinking mazboot coffee and watching us, saying, "My son, this needs a skilled mechanic, not an architect."
transliteration: Khali, Emad, kan biyeshrab ahwa mazboot we biyetfarraj 'aleina we howa bi'ool "Ya ebni, di 'ayza mekaniki shater mesh mohandes."

arabic: بنت عمي، ريم، كانت بتضحك وهي بتصورنا بالموبايل وبتقول "هتعرفوا تعملوها ولا هتجيبوا العيد؟"
english: My cousin, Reem, was laughing as she filmed us with her phone, saying, "Will you manage it, or will you mess it up completely?"
transliteration: Bent 'ammi, Reem, kanet betdehak we heya betsawwarna bel-mobile we bet'ool "Hata'rafo ta'melooha wala hatgeebo el-'eid?"

arabic: والدي وأنا اكتشفنا إن مسمار صغير كان مرتخي، وبمجرد ما ربطناه، المروحة اشتغلت تاني زي الفل!
english: My father and I discovered that a small screw was loose, and as soon as we tightened it, the fan worked again perfectly!
transliteration: Walidi w ana ektashafna en mesmar soghayyar kan mortakhi, we be-mogarrad ma rabatnah, el-marwaha eshtaghalet tani zayy el-fol!

arabic: كل العيلة صقفت وبدأت تضحك، والحمد لله، الجو اللطيف رجع للبيت بفضل تعاون أسرتنا الصغيرة.
english: The whole family clapped and started laughing, and thank God, the pleasant weather returned to the house thanks to our small family's cooperation.
transliteration: Koll el-'eila saqqafet we bada'et tedhak, wal-hamdu lillah, el-gaww el-lateef rege' lel-beit be-fadl ta'awon osretna el-soghayyara.

arabic: أنا عملت تليفون لصاحبي النهاردة
english: I made a phone call to my friend today.
transliteration: Ana amalt telefoan le saheby elnaharda

arabic: أنا قولتله إزيك
english: I told him 'How are you?'.
transliteration: Ana oltelo ezayyak

arabic: هو قالي أنا تمام بس أنا في الشغل
english: He told me 'I am good, but I am at work'.
transliteration: Howa ali ana tamam bas ana fel shoghl

arabic: أنا قولتله آسف افتكرتك أخويا
english: I told him 'Sorry, I thought you were my brother'.
transliteration: Ana oltelo aasef eftakartak akhoya

arabic: هو قالي مفيش مشكلة مين معايا
english: He told me 'No problem, who is with me?'.
transliteration: Howa ali mafish moshkela meen maaya

arabic: اليوم انا عملت طبق جديد في المطبخ اول مرة
english: Today I made a new dish in the kitchen for the first time.
transliteration: El-youm ana amalt taba' gedid fel-matbakh awel marra.

arabic: قطعت بصل وخضار صغيرة والريحة كانت حلوة اوي
english: I cut small onions and vegetables, and the smell was very good.
transliteration: Qata't basal w khodar soghayyara wel-reeha kanet helwa awi.

arabic: بعدين حطيت اللحمة والسخن طلع من الحلة
english: Then I put the meat, and heat came out of the pot.
transliteration: Ba'dein hattait el-lahma wel-sokhn tala' men el-halla.

arabic: الطبق بقى شكله جميل والطعم كان احلى حاجة
english: The dish became beautiful, and the taste was the best thing.
transliteration: El-tabaq ba'a shaklo gameel wel-ta'm kan ahla haga.

arabic: انا بحب الاكل ده دلوقتي وعايز اعمل تاني قريب
english: I love this food now and want to make it again soon.
transliteration: Ana baheb el-akl dah delwa'ti w ayez a'mel tani 'orayeb.

arabic: اليوم كان فيه ماتش كورة مهم
english: Today there was an important football match.
transliteration: El-yoom kaan feeh match koora mohem.
storyTitle: A Football Match and Ali's Joy

arabic: علي كان مبسوط اوي علشان فريقه بيلعب
english: Ali was very happy because his team was playing.
transliteration: Ali kaan mabsoot awi 'alashaan faree'o biyel'ab.
storyTitle: A Football Match and Ali's Joy

arabic: اللعيبة جريوا كتير في الملعب
english: The players ran a lot on the field.
transliteration: El-la'eeba geriwo keteer fel mal'ab.
storyTitle: A Football Match and Ali's Joy

arabic: فريقه جاب جول كبير علي صرخ بفرحة
english: His team scored a big goal Ali screamed with joy.
transliteration: Faree'o gaab goal kibeer Ali sarakh befarha.
storyTitle: A Football Match and Ali's Joy

arabic: كل الناس كانت فرحانة جدا بعد الجول
english: Everyone was very happy after the goal.
transliteration: Koll en-naas kaanat farhana geddan ba'd el-goal.
storyTitle: A Football Match and Ali's Joy

arabic: ريحة البهارات ملت السوق في ناصية خان الخليلي.
english: The smell of spices filled the market at a corner of Khan el-Khalili.
transliteration: Rihet el-baharat malet el-souq fi nasiyet Khan el-Khalili.
storyTitle: A Shopping Trip in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: منى، طالبة شاطرة، كانت عايزة هدية لصاحبتها.
english: Mona, a clever student, wanted a gift for her friend.
transliteration: Mona, talba shatra, kanet ayza hedeya le-sahbet-ha.
storyTitle: A Shopping Trip in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: شافت يافطة محل جميل، وسألت عن السعر.
english: She saw a sign for a beautiful shop, and asked about the price.
transliteration: Shafet yafta mahal gameel, w sa'alet 3an el-se3r.
storyTitle: A Shopping Trip in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: قالت للبياع: "طب، بخمسين جنيه بس يا عم!"
english: She said to the seller: "Okay, fifty pounds only, uncle!"
transliteration: Qalet lel-bayya3: "Tab, bi-khamsin geneh bas ya 3am!"
storyTitle: A Shopping Trip in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: دفعت ستين جنيه، وبعدين ركبت أتوبيس البيت.
english: She paid sixty pounds, then took the bus home.
transliteration: Daf3et seteen geneh, w ba3dein rekbet otobees el-beit.
storyTitle: A Shopping Trip in Khan el-Khalili

arabic: امبارح رحت المول عشان اشتري هدوم جديدة
english: Yesterday I went to the mall to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Imbareh roht il-moll ashan ashtari hedoum gedida
storyTitle: A Day of Shopping for New Clothes

arabic: دورت على قميص لونه ازرق ولقيت واحد شكله جميل
english: I looked for a blue shirt and found a beautiful one.
transliteration: Dawwart ala amees lonoh azraq we la'eit wahed shakloh gameel
storyTitle: A Day of Shopping for New Clothes

arabic: دخلت اوضة البروفة وجربت القميص كان مقاسه مظبوط عليا
english: I entered the fitting room and tried on the shirt, its size was perfect for me.
transliteration: Dakhalet odet il-broofa we garrabt il-amees kan ma'asoh mazboot alaya
storyTitle: A Day of Shopping for New Clothes

arabic: سالت البائع عن السعر وقالي انه عامل خصم حلو
english: I asked the seller about the price and he told me there was a good discount.
transliteration: Sa'alt il-ba'ea aan is-se'r we 'ali innoh aamel khasm helw
storyTitle: A Day of Shopping for New Clothes

arabic: دفعت الفلوس واخدت القميص وكنت مبسوط جدا بيه
english: I paid the money and took the shirt and was very happy with it.
transliteration: Dafaa't il-felous we akhadt il-amees we kont mabsoot geddan beih
storyTitle: A Day of Shopping for New Clothes

arabic: امبارح رحت القهوة مع اصحابي عشان نتفرج على ماتش كورة
english: Yesterday I went to the coffee shop with my friends to watch a football match
transliteration: Embareh roht el-ahwa maa as-habi ashan netfarag ala match kora

arabic: كان فيه قميص جديد لفريقنا شكله جميل اوي
english: There was a new shirt for our team, it looked very beautiful
transliteration: Kan feh amees gedid le-faree'na shaklo gameel awi

arabic: كلنا كنا بنشجع بصوت عالي وبناكل حاجه حلوة
english: We were all cheering loudly and eating something sweet
transliteration: Kollena kunna ben-shagga' be-sout aali w ben-nakol haga helwa

arabic: صاحبي كان بيشرحلي اللعب عشان افهم كل حاجه
english: My friend was explaining the game to me so I could understand everything
transliteration: Sahby kan be-yeshrahly el-la'b ashan afham koll haga

arabic: كان يوم جميل ومستنيين الماتش الجاي بفارغ الصبر
english: It was a beautiful day and we are eagerly awaiting the next match
transliteration: Kan yom gameel w mestanniyeen el-match el-gay be-faregh el-sabr

arabic: انا محتاج اشتري هدوم جديده
english: I need to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Ana mehtaag ashtari hedoum gedida.

arabic: قميصي المفضل قديم جدا
english: My favorite shirt is very old.
transliteration: Ameesi el mofaddal adeem geddan.

arabic: لازم اروح المول بكره عشان اشتري
english: I must go to the mall tomorrow to buy.
transliteration: Lazim arouh el moll bokra ashan ashtari.

arabic: بس انا بذاكر ماده جديده دلوقتي
english: But I am studying a new subject now.
transliteration: Bas ana bazaker madda gedida delwa'ty.

arabic: يا ترى السعر هيكون كويس هناك
english: I wonder if the price will be good there?
transliteration: Ya tara el se'r haykoun kowayyes henāk?

arabic: صباح الخير يا ام يوسف ايه مالك شايلة هم كده
english: Good morning, Umm Yousef, what's wrong, why do you look so worried?
transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya Om Yousef, eh malek shayla hamm keda?

arabic: صباح النور يا ام علي الغسالة بتاعتي بايظة والهدوم مكومة عندي بقالها ايام
english: Good morning, Umm Ali, my washing machine is broken and the clothes have been piled up for days.
transliteration: Sabah el-noor ya Om Ali, el-ghassāla beta'ty bayẓa wel-hedoom mekawwama 'andy ba'alha ayyam.

arabic: يا خبر طب ما تكلمي الأستاذ احمد جارنا هو شاطر اوي في إنه يصلح اي حاجة
english: Oh no! Why don't you call our neighbor Mr. Ahmed? He's really good at fixing anything.
transliteration: Ya khabar! Tab ma tekallemi el-Ostaz Ahmed gārena, howa shater awi fe innaho yessalah ay haga.

arabic: الأستاذ احمد تقصدي المهندس المعماري اللي ساكن في الدور اللي فوقينا
english: Mr. Ahmed? Do you mean the architect who lives on the floor above us?
transliteration: El-Ostaz Ahmed? Ta'sodi el-mohandes el-me'mari elli saken fel-door elli fo'eena?

arabic: ايوه بالظبط ده هو امبارح صلح اللابتوب بتاعه وكان فيه مشكلة كبيرة انا متأكدة إنه هيعرف يصلحها
english: Yes, exactly him. Yesterday he fixed his laptop, and it had a big problem. I'm sure he'll know how to fix it.
transliteration: Aywa bel-ẓabṭ, da howa embareh sallaha el-laptop beta'o w kan feeh moshkela kebeera, ana met'akkeda inno haye'raf yessalahha.

arabic: انا عايز اشتري لبس جديد
english: I want to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Ana ayiz ashtiri libs gideed

arabic: روحت محل كبير
english: I went to a big shop.
transliteration: Roht mahal kabeer

arabic: شفت قميص احمر حلو اوي
english: I saw a very nice red shirt.
transliteration: Shoft amees ahmar helw awi

arabic: سالت البياع بكام القميص ده
english: I asked the salesman, "How much is this shirt?"
transliteration: Sa'alt el-bayya' bekam el-amees da

arabic: هو قالي ده بتاعك اللي لابسه دلوقتي
english: He told me, "That's yours, the one you're wearing now!"
transliteration: Howa 'ali da beta'ak illi labso dilwa'ti

arabic: النهاردة التلاجة بتاعتي مش شغالة كويس
english: Today, my fridge isn't working well.
transliteration: Elnaharda eltallaga betaʿti mesh shaghala kwayyes.

arabic: دي مشكلة كبيرة وكل الاكل ممكن يبوظ
english: This is a big problem and all the food might spoil.
transliteration: Di moshkela kebira we koll elakl momken yeboẓ.

arabic: انا عايزة اعرف اعمل ايه عشان اصلحها
english: I want to know what to do to fix it.
transliteration: Ana ʿayza aʿraf aʿmel ēh ʿashan aṣlaḥha.

arabic: ممكن اشوف محل تصليح قريب مني او اشتري واحدة جديدة
english: Maybe I can look for a repair shop near me or buy a new one.
transliteration: Momken ashūf maḥall taṣlīḥ ʾorayyeb menni aw ashtarī waḥda gedīda.

arabic: لازم الاقي حل للمشكلة دي النهاردة
english: I must find a solution for this problem today.
transliteration: Lāzem alāʾi ḥall lelmoshkela di elnaharda.

arabic: سلمى بتجهز لفرحها الكبير
english: Salma is preparing for her big wedding
transliteration: Salma bitgahhaz lifarahaha el kibiir

arabic: هي مبسوطة اوي بس تعبانة شوية
english: She is very happy but a little tired
transliteration: Heya mabsuta awi bas ta'bana shwaya

arabic: خطيبها احمد قلقان على الفلوس
english: Her fiancé Ahmed is worried about the money
transliteration: Khatibha Ahmed alaan 'ala el fuluus

arabic: سلمى قالتله متقلقش كل حاجة هتبقى كويسة
english: Salma told him Don't worry everything will be fine
transliteration: Salma altilo mat'ala'sh kul haga hatib'a kuwayesa

arabic: هما الاتنين عايزين فرح حلو ومستريحين مع بعض
english: They both want a nice wedding and are comfortable with each other
transliteration: Homa el etnein ayzeen farah helw w mistariheen ma' ba'd

arabic: انا قاعد في القهوة
english: I am sitting at the cafe.
transliteration: Ana qa'ed fil-'ahwa

arabic: انا مستني صاحبي
english: I am waiting for my friend.
transliteration: Ana mestanni saHbi

arabic: انا سامع مزيكا حلوة
english: I hear nice music.
transliteration: Ana same' mazika Helwa

arabic: و شامم ريحة بن جميلة
english: And I smell a beautiful coffee aroma.
transliteration: Wi shamem riihet bonn gamila

arabic: ده مكان مريح جداً
english: This is a very comfortable place.
transliteration: Dah makan muriH giddan

arabic: انا صحيت متاخر النهاردة
english: I woke up late today.
transliteration: Ana sahiit meta'akhar elnaharda

arabic: شربت قهوة بسرعة
english: I quickly drank coffee.
transliteration: Sheribt ahwa be sor3a

arabic: يا لهوي نسيت مفاتيحي
english: Oh no, I forgot my keys!
transliteration: Ya lahwi nesiit mafatiihii

arabic: جريت ارجع اجيبهم وبعدين اكلت سندويتش
english: I ran back to get them and then ate a sandwich.
transliteration: Gereit arga3 ageebhom w ba3dein akalt sandwitsh

arabic: دلوقتي انا رايح الشغل وانا تعبان اوي
english: Now I am going to work, very tired.
transliteration: Delwa'ty ana rayeh elshoghl w ana ta3baan awi

arabic: اليوم فيه مطر كتير الجو برد قوي
english: Today there is a lot of rain, the weather is very cold.
transliteration: El naharda feeh matar kiteer el gaww bard awi

arabic: انا قاعد في البيت
english: I am sitting at home.
transliteration: Ana aa'ed fil beit

arabic: بشرب شاي سخن وببص من الشباك
english: I am drinking hot tea and looking from the window.
transliteration: Bashrab shay sokhn w babos men el shebbak

arabic: بسمع صوت المطر
english: I hear the sound of the rain.
transliteration: Bisma' sot el matar

arabic: الجو هادي و جميل جدا
english: The atmosphere is quiet and very beautiful.
transliteration: El gaww hady w gameel geddan

arabic: صباح الخير انا ماشي في الشارع
english: Good morning, I am walking in the street.
transliteration: Sabah el kheer ana mashy fel share'

arabic: فجأة شفت صديق قديم
english: Suddenly I saw an old friend.
transliteration: Fag'a shoft sadeeq qadeem

arabic: قلتله ازيك عامل ايه
english: I told him, 'How are you?'
transliteration: Olto loh izzayak aamel eh

arabic: قالي انا رايح الشغل كل يوم
english: He told me, 'I go to work every day.'
transliteration: Qaly ana rayeh el shoghl kolle yom

arabic: قلنا نشرب قهوة سوا قريب
english: We said we'd drink coffee together soon.
transliteration: Olna neshrab ahwa sawa orayeb

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد اختي الكبيرة
english: Today is my big sister's birthday.
transliteration: Ennaharda eid milad okhty el-kebira.

arabic: عملنا حفلة كبيرة في بيتنا ودعينا صحابها وعيلتنا
english: We made a big party at our house and invited her friends and our family.
transliteration: 3amalna hafla kebira fi beitna w da3eena sahabha w 3eiletna.

arabic: انا كنت مبسوط اوي عشان شفت كل الناس اللي بحبهم
english: I was very happy because I saw all the people I love.
transliteration: Ana kont mabsout awi 3ashan shoft kol ennas elli bahebbohom.

arabic: كان فيه كيكة جميلة اوي وهدايا كتير
english: There was a very beautiful cake and many gifts.
transliteration: Kan fe keka gamila awi w hadaya keteer.

arabic: كل سنة وهي طيبة كانت حفلة حلوة
english: Happy birthday to her it was a nice party.
transliteration: Kol sana w hiya tayeba kanet hafla helwa.

arabic: انا استيقظ صباحا وانا متعب جدا
english: I wake up in the morning and I am very tired.
transliteration: Ana astayqiz sabahhan wa ana mut'ab giddan.

arabic: عندي شغل كتير والصباح ده مشغول
english: I have a lot of work and this morning is busy.
transliteration: 'Andy shoghl kiteer wal sabah da mashghoul.

arabic: انا بعمل قهوة بسرعة في البيت
english: I quickly make coffee at home.
transliteration: Ana ba'mel qahwa be sur'a fil bayt.

arabic: انا بحس اني مستعجل لكن لازم اكون جاهز
english: I feel rushed but I must be ready.
transliteration: Ana bahess enni mista'gel laken lazim akoun gahez.

arabic: يلا بينا على الشغل انا سعيد باليوم الجديد
english: Let's go to work I am happy for the new day.
transliteration: Yalla bina 'ala el shoghl ana sa'eed bel youm el gedid.

arabic: سلام يا جار ازيك
english: Hello neighbor how are you
transliteration: Salam ya gar izzayyak

arabic: الحمد لله انت كويس فين الكورة بتاعتك
english: Thank God Are you good Where is your ball
transliteration: Elhamdulillah inta kwayyis fein el kora beta'tak

arabic: انا كويس شكرا الكورة انا معنديش كورة
english: I am good thank you The ball I don't have a ball
transliteration: Ana kwayyis shokran El kora Ana ma'andeesh kora

arabic: بس انا شوفتها هنا امبارح كانت كبيرة اوي
english: But I saw it here yesterday It was very big
transliteration: Bas ana shoftaha hena embareh Kanet kebeera awi

arabic: اه دي مش كورة دي بطيخة
english: Ah that's not a ball That's a watermelon
transliteration: Ah dee mish kora Dee batteekha

arabic: انا اشتريت قميص امبارح
english: I bought a shirt yesterday
transliteration: Ana ashtarait amees imbareh
storyTitle: Returning a shirt to the shop

arabic: النهاردة رجعت المحل
english: Today I returned to the shop
transliteration: Ennaharda rega't el mahal
storyTitle: Returning a shirt to the shop

arabic: البياع كان لطيف وقال اهلا
english: The seller was kind and said 'welcome'
transliteration: El bayya' kan lateef w qaal ahlan
storyTitle: Returning a shirt to the shop

arabic: انا قلت القميص كبير وهو اداني واحد تاني
english: I said the shirt was big, and he gave me another one
transliteration: Ana olt el amees kebeer we howa eddani wahed tani
storyTitle: Returning a shirt to the shop

arabic: انا شكرته ومشيت مبسوط
english: I thanked him and left happy
transliteration: Ana shakartoh w mesheet mabsoot
storyTitle: Returning a shirt to the shop

arabic: ليلى طفلة فضولية جدا بتسال اسئلة كتير لدرجة ان جدها ساعات بيواجه صعوبة في الرد عليها
english: Leila is a very curious child who asks many questions to the extent that her grandfather sometimes faces difficulty answering them.
transliteration: Layla tefla fodouleya geddan betesal as'ela keteer ledaraget en geddaha sa'aat beywageh soouba fel radd aleiha
storyTitle: Leila's Questions and the Old Generation

arabic: مرة سالته هو ليه مكنش فيه انترنت وتليفونات زي دلوقتي لما كان صغير وكان نفسه يشوف اصحابه القدام
english: Once she asked him why there wasn't internet and phones like now when he was young, and he wanted to see his old friends.
transliteration: Marra sa'altoh howa leih makansh fe internet we telephoneat zay delwa'ty lamma kan soghayyar we kan nafsoh yeshouf ashaboh el-odam
storyTitle: Leila's Questions and the Old Generation

arabic: جدها ابتسم وقال لها انهم كانوا بيتقابلوا بعد الشغل عشان يدردشوا ويفتكروا ايام زمان من غير ما يحتاجوا اي تكنولوجيا
english: Her grandfather smiled and told her that they used to meet after work to chat and remember old times without needing any technology.
transliteration: Geddaha ebtasam we al laha ennahom kanu byet'abelu ba'd el-shoghl ashan yedardashu we yeftikru ayyam zaman men gheir ma yehtagu ayy technology
storyTitle: Leila's Questions and the Old Generation

arabic: سالته كمان هو ليه بياخدوا وقت ومجهود كبير عشان يجهزوا اكلة محاشي مخصوصة للعزومة بتاعت بكرة بدل ما يطلبوها جاهزة
english: She also asked him why they take a lot of time and effort to prepare a special mahashi dish for tomorrow's gathering instead of ordering it ready-made.
transliteration: Sa'altoh kaman howa leih byakhodu wa't we maghoud kebeer ashan yegahhezu aklet mahashi makhsousa lel-azouma beta't bokra badal ma yatlobuha gahza
storyTitle: Leila's Questions and the Old Generation

arabic: الجد بحكمة رد بإن المتعة الحقيقية في المجهود واللمة مش بس في سهولة الوصول للحاجة زي ما الجيل الجديد بيفكر
english: The grandfather wisely replied that the real joy is in the effort and the gathering, not just in the ease of getting things, as the new generation thinks.
transliteration: El-gedd be-hekmma radd be'enn el-mot'a el-haqiqiya fel maghoud wel lamma mesh bas fe sohoolet el-wosoul lel-haga zay ma el-geel el-gedid beyfakkar
storyTitle: Leila's Questions and the Old Generation

arabic: كل العيلة اتجمعت عشان العشا
english: The whole family gathered for dinner.
transliteration: Kol el 3eila etgamme3et 3ashan el 3asha

arabic: الست اللي هتطبخ العشا كانت بتجهز اكل حلو اوي
english: The woman who will cook dinner was preparing very delicious food.
transliteration: El sett elly hatatbakh el 3asha kanet betgahez akl 7elw awy

arabic: ريحة الاكل كانت مالية البيت كله
english: The smell of the food filled the whole house.
transliteration: Re7et el akl kanet malya el beit kollo

arabic: قعدوا كلهم على السفرة عشان ياكلوا مع بعض
english: They all sat at the dining table to eat together.
transliteration: Qa3ado kollohom 3ala el sofra 3ashan yaklo ma3 ba3d

arabic: العصير اللي شربوه كان طعمه جميل ومنعش
english: The juice they drank tasted delicious and refreshing.
transliteration: El 3asir elly sheriboh kan ta3mo gameel w mon3esh

arabic: انا عايزة اخطط لرحلة في الويك ايند
english: I want to plan a trip for the weekend.
transliteration: Ana 'ayza akhattat li-rehla fi el-week end

arabic: هروح انا وصاحبتي مع بعض
english: My friend and I will go together.
transliteration: Harooh ana we sahbeti ma' ba'd

arabic: هنروح الشط عند البحر
english: We will go to the beach by the sea.
transliteration: Hanrooh el-shatt 'and el-bahr

arabic: هنروح بالعربية بتاعتنا
english: We will go by our car.
transliteration: Hanrooh bel-'arabeya beta'tna

arabic: انا مبسوطة جدا بالرحلة دي
english: I am very happy about this trip.
transliteration: Ana mabsoota geddan bel-rehla di

arabic: انا عايز اشتري هدوم جديدة النهاردة
english: I want to buy new clothes today.
transliteration: Ana ayiz ashtiri hodoum gedida ennaharda.

arabic: رحت المحل اللي في السوق
english: I went to the shop in the market.
transliteration: Roht el-mahal elli fi es-soo2.

arabic: شفت تيشيرت ازرق جميل و بنطلون اسود
english: I saw a beautiful blue t-shirt and black trousers.
transliteration: Shoft tishirt azraq gameel w bantaloon aswad.

arabic: المقاس بتاعي كان تمام و مش غالي قوي
english: My size was good and not very expensive.
transliteration: El-ma'as beta'i kan tamaam w mesh ghali awi.

arabic: اشتريت الهدوم و انا مبسوط قوي
english: I bought the clothes and I am very happy.
transliteration: Eshtareet el-hodoum w ana mabsoot awi.

arabic: انا عايزة اعمل اكلة جديدة اليوم
english: I want to cook a new dish today.
transliteration: Ana ayza a'mel akla gedida el yoom.

arabic: انا شفت وصفة سمك و رز
english: I saw a recipe for fish and rice.
transliteration: Ana shoft wasfa samak w rozz.

arabic: انا بدأت اعملها في المطبخ
english: I started to make it in the kitchen.
transliteration: Ana bada't a'melha fi el matbakh.

arabic: اخد وقت كتير لكن كان شكله حلو
english: It took a lot of time, but it looked good.
transliteration: Akhad wa't keteer laken kan shaklo helw.

arabic: لكن لما دقتو كان حلو مش مالح
english: But when I tasted it, it was sweet, not salty!
transliteration: Laken lama do'to kan helw mesh maleh!

arabic: العيلة اتجمعت في البيت الكبير
english: The family gathered in the big house
transliteration: El 'eila etgam'at fel beit el kabeer

arabic: كان فيه اكل كتير حلو على الترابيزة
english: There was a lot of nice food on the table
transliteration: Kan fe akl keteer helw 'ala el tarabeeza

arabic: كلنا اكلنا رز وفراخ
english: All of us ate rice and chicken
transliteration: Kullina akalna rozz we farakh

arabic: ريحة الاكل كانت جميلة اوي
english: The smell of the food was very beautiful
transliteration: Reehet el akl kanet gameela awi

arabic: بعد الاكل كل واحد شرب شاي
english: After the food, everyone drank tea
transliteration: Ba'd el akl kull wahed sherib shay

arabic: سارة بتحب تشتري هدوم جديدة
english: Sarah likes to buy new clothes.
transliteration: Sara bithebb tishtiri hudum gidida.

arabic: النهاردة قررت تروح محل هدوم يفتح بدري
english: Today she decided to go to a clothes shop that opens early.
transliteration: Elnaharda qararet tiruh mahall hudum yifta badri.

arabic: لما دخلت سالت البياع عندك فستان ازرق
english: When she entered she asked the seller 'Do you have a blue dress?'
transliteration: Lamma dakhalet saalet elbayyaa 'andak fustan azraq?'

arabic: البياع قال ايوة موجود وسارة اخدت الفستان عشان عجبها اوي
english: The seller said 'Yes, it's available' and Sarah took the dress because she liked it a lot.
transliteration: Elbayyaa al aywa mawgud we Sara akhadet elfustan ashan agabaha awi.

arabic: البياع قالها شكرا لزيارتك
english: The seller said to her 'Thank you for your visit.'
transliteration: Elbayyaa alaha shokran leziyartik.

arabic: بابا وانا بنشوف ماتش كورة
english: Dad and I are watching a football match.
transliteration: Baba w ana benshoof match kora.

arabic: بابا بيحب اللعيبة القديمة اوي
english: Dad really likes the old players.
transliteration: Baba bihebb el la3eeba el 'adeema awi.

arabic: انا بحب اللعيبة الجديدة اكتر
english: I like the new players more.
transliteration: Ana bahebb el la3eeba el gedeeda aktar.

arabic: بابا بيقول الكورة زمان كانت احسن
english: Dad says football used to be better.
transliteration: Baba bey'ool el kora zamaan kanet ahsan.

arabic: انا شايف الكورة النهاردة سريعة وحلوة
english: I see today's football is fast and good.
transliteration: Ana shayef el kora ennaharda saree3a we helwa.

arabic: منى، طالبة مجتهدة، شافت قائمة غريبة.
english: Mona, a diligent student, saw a strange menu.
transliteration: Mona, talaba mojtahida, shafet qa'ema ghareeba.

arabic: كانت عايزة تشتري كشري بـ ٥٠ جنيه.
english: She wanted to buy koshary for 50 EGP.
transliteration: Kanet ayza teshtari koshary be khamseen geneh.

arabic: سألت الجرسون:
english: She asked the waiter:
transliteration: Sa'alet el-garson:

arabic: قال:
english: He said:
transliteration: Al:

arabic: منى استلمت طبقها، هي بتحب الأكل ده خالص.
english: Mona received her dish, she really loves this food.
transliteration: Mona estalamet taba'ha, heya bethebb el-akl dah khales.

arabic: امبارح رحت المول عشان اشتري هدوم جديده
english: Yesterday I went to the mall to buy new clothes
transliteration: Embareh roht el-moll ashan ashtari hedoom gedida

arabic: شفت قميص جميل لونه ازرق في محل كبير
english: I saw a beautiful blue shirt in a big store
transliteration: Shoft amees gameel lohnu azraq fi mahal kibeer

arabic: كان عليه خصم كبير وكنت فرحان اوي
english: It had a big discount and I was very happy
transliteration: Kan alayh khasm kibeer we kont farhan awi

arabic: قررت اني اشتريه فورا لاني حبيته جدا
english: I decided to buy it immediately because I loved it very much
transliteration: Qarrart inni ashtareeh fawran le'inni habbetu giddan

arabic: رجعت البيت مبسوط جدا بالقميص الجديد
english: I returned home very happy with the new shirt
transliteration: Rega't el-beit mabsoot giddan bel amees el gedid

arabic: النهاردة الجو وحش اوي ومطر كتير بتشتي برا
english: Today the weather is very bad and a lot of rain is falling outside.
transliteration: Elnaharda el gaww wahash awi we matar keteer beteshti barra.

arabic: انا قاعدة في بيتنا جنب الشباك وبشرب قهوة سخنة
english: I am sitting in our home next to the window and drinking hot coffee.
transliteration: Ana 'a'eda fi beitna gamb el shebbak we bashrab ahwa sokhna.

arabic: كنت عايزة اخرج مع أصحابي لكن الجو مش كويس خالص
english: I wanted to go out with my friends but the weather is not good at all.
transliteration: Kont 'ayza akhrag ma'a ashabi laken el gaww mesh kwayyes khales.

arabic: دلوقتي بعمل فيلم كوميدي وبضحك كتير جوه البيت
english: Now I am watching a comedy film and laughing a lot inside the house.
transliteration: Delwa'ty ba'mel film komedy we badhak keteer gowwa el beit.

arabic: يمكن الجو برا وحش لكن جوه بيتنا كويس ومضحك
english: Maybe the weather outside is bad but inside our home it's good and funny.
transliteration: Yomken el gaww barra wahash laken gowwa beitna kwayyes we modhek.

arabic: انا كنت قاعد في قهوة قديمة مستني صاحبي
english: I was sitting in an old café waiting for my friend.
transliteration: Ana kont qaʿed fi ahwa qadīma mestanni ṣaḥbi

arabic: شفت راجل كبير قاعد بيقرا جرنان وبيتكلم عن الاحزاب السياسية
english: I saw an old man sitting reading a newspaper and talking about political parties.
transliteration: Shoft ragel kebīr qaʿed beyeqra gornān w beyetkallem ʿan el-aḥzāb as-sīyāsīya

arabic: جنبه شاب صغير ماسك موبايله وبيشوف فيديوهات على التيك توك
english: Next to him, a young man was holding his phone and watching videos on TikTok.
transliteration: Gambo shabb ṣoghāyar māsek mobaylo w byeshūf fīdyohāt ʿala et-Tīk Tok

arabic: الراجل الكبير كان بيقول ان التصويت مهم جدا لاختيار رئيس الجمهورية
english: The old man was saying that voting is very important for choosing the President of the Republic.
transliteration: Er-ragel el-kebīr kān beyʾūl en et-taṣwīt mohem geddan lakhṭīyār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya

arabic: كل جيل ليه اهتماماته وطريقته في رؤية الحكم
english: Each generation has its interests and its way of seeing governance.
transliteration: Koll gīl līh ehtemāmāto w ṭarʾīʾto fī roʾyet el-ḥokm

arabic: الثلاجة بتاعتنا مبقتش بتقفل كويس
english: Our fridge isn't closing well anymore.
transliteration: Eth-thallāga betaʿetna mabqaetsh betʾeffel kowayyes.

arabic: وكل ما حد يعدي من جنبها لازم يزقها برجله
english: And every time someone passes by it, they have to push it with their foot.
transliteration: Wa koll ma ḥadd yeʿaddi men gambaha lāzem yezoqqaḥa beregluh.

arabic: قررنا نعمل تصويت عشان نختار مرشح يصلحها
english: We decided to hold a vote to choose a candidate to fix it.
transliteration: Qararnā naʿmal taṣwīt ʿashān nekhtār morashshaḥ yoṣleḥha.

arabic: ماما كانت اقوى مرشح بس بابا كان معترض
english: Mom was the strongest candidate, but Dad objected.
transliteration: Mama kānet aqwa morashshaḥ bas baba kān moʿtareḍ.

arabic: في الاخر اتفقنا إننا نشتري ثلاجة جديدة والفلوس تيجي من ميزانية الحكم في البيت
english: In the end, we agreed to buy a new fridge and the money would come from the household governance budget!
transliteration: Fel-ākher ettafaqnā ennena neshtari thallāga gedīda wel-folūs tīgi men mīzaneyyet el-ḥokm fel-bēt!

arabic: انا اروح السوق
english: I go to the market.
transliteration: Ana arooh el soo'

arabic: انا عايز اشتري فاكهة وخضار
english: I want to buy fruit and vegetables.
transliteration: Ana aayez ashtiri fak-ha we khodaar

arabic: السوق كبير وحلو
english: The market is big and nice.
transliteration: El soo' kibiir we helw

arabic: انا اشتريت تفاح وبرتقال
english: I bought apples and oranges.
transliteration: Ana ashtareet tuffah we burtu'aan

arabic: لما رجعت البيت شفت قطة صغيرة في شنطتي
english: When I returned home, I saw a small cat in my bag.
transliteration: Lamma raja't el beit shoft 'otta saghiira fi shanteti

arabic: فرح اختي قرب وكلنا مبسوطين
english: My sister's wedding is near, and we are all happy.
transliteration: Farah okhty arrab we kollena mabsooteen.

arabic: ماما بتساعد في كل حاجة
english: Mom is helping with everything.
transliteration: Mama betsa3ed fi kol haga.

arabic: الست اللي هتطبخ العشا شاطرة جدا
english: The woman who will cook dinner is very good.
transliteration: El sett elly hatatbakh el 3asha shatra geddan.

arabic: أنا بفكر في الهدية اللي هشتريها
english: I am thinking about the gift that I will buy.
transliteration: Ana bafakkar fi el hedeya elly hashtariha.

arabic: العيلة كلها هتكون هنا يوم الفرح
english: The whole family will be here on the wedding day.
transliteration: El 3eila kolleha hatkoun hena yom el farah.

arabic: الدنيا بتمطر بره واحنا قاعدين في البيت
english: It's raining outside and we are staying at home.
transliteration: El-donya betmatar barra we ehna aa'dein fel bayt

arabic: امي قالت يلا نعمل شاي ونتفرج على فيلم
english: My mother said 'Let's make tea and watch a movie'.
transliteration: Ommy aalet yalla ne'mel shay we netfarag ala film

arabic: احنا بنحب ناكل فاكهة وخضار واحنا بنتفرج على الافلام
english: We love to eat fruit and vegetables while watching movies.
transliteration: Ehna benhebb nakol fakha w khodaar we ehna benetfarag ala el-aflam

arabic: بكرة هننزل السوق الكبير نشتري اللي ناقصنا
english: Tomorrow we will go to the big market to buy what we need.
transliteration: Bokra hannenzen el-soo' el-kibeer neshtary elly na'esna

arabic: ايام المطر بتبقى حلوة للقعدة مع العيلة في البيت
english: Rainy days are nice for sitting with family at home.
transliteration: Ayam el-matar beteb'a helwa lel-a'da ma'a el-'eila fel-bayt

arabic: انا كنت ماشي في الشارع
english: I was walking in the street.
transliteration: Ana kont maashi fi esh-shaare'.

arabic: فجأة شفت صاحبي القديم احمد
english: Suddenly I saw my old friend Ahmed.
transliteration: Faga'a shoft saahbi el-adeem Ahmad.

arabic: قولتله ازيك يا احمد عامل ايه اخبارك
english: I said to him "How are you Ahmed? How are you? What's your news?"
transliteration: Oultelo izzayak ya Ahmad aamel eih akhbaarak?

arabic: رد احمد وقالي الحمد لله انا كويس انت عامل ايه
english: Ahmed replied and said to me "Praise be to God, I am good. How are you?"
transliteration: Radd Ahmad we 'aali el-hamdu lillah ana kwayyes enta aamel eih?

arabic: قولتله انا كمان كويس دلوقتي لازم امشي
english: I said to him "I am also good. Now I have to go."
transliteration: Oultelo ana kamaan kwayyes dilwa'ti laazem amshi.

arabic: النهاردة انا عايزة اعمل اكل جديد
english: Today I want to make a new dish.
transliteration: Ennaharda ana ayza a'mel akl gedid.

arabic: ماما بتعمل اكل كويس كل يوم
english: Mom makes good food every day.
transliteration: Mama betamel akl kwayes kol yom.

arabic: انا مش بعرف اطبخ زيها
english: I don't know how to cook like her.
transliteration: Ana mesh ba'raf atbokh zayaha.

arabic: في المطبخ انا جبت رز و خضار
english: In the kitchen, I brought rice and vegetables.
transliteration: Fi elmatbakh ana gebt rozz w khodar.

arabic: ان شاء الله الطبق هيكون حلو
english: God willing, the dish will be good.
transliteration: In sha Allah ettapaq haykoun helw.

arabic: الدنيا بتمطر برا وكلنا قاعدين في البيت
english: It's raining outside and we are all sitting at home.
transliteration: El-donya betmatar barra w kollena aa'deen fil-beit.

arabic: جدتي قاعدة بتشرب شاي وبتبص من الشباك
english: My grandma is sitting, drinking tea, and looking out the window.
transliteration: Gaddeti aa'da betshrab shay w betboss men el-shebbak.

arabic: اخويا قاعد مع التليفون بتاعه بيلعب العاب
english: My brother is sitting with his phone playing games.
transliteration: Akhouya aa'ed ma' el-telefoon beta'o biyel'ab al'aab.

arabic: جدتي قالت زمان كنا بنقرا كتب
english: Grandma said, "Before, we used to read books."
transliteration: Gaddeti 'alet zamaan kunna ben'ara kotob.

arabic: دلوقتي كل واحد بيحب التليفونات
english: Now, everyone loves phones.
transliteration: Delwa'ti koll wahed bihebb el-telefoonaat.

arabic: انا كنت ماشي و تهت
english: I was walking and got lost.
transliteration: Ana kunt maashi w tehet.

arabic: انا مش عارف فين الشارع
english: I don't know where the street is.
transliteration: Ana mish 'aref feen el shaare'.

arabic: سألت راجل ممكن تساعدني
english: I asked a man: Can you help me?
transliteration: Sa'alt raagel: mumkin tisa'edni?

arabic: هو قال لي امشي على طول وبعدين يمين
english: He told me: Go straight and then right.
transliteration: Howa 'al li: emshi 'ala tool w ba'deen yameen.

arabic: قلت له شكرا و لقيت الشارع
english: I told him "Thank you" and found the street.
transliteration: Oult lo shukran w la'eet el shaare'.

arabic: منى صحيت متأخرة. هما فين دلوقتي؟ الجامعة شغالة!
english: Mona woke up late. Where are they now? University is open!
transliteration: Mona sahit meta'akhara. Homa fein delwa'ti? El-gama'a shaghala!

arabic: عايزة أشتري قميص جديد للمحاضرة النهاردة.
english: I want to buy a new shirt for today's lecture.
transliteration: Ayza ashtari amees gdeed lelmohadra ennaharda.

arabic: المول قريب من بيتها في شبرا، عند تل.
english: The mall is close to her house in Shubra, near a hill.
transliteration: El-mol areeb men beitaha fi Shubra, aand tal.

arabic: بس نسيت محفظتها في هدوم تانية.
english: But she forgot her wallet in other clothes.
transliteration: Bas nesyet mahfazet'ha fi hedoom tanya.

arabic: دلوقتي هأركب تاكسي يحود بسرعة للبيت.
english: Now I will take a taxi that turns quickly to the house.
transliteration: Delwa'ti harkab taksy yehood besor'a lelbet.

arabic: انا صحيت متاخر النهاردة
english: I woke up late today.
transliteration: Ana saheet met'akhkhar elnaharda

arabic: شربت شاي واكلت فطار بسرعة
english: I drank tea and ate breakfast quickly.
transliteration: Sharebt shay w akalt fetar besor3a

arabic: دورت على مفاتيحي ملقيتهاش
english: I looked for my keys but didn't find them.
transliteration: Dawwart 3ala mafateehy mal2eet'hash

arabic: يا خبر مفيش وقت للشغل
english: Oh no, there's no time for work!
transliteration: Ya khabar mafeesh wa't lel shoghl

arabic: وفي الاخر جريت على الشغل بابتسامة
english: And finally, I ran to work with a smile.
transliteration: W fel akher gereet 3al shoghl bebtesama

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد صديقي احمد
english: Today is my friend Ahmed's birthday.
transliteration: Ennaharda eid milad sadeeqi Ahmed.

arabic: عملت له كيكة كبيرة بيضا
english: I made him a big white cake.
transliteration: Amelt-lo keeka kabeera beida.

arabic: اصدقاء كتير جم البيت
english: Many friends came to the house.
transliteration: Asdeqaa' kteer gom el beit.

arabic: احمد كان فرحان قوي وشاف الهدية
english: Ahmed was very happy and saw the gift.
transliteration: Ahmed kan farhan qawi w shaf el hedeya.

arabic: بس الكيكة كانت علبة هدايا كبيرة
english: But the cake was a big gift box!
transliteration: Bas el keeka kanet elbet hadaya kabeera!

arabic: النهاردة الجمعة وهنخطط لرحلة بكره
english: Today is Friday and we will plan a trip for tomorrow.
transliteration: Elnaharda elgom'a we hanakhatat le rehla bokra.

arabic: عايزين نروح اسكندرية ونشوف البحر الجميل
english: We want to go to Alexandria and see the beautiful sea.
transliteration: Ayzeen nerouh Eskandareyya we neshof elbaHr elgameel.

arabic: صوت الموج هناك بيبقى حلو اوي ومريح
english: The sound of the waves there is very nice and relaxing.
transliteration: Sout elmawG henāk beyeb'a Helw awy we moreeH.

arabic: هنجهز الشنط والعربية الصبح بدري
english: We will prepare the bags and the car early in the morning.
transliteration: Hanegahez elshonaT wel'arabeyya elsobh badry.

arabic: انا مبسوط جدا بالرحلة دي
english: I am very happy with this trip.
transliteration: Ana mabsoot geddan belrehla dee.

arabic: النهاردة احنا رايحين نشوف الماتش في القهوة
english: Today we are going to watch the match at the cafe.
transliteration: El naharda ehna rayheen nishuf el matsh fel ahwa.

arabic: القهوة زحمة والناس مبسوطة
english: The cafe is crowded and people are happy.
transliteration: El ahwa zahma wel nas mabsoota.

arabic: بنشرب شاي وبنشجع فريقنا
english: We drink tea and cheer for our team.
transliteration: Binishrab shai we binishagga' faree'na.

arabic: فريقنا جاب جون والكل صرخ
english: Our team scored a goal and everyone screamed.
transliteration: Faree'na gab goon wel koll sarakh.

arabic: بعد الماتش بنتكلم عن الكورة شوية
english: After the match, we talk about football a little.
transliteration: Ba'd el matsh binitkallem 'an el koora showaya.

arabic: صباح الخير يا جارتي ازيك
english: Good morning, my neighbor, how are you?
transliteration: Sabah el kheir ya garti izzayik
storyTitle: My Neighbor and the Heavy Bag

arabic: الحمد لله انا كويسة ايه دي اللي في ايدك
english: Praise be to God, I am good. What is this in your hand?
transliteration: El Hamdulillah ana kwayyesa eh di elli fi eedik
storyTitle: My Neighbor and the Heavy Bag

arabic: دي شنطة كبيرة فيها اكل كتير
english: This is a big bag with a lot of food in it.
transliteration: Di shanta kabeera feeha akl keteer
storyTitle: My Neighbor and the Heavy Bag

arabic: انا رايحة السوق بس الشنطة تقيلة اوي
english: I'm going to the market, but the bag is very heavy.
transliteration: Ana rayha es sou' bas es shanta ta'eela awe
storyTitle: My Neighbor and the Heavy Bag

arabic: مفيش مشكلة انا ممكن اساعدك شوية
english: No problem, I can help you a little.
transliteration: Mafeesh moshkela ana momken asa'edek shwayya
storyTitle: My Neighbor and the Heavy Bag

arabic: عيد ميلاد تيتا النهاردة وكلنا بنحبها اوي
english: It's Grandma's birthday today and we all love her very much.
transliteration: Eid milad Tita el naharda we kollena benhebbaha awee

arabic: يلا نروح السوق الكبير نشتري فاكهة كتير عشان نعمل تورتة
english: Let's go to the big market to buy a lot of fruit to make a cake.
transliteration: Yalla nerooh el soo' el kibeer neshtary fakha keteer ashan na'mel torta

arabic: امي قالت لا انا عايزة فاكهة بس من غير تورتة
english: My mother said no, I want only fruit without a cake.
transliteration: Ommy qalet la ana ayza fakha bass men gheir torta

arabic: الجيل الصغير بيحب التورتة والجيل الكبير بيحب الفاكهة الطازة
english: The young generation loves cake and the old generation loves fresh fruit.
transliteration: El geel el sagheer beyhebb el torta wel geel el kibeer beyhebb el fakha el taza

arabic: بس في الاخر كلنا احتفلنا في البيت الكبير بسعادة
english: But in the end, we all celebrated happily in the big house.
transliteration: Bass fel akher kollena hettafalna fel bayt el kibeer besa'ada

arabic: انا تايه هنا في شارع كبير
english: I am lost here on a big street.
transliteration: Ana tayeh hena fi shaare' kebeer.

arabic: لو سمحت ممكن تساعدني
english: Excuse me, can you help me?
transliteration: Law samaht, mumken tesa'edni?

arabic: انا عاوز اروح محطة المترو هي فين
english: I want to go to the metro station, where is it?
transliteration: Ana 'awiz arouh mahattet el-metro, heya feen?

arabic: الراجل قال روح يمين وبعدين شمال
english: The man said: Go right and then left.
transliteration: El-ragel 'al: Rouh yameen we ba'deen shimaal.

arabic: بس هو كمان قال انا كمان تايه مش عارف الطريق
english: But he also said: I am also lost, I don't know the way.
transliteration: Bas howwa kaman 'al: Ana kaman tayeh mesh 'aref el-taree'.

arabic: اليوم انا عايزة اشتري هدوم جديدة
english: Today I want to buy new clothes.
transliteration: El-yoom ana ayza ashtari hedoom gedeeda

arabic: انا هروح السوق عشان اشوف هدوم حلوة
english: I will go to the market to see nice clothes.
transliteration: Ana haruuh es-sou' ashan ashuuf hedoom helwa

arabic: ممكن اشتري قميص جديد ولون ازرق
english: Maybe I will buy a new shirt and a blue color.
transliteration: Momken ashtari amees gedeed we loon azra'

arabic: بعد كده ممكن اكل حاجة في السوق
english: After that, maybe I will eat something in the market.
transliteration: Ba'd keda momken akol haga fe es-sou'

arabic: وبعدين هاجي البيت
english: And then I will come home.
transliteration: Waba'deen hagi el-beit

arabic: النهاردة كان ماتش كورة مهم اوي في الاستاد
english: Today was a very important football match in the stadium.
transliteration: Elnaharda kan match kora mohem awy fel estad

arabic: الجماهير كانت كتيرة والجو كان حر جدا
english: The crowd was large and the weather was very hot.
transliteration: Elgamaheer kanet keteera wel gaw kan harr geddan

arabic: انا باكل ترمس وانا بتفرج على الماتش بحماس
english: I am eating lupini beans while watching the match with enthusiasm.
transliteration: Ana bakol termis wana batfarag 3ala elmatch behamas

arabic: لما فريقنا جاب جول كل الناس صرخوا بفرحة كبيرة
english: When our team scored a goal, everyone screamed with great joy.
transliteration: Lamma faree'na gab goal kol elnas sarakho befara7a kebeera

arabic: إحنا بناكل فشار دلوقتي وبنحتفل بالفوز الحلو ده
english: We are eating popcorn now and celebrating this sweet victory.
transliteration: E7na banakol feshar delwa'ty webne7tafel bel fawz el7elw da

arabic: النهاردة عيلة احمد اتجمعت للغدا
english: Today Ahmed's family gathered for lunch.
transliteration: Elnaharda 3eilet Ahmed etgam3et lel ghada.

arabic: الام والاب والاولاد كلهم كانوا موجودين
english: Mom, dad, and all the kids were present.
transliteration: El omm wel abb wel awlad kollohom kano mawgoudin.

arabic: الاكل كان حلو اوي والكل كان مبسوط
english: The food was very good and everyone was happy.
transliteration: Elakl kan helw awy wel kol kan mabsoot.

arabic: كانوا بيتكلموا ويضحكوا مع بعض كتير
english: They were talking and laughing a lot together.
transliteration: Kanoo beyetkalemo weyed7ako ma3 ba3d keteer.

arabic: دي لحظة عائلية دافية وجميلة
english: This is a warm and beautiful family moment.
transliteration: Di la7za 3a2eleya dafeya we gameela.

arabic: النهاردة عيد ميلاد سارة
english: Today is Sarah's birthday.
transliteration: Elnaharda eid milad Sara

arabic: اهلها واصحابها جم يحتفلوا
english: Her family and friends came to celebrate.
transliteration: Ahlaha w ashabaha gam yahtafelo

arabic: كان فيه تورته كبيرة وشمع
english: There was a big cake and candles.
transliteration: Kan fe torta kabeera w shama'

arabic: كله قال كل سنة وانتي طيبة وادوا هدايا
english: Everyone said "Happy Birthday" and gave gifts.
transliteration: Kollo al kol sana w enti tayeba w addo hadaya

arabic: كان يوم حلو قوي لسارة
english: It was a very happy day for Sarah.
transliteration: Kan yom helw awi li Sara

arabic: امبارح اشتريت هدية لصديقي من محل كبير
english: Yesterday I bought a gift for my friend from a big shop.
transliteration: Embare7 eshtarait hedeya le sadeeqi men ma7al kebeer.

arabic: الهدية دي كانت لونها احمر وريحتها حلوة جدا
english: This gift was red and smelled very sweet.
transliteration: El hedeya di kanet lonha a7mar w re7etha 7elwa giddan.

arabic: بس لما روحت البيت عرفت انها مش مقاسي
english: But when I went home, I knew it wasn't my size.
transliteration: Bas lamma rowwa7t el beet 3ereft ennaha mesh ma2asi.

arabic: الراجل اللي بيشتغل هناك كان لطيف جدا
english: The man who works there was very kind.
transliteration: El ragel elly bieshtaghal henaka kan lateef giddan.

arabic: رجعت الهدية للمحل والجو بره كان ساقعة
english: I returned the gift to the shop and the weather outside was cold.
transliteration: Ragga3t el hedeya lel ma7al wel gaww barra kan sa23a.

arabic: انا كنت ماشي و تهت شفت راجل كبير و قولت مساء الخير عامل ايه
english: I was walking and got lost. I saw an old man and said "Good evening, how are you?"
transliteration: Ana kont mashy w tehet. Shoft ragel kebir w olt "Masaa el kheer, aamel eh?"
storyTitle: Getting Lost and Asking for Directions

arabic: هو رد الحمد لله انا قولت لو سمحت فين المحطة
english: He replied "Praise be to God." I said "Please, where is the station?"
transliteration: Howa radd "Alhamdulillah." Ana olt "Law samaht, feen el mahatta?"
storyTitle: Getting Lost and Asking for Directions

arabic: الراجل ابتسم و قال عايز تروح المحطة
english: The man smiled and said "Do you want to go to the station?"
transliteration: El ragel ibtasam w aal "Ayez tarouh el mahatta?"
storyTitle: Getting Lost and Asking for Directions

arabic: انا قولت ايوه اروح ازاي قال امشي طوالي و بعدين خد يمين عند المسجد
english: I said "Yes, how do I go there?" He said "Go straight, then turn right at the mosque."
transliteration: Ana olt "Aywa, arouh izzay?" Aal "Emshy tawaly w ba'deen khod yemeen 'and el masged."
storyTitle: Getting Lost and Asking for Directions

arabic: انا شكرته و هو قال العفو
english: I thanked him and he said "You're welcome."
transliteration: Ana shakarto w howa aal "El afw."
storyTitle: Getting Lost and Asking for Directions

arabic: انا قررت اطبخ اكل جديد النهارده
english: I decided to cook a new dish today.
transliteration: Ana qarrart atbokh akl gedid ennaharda

arabic: الصبح رحت السوق عشان اجيب خضار
english: In the morning I went to the market to get vegetables.
transliteration: Essobh roht essouq ashan ageeb khodar

arabic: اشتريت خضار ولحمه من هناك
english: I bought vegetables and meat from there.
transliteration: Eshtarait khodar we lahma men henāk

arabic: رجعت البيت وطبخت الاكل دلوقتي
english: I returned home and cooked the food now.
transliteration: Rega't elbeit we tabakht elakl delwa'ty

arabic: الاكل ده حلو اوي
english: This food is very tasty.
transliteration: Elakl dah helw awi

arabic: في يوم ممطر بعد الضهر البيت كله اتجمع حوالين السفرة
english: On a rainy afternoon, the whole family gathered around the dining table.
transliteration: Fi yom momater ba'd el-dohr el-beit kollo etgam' hawalein el-sofra.

arabic: ماما كانت عاملة محاشي بتشهي خدت منها مجهود كبير بس فرحتنا تستاهل
english: Mom had made delicious stuffed vegetables, which took a lot of effort, but our joy was worth it.
transliteration: Mama kanet amla mahashi betshahhi khadet menha maghoud kebir bas farhetna testahel.

arabic: الكل كان مبسوط الجدود والاحفاد بيضحكوا ويدردشوا عن ايام زمان
english: Everyone was happy, grandparents and grandchildren laughing and chatting about old times.
transliteration: El-kol kan mabsoot el-gedood wel-ahfad beyedhakou weyedardashou 'an ayyam zaman.

arabic: اللمة دي كانت بتدفيني اكتر من اي دفاية في البرد ده
english: This gathering warmed me more than any heater in this cold weather.
transliteration: El-lamma di kanet betdaffini aktar men ay daffaya fi el-bard da.

arabic: كل جيل كان بيحكي حكاية بتوصلنا ببعض وبتخلي اليوم مميز
english: Each generation was telling a story that connected us and made the day special.
transliteration: Kol geel kan beyahki hekaya betwasalna beba'd webetkhalli el-yom momayez.

arabic: انا النهار ده بعمل اكل جديد
english: Today I am making new food.
transliteration: Ana el naharda ba'mel akl gedid.

arabic: ده اول طبق ليا
english: This is my first dish.
transliteration: Da awwal tabaq leya.

arabic: فيه حاجات كتير في الطبق ده
english: There are many things in this dish.
transliteration: Fih hagaat ketiir fil tabaq da.

arabic: انا عايز الاكل يكون حلو
english: I want the food to be good.
transliteration: Ana aayez el akl yekun helw.

arabic: يا رب يطلع حلو مش مش حلو
english: I hope it turns out good, not not good.
transliteration: Ya rabb yetla' helw mush mush helw.

arabic: موبايلي رن فجأة
english: My phone rang suddenly.
transliteration: Mobily rann faga'a.

arabic: كانت صاحبتي بتتصل
english: It was my friend calling.
transliteration: Kanet sahbeti bettessel.

arabic: صوتها كان فرحان أوي
english: Her voice was very happy.
transliteration: Sot'ha kan farhan awi.

arabic: انا ضحكت بصوت عالي
english: I laughed loudly.
transliteration: Ana dehekt besot aali.

arabic: المكالمة كانت حلوة خالص
english: The call was very nice.
transliteration: El mokalma kanet helwa khales.

arabic: انا رحت السوق النهاردة الصبح
english: I went to the market this morning
transliteration: Ana roht el souq ennaharda el sobh

arabic: شفت حاجات كتير والوان حلوة كنت مبسوط اوي
english: I saw many things and beautiful colors, I was very happy
transliteration: Shoft hagaat keteer w alwaan helwa kont mabsut awi

arabic: فجأة مالقيتش صاحبي جنبي كنت قلقان شوية
english: Suddenly I didn't find my friend next to me, I was a little worried
transliteration: Faga'a malqeetsh sahby gamby kont alaan showaya

arabic: بعدين لقيته عند محل الفاكهة وحسيت اني مستريح
english: Then I found him at the fruit shop and I felt comfortable
transliteration: Ba'deen la'eeto 'and mahal el fakha w haseet enny mistariih

arabic: رجعت البيت بعد يوم طويل كنت تعبان بس مبسوط
english: I returned home after a long day, I was tired but happy
transliteration: Rega't el beit ba'd yom taweel kont tabaan bas mabsut

arabic: انا عايز اشتري هدوم جديدة للعيد
english: I want to buy new clothes for Eid.
transliteration: Ana ayez ashtary hedoom gedeeda lel Eid

arabic: روحت محل كبير اوي بس كل حاجة كانت غالية
english: I went to a very big shop, but everything was expensive.
transliteration: Roht mahall kabeer awi bas kol haga kanet ghalya

arabic: شفت قميص حلو بس مقاسي مش موجود
english: I saw a nice shirt, but my size wasn't available.
transliteration: Shoft amees helw bas maqasy mesh mawgood

arabic: البياع قالي مفيش مقاسك انت كبير شوية
english: The salesman told me, "Your size isn't here, you're a bit big!"
transliteration: El baya' qalli "mafeesh maqasak, enta kabeer showaya!"

arabic: ضحكت وقولت خلاص هروح اكل بدل ما اشتري هدوم
english: I laughed and said, "Okay, I'll go eat instead of buying clothes!"
transliteration: Dehekt w olt "khalas harooh akol badal ma ashtary hedoom!"

arabic: سمير شاف صندوق صغير.
english: Samir saw a small box.
transliteration: Samir shaf sandouq soghayyar.

arabic: إيه ده؟ هو بيفكر.
english: What is this? He thinks.
transliteration: Eih da? Howa biyifakkar.

arabic: سمير طالب في الجامعه.
english: Samir is a university student.
transliteration: Samir talib fi el-gam'a.

arabic: كان بيذاكر هنا كتير.
english: He used to study here a lot.
transliteration: Kan biyizaker hena kiteer.

arabic: هو بيحب يشرب كركديه.
english: He likes to drink karkade.
transliteration: Howa biyhebb yeshrab karkadeh.

arabic: صاحب القهوة مشغول خالص.
english: The coffeehouse owner is very busy.
transliteration: Sahib el-ahwa mashghoul khales.

arabic: طب، هو هيروح جوه.
english: Ok, he will go inside.
transliteration: Tab, howa hayrouh gowwa.

arabic: قعد وطلب كركديه.
english: He sat down and ordered karkade.
transliteration: A'ad we talab karkadeh.

arabic: الصندوق لسه موجود.
english: The box is still there.
transliteration: El-sandouq lessa mawgoud.

arabic: هيتكلم بعدين، عادي.
english: He will speak later, it's normal.
transliteration: Hayitkallim ba'dein, a'adi.

arabic: الجو كان مطر كتير بعد الضهر
english: The weather was very rainy after noon.
transliteration: El gaww kan matar keteir ba'd el dohr.

arabic: انا كنت قاعد في البيت جنب الشباك
english: I was sitting in the house next to the window.
transliteration: Ana kont qa'id fi el bayt gamb el shubbak.

arabic: سمعت صوت المطر وكان الجو بارد
english: I heard the sound of the rain and the weather was cold.
transliteration: Semi't sout el matar w kan el gaww barid.

arabic: انا كنت مبسوط اوي وانا بشرب شاي
english: I was very happy while drinking tea.
transliteration: Ana kont mabsut awi wana bashrab shay.

arabic: ده كان يوم جميل في البيت
english: This was a beautiful day at home.
transliteration: Da kan yom gamil fi el bayt.

arabic: صباح الخير احمد بيصحى بدري للشغل
english: Good morning, Ahmed wakes up early for work.
transliteration: Sabah el kheer, Ahmed bisaha badri lel shoghl.

arabic: هو عايز يروح شغله دلوقتي بسرعة
english: He wants to go to his work now quickly.
transliteration: Howa ayiz yerooh shoglo delwa'ty bosor'a.

arabic: مامته بتقوله يا احمد كل اكل الفطار
english: His mom tells him, 'Oh Ahmed, eat your breakfast food.'
transliteration: Mamto bet'ollo ya Ahmed kol akl el fetar.

arabic: احمد بيحب يشوف الموبايل لكن مامته بتحب الاكل
english: Ahmed likes to look at his mobile phone, but his mom likes food.
transliteration: Ahmed bihebb yeshoof el mobile laken mamto bethebb el akl.

arabic: هي عايزة كل يوم ياكل كويس قبل الشغل
english: She wants him to eat well every day before work.
transliteration: Heya ayza kol yoom yakol kwayes abl el shoghl.

arabic: انا رحت السوق النهاردة
english: I went to the market today.
transliteration: Ana roht el soo' el naharda.

arabic: كنت عايز اشتري خضار وفاكهة
english: I wanted to buy vegetables and fruit.
transliteration: Kont ayiz ashtari khodaar w fakiha.

arabic: السوق كان كبير قوي وزحمة
english: The market was very big and crowded.
transliteration: El soo' kan kibeer qawi w zahma.

arabic: لقيت طماطم حمرا وتفاح اخضر
english: I found red tomatoes and green apples.
transliteration: Laqeet tamatem hamra w tuffah akhdar.

arabic: لكن قطة صغيرة جريت وخدت فلوسي
english: But a small cat ran and took my money.
transliteration: Laken qetta soghayyara gereet w khadet foloosi.

arabic: انا روحت المحل النهاردة
english: I went to the shop today.
transliteration: Ana roht el mahal ennaharda.

arabic: كنت عايز اشتري قميص جديد
english: I wanted to buy a new shirt.
transliteration: Kont ayiz ashtary amees gdeed.

arabic: المحل كان فيه هدوم حلوة كتير
english: The shop had many beautiful clothes.
transliteration: El mahal kan feeh hedoom helwa keteer.

arabic: انا قست قميص ازرق كان ناعم
english: I tried on a blue shirt, it was soft.
transliteration: Ana ast amees azraq kan na'em.

arabic: انا اشتريته وروحت البيت مبسوط
english: I bought it and went home happy.
transliteration: Ana eshtaraytuh wa roht el beit mabsoot.

arabic: انا رحت ازور تيتا امبارح
english: I went to visit Grandma yesterday.
transliteration: Ana roht azour teta embareh.

arabic: هي قعدت تتفرج على التلفزيون وانا كنت مشغول بالموبايل
english: She sat watching TV and I was busy with my phone.
transliteration: Heya qa'adet tetfarag 'ala el-televezyoun w ana kont mashghoul bel-mobile.

arabic: هي طلبت كركديه عشان تشرب
english: She ordered karkadeh to drink.
transliteration: Heya talabet karkadeh 'ashan teshrab.

arabic: انا قولت لها انا عايز اروح القهوة مع اصحابي
english: I told her I want to go to the cafe with my friends.
transliteration: Ana olt leha ana 'ayez arouh el-ahwa ma'a ashabi.

arabic: هي قالت لي انت لازم بتذاكر مش تلعب طول الوقت
english: She told me, "You should be studying, not playing all the time."
transliteration: Heya a'aletli enta lazim betzaker mesh tel'ab toul el-wa't.

arabic: مريم اتصلت بصاحبتها سارة عشان يدردشوا شوية عن يومهم العادي
english: Maryam called her friend Sarah to chat a bit about their usual day
transliteration: Maryam ettasalet be-sahbet-ha Sara 'ashan yedardashu shwaya 'an yom-hom el-'adi

arabic: سارة قالت انها الفترة دي بيواجه صعوبة في تنظيم وقتها بين الشغل والبيت
english: Sarah said that this period she faces difficulty organizing her time between work and home
transliteration: Sara 'alet en-naha el-fatara di beywageh soouba fi tanzim wa't-ha bein el-shoghl wel-beit

arabic: مريم اقترحت عليها يعملوا عزومة صغيرة يجمعوا فيها اصحابه القدام عشان اللمة
english: Maryam suggested they make a small gathering/invitation to gather her old friends for the togetherness
transliteration: Maryam eqtarahet 'aleha ya'melu 'azouma soghayyara yegammu fiha ashab-ha el-'odam 'ashan el-lamma

arabic: سارة ابتسمت وقالت انها مستعدة تبذل مجهود كبير عشان تحضر محاشي كتير للكل
english: Sarah smiled and said she is ready to put in a lot of effort to prepare a lot of mahashi for everyone
transliteration: Sara ebtasamet we 'alet en-naha mosta'edda tabzoul maghoud kebir 'ashan tehadder mahashi ketir lel-kol

arabic: ديما بيبقوا فاكرين ان الصداقة الحقيقية بتفضل لاي جيل مهما اتغيرت الظروف
english: They always remember that true friendship lasts for any generation no matter how circumstances change
transliteration: Dima be-yeb'u fakrin en el-sada'a el-haqi'iyya betefdal le-ay geel mahma etghayyaret el-zourouf

arabic: النهاردة فيه ماتش كورة مهم
english: Today there is an important football match.
transliteration: Elnaharda feh match kora mohem.

arabic: أنا بتفرج عليه مع أصحابي في البيت
english: I am watching it with my friends at home.
transliteration: Ana batfarag aleih ma' as7aby fel beit.

arabic: إحنا بناكل ترمس وبنشرب شاي واحنا مبسوطين
english: We are eating lupini beans and drinking tea while we are happy.
transliteration: E7na banakol termos w banshrab shay w e7na mabsooteen.

arabic: اللاعيبة بيلعبوا كويس اوي والجو حماسي
english: The players are playing very well and the atmosphere is exciting.
transliteration: Ella'eeba biyel'abou kwayes awi wel gaw 7amasy.

arabic: نفسي فريقنا يكسب النهاردة
english: I wish our team wins today.
transliteration: Nafsy faree'na yeksab elnaharda.

arabic: كنت ماشي في الشارع
english: I was walking in the street.
transliteration: Kunt maashi fi esh-shaare'.

arabic: شفت صاحبي القديم
english: I saw my old friend.
transliteration: Shoft saHbi el-adeem.

arabic: كنت مبسوط اوي لما شفته
english: I was very happy when I saw him.
transliteration: Kunt mabsooT awi lamma shoftoh.

arabic: قلت له ازيك عامل ايه
english: I said to him, "How are you doing?"
transliteration: Oult loh izzayyak 'aamel eh.

arabic: قعدنا نتكلم شوية هنا
english: We sat and talked a little here.
transliteration: 'Adna nitkallim shwayya hena.

arabic: انا كل يوم بروح القهوة
english: Every day I go to the cafe.
transliteration: Ana kol yoom barooh el ahwa

arabic: بستنى صاحبي هناك
english: I wait for my friend there.
transliteration: Bastanna sahby henak

arabic: بشرب شاي وبقرا كتاب
english: I drink tea and read a book.
transliteration: Bashrab shay w ba'ra ketaab

arabic: الوقت بيعدي بسرعة
english: Time passes quickly.
transliteration: El wa't bya'addi besor'a

arabic: بعد شوية صاحبي بيوصل
english: After a while my friend arrives.
transliteration: Ba'd shwaya sahby byowsal

arabic: احمد بيتفرج على ماتش كورة النهاردة
english: Ahmed is watching a football match today.
transliteration: Ahmad biyitfarag 'ala matsh koora innaharda.

arabic: هو فرحان اوي بالتيم بتاعه
english: He is very happy with his team.
transliteration: Huwa farhan awi bil-teem bita'o.

arabic: التيم بتاعه جاب جون
english: His team scored a goal.
transliteration: Il-teem bita'o gab goon.

arabic: احمد صرخ يا سلام وسقف كتير
english: Ahmed shouted "Wow!" and clapped a lot.
transliteration: Ahmad sarakh ya salam w sa'af kiteer.

arabic: هو مبسوط عشان تيمو كسب
english: He is happy because his team won.
transliteration: Huwa mabsoot 'ashan teemo kisib.
